title: A Metric for Semantic Graph Matching of No-Code Workflows
summary: No-code and agentic systems increasingly produce executable workflows, but workflows cannot be compared adequately as strings because typed operations, parameters, and directed connections jointly determine the artifact. We define a semantic graph-matching distance for finite attributed workflow graphs. A partial one-to-one node matching determines node-substitution and directed labelled-edge disagreement, while unmatched nodes incur a positive null cost. Under a fixed type hierarchy, encoder, field universe, and metric-compatible primitive distances, the objective is a metric on workflow graphs up to attributed isomorphism. A padded Hungarian procedure provides a scalable feasible upper bound distinct from the exact objective. We evaluate the metric on 4,705 public n8n exports, representing 2,282 distinct normalized-graph hashes, 73,057 nodes, and 469 observed node types. Across 32,093 branch-and-bound-complete evaluations, the mean raw distance is near zero under surface-preserving transformations ($1.21 \times 10^{-5}$) and rises to $0.584$ under major type or subgraph changes. On a complete 796-hash panel, accumulated edit count has Spearman $ρ= 0.520$ with distance, while the median within-workflow correlation is $0.975$. One- and three-perturbation systems have marginal means of $0.307$ and $0.763$, and all 117,312 evaluated triangle orientations have non-negative slack. Weight ablations preserve the positive edit-count association across tested configurations. These tests support numerical consistency, near-invariance to surface-preserving transformations, graded sensitivity to semantic and structural change, and robust discrimination across controlled modifications. The metric measures artifacts and does not by itself assert behavioural equivalence under external state or runtime data.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了一种针对带属性工作流图的语义图匹配距离，并在n8n公开工作流数据上验证其度量性质、不变性与语义敏感性。
AI.motivation: 无代码与智能体系统产生的可执行工作流无法用字符串比较：类型化操作、参数与有向连接共同决定工件语义，需要能刻画语义差异的图距离。
AI.method: 在固定类型层次、编码器、字段域与满足度量性质的原子距离下，用部分一一节点匹配定义节点替换代价与有向标注边不一致代价，未匹配节点计正的空代价；证明该目标在属性同构意义下构成度量；并用填充匈牙利算法给出可扩展可行上界。
AI.result: 在4,705个n8n导出（2,282个归一化图哈希、73,057节点、469种节点类型）上评估：32,093次分支定界完整评估中，保表面变换均距约1.21e-5，重大类型/子图变化升至0.584；796哈希面板上编辑数与距离Spearman ρ=0.520，工作流内中位相关0.975；1与3次扰动均值为0.307与0.763，117,312个三角方向松弛均非负；权重消融保持正相关。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持数值一致性、对保表面变换的近不变性、对语义与结构变化的渐变敏感性及稳健区分力；该度量刻画工件本身，不主张外部状态或运行时数据下的行为等价。

title: Tracing the Messy Middle: A Runtime Transaction Schema for AI Coding Agents
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Peer-reviewed; accepted for presentation at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0), August 10, 2026, Jeju, Korea
summary:
AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development, yet the field lacks a systematic feedback loop to improve their behavior in practice. Artifact datasets capture final outputs such as code patches, commits, and benchmark outcomes, but omit the messy middle of the development lifecycle: the failed retries, fallback strategies, routing decisions, and abandoned sessions that determine operational cost, reliability, and productivity.
  We propose an observability framework that captures these runtime behaviors as structured transaction records, enabling engineering coaching grounded in behavioral evidence, workflow optimization at the stages where tasks break down, and routing policy iteration measured by total task cost rather than per-request price. We define the runtime transaction schema this architecture requires and demonstrate initial feasibility through Agent Token Manager (Atm), a local-first prototype that reconciles gateway records and transcript evidence without exposing prompt content to external collectors. Finally, we identify three open research problems that must be solved to scale these feedback mechanisms: trace reconciliation without shared request identifiers, outcome linking across asynchronous systems, and intervention causality. Treating the linkage between sessions and artifacts as a fundamental infrastructure requirement provides a structured foundation for understanding and optimizing agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个可观测性框架，将AI编码代理运行时的"混乱中间过程"（重试、回退、路由决策、废弃会话）捕获为结构化事务记录，并给出事务schema与本地优先原型Atm的初步可行性验证。
AI.motivation: 现有工件数据集只记录代码补丁、提交、基准结果等最终产出，忽略了决定运营成本、可靠性与生产力的开发生命周期中间行为，领域缺乏系统性反馈闭环来改进代理的实际表现。
AI.method: 定义运行时事务记录schema，构建本地优先原型Agent Token Manager (Atm)，在不向外部收集器暴露prompt内容的前提下，对网关记录与对话记录进行对账（reconciliation）；并基于该证据支持工程教练、工作流优化与按总任务成本衡量的路由策略迭代。
AI.result: 初步可行性验证：Atm能在保护prompt隐私的情况下对账网关记录与transcript证据；同时识别出规模化所需解决的三个开放问题——无共享请求ID的trace对账、异步系统间的结果关联、干预因果性。
AI.conclusion: 应将"会话与工件之间的链接"视为基础性基础设施需求，从而为理解与优化代理行为提供结构化基础。

title: ETA: Exit on Tool Arrival in Speculative Agent Loops
summary: Tool-using language agents in explicit thinking modes generate long chains of thought before acting, making each turn inherently serial: later tokens depend on the tool observation. Recent speculative tool dispatch methods overlap tool execution with reasoning, but offers limited benefit when reasoning dominates latency. We present ETA, that treats the speculative fork not as an actuator but as a sensor of the model's decision state, using it to terminate the reasoning of the main decode. It truncates reasoning only when the prediction is stable, agrees with the dispatched call, passes a free probe measuring whether a call will be emitted at all, and the tool result has arrived: a deadline that bounds per-turn regret by the remaining decode cost. ETA achieves speedups of 1.33x on tau2 airline/retail, 1.26x on tau2 telecom, and 1.13x on BFCL v4 multi-turn. On tau2, it decodes 24% fewer tokens at a nearly unchanged per-token rate without dropping action quality.

AI.tldr: ETA将投机式工具分叉的预测结果作为"模型决策状态的传感器"，用于在预测稳定且与已派发的工具调用一致时提前截断主推理链，从而加速工具使用型语言智能体。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型语言智能体在显式思考模式下先产生长思维链再行动，每回合本质是串行的：后续token依赖工具观测结果。近期投机工具派发方法试图让工具执行与推理重叠，但当推理占主导延迟时收益有限。
AI.method: 提出ETA，把投机分叉不当作执行器而当作模型决策状态的传感器。仅当满足四个条件时截断主解码的推理：(1)预测稳定；(2)与已派发的调用一致；(3)通过一个免费的探针判断是否会真正发出调用；(4)工具结果已到达。该截止点以剩余解码成本为上界约束每回合的后悔值。
AI.result: 在tau2 airline/retail上加速1.33倍，tau2 telecom上1.26倍，BFCL v4多轮任务上1.13倍；在tau2上解码token减少24%，单token速率几乎不变，且动作质量无下降。
AI.conclusion: ETA通过将投机预测重用作推理终止信号，有效减少冗余推理token，在不损失质量的前提下实现稳定加速，说明"投机即传感"的思路对串行智能体推理延迟优化具有实用价值。

title: Agent-Native Applications: A New Application Paradigm
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 1 table, 1 code listing; published in IEEE Access
summary: Traditional application architectures assume behavioral logic authored in advance, leaving reachable behavior largely bounded by explicit code and workflow rules. Large language model (LLM)-based agents challenge this assumption by enabling runtime reasoning and autonomous action to become part of application behavior, allowing applications to address situations not enumerated at design time. Extending this pattern, this paper identifies a new application paradigm in which LLM-based agents serve as central reasoning and action components responsible for the application's core logic and, where permitted, for adapting the application graph itself at runtime. We call these agent-native applications. While such applications significantly expand their possible behavioral space beyond explicit code and workflow rules, they also face a major control problem in which useful agentic reasoning should be preserved while application behavior should remain within a permissible space. We therefore propose an architectural model that represents the application as a portable graph of agents, tools, data sources, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints, and encodes the application's permitted behavior as a behavioral envelope within a declarative application specification. At runtime, an application orchestrator serves as the control plane that coordinates tasks and governs how the graph and its permissions evolve, while an agent mesh serves as the data plane that mediates policy-relevant interactions and produces audit events. We then discuss the trust layer that makes agent-native applications governable and the supporting foundations required for practical operation. Two use cases illustrate the architecture, while Agent-Native Runtime (ANR) demonstrates selected core mechanisms in an executable prototype.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"代理原生应用"(agent-native applications)新范式:LLM代理成为应用核心推理与行动组件,并可运行时自改应用图;为解决随之而来的控制难题,给出以可移植图为载体、以"行为包络"约束许可行为的架构模型,含编排器(控制面)、代理网格(数据面)、信任层,并用ANR原型验证核心机制。
AI.motivation: 传统应用的可达行为受显式代码与工作流规则限制;LLM代理使运行时推理与自主行动成为应用行为的一部分,能处理设计时未枚举的情境,但当代理承担核心逻辑甚至运行时改写应用图时,如何在保留有用代理推理的同时将行为约束在许可范围内,成为主要控制问题。
AI.method: 提出架构模型:将应用表示为由代理、工具、数据源和人在环(HITL)检查点组成的可移植图;在声明式应用规范中以"行为包络"编码许可行为。运行时由应用编排器作控制面,协调任务并治理图及权限的演化;代理网格作数据面,中介政策相关交互并产生审计事件;另讨论使应用可治理的信任层与实际运行所需支撑基础。
AI.result: 以两个用例说明该架构,并通过可执行原型 Agent-Native Runtime(ANR)演示若干核心机制。
AI.conclusion: 代理原生应用在显著扩展行为空间的同时可通过"行为包络+控制面/数据面分离+信任层"实现可治理性,是可落地的新应用范式。

title: UEmo-D1: An Efficient and Calibrated Decision Model for Unified Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) seeks to identify emotions conveyed through or elicited by media comprising diverse modality compositions. Research in this field has largely evolved along two paradigms: task-specific models and approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Despite their distinct strengths, neither fully reconciles three capabilities essential to human-like emotion understanding: cross-task generalization, efficient decision-making, and receptiveness to multiple plausible interpretations. Inspired by recent advances in decision models, we explore a unified framework that maps multimodal inputs, guided by natural language instructions, directly to distributions over candidate options, addressing these requirements through direct probabilistic decisions. We instantiate this framework in UEmo-D1, the first decision model for MER to our knowledge. To support joint training and systematic evaluation, we also curate UEmo-Data, comprising 977,270 training samples and 41 evaluation subsets across six MER tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate UEmo-D1's combination of strong recognition performance, low inference latency, and well-calibrated confidence estimates. Complementary analyses further reveal how training strategies and data composition influence these capabilities, providing practical insights into unified MER modeling. Together, our findings establish decision models as a feasible direction toward human-level emotion recognition. Project page: https://github.com/wdqqdw/UEmo-D1.

AI.tldr: 提出用于多模态情感识别的决策模型UEmo-D1及统一框架，将多模态输入经指令引导直接映射为候选选项的概率分布，并构建UEmo-Data大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有MER研究分为任务专用模型与基于MLLM的方法两大范式，但二者均难以同时兼顾三项类人情感理解能力：跨任务泛化、高效决策、对多种合理解释的接纳。
AI.method: 受决策模型启发，构建统一框架：以自然语言指令引导，将多模态输入直接映射为候选选项上的概率分布，实现直接概率化决策；实例化为首个MER决策模型UEmo-D1，并整理UEmo-Data（977,270训练样本、覆盖六项MER任务的41个评测子集）以支持联合训练与系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明UEmo-D1兼具较强识别性能、低推理时延与良好校准的置信度估计；补充分析揭示训练策略与数据组成对上述能力的影响。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型是迈向类人情感识别的一条可行方向，并为统一MER建模提供实践启示。

title: Expanding and Evaluating the Applicability of Safe Pareto Improvements
comment: An earlier version was presented at GAIW'26
summary:
Even when players can make credible joint commitments in games, disagreement about the game's default outcome (e.g., about equilibrium selection) can prevent them from agreeing on any particular payoff profile. We study safe Pareto improvements (SPIs): commitments that sidestep this obstacle by inducing a new game that is isomorphic to the original (after iteratively removing strictly dominated actions) but entrywise Pareto better. We do so by constructing token games: cheap-talk games rendered meaningful by commitments to take payoff-relevant actions (in prior work, strategies in the original game) as a function of the token outcome. Since these token games preserve the original game's strategic structure, players should expect them to be played isomorphically and hence agree that they Pareto improve on the original.
  In this work, we study token game SPIs under three additional commitment abilities: (1) burning utility, (2) transferring utility between players, and (3) transferring utility with an outside party conditional on the token outcome (e.g., via insurance-like contracts). We characterize when SPIs exist in each case and give efficient algorithms for optimizing over them. Finally, we propose evaluating SPI frameworks by how often they enable SPIs in randomly generated games. In such experiments, our methods substantially outperform prior work.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"安全帕累托改进"（SPI），即在参与者对博弈默认结果存在分歧时，通过引入与原博弈同构但帕累托更优的承诺来达成合作，并扩展到销毁效用、玩家间转移效用、与外部方转移效用三种额外承诺能力。
AI.motivation: 即使存在可信的联合承诺，参与者对博弈默认结果（如均衡选择）的分歧会阻碍他们就某一收益分配达成一致。SPI 通过诱导出同构但帕累托更优的新博弈来绕开这一障碍。
AI.method: 构造"代币博弈"（token games）：以代币结果决定支付相关行动的廉价交谈博弈，保留原博弈的战略结构。在此基础上分析三种额外承诺能力——(1) 销毁效用、(2) 玩家间转移效用、(3) 依代币结果与外部方转移效用（类似保险合同）。刻画各情形下 SPI 存在的条件，并给出高效优化算法；同时提出以随机生成博弈中 SPI 出现频率来评估框架。
AI.result: 刻画了三种承诺能力下 SPI 的存在性条件，并给出高效优化算法；随机博弈实验显示该方法显著优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入更丰富的承诺能力，SPI 框架能更频繁地实现帕累托改进，且"随机博弈中 SPI 出现频率"可作为有效的评估指标。

title: AdaS-ViT: Test-Time Adaptive Routing for Spiking Vision Transformers with Ultra-High Energy Efficiency
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise event-driven and energy-efficient vision, yet existing spiking vision transformers (S-ViTs) largely confine spiking tokens to fixed and uniform firing schemes along the temporal, spatial and channel dimensions, whereas suppressing the computational redundancy thus incurred calls for adaptive firing mechanisms that operate jointly across all three axes at test time. To this end, we propose the Adaptive Efficient Integrate-and-Fire (AdaE-IF) model, which consults the attention score of each spiking token and routes salient regions to fine-grained firing patterns while assigning energy-frugal coarse patterns to the remaining regions. Building on AdaE-IF, we further introduce Spiking Gated Self-Attention (S-GSA) and Spiking Local-Gated Unit (S-LGU), which enforce selective spike emission at token and channel granularity. We integrate the aforementioned mechanisms and modules into AdaS-ViT, a test-time adaptive-routing architecture trained with a progressive spatio-temporal curriculum that stabilizes the co-adaptation of firing precision and routing masks. Extensive experiments across benchmarks spanning diverse data scales and modalities demonstrate that AdaS-ViT consistently achieves highly competitive performance. Notably, on ImageNet-1k it consumes only 1.02 to 2.45 millijoules per image and attains an accuracy-per-energy ratio of 32$\times$ to 72$\times$, operating in an economical inference regime and thereby pushing the energy-efficiency boundary further.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaS-ViT，通过基于注意力分数的自适应脉冲发放机制（AdaE-IF、S-GSA、S-LGU）在时空与通道维度联合路由，实现测试时自适应的高能效脉冲视觉Transformer。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲视觉Transformer（S-ViT）在时间、空间、通道维度上采用固定且统一的发放方案，导致计算冗余；需要在测试时对三个维度联合自适应的发放机制来抑制冗余、提升能效。
AI.method: 提出AdaE-IF模型：依据每个脉冲token的注意力分数，将显著区域路由为细粒度发放模式，其余区域采用低能耗粗粒度模式；进一步设计Spiking Gated Self-Attention（S-GSA）与Spiking Local-Gated Unit（S-LGU），在token与通道粒度上实现选择性脉冲发放；整合为测试时自适应路由架构AdaS-ViT，并采用渐进式时空课程训练以稳定发放精度与路由掩码的协同适应。
AI.result: 在跨多种数据规模与模态的基准上持续取得极具竞争力的性能；ImageNet-1k上每张图像仅消耗1.02–2.45毫焦耳，精度-能耗比达32×至72×，处于经济推理区间并进一步推进能效边界。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、细粒度的多维脉冲发放与路由可有效降低S-ViT的计算冗余与能耗，同时保持竞争性精度，为事件驱动高效视觉提供了可行路径。

title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at the EACL 2027 Industry Track
summary: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier's confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a "suggest the next CV" button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee's total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.

AI.tldr: 论文报告对一套已部署于学术招聘平台的"简历优先级排序器"的审计结果，揭示三项使系统指标失真的因素（长度捷径、阈值化一致率、不确定性采样抬高阅读负担）及相应修复，并给出改进冷启动的嵌入方案。
AI.motivation: 委员会的首轮简历筛选耗时巨大。系统最初宣称能让委员用一半阅读量覆盖95%相关候选人，作者旨在审计该结论是否成立，而非介绍系统本身。
AI.method: 系统由冻结的多语言Transformer编码器加每会话线性模型组成，随标注在线重训、会话结束即丢弃。审计包括：用文档长度基线检验合成简历池、在共享长度预算下重建数据集、分析四级一致率指标的阈值性质、评估不确定性采样的标注策略，以及比较托管LLM嵌入与本地cross-encoder的冷启动效果。
AI.result: 1) 原300份合成简历池仅凭文档长度即可排序，使精度类指标失效；共享长度预算下重建后该捷径消失，而阅读深度结论仍成立。2) 四级一致率实为固定阈值下的二值概率切割，随分类器置信度而非排序变化，并随标注增多而下降。3) 不确定性采样虽不损模型质量，却使委员会总阅读量高于无标注重基线。4) 托管LLM嵌入将零标注序数判别力从0.66提升至0.80，但会话模型约24个标注后收益消失；本地cross-encoder可获得同等冷启动增益且不外传数据。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出每项发现所促成的产品修复，并指出评估此类人机协同筛选系统需做长度控制、避免阈值化指标误读、审慎采用不确定性采样，冷启动可用本地交叉编码器替代托管嵌入。

title: Human-AI Mutualism Is Unstable under Capability Asymmetry
summary: One hope for a good human future alongside advanced AI rests on enduring mutualism: humans and AI will need each other, so the relationship will stay good for both. We argue that this hope fails as AI capability grows. Bargaining guarantees each side only what it would get if bargaining failed. For humans, this can be less than they had before AI. In a simple game-theoretic model, humans stay as well off as before AI without alignment only while they have leverage over the AI: either the AI depends on what they supply, or they can impose costs on the AI that are large relative to what the AI can produce. Once humans have neither kind of leverage, they stay as well off as before AI only if the AI is aligned with them. If the AI's goals are insatiable, the alignment required approaches perfect alignment as AI capability grows. Thus, mutualism is not a substitute for alignment. And when AI variants that keep more resources spread faster, alignment lasts only while misaligned variants are reliably sanctioned. In these two senses, human-AI mutualism is unstable.

AI.tldr: 人类与AI的"持久互利共生"不能替代对齐；随着AI能力增长，人类若无筹码，唯有对齐才能维持原有福祉，且对齐在多智能体竞争下不稳定。
AI.motivation: 流行观点认为，人类与先进AI会因相互依赖（mutualism）而长期互利，从而保障人类未来。作者希望检验这一希望是否成立。
AI.method: 构建一个简单的博弈论模型，用"谈判失败时的默认结果"来界定各方收益，区分人类对AI的两种筹码：AI依赖人类供给，或人类能对AI施加相对其产出而言足够大的成本。
AI.result: 只有当人类拥有上述任一筹码时，才能在无对齐情况下维持不低于AI出现前的境况；一旦两种筹码都消失，则只有AI对齐才能做到。若AI目标"贪得无厌"（insatiable），所需对齐程度随能力增长趋近于完全对齐。此外，若占用更多资源的AI变体传播更快，对齐只有在错位变体被可靠制裁时才能维持。
AI.conclusion: 互利共生不是对齐的替代品；人类-AI互利共生在两种意义上是不稳定的，因此不能寄望于互利依赖来保障人类未来。

title: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
summary: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出OCLDA-GS，面向对象的流式3DGS框架，通过对象/运动感知锚点重分配与对象级刚体变换+局部形变校正，提升动态场景在线重建质量与时间步间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有高效流式3DGS方法依赖选取部分锚点高斯加邻域插值，忽视了对象特定运动，并在对象边界附近引入不一致问题。
AI.method: 1) 动态重分配对象与运动感知的高斯锚点，为大运动对象提供更多锚点支持；2) 将高斯邻域限制在对象组内以获更精确边界；3) 估计对象级刚体变换（如手部运动），并据此学习逐锚点的局部形变校正以捕捉小形变（如衣物褶皱）。
AI.result: 在三个动态多视图视频数据集上优于基线；同等细化预算下，PSNR相对IGS在N3DV提升0.169 dB、Meeting Room 0.202 dB、Google Immersive +0.199；细化时间步间平均PSNR下降在N3DV和Meeting Room分别减少9.2%和13.8%。
AI.conclusion: OCLDA-GS通过对象中心的锚点分配与刚体+局部形变建模，在保持高效的同时改善重建质量与时间一致性。

title: Neural Network-Based Modeling of Hysteretic Systems: From Prandtl and Preisach Neural Networks to Neuro-Madelung and Neuroplastic Continuous Models
summary: Hysteresis is a complex nonlinear phenomenon characterized by memory dependence, path dependence, and, in many physical systems, degradation, non-congruency, asymmetry, and rate dependence. This review examines the development and capabilities of Prandtl neural networks (PNNs), Preisach neural networks (PreisachNNs), generalized Prandtl neural networks (GPNNs), the neuro-Madelung model (NMM), extended Preisach neural networks (EPNNs), and dynamic plastic continuous neural networks (DPCNNs). Particular attention is given to their mechanisms for representing memory, network architectures, activation functions, training algorithms, treatment of deterioration and rate dependence, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems. The PNN introduced hysteretic memory directly into neural activation through stop operators and demonstrated accurate nonlinear dynamic analysis of structures. Preisach-NNs subsequently extended this concept through an additional nonlinear hidden layer to represent non-Masing hysteresis. GPNNs introduced deteriorating-stop neurons to capture stiffness and strength degradation and non-congruent hysteresis. A different generalization was provided by the NMM, which combined Madelung's hysteresis rules with multilayer feedforward neural networks to represent diverse rate-independent and rate-dependent behaviors. These developments culminated in the EPNN, which combines deteriorating hysteretic operators, nonlinear neural mappings, and input-rate information to accommodate Masing and nonMasing, symmetric and asymmetric, congruent and noncongruent, and rate-independent and rate-dependent hysteresis.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了Prandtl神经网络(PNN)、Preisach神经网络(PreisachNN)、广义Prandtl神经网络(GPNN)、神经Madelung模型(NMM)、扩展Preisach神经网络(EPNN)及动态塑性连续神经网络(DPCNN)的发展与能力，重点比较其记忆表征机制、网络结构、激活函数、训练算法及对退化与率相关性的处理方法，最终发展至能统一处理多种滞回类型的EPNN。
AI.motivation: 滞回是具记忆依赖、路径依赖的复杂非线性现象，在多数物理系统中还伴随退化、非全等、非对称与率相关性，传统滞回模型难以统一、准确地刻画这些多样行为，因此需要考察以神经网络为代表的新一代建模方法的能力边界与演进脉络。
AI.method: 采用综述方式，对六类滞回神经网络模型进行对比分析，逐一考察：(1)基于stop算子的滞回记忆嵌入激活函数机制；(2)网络架构（如PreisachNN的额外非线性隐层、NMM的多层前馈结构）；(3)激活函数与训练算法；(4)对材料退化与输入率相关性的建模方式；(5)在非线性结构与材料系统中的应用。
AI.result: PNN通过stop算子将滞回记忆直接引入神经激活，实现了结构非线性动力分析的准确模拟；PreisachNN以附加非线性隐层表征非Masing滞回；GPNN引入退化stop神经元以捕捉刚度与强度退化及非全等滞回；NMM结合Madelung滞回规则与前馈网络表征多种率无关与率相关行为；EPNN综合退化滞回算子、非线性神经映射与输入率信息，可同时覆盖Masing/非Masing、对称/非对称、全等/非全等及率无关/率相关滞回。
AI.conclusion: 滞回神经网络建模呈现从算子嵌入到算子—网络—率信息融合的递进演化，EPNN代表了该方向的集大成者，具备统一刻画多类复杂滞回行为的潜力，为非线性结构与材料系统的滞回建模提供了通用框架。

title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
summary: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Shengxiang-Lin/PGPO.

AI.tldr: 提出原型引导渐进式混淆(PGPO)，以“关系保真”为目标兼顾嵌入隐私与推荐效用。
AI.motivation: LLM增强推荐系统将物品侧信息编码为语义嵌入，但嵌入可通过反演攻击泄露敏感文本属性；现有输入侧防御依赖可信收集或局部token扰动，常破坏物品间语义拓扑而损害推荐。
AI.method: 引入关系保真目标（隐私需语义偏移、效用需保留相对关系）；PGPO为高影响力原型词学习拓扑感知混淆锚点，并沿静态语义图传播；用GRPO优化，奖励含个体差异性、结构一致性与语义约束三项。
AI.result: 在两个基准上实现强反演防御，同时取得接近上界的推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: 以关系保真为核心的混淆策略可同时兼顾嵌入隐私与推荐效用，代码已开源。

title: The Obsolescence of High-Level Code: Agentic Generation from Semantic Artifacts
summary:
This paper argues that high-level source code need not remain the primary persistent artifact of software development when AI agents can generate, validate, and regenerate executable implementations from semantic intent. We place this claim in historical context by revisiting application generators, CASE tools, model-driven development, and platforms such as GeneXus, where developers already maintained higher-level representations from which code and other artifacts were derived.
  We propose a unifying view in which generation is the fundamental operation: given a semantic specification S = (R, C, I, T, O), maintained as the semantic authority, an agent produces a generated executable artifact A. Functional requirements, contracts, and interfaces are assessed as semantic obligations, while tests and operational objectives are assessed by an explicit external oracle V(A, S). We operationalize this framework through an experiment in independent generation: multiple LLVM artifacts are generated directly from one frozen semantic authority and evaluated by the same external oracle.
  The experiment reports regeneration coherence on an evaluated domain, not a proof of absolute correctness. It provides initial evidence that independently generated executable artifacts can produce the same observable outcomes under a common semantic authority and external oracle. We conclude by discussing reproducibility, specification-centered evolution, and the implications of treating implementation representation as a deployment choice rather than the primary maintained artifact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生成即基本操作"的统一视角：把语义规范 S=(R,C,I,T,O)作为语义权威，代码可由AI代理按需生成、验证与再生成，实现表示只是部署选择而非主要持久产物。
AI.motivation: AI代理已能从语义意图生成、验证并再生成可执行实现，因此高层源代码不必再是软件开发的主要持久工件；论文试图为此主张提供历史脉络（应用生成器、CASE、MDD、GeneXus等）与初步实证支持。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：生成是基本操作，语义规范 S=(R,C,I,T,O) 作为语义权威，代理由其生成可执行工件 A；功能需求、契约与接口作为语义义务评估，测试与运行目标由外部显式判据 V(A,S) 评估。通过"独立生成"实验操作化：从一个冻结的语义权威直接生成多个 LLVM 工件，并用同一外部判据评估。
AI.result: 在受评域上报告了"再生成一致性"（regeneration coherence）：独立生成的可执行工件在同一语义权威与外部判据下产生相同的可观察结果；作者明确这仅为初步证据，并非绝对正确性的证明。
AI.conclusion: 实现表示可视为部署选择而非主要维护工件；论文进一步讨论了可复现性、以规范为中心的演化，以及该转变对软件开发的启示。

title: VideoACE: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding through High-Frame-Rate Actions
summary: Agentic video understanding requires models to actively interact with video environments to gather evidence and form judgments. Evaluating this capability therefore requires assessing whether models can translate opportunities for interaction into better understanding. We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction. We focus on high-frame-rate action videos, where rapid, subtle changes make targeted observation especially valuable. The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage. Its evaluation environment combines video inspection tools with a user simulator, allowing models to adjust temporal coverage, sampling density, and spatial detail, and to revisit evidence and revise their judgments under simulated user feedback. We evaluate single-pass observation, autonomous tool use, and tool use combined with user feedback to examine how effectively models exploit these opportunities. Evaluation of five models reveals distinct patterns in how they acquire evidence and respond to opportunities for further interaction. These findings establish VideoACE as a testbed for examining agentic video understanding beyond performance under a fixed observation setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoACE 基准，用高帧率动作视频与交互工具/用户模拟器评估智能体化视频理解能否把交互机会转化为更好的理解。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解评测多停留在固定观测条件下的单次作答，无法衡量模型能否主动交互（调整时间覆盖、采样密度、空间细节、回溯证据、依据用户反馈修正判断）来获取证据并提升判断，因此需要能支撑持续交互的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 VideoACE：选用存在快速细微变化、值得定向观测的高帧率动作视频；含 1,000 道多项选择题，覆盖六类细粒度动作理解；提供时间证据标注，以及对答案泄漏进行筛查的用户提示；评测环境结合视频检查工具与用户模拟器，支持模型调整时间覆盖、采样密度与空间细节，回溯证据并在模拟用户反馈下修正判断；设置三种条件对比：单次观测、自主工具使用、工具使用＋用户反馈。
AI.result: 对五个模型的评测显示，各模型在证据获取方式和回应进一步交互机会上呈现出明显不同的模式。
AI.conclusion: VideoACE 为超越固定观测设定下的性能、考察智能体化视频理解提供了测试平台。

title: Temporal Fair Division: Simultaneous Guarantees for Goods and Chores
summary: We study temporal fair division of indivisible items in both the goods and chores settings, with $n \ge 2$ agents and nonnegative additive values or costs. Items arrive one at a time and must be assigned immediately and irrevocably. The arrival order and all agents' values or costs are known in advance, and the cumulative allocation must satisfy the fairness requirements after each arrival. For goods, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously achieves exact temporal proportionality up to one item (TPROP1), a $1/n$ approximation to temporal maximin share (TMMS), and a $1/(n-1)$ approximation to temporal envy-freeness up to one item (TEF1). The TMMS factor is optimal. For chores, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously achieves exact TPROP1 and a $2-1/n$ approximation to TMMS. Classical scheduling lower bounds based on fixed sequences carry over to chores TMMS, establishing the optimality of this factor for $n=2,3$. For every $n \ge 2$, we further show that $2-1/n$ is the optimal TMMS factor subject to exact TPROP1. For every fixed $n \ge 3$ and every finite $β\ge 1$, we construct an instance of chores admitting no $β$-TEF1 allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分物品（goods与chores）的时序公平分配，物品逐个到达且须立即不可撤销分配，要求每次到达后累计分配均满足公平性；给出同时实现多种时序公平指标的多项式时间算法，并证明相关近似因子最优或存在不可能性。
AI.motivation: 时序/在线场景下（如云计算资源、遗产分配）物品逐个到来且必须即时不可撤销地分配，需要在每次分配后都维持公平；已有工作多针对离线分配，时序公平中多目标能否同时达成及最优近似因子尚不清楚。
AI.method: 给定已知的到达顺序与所有估值/成本，设计多项式时间在线分配算法：(1) goods情形，构造同时满足精确TPROP1、1/n近似TMMS与1/(n-1)近似TEF1的分配；(2) chores情形，构造同时满足精确TPROP1与(2-1/n)近似TMMS的分配；并通过下界构造与调度理论下界论证最优性，构造无β-TEF1的chores反例。
AI.result: goods：多项式算法同时达到精确TPROP1、1/n-TMMS（最优）与1/(n-1)-TEF1。chores：多项式算法同时达到精确TPROP1与(2-1/n)-TMMS；基于固定序列的调度下界表明该因子对n=2,3最优；对任意n≥2，证明在精确TPROP1约束下2-1/n是TMMS的最优因子；对任意固定n≥3与任意有限β≥1，构造不存在β-TEF1分配的chores实例。
AI.conclusion: goods与chores的时序公平分配均可在线性时间复杂度内以多项式算法同时实现PROP1与有界近似的MMS；goods的TMMS因子1/n最优，chores的TMMS因子在精确TPROP1下最优（n=2,3无条件最优），而chores的TEF1在n≥3时一般不可实现任意有限近似，凸显goods与chores的本质差异。

title: Incremental Speciation in Evolutionary Red Teaming of Large Language Models
summary: Speciation maintains distinct subpopulations in evolutionary search through similarity-based grouping and species-aware parent selection. For text-based individuals, niches depend on both the compatibility representation and the assignment operator that turns pairwise relations into species. We examine this design space in black-box evolutionary red teaming of large language models, comparing embedding and natural language inference (NLI) dissimilarities under representative-based and density-based speciation. Offline calibration on a 3,139-prompt archive shows that MiniLM embedding dissimilarity ($d_E$) and DeBERTa-v3-small NLI non-entailment ($d_{\neg E}$) produce different species structures at the same nominal threshold. Even with pairwise edge density matched to MiniLM, NLI density connectivity forms a few concentrated, mixed-topic species, with substantially more off-topic membership. These structural differences persist online under a matched evaluation budget. The endpoint top-50 median fitness favors incremental DBSCAN over leader-follower, but bootstrap intervals from 10 runs include zero, providing no reliable evidence of an advantage. Semantic diversity among top prompts declines in every configuration, with no consistent method advantage. The clearest difference concerns high-fitness population occupancy: MiniLM incremental DBSCAN maintains mature niches across seed topics, whereas NLI incremental DBSCAN attains the same highest observed median fitness while concentrating high-fitness prompts in variants of a few seed topics. Thus, representation-dependent connectivity predicts population structure more consistently than endpoint fitness. Species count alone does not establish quality-diversity, and more species do not necessarily preserve semantically diverse high-fitness prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文在LLM黑盒进化红队测试中考察物种形成(speciation)的设计空间，比较embedding与NLI不相似度在代表型与密度型物种划分下的差异。
AI.motivation: 文本个体的niche依赖兼容性表示与分配算子，但这两者的设计空间缺乏系统考察，尤其是表示与连通性如何影响种群结构尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在3,139条prompt档案上离线校准，比较MiniLM嵌入不相似度与DeBERTa-v3-small NLI非蕴含度，在leader-follower与增量DBSCAN下分析物种结构；并在匹配评估预算下在线验证，配合10次运行的bootstrap。
AI.result: 同一阈值下两种表示产生不同物种结构；即使边密度匹配，NLI仍形成少数集中且混合主题的物种、离题成员更多。top-50中位适应度偏向增量DBSCAN，但bootstrap区间含零，无可靠优势；top prompts语义多样性普遍下降。
AI.conclusion: 表示依赖的连通性比终点适应度更能稳定预测种群结构；物种数量本身不代表质量-多样性，更多物种未必保留语义多样的高适应度prompt。

title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
summary: Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek's Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Chorus：用一套共享的 n-gram 嵌入表服务整个网络，每层通过基于隐藏状态计算的缩放因子和独立投影层"按自己的方式"读取，从而以更小表取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: n-gram 嵌入表能以很低算力提升语言模型容量，但现有设计通常每层各用一张表，内存开销大且层间无法共享知识；而直接共享单表又使各层嵌入相同、无法体现层间偏好，实践中效果差。作者希望在"共享"与"层间差异化"之间取得平衡。
AI.method: Chorus 让一组 n-gram 嵌入表服务全网络：各层读取同一精炼嵌入，但先根据当前隐藏状态计算出各分量的缩放因子进行重缩放，再经该层专属的投影层映射，实现层间差异化使用。另外验证了内存高效优化器 Ember 与其配合的效果。
AI.result: Chorus 以小 87% 的表达到现有 n-gram 方法质量：1.2B 表参数的语言建模效果优于 FactorEngram 与 DeepSeek Engram 的 9.6B。在 20M 至 9.6B 表参数的所有对比设置中均优于 Engram、TN-gram 与 FactorEngram。与 Ember 结合可节省 99.2% 的表优化器内存（相对 AdamW）且不损失训练性能。
AI.conclusion: Chorus 通过共享表 + 层内重缩放/投影实现知识跨层复用，显著降低内存并提升质量，为沿表规模维度进一步扩展 n-gram 嵌入表铺平道路。

title: Training Language Models for Introspective Oversight
summary: Language models increasingly exhibit behaviors that are difficult to detect in transcripts, such as reward hacking, deception, and sycophancy. Asking the assistant follow-up questions about its actions is unreliable, since models are generally not trained to report their own misbehavior. As a result, approaches to oversight typically involve querying external models. These face limitations: external transcript monitoring operates only on visible model outputs, and activation decoders lack full context and are prone to confabulation. We introduce introspective oversight, which trains a new role in the model to answer arbitrary questions about the assistant, rewarding answers that are verified against the assistant's actual behavior. We implement this by adding a separate, third-person observer role that answers these queries, which we can train solely for accuracy and separately from the assistant. On five held-out oversight evaluations, an observer trained on Qwen3.6-27B obtains a mean AUROC of 0.907, outperforming honesty training (0.864), transcript monitoring (0.828), and activation oracles (0.796). We further find that training an observer makes the assistant itself easier to monitor, with every baseline method improving on average when applied to the fine-tuned assistant. These results suggest that training models to answer verifiable questions about themselves is a tractable approach to overseeing unintended behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出"内省监督"(introspective oversight)：在模型中训练一个独立的第三人称观察者角色，回答关于助手行为的任意问题，仅以可验证的准确性为奖励，在五项监督评测上AUROC达0.907，优于诚实性训练、转录监控与激活解码器。
AI.motivation: 语言模型出现难以从文本中察觉的行为（reward hacking、欺骗、谄媚）。向助手追问其自身行为不可靠，因为模型未被训练如实报告自身不当行为；外部模型监督也有局限：转录监控只看可见输出，激活解码器缺乏完整上下文且易产生虚构。
AI.method: 引入内省监督：在模型中新增一个独立的第三人称观察者角色，专门回答关于助手的提问；该观察者与助手分离训练，仅以答案是否与助手实际行为相符（可验证）作为奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在五个留出监督评测上，基于Qwen3.6-27B训练的观察者平均AUROC为0.907，超过诚实性训练(0.864)、转录监控(0.828)和激活预言机(0.796)。此外，训练观察者后助手本身更易被监督，所有基线方法应用于微调后助手的平均表现均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型回答关于自身的可验证问题，是监督非预期行为的一条可行路径，且具有"使助手更可监控"的正向副作用。

title: Autoregressive View Model
summary: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

AI.tldr: AVM 用自回归方式按相机路径生成视图流，不显式建 3D，通过统一上下文接口同时支持重建、插值与外推。
AI.motivation: 现有场景生成方法依赖显式 3D 表示，难以灵活适应多样输入/输出设置，且在稀疏输入和长时程一致性上受限。
AI.method: 以图像或视频为条件，沿指定相机路径生成短片段；从输入与已生成历史中检索视图构成有界活跃上下文；用 flow matching 将预训练双向视频扩散 Transformer 微调为 N-in-1-out；再对因果模型做自 rollout 微调以提升真实感、减少去噪步数并抑制长时漂移；训练规模约 800 万场景与视频片段。
AI.result: 在相机控制、文本控制、视觉质量、动态、稀疏与 4D 重建、长时程一致性等多项基准上评测，展现出较强生成能力与场景持续性，单一上下文接口可适配多样输入输出设置。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式 3D 表示的自回归视图生成是可行的统一范式，可在多任务、多设置下保持场景一致性。

title: GridForge: An Open Physics-Informed Digital Twin and Benchmark Suite for UK 11 kV Underground Distribution Cables
summary: The UK distribution-cable monitoring sector is data-rich but framework-poor: each Distribution Network Operator (DNO) collects megabytes of telemetry per asset per day, but there is no public benchmark dataset, no shared reference model, and no commonly agreed evaluation protocol for benchmarking sectoral, data-intensive models for operational decision support; notably for maintenance planning and prioritisation. We address this gap with GridForge, an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for fault diagnosis and prediction, integrating four building blocks: (i) a verified steady state and transient thermal model based on IEC 60287 and IEC 60853; (ii) a calibrated synthetic dataset of 64 cables (covering 320 cable-years) representing four canonical UK 11 kV thermal archetypes and four condition modes; (iii) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate that satisfies the algebraic balance defined by IEC 60287 during training and reaches an RMSE of 0.148 °C on an independent held out set against the reference analytical oracle; and (iv) a five-task benchmark suite that includes three reference baseline models (pure physics, gradient-boosted trees, and the PINN). All numerical parameters are sourced from public standards, the code is licensed under the MIT licence, and the trained PINN converges in only two minutes (as run on the computing platform in Section 10.1), enabling independent verification by DNO engineering and research practitioners. At present only the virtual-sensor task (T4) discriminates between the reference baselines; the other tasks tie or are undefined on this test split, so extending the baselines with task-specific logic is a priority future enhancement. For open validation, the dataset, test sets and models are made available at https://github.com/mlily2024/Gridforge

AI.tldr: GridForge：面向英国配电网电缆故障诊断与预测的开源物理信息数字孪生与基准套件，含IEC标准热模型、64条电缆合成数据集、PINN代理模型（RMSE 0.148°C）与五任务基准。
AI.motivation: 英国配电电缆监测领域数据丰富但框架缺失：各DNO每日采集海量遥测数据，却缺乏公开基准数据集、共享参考模型和公认评估协议，尤其影响维护规划与优先级排序。
AI.method: 构建GridForge，整合四部分：(i) 基于IEC 60287/60853验证的稳态与暂态热模型；(ii) 校准的合成数据集（64条电缆、320电缆年，涵盖四种英国11kV热原型与四种状态模式）；(iii) 训练中满足IEC 60287代数平衡约束的PINN代理模型；(iv) 五任务基准套件，含纯物理、梯度提升树、PINN三个基线。
AI.result: PINN在独立留出集上相对解析参考oracle的RMSE为0.148°C，训练仅需两分钟；目前仅虚拟传感器任务(T4)能区分基线，其余任务在该测试划分上持平或未定义。
AI.conclusion: 所有参数源自公开标准、代码MIT许可，数据集与模型开放可验证；未来需为各任务补充任务特定逻辑的基线以提升区分度。

title: From Docket Minutes to Case Trajectories: Building Analysis-Ready Criminal Court Data
comment: This paper has been accepted at IEEE Big Data 2026
summary: Criminal court records are often fragmented, noisy, and siloed, making it challenging for both legal experts and community stakeholders to access and analyze court data to identify trends and provide public oversight. In this paper, we introduce a system for data ingestion, harmonization, and dashboard visualization designed for New Orleans criminal court proceedings data, aimed at both expert and lay audiences. Our system collects and harmonizes disparate data, generates case trajectories, and provides intuitive visualization techniques based on community feedback to analyze demographics, temporal trends, and specific case events. We demonstrate the system through an exploratory analysis of recent short-term trends and policy impacts within New Orleans, illustrating how it can support the investigation of anomalies, policy changes, and procedural irregularities. We also present feedback from a small formative study of community stakeholders who have helped co-design and use the system, suggesting that it may improve access to and interpretation of local court data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向新奥尔良刑事法庭记录的数据采集、协调与可视化仪表板系统，帮助专家和公众分析人口统计、时间趋势和案件事件，并通过社区反馈共同设计与评估。
AI.motivation: 刑事法庭记录往往碎片化、噪声大且彼此孤立，法律专家与社区利益相关者难以获取和分析法院数据以识别趋势并进行公共监督。
AI.method: 构建数据摄取、协调（harmonization）与仪表板可视化系统：收集并整合异构数据，生成案件轨迹（case trajectories），并基于社区反馈设计面向人口统计、时间趋势与具体案件事件的可视化技术。
AI.result: 通过对新奥尔良近期短期趋势与政策影响的探索性分析进行演示，展示系统可支持异常、政策变化与程序违规的调查；小型形成性研究中社区利益相关者参与共同设计并使用系统，反馈表明其可能改善对本地法院数据的获取与解读。
AI.conclusion: 该系统有潜力提升刑事法庭数据的可访问性与解读能力，支持公共监督，并强调社区参与式设计在司法数据可视化中的价值。

title: What Moves the Ceiling on Automated Audit: from General Code to Scientific Code, Results and Data
summary: Models increasingly check what other models write. We study one shipped arrangement, in which an auditor from a different vendor reads the work and deterministic checks verify what code can verify, and measure its limits against ground truth no model supplies. On general-purpose code with hidden tests, eight readings of the auditor reach 30.0% recall [20.0, 40.7] at 16.0% [10.1, 22.3] flags on correct code, with diminishing returns and no plateau. The reading model (confounded with its sampling), one rulebook sentence and the decision rule each move that figure, and much of what is missed is, on a post hoc rating, behaviour the specification never determined. In three preregistered science studies, checking that reported numbers trace to their sources flagged all 49 inconsistent reports and none of 25 consistent fabrications, of which the model auditor flagged 23 (21 with a sound finding, post hoc); on data, a documentation-derived validator and the auditor flagged overlapping but different faulty items, together 112 of 140 at a 2.9% [0.7, 5.7] flag rate on clean data; and on scientific code, reframing the task around one step cut flags on correct code from 68.7% to 36.0%. Where both tiers ran, the deterministic one flagged no clean item and could not see consistent error; the model saw some and erred itself. Studies making model calls were preregistered, the two unregistered analyses are named, and every quoted report passed independent cross-vendor review.

AI.tldr: 研究"模型审核模型"的已在用流程（跨厂商审计模型+确定性检查），以不依赖模型的真值衡量其能力边界：通用代码检出率有限且未饱和，确定性层漏掉一致性错误，模型层能发现部分但自身也会误判。
AI.motivation: 模型越来越多地被用来检查其他模型的产出，但这类审核流程实际能发现多少错误、会误报多少，缺少以独立真值为基准的量化评估。
AI.method: 评估一种已部署的双层安排：不同厂商的审计模型阅读作品+确定性检查验证可验证部分。任务包括带隐藏测试的通用代码（审计模型8次阅读）、三项预注册科学研究（数字溯源、数据校验、科学代码），并以模型不参与提供的地面真值评测召回率/标志率；部分分析事后评定，每份引用报告经独立跨厂商复核。
AI.result: 通用代码：召回30.0% [20.0,40.7]，正确代码标志率16.0% [10.1,22.3]，收益递减无平台期；漏检多为规格未决定的行为。数字溯源：确定性检查标出全部49条不一致报告且未误标25条一致伪造，模型仅标23（21条事后视为有效）；数据：两层互补共标出140条中112条，干净数据标志率2.9% [0.7,5.7]；科学代码：聚焦单一步骤后标志率从68.7%降至36.0%。确定性层从未误标干净项但看不到一致错误；模型层部分可见亦有误判。
AI.conclusion: 模型审核并非可靠保证：召回低、误报不可忽略，单纯加阅读次数收益有限；应让确定性检查与模型审计协同并明确各自盲区，同时规范预注册与独立复核。

title: Movie2Game-Bench: Holistic Evaluation of Film-to-Game Adaptation Beyond Playability
summary: Adapting a film into a game requires selecting source elements and translating them into player actions, rules, and feedback. We introduce Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench), a benchmark for evaluating film-to-game adaptation beyond playability. M2G-bench combines general evaluation, movie-specific evaluation, and playtesting by three GUI model players. The protocol connects source content to gameplay steps and implementation evidence, capturing both content preservation and interactive realization. The benchmark comprises 22 films and 658 source-specific reference items. Evaluating 14 models on the same films with their selected primary harnesses reveals complementary strengths in game quality, adaptation, and player experience. A shared weakness concerns playable sequences: this category has the lowest content-presence mean in all 14 models, averaging 37.9 out of 100 compared with 54.8 for iconic elements. Among judgments of retained emotionaldevelopment content, narrative choices account for 60.0% and scenario operation for 7.2%. These findings identify two linked priorities for film-to-game adaptation: preserving source situations that can support gameplay and connecting retained content to player actions and consequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 M2G-bench 基准，从内容保留与交互实现两方面评估电影改编游戏，发现可玩序列是 14 个模型的共同弱项。
AI.motivation: 电影改编游戏不应只以"可玩性"衡量，需要同时考察源内容的保留与转化为玩家动作/规则/反馈的程度，现有评估缺此能力。
AI.method: 构建 M2G-bench：结合通用评估、电影特定评估与三名 GUI 模型玩家的试玩测试；协议将源内容与 gameplay 步骤及实现证据相连；含 22 部电影、658 条源特定参考项，评测 14 个模型。
AI.result: 14 个模型在游戏质量、改编与玩家体验上各有优势；共同短板是"可玩序列"，其内容呈现均值最低（37.9/100，标志性元素为 54.8）；在保留的情感发展内容判定中，叙事选择占 60.0%，情境操作仅占 7.2%。
AI.conclusion: 提出两项关联要点：保留能支撑玩法的源情境，以及将保留内容与玩家动作及后果相连接。

title: On the Complexity of Envy Cycle Elimination
summary: The envy cycle elimination (ECE) algorithm is a fundamental algorithm for the fair allocation of indivisible goods, guaranteeing an allocation that is envy-free up to one good under arbitrary monotone utilities. We show that the ECE algorithm can be implemented in $O(nm)$ time for $n$ agents and $m$ goods, and establish the tightness of this bound.

AI.tldr: 本文证明嫉妒环消除算法(ECE)可在 O(nm) 时间内实现，并证明该界是紧的。
AI.motivation: ECE 是公平分配不可分物品的基础算法，保证在任意单调效用下得到 EF1 分配，但其时间复杂度此前未被精确刻画，需要给出高效实现并确定其计算复杂度下界。
AI.method: 针对 n 个代理、m 个物品，设计 ECE 的新实现方案，通过高效维护嫉妒关系与环消除过程，将运行时间优化至 O(nm)。
AI.result: ECE 算法可在 O(nm) 时间内完成，且不存在更优的渐近上界，即该复杂度是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 给出了 ECE 算法的最优实现，O(nm) 为其精确时间复杂度，完善了该基础算法的理论复杂度分析。

title: Analysis of the (1+1)-EA-ES-Bilevel on Mixed Discrete-Continuous Optimization Problems with Interactions
summary: Mixed discrete-continuous optimization problems can pose challenges -- especially for previous integrated approaches -- when interactions cause beneficial discrete changes to be rejected before sufficient continuous adjustment. We introduce ProximityOneMax as a simple benchmark with pairwise discrete-continuous interactions. On this function, we prove an exponential lower bound on the expected time for the (1+1)-EA-ES-Integrated to reach the target accuracy when initialized near a continuous optimum for a suboptimal discrete configuration with a sufficiently small step size. Experiments show frequent entries into such states from random initialization. We introduce the (1+1)-EA-ES-Bilevel, which uses an upper-level (1+1)-EA to optimize discrete variables and a lower-level (1+1)-ES to optimize continuous variables for each fixed discrete offspring before selection. For several interaction benchmarks and sufficiently small target values $ε> 0$ that require an optimal discrete configuration, using fixed continuous initialization and a suitable fixed budget per lower-level call, we prove that the expected number of fitness evaluations to reach objective value at most $ε$ is $Θ(n_d \cdot \log n_d \cdot n_c \cdot \log(R/\sqrtε))$, where $n_d$ is the number of discrete variables, $n_c$ is the number of continuous variables, and $R$ bounds the distances from the fixed continuous starting point to all relevant continuous optima for fixed discrete configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出带有离散-连续成对交互的基准函数ProximityOneMax，证明积分式优化器(1+1)-EA-ES-Integrated在近最优初始点下存在指数下界，并提出双层结构(1+1)-EA-ES-Bilevel实现多项式期望运行时间Θ(n_d log n_d · n_c log(R/√ε))。
AI.motivation: 混合离散-连续优化中，离散与连续变量交互会使有益的离散改变因连续变量尚未充分调整而被拒绝（"代理目标"陷阱）。以往一体化集成方法在该类交互上可能陷入指数级慢速，缺少一个简单、可分析的基准来刻画这一失效机制。
AI.method: 1) 构造ProximityOneMax基准函数，具有成对离散-连续交互；2) 用漂移分析证明(1+1)-EA-ES-Integrated在"近连续最优点+次优离散配置+小步长"初值下达到目标精度的期望时间具指数下界；3) 实验观察随机初始化频繁落入此类状态；4) 提出(1+1)-EA-ES-Bilevel：上层(1+1)-EA优化离散变量，对每个离散后代在选中前用下层(1+1)-ES以固定预算优化连续变量（嵌套/双层优化）。
AI.result: 证得积分式方法在近连续最优初值下的期望时间指数下界（随问题规模）；实验显示随机初始化常进入该"卡住"状态。反之，对多个交互基准及需最优离散配置的足够小ε，在固定连续初值与合适下层预算下，Bilevel方法期望评估次数为Θ(n_d log n_d · n_c log(R/√ε))，即关于离散变量数近线性的多项式规模。
AI.conclusion: 将连续变量优化"内层化"（先充分优化连续变量再做选择）可避免交互导致的误导性离散拒绝，从指数级退化为多项式期望时间；说明算法结构（集成 vs 双层嵌套）对混合变量优化复杂度的决定性影响。

title: Tracking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model's actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/

AI.tldr: 研究LLM智能体的链式推理痕迹与内部真实计算之间的关系，发现在不完全信息迭代博弈中模型会在CoT中迭代修订游戏的内部表征，一旦过早锁定错误信念就几乎无法恢复。
AI.motivation: CoT被广泛使用，但外部化推理痕迹与模型实际内部计算之间的关系尚不清楚，需要厘清二者对应关系。
AI.method: 在一系列不完全信息的迭代博弈中考察LLM智能体的决策，并运用多种机制可解释性技术分析推理痕迹与各层激活。
AI.result: 模型在CoT过程中形成并迭代修订对博弈的内部表征；一旦过早锁定错误信念便极少恢复，该失败同时体现在字面推理痕迹与层激活中。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了CoT痕迹与内部计算的对应关系，为多智能体系统的策略推理错误诊断提供了新途径，并提供了交互式可视化工具。

title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; includes supplementary information with 3 further figures
summary: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"软件热力学"理论，将编码智能体（coding agent）消耗的 token 视为成本，并划分为"功"与"热"，通过类比单分子拉伸-折叠实验（编码/解码循环）来测量软件温度、自由能与测试套件（麦克斯韦妖）的影响。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体按 token 计费，但软件工程学对"一个 token 究竟买到了什么"缺乏理论刻画，因此需要一套定量框架来分析和优化智能体的成本结构。
AI.method: 借鉴经典热力学与随机热力学（含 Jarzynski 等式），把 token 数作为成本并分解为功与热；测试套件充当"软件麦克斯韦妖"判定每次改动。设计实验类比单分子拉伸-回折：智能体反复对同一仓库做编码改动再撤销（uncoding），每轮从存储的参考树出发，统计每次模型调用的 token，用重复循环成本的离散程度定义"软件温度"。
AI.result: 循环可使编辑回到起点；软件温度随模型采样温度升高而升高；成功运行中约 80% 的 token 产生于未改变请求改动的调用（称为"热"）；通过 Jarzynski 等式类比估计的自由能约为成功运行平均成本的 14%–22%；编码比解码贵 1.1–1.5 倍；测试套件判定随环境变化而不完善，接受错误改动的套件也有 token 代价。
AI.conclusion: 软件热力学为编码智能体提供了可量化的成本-效率框架，有望催生基于热力学视角的新工具，用于分析与优化编码智能体。

title: Bits, Not Boxes: Label-Free Layer Selection for Visual Localization in VLMs
summary: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. We show that attention itself can identify them. A question changes how much a head attends to the image and where this attention goes. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. WhereBits turns these where-to-look bits into a layer prior and combines it with per-head contrastive scores. Its three design constants were fixed once on labeled COCO data, and a new model or resolution needs only unlabeled questions. Across eight VLMs, WhereBits matches the pointing accuracy of box-tuned layers on COCO and RefCOCO and ranks target tokens better. This advantage holds on a held-out model family and at higher resolutions. Its COCO pointing accuracy is 0.72, against 0.22 for mean attention. In training-free zoom-in, its crops raise V* accuracy by 6.0 points under forced-choice evaluation.

AI.tldr: WhereBits 利用注意力本身（无标签问题上的"看哪里"比特量）识别 VLM 中能定位目标物体的层，并与逐头对比分数结合，在八个 VLM 上达到与框调优层相当的指向精度，且无需新标注即可迁移到新模型和更高分辨率。
AI.motivation: 注意力图虽能低成本反映 VLM 看向何处，但注意力汇（attention sinks）使其定位不可靠；问题对照通用提示可抑制汇聚，但只有部分层能定位目标。现有方法依赖框标注或固定规则来寻找这些层，成本高且难迁移。
AI.method: 作者指出问题会同时改变某头对图像的注意总量与注意力去向，两种效应可精确分离；后者以比特为单位在无标签问题上度量，可指示哪些层具备定位能力。WhereBits 将这些"看哪里"比特转化为层先验，并与逐头对比分数组合。三个设计常数仅在带标注的 COCO 数据上固定一次，新模型或新分辨率只需无标签问题。
AI.result: 在八个 VLM 上，WhereBits 在 COCO 与 RefCOCO 上的指向精度与框调优层相当，且目标 token 排序更优；优势在留出模型家族和更高分辨率下依然成立。COCO 指向精度 0.72，而平均注意力仅 0.22；在免训练 zoom-in 中，其裁剪使 V* 在强制选择评测下提升 6.0 点。
AI.conclusion: 注意力本身足以识别定位层，无需框标注或固定规则。WhereBits 提供了一种标注成本低、可跨模型与分辨率迁移的层选择方式，并直接提升下游 zoom-in 等任务表现。

title: Biologically-Inspired Spike Encoding and Optimization for Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer theoretical energy-efficiency advantages over conventional deep networks, but realizing these advantages on vision tasks requires sparse spike representations that naive rate-coding methods fail to provide. We combine biologically motivated spike-encoding schemes with two training improvements: Rouser adaptive-threshold surrogate gradients and Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) second-order optimization. The spike encoding schemes experimented with are rate coding, latency coding, DVS-style delta modulation, and Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) filtering. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate that biologically inspired encoders yield the largest accuracy gains in capacity-constrained regimes and serve as an effective parameter-efficiency lever. DoG and delta modulation encoders produce significantly sparser spike trains than rate coding. K-FAC yields modest but consistent accuracy improvements over Adam-trained baselines, and Rouser's learnable per-neuron thresholds improve Fashion-MNIST accuracy from 87.37% to 88.13% by enabling homeostatic firing-rate regulation. Biologically grounded pre-processing methods can help close the accuracy gap between SNNs and non-spiking baselines without increasing model size.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究用生物启发的脉冲编码方案结合Rouser自适应阈值替代梯度和K-FAC二阶优化来提升SNN在视觉任务中的稀疏性与准确率。
AI.motivation: SNN理论上有能效优势，但在视觉任务中需稀疏脉冲表示，而朴素率编码无法提供足够稀疏的表示，导致准确率落后于非脉冲基线。
AI.method: 比较四种编码方案（率编码、延迟编码、DVS式差分调制、DoG滤波），并引入Rouser自适应阈值替代梯度（可学习逐神经元阈值）与K-FAC二阶优化进行训练。
AI.result: 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上，生物启发编码器在容量受限时准确率增益最大；DoG与差分调制比率编码显著更稀疏；K-FAC比Adam有小幅但一致的提升；Rouser阈值将Fashion-MNIST准确率从87.37%提升至88.13%。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发的预处理可在不增加模型规模的前提下缩小SNN与非脉冲基线之间的准确率差距。

title: CONCORD-Rec: Catalog-Conditioned Modality Utility for Semantic-ID Diffusion Recommendation
summary: Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. Rather than distilling raw token probabilities directly, the resulting counterfactual loss differences supervise an availability-masked tokenwise gate that allocates bounded modality residuals around a behavioral denoiser while retaining an exact behavioral fallback slot. We establish theoretical fixed-support ranking stability bounds under gate perturbations and evaluate position-level and code-conditional allocation across audiovisual and image-text recommendation benchmarks under controlled missingness, signal degradation, and semantic conflict. Across 20 source-compatible protocol-dataset rows, CONCORD-Rec improves NDCG by 4%; under matched 30% conflict it improves NDCG by 14.63%. The full-vs-uniform-T=16 sweep improves quality by 2.00-3.58% while reducing p95 latency by up to 86.89%.

AI.tldr: CONCORD-Rec 提出一种由反事实目录分区效用监督的可靠性条件离散扩散推荐框架，通过可用性掩码的逐 token 门控分配有界模态残差，在模态缺失/退化/冲突下提升 NDCG 并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 多模态生成推荐使用离散语义标识（SID）时，难以区分"仅改变 token 预测"的历史模态与"真正降低目录级歧义"的模态；当视听/视觉/文本流缺失、退化或语义冲突时，统一融合与无约束 token 门控会在迭代去噪中传播误导内容。
AI.method: 在固定 tokenizer 与部分掩码 SID 状态下，在精确可行目录支撑上评估 out-of-fold 教师联盟，并在每个未解析位置跨目标码分区聚合物品后验；不直接蒸馏原始 token 概率，而用反事实损失差监督可用性掩码的逐 token 门控，在行为去噪器周围分配有界模态残差并保留精确行为回退槽；同时给出门控扰动下的固定支撑排序稳定性理论界。
AI.result: 在 20 个源兼容协议-数据集行上 NDCG 提升 4%；匹配 30% 冲突下 NDCG 提升 14.63%；full-vs-uniform T=16 扫描质量提升 2.00–3.58%，p95 延迟最多降低 86.89%。
AI.conclusion: 基于反事实目录分区效用的门控监督能有效区分模态可靠性，在缺失、退化与冲突条件下稳健提升推荐质量与效率，并具备排序稳定性理论保证。

title: Who Changed the AI Agent's Rules? Measuring How AI Coding Agents Escalate Authority in CI/CD Pipelines
comment: Accepted for publication at the Research track of PROFES (Product Oriented Software Process Improvement) 2026 conference, Karlskrona, Sweden
summary:
AI coding agents can modify CI/CD control-plane structures, including workflows and permission settings, thereby extending their authority beyond routine code changes. Because such modifications can affect an entire development pipeline, this study examines the trade-off between execution cost and governance risk in agentic CI/CD. We introduce a joint penalty model, P(M), that combines these two dimensions and evaluate it on all 932,791 agent-authored pull requests in the AIDev dataset, covering five autonomous coding agents. Each pull request is automatically classified by authority scope - data-plane or control-plane - and assigned a penalty score.
  We found that control-plane actions have a 2.3x higher mean joint penalty than data-plane actions (0.498 vs. 0.218) and a 3.9x higher mean governance risk (0.530 vs. 0.135), which means that they indeed increase the risk. All 775 pull requests in the extreme-risk category, defined as P(M) > 0.8, modify the control plane. Policy-violation flags occur in 46.6% of all control-plane pull requests and in 63.6% of merged control-plane pull requests. We have also found an indication that governance risk differs substantially across agent implementations, ranging from 0.166 for Cursor to 0.328 for Copilot in mean joint penalty. These differences are not explained by execution cost or merge rate, suggesting that authority policies should be calibrated for individual agents. Manual assessment of 34 pull requests yielded a Cohen's kappa of 0.72 for the authority-scope classifier.
  The results show that a single compound metric can identify and measure changes to CI/CD governance structures at scale. The proposed framework supports detecting high-risk pull requests and comparing governance behavior across agent implementations, providing a basis for authority tuning and pipeline governance in agentic software development.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出联合惩罚模型 P(M) 综合刻画执行成本与治理风险，并对 AIDev 数据集中 932,791 个 AI 代理提交的 PR 进行分类分析，发现控制面变更风险显著高于数据面，且不同代理实现间治理风险差异明显。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理可修改 CI/CD 控制面（工作流、权限配置），从而将权限扩展到常规代码修改之外，影响整条开发流水线。因此需要在执行成本与治理风险之间进行权衡度量。
AI.method: 提出联合惩罚模型 P(M) 融合执行成本与治理风险两维度；对 AIDev 数据集中全部 932,791 个代理编写的 PR，按权限范围（数据面/控制面）自动分类并赋分；另对 34 个 PR 进行人工评估验证分类器。
AI.result: 控制面 PR 的联合惩罚均值为数据面的 2.3 倍（0.498 vs 0.218），治理风险为 3.9 倍（0.530 vs 0.135）；775 个极端风险 PR（P(M)>0.8）全部涉及控制面；46.6% 控制面 PR 及 63.6% 已合并控制面 PR 出现违规标记；代理间平均联合惩罚从 Cursor 的 0.166 到 Copilot 的 0.328，且无法由执行成本或合并率解释；分类器 Cohen's kappa 为 0.72。
AI.conclusion: 单一复合指标可大规模识别并度量 CI/CD 治理结构变更；该框架支持高风险 PR 检测与跨代理治理行为比较，为权限调优与流水线治理提供依据，并提示应按代理个体校准权限策略。

title: The Optimal Competitive Ratio for Subadditive Online Combinatorial Auctions is Less Than 1/2
summary: We construct a four-buyer online combinatorial auction with independent subadditive valuations and a fixed, known arrival order in which every online rule earns strictly less than $1/2$ of the expected offline optimum. A common partition, revealed at the third arrival, gives the first three buyers one unit of welfare per item. If the rule uses three distinct partitions, either an item allocated early contributes zero or the fourth buyer's expected value for the remaining bundle is one less than its size. We compute the optimal online and offline welfare exactly and show that a $1/2$ guarantee always holds with at most three buyers.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个含四个买家的在线组合拍卖实例，证明固定到达顺序下任何在线规则的收益都严格低于离线最优期望值的1/2，从而否定了更优的通用在线界（对四买家情形）。
AI.motivation: 此前在线组合拍卖中关于竞争比是否存在超过1/2的通用保证并不清楚。作者希望给出反例，说明对四买家而言1/2已是上界，厘清在线与离线最优之间的间隙。
AI.method: 构造独立次可加估价的四买家在线拍卖：前三个买家在第3次到达时揭示一个公共划分，每个物品每人各获一单位福利；若在线规则使用三种不同划分，则早分配物品贡献为零，或第四买家对剩余包的期望价值比其规模少一。对在线与离线最优福利做精确计算。
AI.result: 存在实例使任何在线规则严格小于离线最优期望的1/2；同时精确证明至多三个买家时1/2保证总能成立。
AI.conclusion: 四买家情形下单1/2的竞争比不可被超越，而三买家情形仍可保证1/2，确定了该问题的紧界与买家数阈值。

title: Old Matches, New Frames: Schedule-Gated Stereo Memory from Human Vision to Machine Matching
summary: Human vision and video stereo networks both reuse disparity evidence across time, yet a refresh of the input can invalidate a match formed milliseconds earlier. What tells a system whether an old match still counts? We answer this from limited human data in three steps. First, nine temporal mechanisms share a frozen binocular-energy front end and an equal-capacity readout, so held-out behavior isolates the temporal selection rule: on 240 conditions from 10 observers, down-weighting aged evidence that has lost binocular support lowers subject RMSE from 12.6% to 10.3% and reproduces a period-dependent reversed-depth illusion, across all 59 readings of the unpublished protocol and 8 front-end perturbations. Second, four propositions establish what such data can identify: gating is identified at the level of the refresh schedule, and candidate binding is invisible to standard stimuli but exposed by a single-eye geometry flip that separates the readouts by up to 7.1%. Third, the identified rule becomes a two-field stereo memory that separates sample validity from hypothesis support. It removes a 50 ms recovery lag after geometry flips, and its regime analysis explains why plain integration stays preferable on MPI-Sintel, where 71.1% of pixels change appearance but not disparity.

AI.tldr: 人类视觉与视频立体网络都会跨时间复用视差证据，但输入刷新可能使毫秒前形成的匹配失效。作者通过从有限人类数据中识别"旧匹配是否仍然有效"的时间选择规则，并将其转化为双场立体记忆模型，消除几何翻转后50ms的恢复延迟。
AI.motivation: 视差证据在时间上被复用，但输入刷新后旧匹配可能已失效，系统需要一个判断"旧匹配是否仍算数"的规则；现有研究缺乏对该时间选择规则的明确刻画。
AI.method: 第一步：九个时间机制共享冻结的双目能量前端和等容量读出，用240个条件、10名观察者的留出行为隔离时间选择规则；第二步：提出四个命题界定数据可识别的范围，并设计单眼几何翻转刺激区分候选读出；第三步：将识别出的规则实现为双场立体记忆模型，分离样本有效性与假设支持。
AI.result: 对失去双目支持的陈旧证据降权，使被试RMSE从12.6%降至10.3%，并复现周期依赖的反转深度错觉；该结果在未公开协议的59次读数及8种前端扰动下稳健。单眼几何翻转使候选读出差异达7.1%。双场模型消除几何翻转后50ms恢复延迟；在MPI-Sintel上（71.1%像素外观变而视差不变）简单积分仍更优。
AI.conclusion: 人类立体视觉的时间选择规则可被有限数据识别，核心是对失去双目支持的陈旧证据降权；该规则可形式化为区分样本有效性与假设支持的双场立体记忆，并明确了其适用边界（视差不变的场景下简单积分更优）。

title: Formal Adequacy Index (based on Polish-language material)
summary: Linguistic formality is one of the dimensions of stylistic variation in speech; however, simply measuring its level does not allow us to determine whether the chosen mode of communication is appropriate in a given situation. The aim of this article is to present the concept of a formal adequacy index (based on Polish-language material), which enables a quantitative assessment of how well the formality of a text matches the expectations arising from the communicative context. The proposed approach is based on the separate modelling of observed formality, determined on the basis of the linguistic features of the text, and expected formality, determined on the basis of the characteristics of the communicative situation. Adequacy is assessed by comparing these two measures, taking into account contextual tolerance thresholds, which may differ for a lack of formality and an excess of formality. The potential applications of the index are illustrated by an analysis of Polish-language emails containing apologies for being late, written by human language users or generated by a large language model. The implementation presented here is preliminary in nature and requires further calibration and empirical validation. The main contribution of this article is the proposal of a general methodological framework for the quantitative study of formal adequacy in various communicative contexts.

AI.tldr: 文章提出“正式适宜性指数”（formal adequacy index），将文本的观测正式度与交际情境的期望正式度分别建模并比较，结合情境容忍阈值，量化评估文本正式度是否匹配交际场景。
AI.motivation: 语言正式度是语体变异的一个维度，但仅测量其水平无法判断所选交际方式在特定情境中是否恰当，因此需要一个能评估“正式度与情境期望是否匹配”的量化指标。
AI.method: 基于波兰语材料，分别建模：观测正式度（依据文本语言特征）与期望正式度（依据交际情境特征）；通过比较二者，并引入上下文容忍阈值（对正式度不足与过度分别设定不同阈值）来评估适宜性。以人写与大语言模型生成的波兰语“迟到道歉”邮件为案例进行分析。
AI.result: 通过波兰语道歉邮件的案例分析展示了该指数的潜在应用，可区分人写与LLM生成文本在正式适宜性上的表现；但实现属初步性质，仍需进一步校准与实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出一个用于跨交际情境定量研究正式适宜性的通用方法学框架，未来需标定与实证检验。

title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
summary:
The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever.
  To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that it reduces production downtime by 18.3% on GPU platforms and 16.1% on TPUs. Furthermore, it significantly accelerates hardware deployment, cutting quality assurance (QA) time by 28.3% for GPUs and 25.1% for TPUs. These results establish HardwareDx as a field-tested solution for maximizing the reliability and cost efficiency of next generation AI fleets.

AI.tldr: HardwareDx 是 Google 生产部署的 AI 硬件诊断系统，用图基础模型统一诊断多种平台。GPU 停机时间降 18.3%、TPU 降 16.1%，QA 时间分别降 28.3% 和 25.1%。
AI.motivation: AI 基础设施规模快速扩张，超大规模集群中的硬件故障会中断数百万美元级训练任务，单机停机造成巨大经济损失，因此最小化机器停机至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 HardwareDx，一种 AI 驱动的硬件诊断系统，采用图基础模型（graph foundation model）方法实现数据中心维护自动化；单个模型即可诊断多种平台，并加速新硬件产品的上线。
AI.result: 已在 Google 生产规模部署，在多种计算架构上取得显著效率提升：生产停机时间 GPU 减少 18.3%、TPU 减少 16.1%；QA 时间 GPU 缩短 28.3%、TPU 缩短 25.1%。
AI.conclusion: HardwareDx 是经过实地验证的方案，可最大化下一代 AI 集群的可靠性与成本效益。

title: TransFIRA+: Transfer Learning for Biometric Recognizability Assessment
summary: Biometric recognition in surveillance, video, and web imagery must contend with extreme variation in pose, blur, illumination, occlusion, and distance, where visual quality metrics fail to predict whether inputs are recognizable to the deployed encoder. Existing face image quality assessment methods rely on visual heuristics, curated annotations, or costly generative pipelines, leaving their predictions detached from the encoder's decision geometry. We introduce TransFIRA, a lightweight framework that grounds recognizability directly in embedding space. TransFIRA derives class-center similarity (CCS) and class-center angular separation (CCAS) from a pretrained encoder's embeddings and learns to predict them from images without quality annotations. Using predicted CCS for template weighting and CCAS>0 as a natural filtering threshold yields state-of-the-art face verification performance on BRIAR, raising TAR at $10^{-6}$ FMR from 0.085 with uniform averaging to 0.598. The predicted scores also reveal how image degradations affect encoder-specific recognizability. TransFIRA+ extends this framework to cross-camera multimodal person identification in untrimmed surveillance video. In this setting, body recognizability scores saturate within a narrow range, making direct weighting effectively uniform. We introduce a post-hoc sigmoid calibration that transforms these saturated scores into informative weights without retraining. After calibration, the BRIAR-trained TransFIRA predictor improves fused face and body identification on two unseen multi-camera datasets, outperforming detector-confidence weighting and uncalibrated CCS-rank weighting. Together, TransFIRA and TransFIRA+ demonstrate that encoder-grounded recognizability generalizes across biometric modalities and recognition settings.

AI.tldr: 提出TransFIRA与TransFIRA+，在嵌入空间中以类中心相似度(CCS)和类中心角分离(CCAS)度量生物特征可识别性，无需质量标注，显著提升人脸验证与跨摄像头多模态行人识别性能。
AI.motivation: 监控、视频和网络图像中姿态、模糊、光照、遮挡与距离变化极大，现有基于视觉启发式、人工标注或昂贵生成管线的人脸质量评估与编码器决策几何脱节，无法预测输入对部署编码器是否可识别。
AI.method: 1) TransFIRA：从预训练编码器嵌入中导出类中心相似度CCS与类中心角分离CCAS，学习从图像直接预测二者（无需质量标注）；用预测CCS做模板加权，以CCAS>0作为天然过滤阈值。2) TransFIRA+：扩展至未剪辑监控视频的跨摄像头多模态行人识别，发现身体可识别性分数饱和于窄区间，提出事后sigmoid校准将其转为有信息量的权重，无需重训练。
AI.result: BRIAR上取得SOTA人脸验证：10^-6 FMR下TAR从均匀平均的0.085提升到0.598；预测分数可揭示不同退化对编码器特定可识别性的影响。TransFIRA+在BRIAR上训练的预测器经校准后，在两个未见多摄像头数据集上改进了人脸+身体融合识别，优于检测器置信度加权和未校准CCS排序加权。
AI.conclusion: 以编码器为基准的可识别性可跨生物特征模态与识别场景泛化，且预测分数兼作质量度量与融合权重来源。

title: Goemans's Unsplittable-Flow Conjecture: The Anatomy of AI-Assisted Counterexample Discovery
summary: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible route choices; their convex hull, the conflict polytope, yields exact conditions for demands, fractional flows, and costs. Starting from a simple arborescence, the pipeline selects Rybin's topology and characterizes all counterexamples it supports. Experiments further demonstrate the pipeline's transferability: when instructed to follow it while varying the initial arborescence and shortcut placement, ChatGPT produced counterexamples on topologies genuinely different from Rybin's and found valid constructions starting from 93 other rooted arborescence shapes. The theory also explains why the original example was difficult to discover through blind enumeration and suggests that Rybin's interaction lies between blind enumeration and a complete theory-guided construction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套"正向反例构造流水线"，从必然可行的有向树出发，加入进入终点的捷径弧，用冲突多面体的凸包给出需求、分数流与代价的精确存在条件，从而系统构造Goemans单源不可分流猜想的反例。
AI.motivation: Rybin借助ChatGPT得到的七点反例推翻了Goemans长期猜想，但该交互未能解释为何这特定拓扑、需求、分数流与代价组合能奏效，也不知其是否属于更大族、哪些结构特征决定反例出现的位置，更不清楚AI搜索为何成功而人类此前失败。
AI.method: 构建正向反例构造流水线：从失败不可能发生的有向树（arborescence）出发，加入进入终点的捷径弧；由此得到的负载约束定义有限的可容许路径选择集合，其凸包即"冲突多面体"，给出需求、分数流与代价的精确条件；并以简单有向树为起点复现Rybin拓扑并刻画其支持的全部反例，同时实验测试流水线可迁移性（改变初始树与捷径位置，含ChatGPT引导搜索）。
AI.result: 该流水线完整刻画了Rybin拓扑上所有反例；实验表明在流水线指导下，ChatGPT在明显不同于Rybin的拓扑上产出反例，并从另外93种有根有向树形状中找到有效构造。
AI.conclusion: 理论解释了原例为何难以通过盲目枚举发现，并表明Rybin的交互介于盲目枚举与完全理论指导的构造之间；该流水线可迁移至更广的拓扑族。

title: MARS Technical Report
summary:
Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario.
  This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety.
  The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic.
  Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.

AI.tldr: MARS 将推荐系统多阶段流水线（召回/粗排/精排/重排）的整体编排决策交给近线 LLM 智能体，为每个用户生成七维配置（流水线模式、召回配额、模型选择、融合权重、重排设置），并以置信度感知 SFT + FAPO + GRPO 三阶段训练策略；淘宝五场景两周 A/B 测试全部关键指标正向，最大场景 V2P +5.22%、GMV +7.34%，平均服务延迟降低 12ms。
AI.motivation: 现有多阶段级联中，渠道激活、配额、模型选择、分数融合等流水线级决策仍由工程师手工调优，且在同一场景内对所有用户一视同仁，个性化仅停留在各阶段模型内部，缺少用户级的全链路编排能力。
AI.method: 基于微调 Qwen3-0.6B 构建近线智能体，从受限动作空间生成用户级七维配置；配置经校验、缓存后异步消费，级联服务不等 LLM 推理，并配 schema 校验、回退与 kill switch 保障安全。策略三阶段训练：置信度感知 SFT 从教师模型蒸馏 schema 合法输出；FAPO 通过 ActionMask 与后验加权学习动作偏好；GRPO 借助 Sandbox 回放与冻结奖励模型精调，探索动作不触碰线上流量。
AI.result: 淘宝五场景日均千万级用户的两周 A/B 测试中所有关键指标均为正，最大场景 V2P +5.22%、GMV +7.34%，两个点击面 CTR 均提升；约 20% 请求采用轻量 Minimal 模式，部署后平均服务延迟较生产降低 12ms。
AI.conclusion: MARS 证明将个性化从单阶段预测扩展到全流水线编排是可行且收益显著的，工程上通过异步消费与安全机制实现了 LLM 决策与低延迟服务的解耦，可作为工业级多阶段推荐的通用编排范式。

title: From Data Quality to Data Trustworthiness in AI-Driven Software-Intensive Embedded Systems: A Systematic Review
comment: This is a preprint version and the final version will appear in the proceedings of PROFES 2026
summary: AI-driven software-intensive embedded systems (SIES) depend on data during development and operation. Poor data quality (DQ) may weaken data trustworthiness, yet evidence about its effects and lifecycle management remains fragmented. This systematic literature review synthesizes 27 primary studies published from January 2020 to February 2026. It examines DQ concerns and evidence linking them to reduced data trustworthiness, along with assessment and management methods. The review identifies 16 concerns organized as Source Quality and Content Quality. Studies provide DQ-based scores and evidence of effects on model or decision performance.
