Synthesis suggests upstream source or handling problems may become embedded in training baselines and remain difficult to detect at runtime. Eight method categories were identified. Runtime monitoring is the largest category, while upstream and training-time controls remain poorly integrated with runtime assurance. No study covers the full lifecycle. Data trustworthiness supports reliable SIES decisions but is one component of AI-system trustworthiness.

AI.tldr: 系统综述27篇(2020.1–2026.2)文献，梳理AI驱动嵌入式系统的数据质量关切（16项，分来源质量与内容质量）、其对数据可信性的影响证据及8类评估管理方法；发现无研究覆盖全生命周期。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的软件密集型嵌入式系统在开发与运行中依赖数据，数据质量差会削弱数据可信性，但相关影响证据与生命周期管理实践高度碎片化，缺乏系统性整合。
AI.method: 系统文献综述，纳入2020年1月至2026年2月发表的27篇原始研究；对数据质量关切进行分类归纳，并识别影响证据与评估管理方法类别。
AI.result: 识别16项数据质量关切（归为来源质量与内容质量两类）；研究提供了基于数据质量的评分及对模型或决策性能影响的证据，提示上游来源或处理问题可能固化进训练基线、运行期难以检测。共归纳8类方法：运行时监控占比最大，而上游与训练期控制同运行时保障整合不足。
AI.conclusion: 数据可信性支撑嵌入式系统可靠决策，但仅是AI系统可信性的一个组成部分；现有研究缺乏全生命周期覆盖，需加强上游、训练期与运行时保障的贯通整合。

title: Sharp Complexity Thresholds for Network Cournot Competition
summary:
We determine the approximation complexity of network Cournot equilibrium as a function of demand degree and the number of firms sharing a market. For common, nonincreasing concave polynomial inverse demands, convex quadratic costs of firms' allocation vectors, and rational total capacities, high-precision approximation is polynomial-time solvable for cubic demands, regardless of market size. Quartic demands remain tractable when each market has at most three firms, and quintic demands remain tractable with at most two. These thresholds are exact: approximation at a fixed positive profit-regret tolerance is PPAD-hard for quartic demands with four firms per market, quintic demands with three, and sextic demands with two. Each hardness result uses one fixed demand curve in every market, a constant number of markets per firm, and globally nondecreasing strongly convex quadratic costs.
  We also give a polynomial-time algorithm for arbitrary-degree nonincreasing concave polynomial demands when each firm's convex polynomial cost depends only on its total production. The algorithm applies to arbitrary access graphs and permits firm-specific inverse demands. Its running time is polynomial in the input size and the logarithm of the inverse accuracy. The algorithm assigns one marginal charge to each firm and adjusts the charges until each firm's total sales approximate the quantity it would produce at that charge.

AI.tldr: 本文确定网络古诺均衡近似复杂度随需求次数与市场企业数的精确分界：三次需求始终可多项式时间高精度近似，四次至多3家、五次至多2家仍可解，而四次4家、五次3家、六次2家则PPAD-hard；并对总产量依赖成本给出任意次数可近似算法。
AI.motivation: 刻画网络古诺均衡的近似复杂度如何依赖需求多项式的次数和每个市场的企业数量，找出可计算与PPAD-hard之间的精确阈值。
AI.method: 对非增凹多项式逆需求、凸二次成本向量与有理总容量，按需求次数和企业数分类构造多项式时间高精度近似算法；硬性结果通过固定需求曲线、常数市场竞争数与全局强凸二次成本归约到PPAD-hard问题；另给出基于"每家一个边际收费并迭代调整"的算法处理成本只依赖总产量的任意次数情形。
AI.result: 三次需求任意市场大小可高精度多项式近似；四次≤3家、五次≤2家可处理。阈值精确：固定正利润遗憾容差下，四次4家、五次3家、六次2家近似为PPAD-hard。第二个算法对任意次数、任意接入图、企业特定逆需求运行时间为输入规模与精度对数的多项式。
AI.conclusion: 需求次数与企业数构成网络古诺均衡近似复杂度的精确相变边界；总产量成本情形下复杂度消失,可高效近似任意次数均衡。

title: From Arraignment to Resolution: Transformer Models of Court Cases
summary: The criminal legal system is composed of many complex decision points, such as which charges are pursued, how bond is determined, plea deal negotiations, and sentencing. Given the profound impact of such decisions, there is a growing need to increase the transparency within this system. While prior machine learning approaches have focused on modeling single decisions (e.g., recidivism), this paper proposes a transformer-based time series model to forecast the outcome of the next proceeding in a case (e.g., charges accepted, bond set, plea deal made, etc.). By modeling a case as an event sequence, we enable a more nuanced analysis to support better oversight and understanding of decision making. We conduct an empirical analysis of thousands of cases using a newly constructed dataset derived from publicly available court records of a mid-sized U.S. city. We fit models that combine textual data from clerk notes with structured information about the defendant, prior charges, and courtroom. Our transformer model achieves $.57$ micro-F1 on a 20-class multi-label task, a significant improvement over several baselines and comparable to a GRU trained on the same input. We demonstrate how the model can be used to provide insights into decision-making and help court observers identify emerging issues within the jurisdiction studied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer的时间序列模型，将案件建模为事件序列以预测案件下一次程序的结果，并利用新构建的法院记录数据集验证了模型有效性并能辅助司法决策监督。
AI.motivation: 刑事司法系统包含保释、认罪协商、量刑等多个复杂决策点，其影响深远，因此迫切需要提高决策透明度。此前机器学习方法多聚焦单一决策（如再犯预测），难以刻画案件全程的决策过程。
AI.method: 将案件视为事件序列，构建基于Transformer的时间序列模型来预测下一次程序结果（如指控被接受、保释设定、达成认罪协议等）。数据来自美国某中型城市公开法院记录新构建的数据集，融合书记员笔记文本与被告、既往指控、法庭等结构化信息。
AI.result: 在20类多标签任务上，Transformer模型取得0.57的micro-F1，显著优于多个基线，与相同输入训练的GRU相当。模型还能揭示决策规律，帮助法庭观察者发现辖区内新出现的问题。
AI.conclusion: 表明将案件建模为事件序列可支持更细致的分析与监督，Transformer模型能够为司法决策透明化与问题发现提供实用工具。

title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.

AI.tldr: RFBench是一个基于ADS Momentum仿真的被动射频版图设计基准数据集，包含10,000个双端口平面版图及七项跨模态任务，揭示了多模态语言模型在射频版图生成与物理响应预测上的系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态语言模型能否连接被动射频设计意图、版图几何与电磁行为尚无系统评测，缺乏带仿真真值的标准测试平台。
AI.method: 构建10,000个双端口平面版图，每个用可编辑几何图元、栅格图像、16x16占据网格、201频点复S参数、结构类别和RF响应标签等多重对齐表示描述；定义七项任务（规格条件生成、表示翻译、响应预测、仿真验证、设计诊断与改进、结构理解、响应分类），并在七个多模态语言模型上建立基线，另做RF领域微调实验。
AI.result: 基线模型在生成结构有效版图和预测电磁可信响应上存在系统性弱点；RF专用微调将T1a结构有效率从0.0%提升至83.2%，T3图元输入的2dB内命中率从17.7%提升至62.8%。
AI.conclusion: RFBench为评估多模态射频能力提供统一测试平台，证明领域适配有效但仍留有较大提升空间，可指导连接设计意图、版图表示与物理行为的模型研发。

title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
summary: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 control by +0.954 percentage points (73.88% vs. 72.92%) across an 88-epoch stateless replay schedule, with learned attention amplitude rising monotonically with semantic depth (27.2% at P3 -> 45.4% at P4 -> 66.3% at P5). Second, we evaluate recurrent weight sharing across repeated MBConv blocks with pass-specific BatchNorm statistics (+1,536 parameters per pass). While post-hoc kernel averaging degrades accuracy to 17.03% and single-template stage tying (-27.6% parameters) plateaus at 66.10%, alternating two shared block templates ([B1, A, B, A]) in Stage 6 cuts total model parameters by 10.9% (582K weights) and recovers by +10.82 points in a single epoch to 70.92% (-1.84 points vs. unshared control).

AI.tldr: 在EfficientNet-B0上系统研究两个混合架构问题：全局自注意力应插入何处，以及重复MBConv块能否共享权重。结论是零门控残差自注意力适配器插在P3/P4/P5效果最佳（提升约+0.95点），而交替双模板权重共享可减参10.9%仅损失约1.84点。
AI.motivation: 紧凑卷积骨干（如EfficientNet）参数效率高，但混合设计中两个结构问题尚无定论：全局自注意力相对纯卷积在何处带来识别提升，以及重复块能否共享权重而不损失表征能力。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k上用受控的EfficientNet-B0实验：(1) 比较BiFPN多尺度特征金字塔（含/不含阶段注意力）与纯MBConv主干；(2) 保持MBConv主干不变，在P3(28x28窗口)、P4(14x14全局)、P5(7x7全局)插入轻量零门控残差自注意力适配器，并与逐位匹配的纯B0对照在88轮无状态重放调度下比较；(3) 评估重复MBConv块间的循环权重共享（每次传递独立BatchNorm），测试后验核平均、单模板阶段绑定、交替双模板[B1,A,B,A]方案。
AI.result: BiFPN包裹不及纯B0（69.99%–71.81% vs 72.86%），加阶段注意力后达73.15%。零门控自注意力适配器独立达74.02%，比匹配对照高+0.954点（73.88% vs 72.92%），且注意力幅度随语义深度单调上升（P3 27.2%→P4 45.4%→P5 66.3%）。权重共享方面：后验核平均崩溃至17.03%，单模板阶段绑定（-27.6%参数）止步66.10%，交替双模板在Stage 6减参10.9%（582K权重），单轮恢复+10.82点至70.92%（较未共享对照-1.84点）。
AI.conclusion: 全局自注意力更适合以轻量残差适配器形式插入深层阶段（P4/P5收益更大），优于金字塔包裹式改造；而适度的交替模板权重共享可在小幅精度损失下显著压缩参数，极端共享（核平均）则不可行。

title: Response-Relevant Information Is Not Sufficient for Neural Training-State Equivalence
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Code and provenance verified artifacts: https://github.com/ClevixLab/training-state-equivalence
summary: Response-relevant information is not sufficient evidence that two neural networks are in the same training state. We define training-state equivalence operationally: two checkpoints are equivalent, relative to an intervention family and horizon, if they respond alike when training is perturbed and continues. On fresh runs of a one-layer transformer learning modular addition, response to a weight-decay pulse is highly reproducible relative to between-checkpoint differences (rho_state = 0.934 at 500 steps), establishing the target as measurable. Fifteen descriptors of weight spectra, representation geometry and optimiser geometry carry within-run response-relevant information beyond weight norm and loss on a development dataset, predicting held-out response deviation across seed blocks. But their apparent 16.1% advantage at matching checkpoints by future response does not separate from a conditional placebo preserving each descriptor's fitted dependence on the conventional observables, and a calibrated positive control makes simple insensitivity an unlikely explanation. Information a decoder can extract need not be organised in the pairwise geometry that similarity judgments require.

AI.tldr: 在单层Transformer学模加法的实验中，检查点的"响应相关"信息可测量，但15个权重谱/表示/优化器几何描述子虽在开发集上优于权重范数和损失，其匹配优势与保留条件依赖的安慰剂无法区分，说明解码可得信息未必组织成相似性判断所需的成对几何。
AI.motivation: 区分两个神经网络是否处于同一训练状态：响应相关信息不足以为证。作者因此以"操作化"方式定义训练状态等价——相对某个干预族与时间跨度，若训练被扰动并继续时两者响应相似，则视为等价。
AI.method: 用单层Transformer学模加法，重复新训练运行，对权重衰减做一次"脉冲"干预并测量响应；计算状态内重复性rho_state。再用15个描述子（权重谱、表示几何、优化器几何）做预测，检验其在开发集上对留出响应偏差的预测能力；并设计与传统观测量条件依赖相匹配的"条件安慰剂"和校准的阳性对照。
AI.result: 响应相对检查点间差异高度可重复（500步时rho_state=0.934），目标可测量。15个描述子确实携带超出权重范数与损失的信息，并预测跨种子块的留出响应偏差。但按未来响应匹配检查点时，其表观16.1%优势无法与条件安慰剂区分，阳性对照又排除了"简单的不敏感性"解释。
AI.conclusion: 响应相关信息存在于检查点中，但不足以支撑基于成对相似性几何的匹配判断：解码器可提取的信息未必以相似性判断所需的方式组织。这为"训练状态等价"的操作化定义与检验范式提供了方法论警示。

title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
comment: Alexander Ploshkin, Nikita Stepanov and Alexey Pismenny contributed equally to this work
summary: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.

AI.tldr: X-split ARGUS 是一个端到端训练的广告排序框架，用离线计算的压缩历史 token 与近期行为交叉注意力来预测 CTR，可在生产算力/延迟约束下平衡效果与成本。
AI.motivation: 准确 CTR 预测需同时刻画用户的长期偏好与近期意图，但对每次排序请求处理完整行为历史在生产算力与延迟约束下成本过高。
AI.method: 历史压缩器与在线排序器端到端联合训练：压缩器将历史交互编码为少量紧凑 token，离线计算并在候选间复用；在线排序器通过交叉注意力对这些 token 与近期事件表示打分。训练将点击反馈的自回归损失与蒸馏损失结合，后者来自使用未压缩历史为每个候选打分的更大教师模型。压缩 token 数与近期历史长度可调以适配服务预算。
AI.result: 离线评估中归一化熵（NE）相对生产基线降低 0.81%；部署于大规模实时竞价系统使在线推理成本相对基线增加 15%；线上 A/B 测试中广告主转化货币价值业务指标相对提升 4.65%，点击提升 2.96%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以可控的推理开销换取显著线上收益，验证了离线压缩复用 + 在线交叉注意力 + 教师蒸馏端到端训练的实用价值。

title: Measuring What Matters in the Age of AI: The Research Software Metrics Landscape
summary: Research software now serves as a primary instrument of science, but the methods the community uses to judge its quality, sustainability, reuse, and impact remain scattered across software engineering, open science, FAIR software, citation, and research-assessment literature. AI-assisted development sharpens the problem: code can be produced at rates that outpace human review capacity, provenance and attribution are harder to track, scholarly credit systems cannot keep pace, and existing metrics inherit assumptions about how research software gets developed that may no longer apply. To aid in navigating these challenges, we present a focused landscape synthesis of research software metrics based on 49 substantive references, organizing the recurring metrics into eight families described by data source, claimed construct, evidence of validity, automation potential, and susceptibility to misuse. Many widely cited research software metrics serve as partial signals but make weak standalone measures of scientific impact. The AI era opens or widens gaps around provenance, maintainability of generated code, reviewer effort, model and data dependencies, reuse and community-health signal inflation, and credit for human labor that AI does not perform. We argue for responsible, contextual, mixed-method use of research software metrics, and offer decision guidance for Research Software Engineers (RSEs), principal investigators, institutions, and funders selecting metrics that support better software, fairer credit, and more trustworthy science. All findings rest on the 49-reference focused review; a reproducible search-and-triage protocol and a 727-record triaged corpus accompany the paper as a transparency artifact for a future full systematic mapping study.

AI.tldr: 一篇基于49篇文献的研究软件度量的聚焦综述，将常见度量归为八大类，并指出AI辅助开发带来的新缺口，提出负责任、情境化、混合方法的使用建议。
AI.motivation: 研究软件已成为科学的主要工具，但评价其质量、可持续性、复用与影响力的方法分散在软件工程、开放科学、FAIR软件、引用与研究评估等多个领域；AI辅助开发生成代码速度超过人工审查能力，溯源与署名更难追踪，学术贡献体系跟不上，现有度量所依赖的开发假设可能失效。
AI.method: 基于49篇实质性参考文献的聚焦式景观综述；将反复出现的度量按数据来源、声称的构念、效度证据、自动化潜力、误用易感性五个维度组织为八大族；附带可复现的检索与筛选协议及727条记录的分类语料库作为透明度人工物。
AI.result: 许多被广泛引用的研究软件度量只是部分信号，作为科学影响力的独立度量较弱；AI时代在溯源、生成代码可维护性、评审工作量、模型与数据依赖、复用与社区健康信号膨胀、以及AI无法替代的人力劳动署名等方面扩大或产生新缺口。
AI.conclusion: 主张负责任、情境化、混合方法地使用研究软件度量，并为RSE、首席研究员、机构与资助方提供选指标的决策指导，以支持更好的软件、更公平的署名和更可信的科学；结论限于49篇文献的聚焦综述，为未来完整系统映射研究奠定基础。

title: Dreaming Up Authors: Factual Prevalence and LLM Hallucinations in Academic Authorship Attribution
comment: Published in EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 37 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/quinnzhong1/dreaming-up-authors. Anthology: https://aclanthology.org/2026.emnlp-main.2372/
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used for question answering but are prone to hallucinations, yet the underlying causes, particularly the role of factual prevalence in training data, remain underexplored. In this work, we study this through academic authorship attribution, hypothesizing that hallucinations are more likely for less prevalent papers. Using citation count as a proxy for factual prevalence, we curate a dataset of 1.92 million papers across eight scientific disciplines with stratified samples by citation level. Experiments on three state-of-the-art LLMs confirm our hypothesis, revealing a robust inverse relationship between hallucination rate and citation count across all models and disciplines, with hallucination rates exceeding 98% for rarely cited papers and falling below 37% for highly cited ones. Our in-depth analysis further shows that these failures primarily reflect retrieval limitations rather than knowledge absence, and hidden-state probing of open-source models shows that factual prevalence is encoded in pre-generation representations, providing convergent mechanistic evidence for the prevalence-hallucination relationship. The code and data are available at https://github.com/quinnzhong1/dreaming-up-authors.

AI.tldr: 论文研究训练数据中事实流行度与LLM幻觉的关系，以学术论文作者归属为任务，发现引用量越低的论文幻觉率越高，并将其归因于检索限制而非知识缺失。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛用于问答但易产生幻觉，其成因尤其是训练数据中事实流行度（factual prevalence）的作用尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 以学术作者归属为研究任务，用引用量作为事实流行度的代理指标，构建覆盖8个学科、按引用层级分层抽样的192万篇论文数据集；在3个SOTA LLM上实验，并做深入分析（失败归因）及开源模型隐藏状态探测。
AI.result: 三个模型、所有学科均呈现幻觉率与引用量的稳健负相关：极少被引论文幻觉率超98%，高被引论文低于37%。分析表明失败主要源于检索限制而非知识缺失；隐藏状态探测显示事实流行度被编码在生成前的表征中。
AI.conclusion: 证实数据流行度与幻觉率的因果关联，提供机制性证据（流行度编码于预生成表征），并公开代码与数据。

title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
summary: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. We show that keeping less than 5% of critical layer activations in 8-bit precision recovers up to 92% of the accuracy lost during aggressive sub-4-bit compression. Finally, we bridge the hardware reality gap by evaluating deployment performance on standard ARM and x86 CPU architectures. We show that while low-bit quantization reduces memory storage requirements, standard runtime software bit-unpacking introduces a 1.48x to 21.5x execution slowdown depending on batch size, highlighting a critical trade-off between model footprint and actual edge throughput. Our findings provide a practical blueprint for navigating the limits of sub-4-bit deployment without sacrificing hardware performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统剖析了视觉 CNN 在低于4比特量化时的"崩溃解剖学"：崩溃呈高度非线性，集中于后段 pointwise 投影与 depthwise 层；保留不到5%关键层激活为8比特精度可恢复至多92%的精度损失；同时揭示CPU上bit-unpacking带来1.48x–21.5x执行减速的硬件现实权衡。
AI.motivation: 资源受限环境下视觉模型依赖低位量化，但权重压到4比特以下常导致灾难性精度崩塌；现有混合精度恢复策略只是"救精度"，却不清楚崩溃发生在哪里、为何发生，缺乏系统机理理解与部署可行性评估。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k完整5万张验证集上，对ResNet、EfficientNet等标准视觉CNN进行系统性分析：1）逐层映射量化退化进程，定位崩溃集中区域；2）提出结构化多步恢复瀑布（recovery waterfall），评估选择性INT4/INT8整数精度与选择性浮点scale；3）在ARM与x86 CPU上实测部署性能，量化bit-unpacking带来的运行时开销。
AI.result: 崩溃高度非线性，集中于后段pointwise projection与depthwise层；将不足5%的关键层激活保持8比特即可挽回激进sub-4-bit压缩所致精度损失的至多92%；低位量化虽降低存储，但标准运行时软件解包导致1.48x–21.5x的执行减速（随batch size变化）。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了一套在sub-4-bit部署极限下兼顾精度与硬件吞吐的实践蓝图，强调仅看模型体积不足够，必须同时考虑实际边缘执行效率，并指出关键层选择性高位保留是高效的恢复手段。

title: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
summary: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.

AI.tldr: NIRJALA：一种基于三路径水下成像模型（TRIVENI）与可逆物理锚（PRATIBIMBA）的3D高斯泼溅框架，可同时恢复无水外观与几何，并证明反演增益在全距离上有界。
AI.motivation: 水下图像并非简单着色，而是衰减场景辐射、后向散射与前向散射的混合，存在严重病态性；多数高斯泼溅方法只建模前两项并用指数衰减透射率做除法去除水体，导致反演增益无界发散。
AI.method: 提出TRIVENI三路径成像模型（在直接透射与后向散射外增加距离饱和的前向散射项），证明反演增益有界并给出后向散射/衰减误差的传播界；PRATIBIMBA可逆物理锚将灵活神经水体模型与十参数物理模型双向绑定；SAMARASA整合物理约束目标（含距离分箱颜色先验）。此外构建SAJALA——30场景Blender Cycles路径追踪数据集，含无水图像、深度与法线。
AI.result: 在SAJALA上相比最强基线，PSNR由24.34提升至24.76 dB，深度AbsRel由0.109降至0.091；在真实SeaThru-NeRF场景上LPIPS由0.194降至0.175，渲染速度44 FPS。论文还讨论了水下外观指标与几何评价不一致的现象及评估局限。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入有界反演的三路径物理模型与双向可逆物理锚，可有效抑制水体"藏匿"场景信息，实现外观与几何联合恢复；但现有水下评价指标（外观与几何）存在分歧，评估本身仍有局限。

title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
summary: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured walls match the formulas to between 89 and 94 percent. We give closed-form rigorous remainders, among them the first polynomial softmax transformer; existing sound treatments are linear relaxations. On closed loops, certificates survive where the Taylor ones diverge, and specifications flip from unknown to proven; on trained classifiers up to real MNIST digits, the Chebyshev frontier certifies input territory the Taylor basis surrenders. Every certified claim passed large Monte-Carlo harnesses with zero violations, and an applicability map states in advance where the basis provably cannot matter.

AI.tldr: 该文指出Taylor展开在非线性动力学可达集计算上存在收敛半径"天花板"，并用Chebyshev抽象给出无上限、随阶数几何增益的替代方案，获得首个多项式softmax transformer的严格余项证明。
AI.motivation: 现代控制器中的有理项与sigmoid门在实轴上光滑，但复平面上近轴奇点会限制Taylor展开可覆盖的集合宽度，且在切换面处最紧——这正是控制器决策的关键区域。作者希望突破这一"点态展开"固有瓶颈。
AI.method: 证明二分性：任何阶数的Taylor展开都无法证明超过奇点决定的宽度上限；而同阶Chebyshev多项式zonotope抽象锚定整个集合，无此上限，宽度以几何速率随阶数增长。给出闭式严格余项，包括首个多项式softmax transformer的严格界。
AI.result: 实测"墙壁"与公式吻合89–94%；闭环中Chebyshev证书在Taylor发散的场合仍成立，规格由未知变为已证；在真实MNIST训练分类器上认证出Taylor基放弃的输入区域。所有认证声明经大规模蒙特卡洛检验零违例。
AI.conclusion: Chebyshev抽象在多項式zonotope流程中全面优于Taylor基，并提供适用性地图预判基函数何时不可能起作用。

title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.

AI.tldr: ExecJudges 用前沿 LLM 将评估指南转写为可执行程序（仅依赖词法匹配、解析器等标准 NLP 工具和池统计），为每个话题生成快速、可检视、可复现的相关性判定器，替代逐文档调用 LLM 的昂贵判断。
AI.motivation: LLM 裁判已成为大规模相关性标注的常用手段，但每次判定都要调用昂贵的前沿模型，且判定结果难以解释、不易复现。作者追问：能否让 LLM 为每个话题直接写出一段可读程序，代替逐文档的判定。
AI.method: 提出 ExecJudges：利用前沿 LLM 把评估准则转换为可执行程序，程序中只使用词法匹配、标准 NLP 库（如 parser）和结果池统计信息；其 ExecJudges-L 变体在存在人工标签样例时可加以利用。在七个 TREC 集合上，将生成标签与 NIST 评审员、前沿 LLM 裁判及近期提出的按话题分类器进行比较。
AI.result: 在 TREC DL 2019–2021 上，ExecJudges 与 NIST 评审员的一致性达到 Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM 裁判的水平；每话题仅需少量人工标签时，ExecJudges-L 在全部七个集合上均优于使用同样标签的按话题分类器，在 Krippendorff's alpha 上超过或与同标签 LLM 裁判相差约 0.05 以内。所得标签对官方 TREC DL 系统排名的一致性 Kendall's tau 为 0.87–0.94；写程序为一次性成本，每话题 0.17–0.49 美元，后续评分无额外费用。
AI.conclusion: ExecJudges 为深层结果池标注提供了可复现、可检视、高效且低成本的 LLM 裁判替代方案，适用于系统评估或排序改进。

title: Structure-Behavior Coalescence: A Definition of Systems
summary: For more than seventy years, systems engineering has developed extensive models and frameworks, yet the fundamental question of what constitutes a system remains insufficiently formalized. Existing approaches often treat structure and behavior as separate aspects, leaving their unity, system identity, and consistency conditions insufficiently defined. This paper introduces Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC) as a formal framework that defines a system as an integrated entity in which structure and behavior are coalesced through interaction. SBC provides a formal modeling approach with well-formedness constraints for maintaining structural-behavioral coherence, including representations for terminal, paused, and intermediate states and rules for sequential, parallel, and alternative behaviors. The framework provides a formal perspective on the question, "What is a system?", and establishes a foundation for consistent system modeling, verification, and analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文提出结构-行为聚合(SBC)形式化框架，将系统定义为通过交互使结构与行为聚合的整合实体，旨在形式化回答"什么是系统"。
AI.motivation: 七十余年来系统工程发展了众多模型与框架，但"系统的本质构成"这一根本问题仍缺乏充分形式化。现有方法常将结构与行为割裂处理，二者的统一性、系统身份及一致性问题定义不足。
AI.method: 提出SBC形式化建模方法：以交互为纽带将结构与行为聚合为一体，给出良构性约束以维系结构-行为一致性，并提供终态、暂停态、中间态的表征，以及顺序、并行、备择行为的规则。
AI.result: 框架为系统身份与结构-行为统一提供了形式化定义与一致性条件，能够支撑一致性的系统建模、验证与分析。
AI.conclusion: SBC从形式化视角回答了"什么是系统"，为一致的系统建模、验证与分析奠定理论基础。

title: Can LLMs Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the latent mechanisms that generate observable outcomes. To examine this assumption, we introduce LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether models can infer latent market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations. Models generate event-induced causal graphs representing inferred market structure and are evaluated through a reconstruction-based framework. Our evaluation of 6 open-weight and proprietary LLMs shows that adding their generated graphs generally reduces reconstruction quality compared with using historical observations alone, although a few metrics improve. These findings suggest that inferring informative, event-specific market structures from observable evidence remains challenging for the evaluated LLMs.

AI.tldr: LUCID基准通过让LLM从事件描述和历史金融观测中生成因果图，检验其能否推断潜在市场结构；结果显示多数模型生成的图反而降低重构质量。
AI.motivation: 现有评估隐含假设"预测成功=理解系统"，但准确预测未必意味着恢复了生成观测结果的潜在机制，因此需要直接检验模型能否推断潜在结构。
AI.method: 提出LUCID基准：模型基于事件描述与历史金融观测生成事件诱发的因果图（表示推断的市场结构），并用基于重构的框架进行评估；测试了6个开源与专有LLM。
AI.result: 加入模型生成的因果图后，重构质量整体上不如仅使用历史观测，仅少数指标有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 从可观测证据中推断有信息量、事件特异的市场结构，对所评估的LLM仍具挑战性；预测表现不能等同于机制理解。

title: LusoClin: A Synthetic Clinical Note Dataset for Medical Information Retrieval in European Portuguese
summary: Access to large-scale clinical text collections is crucial for advancing medical information retrieval research, including clinical note search, patient cohort identification, and domain-adapted retrieval models. However, real clinical notes are rarely available due to privacy regulations, which particularly limits progress for low-resource languages such as European Portuguese. We present LusoClin, a publicly released dataset of synthetic clinical notes in European Portuguese, created to support privacy-preserving research on clinical text retrieval. LusoClin was generated by pre-processing real clinical data, fine-tuning the open-source Llama 3.2 (3B) instruction-tuned model using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, and applying prompt-based clinical note generation. To facilitate semantic indexing and clinical search, the notes are automatically annotated with clinical entities using a BERT-based model. We evaluate LusoClin in terms of utility, fidelity, diversity, and privacy using automatic metrics and human evaluation. Results indicate that the dataset captures clinically relevant language patterns and can support downstream IR applications such as clinical document retrieval and domain-specific model adaptation, although annotators can often distinguish synthetic from real notes and some medical inconsistencies persist.

AI.tldr: 本文发布LusoClin——一个欧洲葡萄牙语合成临床笔记的公开数据集，用于隐私保护的临床文本检索研究。
AI.motivation: 大规模临床文本对医学信息检索至关重要，但隐私法规使真实临床笔记难以获取，尤其限制了欧洲葡萄牙语等低资源语言的研究进展。
AI.method: 先预处理真实临床数据，再用QLoRA微调开源Llama 3.2 (3B)指令模型，通过提示生成合成临床笔记；并用BERT模型自动标注临床实体以支持语义索引与检索。
AI.result: 通过自动指标与人工评估从实用性、保真度、多样性和隐私性四方面评估：数据集能捕捉临床相关语言模式，可支持临床文档检索与领域模型适配；但标注者常能区分合成与真实笔记，且仍存在医学不一致性。
AI.conclusion: LusoClin为低资源语言的隐私保护临床检索研究提供了可用资源，但合成质量（真实感与医学一致性）仍需改进。

title: mmTherm: Absolute 3D Human Pose Estimation from Low-Resolution Thermal Images and mmWave Radar
summary: Absolute 3D human pose estimation (HPE) aims to recover both a person's body pose and their global position in 3D space. Privacy-preserving millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides distance and direction measurement capabilities, but its sparse point clouds make HPE under-constrained. Low-resolution thermal imaging can provide complementary observations of body direction and structure. However, our evaluation shows that a strong feature-level fusion baseline loses much of its localization and HPE advantage when generalizing to unseen subjects, with radial localization becoming less accurate than a radar-only baseline. Motivated by this finding, we introduce mmTherm, a lightweight framework that explicitly incorporates the complementary geometric properties of thermal imaging and mmWave radar. It combines body structure and joint directions estimated from thermal images with range information from radar to localize the body and reconstruct its 3D pose. Experiments on OctoNet show that mmTherm reduces cross-user absolute joint error by 33% and root localization error by 38% relative to the strongest corresponding baselines, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and less computation at inference.

AI.tldr: 该文提出mmTherm，一个轻量框架，融合热成像与毫米波雷达的几何互补信息实现绝对3D人体姿态估计，在未见受试者上显著降低跨用户误差。
AI.motivation: 绝对3D人体姿态估计需同时恢复姿态与全局位置。毫米波雷达保护隐私且能测距测向，但点云稀疏导致约束不足；低分辨率热成像可补充体向与结构信息。然而作者评估发现，强特征级融合基线在泛化到未见受试者时，定位与姿态优势大幅丧失，径向定位甚至不如只用雷达，说明简单特征融合不可靠。
AI.method: mmTherm显式利用两种模态的互补几何特性：从热图像估计身体结构与关节方向，结合雷达的距离信息，用于定位人体并重建3D姿态。框架设计轻量，参数量与推理计算量均较少。
AI.result: 在OctoNet数据集上，相较最强对应基线，跨用户绝对关节误差降低33%，根节点定位误差降低38%，同时参数更少、推理计算量更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于几何互补的显式融合比单纯特征级融合在跨用户泛化上更有效，且以更低计算成本实现更优的绝对姿态与定位精度。

title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
summary: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. An exact histogram implementation and two synthetic experiments across 20 seeds verify the construction. The optimized multiplier improves over uniform and average-density weights, while fitted-model performance does not improve uniformly. The result is a loss-design guarantee under an explicit budget, rather than a general claim of predictive superiority.

AI.tldr: 在阈值分布属于已知有限族的设定下，推导出使"代理遗憾→阈值平均决策遗憾"最坏情况乘子最小的proper loss权重，其为阈值密度的重标定上包络在给定下界处的截断，归一化由一维求根得到，并用实验验证。
AI.motivation: 同一二元概率估计会被不同错误成本的多个决策者使用；proper scoring rule可强调特定阈值，但单一平均阈值分布无法提供良好的最坏情况遗憾保证。因此需要在阈值分布属于指定有限族时选择合适proper loss，并给出显式的损失设计保证。
AI.method: 在具有正点态下界与固定总质量的绝对可积损失权重类中，最小化从代理遗憾到阈值平均决策遗憾的尖锐、无分布依赖乘子；解为阈值密度重标定上包络在指定下界处的截断（clip），归一化常数通过一维根搜索求得。论文证明了尖锐性、最优性与密度误设下的稳定性，并指出原子阈值律的局限；同时给出精确直方图实现，在20个随机种子上做两组合成实验。
AI.result: 优化后的乘子优于均匀权重与平均密度权重；但在拟合模型上的实际表现并非一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 该结果是在显式预算约束下的损失设计保证，而非预测优越性的普遍主张；原子阈值律存在本质局限。

title: Structure-Behavior Coalescence for Model-Based Systems Engineering
summary: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) has advanced system design and analysis for decades, yet traditional approaches often treat structure and behavior separately, resulting in inconsistencies, incomplete models, and ambiguity. This paper introduces Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC) as a formal and unified definition of systems for MBSE. SBC defines a system as a single integrated entity in which structure and behavior are coalesced through interaction, providing both a conceptual foundation and a formal process-algebra framework. Well-formedness constraints ensure that interactions are structurally grounded and compositions are valid, enabling consistency by construction. Boundary processes, including 0 for terminal states and a checkpoint construct for paused or suspended states, allow inactive and intermediate states to be represented while preserving system unity. Illustrative examples and a Smart Healthcare IoT case study demonstrate how SBC supports sequential, parallel, and alternative behaviors while maintaining structural-behavioral coherence. SBC provides a foundation for formal verification, compositional modeling, and systematic inconsistency detection, connecting a rigorous definition of systems with practical MBSE applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构-行为合一（SBC）作为MBSE中系统的形式化统一定义，用单一实体将结构与行为通过交互融合，并提供进程代数框架与良构约束，从而"构造即一致"，配以智慧医疗IoT案例验证。
AI.motivation: 传统MBSE方法往往将结构与行为分开建模，导致不一致、模型不完整与歧义。作者希望给出系统的形式化统一定义，使一致性由构造过程本身保证，并为形式验证与组合建模奠定基础。
AI.method: 将系统定义为结构与行为通过交互合一的单一集成实体，给出概念基础并建立进程代数形式化框架；引入良构性约束保证交互在结构上有依据、组合合法；引入边界进程（终止态记为0，以及表示暂停/挂起状态的检查点构造）以表达非活跃与中间状态并保持系统统一性；通过说明性示例与智慧医疗IoT案例，演示顺序、并行与选择行为的建模。
AI.result: 示例与智慧医疗IoT案例表明，SBC能在保持结构-行为一致性的同时支持顺序、并行与选择等行为；良构约束使模型一致性由构造保证，边界进程可表示非活跃与中间状态而不破坏系统统一性。
AI.conclusion: SBC为形式验证、组合式建模与系统性不一致检测提供了基础，把严格的系统定义与实际MBSE应用连接起来。

title: Language Models Make New Research Sound Old
summary: Researchers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to validate research questions. We find that LLMs make open research questions sound partly studied and overstate what related papers establish. Models recognize most of these overstatements when asked to check the papers' full texts separately. On 40 questions drawn from newly accepted papers, GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% to be unstudied, but states that status plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers. All six frontier systems show reporting gaps of 30-90 percentage points. Across 22 models given identical papers, higher capability is associated with more accurate judgments and larger reporting gaps. This reporting failure is asymmetric: models correctly identify studied questions in 88-100% of ordinary answers when we supply the answering papers. To correct this, we build a fixed answer from each model's judgment and separate checks of cited papers. This raises Astra's clear reporting of open status from 8% to 95%, with improvements in all six systems. Finally, we predict reviewers' novelty grades by combining several models' written ratings with a rule learned from graded examples, reaching the performance range reported by Think-Probe-Respond. Unlike TPR, our approach needs no access to model weights or internal activations, so it also works with closed-weight frontier models.

AI.tldr: LLMs tend to make genuinely open research questions sound partly studied and overstate what related literature establishes; a verification-and-repair pipeline largely fixes this reporting failure and supports novelty prediction without model internals.
AI.motivation: Researchers increasingly rely on LLMs to validate whether research questions are novel/unstudied, so failures in how models report the status of a question could mislead scientific work. The authors investigate whether LLMs accurately and clearly report that a question is open or already studied.
AI.method: Evaluate frontier LLMs on 40 questions from newly accepted papers. Compare models' ordinary answers with their judgments when verifying cited papers' full texts separately. Then construct a fixed answer combining each model's own judgment with separate checks of cited papers. Finally, predict reviewers' novelty grades by aggregating several models' written ratings with a rule learned from graded examples.
AI.result: GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% of questions as unstudied but states this plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers; all six frontier systems show 30-90 point reporting gaps. Across 22 models, higher capability correlates with more accurate judgments but larger gaps. The failure is asymmetric: studied questions are correctly identified in 88-100% of answers when answering papers are supplied. The repair raises Astra's clear open-status reporting from 8% to 95%, with gains in all six systems. Novelty-grade prediction reaches the range reported by Think-Probe-Respond.
AI.conclusion: LLMs have accurate internal judgments but poor reporting: they obscure the open status of questions. A lightweight verification-and-repair approach, requiring no weights or internal activations, substantially improves reporting and matches TPR-level novelty prediction, making it applicable to closed-weight frontier models.

title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
summary: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. Across two model backbones, the framework produces verifier-accepted drafts for 94% (47/50) of requirements per run. Blind expert evaluations confirm high mathematical accuracy and curriculum alignment, with strict teacher-readiness assessments accepting up to 56.8% of generated items. Analysis of rejected drafts reveals persistent domain-agnostic challenges involving formatting, statement validity, and solution-step completeness. These findings demonstrate that VeriMath can bridge generative AI and dependable educational applications by producing highly reviewable assessment drafts within tightly constrained national curriculum frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出VeriMath——一个人类在环的通用框架,用于生成严格且受课程标准约束的数学试题草稿,并在越南12年级4555道题的案例中达到每轮94%验证通过率。
AI.motivation: 自动生成数学试题在教育AI中兴起,但课堂部署困难:题目需同时满足数学正确性、课标对齐、合适认知难度与教师可审阅性;已有文本生成工作缺乏对局部考试格式的细粒度控制与专家教学判断。
AI.method: 以标注参考题为锚,将生成锚定到指定考试板块与认知推理层级;随后进行顺序化自动验证与引导式修复;最后交由专家审阅。
AI.result: 基于越南12年级4555道数学题与50条生成需求(涵盖选择题、判断题、简答题);两种模型主干下,每轮有94%(47/50)需求获得验证器接受的草稿;盲评显示数学准确性与课标对齐度高,严格教师可用性评估接受至多56.8%题目;被拒草稿暴露出格式、陈述有效性与解题步骤完整性等跨领域难题。
AI.conclusion: VeriMath能在严格国家课标框架下产出高度可审阅的试题草稿,从而连接生成式AI与可靠教育应用。

title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
summary: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.

AI.tldr: 提出离线、免训练、参考引导的数据筛选方法，用少量高质量参考集为大规模医学影像-报告对生成多模态质量信号并排序聚合，实现3D VLM高效预训练。
AI.motivation: 跨机构收集的大规模医学影像数据存在冗余、类别不平衡和异质性，直接用于3D视觉语言模型预训练受数据质量制约。
AI.method: 利用小型高质量参考集，为大规模未筛选数据池的每个模态独立提取质量信号，再通过秩聚合（rank-aggregation）融合为单一排序，据此选择训练样本；方法无需训练、可离线执行。
AI.result: 在3D腹部CT（35k样本、两个机构）上，用3.3倍更少数据和5k参考集即达到Merlin基线的零样本疾病分类性能；在2D胸片（58k样本）上，用最多10倍更少数据和仅74个参考样本即达到或超过全量训练模型。消融显示参考重采样下选择稳定、更小参考集仍优于随机采样、标签重平衡无收益。
AI.conclusion: 参考引导的数据筛选可显著降低医学3D VLM预训练的数据需求而不损失性能，方法简单、稳定且可复现。

title: Exploring Parkinson's Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Techniques
summary: In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as promising tools for accurate and timely diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) which is an incurable neurodegenerative disorder. This study explores the integration of ML algorithms and PD diagnosis, highlighting their potential applications in various aspects of the disease. ML methods such as support vector machines, decision trees, multilayer perceptron, k-nearest neighbours, logistic regression and random forest (with and without particle swarm optimisation) were applied on a PD dataset obtained from Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust containing data from 58 people. In terms of accuracy, the Decision Tree and Logistic Regression performed the best with scores of 72-76% while multilayer perceptron was least effective. All the models were remarkable in classifying positive PD cases with sensitivity scores going up to 97.56%, with SVM classifier at the pinnacle. However, ability to classify healthy controls from PD cases was insignificant throughout the board. Although, all the employed models delivered reasonable results in categorising PD patients in the presented dataset; access to more data, further study and advancement of these ML approaches could lead to enhanced diagnostic outcomes, supplementing to an improved understanding of Parkinson's disease.

AI.tldr: 本研究将多种机器学习算法（SVM、决策树、多层感知机、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林，含/不含粒子群优化）应用于Leeds教学医院的58人帕金森病数据集，准确率72-76%，阳性病例敏感性高达97.56%，但区分健康对照的能力不足。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病是不可治愈的神经退行性疾病，亟需准确、及时的诊断工具；作者希望探索机器学习在PD诊断中的整合潜力与应用价值。
AI.method: 在来自Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust的58人PD数据集上，采用SVM、决策树、多层感知机、KNN、逻辑回归和随机森林六类模型（部分结合粒子群优化PSO）进行分类实验，以准确率和敏感性等指标评估。
AI.result: 决策树与逻辑回归准确率最高（72–76%），多层感知机最差；所有模型的阳性PD识别敏感性突出，最高达97.56%（SVM最佳），但对健康对照的辨别能力普遍较弱。
AI.conclusion: 各模型在该数据集上对PD患者的分类结果尚属合理，但样本量小限制了阴性类判别；获取更多数据并进一步研究与改进ML方法有望提升诊断效果并加深对PD的理解。

title: Generative AI in Software Testing: Practitioners' Perspectives on the Benefits, Challenges, Opportunities, and Risks
comment: Accepted for publication in 27th International Conference on Product-Focused Software Process Improvement (PROFES 2026)
summary: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) increasingly supports software testing, yet empirical evidence on practitioners' perceptions remains limited. This study investigates perceived benefits, challenges, opportunities, and risks of GenAI in software testing through a questionnaire survey of 64 practitioners. Closed-ended responses were analyzed descriptively, while open-ended responses were qualitatively coded to contextualize the findings. Among the respondents, 34 were users (those with regular or experimental use of GenAI in testing) and 30 were non-users (those without prior use of GenAI in testing). Results show generally positive perceptions of GenAI for reducing effort, test generation, and debugging, alongside concerns about prompt dependence, trust, and incorrect outputs. Users were more positive about several concrete benefits while also more frequently prioritizing reliability-related risks, whereas non-users showed greater uncertainty about some technically specific challenges. Overall, the findings position GenAI as an assistive technology requiring human validation and highlight the importance of considering practitioners' experience with GenAI when interpreting perceptions of GenAI-assisted testing.

AI.tldr: 通过对64名从业者（34名用户、30名非用户）的问卷调查，研究GenAI在软件测试中的感知收益、挑战、机遇与风险，发现整体态度积极但强调需人工验证。
AI.motivation: GenAI正日益支持软件测试，但关于从业者感知的实证证据仍然有限，尤其是用户与非用户之间认知差异缺乏系统调查。
AI.method: 对64名从业者开展问卷调查：封闭式题目做描述性统计分析，开放式回答进行定性编码；并按使用经验分为GenAI用户（34人，常规或试验性使用）与非用户（30人，未使用）进行对比。
AI.result: 总体感知积极，认为GenAI可减少工作量、辅助测试生成与调试；同时担忧提示依赖、信任问题及错误输出。用户对多项具体收益更积极，且更常关注可靠性相关风险；非用户在某些技术性具体挑战上表现出更高不确定性。
AI.conclusion: GenAI应被定位为需人工验证的辅助技术；解读GenAI辅助测试的感知时，必须考虑从业者的使用经验差异。

title: FutureBench: A Renewable Framework for Evaluating Knowledge-Context Conflict in LLMs
summary: Asking a model to check retrieved text can also tell it which source to trust. We introduce FutureBench, a renewable framework for evaluating knowledge-context conflict using timestamped questions, controlled passage triplets, and no-context probes. Across 3,629 questions and six models, Verify (a prompt combining checking with passage priority) raises false-answer adoption in all five models tested on pre-cutoff events, mainly by displacing answers that were correct under Baseline, which allows both passage evidence and model knowledge. On post-cutoff events, only o4-mini increases adoption (+13.7 percentage points). A four-prompt comparison on 902 post-cutoff questions finds that passage priority without checking raises adoption, while moving to Verify lowers it in all five models. Adversarial-Aware, which warns of misleading passages and prioritizes model knowledge, restores 82.5-98.9% of displaced pre-cutoff answers with under one point of change in true-passage accuracy. FutureBench supports repeated evaluation on fixed cohorts and extension to new events as models change.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FutureBench，一个可复用的知识-上下文冲突评测框架（带时间戳问题、受控段落三元组、无上下文探针），发现"验证+段落优先"提示（Verify）主要在知识截止前事件上提高错误答案采纳率。
AI.motivation: 让模型核查检索文本时，可能同时改变其"信任哪个来源"的倾向，导致误采纳检索到的错误答案；现有评测缺乏对时间敏感、可控且可重复扩展的冲突评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 FutureBench：3,629 个带时间戳问题、受控段落三元组（真实/错误/误导）、无上下文探针；在六个模型上比较 Baseline、Verify、仅段落优先、Adversarial-Aware 等提示；另在 902 个截止后问题上做四提示对比。
AI.result: 截止前事件中，Verify 在五个受测模型上均提高错误答案采纳，主要挤占 Baseline 下的正确答案；截止后事件仅 o4-mini 采纳率上升（+13.7 个百分点）。截止后问题上，段落优先无核查提高采纳，而 Verify 使五个模型均下降。Adversarial-Aware 恢复 82.5–98.9% 被挤占的截止前答案，真段落准确率变化不足 1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 核查类提示并不必然提升可靠性，反而可能诱导对检索错误的盲信；明确的"防误导+优先模型知识"提示可显著缓解。FutureBench 支持固定队列重复评测并随模型更新扩展新事件。

title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
comment: Equal contribution: Minghe Zhang and Xuetao Kang. 38 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables
summary: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.

AI.tldr: GUARD：一种无需外部评分器的闭环框架，用于自主智能体的持续"harness"自进化，通过对任务分解为执行前自检、方向性后悔与Soft-HURT门控，在无权重更新下实现非退化式自我改进。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体以冻结基座模型+可编辑harness(prompt、技能、工具规则、记忆)构成，递归自我改进(RSI)可从经验中改harness而无需更新权重。但缺乏外部评分器时，反思与标量分数会把"新破坏的行为"与"仍未解决的问题"混为一谈，导致局部退化、技能遗忘与记忆膨胀。
AI.method: GUARD(Grader-free UED with Adaptive Rule Distillation)：1)将每个任务分解为执行前自检(pre-execution self-checks)；2)以方向性后悔(directional regret)引导harness更新，每轮用自检给轨迹打分，锁定已掌握的规则并优先修复新出现的破坏；3)用无critic的组相对适应度(group-relative fitness)在并行候选编辑中筛选；4)Soft-HURT门控仅在收益大于退化时采纳编辑，将专门化修复限定范围以防过度触发，并保证在其门控缓冲上非退化。测试时单一冻结harness单次pass运行。
AI.result: 在记忆、技能进化、持续任务流与领域推理等基准上，GUARD一致提升性能，无灾难性遗忘与记忆污染，同时大幅降低部署token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 将"破坏检测"与"未解决问题"分离、并以方向性后悔+门控式编辑筛选，是实现无评分器持续harness自我改进的有效路径，兼顾性能提升、稳定性与部署效率。

title: GRID-UAV: Geometry and Ray-depth Integrated Decision-making for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. On long aerial routes, adding depth features directly brings no significant gain (42.5% vs. 42.6% success), so we study how 3D information should be given to the policy. Analyzing flight failures, we find that two forms of 3D grounding fail in opposite ways: explicit 3D lifting of depth collides less on the way but more often fails to finish at the target, while implicit alignment with a 3D geometry model finishes more often but collides more. We propose GRID, which combines both: (1) it lifts monocular depth into ray-corrected 3D positions in the UAV's frame for both cameras, and (2) during training only, it aligns its visual features with a frozen multi-view geometry model, at no inference cost. GRID adding explicit lifting to implicit alignment significantly increases how often the policy reaches the target ($61.5\% \rightarrow 69.5\%$, $p<0.001$), and adding implicit alignment to explicit lifting significantly increases how often it completes the task once there ($57.7\% \rightarrow 61.4\%$, $p<0.05$). On TravelUAV (3,005 test episodes), GRID achieves the best success rate on every split, with relative gains over the state of the art of 9.5% (seen), 17.1% (unseen objects) and 25.4% (unseen map).

AI.tldr: GRID 将单目深度显式提升到无人机坐标系下的射线校正 3D 位置，并在训练时用冻结的多视角几何模型对齐视觉特征，从而显著提升长距离空中导航任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）用 2D 编码器处理图像，缺乏 3D 结构信息；直接喂入估计深度在长距离航线上几乎无增益（42.5% vs 42.6%），因此需要研究如何把 3D 信息更有效地交给策略。无人机自行选择高度、需判断数十米外距离、还要关联前视与下视视角，单目深度在此可靠性不足。
AI.method: 通过分析飞行失败案例发现两类 3D 接地方式失效模式相反：显式 3D 提升（漏碰撞但常无法到达终点）与隐式几何模型对齐（易到达但碰撞多）。GRID 将两者结合：(1) 对两个相机把单目深度提升为无人机坐标系下射线校正的 3D 位置；(2) 仅在训练时将视觉特征与冻结的多视角几何模型对齐，推理时不增加开销。
AI.result: 在显式提升基础上加入隐式对齐使到达目标率从 61.5% 提升到 69.5%（p<0.001）；在显式提升基础上加隐式对齐使到达后完成任务率从 57.7% 提升到 61.4%（p<0.05）。在 TravelUAV（3,005 个测试回合）上，GRID 在所有划分上取得最佳成功率，相比 SOTA 相对提升 9.5%（已见）、17.1%（未见物体）、25.4%（未见地图）。
AI.conclusion: 显式 3D 提升与隐式几何对齐互补，结合后可同时改善到达与完成率；GRID 在多种泛化场景下均优于现有方法，且不增加推理成本。

title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.

AI.tldr: 针对生成式推荐（GR）推理的特点（长输入、宽beam、少量固定输出），本文通过Tree Attention将各beam沿序列维度拼接以消除冗余KV访问，并结合预生成部分注意力掩码、静态KV缓存、循环展开调度、TorchAir图编译、自动算子融合和词表约束解码进行整体优化；无需自定义kernel，在Ascend NPU上相比vLLM端到端延迟最高降低25倍，并与使用自定义kernel的SOTA方案生成延迟相当。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐推理与常规LLM服务差异显著：输入序列长、beam search宽度大、输出token少且固定。现有LLM服务引擎（如vLLM）将各beam视为批内独立序列处理，对共享prompt前缀造成冗余KV缓存访问；且每步beam search都作为独立引擎调用，导致host端beam处理开销与PagedAttention运行时KV块管理开销巨大。
AI.method: 采用Tree Attention将beam沿序列维度拼接，消除冗余KV访问；配合预生成的部分注意力掩码、静态KV缓存分配、循环展开的生成调度、TorchAir图编译、自动算子融合及词表约束解码；不依赖自定义kernel。
AI.result: 在Ascend NPU上，端到端延迟相较vLLM最高降低25倍，生成延迟与采用自定义kernel的SOTA方案相当。
AI.conclusion: 生成流水线应在引入自定义kernel开发之前先从整体上进行优化，即可获得显著性能收益。

title: VIBRA: Backward-Compatible Cross-Modal Retrieval with Consensus Barycenters
summary: Backward-compatible retrieval enables a new encoder to query the gallery that an old model has already encoded, so that a cross-modal retrieval system can be upgraded without re-encoding billions of items. Existing compatible methods either fit the old query and stay near the accuracy of the old model, or run the old and the new encoder for every query. We propose VIBRA, which matches relevance on the old gallery, corrects the errors of a single model with the barycenter of several views, which is itself a query in the old space, and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, so that models absent at deployment still shape every query. We show that the barycenter gains margin over the average of its views exactly when their hardest irrelevant items differ, and we characterize the share of this gain that one encoder can reach. On five benchmarks with five upgrades among six CLIP, MetaCLIP and SigLIP2 backbones, VIBRA is the best compatible method in all 50 settings, improving Recall@1 by up to 5.6 points over the strongest baseline and by up to 18.0 points over the old model, while adding less than 1 ms to the latency of the new encoder.

AI.tldr: VIBRA 通过多视图重心蒸馏实现向后兼容的跨模态检索，在 50 个设置中全部最优，Recall@1 最高提升 5.6/18.0 点，延迟增加不到 1ms。
AI.motivation: 跨模态检索系统升级时，若重新编码数十亿图库代价极高，因此需要向后兼容检索：新编码器能直接查询旧模型已编码的图库。现有兼容方法要么只对齐旧查询、精度停留在旧模型水平，要么每次查询都同时运行新旧编码器，成本高。
AI.method: 提出 VIBRA：在旧图库空间上匹配相关性，用多个视图的重心（其本身是旧空间中的一个查询）来纠正单模型的错误，再训练新编码器继承这一共识，使部署时缺席的模型仍能影响每次查询。理论分析表明，当各视图最难不相关项不同时，重心相对视图平均可获得 margin，并刻画了单个编码器能达到的增益比例。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准、6 个 CLIP/MetaCLIP/SigLIP2 骨干网络构成的 5 次升级中，VIBRA 在全部 50 个设置里都是最佳兼容方法；Recall@1 相比最强基线最高提升 5.6 点，相比旧模型最高提升 18.0 点，而新增延迟不足 1 ms。
AI.conclusion: VIBRA 以低成本实现高精度的向后兼容检索升级，兼具理论保证与广泛实验优势。

title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
summary: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose. We introduce StatePortal, an agent that synthesizes a checkpoint, an artifact that restores that state and can be versioned and replayed, from a natural-language functional test case and read-only access to the target's source code. The checkpoint is restored through a per-application hook that an onboarding agent binds or synthesizes once without hand-written hook code. Because a checkpoint can satisfy state checks while rendering incorrectly, checkpoints are scored by hybrid programmatic-state and visual evaluation: acceptance requires both a programmatic-state oracle and a visual oracle to pass. We calibrate the visual oracle against a blinded cross-VLM reference. We release DeepStateBench, 61 deep-state tasks across 10 interactive applications that span five language families and six rendering stacks, with source sizes from 874 to 7.2M lines. Across three registered models, a GUI agent seeded with synthesized checkpoints completes 10.4% of trials, compared with 0% without seeding under the same pixel action space, while StatePortal, which also delivers the target action through the hook, completes 27.5%. Over 1,361 replays of 112 checkpoints, 98.90% reproduce the original verdict with zero model calls, and the hybrid oracle detects 96.25% (77/80) of controlled visual faults invisible to programmatic-state checks alone. We open-source our code at https://github.com/pzy2000/State_Portal and website at https://stateportal.mineyosemite.chatgpt.site

AI.tldr: StatePortal：一种从自然语言功能测试用例和只读源码合成"检查点"的智能体，可恢复GUI软件的深层状态并版本化/重放，配合混合状态与视觉双重判定，显著提升深层状态测试效率。
AI.motivation: LLM降低了GUI交互软件的编码成本，但测试瓶颈在于到达需要长交互历史的"深层状态"，其代价在每个commit上重复出现；现有GUI自动化依赖DOM或可访问性树，而自渲染引擎不暴露这些结构，无法摊销成本。
AI.method: 提出StatePortal：由自然语言功能测试用例+只读源码合成checkpoint（可版本化、可重放的恢复工件）；通过按应用一次性绑定或合成的hook恢复状态，无需手写hook代码；因checkpoint可能满足状态检查却渲染错误，采用程序化状态oracle与视觉oracle双重判定的混合评估，视觉oracle以盲化跨VLM参考校准；并发布DeepStateBench（61个深层状态任务、10款应用、5种语言族、6种渲染栈，源码874行至7.2M行）。
AI.result: 三个注册模型下，注入合成checkpoint的GUI智能体完成10.4%试验，无注入时为0%；StatePortal（同时通过hook直接投递目标动作）达27.5%。112个checkpoint的1,361次重放中98.90%复现原始判定且零模型调用；混合oracle检测出96.25%(77/80)程序化检查不可见的受控视觉故障。
AI.conclusion: 合成可版本化checkpoint能有效摊销深层状态到达成本，且必须配合视觉判定以保证正确性；方法在跨语言、跨渲染栈、大规模代码库上有效，代码与基准已开源。

title: Localizing Text Anonymization for Trustworthy AI: Extending RAT-Bench to Malaysian Microdata and PII
comment: Accepted at the Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD) Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: As governments and organizations adopt foundation models for public services and workplace productivity, sensitive citizen, employee, and administrative text may enter LLM workflows through inference, retrieval, fine-tuning, or local model development. We examine whether text anonymizers transfer to new deployment settings by extending RAT-Bench to Malaysia using local microdata, Malaysian PII formats, and culturally grounded transcripts in Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia. We evaluate NER- and LLM-based anonymizers using an LLM attacker that infers attributes from anonymized text, measuring both re-identification success and text utility. Across Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia, the two LLM anonymizers provide the strongest explicit privacy-utility trade-offs, reducing Easy/Hard re-identification risk to 23-29% while preserving BLEU scores of 0.77-0.94. Non-LLM tools show sharper failure modes, either preserving utility while leaving high residual risk or reducing risk through severe over-redaction, especially in Bahasa Malaysia. These findings suggest that anonymizers should be evaluated against deployment-relevant languages, identifier formats, and cultural contexts before being relied on in public-sector, workplace, or local AI pipelines.

AI.tldr: 论文将 RAT-Bench 扩展到马来西亚场景，评估 NER 与 LLM 匿名化工具的跨场景迁移能力，发现 LLM 匿名器在马来语与马来西亚英语上隐私-效用权衡最佳，非 LLM 工具失效更明显。
AI.motivation: 政府与组织将基础模型用于公共服务和办公场景时，敏感文本会经推理、检索、微调或本地模型开发进入 LLM 流程。现有匿名化工具是否能在新的部署语言、标识符格式与文化语境下可靠迁移尚不清楚，本文考察这一问题。
AI.method: 基于本地微观数据、马来西亚 PII 格式以及马来西亚英语和马来语的文化语境化文本，将 RAT-Bench 扩展到马来西亚；用基于 LLM 的攻击者从匿名化文本中推断属性，对比基于 NER 与基于 LLM 的匿名器，同时度量重识别成功率与文本效用（BLEU）。
AI.result: 在马来西亚英语和马来语上，两种 LLM 匿名器提供最佳的显式隐私-效用权衡：Easy/Hard 重识别风险降至 23-29%，同时 BLEU 保持 0.77-0.94。非 LLM 工具失效模式更尖锐：或保留效用但残余风险高，或通过严重过度脱敏降低风险，马来语中尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 匿名器在用于公共部门、办公或本地 AI 流水线前，应针对部署相关的语言、标识符格式和文化语境进行评估，而不能直接迁移。

title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
summary: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. In this retrospective study, six VLMs read 100 emergency CT and MRI examinations published in a public archive (March 2025-August 2026) under four conditions (free navigation, navigation from a key slice, and all slices or key slices in a single request), twice each (4800 runs). Nine radiologists read 30 of those cases. A large language model judge validated against two radiologists graded the answers. Conditions were compared with generalized estimating equations clustered by case. Results. Pooled accuracy was lowest under free navigation (32.6%; 391/1200), followed by navigation from a key slice (37.9%; 455/1200; P = .003), and highest with all slices (42.2%; 506/1200) or key slices (42.5%; 510/1200) in one request (both P < .001). On the 30 cases read by radiologists, freely navigating models were correct in 30.0% of runs (108/360) versus 77.0% for radiologists (208/270; P < .001). Models formed a first hypothesis after a median of 10.8% of the slices and kept it in 63.1% of runs (755/1196); final answers were correct in 12.4% of runs after a wrong first hypothesis (110/885) versus 90.4% after a right one (281/311; P < .001). Median stated confidence in the final answers was 90%, whereas 38.9% of them were correct (1861/4778). Conclusion. Across all exploration strategies, VLM agents remained far less accurate than radiologists. They adopted an early hypothesis and usually kept it, seldom correcting a wrong one.

AI.tldr: 系统评估六种视觉语言模型(VLM)代理在不同探索策略下阅读急诊CT/MRI的诊断准确性与阅片导航行为，发现所有策略下VLM准确率均远低于放射科医生，且模型倾向于早期形成假设并难以纠正错误假设。
AI.motivation: VLM代理正被用于医学影像诊断，但其阅片过程中的探索策略（如何浏览切片、如何形成与修正假设）对诊断准确性的影响尚不明确，需要系统量化其导航行为与诊断可靠性。
AI.method: 回顾性研究：6个VLM阅读公共档案中100例急诊CT/MRI，采用四种条件（自由导航、从关键层导航、一次性请求全部切片、一次性请求关键切片），每种重复两次，共4800次运行；9名放射科医生阅读其中30例。由对照两名放射科医生校验过的大语言模型裁判对答案评分，采用按病例聚类的广义估计方程比较各条件。
AI.conclusion: 在所有探索策略下，VLM代理的准确性都远低于放射科医生；模型倾向于过早形成假设并通常坚持该假设，很少纠正错误假设，且自报置信度严重高估实际正确率。

title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
summary: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/.

AI.tldr: MedHarness 是一个"多表面"运行时可靠性层，把回答后的控制问题重构为在提议者初始预测后挂载共享决策对象，用同一套策略配合各表面配方适配器，实现跨模态共享的停止/开证据/修复/拒答控制器。
AI.motivation: 医学影像智能体已能在异构影像表面上作答，但部署时的验证预算有限，错误接受会损害临床信任。浅层核查与深层证据核查对同一病例意见不一致时，缺少共享控制器使"何时停止、开更多证据、修复或拒答"成为病态问题。现有工具使用流程要么按数据集锁定特定表面的证据顺序，要么走私有的"总是全深度验证"路径，成本高、错误接受多，且无法跨模态共享控制器。
AI.method: 提出 MedHarness 注册式多表面运行时可靠性层，核心是三条原则：Shared Decision Object（共享决策对象）、Minimum-Sufficient Verification（最小充分验证）、Intermediate Repair（中间修复）。通过一个共享策略加表面配方适配器，新影像表面只需注册配方即可加入同一控制器。
AI.result: 在 512 例在线池上，相比全验证基线，错误接受降低约 47%；在接受准确率 83.2% vs 72.9%、覆盖率 86.1%（对比基线全量释放）下表现更优。在失败富集的多表面压力排序上，匹配上下文负载设置下每例估计远程服务调用减少约 71%。三表面留出检验与另一语言模型迁移均保持相同的控制排序。
AI.conclusion: 单一共享控制器可跨异构影像表面注册扩展，在显著降低验证成本（远程调用减约 71%）的同时减少错误接受、提升接受准确率，并具备跨表面与跨模型的稳健性。

title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
summary: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. A nine-dimensional feature-quality prior and duplicate-aware sample initialization are calibrated using materials domain rules and statistical evidence. Confidence is further refined through sample-feature bipartite graph propagation and weakly supervised graph attention, while a Memory-GAT module provides historical reference scoring. Experiments on 23 ODDS benchmark datasets show that the generic module achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.866. In five repeated mixed-contamination experiments on mp\_20, rule calibration improves HistGradientBoostingRegressor test $R^2$ from $0.538\pm0.008$ to $0.616\pm0.014$. Graph refinement increases average precision from $0.943\pm0.004$ to 0.953\pm0.004$, while the rule-calibrated configuration has the highest mean test $R^2$ among the evaluated screening configurations. Five repeated MACE subset experiments further show an increase in $R^2$ from $0.590\pm0.053$ to $0.880\pm0.027$ after rule-based screening.

AI.tldr: 提出基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，将数据质量建模为连续置信度估计问题，结合领域规则、图结构学习与历史参考评分，在ODDS基准和mp_20、MACE数据上验证可提升数据筛选与下游模型性能。
AI.motivation: 材料机器学习依赖大规模异构数据，但真实数据库存在测量误差、计算失败、缺失/重复记录及隐含违反物理化学约束的问题；这类"统计上看似合理"的损坏样本难以用显式离群点方法识别，导致模型可靠性受损。
AI.method: 将数据质量定义为连续置信度估计而非二分类异常检测，支持样本级评估与基于历史参考的批间比较。构建九维特征质量先验与去重感知的样本初始化，并用材料领域规则和统计证据校准；再通过样本-特征二部图传播与弱监督图注意力精化置信度；采用Memory-GAT模块提供历史参考评分。
AI.result: 23个ODDS基准数据集上通用模块平均AUC-ROC达0.866；mp_20五次重复混合污染实验中，规则校准使HistGradientBoostingRegressor测试R²从0.538±0.008提升至0.616±0.014；图精化使平均精度从0.943±0.004升至0.953±0.004，规则校准配置在评估的筛选配置中平均测试R²最高；MACE子集五次重复实验中，规则筛选后R²从0.590±0.053提升至0.880±0.027。
AI.conclusion: 领域知识校准与图结构学习相结合可有效量化材料数据置信度，优于纯统计异常检测，并显著改善下游回归模型性能，为材料数据质量评估提供可复用框架。

title: KnowMe Paper Radar: Lightweight Discovery of Promising Papers in the Age of Autoresearch
comment: Ongoing work. 67 pages with 34 figures and 37 tables. Project website: https://hackerchenzhuo.github.io/knowme-research-ai/en/ GitHub: https://github.com/hackerchenzhuo/knowme-research-ai
summary: The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities. Users specify topics, priorities, exclusions and dates; the system brings together topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths and direction-specific institutional context. By exposing each score component and its supporting sources, KnowMe helps readers select promising papers for their current questions and discover relevant work beyond familiar authors. Automatic acquisition, version merging and graph-cache reuse keep this workflow convenient without large language model (LLM) inference during ordinary use. Experiments on 174,640 acquired records show more than threefold faster repeated context preparation, while cached abstracts improve normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 (NDCG@10) from 0.412 to 0.598 on expert-judged retrieval tasks. Complementary analyses examine how the same accumulated records support semantic retrieval, research-history modeling and literature-grounded planning. A browser interface and a structured command-line interface (CLI) make these capabilities available to both researchers and research agents, positioning KnowMe as a practical upstream tool for literature-informed recursive self-improvement (RSI) workflows.

AI.tldr: KnowMe Paper Radar 是一个轻量级论文发现工具，将主题相关性、时效性、作者研究历史、合作路径及机构背景等多源证据融合为个性化阅读优先级，无需 LLM 推理即可高效运行。
AI.motivation: 主题相似的论文数量激增，难以识别能提供研究洞见或方法指导的新工作；现有检索缺乏个性化与多源证据整合。
AI.method: 用户设定主题、优先级、排除项与时间范围；系统整合主题相关性、新近度、作者研究历史、合作路径和方向特定机构背景等证据，并公开各评分成分及其来源。系统支持自动采集、版本合并与图缓存复用，日常使用不需 LLM 推理；提供浏览器界面和 CLI 接口。
AI.result: 在 174,640 条采集记录上，重复上下文准备速度提升三倍以上；缓存摘要使专家评判检索任务的 NDCG@10 从 0.412 提升至 0.598。补充分析显示同一批累积记录可支持语义检索、研究历史建模和文献支撑规划。
AI.conclusion: KnowMe 可作为文献驱动递归自我改进（RSI）流程的实用上游工具，同时服务研究人员与研究智能体。

title: EnvAgent: Multi-Agent Approach to Building Science Environments in the Clouds
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at AI4S@SC26 (SC26 Workshop)
summary: AI agents are transforming scientific computing and software workflows, but generating and executing code requires a correctly configured execution environment. Automating environment construction remains difficult because repositories encode heterogeneous, often incomplete requirements for operating systems, toolchains, dependencies, and build procedures. Existing workflows thus rely on developer-maintained Dockerfiles and setup scripts, making preparation labor-intensive, hard to scale, and potentially biasing evaluations. We present ENVAGENT, an agentic framework that synthesizes, builds, and verifies repository-level Docker environments. ENVAGENT combines deterministic utilities for Docker execution and state management with coordinated agents for repository analysis, planning, Dockerfile synthesis, and iterative failure diagnosis and repair. We also introduce ENVBENCH, a benchmark of 54 scientific artifacts and open-source repositories spanning seven languages from Chameleon Trovi and Multi-SWE-bench. For each repository, we curate a declarative rubric of required structure, configuration, and functionality, and a shared evaluator applies 2,108 weighted checks across generated environments. Across four matched language-model settings, ENVAGENT constructs 43.5 executable environments out of 54 on average, versus 23.5 for Codex and Claude Code, and scores 62.02 versus 24.19 on a composite of executability and rubric satisfaction. These results show that environment-specific agent orchestration substantially improves automated environment construction.

AI.tldr: ENVAGENT 提出一个智能体框架，自动为代码仓库合成、构建并验证 Docker 运行环境，并配套发布含 54 个科学计算/开源仓库、七种语言的 ENVBENCH 基准，性能显著优于通用编码智能体。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体在科学计算与软件工程中需要能正确执行代码的环境，但仓库中的环境需求异质且往往不完整（操作系统、工具链、依赖、构建流程），现有做法依赖人工编写 Dockerfile 与安装脚本，成本高、难扩展，并可能给评测带来偏差。
AI.method: ENVAGENT 将确定性的 Docker 执行与状态管理工具同多个协作智能体结合：仓库分析、规划、Dockerfile 合成，以及基于迭代的失败诊断与修复。同时构建 ENVBENCH：从 Chameleon Trovi 与 Multi-SWE-bench 收集 54 个科学制品与开源仓库（七种语言），为每个仓库制定声明式的结构、配置与功能评分标准，由统一评估器施加 2,108 项加权检查。
AI.result: 在四组对齐的语言模型设置下，ENVAGENT 平均成功构建 43.5/54 个可执行环境，而 Codex 与 Claude Code 为 23.5；在可执行性与评分标准满足度的复合指标上得分为 62.02 对 24.19。
AI.conclusion: 面向环境构建的专用智能体编排可显著提升自动化环境构建的成功率与质量，表明该任务需要超越通用编码智能体的专门化设计。

title: Beyond Replacement: Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a flexible alternative to autoregressive models, enabling any-order infilling. While most existing decoding methods treat decoded tokens as fixed, some recent models allow previously decoded tokens to be revised only by replacing them with alternative tokens, a paradigm we refer to as replacement-only editing (ROE). Although ROE can correct individual tokens, it is inefficient for sequence shifts caused by missing or extra tokens and struggles when errors occur across many positions. To address these limitations, we propose LED (Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models), a post-training framework that extends ROE with insertion and deletion, enabling Levenshtein-style refinement of generated sequences. It uses two training designs. First, it reconstructs edit supervision on the fly during supervised fine-tuning using longest-common-subsequence alignment, enabling insertion and deletion learning without manually annotated labels. Second, it adopts multi-stage training, where the state from one stage becomes the input to the next, exposing the model to its earlier errors and enabling it to correct them. When applied to the 16B-parameter LLaDA2.1-Mini Base, LED raises the average score across twelve benchmarks from 54.86 to 57.10 under confidence-guided decoding while increasing tokens per forward from 6.14 to 7.05, whereas under confidence-free decoding it raises the average score from 27.52 to 47.19. We further show that LED achieves higher pass@k at large k than thresholded decoding without editing, demonstrating improved generation diversity and revealing the diversity potential of DLMs without confidence guidance. LED also improves robustness to large block sizes, raising the average score from 36.97 to 51.34 at block size 128. Together, these results suggest that LED supports more robust self-correction in DLMs.

AI.tldr: LED 是一个针对扩散语言模型的后训练框架，通过引入插入与删除操作，将仅替换式编辑（ROE）扩展为 Levenshtein 式编辑，实现更稳健的序列自我纠错。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型解码方法多把已解码 token 视为固定，部分模型仅允许用替代 token 做替换式编辑（ROE）。ROE 只能修正单个 token，对因缺失或多余 token 引起的序列位移效率低下，且错误分散在多个位置时表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出 LED 后训练框架，在 ROE 基础上增加插入与删除操作。采用两种训练设计：(1) 在监督微调中利用最长公共子序列对齐在线重建编辑监督，无需人工标注即可学习插入/删除；(2) 多阶段训练，将前一阶段的状态作为下一阶段输入，使模型接触自身早期错误并学会纠正。
