AI.result: 应用于 16B 参数的 LLaDA2.1-Mini Base：置信度引导解码下十二项基准平均分从 54.86 提升至 57.10，每前向 token 数从 6.14 增至 7.05；无置信度解码下平均分从 27.52 提升至 47.19；大 k 时 pass@k 优于无编辑的阈值解码，说明多样性提升；块大小 128 时平均分从 36.97 提升至 51.34。
AI.conclusion: LED 通过插入/删除式编辑支持扩散语言模型更稳健的自纠错，显著提升多种解码设置下的性能、多样性与对大块尺寸的鲁棒性。

title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpecLook，一种无训练的"推测-验证"框架，通过让小模型推测智能体下一步的"观察"（glimpse）而非答案，实现可验证的多级推测，从而在无需工具循环的情况下加速并提升准确率与答案可靠性评分。
AI.motivation: 现有"以图像思考"的智能体 MLLM 采用顺序的推理-放大（zoom-in）工具调用循环，速度慢且答案缺少可靠性分数。以往对 token、推理步或答案的推测仍保留该循环，而且答案推测会接受"自信的错误"。作者还发现该循环大多只增加一次放大步骤，小模型这一步往往已领先智能体。
AI.method: SpecLook 三级推测-验证框架（无需训练）：1）小模型草拟一次 glimpse 并据此重新作答，若答案不变且置信则结束；2）否则由大模型无工具地验证并纠正 glimpse，融合两者答案；3）仍缺证据的问题才交给智能体，且仅一次前向（SpecLook-Fast 直接跳过）。轨迹同时为每个答案给出无标签可靠性评分。
AI.result: 在 V*、HR-Bench、POPE 上，两个变体在每个划分上均优于所有基线。SpecLook 平均准确率 87.2% 和 86.2%，相对 DeepEyes-7B 与 Thyme-RL 智能体分别加速 7.7x 和 4.7x；SpecLook-Fast 分别达 9.9x 和 6.3x。
AI.conclusion: 推测"观察"而非答案，使推测内容可验证、可纠正并可用于检验答案，实现无训练、无循环的准确且快速推理，并附带无标签的可靠性评分。

title: Trust the Ray, Not the Depth: Ray-Lateral Agreement for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Fusion
summary: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. Its error therefore points almost entirely along its own viewing ray, and the calibration tells us that direction exactly. To address this, we introduce the Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA), which follows one rule: trust the ray, not the depth. RLA first slides every estimate along its own rays, which removes the depth bias and leaves the shape untouched. It then fuses the views one point at a time, under a Gaussian error whose precision follows each viewing ray. The maximum-likelihood solution is closed-form, interpolates between averaging and midpoint triangulation, and stays well conditioned where triangulation is singular. Robustness is the harder half, because correct views also disagree along their rays. Any weight built on the full residual therefore punishes good views together with bad ones. Ray-lateral agreement instead scores every view, at every point, by its residual across that view's own ray alone. We evaluated RLA on multi-camera public benchmark datasets. Across two, three, and four cameras and three per-view pose estimators, RLA consistently achieves lower worst-case error than all triangulation baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA)，通过“信任射线、不信任深度”的原则，先沿各自射线滑动单目网格估计以消除深度偏差，再以高斯误差模型逐点融合多视角，得到闭式最大似然解，并仅用沿自身射线的横向残差进行鲁棒打分。
AI.motivation: 将单目网格估计器用于标定多相机阵列时，重建人体会相差一米以上。原因是几何性的：每个估计的深度由网络假定的焦距决定而非相机真实焦距，因此误差几乎完全沿自身视线方向，而该方向可由标定精确得知。现有三角化与加权融合方法未利用这一先验，且依赖完整残差的鲁棒权重会同时惩罚正确视角。
AI.method: RLA 分两步：(1) 沿每条射线滑动各视角估计，去除深度偏差且不改变形状；(2) 以精度沿射线方向分布的高斯误差模型逐点融合，最大似然解为闭式，介于平均与中点三角化之间，并在三角化奇异处保持良态。鲁棒性方面，仅用每个视角在每个点上沿其自身射线的横向残差打分，避免正确视角的深度差异被误判为异常。
AI.result: 在多相机公开基准数据集上评测，涵盖两、三、四相机及三种单视角姿态估计器，RLA 在 worst-case 误差上始终优于所有三角化基线。
AI.conclusion: 利用“误差沿射线”这一几何结构，可将深度偏差与融合问题解耦，RLA 提供闭式、良态且鲁棒的多视角人体网格融合方案，一致优于三角化基线。

title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
summary: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads; most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models were trained on PTB-XL for six input sets (I; II; I+II; I+II+V1; I+II+V2; I+II+V1+V4), see only the measured leads at inference, and were tested on the PTB-XL test fold (2,198 records) and two external cohorts (Georgia, 10,275 records; Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo, 43,559). From lead II alone, the pooled median Pearson correlation (PCC) over the 11 predicted leads was 0.914 on PTB-XL, against 0.784 for a least-squares linear filter (lead I: 0.906 against 0.789). As limb leads are exactly derivable from I and II, multi-lead inputs were compared on predicted chest leads: 0.939 against 0.849 for I+II and 0.979 against 0.962 for I+II+V1+V4. BiMa-SR exceeded the linear comparator in all 18 configuration--cohort pairs (by 0.012--0.136), a margin that shrank as chest leads were added. From lead II, regression was more accurate than diffusion (DiBiMa-SR: 0.903 one-step, 0.862 with six DDIM steps). A 12-lead classifier trained only on real ECGs reached a superclass macro AUROC of 0.912 on real PTB-XL ECGs, 0.843 on reconstructions from lead II and 0.908 from I+II+V1+V4; externally, reconstructions from three or four leads scored within 0.004 of real ECGs. BiMa-SR (2.68\,M parameters) takes 45.8 ms per 10-s record on a GPU. Reconstruction makes reduced-lead recordings usable by 12-lead tools; it cannot add information absent from the measured leads.

AI.tldr: 提出 BiMa-ECGSR，用双向 Mamba 状态空间编码器-解码器从少量导联重建 12 导联 ECG（回归版 BiMa-SR / 扩散版 DiBiMa-SR），在 PTB-XL 及两个外部大队列上显著优于线性最小二乘基线。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备与监护仪通常只记录极少数 ECG 导联，而多数诊断工具假设输入为 12 导联，因此需要从少量导联重建完整 12 导联 ECG，使现有诊断工具可用。
AI.method: 以双向 Mamba 状态空间编码器-解码器为核心，提供回归（BiMa-SR）与扩散（DiBiMa-SR）两种建模范式；在 PTB-XL 上针对 6 种输入导联集（I、II、I+II、I+II+V1、I+II+V2、I+II+V1+V4）训练，推理时仅使用实测导联；在 PTB-XL 测试折（2198 条）及 Georgia（10275 条）、Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo（43559 条）两个外部队列测评，并与最小二乘线性滤波对比；再以仅用真实 ECG 训练的 12 导联分类器评估重建信号的下游可用性。
AI.result: 单导联 II 输入时，11 个预测导联的合并中位 PCC 在 PTB-XL 上为 0.914（线性基线 0.784），导联 I 为 0.906（0.789）；I+II 的胸导联为 0.939（0.849），I+II+V1+V4 为 0.979（0.962）。BiMa-SR 在全部 18 个「配置-队列」组合中均优于线性基线（+0.012~0.136），且优势随胸导联增多而缩小。单导联 II 下回归优于扩散（DiBiMa-SR 一步 0.903，六步 DDIM 0.862）。分类器在真实 PTB-XL 上超类宏 AUROC 0.912，由导联 II 重建信号上 0.843，由 I+II+V1+V4 重建信号上 0.908；外部队列中三或四导联重建与真实 ECG 差距在 0.004 以内。BiMa-SR 仅 2.68 M 参数，GPU 上每条 10 秒记录耗时 45.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 重建可使少导联记录被 12 导联诊断工具使用，但无法补充实测导联中本不存在的信息；性能上限受输入导联数量与配置约束。

title: ReflectRec: Cycle-Consistency Preference Verification for LLM-based Recommendation
comment: 15 pages. Published in the Proceedings of EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: CoT-style LLM recommenders generate a natural-language preference note as a chain-of-thought prefix to ranking, but the note is trusted without verification, and the ranker never consults behaviorally similar users. We propose ReflectRec, organized around a preference-to-history round-trip verifier whose recall score serves as an operational signal of preference-to-history recoverability, enabling conditional regeneration for low-recoverability preferences and selection among regeneration attempts. Around this verifier, we wire a semantic Stage-1 prompt, conditional regeneration, and Forward-Look retrieval that injects future watches of behaviorally similar users as a collaborative hint. On MovieLens-100K and MovieLens-1M, the full pipeline outperforms CoT4Rec-ICL by +16.25 / +4.46 pp Hit@10, with positive gains across all ValScore buckets and three LLM backbones (Qwen3-30B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3.3-70B). We also observe a similar verifier-guided regeneration pattern on Amazon Electronics.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReflectRec，用"偏好-历史往返验证器"检验 CoT 式 LLM 推荐的偏好笔记，并配合条件重生成与 Forward-Look 协同检索，在 ML-100K/1M 上显著优于 CoT4Rec-ICL。
AI.motivation: 现有 CoT 式 LLM 推荐器先生成自然语言偏好笔记再排序，但该笔记未经校验即被信任，且排序器从不参考行为相似用户的信息。
AI.method: 以偏好-历史往返验证器的召回分数作为"偏好可回溯性"信号；围绕其构建语义 Stage-1 提示、低分时条件重生成及多次重生成的选择机制；再加入 Forward-Look 检索，将行为相似用户的未来观看记录作为协同提示注入。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens-100K 与 MovieLens-1M 上，完整流程比 CoT4Rec-ICL 的 Hit@10 分别提升 16.25 与 4.46 个百分点，且在全部 ValScore 桶与三种 LLM 骨干（Qwen3-30B、Qwen2.5-72B、Llama-3.3-70B）上均为正增益；Amazon Electronics 上也观察到类似的验证器引导重生成模式。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好笔记的可验证性与协同信号显式引入 LLM 推荐流程，可稳定提升排序效果并具跨数据集、跨骨干的泛化性。

title: Controlled Natural Language for Requirements Specification: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: Requirements are critical artifacts of the software development life-cycle. They express capabilities that the system should provide, guiding both the development and testing process. Given their significance, require- ments specification has attracted the interest of researchers and practitioners in recent years. Requirements specification is an activity where requirements are specified, i.e., documented. In this context, Controlled Natural Languages (CNL) were proposed as a compromise between the ambiguity of natural language and the complexity of formal languages. CNLs enable the specification of requirements using accurate statements that can be processed automatically, while remaining understandable by stakeholders. In this article, we perform a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) to identify, categorize, and compare CNL approaches for requirements specification. The SLR covers 133 primary studies published between 2000 and 2024. We evaluate them accord- ing to seven dimensions: context, scope, targeted requirements types, specification technique, tool support, validation method, and adoption. We provide a categorization framework that summarizes the evaluated dimensions, and we identify directions for future research. Our main results reveal: (1) four types of CNL: standalone templates, requirement patterns, elementary templates, and linguistic rules, (2) limited support for automated tools and domain vocabulary usage, and (3) lack of validation through case studies and limited adoption for the majority of approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述（SLR）梳理2000-2024年间133项关于受控自然语言（CNL）用于需求规约的研究，建立七维度分类框架并提出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 需求规约是软件生命周期中的关键活动，需在自然语言的歧义性与形式语言的复杂性之间取得平衡；受控自然语言（CNL）被视为二者折中方案，但缺乏对现有CNL方法的系统梳理与比较。
AI.method: 开展系统性文献综述，覆盖2000-2024年133项一手研究，按七个维度评估：语境、范围、目标需求类型、规约技术、工具支持、验证方法、采用情况，并据此构建分类框架。
AI.result: 归纳出四类CNL（独立模板、需求模式、基础模板、语言规则）；发现自动化工具与领域词汇支持有限；多数方法缺乏案例研究验证，实际采用率偏低。
AI.conclusion: CNL在需求规约中已形成多种形态，但在工具化、领域适配与实证验证方面仍有明显空白，文中给出相应未来研究方向。

title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.

AI.tldr: 将读目标模型隐状态的草稿模型（DFlash、EAGLE-3）的残差流宽度减半或减至四分之一，可基本保持接受率，端到端解码加速 1.06–1.21x（B200）、1.13–1.44x（GB10）。
AI.motivation: 推测解码中，读取目标模型隐状态的草稿模型通常继承目标的隐层宽度，造成草稿阶段计算与内存开销偏大；作者探究该宽度是否可压缩而不损失接受率。
AI.method: 把草稿模型整个残差流降到目标宽度的 1/2 或 1/4；对借用目标词嵌入投影的 DFlash，将训练好的输出适配器折叠进该投影得到单个更窄投影，logits 仅在浮点舍入意义下不变。在 SGLang 上以 Qwen3-8B(NVFP4)、GPT-OSS-20B(MXFP4) 为目标，测试 DFlash 与 EAGLE-3，硬件为 B200 与 DGX Spark(GB10)。
AI.result: batch=1、temperature=0 时，端到端解码加速 B200 1.06–1.12x、GB10 1.13–1.44x；更大 batch 下加速保持，batch 32 至各 GPU 最大可容纳 batch 时最高达 1.21x，且没有任何窄草稿慢于全宽版本。
AI.conclusion: 草稿模型宽度并非必须与目标一致，减窄残差流几乎无损且稳定提速，是一种低风险、易落地的推测解码优化；但加速幅度中等，且依赖特定模型与量化/硬件组合。

title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的推理时方法 BOS Summary：在预填充阶段单个 transformer 层中，仅解除 BOS 查询行的因果掩码，让 BOS 聚合全部视觉与文本输入形成上下文表示，从而把原本无信息的注意力汇聚点改造成可携带输入的持久通路。
AI.motivation: LVLMs/LLMs 存在注意力汇聚（attention sink）现象，BOS 等位置获得不成比例的注意力；但标准因果掩码下 BOS 查询只能看到自身，导致后续 token 反复访问的表示不含任何输入信息，形成一条"持久却空载"的通路。
AI.method: BOS Summary 为无需训练、无额外参数的推理时干预：仅在 prefill 阶段的某一 transformer 层，对 BOS 查询这一行放宽因果约束，使其可聚合所有视觉与文本 token，得到自导出的上下文表示；其他 token 保持标准因果注意力，解码阶段无额外开销，也不需要辅助模块。
AI.result: 在多个 VLM 与 LLM 系列、八个多模态与纯文本基准上，优于直接提示与 Chain-of-Thought 提示，并在多步推理任务上超过近期 sink 干预方法。机制分析显示：使 BOS 输入相关会削弱其 sink 主导性，并将注意力重新分配到承载内容的提示 token 上。
AI.conclusion: 改变汇聚点"承载什么"能重塑后续层如何分配注意力；BOS Summary 以极低代价将无信息的持久通路转为上下文通路，是一种简洁有效的推理增强手段。

title: Beyond the Sink Token: Sink-Guided Key Editing in Vision-Language Models
summary: In vision-language models (VLMs), a few sink tokens attract a disproportionate share of attention. While previous studies have examined why these tokens attract attention, we investigate how the sink-key direction affects attention to image and question tokens. Across four probed VLMs, boosting the magnitude of positive sink-aligned components increases attention on average, whereas boosting negative components decreases it; these responses persist through later layers. This identifies the native sink key as a reference for controlling attention beyond its own position. Motivated by this finding, we propose SHRINK, a training-free method that partially reduces sink-aligned components across visible keys during generation. On nine benchmarks under sampled reasoning, it improves mean accuracy by 5.1 and 2.7 percentage points on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with smaller gains on the other two main models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Gemma-3-4B. Beyond SHRINK, rescaling sink-aligned key components can replace the attention operations of two existing attention-steering methods, GIFT and ACG, with comparable accuracy on hallucination benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 研究视觉语言模型中"沉没键"(sink key)方向如何调控注意力，并提出免训练方法SHRINK，通过削减可见键中与沉没键对齐的分量来提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注沉没token"为何"吸引注意力，但尚不清楚沉没键方向对其他图像/问题token注意力的"调控作用"。
AI.method: 先对4个VLM做探查：放大与正向沉没键对齐的分量会提升注意力，放大负向分量则降低，且效应持续到后续层，说明原生沉没键可作为注意力控制参考。据此提出SHRINK——生成时对可见键中与沉没键对齐的分量做部分削减，无需训练。
AI.result: 在采样推理下9个基准上，LLaVA-OneVision-7B平均准确率提升5.1个百分点，Qwen2.5-VL-3B提升2.7个百分点，另两个主模型增益较小；此外，重缩放沉没对齐键分量可替代GIFT与ACG的注意力操作，在幻觉基准上准确率相当。
AI.conclusion: 沉没键方向是控制注意力的有效杠杆；SHRINK以极简、免训练方式提升VLM推理表现，并为理解与替代现有注意力引导方法提供统一视角。

title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
summary: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). Then we propose a novel Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) scheme to protect the binary weights at very low overhead. This scheme exploits the invariance of Transformers to permutations in the rows and columns to group the critical weights and perform selective protection on those weights. Simulation results show that PIES can recover most of the performance loss caused by bit errors at BERs as high as 10%, at an overhead significantly lower than traditional error correction schemes. These results confirm the feasibility of running binary Transformers using approximate memory with aggressive voltage scaling on resource-limited low power edge devices. The code for PIES is released on github (https://github.com/YangZhutian/binary-transformer-prefix-repair).

AI.tldr: 本文评估二值Transformer（以BERT为例）在近似内存误码下的可靠性，并提出PIES方案以极低开销保护关键二值权重。
AI.motivation: 量化（尤其权重二值化）可降低Transformer的存储、计算与功耗，近似内存能进一步省电但引入位错误；现有二值Transformer研究只关注任务性能，缺乏对其在内存错误下可靠运行的深入分析。
AI.method: 首先以BERT为案例评估二值Transformer在误码下的可靠性；随后提出PIES（Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective）方案，利用Transformer对行列置换的不变性将关键权重分组，并对这些权重进行选择性保护。
AI.result: 仅在较高误码率（如BER=5%或10%）时出现明显精度损失；PIES在BER高达10%时可恢复大部分性能损失，且开销显著低于传统纠错方案。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实了在资源受限低功耗边缘设备上、以激进电压缩放运行的近似内存中部署二值Transformer的可行性；PIES代码已开源。

title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
summary:
Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree.
  In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出联合优化动作级记录策略与控制变量，以更低方差估计两策略间的平均处理效应，从而大幅降低在线A/B测试的流量需求。
AI.motivation: 标准A/B测试的差值均值估计虽无偏但方差大：当处理策略与生产策略以相似概率选择相同动作时，这些观测只带来噪声而信息量低，导致检测小效应需要大量流量与长时间。现有降方差方法多在数据采集方案固定后改进估计器，近期的重叠感知设计也只优化单一流量分配比例，无法将流量导向两策略有分歧的动作。
AI.method: 将"如何采样动作"与"如何用观测估计效应"联合优化。第一，基于成对离策略评估（pairwise off-policy evaluation），推导出估计两策略间平均处理效应的方差最优动作级记录策略(logging policy)，对任意固定控制变量均有闭式解。第二，利用历史日志联合优化记录策略与控制变量，进一步降低方差。
AI.result: 在模拟策略A/B测试中，该方法在所有评估设置上对ATE的估计都比现有降方差方法更准确，同时总体上提升了统计功效，并降低了选中较差策略的频率。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计记录策略与估计器可显著降低在线流量需求，使实践者以更少流量获得可靠的部署决策。

title: Software Engineering for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based Agents perform tasks through tool use and interaction with external environments. Public engineering guidance commonly begins with a target task, selects a suitable workflow or autonomous Agent design, and refines prompts, tools, and execution strategies using task outcomes, latency, and cost. When delivered as software systems, Agents must also satisfy stakeholder requirements, action boundaries, quality checks, and maintenance needs. Model-directed execution can vary across runs, failures can span model decisions and tools, and changes to prompts, models, or interfaces can affect previously accepted behavior. This survey examines how LLM-based Agents are engineered across five software lifecycle stages: Requirements Engineering, Architecture and Design, Implementation and Integration, Testing and Assurance, and Maintenance and Evolution. Based on a main collection of 355 papers, we compare the engineering problems addressed, explain how methods and practices work, and examine their reported evaluations and limitations within each stage. We synthesize how existing research supports Agent development activities and identify open problems and research directions. The result is a lifecycle-oriented reference for understanding, selecting, and further developing methods for engineering Agent software.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，从软件生命周期五个阶段（需求工程、架构与设计、实现与集成、测试与保障、维护与演化）系统梳理LLM Agent的工程化方法。
AI.motivation: 当前Agent工程实践多从任务出发选工作流、调提示与工具，但作为软件系统交付还需满足干系人需求、行动边界、质量检查与维护要求；且模型执行不确定性、跨模型与工具的失败、变更带来的回归风险，均缺乏系统性的生命周期视角。
AI.method: 基于355篇主文献集，按五个软件生命周期阶段组织，比较各阶段所解决的工程问题，说明方法与实践如何运作，并考察其报告的评价与局限，最后归纳现有研究对Agent开发活动的支撑情况及开放问题。
AI.result: 形成以生命周期为线索的文献比较与综合，揭示各阶段的工程问题、方法要点、评价方式与局限，并识别开放问题与研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个面向生命周期的参考框架，帮助理解、选择并进一步发展Agent软件工程方法。

title: Coverage Governs Accuracy: When to Expand the Lexicon and When to Fall Back in Low-Resource Manchu OCR
summary: Character-level OCR for low-resource Manchu often produces near-miss spelling errors. Lexicon-constrained decoding can correct such errors with lexical knowledge, but a fixed dictionary cannot cover the many unseen word forms produced by agglutinative word formation. We study whether morphological expansion alleviates this limitation, and how the expansion size and confidence fallback affect recognition. We segment the training transcriptions with a dictionary-based stem list, extract roots and suffix chains from them, generate about 510k candidates, select the expansion size through frequency ranking on the validation set, and decompose accuracy under hard lexicon constraints into the product of coverage and in-lexicon precision. Across three CRNN training seeds, adding 250k candidates to a base dictionary of about 29k words raises the type accuracy on unseen combinations of seen roots from 63.6% to 86.3%, and overall token accuracy from 82.4% to 84.2%. Adding all candidates lowers overall token accuracy to 81.5%, showing that the coverage gain comes with a loss of in-lexicon precision. A further comparison shows that the base dictionary with confidence fallback performs best overall among the CRNN systems tested, reaching 76.1% type and 85.5% token accuracy and outperforming the expanded lexicon both with and without fallback. A Transformer recognizer shows similar trends. These results indicate that morphological expansion relieves the constraint of a fixed dictionary, but a larger lexicon does not guarantee better recognition; in the present low-resource Manchu OCR setting, a selective combination of reliable lexical constraints and open recognition is more effective.

AI.tldr: 研究满语低资源OCR中词典约束解码的改进：用词法扩展（词干+后缀链生成约51万候选）缓解固定词典覆盖不足，并分析扩展规模与置信度回退的影响。250k扩展使未见组合类型准确率63.6%→86.3%，但全量扩展反而降低整体token准确率；基础词典加置信度回退综合最优（76.1% type / 85.5% token）。
AI.motivation: 满语字符级OCR易产生近似拼写错误，词典约束解码可纠正，但固定词典无法覆盖黏着构词产生的大量未见词形，作者希望检验形态学扩展能否缓解这一局限，以及扩展规模与置信度回退如何影响识别。
AI.method: 用基于词典的词干表对训练转写进行分词，抽取词根与后缀链，生成约510k候选；在验证集上按频率排序选择扩展规模；在硬词典约束下将准确率分解为覆盖率与词典内精确率的乘积；跨三个CRNN训练种子评估，并与Transformer识别器对比。
AI.result: 在约29k基础词典上加入250k候选，未见"见过词根的新组合"类型准确率由63.6%升至86.3%，整体token准确率82.4%→84.2%；加入全部候选使token准确率降至81.5%，说明覆盖率提升伴随词典内精确率损失。基础词典+置信度回退综合最佳（76.1% type、85.5% token），优于扩展词典（有无回退均如此）。Transformer呈相似趋势。
AI.conclusion: 形态学扩展可缓解固定词典的约束，但更大词表并不保证更好识别；本低资源满语OCR场景下，"可靠词典约束+开放识别"的选择性组合更有效。

title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
summary: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT方法，用父代特定的执行证据（成功与失败样本）引导LLM智能体架构的进化式语义交叉，在六个推理/编程任务上平均测试准确率82.0%，超最强基线9.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自动化智能体架构搜索通常只用聚合适应度引导，掩盖了每个分数背后的实例级成功与失败信息，搜索信号过于粗糙。
AI.method: GRAFT：聚合适应度仅用于选择与存活；交叉阶段引入父代特定执行证据指导语义交叉并整合变异。其反馈机制复用适应度评估中有限数量的成功/失败运行样本，隐藏参考答案、不增加额外任务执行。
AI.result: 在六个推理与编程设置、使用开源权重优化器与执行器模型下，平均测试准确率82.0%，比最强基线高9.8个百分点；控制消融（固定初始化、搜索规则、修复策略与评估预算）显示加入执行证据即可提升测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 父代特定执行证据对进化式智能体设计具有明确价值，是可低成本获取且有效的搜索引导信号。

title: ORGANIC3D: Grounding 3D CT Vision Language Models in Organ Level Image Text Coupling
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in 3D computed tomography (CT) classification, but high accuracy does not reflect whether their predictions rely on the correct anatomical evidence. We introduce ORGANIC3D, a framework for evaluating and improving organ level image text alignment through controlled anatomical interventions. Our benchmark assesses 12 vision encoder checkpoints and 7 generative VLMs using matched patient comparisons, organ erasure, lesion replacement, and laterality perturbations, revealing substantial alignment failures even among top performing models. To learn organ level image text correspondence, ORGANIC3D aligns each finding sentence with the anatomy aware image features and trains on edited scans to anchor this alignment in the organ's image evidence. We further extend this framework to generative VLMs, promoting evidence dependent question answering and report generation. Trained exclusively on public data, ORGANIC3D achieves SOTA classification AUROC on CTRATE, Merlin, and the heldout RADChestCT dataset and reaches 77% laterality accuracy, compared with at most 66% for prior models. Its generative VLM matches or exceeds all evaluated publicly released VLMs on visual question answering, achieves the highest report accuracy, and retracts 96 to 99% of target organ findings after organ removal, versus a maximum of 69% for other models. Together, these results establish ORGANIC3D as a framework for testing whether 3D CT vision language models ground their predictions in anatomical evidence and for improving organ level alignment alongside predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 ORGANIC3D 框架，通过解剖干预检验并提升 3D CT 视觉语言模型的器官级图文对齐，兼顾准确性与证据依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在 3D CT 分类上精度高，但高准确率并不代表预测依赖正确的解剖证据，缺乏对器官级图文对齐的检验与改进手段。
AI.method: 构建基准，用匹配患者比较、器官擦除、病灶替换和左右侧扰动评估 12 个视觉编码器与 7 个生成式 VLM；将每条结论句与解剖感知图像特征对齐，并在编辑后扫描上训练锚定对齐；扩展到生成式 VLM 以支持证据依赖的问答与报告生成。
AI.result: 仅用公开数据即在 CTRATE、Merlin 及留出集 RADChestCT 上取得 SOTA 分类 AUROC；左右侧准确率 77%（此前最高 66%）；生成式 VLM 在 VQA 上持平或超越所有公开 VLM，报告准确率最高，器官移除后能撤回 96–99% 的目标发现（其他模型最多 69%）。
AI.conclusion: ORGANIC3D 提供了检验 3D CT VLM 是否基于解剖证据推断的评测框架，并能在提升预测准确率的同时改善器官级对齐。

title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.

AI.tldr: TRACE-MAS：面向LLM多智能体系统的细粒度故障诊断与修复框架，通过学习良性轨迹中的协作模式，检测智能体状态、消息传递、任务依赖的偏差，做源感知归因并施加最小干预恢复协作。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS防护主要做智能体级别的异常检测，当故障源于智能体之间的交互时不够用，且检出的异常不一定揭示真正的故障源头。
AI.method: 从良性轨迹中学习正常协作执行模式；在智能体状态变化、消息转移、任务依赖演化三个层面检测偏差；通过源感知归因（source-aware attribution）定位应负责的执行元素；选择最小干预以在保持任务关键能力的前提下恢复协作。
AI.result: 在五个MAS基准上，根因定位准确率提升60.2%，任务恢复表现持续优于强基线MAS防护方法。
AI.conclusion: 将MAS可靠性保障从智能体级异常检测提升到交互级诊断与修复，实现更精准的根因定位与有效恢复。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Finance and the Early-Career Skills Shift: A Structured Evidence Synthesis of Decision Delegation, Bank Deployments, and Business Education
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Structured evidence synthesis of AI in finance, decision delegation, early-career work, and business education. No new experimental measurements are claimed; empirical findings and deployment claims are attributed to cited sources
summary: Artificial intelligence is becoming a general interaction and decision-support layer across finance. Banks use AI for research retrieval, document synthesis, meeting follow-up, customer service, coding, fraud detection, risk support, and increasingly multi-step workflows. This paper asks which parts of finance work can be delegated safely, which remain human-owned, and how education should change when AI compresses the tasks through which novices traditionally build judgment. It presents a structured evidence synthesis of research and public evidence released from 2023 through October 2026 across finance, labor economics, education, bank deployments, and financial regulation. Numerical results and deployment claims remain attributed to their original sources. Four connections emerge: AI is strongest at retrieval, transformation, coding, and first-pass analysis; financial institutions are moving toward constrained rather than unrestricted autonomy; productivity assistance can weaken apprenticeship when assisted output improves faster than unaided capability; and delegation should depend jointly on consequence, reversibility, verification strength, and operational resilience. The paper develops a Finance Work Stack, Decision Delegation Matrix, AI Apprenticeship Paradox, Apprenticeship Preservation Protocol, and Career Readiness Stack. It argues that useful financial AI must improve productivity without weakening accountability, human capability, cyber resilience, or the future talent pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文对2023年至2026年10月的金融、劳动经济学、教育及银行部署证据进行结构化综合，提出金融AI的"工作栈""决策委托矩阵""学徒悖论"等框架，主张AI应在提升效率的同时不削弱问责、人类能力、网络韧性与人才梯队。
AI.motivation: AI正成为金融业的通用交互与决策支持层，但哪些工作可安全委托、哪些须由人承担、以及AI压缩新手建立判断力的任务后教育应如何调整，尚缺系统回答。
AI.method: 结构化证据综述：整合2023年至2026年10月间金融、劳动经济学、教育、银行部署与金融监管领域的公开研究与证据，数值与部署结论均归因原始来源。
AI.result: 得出四点关联：AI在检索、转换、编程与初筛分析上最强；金融机构趋向"受限式"而非"无限制"自主；辅助式提效可能使受助产出增速快于无辅助能力从而削弱学徒制；委托应同时取决于后果严重性、可逆性、可验证性与运营韧性。
AI.conclusion: 作者构建Finance Work Stack、Decision Delegation Matrix、AI Apprenticeship Paradox、Apprenticeship Preservation Protocol与Career Readiness Stack五个框架，认为有用的金融AI须在提高生产率的同时不损害问责、人类能力、网络韧性与未来人才供给。

title: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
summary: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations. BeFit (i) finds compact Bernstein-activated convolutional neural networks (BeCNNs) through hardware-aware neural architecture search and trains them via knowledge distillation; (ii) projects their weights to multiplication-free codes, freezes the codes, and recovers the resulting accuracy loss through the learnable activations; and (iii) generates model-specific kernels that exploit the projected weights for multiplication-free convolutions. On human activity recognition, BeCNNs are 2.75 percentage points (pp) more accurate on average than ReLU CNNs of identical architecture. On a TI CC3220SF (Cortex-M4), weight projection speeds BeCNNs up by 2.2x on average while losing 0.8 pp, compared with 2.4 pp for ReLU CNNs. Against the MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN reference model running on TensorFlow Lite Micro with CMSIS-NN, the unprojected BeCNN achieves 1.0 pp higher accuracy, 2.2x lower latency, and 6.4x lower flash, while the projected model remains within 1.0 pp of the reference accuracy and runs 5.9x faster. In emulation on a RISC-V core without a hardware multiplier, the instruction-count reduction relative to the DS-CNN increases from 5.2x on the Cortex-M4 to 147x. BeFit also extends to transformers and MLPs, and across all tasks the final models stay within 1.56 pp of their float32 teachers on average.

AI.tldr: BeFit 是一个端到端框架，将模型容量从权重转移到可学习的 Bernstein 多项式激活函数上，实现资源受限微控制器上的无乘法时序神经网络部署。
AI.motivation: 时序感知日益依赖神经网络，但在资源受限的微控制器上部署困难：激进压缩会降低精度，而将权重量化为无乘法表示会带来进一步损失。
AI.method: 三步：(i) 通过硬件感知神经架构搜索找到紧凑的 Bernstein 激活卷积网络（BeCNN），并用知识蒸馏训练；(ii) 将权重投影为无乘法编码并冻结，再通过可学习激活函数恢复精度损失；(iii) 生成利用投影权重的模型专属 kernel，实现无乘法卷积。
AI.result: 人体活动识别上，BeCNN 比同架构 ReLU CNN 平均高 2.75 pp；在 TI CC3220SF (Cortex-M4) 上权重投影带来 2.2x 加速，仅损失 0.8 pp（ReLU CNN 损 2.4 pp）。对比 MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN（TFLite Micro + CMSIS-NN）：未投影 BeCNN 精度高 1.0 pp、延迟低 2.2x、flash 少 6.4x；投影后模型精度差距 1.0 pp 内且快 5.9x。在无硬件乘法器的 RISC-V 仿真上，相对 DS-CNN 的指令数减少从 Cortex-M4 的 5.2x 提升至 147x。
AI.conclusion: BeFit 可扩展至 transformer 和 MLP，所有任务上最终模型平均保持在 float32 教师模型 1.56 pp 以内，验证了容量向可学习激活转移在无乘法 MCU 部署中的有效性。

title: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
summary: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $π^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.

AI.tldr: LMSA 按层诊断 cross-view 注意力，对"弥散层"用无偏 hub-key 采样、对"匹配层"保持精确，在低冗余视图上逼近稠密注意力精度并加速。
AI.motivation: VGGT 一次性重建相机与几何，但全局注意力随视图数二次增长；现有免训练稀疏加速器面向冗余视频，在视图间几何重叠少时位姿精度下降。作者认为原因是统一的稀疏近似无法同时保留两类跨视图信息：弥散层（分布式上下文聚合）与匹配层（依赖 query 特异交互、注意力质量小但关键）。
AI.method: 以"mean token 遗漏的对数质量"作为逐层统计量，其免行访问代理为 logit 方差，据此为每层选择估计器：弥散层用共享、重要性采样的 hub keys，并配 log 权重使 softmax 分子分母无偏；匹配层保持精确计算（所有激进稀疏化都掉精度）。
AI.result: 13 个未见低冗余场景、32 视图下，LMSA 距稠密注意力 1.4 AUC@5（AVGGT 10.3、SAF3R 4.5）；与 GPA-VGGT 差异不显著，仅对 AVGGT 的优势通过两项场景级检验。100 视图时距稠密 1.9 AUC@5，聚合器快 2.0×。事后用该统计量选择 GPA-VGGT 保护层，提升 1.2 AUC@5，FLOPs 仅增 5%。未经调参用于 π³ 时优于 AVGGT，但离稠密仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: 跨视图注意力应区分弥散层与匹配层的异质需求，逐层自适应选择估计器比统一窗口稀疏更有效；该统计量也可作为现有方法的层级选择工具，但迁移到 π³ 尚未完全对齐稠密精度。

title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

AI.tldr: 提出 QDA 系统，用 LLM agent 自动为不同模型与精度设计后训练量化（PTQ）方案，通过快速代理评估（隐藏推理轨迹上的输出 KL 散度）+ 长生成校验加速搜索，在多个推理模型和 GLM-5.3-Flash 上取得更强精度且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 最佳 PTQ 配方随模型和精度而变，需专家为每个新模型重新设计，耗时且次优。用 agent 迭代搜索可改善，但两处瓶颈：评估一个量化推理模型需数十 GPU 小时；跨代码库组合方法需手工移植到新架构。
AI.method: QDA 让 agent 针对每个模型与精度设计配方。评估加速：用 agent 未见过的推理轨迹上相对原模型的输出 KL 散度，几分钟内给候选打分；对高分候选再做长生成检查，捕捉重复循环等失败。构建加速：提供相互兼容且适配新架构的公开 PTQ 方法库。
AI.result: 四个推理模型上，W4A16、W4A8、W3A16 分别比最强公开配方平均提升 0.9、1.4、2.2 个百分点，每次搜索用 64 GPU 小时；320B MoE 模型 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 NVFP4 W4A4 下恢复 FP8 精度的 98.3%，优于最佳厂商 checkpoint 的 96.9%。
AI.conclusion: QDA 以低成本自动化 PTQ 配方设计，产出 checkpoint 可直接跑现有服务内核、无推理开销；将开源方法库、评估器与 harness。

title: Perceived Effectiveness of Social Debt Mitigation Measures: A Preliminary Vignette-Based Survey
summary: Software engineering is a socio-technical discipline in which unresolved social and organizational problems accumulate as social debt, gradually eroding collaboration and project health. The literature offers a solid vocabulary for these problems but says little about which countermeasures practitioners consider effective. We address this gap with a vignette-based survey: six social debt problem dimensions (Organizational Silo, Newcomer Isolation, Communication Breakdown, Knowledge Bottleneck, Cultural and Geographical Distance, Psychological Safety Deficit) were presented as realistic team scenarios, and 23 IT professionals and advanced students rated 41 literature-derived mitigation measures. Rankings were analyzed with paired t-tests and a hierarchical Bayesian model that accounts for the within-subject design and yields, for each measure, the probability of being the best option in its scenario. Only for Communication Breakdown is the answer unambiguous: consolidating communication into a single primary channel is almost certainly preferred (P(best)=0.91). For the other five dimensions, the model identifies favorites with moderate evidence (P(best) between 0.38 and 0.58), such as structured knowledge transfer and blameless retrospectives. Across scenarios, structural measures that change how information, decisions, and knowledge are organized were rated higher than role-based or attitudinal measures (by 0.3 to 0.4 scale points), although not in every scenario. Given the small convenience sample, the results are exploratory, but they offer software engineering managers an evidence-graded starting point for selecting mitigation measures.

AI.tldr: 本文用情境问卷(Vignette)调研23名IT从业者与高年级学生对六类"社会债务"问题下41种文献措施的偏好，并用配对t检验与分层贝叶斯模型给出各措施成为最优的概率。
AI.motivation: 文献虽为社会/组织类问题(社会债务)提供了词汇，但缺乏关于哪些应对措施被实践者认为有效的证据。
AI.method: 将六类社会债务问题(组织孤岛、新人孤立、沟通中断、知识瓶颈、文化与地理距离、心理安全感缺失)以真实团队情境呈现，让参与者对41条文献衍生的缓解措施打分；用配对t检验和被试内设计的分层贝叶斯模型(P(best))分析。
AI.result: 仅"沟通中断"结论明确：统一为单一主渠道几乎必然最优(P=0.91)；其余五类最优措施证据中等(P=0.38–0.58)，如结构化知识转移、无责复盘。跨情境中改变信息与决策组织方式的结构性措施比角色/态度类措施得分高0.3–0.4分，但并非所有情境成立。
AI.conclusion: 受限于小样本便利抽样，结果属探索性，但为软件工程管理者选择缓解措施提供了按证据分级排序的起点。

title: A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning and Out-of-Context Hallucination
summary: Large language models can infer and follow specific rules through in-context learning (ICL), yet may fail to remain faithful to provided evidence, giving rise to out-of-context (OOC) hallucination. Existing work has largely investigated the underlying mechanisms of ICL and OOC hallucination along separate lines. However, this separation obscures the mechanistic basis for these seemingly opposing outcomes. In this work, we study this contrast through the unified view of functional roles in dynamic context. The key observation is that role information can be internally represented without reliably constraining output. We derive a first-order decomposition to characterize the role effect, showing that its substantial influence depends on two necessary conditions, namely sufficient contribution magnitude and coherent signed aggregation. Causal analysis further shows that role span contributions affect key token choices involving response structure, content selection, and factual values. We further show that role-consistent choices depend on sufficient role span support at these key decisions, while failing choices can be reversed when this support overcomes the deficit. These findings support a common mechanistic view of ICL and OOC hallucination: each functional role defines the pattern of output decisions over which role span contributions must remain effective, and differences in this organization account for the seemingly opposing outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文从"动态语境中功能角色"的统一视角研究ICL与OOC幻觉，提出角色效应的一阶分解：角色影响需满足"足够贡献幅度"和"一致的有符号聚合"两个必要条件；因果分析表明角色片段贡献影响响应结构、内容选择与事实值等关键token决策。
AI.motivation: 现有工作分别研究ICL机制与OOC幻觉机制，二者割裂，无法解释"模型能遵循规则却违背证据"这一看似矛盾的现象，缺乏统一的机制性解释。
AI.method: 以动态语境中的功能角色为统一视角；观察到角色信息可在内部被表征却不必然约束输出；推导角色效应的一阶分解刻画其作用条件；并结合因果分析考察角色片段贡献对关键token选择的影响。
AI.result: 角色效应的大小取决于贡献幅度与有符号聚合的一致性；角色片段贡献影响涉及响应结构、内容选择和事实值的key token；角色一致的选择依赖关键决策处足够的角色片段支持，当支持足以弥补缺陷时错误选择可被逆转。
AI.conclusion: ICL与OOC幻觉存在共同的机制视角：每个功能角色定义了输出决策的模式，角色片段贡献须在该模式上保持有效，而这种组织方式的差异解释了看似相反的结果。

title: FACET - Facet Aware Contrastive Embeddings for Traits- Big Five Estimation from Life Narratives
summary: Personality is only weakly and inconsistently signaled by written language, and existing text-based methods typically combine language-model and psycholinguistic representations at the input or decision level. It remains open whether a more deliberate combination of the two views, and a decomposition of the prediction target, can recover more of the signal. We present a three-phase framework for estimating Big Five personality domain scores from life-narrative interview text. It encodes text and psycholinguistic features separately and combines them by concatenation or by a learned weighting, decomposes each domain into contrastively trained facet embeddings instead of predicting the domain directly, and pools the facet embeddings by attention into a domain-level prediction. We compare end-to-end with staged training and ablate the input modalities, their combination, and the facet-pooling strategy. On 1,332 participants from the St. Louis Personality and Aging Network (SPAN) study, facet embeddings reach AUC up to 0.740, and domain-level R2 reaches 0.328, highest for Openness. End-to-end training gives lower error than staged training in every domain, and attention pooling gives the lowest error in every domain. Combining the two views lowers error relative to text alone for Conscientiousness and Agreeableness, whereas a learned weighting of the views shows no consistent advantage over concatenation. The framework provides facet- level predictions that a domain-only model cannot, and it improves modestly on a regression from the raw features in four of the five domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三阶段框架，从生活叙事访谈文本估计大五人格分数：分别编码语言模型和心理语言学特征并融合，将每个维度分解为对比学习训练的面嵌入（facet embedding），再用注意力池化得到维度级预测。在SPAN的1332名被试上，面嵌入AUC最高0.740，维度R2最高0.328（开放性）；端到端训练误差低于分阶段训练，注意力池化在各维度误差最低。
AI.motivation: 书面语言对人格的指示信号微弱且不稳定，现有文本方法多在输入或决策层简单融合语言模型与心理语言学表征，且直接预测维度分数。作者希望探究更"刻意"的双视角融合方式以及将预测目标分解，能否恢复更多人格信号。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：1）分别编码文本特征与心理语言学特征，通过拼接或学习权重融合；2）将每个大五维度分解为对比训练的面嵌入，而非直接预测维度；3）通过注意力池化面嵌入得到维度级预测。实验比较端到端与分阶段训练，并消融输入模态、融合方式及池化策略。数据为SPAN研究1332名被试。
AI.result: 面嵌入AUC最高达0.740；维度级R2最高0.328（开放性最好）。端到端训练在全部五个维度误差均低于分阶段训练；注意力池化在全部维度误差最低。双视角融合相较于纯文本在尽责性和宜人性上降低误差，但学习权重相较拼接无一致优势。框架相较原始特征回归在五维度中的四个上有小幅提升，并提供维度模型无法给出的面级预测。
AI.conclusion: 在预测目标中引入面级分解与注意力池化，有助于从叙事文本中更有效地提取人格信号，端到端训练优于分阶段训练，但学习式融合相对简单拼接并无显著收益。

title: DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics
summary: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文指出潜在空间规划器假设特征距离反映到目标的远近，但实测该假设很弱；作者提出 DOCK，学习与物理运动一致的物体表征，作为规划代价显著提升任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 潜在空间规划器通过比较预测未来图像与目标图像的嵌入距离来选择动作，隐含假设嵌入空间距离能反映场景与目标的接近程度。作者想验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 用模拟器执行的真实未来（消除预测误差）对六个冻结的 DINO 与 V-JEPA 编码器做剖析。随后借鉴腹侧（what）与背侧（where/how）视觉通路提出 DOCK：利用被夹持物体随夹爪运动、由关节角正运动学给出无标注位移代理；从 21 个模拟厨房场景的 9,951 条搬运轨迹挖出 404K 位移对，训练三部分——由 patch 特征池化的物体 token（what）、使读出坐标差等于实测位移的空间标尺（where）、物体 token 上的动力学预测器（how）。
AI.result: 冻结特征距离与物体到目标距离的秩相关最高仅 0.11（掩码质心为 0.87），且被背景与机器人 patch 主导，读出更多捕捉机械臂而非物体。DOCK 作为规划代价在 21 个任务中 15 个成功放置物体，与读取真实物体位置的 oracle 相当；掩码几何为 10，冻结特征距离为 9。在可见未见机械臂时仍解最多任务，且排序可无适配地迁移到未见布局、未见过物体实例与类别。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉特征的嵌入距离并不忠实反映物理接近程度，需学习与运动学一致的物体表征。DOCK 以正运动学监督学得物体中心、可度量位移与动力学的表征，显著优于冻结特征距离与掩码几何，并具备较强泛化性。

title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even when the student and teacher are far apart. Across language model post-training settings, we demonstrate the implications of these theoretical findings for which OPD objective is preferable, highlighting the importance of accounting for the interplay between the student, teacher, and task at hand.

AI.tldr: 本文理论分析 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中目标函数（序列级 vs 词元级、不同散度）如何影响词元优先级、学习顺序与优化效率，指出序列级 OPD 存在"未来一致性偏置"导致反向学习顺序，且前向 KL 优化更稳定，反向 KL 等可能梯度消失。
AI.motivation: OPD 在实践中被广泛采用，但"该在序列级还是词元级应用、该最小化哪种散度"缺乏形式化理解。作者希望填补这一理论空白，厘清不同 OPD 目标的适用场景。
AI.method: 纯理论分析。推导不同 OPD 目标下各词元被优化的优先级、顺序与效率；分析序列级目标的偏差性质；比较前向 KL 与反向 KL 等 f-散度的目标景观与梯度行为；并在多种语言模型后训练设置中验证理论结论的含义。
AI.result: 发现：(1) 序列级 OPD 具有"未来一致性偏置"，而短视（myopic）的词元级目标可避免；(2) 该偏置导致反向学习顺序——序列级 OPD 先在后部词元位置与教师匹配，而在前部位置可能偏向教师认为极不可能、因而不理想的词元；(3) 散度选择强烈影响基于梯度的可优化性：前向 KL 具有良好良性的目标景观，而反向 KL 等其他 f-散度即使在师生差距大时也会出现梯度消失。
AI.conclusion: OPD 目标的选择应视具体情况而定，需综合考量学生模型、教师模型与具体任务之间的相互作用；不存在普遍最优的 OPD 目标，理论分析为实际选择提供了依据。

title: Escaping the Anthropomorphic Trap: Resolving the Cognitive Mismatch in Future AI Software Development
summary: For more than a half-century, the foundational paradigms of software development-such as modularity, information hiding, and hierarchical labor division-have been engineered to accommodate the strict cognitive limitations of human working memory. However, the rapid emergence of multi-agent artificial intelligence exposes a fundamental cognitive mismatch. Current frameworks attempt to integrate high-dimensional, stateless neural reasoning engines by coercing them to operate within these legacy, human-centric structures, falling into an anthropomorphic trap. This friction generates a novel, highly volatile behavioral entropy defined as AI-software technical debt, wherein amnesic agents hallucinate opaque workarounds to bypass architectural blindfolds. To resolve this, we propose Invisible Software Engineering (Invisible SE), a paradigm shift from agent-centric human emulation to environment-centric stigmergic governance. By reimagining the repository as an active computational topology which utilizes topological gradients, temporally weighted memory, and representation-space regularization, Invisible SE safely guides AI behavior without classical code-level constraints, thus transcending the cognitive horizons of human developers. This environment-centric protocol offers a potential blueprint for orchestrating scalable, long-lived computational infrastructures that transcend the cognitive horizons of human developers and enable autonomous agents to work, coordinate, and scale to build future software systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"隐形软件工程"(Invisible SE)，主张从以智能体为中心的人类模仿转向以环境为中心的共识治理，把代码仓库重构为主动计算拓扑，通过拓扑梯度、时间加权记忆与表示空间正则化来引导多智能体AI行为。
AI.motivation: 半个多世纪以来的软件工程范式（模块化、信息隐藏、层级分工）是为适应人类工作记忆的认知局限而设计的。多智能体AI的兴起暴露了这一根本性错配：现有框架强行让高维、无状态的神经网络推理引擎运行在遗留的人类中心结构中，陷入"拟人化陷阱"，并产生一种新的高度波动的行为熵——"AI-软件技术债"（失忆智能体幻觉出晦涩的变通方案以绕过架构盲区）。
AI.method: 提出 Invisible SE 范式：以环境为中心，把仓库视为"主动计算拓扑"，利用三类机制引导AI行为——拓扑梯度（topological gradients）、时间加权记忆（temporally weighted memory）、表示空间正则化（representation-space regularization），在不依赖传统代码级约束的情况下安全地引导智能体行为。
AI.result: 本文为概念性/立场性论文，未给出实证结果；其"结果"是提出 AI-软件技术债这一诊断概念，以及 Invisible SE 的概念框架与协议蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 环境中心协议有望成为编排可扩展、长寿命计算基础设施的蓝图，使自主智能体能够协作、规模化地构建未来软件系统，并超越人类开发者的认知边界。

title: Compression Effects on Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
comment: `Pilot study. 3 model families x 3 precisions x 6 directions on FLORES-200. Code and raw results: https://github.com/avvas200/efficient-multilingual-nmt-pilot`
summary: We present a pilot study characterising the effect of post-training quantisation on multilingual machine translation quality and inference cost for three African languages - Hausa, Swahili, and Yoruba - across three model families: a small general-purpose LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B), a larger multilingual instruction-tuned LLM (Aya-23-8B), and a dedicated multilingual MT model (NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B). Evaluating on the FLORES-200 devtest set (1,012 sentences per direction) under FP16, bitsandbytes INT8, and NF4 INT4 precisions on consumer-grade NVIDIA T4 GPUs, we find: (i) the specialised MT model outperforms both LLMs by 32.7-43.3 chrF on the Hausa and Swahili directions, and by 12.9-24.7 chrF on Yoruba, despite being roughly a sixth the size of the 8B instruction-tuned LLM; (ii) post-training quantisation preserves aggregate translation quality within approximately 1 chrF across all model families and language directions, with a single worst case of 2.19 chrF; (iii) on consumer GPUs, INT8 and INT4 quantisation provide substantial memory savings (49-61% at INT4) but do not reduce inference latency relative to FP16 - in fact, latency increases by 1.3x to 5.3x; (iv) a clear performance gradient tracking training-resource availability is visible across languages (Swahili > Hausa > Yoruba). These findings motivate a research agenda focused on hardware-aware compression and error-type analysis beyond aggregate metrics for low-resource deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文试点研究后训练量化对三种非洲语言（豪萨语、斯瓦希里语、约鲁巴语）多语机器翻译质量与推理成本的影响，发现专用MT模型显著优于LLM，量化基本保持翻译质量并大幅节省显存，但反而增加推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言在消费级GPU上部署多语机器翻译面临硬件与资源限制，需要了解后训练量化能否在不损害翻译质量的前提下降低推理成本，而相关实证研究缺乏。
AI.method: 在FLORES-200 devtest集（每方向1012句）上，对三个模型系列——Qwen2.5-1.5B、Aya-23-8B、NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B——在NVIDIA T4 GPU上分别以FP16、bitsandbytes INT8、NF4 INT4三种精度评测三种非洲语言的翻译质量（chrF）与推理开销。
AI.result: （i）专用MT模型在豪萨语和斯瓦希里语方向上比两个LLM高32.7–43.3 chrF，约鲁巴语方向高12.9–24.7 chrF，尽管其规模仅为8B指令微调LLM的约六分之一；（ii）量化基本保持总体翻译质量，损失约在1 chrF以内，最差单例为2.19 chrF；（iii）INT8/INT4显存节省显著（INT4达49–61%），但延迟不减反增（1.3–5.3倍）；（iv）性能呈随训练资源可得性变化的梯度：斯瓦希里语>豪萨语>约鲁巴语。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示低资源部署需转向硬件感知的压缩方法，并在聚合指标之外开展错误类型分析，构成后续研究议程。

title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
summary: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出潜在空间不确定性估计器（Latent Uncertainty）及传播方法 LProp，用潜表示替代标量分数和冗长描述来传递不确定性，在无需额外轨迹采样的情况下修正继承答案分布，在多数指标上优于基线且推理 token 消耗最低。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在下游传递中间判断时若不带不确定性，后续决策会把试探性假设当作事实。有效的不确定性传播既要保留可供纠正的信息，又要能随新证据更新继承信念。现有方案存在缺陷：标量分数丢失了修订所需的信息，而详细描述与反思式方法则带来额外开销。
AI.method: 先构建 Latent Uncertainty——一种潜空间估计器，在潜表示中保留与不确定性相关的信息，避免冗长文本描述。再在其基础上提出 LProp（Latent Uncertainty Propagation），利用潜表示与新证据修正继承的答案分布，且不进行额外的轨迹采样。
AI.result: 在多项选择、是/否、开放式问答与数学推理任务上评测：方法在多数指标上优于基线；LProp 在全部八种传播设置中平均推理 token 用量最低。匹配特征消融显示，继承的潜在内容相比仅用答案概率或仅靠模型容量，能带来更好的错误恢复。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间表示是一种兼顾信息保真与成本的不确定性传播载体，可支持无需额外采样的信念修订，并提升下游错误恢复能力。

title: ExiST: Existence-Aware Self-Training for Semi-Supervised Multi-Organ Segmentation
summary: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation should learn more than a dozen organs from a handful of labeled scans, and the smallest organs occupy less than one percent of the foreground. We identify a failure mode of self-training that is specific to this regime. When a teacher misses a small organ in a scan, every voxel of that organ receives the confident pseudo-label background, and the student is trained toward the organ absence. Repeated over many scans, this loop extinguishes tail organs. In a pilot study, removing the gallbladder from the pseudo-labels reduced its Dice on AMOS from 36.5 to 1.0. We argue that a missing organ should be treated as unresolved rather than absent and propose Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST). It builds pseudo-labels by leave-one-out consensus of independently trained networks, screens them with a quality gate on validation scans, and infers, per scan and per organ, whether the organ was found. For every unresolved organ, the background voxels of that scan receive the set-valued target, trained with a marginal cross-entropy that accepts either answer and a Dice term that skips uncertain voxels. We show that this loss never pushes a candidate organ toward absence and never favors one member of the set, which leaves the decision to labeled evidence. ExiST outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods and reaches 77.1 mean Dice on Synapse with 20% labeled scans and 75.9 on AMOS with 5% labeled scans.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST)，将"教师漏检的器官"视为"未决"而非"缺失"，用集合值目标和边际交叉熵避免自训练中尾部器官被逐步消失。
AI.motivation: 半监督多器官分割中器官众多、有标注扫描极少，小器官占比不足前景的1%。自训练存在特定失效模式：教师漏检小器官时，该器官所有体素被赋予高置信背景伪标签，学生被训练成"该器官不存在"，多轮后尾部器官被彻底消灭。预实验显示从伪标签中移除胆囊使其在AMOS上Dice从36.5降至1.0。
AI.method: ExiST 用多网络留一共识（leave-one-out consensus）构建伪标签，并用验证集质量门控筛选；再逐扫描、逐器官推断该器官是否"被找到"。对每个未决器官，将该扫描中的背景体素赋予集合值目标，用边际交叉熵（接受"存在"或"背景"任一答案）加跳过不确定体素的 Dice 项进行训练。作者证明该损失既不把候选器官推向缺失，也不偏向集合中任一成员，从而把决策留给有标注证据。
AI.result: ExiST 优于当前先进方法：Synapse 在 20% 标注扫描下达到 77.1 平均 Dice；AMOS 在 5% 标注扫描下达到 75.9。
AI.conclusion: 把漏检器官建模为"未决"而非"缺失"，并以集合值目标+边际损失训练，可有效缓解半监督多器官分割中尾部器官消亡问题，在小标注比例下取得领先性能。

title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève Update
summary: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. A forgetting factor lets the method track drifting distributions, and a sample-size-invariant embedding keeps outputs comparable across time. Experiments show agreement with Roseland to round-off on stationary data, and accuracy that exceeds equal-memory Roseland by an order of magnitude on long streams. On drifting data, we observe large gains from forgetting with a window matched to the drift.

AI.tldr: 提出增量式 Roseland (iRoseland)，将 landmark 亲和矩阵视作行可增长矩阵，用核化 SKL 在线更新其 SVD，实现单遍、有界内存的扩散映射式谱嵌入。
AI.motivation: 原始 Roseland 计算成本远低于完整扩散映射，但要求所有数据一次性可就绪，无法处理数据流或分布漂移场景。
AI.method: 把 landmark 亲和矩阵写成行增长形式，用核化 Sequential Karhunen–Loève 方案增量更新 SVD；度校正通过对参考均值核行的 一阶展开处理，每步只需一次 landmark×landmark 特征分解即可恢复 landmark 侧特征基；引入遗忘因子跟踪漂移分布，并用样本量不变的嵌入保证跨时间可比。
AI.result: 平稳数据上与 Roseland 一致到舍入误差；长数据流上精度比同等内存的 Roseland 高一个数量级；漂移数据上，遗忘因子配以匹配漂移的窗口带来大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: iRoseland 在保持 Roseland 低计算成本的同时实现在线、有界内存与漂移适应能力，适用于流式谱嵌入任务。

title: Skill Roulette: Measuring Skill Invocation Rate Across LLM Coding Agents
comment: Registered report, submitted to ACM TOSEM
summary: Agent skills package procedures for large language model (LLM) coding agents. An agent selects a skill from its name and description before reading the procedure. It may complete the task without invoking a relevant skill. We investigate how reliably coding agents invoke relevant skills and which factors affect that decision. We estimate invocation rates by repeating trials with identical inputs; invocation rate is the proportion of trials in which the agent invokes the relevant skill. We test 9 non-directional hypotheses about skill metadata, competing skills, contextual instructions, and task wording and composition. Eight concern invocation; the ninth tests whether making a skill available changes the occurrence of an action that the task does not request. We use tasks from 4 software engineering categories in a synthetic repository, running each of 4 coding-agent harnesses with 2 models. The planned 20,400 trials include 60 repetitions per Baseline category and configuration, 60 more per category in Claude Code with Sonnet 5.5 that admit each category's task and skill, and 10 per experimental condition. Comparisons are specified before collection and evaluated within each model and harness configuration using Boschloo's exact test.

AI.tldr: 研究编码智能体在多大程度上会主动调用相关的 agent skill，并测量调用率及其影响因素。
AI.motivation: Agent skill 通过名称和描述被选择，智能体可能在未调用相关 skill 的情况下完成任务，因此需要量化其调用可靠性及影响决策的因素。
AI.method: 在合成仓库中使用 4 类软件工程任务，4 个编码智能体框架与 2 个模型组合；以相同输入重复试验估计调用率；检验 9 个非方向性假设（元数据、竞争 skill、上下文指令、任务措辞与构成，以及 skill 可用性是否引发未请求动作）；计划 20,400 次试验，用 Boschloo 精确检验在每种模型-框架配置内评估预设比较。
AI.result: 摘要为研究方案，未报告结果；计划包括每类基线 60 次重复、Claude Code 与 Sonnet 5.5 每类额外 60 次、每个实验条件 10 次。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将建立 skill 调用率的量化基准，并识别影响编码智能体调用相关 skill 的关键因素。

title: A Hybrid RAG Framework for Deceptive Review Detection: Integrating RoBERTa-LoRA, FAISS-Based Retrieval, and LLM Reasoning
summary: The growth of deceptive online opinions poses a critical risk of misinformation and fraud. This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to automatically distinguish spam reviews. The architecture integrates RoBERTa with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) classification, FAISS semantic vector retrieval, and a Large Language Model (LLM) for final reasoning. The system was evaluated across balanced and severely imbalanced real-world scenarios. Results demonstrate that five epochs of fine-tuning enable robust domain transfer, achieving an F1-score of 0.90 in cross-domain evaluation, outperforming baselines (OpenAI Detector,F1 = 0.82) and demonstrating competitive performance against specialized in-domain SOTA models (fakeRoBERTa,F1 = 0.97). The proposed architecture provides evidence-backed explainability and statistically significant precision gains while maintaining comparable overall detection performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合RoBERTa+LoRA分类、FAISS语义检索与LLM推理的RAG系统用于虚假评论检测，跨域F1达0.90。
AI.motivation: 在线欺骗性意见（虚假评论）增长带来误信息与欺诈风险，需要自动区分垃圾评论的手段，且要求检测结果具备可解释性。
AI.method: 构建RAG架构：以RoBERTa配合LoRA微调做分类，用FAISS做语义向量检索，再交由大语言模型进行最终推理判断；在平衡与严重不平衡的真实场景下评估。
AI.result: 五轮微调即可实现稳健的领域迁移，跨域评估F1为0.90，优于OpenAI Detector（F1=0.82），与域内专用SOTA（fakeRoBERTa，F1=0.97）相比具竞争力；精确率提升具统计显著性，整体检测性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在保持可比检测性能的同时提供有证据支撑的可解释性，是应对虚假评论的有效方案。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Clarification for Multi-Agent Food Assistance
summary: Food insecurity creates a pressing need for guidance that helps households find usable food resources and assess food choices in light of their circumstances. Such guidance must connect eligibility requirements, practical access constraints, and dietary needs rather than return isolated listings or generic nutritional advice. Multi-agent food assistants can coordinate these tasks, with uncertainty indicating when clarification or verification is needed before a recommendation. However, uncertainty can be lost across agent handoffs, allowing tentative interpretations to propagate as facts and obscuring opportunities for correction. Moreover, confidence that a service requirement has been interpreted correctly is not confidence that a recommendation satisfies the user's needs; local confidence cannot simply be reused as downstream reliability. We introduce an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework that preserves shared premise identities and replays consistent interpretations across dependent agents. Each receiver exposes admissible decisions and remaining evidence obligations, so question relevance reflects both decision changes and missing support. Information questions and user-confirmable fallback adjustments are evaluated together with their anticipated follow-up interactions under shared budgets. This structure connects clarification to jointly supported plans for resource navigation, nutritional reasoning, and supply-side planning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理时的"接收方条件化"澄清框架，用于多智能体食物援助助手，通过保留共享前提身份并在依赖智能体间重放一致解释，避免不确定性在交接中丢失，使澄清问题与最终联合支持的推荐计划相连。
AI.motivation: 食物不安全家庭需要能同时衔接资格条件、实际获取约束与饮食需求的指导，而非孤立清单或泛化营养建议。多智能体可协调此类任务，但不确定性在智能体交接中易丢失，试探性解读被当作事实传播；且"解释正确"的局部置信不等于下游推荐可靠，局部置信无法直接复用为下游可靠性。
AI.method: 推理时、接收方条件化的澄清框架：保留共享前提身份，并在依赖智能体间重放一致解释；每个接收方暴露可采纳决策与剩余证据义务，使问题相关性同时反映决策变化与缺失支撑；在共享预算下，将信息性问题与用户可确认的回退调整连同其预期后续交互一起评估。
AI.result: 该结构将澄清环节与资源导航、营养推理、供给侧规划三方面共同得到支撑的计划连接起来，使澄清问题针对真正的决策变化与证据缺口，并支持对推荐的联合验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过在智能体间显式传递前提与证据义务，该框架可缓解不确定性传播与局部置信误用问题，为食物不安全场景下的多智能体助手提供可澄清、可验证的联合推荐路径。

title: GRAFT: Graph-Regularized Prototype Fields for Realistic Test-Time Adaptation of VLMs
summary: Unlabeled test data can improve the zero-shot classifier of a vision-language model, yet transductive and test-time adaptation methods often fall below the zero-shot baseline when only a few vocabulary classes are present in a batch or when streams are correlated. We trace this failure to a shared design: every class owns independent parameters estimated from its own samples, so absent or rare classes are left at biased text anchors or fitted to foreign samples. We propose Graph-Regularized Anchor-displacement Field Transduction (GRAFT), which models the adapted prototypes as text anchors plus a displacement field that is partially pooled over a semantic class graph through a Gaussian Markov random field prior, together with an explicit class-presence model. Inference is closed-form and gradient-free on cached features. Anchor-only shrinkage and a single global shift are the two extreme settings of the prior; absent classes are provably harmonic extensions of the present ones, and the pooling strength can be chosen by empirical Bayes. Under the realistic batch and online protocols on eleven benchmarks and four ImageNet shifts, GRAFT improves over the zero-shot model in every setting and over anchor-based transduction where few classes are present.

AI.tldr: GRAFT 把适配原型建模为"文本锚点+位移场"，用语义类图上的高斯马尔可夫随机场先验做部分池化，并加入显式类存在模型，实现闭式、免梯度的转导推理，在十一基准与四个 ImageNet 偏移设定下全面优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有转导与测试时自适应方法在批次中词汇类很少或数据流相关时，往往低于零样本基线。作者将失败根源归为共同设计缺陷：每个类拥有从自身样本独立估计的参数，导致缺席或稀有类停留在有偏的文本锚点上，或被错误地拟合到其他类的样本。
AI.method: 提出图正则锚点位移场转导（GRAFT）：将适配原型表示为文本锚点加位移场，通过高斯马尔可夫随机场先验在语义类图上对位移做部分池化，并配以显式类存在模型。推理在缓存特征上进行，闭式求解、无需梯度。
AI.result: 仅锚点收缩与单一全局平移是该先验的两个极端情形；缺席类可被证明为存在类的调和延拓；池化强度可用经验贝叶斯选择。在十一基准和四个 ImageNet 偏移的真实批次与在线协议下，GRAFT 在所有设定中均优于零样本模型，并在类别稀少时优于基于锚点的转导方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在类图上共享位移统计，GRAFT 从根本上缓解了少类批次与相关数据流下的失败模式，且具备理论保证与闭式轻量推理，是一种实用且稳健的视觉语言模型测试时自适应方案。

title: Stability Does Not Mirror Plasticity: A Module-Level View of Declarative and Procedural Learning in Transformers
summary: Plasticity and stability in continual learning are typically studied at the entire-model level and in a task-agnostic manner, yet prior work has reported divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by cognitive distinctions between declarative and procedural memory, we instead study how plasticity and stability vary across transformer modules and task types. In a controlled synthetic environment with clean measurement, we show a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability, however, does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. Targeted module reset-and-recovery experiments explain this asymmetry: plasticity tracks which module is best suited to a task's primary computation or storage, whereas stability depends on all ways the existing capability relies on that module, including access to information stored in other modules. Experiments on a realistic model and tasks broadly echo these asymmetric dynamics. Overall, our work shows that plasticity and stability depend on different aspects of a module's functional role, offering a task-dependent, module-level perspective on continual learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文在模块层面（而非整模型层面）区分任务类型，研究Transformer中可塑性与稳定性的分化，发现QK/VO在程序性任务中可塑性最强，MLP在陈述性记忆中最强，且稳定性并不镜像可塑性。
AI.motivation: 已有持续学习研究多在整模型层面、任务无关地考察可塑性与稳定性，导致不同设置下结论分歧。作者借鉴认知科学中陈述性记忆与程序性记忆的区分，希望在模块层面、按任务类型重新审视这两个性质。
AI.method: 构建可控合成环境以实现干净测量，按任务类型（程序性/陈述性）分别考察Transformer各模块（QK、VO、MLP）的可塑性与稳定性，并辅以模块重置-恢复（reset-and-recovery）实验解释其不对称性；在真实模型与任务上验证。
AI.result: 呈现双重分离：QK与VO在程序性任务上最具可塑性，MLP在陈述性记忆上最具可塑性。稳定性并不镜像可塑性：学习新程序时更新QK可保留过半陈述性记忆，更新MLP保留很少，更新VO约损失五分之四。重置实验表明可塑性取决于模块与任务主计算/存储的匹配程度，而稳定性取决于既有能力对该模块的所有依赖方式，包括对其他模块中所存信息的访问。
AI.conclusion: 可塑性与稳定性依赖模块功能角色的不同侧面，因而持续学习需要一个任务相关、模块层面的视角；真实模型与任务上的实验基本印证了这种不对称动态。

title: An Industry Perspective on Software Vulnerability Management: A Systematic Review of Approaches, Tools, Practices, and Challenges
comment: Preprint version. Submitted to ACM; under review. Online appendix included as supplementary material
summary: Software vulnerability management (SVM) refers to coordinated activities to detect, assess, repair, and disclose software vulnerabilities (SVs) across a product or ecosystem. As software systems grow in scale and dependency depth, organisations must balance timely security action with limited expertise, evolving tooling, and delivery pressure. In this practitioner-centred systematic literature review, we synthesise 57 peer-reviewed empirical studies published between 2010 and 2025 that collect primary data directly from industry practitioners. We examine the SVM solutions (approaches, tools, and practices) proposed and evaluated with practitioners and the challenges practitioners report when adopting and using these solutions in real-world settings. We find that practice-oriented contributions, such as guidelines, recommendations, lessons learned, and shared experiences, constitute most of the evidence base, while fewer studies evaluate concrete approaches and tools in industrial environments. The solution landscape and evaluation focus are weighted toward SV detection and repair, with comparatively limited practitioner-centred coverage of SV assessment and disclosure. The most persistent challenges concern how SVM work is organised and embedded: limited security expertise and time, unclear responsibility for SV-related decisions, scattered or poorly coordinated processes, and tools that are difficult to understand, configure, or integrate into existing workflows. These findings highlight the need for more integrated socio-technical interventions, stronger coverage of under-studied SVM tasks, and evaluations that prioritise sustained workflow impact alongside technical performance.

AI.tldr: 对2010–2025年57篇基于从业者一手数据的实证研究进行系统性文献综述，梳理软件漏洞管理（SVM）的解决方案与实践挑战，发现证据偏重检测与修复、以实践指导类贡献为主，组织与流程嵌入类挑战最为突出。
AI.motivation: 软件系统规模与依赖深度增长，组织需在及时安全响应与有限专业知识、演进工具、交付压力之间权衡；现有研究缺乏以从业者为中心的整合视角，需明确哪些SVM方案经过真实环境验证、从业者面临何种落地挑战。
AI.method: 以从业者为中心的系统性文献综述，纳入2010–2025年间57篇同行评审、直接从产业从业者收集一手数据的实证研究，归纳分析所提出与评估的SVM方案（方法、工具、实践）及其实世界采用挑战。
AI.result: 实践导向贡献（指南、建议、经验教训、经验分享）构成主要证据基础，在工业环境中评估具体方法与工具的研究较少；方案与评估重心偏向漏洞检测与修复，评估与披露环节的从业者研究覆盖不足；最持久的挑战集中在工作组织与嵌入层面——安全专业知识与时间有限、漏洞决策责任不清、流程分散或协调不足、工具难以理解/配置/集成到现有工作流。
AI.conclusion: 需更多综合性社会技术干预、加强对研究不足SVM任务的覆盖，并在技术性能之外优先评估对工作流的持续影响。

title: Grading Executable Legal Rules Against Independent Records: Transitional Provisions and Korean SME Status
comment: 51 pages, 2 figures (plus 1 in the appendix). Submitted to Artificial Intelligence and Law. Code and data: https://github.com/nepersoned/lextemporis
summary: Laws are increasingly turned into programs that decide cases, such as whether a firm was a small or medium enterprise (SME) on a given date, and large language models (LLMs) now write them. The programs are usually graded against answers written by someone who read the same law, so a program can score well by sharing the grader's reading rather than by getting the law right. LexTemporis grades them instead against records of what actually happened: 10,901 firm-years of SME status disclosed by Korean listed companies, with every version of the governing rules. An appendix adds comparison cases from US income tax and German hospital minimum volumes. The date changes outcomes mainly through provisions outside the main statutory text: one transitional provision raises agreement with the disclosures from 83-86% to 89-90%. The disclosures also test the author's reading of a contested provision, favouring it in 130 of 189 firm-years where readings diverge. Four LLMs wrote the rules, given different selections of the law. A pre-registered comparison finds no condition better across all four models. In exploratory analyses, supplying the right provisions looks better graded against the author's reading than against the records: the advantage shrinks for three models (for one, to between a quarter and three-fifths of its size), and per firm-year it is several times larger where the author's reading is wrong, partly by construction, since there reproducing that reading more faithfully must lose. Grading legal programs against the grader's own reading can overstate how well they work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LexTemporis 基准，用韩国上市公司真实披露的 10,901 个企业-年 SME 状态记录（而非人工解读的答案）来评测 LLM 编写的法律程序，发现以"评分者自己的解读"为标准的评测会高估程序效果。
AI.motivation: 法律正被转化为判定个案的程序（如某企业某日是否为中小企业），LLM 也开始编写这类程序。现有评测通常与"同读了该法律的人写出的答案"比对，程序可能仅因与评分者共享同一解读而得分高，而非真正正确地实现了法律。
AI.method: 构建 LexTemporis 基准：以 10,901 个企业-年的韩国上市公司 SME 状态真实披露、配合所有版本的适用规则作为评分依据；附录补充美国所得税与德国医院最低手术量的比较案例；由四个 LLM 在不同法律条文选取条件下编写规则，并进行预注册比较与探索性分析（分别按作者解读与真实记录评分）。
AI.result: 日期主要通过主法条之外的条款影响结果：一条过渡性条款使程序与披露的一致率从 83–86% 提升到 89–90%。披露数据还可检验作者对一条争议条款的解读，在解读分歧的 189 个企业-年中 130 个支持作者解读。预注册比较未发现任何条件在四个模型上全部更优。探索性分析显示：提供正确条文时，按作者解读评分比按真实记录评分更有利，三个模型的优势缩小（其中一个缩至原来的 1/4 到 3/5），且在每个企业-年上，作者解读出错的样本中优势大数倍（部分源于构造性偏差——忠实复现该解读必然失分）。
AI.conclusion: 以评分者自身解读为基准来评测法律程序会高估其实际有效性；应改用真实世界记录作为评分标准。

title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
summary: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $τ^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $τ^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $τ^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).

AI.tldr: ARISE 是一种无需更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑的记忆架构，让 Agent 从自身失败中迭代改进：归因失败→提出纠正→作为微记忆检索→整合为宏观规则→仅在留出集准确率提升时接受规则。在 SOP-Bench 和 τ²-bench 上显著优于基线及 GEPA。
AI.motivation: 企业 LLM Agent 运行在动态环境中：基础模型快速迭代、工作流频繁更新、部署需满足准确率与成本约束。传统方法依赖更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑，成本高且不灵活，因此需要一种无需改动模型与流程、能持续自我改进的实用记忆架构。
AI.method: ARISE（Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation）：用模型自身或教师模型对失败进行归因并提出纠正；将纠正作为可检索的微记忆保存；进一步整合为宏观规则；只有留出集准确率上升时才接受规则更新。含 ARISE-Teacher（用 Claude Opus 4.6 做归因与整合）与 ARISE-Self（部署模型自我归因）两种变体。
