summary: Online continual learning (OCL) requires learning from a data stream whose arrival rate is independent of model training speed. When training cannot keep pace, computationally expensive gradient-based methods update less frequently, limiting adaptation. Analytic methods reduce this overhead, but their frozen backbones cannot adapt representations to changing distributions. We propose DuoCL, a dual-path OCL framework whose fast analytic path accumulates feature statistics from every incoming minibatch while its slow path periodically adapts the backbone. The slow path adjusts its sample count to the available compute budget without interrupting fast-path learning. Feature alignment compensates for drift in the accumulated classifier statistics. Across four datasets and three computational budgets, DuoCL improves online accuracy by an average of 9.67 percentage points over the strongest gradient-based baseline in each setting. DuoCL consistently outperforms analytic learning under distribution shifts, with gains of up to 4.00 percentage points on CIFAR-C, and achieves higher accuracy than prior methods across disjoint class-incremental, domain-incremental, and Si-Blurry settings.

AI.tldr: DuoCL：双路径在线持续学习框架，快路径用解析学习累积特征统计，慢路径周期性适配骨干，在计算受限下显著提升在线准确率。
AI.motivation: 在线持续学习中数据到达速率与训练速度无关，计算昂贵的梯度方法更新频率受限，而解析方法虽降低开销但冻结骨干无法适应分布变化。
AI.method: 双路径框架：快速解析路径对每个到达的小批次累积特征统计；慢速路径周期性适配骨干，按可用算力调整样本数且不打断快路径学习；用特征对齐补偿累积分类器统计的漂移。
AI.result: 四种数据集、三种计算预算下，在线准确率平均超过最强梯度基线9.67个百分点；在分布偏移下优于解析学习，CIFAR-C上提升至4.00个百分点；在不相交类增量、域增量及Si-Blurry设置中均优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合解析学习的效率与骨干适配的适应性，DuoCL在计算受限的在线持续学习场景中一致优于梯度与解析两类基线。

title: Log Analysis for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
summary: Logs generated by LLM-based agents support analysis of execution behavior beyond final outputs. Existing surveys give limited attention to dependencies across the lifecycle of these records. A lifecycle-oriented review of 90 core studies published between 2024 and August 2026 covers Agent Logging, Agent Log Structuring, and Agent Log Mining. Stage-specific comparisons reveal cross-stage dependencies and limitations. Detailed logs do not necessarily provide sufficient evidence. Structural uniformity does not guarantee semantic equivalence. Analytical claims require alignment with supporting evidence, reference criteria, and validation procedures. Representative open-source tools, public datasets, and future research directions are also summarized.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向LLM智能体日志生命周期（记录—结构化—挖掘）的系统性综述，覆盖2024年至2026年8月的90项核心研究，揭示跨阶段依赖与局限。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体产生的日志可支持对执行行为的分析，但现有综述对其全生命周期中记录间的依赖关系关注不足。
AI.method: 采用生命周期导向的综述方法，将文献划分为Agent Logging、Agent Log Structuring与Agent Log Mining三个阶段，对90项核心研究进行阶段对比分析，并梳理代表性开源工具与公开数据集。
AI.result: 阶段对比揭示了跨阶段依赖与局限：详细日志未必提供充分证据；结构统一不代表语义等价；分析结论需与支撑证据、参照标准和验证流程相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 日志各阶段并非独立，后续分析质量受前序记录与结构化质量制约，未来研究应关注证据充分性、语义一致性与验证规范，并总结开源工具、数据集与研究方向。

title: MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
summary: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a "divide-and-conquer" strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. Furthermore, to model cross-modal complementary correlations, we propose a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module, where a dynamic modality-aware weighting network refines interactions across hierarchical semantic levels, thereby integrating multi-granular evidence to counteract element dominance. Finally, we incorporate a generative semantic refinement stage that utilizes large language models for zero-shot re-ranking. Extensive experiments on WikiDiverse, RichpediaMEL, and WikiMEL show that MECI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Hits@1 by 1.95%, 7.30%, and 2.31%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出MECI框架解决多模态实体链接中的元素主导问题，通过多视图专家解耦学习、分层多模态交互与生成式语义精化提升性能。
AI.motivation: MEL需捕捉多级对应关系（提及-实体语义一致性、跨模态互补关联），但现有方法依赖耦合交互或粗糙全局聚合，导致元素主导问题。
AI.method: 1) 多视图专家网络：分治策略解耦特征学习，KL引导路由控制专家专门化与协作；2) 分层多模态交互模块：动态模态感知加权网络在分层语义级别精化交互；3) 生成式语义精化阶段：用LLM进行零样本重排序。
AI.result: 在WikiDiverse、RichpediaMEL、WikiMEL上Hits@1分别提升1.95%、7.30%、2.31%，持续优于SOTA。
AI.conclusion: MECI通过多元素解耦协作与分层跨模态交互有效缓解元素主导，结合LLM重排序显著提升MEL性能。

title: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.

AI.tldr: COTEX：以适配器级低成本持续扩展多模态智能体工具空间，将专家视觉模型接入已训练智能体而不损害原有工具能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体主要依赖裁剪、搜索、代码执行等通用工具，专家视觉模型未被纳入工具空间；而把新模型接入已训好的智能体存在难点——需高效学习新工具同时保留旧工具使用能力。
AI.method: 定位两组参数方向：一组触发工具调用从而开启多轮推理轨迹，另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器仅被限制在“调用”方向上，并用正交约束使其不影响既有工具的选择；另提出一套协议，把专家模型已有的任务标注转化为经验证的工具使用轨迹。
AI.result: 在两个代表性智能体与三个专家工具上，于十个视觉语言基准上取得提升，对已有工具的性能最多仅下降0.3个点。
AI.conclusion: 以适配器级成本实现的持续工具空间扩展，可在几乎不损失旧工具性能的前提下有效增强智能体的专家能力。

title: Structured Extraction of Diffraction Data from Covalent Organic Frameworks
comment: 66 pages: main text (19 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables) and Supporting Information (47 pages) in one file. Data and code: https://github.com/AaronG211/pxrd_PEAK ; database website: https://pxrd-peak.vercel.app
summary: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is the primary structural evidence for covalent organic frameworks (COFs) and many other materials. Yet decades of measured patterns exist only as images in published figures. Automatic recovery is difficult, because PXRD figures vary widely in format, from a single curve to crowded stacks with labels, insets, and neighboring plots that challenge traditional computer vision. This work presents a pipeline in which a vision large language model (LLM) interprets the layout of each figure, locating the diffraction plot and its curves and sketching a coarse trace of each, while classical computer vision (CV) refines every trace to pixel-level accuracy. Applied to 3,954 COF articles, the pipeline produces 11,445 calibrated diffraction curves, released in the open database COF-PEAK. Compared with a hand digitization of 60 panels, extracted peak positions differ by a median of only 0.07 degrees. Whereas papers usually report only a few peak angles, which limits further analysis, the digitized curves enable tracking how peak prominence, a possible marker of crystallinity, changes with synthesis conditions. Vision LLMs and classical CV can thus turn such figures into reusable experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉大语言模型(LLM)+经典CV"的流水线，从文献图像中自动恢复PXRD衍射曲线，在3,954篇COF文章中提取11,445条校准曲线并建成开放数据库COF-PEAK。
AI.motivation: PXRD是COF等材料的主要结构证据，但几十年来大量实测图谱只以论文图片形式存在，无法直接复用；图版格式差异大（单曲线、带标签/插图的堆叠曲线、相邻子图等），传统计算机视觉难以自动处理。
AI.method: 视觉LLM先解读整幅图的版式，定位衍射图区域及各条曲线并给出粗略轨迹；随后用经典CV对每条轨迹做像素级精细化校准，实现曲线数字化。
AI.result: 在3,954篇COF文章中产出11,445条校准衍射曲线（COF-PEAK数据库）；与60个子图的人工数字化结果相比，峰位中位误差仅0.07°。
AI.conclusion: 视觉LLM与经典CV结合可将文献图谱转化为可复用实验数据；数字化曲线能追踪峰强度（可能的结晶度指标）随合成条件的变化，突破原文仅报告少数峰角的局限。

title: Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients for Stable Feature Attribution
comment: 36 pages, 19 figures, 27 tables, including the appendix
summary: Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to interpret neural networks, yet imperceptible input perturbations can drastically alter their attribution maps while leaving model predictions unchanged. We introduce Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients (ERIG), a path-based attribution method that intrinsically attenuates gradient irregularities along the integration path using maximum-entropy softmax weighting with temperature parameter $τ$. We quantify the effect of the entropy-regularized weighting on attribution stability by using the Lipschitz properties of the model and its gradients. We decompose the attribution change under an input perturbation into a model-response term, whose bound is $τ$-independent, and a weight-variation term, whose bound decreases at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/(2τ))$. Their ratio $R(τ)$ characterizes the trade-off between gradient information and attribution stability. We further add a new dimension to attribution evaluation by adapting classical noise estimators into two metrics, LINV-C and LINV-P, that quantify attribution noise. Across eleven CNN and Transformer backbones on ImageNet and Oxford-IIIT Pet datasets, our experiments show that, relative to the next-best method, ERIG remains comparable on ranking-based fidelity metrics while improving localization by approximately 24% and attribution stability by approximately 47-fold on average, reaching up to four orders of magnitude improvement over IG, all at negligible additional computational cost.

AI.tldr: ERIG 通过在积分路径上用最大熵 softmax 加权（温度 τ）抑制梯度不规则性，提升基于路径的归因方法的稳定性，同时保持可靠的归因保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于路径的归因方法（如 Integrated Gradients）对输入施加不可感知的扰动时，归因图会发生剧烈变化，而模型预测却保持不变，说明归因方法的稳定性不足，影响其可信度。
AI.method: 提出 Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients（ERIG）：沿积分路径使用带温度参数 τ 的最大熵 softmax 加权，内在地衰减梯度不规则性；利用模型及其梯度的 Lipschitz 性质，将扰动下归因变化分解为与 τ 无关的模型响应项和以 O(1/(2τ)) 速率下降的权重变化项，并用比值 R(τ) 刻画梯度信息与归因稳定性的权衡；同时把经典噪声估计器改造为 LINV-C 和 LINV-P 两个归因噪声度量。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 和 Oxford-IIIT Pet 上，覆盖 11 种 CNN 与 Transformer 骨干网络：相比次优方法，ERIG 在基于排序的保真度指标上相当，定位提升约 24%，归因稳定性平均提升约 47 倍，最高比 IG 提升达四个数量级，且额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: ERIG 以理论可证的机制在几乎零额外成本下显著改善归因稳定性与定位质量，并引入 LINV-C/LINV-P 作为归因噪声评估的新维度，为归因方法的稳健性评价提供了新视角。

title: Ephyra: A Property-Based Testing Framework for the LLM Era
summary: Coding agents now write a growing share of software tests; however, property-based testing (PBT) libraries are designed with historical considerations. We present Ephyra, a PBT library in Rust built on three concepts: customizability, observability and generator synthesis. Ephyra lets users compose their own testing loops from generation, mutation and shrinking, and synthesize these components to satisfy functional predicates. Applying Ephyra to 14 open source systems, we have found 349 bugs and reported 300 of them, in database management systems (SQLite, Turso, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, DataFusion), the verified policy engine (Cedar), the SQL equivalence prover (QED), the URL parser used in Node.js (ada-url), reimplementations of existing open source systems in Rust (coreutils, brush, gitoxide), and compilers (binaryen, OCaml, and OxCaml).

AI.tldr: Ephyra是一个基于可定制性、可观测性和生成器合成三大概念的Rust属性测试库，在14个开源系统中发现349个bug。
AI.motivation: 编码代理越来越多地编写软件测试，但现有属性测试（PBT）库基于历史设计，难以适应代理驱动测试的新需求。
AI.method: 提出Ephyra：允许用户从生成、变异、收缩等环节自行合成测试循环，并可依据功能谓词合成组件以满足特定测试目标。
AI.result: 在14个开源系统中发现349个bug，报告300个，覆盖SQLite、Turso、PostgreSQL、DuckDB、DataFusion、Cedar、QED、ada-url、coreutils、brush、gitoxide、binaryen、OCaml与OxCaml。
AI.conclusion: Ephyra的高可定制与生成器合成设计能有效支撑大规模真实系统测试，证明其为实用且高产的PBT工具。

title: ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
summary:
Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive "System 1" side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative "System 2" reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters.
  We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models.

AI.tldr: ProbMedTOD自动从少量临床笔记合成临床贝叶斯网络，并与小语言模型结合，实现多轮问诊中的概率推理与可审计的信念跟踪。
AI.motivation: 问诊是迭代更新诊断假设的多轮过程，理想上需要"系统2"式的审慎推理；而小模型（SLM）受隐私、成本、延迟约束更受青睐，但只具备快速的"系统1"直觉能力，缺乏显式维护诊断不确定性的机制。贝叶斯网络可提供可解释的概率信念跟踪，但临床贝叶斯网络依赖专家构建，难以获得。
AI.method: 提出ProbMedTOD：三阶段自动合成临床贝叶斯网络——本体构建、结构预测、参数估计；再将贝叶斯网络与SLM集成。其中贝叶斯网络Agent实时维护诊断后验分布，策略Agent选择最具诊断信息量的问题。
AI.result: 在DDXPlus与MIMIC-IV Notes数据集上，ProbMedTOD优于纯LLM和基于检索的基线，且对更小模型的提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将自动构建的可解释贝叶斯网络与SLM结合，可低成本地补足小模型的审慎推理与不确定性跟踪能力，在临床多轮问诊中取得更优表现。

title: Metrics-in-the-Loop: Complexity Feedback Reshapes Agent-Written Code
comment: Agent Evaluation Science Symposium, Fall 2026, New York City
summary: Coding agents now write whole codebases in long autonomous runs, guided mainly by whether their tests pass. Yet passing tests alone does not reveal accumulating complexity or gaps in test coverage, which then persist as agents extend their own code. We introduce metrics-in-the-loop, an inference-time intervention that gives agents in-flight feedback: cheap, automatically computed code metrics injected into the agent's context during the trajectory. After each code-changing agent turn, we insert short feedback messages naming changed functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds a limit (complexity feedback) or changed lines that are skipped by tests (coverage feedback), giving the agent the opportunity to refactor code or strengthen tests before continuing. We run extensive experiments and ablations comparing several interventions across three long-horizon coding benchmarks and four strong models. We find that complexity feedback significantly reduces erosion, a measure of complexity concentration of code, without affecting held-out correctness of the code. Broadly, our experiments investigate a practical form of agent "re-railing", where timely, actionable measurements redirect agents before weaknesses become the foundation they keep building on. As agents scale to codebases with millions of lines, such interventions become critical to sustaining effective development and long-term code maintainability.

AI.tldr: 提出"指标在环"(metrics-in-the-loop)推理时干预：在编码智能体轨迹中注入自动计算的代码指标反馈，使其能及时重构或补测试，从而降低代码复杂度侵蚀。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在长时间自主运行中主要靠"测试是否通过"作为指导信号。但仅凭测试通过无法暴露不断累积的复杂度或测试覆盖缺口，而这些缺陷会随着智能体继续在自己代码上扩展而长期保留。
AI.method: 一种推理时干预：在每个改变代码的智能体回合之后，插入简短反馈消息，指出被改动且圈复杂度超限的函数（复杂度反馈），或指出被测试跳过的改动行（覆盖反馈），让智能体有机会在继续前重构或加强测试。在三个长程编码基准、四个强模型上进行大量实验与消融对比。
AI.result: 复杂度反馈显著降低了"侵蚀"（代码复杂度集中度的度量），且不影响代码的留出正确性。消融实验对比了多种干预方式。
AI.conclusion: 实验探索了一种实用的智能体"重上轨道"机制：及时、可执行的度量能在弱点成为后续构建基础之前纠正智能体。当智能体扩展到数百万行代码库时，这类干预对维持有效开发和长期可维护性至关重要。

title: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at WSDM 2027 Findings
summary: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. While prior work has applied quantization for efficient MoE inference at the edge, we point out that in MoE-based VLMs, the modality-specific characteristics of visual and text tokens further impact expert quantization. To address this issue, we present MoMoVL, a modality-aware adaptive compression framework for MoE-based VLMs that brings vision-language inference within reach of on-device resource budgets. Motivated by our empirical findings on modality-induced disparities across experts, MoMoVL jointly exploits the per-expert activation profile and per-modality quantization sensitivity to guide bit-width assignment. Experimental results show that MoMoVL improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines and reduces memory footprint by up to 15.44% with a modest drop in accuracy over its uniform-precision baseline. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/sco-edge/MoMoVL.

AI.tldr: MoMoVL是一个面向MoE架构视觉语言模型(VLM)的模态感知自适应混合精度量化框架，利用专家激活轮廓与模态量化敏感性联合分配比特宽度，在精度略降下将内存占用最多降低15.44%。
AI.motivation: 智能体Web兴起带来端侧VLM需求，MoE虽计算高效但多专家结构内存需求大；混合精度量化适合MoE结构稀疏性，但此前工作忽略了视觉与文本token的模态差异对专家量化的影响。
AI.method: 基于对模态引起专家间显著差异的实证发现，MoMoVL联合利用逐专家激活轮廓(per-expert activation profile)与逐模态量化敏感性(per-modality sensitivity)来指导比特宽度分配，实现端侧可行的模态感知自适应压缩。
AI.result: 相比SOTA混合精度基线，MoMoVL在精度-压缩权衡上更优；相对统一精度基线，内存占用最多降低15.44%，且精度仅有适度下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入模态感知的自适应量化分配，MoMoVL有效缓解MoE-VLM端侧部署的内存瓶颈，验证了模态特性在专家量化中的关键作用，代码与数据已开源。

title: JEPA as a Transferable Optimizer: Learning and Understanding Black-Box Optimization from Reward-Agnostic Pretraining
summary: Black-box optimization evaluates candidates through simulations, rollouts, or experiments, often without gradients. Learned optimizers are usually judged by whether they outperform existing methods. We ask a complementary question: what information does a learned optimizer use from its search history? We introduce JEPA-PS (JEPA Policy Search), based on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. It is pretrained on random rollouts using parameter vectors and scalar returns. Its latent-prediction objective predicts the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than its reward or gradient, allowing us to examine what was tried and how well it performed. At test time, JEPA-PS reads a short evaluation history and proposes a candidate in one forward pass, without task descriptions, reward shaping, or test-time gradients. We evaluate it on 15 control environments against 12 optimizers, including evolutionary methods, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and an LLM optimizer. JEPA-PS is competitive with tuned classical baselines and outperforms the LLM optimizer by more than 2x on Swimmer at 71x lower per-step cost. It also transfers zero-shot to environments excluded from pretraining. Null-model comparisons and decoder-training ablations indicate that its latent representation carries information beyond simple history statistics; every trained decoder variant performs worse than the default frozen representation. Our main finding is that the history JEPA-PS uses depends on the task. On smooth landscapes it uses the full trajectory, whereas on rugged landscapes the best-seen point carries nearly all the signal. This memory requirement has a weak positive correlation with fitness-distance correlation (FDC; r=0.112, n=7), while an independent reward-ordering sensitivity probe does not corroborate the relationship (r=-0.024, n=7). Code: https://github.com/mdebnath22/jepa-props.

AI.tldr: JEPA-PS 用联合嵌入预测架构预训练一个策略搜索优化器，只预测轨迹中下一个参数点而非奖励/梯度；在15个控制环境上对12种优化器表现有竞争力，并可零样本迁移。核心发现：所用历史取决于任务难度特征。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型优化器多只被评估"是否更好"，缺少对"它到底利用了搜索历史中的什么信息"这一问题。作者提出互补问题：学习型优化器从历史中提取什么信息。
AI.method: 基于 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture 的 JEPA-PS：在随机 rollout 上用参数向量和标量回报预训练，潜空间预测目标是轨迹中下一个点（而非 reward 或 gradient）。测试时读入短评估历史，一次前向提出候选，无需任务描述、奖励塑形或测试时梯度。对比包含进化方法、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES 和 LLM 优化器在内的12种基线，并用空模型比较与解码器训练消融分析其潜表示。
AI.result: 在15个控制环境上，JEPA-PS 与调优经典基线相当；Swimmer 上比 LLM 优化器好2倍以上且单步成本低71倍；可零样本迁移到预训练未见环境。空模型与解码器消融显示潜表示含有超出简单历史统计的信息，所有可训练解码器变体均劣于默认冻结表示。
AI.conclusion: 历史需求随任务而变：平滑地形上使用完整轨迹，崎岖地形上"已见最优点"几乎承载全部信号。该记忆需求与 FDC 仅有弱正相关（r=0.112, n=7），且独立的奖励排序敏感度探针未能印证（r=-0.024, n=7）。

title: When Single Agent Is Enough: Rethinking Multi-Agent Systems for Automated Code Review
summary: Code review plays a critical role in identifying software quality issues and ensuring system robustness. Prior work has proposed techniques for Review Comment Generation (RCG) and Code Refinement (CR), with recent Multi-Agent (MA) approaches achieving state-of-the-art results by coordinating agents specialized in different quality dimensions. However, MA systems introduce substantial architectural complexity and runtime overhead, and recent evidence suggests they may underperform Single-Agent (SA) approaches in certain tasks. In this work, we systematically compare MA and SA designs for RCG and CR. Surprisingly, our results show that SA approaches perform comparably to- and sometimes outperform-MA systems, despite their simpler design. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that MA architectures are the default choice for complex software engineering tasks.

AI.tldr: 系统对比多智能体（MA）与单智能体（SA）在评审评论生成（RCG）和代码改进（CR）任务上的表现，发现SA设计可与MA相媲美甚至更优。
AI.motivation: MA方法在代码评审任务上取得SOTA，但带来显著的架构复杂性和运行开销，且已有证据显示其在某些任务上可能不如SA，因此需要澄清MA是否真是复杂软件工程任务的默认选择。
AI.method: 针对RCG与CR两项任务，系统性地构建并对比MA与SA两类设计，在统一设置下开展实证评估。
AI.result: SA方法表现与MA相当，有时甚至超过MA系统，尽管其设计更为简单。
AI.conclusion: 结果挑战了"MA架构是复杂软件工程任务默认选择"的普遍假设，提示研究者应重新审视架构复杂度的必要性。

title: Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models
summary: Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.

AI.tldr: 在相同模型、数据和训练预算下对比五种改进组件，发现MoE、Muon优化与Gated DeltaNet混合收益最大，额外归一化也有效，而注意力门控在参数匹配下收益甚微；各项增益基本可叠加，但存在小交互效应，需重复实验确认。
AI.motivation: 构建小语言模型时需要从众多已发表的改进中选择组合，但缺乏在统一条件下对各组件效果及相互作用的可靠比较。
AI.method: 在同一模型架构、同一数据和同一训练预算下对比五种改动，测试所选组合，并用第二个随机种子重复每个实验，以检验结果稳定性。
AI.result: MoE层、Muon优化和Gated DeltaNet混合带来最大增益；额外归一化也有帮助；参数预算匹配的注意力门控平均增益很小。各改动增益大体可叠加，但重复运行中出现小的交互作用，且重复实验还揭示出初次统计估计被判为噪声的收益。
AI.conclusion: 结论仅适用于小模型训练场景（专家模型总容量更大）。实践建议是把有前景的组件放在一起测试，并在决定保留哪些组件前重复对比实验。

title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.

AI.tldr: 提出证据驱动的信用分配(ECA),在终端结果奖励上加入仅训练用的辅助信号,衡量检索文档对参考答案似然度的提升,从而区分同一轨迹中不同搜索步骤的实际价值。
AI.motivation: 结果监督的强化学习对轨迹中每次搜索给予相同信用,无论其是否检索到有用信息;当所有采样轨迹均失败时,组中心化的优势值归零,即使不同轨迹收集到的证据差异明显。
AI.method: 用冻结的当前策略快照,在仅含问题与去重文档的证据专用提示下查询,隔离检索段落效用;比较两种回报形式:ECA-Step(累积步级裁剪的势函数增量)与ECA-Horizon(保留望远镜式视界增益);配合跨折组归一化、新颖性门控和搜索局部token分配。
AI.result: 在七个Search QA基准上,ECA-Horizon相比仅结果奖励的GRPO基线,在Qwen2.5-3B和7B-Instruct上严格宏平均精确匹配分别提升1.03和4.80个百分点,优于RLOO和GiGPO;MultiHop-RAG零样本评估显示对多跳推理查询的良好迁移。
AI.conclusion: 提供细粒度证据级信用可显著改善搜索增强语言模型的强化学习训练效果,优于现有基线并具备跨任务泛化能力。

title: What Do Learned 3D Models Add to Localization from Posed References?
summary: Localizing a query from a few posed reference images avoids building a 3D point map. We ask what the camera predictions of learned 3D models add to geometric estimation from the same references, and where failures arise. Across eight learned models and variants and five test sets, we compare reference budgets, swap pose components, and intervene on the references a model sees. At fine pose-error thresholds, geometric estimation with one additional reference is significantly more accurate than every model on two references on Cambridge and NAVER B1 and never significantly worse, alone or as a fallback behind a shared acceptance gate; with the same three references, the more accurate approach depends on the scene. The gain from the learned translation magnitude depends on reference selection: it improves seven of the eight models on 12-Scenes with the spread-out pairs we select, but none of the five we test with the two top-ranked retrieved references. Where retrieval also returns references from other locations, at NAVER Gangnam Station, models fail at different stages. A robust alignment brings Pi3X and MapAnything within 3.3 pp of adding references as needed. In controlled tests, aligning on the nearby references largely restores VGGT, Pi3X and MapAnything but not Depth Anything 3, and pose-conditioned Pi3X recovers only if the far poses are masked and left out of its input-pose normalization.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了学习式3D模型的相机位姿预测与几何估计（从少量参考图像定位）在野外定位中的表现，发现精细误差阈值下几何估计加一张参考图显著优于所有模型，并分析了失效来源与对齐策略。
AI.motivation: 研究已知位姿的少量参考图像定位可避免构建3D点云地图，但尚不清楚学习式3D模型的相机预测相对于同一参考集上的几何估计能带来多少增益、以及失败发生在何处，作者希望对二者进行严谨的对照分析。
AI.method: 在8个学习式模型及其变体、5个测试集上开展实验：比较参考图预算、交换位姿分量（如平移幅度与旋转）、并对模型所看到的参考图像进行干预；同时用共享接受门（acceptance gate）将几何估计作为回退方案，并在NAVER江南站等跨位置检索场景中分析模型失败阶段，采用稳健对齐策略。
AI.result: 在精细位姿误差阈值下，几何估计加一张参考图在Cambridge与NAVER B1上显著优于所有使用两张参考图的模型，且无论单独使用还是作为接受门的回退都从不显著更差；使用三张参考图时更优方法依场景而定。学习式平移幅度的增益依赖参考选择：在12-Scenes上对作者选定的分散图像对可提升8个模型中的7个，但对检索到的两张最高排名参考无一提升。跨位置检索时各模型在不同阶段失败；稳健对齐使Pi3X与MapAnything与“按需增加参考图”的差距缩小到3.3个百分点以内。受控实验中，对近邻参考进行对齐可基本恢复VGGT、Pi3X和MapAnything的性能，但Depth Anything 3不行；位姿条件化的Pi3X仅在遮蔽远方位姿并将其排除于输入位姿归一化时才能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 几何估计在少量参考下是学习式3D模型位姿预测的强基线，二者应按场景与参考选择互补使用；模型失效主要源于远位/跨位置的参考与输入位姿归一化，采用稳健的最近参考对齐可显著缓解但并非对所有模型有效。

title: Label-Free Role-Aware Segmentation of Classroom Recordings: Recovering the Teacher from Transferable Structure
comment: Accepted at the AAAI track is IAAI (Innovative Applications of AI)
summary:
How much the teacher talks and when are among the most informative and costly-to-measure signals of teaching. Yet, classroom audio is among the most sensitive data an AI system can process: recordings capture minors and fall under GDPR, preventing raw audio from leaving the recording device. We present a teacher-student segmentation pipeline designed to meet exactly this constraint: label-free at inference, running on a recording device, and requiring no per-session calibration. The pipeline chains a lightweight voice activity detector, compactly pretrained speaker embeddings, agglomerative clustering, and a small logistic regression that assigns the teacher role based on session-relative structure rather than voice identity. We show that our structural cue transfers across classrooms, languages, and acoustic conditions.
  In leave-one-teacher-out cross-validation on 292 recordings from 63 teachers across English and German corpora, our pipeline achieves teacher F1 of 0.81 and 0.87, respectively, outperforming both enrollment-based baselines and a 30-second supervised enrollment ceiling. On a commodity smartphone, its performance matches pyannote, a strong neural diarization tool, while running 4.8x faster at comparable peak memory at a real-time factor of ~0.18. We also find that transcribing filtered audio only marginally increases teacher's word error rate from $0.26$ to 0.28. Residual failures concentrate where teacher and student voices are not acoustically separable. However, we show how to flag these sessions label-free at inference so that they can be routed to human review, enabling selective, privacy-preserving deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在录音设备端运行、推理时无需标注和逐次校准的师生语音分割流水线，利用"教师角色"的结构性线索实现跨课堂、跨语言泛化，兼顾隐私与性能。
AI.motivation: 教师说话量与说话时机是极有价值但测量成本高的教学信号。然而课堂音频含未成年人、受GDPR约束，原始音频不能离开录音设备，因此需要一种能在设备端、无标注推理、无需逐次校准的分割方案。
AI.method: 流水线串联：轻量级语音活动检测(VAD) → 紧凑预训练说话人嵌入 → 凝聚聚类 → 小型逻辑回归；后者依据"会话内相对结构"而非声纹身份来分配教师角色。另用无标注方式在推理时标记不可分离会话以路由人工复核。
AI.result: 292段录音、63位教师、英德双语语料的留一教师交叉验证中，教师F1分别为0.81和0.87，优于基于注册(enrollment)的基线和30秒监督注册上限。手机端性能与pyannote相当，速度快4.8倍(RTF约0.18)。对过滤后音频转写，教师词错率仅从0.26升至0.28。
AI.conclusion: 结构性线索可跨课堂、语言和声学条件迁移，实现隐私保护、选择性的设备端部署；残余错误集中在师生声学不可分的会话，但可通过无标注标记进行人工复核。

title: Code Cloning and Procedural Abstraction in Scratch: A Large-Scale Study of Co-Existing Reuse Practices
summary: Code cloning is a long-standing software-evolution concern: duplicated implementations diverge as software changes. In block-based programming, however, duplication is an everyday reuse mechanism, and Scratch facilitates a copy-and-paste culture that may hinder abstraction. We study this relation in 2.04 million public Scratch projects. We compare cloned sequences with existing abstractions and examine how their use varies across Computational Thinking (CT) score levels. Clones occur in 6.2% of projects and custom blocks in 11.9%. Of 436,198 detected clone instances, 16.1% have a normalized sequence matching a custom block in the same project and 17.8% match a custom block only outside it. At the pattern level, 83 of the 100 most frequent clone patterns have counterparts implementable as custom blocks elsewhere in the corpus. Of the remaining 17 patterns, 15 are amenable to custom-block extraction, while in two cases the benefit of abstraction is ambiguous; no class of frequent clone resists abstraction in principle. Yet the abstractions that do exist are often shallow: 53.0% of custom blocks are parameter-free. Increased use of abstraction does not coincide with less cloning. Both become more prevalent at higher CT-score levels, and their combined use dominates the highest band. These findings are consistent with cloning and procedural abstraction being co-existing reuse practices rather than mutually exclusive stages. Closing that gap requires both instruction on when to abstract, not only how, and platform support for refactoring.

AI.tldr: 在204万个Scratch项目中，克隆代码出现在6.2%的项目，自定义积木出现在11.9%；克隆与过程抽象是共存的复用实践，而非互相排斥的演进阶段。
AI.motivation: 代码克隆长期被视为软件演化中的问题，但在积木式编程中复制粘贴是日常复用手段，Scratch的复制粘贴文化可能阻碍抽象。作者想弄清克隆序列与已有抽象之间的关系，以及二者在不同计算思维（CT）水平上的分布。
AI.method: 对2,043,000个公开Scratch项目做大规模代码克隆检测，将克隆序列归一化后与同一项目内及语料库其他项目的自定义积木进行匹配，并按CT得分分层比较克隆与自定义积木的使用情况。
AI.result: 436,198个克隆实例中，16.1%的归一化序列匹配同一项目内的自定义积木，17.8%仅匹配项目外的自定义积木；100个最高频克隆模式中有83个在语料库其他位置存在可实现的等价自定义积木，其余17个中15个适合抽取为自定义积木，仅2个抽象收益不明确，没有一类高频克隆在原理上无法抽象。同时已有抽象往往较浅：53.0%的自定义积木无参数。抽象使用增加并不伴随克隆减少，二者在更高CT得分层都更普遍，在最高分层中组合使用占主导。
AI.conclusion: 克隆与过程抽象是共存的复用实践而非互斥阶段；弥合这一差距既需要教授“何时”抽象（而非仅“如何”抽象），也需要平台层面的重构支持。

title: Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer's residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse--dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.

AI.tldr: 研究在Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC)中为不同残差流分配不同学习目标，发现目标特化能提升稀疏-稠密检索融合性能，并诱发深度相关的结构化特化。
AI.motivation: 以往mHC训练中所有残差流共享同一目标，本文探究是否可给不同流分配不同目标以提升任务表现并产生目标特化。
AI.method: 以互补的词汇（稀疏）和语义（稠密）检索目标为测试案例，比较目标特化mHC与非特化mHC，在2流/4流及两种模型规模、全稀疏-稠密融合范围上测试；并用流表征探针、残差混合、目标特定梯度流及读写门分析内部机制，另将残差混合固定为恒等以做消融。
AI.result: 特化模型在全融合范围内一致优于非特化模型；两者在大部分网络层行为相似，但在最后几层分化：特化模型出现日益目标特定的梯度流、不同的读写路由模式、跨流混合减少，不同目标流渐趋相异而同目标流仍高度相似。固定残差混合为恒等后特化收益依然保留。
AI.conclusion: 为mHC流分配不同目标可改善多目标检索，并在残差计算中诱发结构化、依赖深度的特化；收益主要来自目标特定的读写路由而非学到的跨流混合。

title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
summary: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.

AI.tldr: 本文用冻结大模型+两个小型投影头+温度参数构建System 1式多选题答题器，在MedMCQA上验证其上限：小模型约42%，Qwen3-8B达46.0%，远低于Med-PaLM 2的72.3%，属廉价快速基线。
AI.motivation: System 1式单次前向的多选题答题范式已在智能体决策中验证，但在需要医学知识的考试题上（正确选项与题干相似度未必高于错误选项）尚未被系统研究，作者希望厘清该范式在医学考试题上的能力边界。
AI.method: 基于冻结的Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B与Qwen3-8B，仅训练两个投影头和温度参数，用带批内负样本与难负样本的对比损失及重复答案掩码，在MedMCQA上从头复现配方；并尝试"一句话摘要"提示与降低学习率。
AI.result: 原始末位token向量下两个小模型准确率33.1%/33.0%（3,842题留出集，随机为25.0%）；改用摘要提示并降低头学习率后升至41.7%/42.5%，Qwen3-8B为46.0%±0.2（三个种子）。打乱题干与选项后准确率回落到随机水平，说明头确实利用了题干信息。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为廉价快速基线，但不具竞争力（Med-PaLM 2为72.3%、Flan-PaLM为57.6%，且协议不同）；证据局限在于验证集增益约为测试集增益的1.7–2倍，且无法分离多层编码器读取与其他改动各自的贡献。

title: A Hardware-Aware Comprehensive Study of Edge Vision Deployment with A Unified Hardware-Model-Runtime Mapping Framework
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has driven the deployment of computer vision directly on resource-constrained edge devices. However, the extreme heterogeneity of edge hardware architectures poses major challenges in selecting and designing suitable vision models. This survey bridges the gap between edge hardware constraints, model architectures, and deployment software toolchains. We establish a comprehensive taxonomy classifying edge hardware into three distinct tiers: mid-range devices (GPUs and dedicated NPUs or TPUs), dedicated embedded MPU or SoC processors, and microcontrollers (MCUs). We aggregate and analyze multi-source benchmark results for image classification and object detection across the computing spectrum, spanning from tens of watts down to milliwatt-scale bare-metal MCUs. Based on these empirical findings, we propose a two-tiered hardware-to-model mapping framework that provides concrete model selection matrices across performance priorities (Speed, Balanced, Accuracy) and actionable architectural design principles (peak SRAM budgeting, resolution-first scaling, and algorithm-compiler co-design). Finally, we highlight critical deployment challenges including toolchain fragmentation, operator incompatibility, and Vision Transformer feasibility, and outline promising future research directions in on-device adaptation and sustainable Edge AI.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理边缘硬件约束、视觉模型架构与部署工具链之间的关系，提出三层级硬件分类与两层"硬件-模型"映射框架，为不同功耗与算力平台上的视觉模型选型与设计提供指导。
AI.motivation: 深度学习发展推动计算机视觉向资源受限的边缘设备下沉，但边缘硬件架构极度异构，导致研究者与工程师难以选择合适的视觉模型并针对性设计。硬件约束、模型架构与部署软件工具链三者之间缺乏系统性的关联分析，本文旨在弥合这一缺口。
AI.method: (1) 建立边缘硬件三级分类体系：中端设备（GPU、专用NPU/TPU）、嵌入式MPU/SoC、微控制器（MCU）；(2) 汇总并分析跨算力谱（数十瓦至毫瓦级裸机MCU）的多种来源图像分类与目标检测基准结果；(3) 基于实证结果提出两层"硬件-模型"映射框架，给出按性能优先级（速度、均衡、精度）划分的模型选型矩阵，以及峰值SRAM预算、分辨率优先缩放、算法-编译器协同设计等可操作的架构设计原则。
AI.result: 形成覆盖从数十瓦到毫瓦级MCU的统一基准分析视图，输出可落地的模型选型矩阵与架构设计准则，并指出工具链碎片化、算子不兼容以及Vision Transformer在边缘端可行性等关键部署障碍。
AI.conclusion: 边缘视觉模型的选择应硬件层级驱动而非单一精度导向；未来需在发展端侧自适应（on-device adaptation）与可持续边缘AI方向持续投入，并解决工具链与算子生态的碎片化问题。

title: Error accumulation in reverse diffusion with an imperfect score: beyond path-space analyses
summary:
Diffusion modeling is a popular method of sampling from a complex, high-dimensional distribution $p$ using learned approximations of its (noised) score functions. Generating a single sample requires simulating the reverse diffusion process, which requires many queries to the learned scores. Thus, a priori, the learning errors can easily compound. Indeed, in existing theoretical analyses, the sampling error (as measured in total variation distance to $p$) accumulates polynomially with the horizon of the stochastic process. This is a consequence of bounding the error of the output law by the error of the law of the entire reverse diffusion path.
  In this paper, we demonstrate that by circumventing the "path-space" analysis, the error accumulation of the diffusion sampler can be mitigated when $p$ satisfies a Poincaré inequality. Moreover, we achieve this result as a special case of a broader framework that applies to any distribution $p$, but relaxes the error metric from total variation distance to a weaker metric capturing all sample statistics that do not "witness" the multimodality of $p$.
  We then zoom out from analyzing the diffusion sampler to the information-theoretic question: given a learned score with some error bound, how accurately can we identify $p$? We show that, for any given bound on the Poincaré constant of $p$, the diffusion sampler already nearly achieves optimal total variation error.

AI.tldr: 本文突破传统的"路径空间"分析框架，证明在分布满足Poincaré不等式时，扩散采样器的误差累积可被缓解；并给出更一般的度量松弛框架及信息论意义下的近最优性结论。
AI.motivation: 扩散采样需多次查询学习到的score，学习误差会累积。已有理论以全变差距离度量采样误差，但因用整条反向扩散路径的分布误差作为上界，导致误差随过程时间多项式级累积，估计过于悲观。
AI.method: 规避"路径空间"分析，转而直接分析输出分布，从而在p满足Poincaré不等式时缓解误差累积；将结果作为更广框架的特例，该框架适用于任意p，但把误差度量从全变差距离放松为一种更弱的度量——不"见证"p多模态性的样本统计量。
AI.result: 在Poincaré不等式下，扩散采样的误差累积得到缓解；一般框架下可在弱度量意义下给出保证。进一步的信息论分析表明，对任意给定的Poincaré常数上界，扩散采样器在全变差误差上已近乎达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 放弃路径空间分析可显著改善扩散采样的理论误差界；扩散采样在Poincaré分布类上关于全变差误差近乎信息论最优。

title: Beyond Stars: MTTX Brings Developer Responsiveness to Dependency Decisions, from Dashboard to IDE to GitHub Actions
summary: Modern software reuses open-source packages as dependencies, and developers often choose among candidate packages with cheap signals, such as GitHub stars and download counts. However, such signals are easy to fake, so developers need signals that represent "observed behavior," such as how quickly the developers of a package respond to new dependency releases and to security fixes. Prior work computed these responsiveness metrics, MTTU (Mean Time To Update) dependencies and MTTR (Mean Time To Remediate) vulnerable dependencies, but only with a research prototype for a fixed set of packages. Therefore, developers cannot easily benefit from them or integrate them into their workflow. We present MTTX, an open-source tool that computes MTTU and MTTR with accurate historical dependency resolution for any package and given time window, and brings them into different phases of developer workflow. MTTX resolves each version constraint of npm, PyPI, and Cargo packages as of a past date, with data from the native registries or deps.dev and vulnerability data from OSV. We validated MTTX with 328 automated tests, and for 90 packages from prior work, we manually verified its dependency resolution at each historical release point and its MTTU and MTTR computation. Developers can use MTTX in an interactive web dashboard, an IDE extension, and a GitHub Action, which are all available from the project homepage at https://imranur-rahman.github.io/dependency-update-metrics/. We envision that package registries (e.g., npm) and metadata aggregators and intelligence platforms (e.g., deps.dev) will display these values on the package page, alongside download counts and stars, to make them easier for developers to access. A demo video is at https://youtu.be/MZqjDnJ8bEQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源工具 MTTX，可对任意 npm、PyPI、Cargo 包在任意时间窗口内准确重建历史依赖解析，计算 MTTU（依赖更新平均时间）和 MTTR（漏洞依赖修复平均时间），并以网页仪表盘、IDE 插件和 GitHub Action 三种方式融入开发者工作流。
AI.motivation: 开发者常用 GitHub star 数、下载量等"廉价信号"选择依赖包，但这些信号容易被伪造。更能反映真实行为的是包维护者对依赖发布和安全修复的响应速度（MTTU/MTTR），然而此前只有针对固定包集合的研究原型，开发者难以使用或集成到工作流中。
AI.method: MTTX 针对 npm、PyPI、Cargo 包，按过去某一日期解析每个版本约束（历史依赖解析），元数据来自原生注册表或 deps.dev，漏洞数据来自 OSV，从而计算 MTTU 与 MTTR；并提供交互式 Web 仪表盘、IDE 扩展、GitHub Action 三种接口。
AI.result: 用 328 个自动化测试验证；对来自先前工作的 90 个包，逐一人工核验各历史发布点的依赖解析及 MTTU/MTTR 计算；工具已开源并通过项目主页提供三种使用形态。
AI.conclusion: MTTX 使"行为型"依赖健康信号可被任意包、任意时间窗口计算并集成到开发流程；作者期望包注册表（如 npm）和元数据平台（如 deps.dev）在包页面上与下载量、星数并列展示这些指标。

title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"late entry（晚进入）"解码策略与"Wake verification"机制，使循环语言模型的新token跳过前几轮迭代直接从最终K轮进入深缓存的上下文，并在CUDA图中统一实现贪心精确/门控/有损三种验证，从而在不损失精度的前提下获得5-12倍实际加速。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型靠重复共享层T次来加深推理，但深度直接转化为串行解码延迟。传统early-exit在初始几轮后就停止，缓存不完整，导致历史token的KV状态只保留浅层深度，浪费了循环带来的深度优势。作者想研究相反方向：能否利用深缓存的上下文来替代被跳过的token局部计算。
AI.method: 提出late entry：新token跳过前T-K轮，直接在最终K轮作用于深上下文缓存；用轻量微调解决进入边界处隐状态范数不匹配。为使该非对称性转化为实际墙钟加速，候选块只在最终K轮做验证（关键路径），已提交token在后续步骤中并行补齐1→T轮（零额外串行调用）。在已有输出GEMM中投影T轮的wake状态（Wake verification），以logit margin容差τ∈[0,∞]统一三种模式：τ=0贪心精确（等价K=T块解码）、τ>0门控验证、τ=∞无回滚有损late entry，全部打包进单个静态CUDA图。
AI.result: Ouro-2.6B（T=4）：K=2时τ=0达5.2倍贪心精确加速（比K=4块解码+26%），τ=∞达6.8倍（同速下比训练好的early-exit高16.9分）。Huginn-3.5B上T∈{8,16,32,64}：K=T/4回滚随深度下降21.5倍，τ=0加速达6.1倍(T=32)与8.4倍(T=64，比K=64块+153%)，τ=∞加速10.6–12.5倍。
AI.conclusion: late entry利用深缓存上下文优于对称的early exit，配合Wake verification在单一静态CUDA图中实现从精确到有损的可调速度-精度谱，且随循环深度增大收益越显著，为循环/深度推理模型提供了实用的解码加速方案。

title: RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop
summary: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

AI.tldr: RoboBuilder 是一个让编码智能体协同设计机器人硬件与程序的基准：所有仿真通过的机器人都会被 3D 打印并在真实赛道上测试。仿真与现实存在巨大差距，但让智能体观看真实失败视频并闭环迭代，可显著消除失败。
AI.motivation: 研究问题：AI 智能体能否设计出在真实世界工作的机器人？纯仿真验证不足以说明问题，需要评测"仿真→实物"的迁移能力，并探索如何缩小 sim-to-real 差距。
AI.method: 构建 RoboBuilder 基准：智能体用标准零件、电机与一个自定义 3D 打印件共同设计机器人硬件与控制程序；仿真通过即被制造并在真实赛道测试。智能体可通过主动请求测量数据和真实运行视频来学习模拟器。评测 4 个前沿编码智能体、10 个障碍 × 3 难度，共 16,427 次仿真（12,774 个不同机器人）与 135 个实物机器人（约 240 小时）。
AI.result: 仅凭公开零件数据，15 个初始仿真通过的方案无一能通过真实赛道。智能体几乎解决所有简单障碍，并能发明搜索基线达不到的机构；但在高难度、单一机器人需跨越所有障碍、以及现实世界中表现不佳——各难度下仿真通过率仅 66% 在实物上成立。闭环反馈有效：向智能体展示自身真实失败视频后，它会重新设计（有时会修正其模拟器），消除 72% 的 level-1/2 失败。
AI.conclusion: RoboBuilder 揭示了 sim-to-real 差距是当前智能体工程设计的主要瓶颈，并表明"实物失败视频反馈"的闭环迭代是有效改进路径，为衡量智能体走向真实机械工程能力提供了可量化基准。

title: CoScan: Multi-Scale Content-Adaptive Space-Filling Scans for Causal State-Space Image Restoration
summary: Selective state-space models (SSMs) have recently shown strong potential for efficient image restoration. A central difficulty, however, is that a 2D feature map typically needs to be linearized into a 1D token sequence for causal state-space updates, making restoration performance highly sensitive to the imposed scan order. Existing deterministic scans follow space-filling principles but remain fixed and content-agnostic, and can yield fragmented or semantically inconsistent contexts under degradations. We propose \textbf{CoScan}, a \textbf{co}ntent-adaptive \textbf{scan}-order design for causal vision SSMs. CoScan learns image-dependent space-filling traversals via differentiable proxy supervision driven by \textbf{scan-quality objectives} that \textit{encourage short-range coherence and causal predictability, while preserving spatial adjacency}. To support hierarchical restoration backbones, we introduce an \textbf{efficient multi-scale scan construction by coarsening a fine-level minimum spanning tree}, producing coherent scans across feature resolutions. In addition, a \textbf{frequency-guided start selection strategy} is designed to \textit{place informative structures early in the sequence prefix to strengthen causal context formation}. Plugged into existing Mamba-based backbones, CoScan yields consistent improvements across several restoration benchmarks with minimal overhead and shows promising results on high-level vision tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/dongw22/CoScan

AI.tldr: CoScan：面向因果视觉状态空间模型的内容自适应扫描顺序设计，通过可微代理监督学习图像相关的空间填充遍历，并配合多尺度扫描构造与频率引导起点选择，在多种修复基准上以极小开销取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 选择性状态空间模型（SSM）用于图像修复时需将2D特征图线性化为1D序列进行因果更新，导致性能高度依赖扫描顺序。现有确定性扫描遵循空间填充原则但固定且与内容无关，在退化图像下易产生碎片化或语义不一致的上下文。
AI.method: 提出CoScan内容自适应扫描顺序。1）通过可微代理监督学习图像依赖的空间填充遍历，监督由扫描质量目标驱动，鼓励短程连贯性与因果可预测性，同时保持空间邻接；2）通过对细粒度最小生成树粗化实现高效多尺度扫描构造，支持层级修复主干；3）频率引导起始点选择策略，将信息丰富结构置于序列前缀以强化因果上下文形成。
AI.result: 嵌入现有Mamba类主干后，在多个修复基准上取得一致提升且开销极小，并在高层视觉任务上展现潜力。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应的扫描顺序是提升因果视觉SSM修复性能的有效方向，CoScan以轻量方式实现，具备良好通用性，代码将于GitHub开源。

title: EEG2MCU: Sensing-to-Execution Co-Design for Wearable EEG Inference
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at DATE 2027
summary: Wearable EEG inference is constrained not only by model size, but also by the channel-dependent sensing front end that must process high-dimensional inputs before compact downstream computation. We present EEG2MCU, a sensing-to-execution co-design framework that treats electrode count as a hardware design variable through task-aware montage selection. EEG2MCU retains a compact time-frequency representation and generates only the INT8 regions required by each first-layer tile, avoiding full input materialization. Halo reuse and access-aware placement across Flash, SRAM, and tightly coupled memory further reduce redundant generation and data movement. On a Cortex-M7 MCU, EEG2MCU reduces peak SRAM by 11.38x relative to the baseline, including a 1.71x reduction from the 62-to-19 electrode montage, while reducing latency by 2.57x and energy by 2.48x. It retains 94-96% of full-montage accuracy, demonstrating practical high-dimensional EEG inference under tight embedded-resource constraints.

AI.tldr: EEG2MCU 提出一种从传感前端到执行端的协同设计框架，将电极数量作为硬件设计变量，通过任务感知的导联（montage）选择、按需 INT8 时频区域生成、halo 复用与跨 Flash/SRAM/TCM 的访问感知布局，在 Cortex-M7 MCU 上实现高维 EEG 推理，峰值 SRAM 降低 11.38 倍、延迟降低 2.57 倍、能耗降低 2.48 倍，并保留 94–96% 全导联精度。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 EEG 推理的瓶颈不只在模型规模，还在于与通道数相关的传感前端必须先处理高维输入，再交给紧凑的下游计算；因此需要同时优化传感与执行两端，而非仅压缩模型。
AI.method: 以电极数量作为硬件设计变量，进行任务感知的导联选择；保留紧凑时频表示，仅生成第一层每个 tile 所需的 INT8 区域，避免完整输入物化；采用 halo 复用与访问感知的 Flash/SRAM/TCM 放置策略，减少冗余生成与数据搬运。
AI.result: 在 Cortex-M7 上，相比基线峰值 SRAM 降低 11.38 倍（其中 62→19 电极导联贡献 1.71 倍），延迟降低 2.57 倍，能耗降低 2.48 倍，并保留全导联精度的 94–96%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明在严格嵌入式资源约束下进行高维 EEG 推理是可行的，传感-执行协同设计（尤其是导联选择与按需计算）是提升可穿戴 EEG 部署效率的关键手段。

title: The Illusion of Relief: How GenAI Redistributes Cognitive Workload in Software Organizations
comment: Accepted for 20th International Scientific Conference on Industrial Systems - IS'26
summary: This study explores how Generative AI (GenAI) reshapes software practitioners' cognitive work across software development activities. We analyzed questionnaire responses from 44 practitioners across nine organizations using descriptive quantitative methods and qualitative analysis of relevant open-ended responses. Practitioners reported productivity and time savings, but also effort associated with providing context, prompting, reviewing, correcting, verifying, and integrating AI-generated outputs. Human judgment and accountability remained central, with practitioners anticipating a shift from direct code production to guiding, evaluating, validating, integrating, and coordinating AI-supported work. Thus, GenAI appears to redistribute cognitive work toward oversight rather than simply eliminate it, although whether overall cognitive workload increases or decreases remains undetermined.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI并未简单消除软件开发者的认知工作，而是将其重新分配到监督、审查与整合等环节，整体认知负荷是增是减尚不确定。
AI.motivation: 探讨生成式AI（GenAI）如何重塑软件从业者在各类开发活动中的认知工作，厘清其对工作效率与认知负荷的真实影响。
AI.method: 对来自9家组织的44名从业者进行问卷调查，采用描述性定量方法，并对相关开放式回答进行定性分析。
AI.result: 从业者报告了生产力提升与时间节省，但同时也需投入精力提供上下文、编写提示、审查、纠错、验证及整合AI生成内容；人的判断与问责仍然核心，从业者预期工作重心将从直接写代码转向引导、评估、验证、整合与协调AI支持的工作。
AI.conclusion: GenAI将认知工作转向监督而非简单消除，但整体认知负荷是否增加仍无法确定。

title: Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190
summary: This research investigates whether a large language model or an autonomous AI Agent performs better at translating from English to Arabic, which is considered a low-resource language. The authors introduce WikiEn-Ar190, a new dataset of 190 carefully selected Wikipedia articles from 18 different areas, which were created and verified by two native Arabic speakers to ensure that they accurately reflect both meaning and style. Using this dataset, the study evaluates the translation quality of GPT-5-mini both as an independent neural translator and when used within a more complex process that includes self-assessment and improvement. As a standalone model, GPT-5-mini produced very fluent translations , achieving a COMET score of 0.8649 and receiving high human scores for adequacy, fluency, and style (averaging 4.53 out of 5). When used in a system that combined translation with self-assessment, it improved lexical accuracy by 28.76% (BLEU score of 22.83) while maintaining a similar level of semantic quality. These findings show that methods involving autonomous reasoning can improve translation consistency for language pairs with limited resources. Beyond the results, the approach offers a framework for evaluating and improving translations, potentially using them as assisting tools to expand the representation of low resource languages, such as Arabic, on the web.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型与自主AI Agent在英译阿（低资源语言）翻译任务上的表现，提出新数据集WikiEn-Ar190并评估GPT-5-mini的翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语属低资源语言，缺乏高质量评测数据集与评估框架，需探究自主AI Agent能否提升英阿翻译质量与一致性。
AI.method: 构建WikiEn-Ar190数据集（190篇覆盖18个领域的维基百科文章，由两位阿拉伯语母语者创建与校验以兼顾语义与风格）；将GPT-5-mini分别作为独立神经翻译器和"翻译—自评—改进"的自主Agent流程进行对比评测，采用COMET、BLEU及人工评分（充分性、流畅性、风格）。
AI.result: 独立模式下GPT-5-mini翻译流畅度高，COMET 0.8649，人工评分平均4.53/5；Agent模式词法准确率提升28.76%（BLEU 22.83），语义质量基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 含自主推理的方法可提升低资源语言对的翻译一致性与质量，所提框架可推广至翻译评测与改进，并助力扩展阿拉伯语等低资源语言在网络上的代表性。

title: Asking but Missing: Decision Coverage in Natural-Language Data Querying
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to translate natural language questions about structured data into executable programs. A fundamental challenge is recognizing when a question admits multiple computational interpretations and identifying the decisions needed to resolve them. We investigate whether language models recognize these unresolved decisions before generating code, or silently adopt assumptions that may lead to incorrect results. We refer to the latter behavior as Underspecified Decision Completion (UDC). To distinguish different causes of UDC, we introduce Grounded Code Generation (GCG), a diagnostic protocol that separates the identification of unresolved decisions, their resolution using evidence, and their translation into executable code. By examining each stage separately, we can determine where the decisions responsible for incorrect results were first missed or mishandled. We evaluate this framework on BIRD-Pandas with twelve models. The results show that answering clarification questions consistently improves execution accuracy, yet substantial errors remain. Our findings suggest that the main difficulty lies not in answering clarification questions, but in recognizing which questions need to be asked in the first place.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"欠规格决策补全"(UDC)概念与"接地代码生成"(GCG)诊断协议，发现LLM的主要困难不在于回答澄清问题，而在于识别哪些问题需要被提出。
AI.motivation: LLM将自然语言问题翻译为可执行程序时，一个根本挑战是识别问题存在多种计算解释，并找出消解歧义所需的决策。作者想探究：模型在生成代码前是否能意识到这些未决决策，还是会默默采用假设而导致错误结果。
AI.method: 定义UDC行为，并提出GCG诊断协议，将流程拆分为三个阶段：识别未决决策、利用证据进行决策消解、翻译为可执行代码。分阶段检查可定位错误首次被遗漏或误处理的环节。在BIRD-Pandas数据集上用12个模型评估。
AI.result: 回答澄清问题能持续提升执行准确率，但仍存在大量错误；模型在回答澄清问题上表现尚可，真正瓶颈在于识别哪些澄清问题需要被提出。
AI.conclusion: LLM的主要失败根源是未决决策的识别，而非决策的求解；应着力提升模型对歧义与未决决策的觉察能力。

title: Do 3D Point Representations Encode Architectural Functions? Probing Supervised and Pretrained Models on Urban Facades
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Semantic labels say what a building element is, not what it does: two identical-looking windows on one facade may be operable or fixed, a column may carry load or only decorate. We ask whether 3D point representations encode such architectural function. On 22 mobile-LiDAR buildings with 15 functional attributes per element, we hold out entire buildings and compare hand-crafted descriptors, networks trained from scratch and frozen self-supervised point transformers. Descriptors and frozen features are read by the same linear layer. No network trained from scratch, from PointNet to a 108M-parameter PTv3, clearly exceeds the descriptors (0.610 mAP on functionally ambiguous elements), whereas frozen Utonia reaches 0.732. Random-weight controls of the same architectures (0.649 and 0.652) attribute the gain to pretraining (Utonia: +0.080, 95% building interval [+0.035, +0.124]). Pretrained features improve at every tested number of labelled buildings while descriptors and random features plateau, and, in the configurations we tested, fine-tuning erodes the benefit: at today's data scale, function is better read from pretrained representations than learned from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文探究3D点表示是否编码建筑构件的"功能"信息。通过跨建筑留出评估，发现预训练自监督点云Transformer（Utonia）冻结特征在下游线性探测中显著优于手工描述子和从头训练网络，说明当前数据规模下功能更适合从预训练表示中读取。
AI.motivation: 语义标签只说明建筑构件"是什么"，而非"做什么"：外观相同的两扇窗可能一个是可开启、一个是固定，柱子可能承重也可能只是装饰。因此需要验证3D点表示是否蕴含这类架构功能信息。
AI.method: 在22栋移动LiDAR建筑上，为每个构件标注15个功能属性，留出整栋建筑做泛化评估；对比手工描述子、从头训练网络（PointNet到108M参数PTv3）与冻结自监督点Transformer，二者都用同一线性层读取；并设置随机权重对照，隔离预训练的作用。
AI.result: 功能模糊元素上描述子为0.610 mAP，从头训练网络均未明显超越；冻结Utonia达0.732。随机权重对照（0.649/0.652）表明增益来自预训练（Utonia +0.080，95%建筑区间[+0.035,+0.124]）；预训练特征随标注建筑数增加持续提升，而描述子与随机特征趋于饱和；微调反而削弱该优势。
AI.conclusion: 在现有数据规模下，建筑功能信息更适合从预训练点云表示中读取而非从头学习，预训练是获取功能信息的关键。

title: Agent Verifiers in Counterfactual Analysis: A Pilot Study Benchmarking Agentic Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Agents can expand the covariate space of randomized experiments by retrieving fast-moving local context missed by slow-changing survey baseline covariates, helping characterize who benefits most from an intervention. Verifying such covariates is difficult: individual treatment effects are unobserved, retrieval leakage can pull post-treatment information into nominally pretreatment summaries, and encoder leakage can inject post-treatment pretraining knowledge into representations even after temporal filtering of inputs. Guided by a two-channel information bound separating summary provenance from encoder weights, we propose a three-layer benchmark protocol: (i) retrieval admissibility via pre-treatment date filtering; (ii) heterogeneity validation scored rank-weighted average treatment effects (RATEs); and (iii) encoder admissibility checked with chronologically vintaged encoders, future-fact probes, and weight perturbations. Across 11 datasets anchored by Uganda's Youth Opportunities Program, we compare session-isolated retrieval (sandboxed, bounded-budget agent runs per study) against a persistent workspace teammate (xAI's GrokBot) that builds one date-verified corpus per study while blinded to outcomes. The workspace teammate yields higher mean RATE ratios in 6/11 datasets for text alone and 7 for combined features, though paired tests show neither workflow universally dominates. Even on fixed retrieved text, encoder choice significantly shifts heterogeneity signal. Chronologically vintaged probes show no clear evidence of weight leakage, but single-record adapter perturbation analyses show that memorized future facts, once present, persist until injected noise degrades model output. Temporal filtering of retrieval is necessary but insufficient: verifying agent-generated covariates requires jointly examining source provenance, out-of-sample treatment-effect signal, and encoder weights.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个三层基准协议（检索可准入性、异质性RATE验证、编码器可准入性），在11个数据集上比较"会话隔离检索"与"持久工作区智能体"两种智能体工作流，发现工作区智能体在多数数据集上获得更高RATE比值但无普遍优势，且时序过滤虽必要但不充分——验证智能体生成协变量需同时审查数据来源、样本外处理效应信号与编码器权重。
AI.motivation: 智能体可通过检索快速变化的本地情境来扩展随机实验的协变量空间，从而刻画谁最能从干预中获益。但这类协变量极难验证：个体处理效应不可观测；检索泄漏可能把处理后信息带入名义上的前处理摘要；编码器泄漏则可能在输入经时间过滤后仍通过预训练权重注入处理后知识。
AI.method: 以"摘要来源与编码器权重"两通道信息界为指导，设计三层基准协议：(i) 通过前处理日期过滤检验检索可准入性；(ii) 用rank-weighted平均处理效应(RATE)评估异质性；(iii) 用按时间切片的编码器、未来事实探针和权重扰动检验编码器可准入性。在含乌干达青年机会项目在内的11个数据集上，比较会话隔离检索（沙箱、有界预算）与持久工作区队友（xAI的GrokBot，对结果盲测、构建日期核实语料）。
AI.result: 工作区队友在纯文本特征下6/11数据集、组合特征下7/11数据集取得更高平均RATE比值，但配对检验显示两种工作流均无普遍优势。即使使用固定的检索文本，编码器选择也显著改变异质性信号。按时间切片的探针未发现明确的权重泄漏证据，但单记录适配器扰动分析表明：一旦记忆了未来事实，该信息会持续存在，直到注入噪声使模型输出退化。
AI.conclusion: 检索的时序过滤是必要但不充分的；验证智能体生成的协变量必须联合考察来源溯源、样本外处理效应信号与编码器权重三方面。

title: Decided or Open? Comparing Program Repair Techniques When Patch Correctness Is Unknown
comment: 40 pages. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Also available at Research Square, doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11480796/v1. Replication package: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23590962
summary: Comparisons of automated program repair (APR) techniques depend on knowing which patches are correct, but many patches are never checked and some archived test results are wrong. We propose reporting each comparison as decided or open. For two techniques that each pick one patch per bug, we compute the full range of the difference in their success rates over every possible value of the unknown labels, and we call the comparison decided when that range excludes zero. Because a test can only show that a patch is wrong, more testing can move this range in one direction only. This lets us tell, before any test runs, which open comparisons testing could never settle. We study eight settings, including 55,466 candidate patches for Defects4J bugs. The labels already in the archive decide 12 of 16 comparisons between a learned patch selector and its baselines, and adding further evidence decides all 16. In a campaign whose predictions we published in advance, all eight predictions held. We also show that copies of the developer's fix, which must pass, are recorded as failing for 33.5% of GPT-4's copies but for only 2.5% of the RepairLLaMA model's, so the reliability of archived test results differs between models. With these checks, researchers can see which comparisons need more evidence and which kind of evidence can help.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将APR技术对比结果分为"已判定(decided)"与"待定(open)"，基于未知标签的极值计算成功率差的完整范围，仅在范围不含零时判定；并利用测试只能单向移动范围的性质，预判哪些待定对比永远无法靠测试解决。
AI.motivation: APR技术对比依赖"补丁是否正确"的标签，但大量补丁从未被检验，归档测试结果也有错误，导致对比结论不可靠。需要一种能诚实标注结论不确定性、并指导何时该补充证据的评估框架。
AI.method: 针对两种技术每bug各选一个补丁的情形，在所有未知标签可能取值下计算成功率差的完整范围，范围排除零即判为decided；利用测试只能证明补丁错误这一单调性，测试前即可识别无论多少测试都无法解决的可疑对比。在8个设置（含Defects4J 55,466个候选补丁）上开展评估，并做预注册的预测验证campaign，同时分析开发者修复副本的归档测试失败率。
AI.result: 归档标签已判定学习型补丁选择器与其基线16项对比中的12项，补充证据后16项全部判定；预注册的8项预测全部成立。开发者修复副本须通过却被记为失败的比例：GPT-4为33.5%，RepairLLaMA仅2.5%，说明不同模型的归档测试可靠性存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架让研究者明确哪些对比需要更多证据、以及哪类证据有效，提升APR评测的严谨性与可复现性，并揭示归档测试结果可靠性因模型而异。

title: Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the performance of Large Language Models by eliciting intermediate reasoning steps. However, CoT is far from perfect: on some tasks, models perform worse than with direct-answer prompting, and on others they generate a few hundred tokens to reach the correct answer. We start by labelling each CoT hidden state as recovering if patching it into the direct prompt yields the correct answer, and failed otherwise. A linear probe shows that the model encodes these two classes differently. We then show that the representation space of the direct prompt holds a direction for each question that leads the model, in a short generation, to the correct answer more often than CoT does. Specifically, we rotate the direct prompt's last hidden state once, before generation, towards a direction built for each question from its own recovering and failed states. Across 25 tasks, these directions raise the direct prompt's mean accuracy from $46\%$ to $85\%$ on LLaMA 3.1 8B (CoT: $69\%$) and from $52\%$ to $86\%$ on Qwen 2.5 7B (CoT: $77\%$), with a tenth of CoT's tokens. CoT is thus not the shortest route to this accuracy, and these directions can be used in future work to train models to align their states with them.

AI.tldr: 通过线性探针发现CoT隐藏状态可区分"可恢复/失败"两类，并为每题构造直接提示表示空间中的方向，旋转末层隐藏状态后以1/10 token量显著超越CoT准确率。
AI.motivation: CoT虽提升推理但存在缺陷：部分任务不如直接回答，且需数百token。作者想探究模型内部是否已编码正确解，从而寻找比CoT更短的路径。
AI.method: 将每个CoT隐藏状态patch进直接提示，标注为recovering（得正确答案）或failed；用线性探针验证两类可区分。随后利用每题自身的recovering与failed状态构造一个方向，在生成前对直接提示最后一层隐藏状态做一次旋转。
AI.result: 25个任务上，LLaMA 3.1 8B平均准确率由46%升至85%（CoT 69%），Qwen 2.5 7B由52%升至86%（CoT 77%），token量仅为CoT的十分之一。
AI.conclusion: CoT并非达到该准确率的最短路径；所构造的方向可用于未来训练模型对齐其内部状态。

title: Risk-Controlled Correction for Frozen Multimodal Models under Missing Modalities
summary: A deployed multimodal predictor may face missing modalities after its weights can no longer be changed. This raises a question that training-time repair does not answer: what part of the resulting error is still correctable from the information that remains? We show that this part is characterized by the Bayes gap, the difference between the model's prediction and the Bayes prediction given the observed modalities. For cross-entropy and squared error, excess risk measures this gap in the geometry of the loss; ambiguity in the observed modalities cannot be removed. Thus, a badly degraded prediction is not necessarily a correctable one. Estimating the Bayes prediction normally requires labels. However, when a model observing more modalities is conditionally correct, averaging its outputs conditional on the remaining modalities recovers this target without retrieval labels; with the same fixed blend and neighbors, it is no worse in expected cross-entropy or Brier risk than averaging hard labels. Some such assumption is unavoidable: otherwise the target is not identifiable from unlabeled data alone. GUARD (Gated Utility-Aware Recalibration for Deployment) leaves the deployed predictor unchanged. It estimates a candidate correction by retrieval, learns from deployment-matched labeled data when correction is likely to help, and calibrates a threshold on a held-out split by conformal risk control. Under exchangeability, the marginal probability that GUARD applies a correction whose loss increase exceeds a prescribed tolerance is bounded by a preset level, regardless of the learned score. In controlled experiments, correction gain follows headroom rather than raw error; across nine frozen model-dataset pairs spanning six domains, GUARD retains most of blanket correction's gain within harm budgets that blanket correction often exceeds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Bayes gap"框架，刻画部署后多模态模型缺失模态时误差中仍可纠正的部分，并给出无标签条件下估计该目标的方法GUARD，实现有风险保证的门控校正。
AI.motivation: 模型权重冻结后遇到缺失模态输入，训练时修复手段失效。关键问题：剩余误差中哪部分是仅凭现有信息仍可纠正的？直觉上误差大就应纠正，但论文指出退化严重的预测未必可纠正，需要区分"损失几何中的可纠正部分"与"观测模态本身固有的模糊性"。
AI.method: 1) 定义Bayes gap：模型预测与给定观测模态下Bayes预测之差，交叉熵/平方误差下超额风险即度量该差距。2) 若无检索标签，可用一个观测更多模态且条件正确的模型，在剩余模态上条件平均来恢复Bayes预测目标（固定混合与邻居时，期望交叉熵/Brier风险不劣于平均硬标签）；并证明若不作此类假设目标不可识别。3) GUARD：不改动原预测器，通过检索估计候选校正，用与部署匹配的有标签数据学习"校正是否有用"的打分，再用保形风险控制在留出集上校准阈值。
AI.result: 在可交换性假设下，无论学到的打分如何，GUARD施加"损失增量超过容差"的校正的边际概率被预设水平界住。受控实验中，校正收益跟随headroom而非原始误差；在覆盖六个领域的九个冻结模型-数据集对上，GUARD在伤害预算内保留了大范围（blanket）校正的大部分收益，而后者常超出该预算。
AI.conclusion: 部署后缺失模态的可纠正性应被视为"headroom"问题而非"误差大小"问题；Bayes gap提供了理论刻画，GUARD提供了带风险保证、即插即用的实用方案。

title: GTA: Generative Tower of Agents for Scalable Holonic Scene Generation
summary: Scalable world modeling requires coordinating scene-wide goals with fine-grained objects and dynamic characters under limited time and context budgets. We introduce GTA (Generative Tower of Agents), which represents every unit at every level of an adaptive scene hierarchy as a holon, both a self-contained construction task and a composable scene unit. Parallel agents recursively plan the hierarchy top-down, generate assets, and assemble and refine them bottom-up. Uniform interfaces carry scene-wide requirements down the hierarchy, guiding local construction so that each holon fits into the larger one. GTA accelerates scalable world modeling through high-throughput parallel execution while preserving well-structured layouts and fine-grained asset details. GTA then populates the assembled environments with dynamic human characters whose appearance and motion are guided by the scene, yielding realized 4D worlds. Project page: https://zt-zeng-tao.github.io/GTA/

AI.tldr: GTA提出"生成式智能体塔"框架，将自适应场景层级中每个单元建模为holon（既是独立构建任务又是可组合场景单元），通过并行智能体自顶向下递归规划、自底向上生成与精炼，并结合场景引导的动态人物生成，实现高吞吐、结构良好且细节丰富的4D世界建模。
AI.motivation: 可扩展世界建模需在有限时间和上下文预算下，协调场景级目标与细粒度物体及动态角色，现有方法难以兼顾全局布局结构与局部资产细节。
AI.method: 引入holon概念统一表示各层级单元；并行智能体自顶向下递归规划层级，生成资产后自底向上装配与精炼；统一接口将场景级需求沿层级下传以引导局部构建；最后在装配环境中填充受场景引导外观与运动的动态人物。
AI.result: 实现高吞吐的并行执行，加速可扩展世界建模，同时保持结构良好的布局与细粒度资产细节，并生成具有动态人物的4D世界。
AI.conclusion: GTA通过层级化holon表示与双向并行智能体协作，有效平衡全局一致性与局部细节，为可扩展4D世界建模提供了可行框架。

title: What Interpolators Store and What They Express: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Benign Overfitting and Label-Free Model Selection
summary: Overparameterized learners can fit noisy training labels perfectly and still predict well, which neither classical complexity measures nor information-theoretic generalization bounds explain. We develop an information-theoretic framework that separates two things an interpolating learner does with its sample: storage, the information the trained model retains about its training labels, and expression, the information about the sample that reaches its predictions at fresh inputs. We first characterize the ideal model: for a loss l, the least complex l-sufficient representation is the Bayes act, whose entropy is the minimal sufficient complexity; this generalizes, and corrects, an earlier "lossless maximal compression" view of boosting. We then show that every interpolator stores exactly nH(Y|X) bits of label noise, so storage, and bounds built on it (including CMI bounds), cannot tell interpolators apart. Expression can: excess risk is bounded above and below by the expressed information V, the entropy over training samples of the prediction at an input, plus a modal-bias term, exactly so for binary labels. Benign overfitting is therefore vanishing expression, a picture that covers nearest-neighbour rules, averaging, minimum-norm least squares and double descent, and that links V to classical bias-variance decompositions and to model disagreement. Finally, V gives a model-selection criterion that needs no held-out labels. Among overparameterized learners on 15 noisy datasets, V estimated from two disjoint halves has 60% less regret than holdout validation at the same cost and matches 5-fold cross-validation at a quarter of its cost; at matched cost it also beats selection by conditional mutual information. We characterize when it fails and give remedies. Code: https://github.com/nnikolaou/GLMC

AI.tldr: 提出"存储(storage)与表达(expression)"分离的信息论框架，证明所有插值器存储的噪声信息相同，而"表达信息V"能上下界超额风险并作为无需留出标签的模型选择准则。
AI.motivation: 过参数化模型能完美拟合噪声标签却仍泛化良好，经典复杂度度量和信息论泛化界都无法解释这一"良性过拟合"现象；现有基于存储（如CMI）的界对插值器完全无区分力。
AI.method: 将插值学习器作用于样本的信息分为存储（模型保留的训练标签信息）与表达（到达新输入预测的样本信息）；刻画最小复杂度l-充分表示即Bayes act；证明插值器恰好存储nH(Y|X)比特；以表达信息V（输入处预测在训练样本上的熵）加上模态偏差项给出超额风险上下界；据此构造无留出标签的模型选择准则。
AI.result: 良性过拟合等价于表达趋于零，可覆盖最近邻、平均、最小范数最小二乘与双下降；V与偏差-方差分解及模型不一致性相联系。在15个噪声数据集上，用两个不相交半集估计的V在同成本下比留出验证后悔低60%，以1/4成本匹配5折交叉验证，并优于CMI选择；也刻画了失效情形并给出补救措施。
AI.conclusion: 泛化能力的区分关键在于"表达"而非"存储"，V是解释良性过拟合的统一理论量，同时是实用、低成本、无需标签的模型选择准则。

title: An Empirical Study of Visual Artifacts in Pull Request Descriptions
summary: Reviewers rely on pull request (PR) descriptions to understand what a change does, yet some changes, such as UI updates or runtime behavior, are hard to convey in text alone. PR authors attach visual artifacts to fill this gap, but how often they do so, what they show, and whether they change how a PR is reviewed remain unknown. We present a large-scale study of visual artifacts in GitHub PR descriptions. From 6,505,113 closed PRs in 5,012 repositories, we built VisPR, a dataset of 2,473,892 English, human-authored PRs from 647 repos where visual artifacts are an established practice. Of these, 329,185 (13.3%) are visual PRs, i.e., their descriptions contain at least one visual artifact (479,974 in total). By manually labeling a sample of 1,113 visual artifacts from 891 merged visual PRs, we derived two taxonomies: 11 content types capturing what developers show and six purposes capturing why they include visual artifacts. The dominant content type is Interaction & State, which shows how the interface responds to user actions. its share rises from 37.0% of images to 63.5% of GIFs and 79.7% of videos, whereas about a quarter of images (23.4%) show text such as logs, code, or error messages . Compared with 1,782 merged non-visual PRs matched on repository, PR type, and change size, visual PRs receive 43% more review comments and 17% more reviewers, and take 72% longer from first response to merge, time to merge and churn-normalized review efficiency do not differ significantly. LLM-assisted classification of 10,031 review comments in two groups shows that review centers on code in both, but comments on visual PRs address how the UI looks or behaves twice as often (6.4% vs.3.3%), and visual-output fixes after review are about four times as common (4.7% vs. 1.2% of PRs). Visual artifacts are thus associated with closer scrutiny of what users see, not with an overall faster review.

AI.tldr: 本文对GitHub PR描述中的视觉工件(截图/GIF/视频)进行大规模研究，构建VisPR数据集并分析其内容类型、用途及对评审的影响。
AI.motivation: PR作者常需借助视觉工件传达难以用文字描述的变更(如UI更新、运行时行为)，但其使用频率、展示内容和是否改变评审过程尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从5,012个仓库的6,505,113个已关闭PR中筛选出647个仓库的2,473,892个英文人工PR构建VisPR数据集；对891个已合并视觉PR的1,113个视觉工件人工标注，归纳出11种内容类型和6种用途；与1,782个匹配的已合并非视觉PR对比评审评论、评审人数、合并时长等；并用LLM辅助分类10,031条评审评论。
AI.result: 13.3%为视觉PR；主导内容类型为"交互与状态"(图片37.0%、GIF 63.5%、视频79.7%)，约23.4%的图片展示文本。视觉PR比非视觉PR多43%评审评论、多17%评审者，首次响应到合并时间长72%，但合并时长和churn归一化评审效率无显著差异；评论中针对UI外观/行为的情形约为两倍(6.4% vs 3.3%)，评审后视觉输出修复约四倍(4.7% vs 1.2%)。
AI.conclusion: 视觉工件与对用户可见内容的更严格审查相关，但并不带来整体更快的评审。

title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
summary: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.

AI.tldr: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 是一个总参数 35B、激活参数 3B 的混合专家扩散语言模型，支持思考模式生成，在多项智能体指标上领先，并实现高速生成。
AI.motivation: 推动扩散语言模型在智能体任务上的应用，兼顾生成质量、草稿与验证成本以及在受限内存下的部署效率。
AI.method: 将 Gated Delta Networks 适配到块扩散中，把已生成上下文循环记忆与当前块内双向 softmax 注意力结合；历史记忆读出与当前块 token 在共享 softmax 中竞争，配合可学习块大小校准及独立、零初始化的右上下文卷积分支。此外提出决策模型变体，一次去噪过程生成相关问题的答案。
AI.result: 在七项评估的智能体指标中均领先，SWE-bench Verified 达 73.6，Terminal-Bench 2.1 达 51.7；内部负载在单块 NVIDIA GB300、BF16、batch size 1 下达到 680 tokens/s。决策变体在 500 组内部集上将问题准确率从 90.37% 提升至 93.88%，全对组准确率从 65.4% 提升至 77.0%。
AI.conclusion: Clover 展示了 MoE 扩散语言模型在智能体任务上的强劲性能与高效部署潜力，其联合预测变体还能通过一次去噪提升多问题整体正确率。

title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
summary: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping.
