These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. A leader agent coordinates the proposals, and a Nash bargaining rule selects updates that balance progress across dimensions. Humans design the exam, review candidate changes and revise the curriculum between stages. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, EVA-RSI improves motion evaluation, with the largest gain on smoothness, and the gains carry over to defect types never seen during the run. On the dynamics subsets of public benchmarks, our evaluator achieves the highest observed scores among 21 tested models. As an RL reward, it increases generated motion and earns human preference. A data-selection pipeline incorporating it also increases motion.

AI.tldr: EVA-RSI：多智能体递进自改进框架，在无显式验证器、多维度冲突约束下提升视频评估器（尤其运动维度）能力。
AI.motivation: 视频评估器常忽略运动缺陷，限制生成视频质量。递归自改进（RSI）在数学/代码上因有可靠验证器、单一目标而成功，但视频评估缺少验证器，且需同时权衡物理、平滑度、动态性等多维度（此消彼长），故需探索新范式。
AI.method: 构建带构造性目标的固定代理考试：对视频施加时序反转、丢帧等受控编辑以自动生成监督信号，无需人工标注；少量人工标注真实视频用于锚定人类判断。每个维度配备一个LLM智能体提出改进，由leader智能体协调，并用Nash讨价还价规则选出跨维度均衡的更新。人类负责设计考试、审核候选改动并在阶段间调整课程。基线为Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.result: 运动评估显著提升（平滑度增益最大），并泛化到训练中未见的缺陷类型；在公开基准dynamics子集上，21个测试模型中取得最高观测分数。作为RL奖励可提升生成运动并获得人类偏好；数据筛选管线纳入后同样提升运动表现。
AI.conclusion: 在无验证器、多维度权衡条件下，结合构造性代理考试、多智能体提案与Nash均衡选择，可实现视频评估器的有效递进自改进，并向下游生成与数据筛选迁移收益。

title: GaussLearner: 3D Gaussian Primitives as Self-Regulating Continual Learners
summary: Continual learning of 3D Gaussian fields aims to maintain faithful reconstructions of the evolving world. However, directly fine-tuning an existing Gaussian field on new observations can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously reconstructed content. To address this challenge, existing methods employ selective local optimization, replay, or parameter regularization, yet still struggle to balance adaptation to scene changes with preservation of still-valid content. Our key insight is to view 3D Gaussian primitives themselves as self-regulating continual learners. Based on this insight, we introduce GaussLearner, which equips each Gaussian with a closed continual-learning loop connecting observation, self-regulation, and adaptation at the primitive level. At each novel state, GaussLearner first attributes pixel-wise inconsistencies in current observations to their contributing Gaussians. Each Gaussian then self-regulates through a learning weight that balances current observations against cross-state reliability. This weight governs both Gaussian parameter adaptation and optimizer memory refresh. As current inconsistencies are resolved, the adaptation outcome renews each Gaussian's reliability for future states. The resulting field is a globally coupled population of locally self-regulating learners. Across scenes from CL-Splats, WAT, and our CL-3D dataset, GaussLearner improves average PSNR by 3.41 dB over the strongest baseline. On CL-3D, it achieves the best reconstruction quality on both changed and unchanged views.

AI.tldr: GaussLearner将每个3D高斯原语视为自调节的持续学习器，通过原语级闭环（观测-自调节-适应）平衡场景变化适应与有效内容保持。
AI.motivation: 直接在新观测上微调3D高斯场会导致对已重建内容的灾难性遗忘；现有的局部优化、回放与参数正则化方法难以平衡适应场景变化与保留仍有效内容。
AI.method: 为每个高斯配备连接观测、自调节与适应的闭环：在新状态将像素级不一致归因到贡献的高斯；每个高斯通过平衡当前观测与跨状态可靠性的学习权重进行自调节，该权重同时控制高斯参数适应和优化器记忆刷新；不一致消解后，适应结果更新各高斯对后续状态的可靠性。
AI.result: 在CL-Splats、WAT及自建CL-3D数据集上，平均PSNR比最强基线提升3.41 dB；在CL-3D上对变化与未变化视角均取得最佳重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 把持续学习下沉到高斯原语级别、形成全局耦合的局部自调节学习器群体，可有效缓解遗忘并适配场景变化。

title: FairPGT: Partitioned Graph Transformers for Dual-Level Fair Graph Clustering
comment: Under review. 36 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/SiamakGhodsi/FairPGT
summary: Clustering on attributed graphs can produce demographically biased clusters, particularly when communities align with protected groups. Graph transformers can amplify this bias through same-group attention, while global attention limits scalability. We propose FairPGT, a partitioned graph transformer for fair graph clustering. FairPGT restricts attention to METIS partitions and connects them through routing tokens, which divides the quadratic cost of attention by the number of partitions. A graph-aware self-training target guides clustering, with a provably bounded deviation from the standard DEC target. Fairness is imposed at two levels: a mutual-information term promotes demographic parity in cluster assignments, while a normalized cross-group attention ratio (nCGAR) guides attention toward group neutrality through self-distillation. We prove that the nCGAR correction moves attention toward neutrality and establish a condition preventing overshooting. Across seven benchmarks, FairPGT achieves the best clustering performance and statistical parity on the three largest graphs (Credit, Pokec-n, Pokec-z), with a statistical-parity gap approximately ten times lower than DMoN, and is Pareto-dominated on only one dataset. On controlled stochastic block models, FairPGT attains 97% of the derived upper bound on NMI for exactly fair clustering when communities and protected groups coincide. These graphs further show that, under strong alignment, assignment-level fairness alone makes the attention group-heterophilous, whereas attention-level fairness alone improves neutrality without ensuring fair clusters. Code for reproducibility is available at https://github.com/SiamakGhodsi/FairPGT.

AI.tldr: 提出 FairPGT，一种分区图 Transformer，通过限制注意力到 METIS 分区并用路由 token 连接，在保证可扩展性的同时实现公平的图聚类，在多个基准上兼顾聚类质量与统计平权。
AI.motivation: 属性图聚类可能在社区与受保护群体重合时产生人口统计偏差，图 Transformer 会通过同组注意力放大这一偏差，而全局注意力又限制可扩展性。因此需要同时解决公平性与可扩展性的方法。
AI.method: FairPGT 将注意力限制在 METIS 分区内并用路由 token 连接各分区，把注意力二次成本按分区数分摊；采用图感知的自训练目标指导聚类（可证明其与标准 DEC 目标的偏差有界）；在两个层面施加公平：互信息项促进聚类分配的人口统计平权，归一化跨组注意力比（nCGAR）通过自蒸馏引导注意力趋向群体中立。作者证明 nCGAR 校正使注意力趋于中立，并给出防止过冲的条件。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，FairPGT 在三个最大图（Credit、Pokec-n、Pokec-z）上取得最佳聚类性能与统计平权，统计平权差距比 DMoN 低约一个数量级，且仅在一个数据集上被帕累托支配。在受控随机块模型上，当社区与受保护群体重合时，NMI 达到所推导的精确公平聚类上界的 97%；并表明强对齐下，仅分配层公平会使注意力变为群体异质，而仅注意力层公平可提升中立性但无法保证公平聚类。
AI.conclusion: FairPGT 通过在分区图 Transformer 中联合分配层与注意力层的公平约束，实现了可扩展且公平的图聚类，理论与实验均验证了两层公平机制的作用与必要性。

title: Monitoring Machine Learning Systems in Production: A Multivocal Literature Review
summary: Monitoring is essential for maintaining reliable machine learning (ML) systems after deployment. However, knowledge about its practical implementation and effectiveness remains fragmented across academic and gray literature. We present a multivocal literature review of 94 sources (37 academic and 57 gray) covering both traditional ML and generative AI systems. We develop taxonomies covering monitored objects and properties, techniques, input signals, tools, automation, frequency, evaluation, and challenges. Our findings reveal an imbalanced monitoring process. Existing approaches provide broad and largely automated support for observing system behavior, detecting problems, and communicating findings, while monitor configuration, investigation, and response retain substantial human involvement. Monitoring is concentrated on inference, with no source covering the entire production ML system, limiting end-to-end diagnosis. Evidence of effectiveness is also limited: among 78 sources presenting an approach or tool, 45 provide no formal evaluation, 24 report offline or controlled evaluations, and only nine evaluate monitoring in live production. This gap is particularly evident for generative AI, where evidence is dominated by gray literature and vendor claims. We propose six directions for improving monitor design, cross-layer diagnosis, proxy validation, corrective responses, production-oriented evaluation, and organizational practices. Our review provides a structured basis for improving the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of production ML problems.

AI.tldr: 本文对94份来源（37篇学术、57份灰色文献）做多声部文献综述，构建了监测对象、技术、工具、自动化、频率、评估与挑战等分类体系，发现生产ML监测存在过程失衡、集中于推理阶段及评估证据不足等问题，并提出六个改进方向。
AI.motivation: 部署后监测对维持ML系统可靠性至关重要，但关于其实际落地方式与有效性的知识分散在学术与灰色文献中，缺乏系统整合。
AI.method: 多声部文献综述（multivocal literature review），覆盖传统ML与生成式AI系统共94份来源，归纳出监测对象与属性、技术、输入信号、工具、自动化程度、频率、评估及挑战等分类体系。
AI.result: 监测过程存在失衡：观察行为、检测问题与沟通结果已有较广且较自动化的支持，而监测配置、调查与响应仍高度依赖人工；监测集中于推理环节，无来源覆盖整个生产ML系统，限制端到端诊断。78份提出方法或工具的来源中，45份无正式评估，24份为离线或受控评估，仅9份在生产环境中评估；生成式AI方面证据多来自灰色文献与厂商声明。
AI.conclusion: 提出六个改进方向：监测设计、跨层诊断、代理验证、纠正性响应、面向生产的评估与组织实践，为改进生产ML问题的检测、诊断与解决提供结构化基础。

title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
comment: 22 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Project page and blog: https://decisionplayground.agentscope.io/piccolo.html
summary: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

AI.tldr: Piccolo 是一系列 0.8B–27B 的多模态决策模型，通过 Agentic Data Engineering 与递归自我改进（RSI）实现模型能力与训练数据协同进化，在 Decision Index 榜单上取得领先成绩。
AI.motivation: 传统决策模型开发中，模型能力与训练数据往往割裂，缺乏自动化、可反馈迭代的数据工程流程。作者希望探索一种让模型与数据共同进化、可规模化扩展的数据驱动自我改进范式。
AI.method: 模型对候选答案输出概率，覆盖文本/视觉判断、agent harness、数据工作流和交互游戏等任务。研究代理负责分析模型行为、构造训练数据、开展实验，并依据结果改进后续方案；语义切片与共享研究记忆跨模型家族串联这些动作。训练配方包含数十万级样本，数据选择与反馈驱动精修构成自我改进核心。
AI.result: Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分登顶 Decision Index Vision Full 榜单，Piccolo-9B 与 Piccolo-4B 分别取得 68.35 和 67.46，三者在各自尺寸类别的 Private benchmark 上均排名第一。大规模 RSI 探索给出三点反直觉发现：(1) backbone-配方协同适配比模型新旧更重要；(2) 定向数据精修可使 4B–9B 模型在专门工作流上媲美 27B 基线；(3) 持续降低 loss 可能与离散决策准确率脱钩甚至损害准确率。
AI.conclusion: Piccolo 连同 Data-Juicer 与 AgentScope 生态开放权重与工具，为构建前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动 RSI 提供了可落地的蓝图。

title: Evaluating invariance training with certified answer-changing controls in neural graph algorithms
summary: Invariance training aims to make neural algorithmic reasoners robust to answer-preserving input changes and is judged by accuracy and by how rarely such edits change predictions. We ask whether this evaluation detects lost sensitivity to answer-changing edits on minimum spanning trees of synthetic graphs, where both directions can be certified. Attaching a subgraph through one bridge provably preserves every original label. Attaching it through two edges, oracle-selected to change a label, and lowering one weight inside the graph serve as answer-changing controls; a response is a changed prediction on an edge whose label changes. A reproduced graph transformer (GDT) within its published accuracy range changes a provably fixed label on 53.3-65.9% of the 64-vertex graphs it solves exactly after a 64-vertex bridge attachment; removing the connecting edge changes little. With 16-vertex graphs and attachments, three invariance objectives lower GDT violations from 2.91% to 0.52-2.02% of pairs at essentially unchanged accuracy. Training also lowers the response to two-edge attachments from 97.6% to 66.0-79.0%, while the response to in-base weight edits stays near 99.5%. At 64 vertices accuracy also falls, but on 16-vertex bases only the attachment control reveals the loss. A message-passing network loses some attachment response at small penalty weights but gains little invariance. Running the conventionally trained GDT on each biconnected block separately removes all observed violations and keeps accuracy and both responses, so the task does not force the trade-off. Sensitivity checks for trained invariance should include certified answer-changing edits that attach material as the training edits do.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验：不变性训练的评测（用准确率与保答编辑下的预测稳定性）是否能检测出模型对"改变答案"的编辑丧失了敏感性。作者在合成图的最小生成树上构造可证明的保答与变答编辑，发现常规训练的不变性目标会牺牲对变答编辑的响应性，而该权衡其实并非任务所强制。
AI.motivation: 现有不变性训练用"准确率"和"保答输入变化下预测是否稳定"来评判，但这两项无法发现模型是否同时变得对应当改变答案的编辑也变得不敏感（即丧失了应有的敏感性）。作者希望用双向都可认证的编辑来检验这一评测缺陷。
AI.method: 在合成图的最小生成树上设计可证明的编辑：1）用单桥接边附加子图，可证明所有原始标签不变；2）用两条（经 oracle 选择的）接边附加子图以改变某标签，作为变答对照；3）降低图内某条权重也作为变答对照。以"标签变化边上的预测是否改变"作为响应指标。在复现的图变换器 GDT 及消息传递网络上测试，并在 16 与 64 顶点图上比较三种不变性训练目标；另将常规训练的 GDT 按双连通块分别运行作为对照。
AI.result: GDT 在 64 顶点图上：单桥附加后，在被精确求解的图中 53.3–65.9% 出现可证明固定标签被改变，去掉连接边影响不大。16 顶点上三种不变性目标把违规率从 2.91% 降到 0.52–2.02%（准确率基本不变），但两接边附加的响应从 97.6% 降到 66.0–79.0%，而图内权重编辑响应仍近 99.5%。64 顶点时准确率也下降，但 16 顶点基图上只有附加对照能揭示这一损失。消息传递网络在小惩罚权重下损失部分附加响应但获益有限。按双连通块分别运行常规 GDT 可消除全部观察到的违规，同时保持准确率和两种响应。
AI.conclusion: 不变性训练的评测需要加入"认证的变答编辑"，且这些编辑应像训练编辑那样附加材料；否则不会发现模型丧失了应有的响应性。观察到的敏感性—不变性权衡并非任务本身所强制，可通过按双连通块分解处理来避免。

title: ACUS: An Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score for Incomplete-View CT
summary: Sparse-view and limited-arc computed tomography (CT) are commonly treated as projection completion: a network fills an unmeasured view, and the result is ranked by similarity to one ground-truth image. That score can be high even when the query angle is far from every acquired measurement, because a learned prior may invent anatomy the scan never constrained. Existing protocols therefore leave a basic question unanswered: how does predictive reliability change with distance from the acquired views? We propose the Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score (ACUS) to answer that question. ACUS is the Winkler interval score of a nominal 90% predictive interval on held-out projections, binned by distance to the nearest acquired view. It charges interval width and adds a large miss penalty when a held-out pixel falls outside the interval, so a narrow band helps only when coverage holds. We use collapse on acquired angles as a necessary consistency check on the predictor. On chest and dental cone-beam orbits, interval width grows with the angular gap. Empirical coverage ranges from 77% to 92%, and the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the point estimate falls as the width rises. Nearest-neighbor, interpolation, and point completion, each given one residual scale, have zero reported far coverage and incur outside-distance penalties. ACUS exposes gap-dependent overconfidence that a point-estimate PSNR alone does not measure.

AI.tldr: 提出角度校准不确定性评分ACUS，按到最近采集视角的距离分箱度量预测可靠性，揭示稀疏/有限弧CT中随角度间隙增大的过度自信问题。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角与有限弧CT常被当作投影补全任务，仅用与单一真值图像的相似度（如PSNR）评价，忽略了远离采集视角处先验可能"编造"解剖结构，无法回答预测可靠性随距离如何变化这一基本问题。
AI.method: ACUS定义为在留出投影上名义90%预测区间的Winkler区间分数，按到最近采集视角的角度距离分箱；同时惩罚区间宽度，并对落在区间外的像素施加大的miss惩罚；并以在采集角度上的"collapse"作为预测器的必要一致性检查。
AI.result: 在胸部与牙科锥束轨道上，区间宽度随角度间隙增大而增大；经验覆盖率在77%–92%之间，点估计PSNR随宽度上升而下降；最近邻、插值及点补全方法（各给定单一残差尺度）在远端报告覆盖率为零并受到距离外惩罚。
AI.conclusion: ACUS能暴露点估计PSNR无法衡量的、依赖角度间隙的过度自信；仅靠点估计相似度不足以评价稀疏/有限弧CT预测的可靠性。

title: Toaster: Nonlinear Memory from Cascaded Linear Memories and Target Propagation
summary: Recurrent memories let language models process long sequences with a fixed-size state. Linear memories such as DeltaNet and KDA store one matrix and take one delta-rule step per token. The product of a chunk of such steps has an exact WY form, so they train fast. Deep memories such as TTT-MLP and Titans store a small MLP, which can hold maps that no matrix can, but their update has no WY form. Toaster bridges the two by building on a known fact: a gradient step on a linear layer is a delta-rule write. It builds a two-layer nonlinear memory from two linear memories with an activation between them. We use target propagation to give the hidden memory its values by projecting the output error back through the second memory. Given a chunk's cross-layer signals, approximated once per chunk, each layer can then run on an unmodified delta-rule kernel. Our default runs this kernel on the output layer and updates the hidden layer once per chunk. Running it on both layers gives a better model in our ablation. At matched backbones and training-token budgets, Toaster has lower loss than KDA at all five tested sizes (0.2B-1.6B non-embedding parameters) on both C4 and PG19. Its C4 perplexity also matches or slightly improves on the attention baseline at every size. At 1.2B it is also below Titans. In a 3:1 hybrid with global attention, the Toaster hybrid has the lowest perplexity of the four hybrids tested, and it is 0.18 (C4) and 0.44 (PG19) below the attention baseline. At the largest size, Toaster's mean three-shot accuracy on 13 tasks is 51.84%, compared with 50.52% for KDA and 50.04% for Titans. In length extrapolation, Toaster's loss stays below KDA's up to 20K tokens (5x the training length). On the 145M backbone, at a hidden width matched to Titans' memory, Toaster takes at most 1.33x KDA's training-step time and is 2.8-5.5x faster than the tested Titans configurations at 32K context.

AI.tldr: Toaster 用两层线性记忆（中间加激活）构造深度记忆：借助 target propagation 将输出误差回传得到隐层目标，使每层都能用精确 WY 形式的 delta-rule 核快速训练，在 0.2B–1.6B 规模上损失低于 KDA/Titans，且接近甚至超过注意力基线。
AI.motivation: 线性循环记忆（DeltaNet、KDA）每 token 一步 delta 更新、chunk 内乘积有精确 WY 形式，训练高效但只能存一个矩阵，表达受限；深度记忆（TTT-MLP、Titans）可存 MLP、表达更强，但更新无 WY 形式，训练慢。作者希望兼得深度表达力与 WY 快速训练。
AI.method: 基于"线性层的一次梯度步即 delta-rule 写入"这一事实，用两个线性记忆叠加非线性激活构成两层非线性记忆；用 target propagation 将输出误差经第二层记忆投影回传，为隐层记忆提供目标值；chunk 内跨层信号只近似一次，于是各层可直接跑未修改的 delta-rule 核。默认配置：输出层用该核，隐层每 chunk 更新一次；消融中两层都用核效果更好。
AI.result: 相同骨干与 token 预算下，0.2B–1.6B（非嵌入参数）五个规模在 C4 和 PG19 上损失均低于 KDA；C4 困惑度在各规模与注意力基线持平或略优；1.2B 时也低于 Titans。3:1 全局注意力混合中，Toaster 混合在四种混合里困惑度最低，比注意力基线低 0.18（C4）/0.44（PG19）。最大规模 13 任务三样本平均准确率 51.84%（KDA 50.52%，Titans 50.04%）。长度外推优于 KDA 至 20K（训练长度 5 倍）。145M 骨干、隐宽匹配 Titans 时，训练步时不超过 KDA 的 1.33 倍，32K 上下文下比所测 Titans 配置快 2.8–5.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Toaster 以简单的两层线性记忆 + target propagation 组合，在保持 delta-rule 快速训练的同时获得深度记忆的表达能力，实验上在质量、混合架构、下游准确率、长度外推与效率上均优于线性与深度记忆基线，是一个高效的折中方案。

title: From Ambiguous Tickets to Ranked Hypotheses: Multi-Agent Root-Cause Analysis for Autonomous Heavy-Vehicle Software
summary: Autonomous haulage systems run safety-critical software on driverless mining trucks, with no onboard driver to detect or mitigate abnormal behavior. Every failure in testing or operation must therefore be traced to its root cause to keep the safety case valid and limit downtime. An investigation often starts from a sparse ticket containing an approximate timestamp, sometimes a suspected cause, and a multimodal vehicle recording of several gigabytes. We present a multi-agent root-cause analysis (RCA) workflow that turns this input into a telemetry-grounded event chain, ranked causal hypotheses, and candidate code locations. A suspected cause in the ticket, which could anchor the analysis on a false theory, goes to a single LLM analyst in a separate agent session. Non-neural tools select the relevant telemetry once, before analysis, and an LLM condenses it into shared evidence artifacts; this more than halved the cost per incident compared with per-analyst querying. Specialist analyst agents then apply established RCA techniques in parallel, including fault tree analysis, Kepner-Tregoe analysis, and call-chain tracing, and hypotheses that several LLM analysts reach independently rank higher. We evaluated the workflow on 12 held-out industrial incidents against a single agent with the same model and tools. It located the faulty file more often (10 vs. 8 cases) at higher cost. Two human domain experts accepted a top-three hypothesis in 4 and 9 cases, respectively. The gap, which two LLM judges did not resolve, shows that rating causal explanations is itself a hard evaluation problem.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体根因分析（RCA）工作流，将稀疏工单与多模态车辆记录转化为有遥测依据的事件链、排序的因果假设和候选代码位置，工业事故评测中定位故障文件优于单智能体但成本更高。
AI.motivation: 无人矿卡运行安全关键软件，车上无驾驶员可发现或缓解异常，因此测试或运营中的每次失败都必须追溯到根因以维持安全论证有效性并减少停机。而调查起点通常仅是含大致时间戳、有时含可疑原因的稀疏工单，加上数GB多模态车辆记录。
AI.method: 多智能体工作流：工单中的可疑原因交由独立会话中的单一LLM分析，避免锚定于错误理论；非神经工具在分析前一次性选取相关遥测，再由LLM浓缩为共享证据工件（相较每分析师各自查询使单次事故成本减半以上）；并行专家分析师分别应用故障树分析、Kepner-Tregoe分析和调用链追踪，多个LLM分析师独立得出的假设排名更高。
AI.result: 在12个留出的工业事故上，与使用同模型同工具的单智能体对比：找到故障文件的案例为10 vs 8，但成本更高。两位人类领域专家分别在其中4例和9例接受前三名假设。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体RCA在定位故障文件上优于单智能体基线但成本更高；人类专家之间的一致性差距（两个LLM评审也未能消解）表明，评价因果解释本身就是一个困难的评测问题。

title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
summary: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.

AI.tldr: 提出 CurvDelta 框架，将"能力保持"约束嵌入参数更新的参数化中，通过在预适应模型附近构造低曲率空间使更新几乎不改变保持损失；用 K-FAC 和因子化投影使其可扩展到 LLM，并给出低秩变体 CurvLoRA，用于能力学习与选择性遗忘任务。
AI.motivation: 适配 LLM 的核心难题是能力保持：适配在达成目标的同时可能损害通用能力。作者希望把保持约束直接写进更新参数化，而非仅作为后处理或正则项惩罚。
AI.method: 分析保持约束在预适应模型处的局部几何，构建"低曲率空间"，使其中参数更新对保持损失近似不变；用 Kronecker 因子近似曲率（K-FAC）与因子化投影降低计算/存储开销使方法适用于 LLM；并提出同一保持几何下的低秩变体 CurvLoRA 以提升效率。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成与知识遗忘三类任务上评估。前两者达到有竞争力的下游性能且更好地保持通用能力，取得更优的"获得—保持"权衡；在 TOFU 与 MUSE 上，定向遗忘与知识保持的平衡优于基线，保持性能接近从头重训的参考水平。
AI.conclusion: 将保持约束纳入更新参数化（低曲率子空间）是一种可扩展且有效的 LLM 适配范式，兼容能力学习与选择性遗忘，并可通过低秩设计兼顾效率。

title: Training-Free Domain Generation for One-Shot Federated Learning with Server-Side Pre-trained Diffusion Models
summary: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) has attracted increasing attention for its ability to substantially reduce communication overhead by limiting client-server interaction to a single communication round. Nevertheless, this limited interaction makes learning from heterogeneous client distributions challenging. Diffusion-based OSFL approaches seek to address this challenge by synthesizing data that approximate client distributions. However, existing diffusion-based approaches often impose substantial computational costs on clients and lack effective visual guidance to generate data aligned with client distributions. To address these limitations, we propose FedDoG, a training-free Domain Generation framework that leverages server-side pre-trained diffusion models to synthesize data aligned with client domains. FedDoG extracts compact domain representations using a frozen image encoder, substantially reducing client-side computational and communication costs. These representations are incorporated into the diffusion model through a pre-trained image-conditioning adapter, thereby providing explicit visual guidance for domain generation. To further improve the quality of synthetic data, FedDoG adapts the strength of visual conditioning according to domain concentration and filters generated samples based on class consistency and predictive entropy. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that FedDoG generates higher-quality synthetic images and outperforms existing OSFL baselines in classification accuracy. Meanwhile, FedDoG reduces client upload and computation time by 99.9% and 91.5%, respectively. The code is available at https://github.com/YXTong17/FedDoG.

AI.tldr: FedDoG是一种无需训练的领域生成框架，利用服务器端预训练扩散模型为一次性联邦学习合成与客户端领域对齐的数据，在提升分类精度的同时大幅降低客户端开销。
AI.motivation: 一次性联邦学习（OSFL）仅进行单轮通信以降低开销，但因交互受限难以应对客户端数据分布异构问题。现有基于扩散模型的OSFL方法虽尝试合成近似客户端分布的数据，却给客户端带来巨大计算成本，且缺乏有效的视觉引导来生成与客户端分布对齐的数据。
AI.method: 提出FedDoG：①用冻结图像编码器提取紧凑的领域表示，显著降低客户端计算与通信成本；②通过预训练图像条件适配器将表示注入扩散模型，提供显式视觉引导；③根据领域集中度自适应调节视觉条件强度；④基于类别一致性和预测熵对生成样本进行过滤。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，FedDoG生成的合成图像质量更高，分类精度优于现有OSFL基线；同时客户端上传量和计算时间分别减少99.9%和91.5%。
AI.conclusion: FedDoG通过服务器端训练无关的扩散生成与视觉引导，有效缓解OSFL中的数据异构问题，兼顾了合成数据质量、模型精度与低客户端开销，代码已开源。

title: Detect What You Need: Chain-of-Causal Reasoning for 3D Intent Grounding
summary: Accurately matching human intentions in 3D space is an important goal of artificial intelligence. Recently, 3D Intention Grounding (3D-IG) has emerged, aiming to localize target 3D objects given a natural-language intent. Unlike conventional visual grounding with descriptive referring expressions, 3D-IG intents are abstract and non-descriptive, making object localization substantially more challenging. This requires inferring latent functional requirements from non-descriptive intents and aligning them with object-level 3D representations. However, existing methods largely rely on implicit intent-object matching, leading to logical gaps and limited interpretability, robustness, and generalization. To address these challenges, we propose Chain-of-Causal Reasoning (CoCR), a causality-inspired functional dependency reasoning framework that explicitly bridges abstract intentions and candidate objects through intermediate functional requirements. Specifically, CoCR progressively decomposes complex intents into ordered functional requirements, thereby forming an explicit intent-function-object reasoning chain that links abstract intentions to object suitability. Building on this chain, we construct a causality-inspired functional dependency graph to model requirement-attribute relationships and introduce a causal-visual alignment module that aligns function-aware representations with the geometric-semantic features of 3D point clouds, enabling bidirectional verification between structured functional reasoning and visual evidence. Extensive experiments on 3D Intention Grounding and 3D Visual Grounding demonstrate that our method enhances intent-aware object localization. Our code is available at https://2490o.github.io/CoCR.

AI.tldr: 提出链式因果推理框架CoCR，通过显式意图-功能-物体推理链，解决3D意图定位中非描述性意图与物体匹配的难题。
AI.motivation: 3D意图定位(3D-IG)的意图抽象且非描述性，需从意图推断潜在功能需求并对齐物体级3D表示；现有方法依赖隐式意图-物体匹配，存在逻辑鸿沟，可解释性、鲁棒性和泛化性受限。
AI.method: CoCR将复杂意图逐步分解为有序功能需求，形成显式意图-功能-物体推理链；构建因果启发的功能依赖图建模需求-属性关系，并引入因果-视觉对齐模块，将功能感知表示与3D点云几何语义特征对齐，实现结构化功能推理与视觉证据的双向验证。
AI.result: 在3D意图定位和3D视觉定位任务上的大量实验表明，该方法提升了意图感知的物体定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式因果/功能推理 bridging 抽象意图与3D物体，CoCR提升了3D意图定位的可解释性与有效性。代码已开源。

title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

AI.tldr: COPD 用自然语言交流取代教师 logits，实现黑盒模型间的同策略蒸馏，使小模型在长程任务上获得大模型能力。
AI.motivation: 传统 on-policy distillation 依赖教师 logits，但纯文本黑盒模型不暴露 logits，导致强模型能力无法蒸馏给小模型。
AI.method: 学生自主决定何时向黑盒教师求助，并用开放式自然语言提问（无模板、无干预计划）；成功的师生交互作为特权参考，通过 on-policy self-distillation 监督无顾问的学生 rollout，并与任务奖励强化学习联合训练。
AI.result: 在 CAMG-II 上，COPD 的增益是最强黑盒 OPD 基线的 2.46 倍；所学能力可泛化到 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 SWE-Bench Pro V2，在无顾问访问下仍提升任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言通信可作为有效的蒸馏中介，替代 logits，使黑盒教师的能力可迁移且具备跨任务泛化性。

title: Ask the Peers: Ranking NFR Coverage Gaps for Requirements Review
comment: Pre-review version of a paper subsequently accepted for publication at PROFES 2026
summary: Missing or underrepresented non-functional requirements (NFR) categories leave little direct evidence in a requirements set, making them difficult to identify during requirements review. In this study, we frame NFR coverage-gap review as a project-level ranking task: given a target requirements specification, the goal is to rank the 11 PROMISE NFR categories for analyst inspection. We compare seven statistical, embedding-based, and large language model (LLM)-based configurations that differ in both ranking mechanism and evidence source, including target requirement statements, peer requirements, their semantic representation, and peer category statistics. We evaluate the configurations using controlled gap injection with leave-one-project-out evaluation on PROMISE, PROMISE+, PURE-Transport, and PURE-Business. Four configurations that use peer category statistics are effectively tied under complete removal (0.875-0.889 mean AUROC), despite different ranking mechanisms, and supplying those statistics to a direct LLM ranker produces the largest evidence gain. All configurations weaken when a category is present but underrepresented, and none is best for every NFR category. For count-changing category-level gaps, structured peer evidence matters more than ranker sophistication. The findings suggest that the rankings should guide analyst inspection rather than serve as automatic judgements of requirements completeness.

AI.tldr: 论文将NFR覆盖缺口审查建模为项目级排序任务：给定目标需求规格，对11个PROMISE NFR类别排序供分析师审查。比较7种统计/嵌入/LLM配置，在PROMISE、PROMISE+、PURE-Transport、PURE-Business上用受控缺口注入+留一项目评估。结果显示：使用同类项目类别统计的4种配置在完全移除场景下几乎持平（平均AUROC 0.875-0.889），但类别仅"欠代表"时性能均下降，且无单一最佳配置。
AI.motivation: 缺失或欠代表的NFR类别在需求集中留下的直接证据很少，使需求评审中难以识别这类覆盖缺口；作者希望将这一识别问题转化为可辅助分析师的排序问题来缓解证据稀缺。
AI.method: 将NFR覆盖缺口审查框架为项目级排序任务（对11个PROMISE NFR类别排序）；比较7种配置，差异在于排序机制（统计、嵌入、LLM）与证据来源（目标需求语句、同伴需求、语义表示、同伴类别统计）；采用受控缺口注入与留一项目交叉验证，在PROMISE、PROMISE+、PURE-Transport、PURE-Business四个数据集上评测。
AI.result: 完全移除类别时，4种使用同伴类别统计的配置表现基本持平（平均AUROC 0.875–0.889），尽管排序机制不同；将这些统计直接提供给LLM排序器带来的证据增益最大。当类别存在但欠代表时，所有配置性能均下降；没有任何配置在所有NFR类别上都最优。对改变计数的类别级缺口，结构化同伴证据比排序器复杂度更重要。
AI.conclusion: 排序结果应作为分析师审查的引导，而非自动判定需求完整性；对于计数变化的类别级缺口，结构化的同伴项目统计证据比排序器本身的高级性更关键。

title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French
summary: Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model's existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model's existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过九个 LLM 在魁北克法语理解上的受控实验（每次 3000 万 token 预算匹配）表明：持续预训练（CPT）的收益强依赖基座模型的现有该变体能力，收益主要由语料构成（尤其文学文本）而非数据量驱动，且主要提升表达理解而非语法能力，并存在被聚合分数掩盖的能力权衡。
AI.motivation: CPT 被广泛用于将预训练语言模型适配到方言和非标准语言变体，但其必要性、收益来源以及聚合评测能否充分反映其效果均不清楚。作者希望厘清何时需要 CPT、收益由什么驱动、以及评测方式是否足够。
AI.method: 对魁北克法语语言理解开展 CPT 受控研究，覆盖不同模型家族与规模的九个 LLM；采用每次实验 3000 万 token 的预算匹配协议；进行语料组成与数据量对比、源级别数据分析，以及魁北克法语与标准法语的配对任务级评测。
AI.result: CPT 的收益强烈取决于基座模型对目标变体的已有能力；在 CPT 有效时，提升更多由语料组成而非数据量驱动，文学文本贡献了大部分增益；配对评测显示 CPT 主要改善表达理解而非语法能力，且语料语域决定习得哪些地区性表达；同时存在能力相关的权衡，如聚合分数会掩盖阅读理解下降。
AI.conclusion: 面向方言适配的 CPT 不应被视为普遍有益的默认做法；适配策略应先仔细评估基座模型的现有能力，并辅以源级别数据分析和任务级评测。

title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
summary: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an objective calibrated to match online impact, and careful context engineering. In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint. Its best model increases search volume by 0.23\% in an A/B test of large scale. Several improvements were architectural changes the team had never tried, drawn from the broader industry and literature, suggesting that MLE agents can explore regions of the design space that human intuition overlooks. We find that the design of the harness around the model matters: intuition suggests that a stronger underlying model is enough, but in our experience, the design of the loop around it is just as critical. More broadly, our work shows that autonomous agents can do real machine-learning engineering in industry-scale systems.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了"human-on-the-loop"的机器学习工程师(ΜLE)智能体，能在大规模搜索排序模型上自主提出、实现、训练与评估模型改动，单次campaign完成1097个实验、接受325个(29.6%)，最优模型在A/B测试中提升搜索量0.23%。
AI.motivation: 传统大规模排序/推荐模型的迭代流程缓慢繁琐，依赖工程师直觉与经验；现有LLM智能体多在benchmark或小代理任务上验证，尚不清楚能否用于工业级系统。作者希望验证自主智能体能否在真实工业环境中完成端到端ML工程。
AI.method: 采用人类保留控制权（目标设计、搜索方向、最终模型审核）的MLE智能体，让其自动提出、实现、训练和评估模型改动。针对三大挑战分别应对：并行训练运行解决单实验数小时反馈延迟；校准与线上影响匹配的目标函数缓解离线指标与线上效果不一致；精细的上下文工程（context engineering）应对早期收益饱和。
AI.result: 一次campaign运行1097个完整候选实验，接受325个，接受率29.6%（对比早前不同目标与搜索约束下campaign的15.6%）；最佳模型在大规模A/B测试中使搜索量提升0.23%。若干改进为团队从未尝试过的架构改动，源自更广泛业界与文献，说明智能体能探索人类直觉忽略的设计空间。
AI.conclusion: 自主智能体可在工业级系统中完成真实的机器学习工程；且围绕模型的外围"harness"（循环）设计与底层模型强度同等关键，并非仅靠更强模型即可。

title: GramStatTexNet: Efficient, Interpretable, and Neuro-Inspired Texture Analysis-by-Synthesis
summary: Deep networks achieve high realism in texture synthesis but often rely on opaque, over-parameterized representations that have limited direct connection to biological vision. Neuroscience-informed pyramid models are interpretable, compact, and biologically inspired, but rely on small, hand-curated statistics sets that are difficult to generalize or extend. We introduce GramStatTexNet, a hybrid analysis-by-synthesis framework that combines the multi-scale Gabor filter structure of classical models with the flexibility of Gramian-based correlations, organized into structured filter families. This structured representation enables analyses that are challenging for deep-feature methods: each statistic carries a named filter-family identity, allowing us to decompose synthesis fidelity into per-family contributions and to learn an interpretable, low-dimensional embedding that preserves perceptual texture content. We compare our framework to classical and deep texture-synthesis baselines across diverse texture categories, and on multiple perceptual metrics, highlighting the compactness and interpretability advantages of this hybrid representation, alongside competitive synthesis quality. This same framework extends naturally to peripheral textures via spatial pooling, and to dynamic textures using a spatiotemporal filter bank. GramStatTexNet provides a unified, interpretable framework for analyzing and modeling visual information with natural extensions across space, time, and eccentricity. Project page: https://vdutell.github.io/gstn

AI.tldr: 提出GramStatTexNet，融合经典Gabor金字塔与Gramian相关统计的混合分析-合成框架，实现可解释、紧凑的纹理分析与合成。
AI.motivation: 深度网络纹理合成效果好但表示不透明、过参数化且与生物视觉联系弱；神经科学启发的金字塔模型虽可解释紧凑，却依赖少量手工统计，难以泛化与扩展。
AI.method: 构建结构化的Gabor滤波器族，按滤波器族组织Gramian相关性统计，形成分析-合成框架；每个统计具有可命名的滤波器族身份，可分解各滤波器族对合成保真的贡献，并学习保留感知纹理内容的低维可解释嵌入。通过空间池化扩展到外周纹理，用时空滤波器组扩展到动态纹理。
AI.result: 在多种纹理类别及多个感知指标上与经典和深度纹理合成基线比较，合成质量具竞争力，同时展现紧凑性与可解释性优势。
AI.conclusion: GramStatTexNet提供统一、可解释的视觉信息分析建模框架，可自然扩展到空间、时间与偏心度维度。

title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
summary: Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. On ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, STRM improves over the published TRM results by $5.4$ and $0.5$ points. We will release our code upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 提出STRM，用单状态、统一更新的简化递归替代TRM的复杂嵌套循环设计，在不牺牲泛化性的前提下提升训练速度与最终性能。
AI.motivation: TRM/HRM类小模型在数独、迷宫最短路等谜题任务上表现优异，但其递归结构复杂：包含高低两层状态、嵌套循环递归，以及随循环位置变化的不同输入输出签名的网络调用。这些机制本质上是为规避记忆与过拟合而引入的，导致设计冗余、实现复杂。作者希望用更简单统一的递归达到同等甚至更好的效果。
AI.method: STRM采用单一状态和统一更新规则，去掉高层/低层双状态与嵌套循环。关键设计：(1) 对状态做指数移动更新(EMA)，使用不同更新速率；(2) 训练时对这些速率做抖动(jitter)；(3) 仅从慢更新通道读出答案。作者认为这三点是让简化递归仍能保持泛化能力的原因。
AI.result: 在与TRM相同的数据、参数量和计算量下：Sudoku-Extreme提升3.8分，PPBench提升8.4分，Maze-Hard持平；在ARC-AGI-1和ARC-AGI-2上，相较已发表的TRM结果分别提升5.4分和0.5分。同时训练速度更快。
AI.conclusion: STRM表明TRM中复杂的双状态嵌套循环并非必要，通过EMA多速率更新、训练期速率抖动和慢通道读出即可用单一统一递归实现更强性能与更快训练，是TRM的有效简化。代码将在论文录用后开源。

title: Architectural Design Decisions for Data Ingestion in Big Data Architectures
summary:
Introduction: Data ingestion is the first critical step in a data architecture, in which data from various sources is moved to storage systems, such as data lakes and data warehouses, for analysis and insight generation. When developing a data ingestion pipeline, practitioners (e.g., data engineers and architects) must understand the data ingestion requirements (functional and non-functional) and select appropriate design options to support them.
  Objective: To help practitioners systematically develop data ingestion processes, this paper aims to compile a catalog of data ingestion design decisions, their options, and the selection drivers.
  Method: We conducted a systematic gray literature review on data ingestion, analyzed the selected literature using qualitative data analysis methods, and conducted semi-structured interviews with experts to assess the framework's practicality and utility.
  Results: From 42 gray literature articles, we identified 8 architectural design decisions, 59 decision options, and 36 decision drivers to guide practitioners in the design and implementation of data ingestion pipelines. The framework was evaluated through expert interviews, assessing its completeness, simplicity, understandability, operational feasibility, and usefulness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统灰色文献综述与专家访谈，构建了数据摄取管道设计决策目录，包含8个架构设计决策、59个设计选项和36个决策驱动因素，并评估了其实用性。
AI.motivation: 数据摄取是数据架构的第一步，需将多源数据移至数据湖/数据仓库以供分析。实践者在开发摄取管道时需理解功能与非功能需求，并选择合适的架构设计选项，但缺乏系统化的指导。
AI.method: 对灰色文献进行系统综述（共42篇），采用定性数据分析方法处理文献，并通过半结构化专家访谈评估框架的实用性、完整性、简洁性、可理解性与操作可行性。
AI.result: 识别出8个架构设计决策、59个决策选项和36个决策驱动因素，形成指导数据摄取管道设计与实施的框架；专家访谈确认框架在多维度上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该决策目录可帮助数据工程师与架构师系统化地设计数据摄取流程，但其结论主要基于灰色文献，尚需进一步实证验证。

title: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
summary: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.

AI.tldr: 该论文从机制层面剖析 SLAM-ASR（冻结语言模型+小型语音映射器）为何能竞争性地完成语音识别，指出其依赖冻结LLM中的归纳头（induction heads）以及一对构成"约束式差分注意力"的头，并据此提出可用于噪声音频下提升转录质量的方法。
AI.motivation: SLAM-ASR 的假设是冻结语言模型本身具备足够的语言知识来完成识别任务，但这一假设虽然合理，却无法解释模型内部究竟依靠哪些具体结构工作。作者希望揭示其依赖的具体内部机制。
AI.method: 通过机制可解释性分析，将 SLAM-ASR 的行为定位到冻结语言模型中的特定注意力头：识别出对语音嵌入映射到转录token至关重要的归纳头（即在文本中复制重复token序列的头）；并发现成对的头表现出一种受限形式的差分注意力，用于抵消注意力噪声、将注意力锐化到前一个已生成词上。
AI.result: 实验表明，文本中负责复制重复token序列的归纳头同样在语音嵌入到转录token的映射中起关键作用；成对头通过差分注意力抵消噪声并聚焦前一词；并展示了利用归纳头在噪声音频条件下改善转录质量的可能性。
AI.conclusion: SLAM-ASR 的竞争力可归因于冻结语言模型中的归纳头及成对差分注意力机制，这为理解该类架构提供了具体机制解释，并为噪声鲁棒性改进提供了可操作的方向。

title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
summary: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.

AI.tldr: Vanguard：一个无需训练的"看图判步"评判器，让小模型草拟视觉语言智能体的每一步、由带截图的通用决策模型打分，通过即采用、否则回退大模型，从而在更少延迟/成本下达到甚至超过大模型精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言智能体每步动作前都要推理，导致每步都被大模型延迟与成本卡住；现有的步级投机（小模型草拟、大模型判定）成败取决于评判器，而仅读文本的评判器无法判断该步是否契合其操作的屏幕界面。作者还观察到小模型多样本常能包含正确步骤，且与大模型的正确步骤并不总重合，因此带屏幕信息的评判可能"又便宜又更好"。
AI.method: 提出Vanguard，一个训练无关的评判器，不改动草稿模型与目标模型：用一个通用决策模型（输入包含截图），一次前向为每个候选步骤给出"正确概率"；最优候选超过阈值则采纳，否则由大模型重新生成该步。阈值经过校准可迁移到未见过网站，且可与token级投机解码组合。
AI.result: 在Web、移动与具身智能体上：2B草稿+Vanguard精度不低于8B目标模型，在Mind2Web与EB-ALFRED上显著更高，且目标模型只写少数步骤；完成更多闭环回合；配另一家族的27B目标模型时既更快又更准。在智能体任务中为对比中最准的评判器，依赖截图，跨模型家族时收益随草稿pass@4相对目标的优势增大；在数学任务上与已训练的过程奖励模型相当。
AI.conclusion: Vanguard把投机从"节省大模型算力"提升为"可能超越大模型"的机制，为低延迟、低成本的视觉语言智能体部署提供可行路径。

title: Mean Curvature Minimizing Foliations Of A Vector Field
summary: Streamline patterns are ubiquitous in nature. Prominent examples include white matter fibre tracts in the mammalian brain and arrangements of elongated cells, such as cardiomyocytes in the heart wall. It has been posited that such organisations foliate into locally smooth surfaces to optimise function. However, the recovery of these foliations from a single vector field aligned with the local orientation of the underlying sheets remains an open problem. We address this challenge by introducing a mathematical model of a sheet and developing an algorithm for sheet inference, from measurements of the oriented structures. Given an input vector field, our model estimates a second vector field that is orthonormal to it, while also requiring the Lie bracket of the two to vanish. To balance sheet likelihood against low surface area, we also reduce the mean curvature of the recovered local surface. We compute the first variation of an associated energy and provide a numerical method which admits an efficient, parallel implementation for sheet estimation. We demonstrate our approach on both synthetic and biological examples, motivated by applications to medical imaging. These include white matter fibre tracts from a brain atlas and confocal microscopy images of cleared heart wall tissue. For the latter we are able to reconstruct sheets aligned with local cardiomyocyte directions at unprecedented (micrometre) scale.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从单一取向向量场推断局部光滑曲面（foliation）的数学模型与算法，通过引入与之正交且Lie括号为零的第二向量场，并加入平均曲率正则，估计曲面片层，应用于脑白质纤维束与心脏壁心肌细胞的曲面重建。
AI.motivation: 自然界中的流线模式（如脑白质纤维束、心肌细胞排列）被认为组织成局部光滑的曲面以优化功能，但仅凭与片层局部取向对齐的单一向量场恢复这些曲面仍是一个未解决的问题。
AI.method: 建立片层（sheet）的数学模型：给定输入向量场，估计一个与其正交的第二向量场，并要求两者的Lie括号为零（保证积分曲面存在）；同时以平均曲率最小化来平衡片层似然性与低表面积，计算相关能量的第一变分，给出可高效并行实现的数值方法。
AI.result: 在合成与生物数据上验证方法；成功处理脑图谱中的白质纤维束以及透明化心脏壁组织的共聚焦显微图像，后者以微米级精度重建了与局部心肌细胞方向对齐的片层。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从单一取向向量场恢复光滑片层结构提供了有原理依据且可并行计算的框架，并在医学影像场景中展示了实用性。

title: Variable Length Diffuse Everything: Arbitrary Length Generative Modeling on Arbitrary State Spaces
summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative models have achieved remarkable results across diverse applications, but most assume data of fixed-dimension/length. Meanwhile, real-world problems such as layout generation often involve variable-length, multimodal data, such as continuous bounding box coordinates paired with discrete types. Existing methods typically address variable length by padding data to a fixed size or by introducing specialized objectives to model lengths explicitly, adding complexity and limiting generality. We propose Variable Length Diffuse Everything (VL-DE), a simple and general framework for variable-length multimodal generation on arbitrary state spaces. Instead of padding, VL-DE handles variable length through an insertion-based mechanism grounded in a principled theoretical framework, yielding a tractable training objective. In addition, by utilizing the fact that VL-DE is based on a generator with an additive form, we develop a higher-order sampler by appropriately handling the time dependence. Extensive experiments on layout and molecule generation demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 VL-DE，一个基于插入机制的可变长度、多模态扩散/流生成框架，无需填充或显式长度目标，并配套高阶采样器，在布局与分子生成上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散/流模型多假设数据维度固定；布局生成等实际问题含可变长度、多模态数据（连续坐标+离散类型）。已有做法靠填充到固定长度或加专门目标建模长度，增加复杂度、损害通用性。
AI.method: 用基于插入的机制代替填充，并在理论框架下推导可得可处理的训练目标；利用生成器具有加性形式的特点，适当处理时间依赖，设计高阶采样器；框架适用于任意状态空间。
AI.result: 在布局生成和分子生成两类任务上的大量实验表明方法有效。
AI.conclusion: VL-DE 提供了简单通用的可变长度多模态生成方案，避免填充与额外长度目标，可作为扩散/流模型拓展到变长数据的通用范式。

title: Plug-and-Play Sensor Evolution in Software-Defined Vehicles through Asset Administration Shells
comment: Peer-reviewed and Published in the 2026 IEEE 31st International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA)
summary:
Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) promise continuous software evolution, but sensor integration in deployed vehicles still depends on manual configuration, hardware-specific drivers, and repeated application-side adaptation. Existing standards address only parts of this problem. AUTOSAR standardizes selected sensor interfaces, the Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS) standardizes signal semantics, and Asset Administration Shells (AAS) standardize digital asset descriptions. However, these building blocks are rarely combined into an end-to-end onboarding path for sensors attached after vehicle deployment.
  This paper presents an AAS-driven plug-and-play sensor integration framework for safety-supervised sensors. Each sensor is represented by an AAS that combines hardware identification, interface metadata, VSS mappings, and references to containerized driver and optional application software. After physical connection, an edge gateway identifies the device, retrieves the matching AAS, deploys the referenced software, and publishes the resulting data under stable vehicle signal paths. A prototype on a resource-constrained edge gateway connected to an RR100 UGV demonstrates automated integration of a USB camera and an ultrasonic sensor. Across repeated integration cycles, the prototype reaches operational state in about 2s, shows no failed events, and keeps applications independent of hardware-specific interfaces. The results indicate that the introduction of AAS as an executable onboarding contract enables automated runtime deployment of sensor drivers in SDV environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以AAS为驱动、面向安全监督传感器的即插即用集成框架，实现车辆部署后传感器的自动化运行时接入。
AI.motivation: 软件定义汽车强调软件持续演进，但部署后传感器接入仍依赖人工配置、硬件专用驱动和应用侧反复适配。AUTOSAR、VSS、AAS等标准只覆盖局部问题，缺乏端到端的传感器上线路径。
AI.method: 为每个传感器构建AAS，整合硬件标识、接口元数据、VSS映射以及容器化驱动（及可选应用软件）的引用；物理连接后由边缘网关识别设备、获取对应AAS、部署所引用软件，并在稳定的车辆信号路径下发布数据。
AI.result: 在资源受限边缘网关连接RR100 UGV的原型上，自动完成USB相机与超声波传感器的集成；重复集成周期中约2秒进入运行状态，无失败事件，应用与硬件专用接口解耦。
AI.conclusion: 将AAS引入为可执行的上线契约，可在SDV环境中实现传感器驱动的自动化运行时部署。

title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
summary: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.

AI.tldr: FlashMorph2提出一种on-policy层选择方法，将混合注意力架构转换中的层选择与权重恢复联合优化，显著优于现有方法且高效可扩展。
AI.motivation: 将预训练Transformer转换为全注意力与线性注意力混合的模型，需要在给定预算下确定哪些层保留全注意力。现有方法FlashMorph存在两处离策略（off-policy）失配：(i) 连续分支插值与教师强制隐藏状态偏离离散混合计算；(ii) 冻结权重忽略了后续恢复过程中的参数适应。
AI.method: 提出FlashMorph2，一种on-policy层选择方法：(I) 对采样得到的离散混合架构使用其自身隐藏状态进行端到端评估；(II) 在恢复目标下联合优化层选择分数与模型权重，以反映适应后的性能。
AI.result: 在Qwen3多个规模和多种线性注意力变体上实验，FlashMorph2持续优于现有层选择方法：相比FlashMorph平均提升RULER +2.42分、LongBench +1.08分、召回密集型任务 +0.76分；层选择仅需0.72–3.57 GPU小时（0.6B–8B模型）。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除离策略失配、采用端到端离散评估与权重联合优化，FlashMorph2在质量与效率上均取得更优表现，展现出高效率和良好的可扩展性。

title: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
summary: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.

AI.tldr: MyoECG是一个跨模态表示学习框架，将心脏磁共振（CMR）的结构与功能知识蒸馏到标准12导联ECG中，实现仅凭心电图进行心肌病检测与亚型分类。
AI.motivation: 人群规模的心肌精准表型受制于CMR的成本与可及性；ECG普及但仅反映电生理信息而非结构与功能信息。作者希望把资源密集型影像的知识迁移到广泛可部署的生理信号上。
AI.method: 在UK Biobank及一家三级心血管中心的45,241例配对ECG-CMR检查上预训练MyoECG，再在7个独立数据集、逾180万份ECG上开发与验证；与5个预训练ECG基础模型对比，开展6位心内科医生的多阅片者研究，并在41,128名UK Biobank参与者中做遗传相关、GWAS（4个位点，含NFIA、KCNQ1）、69种循环蛋白关联分析，以及校正27项CMR性状后的验证。
AI.result: 在0.2%–54.7%患病率的内外部数据集上，心肌病检测AUROC达0.800–0.974，优于5个ECG基础模型；医生在MyoECG辅助下平均敏感度提升0.109（P=0.009）、特异度提升0.056（P=0.040）；MyoECG评分与心肌病（rg=0.409）及扩张型心肌病（rg=0.371）存在遗传相关，校正27项CMR性状后相关性减弱至不显著（rg=0.131, P=0.143）。
AI.conclusion: MyoECG提供了可扩展的、受CMR启发的心肌病评估路径，并给出将资源密集型影像知识迁移至广泛可部署生理信号的通用策略。

title: Keep the Reasoning, Read the Image: On-Demand Visual KV for Multi-Turn Reasoning VLMs
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) think for thousands of tokens before they answer, and retention policies keep the KV cache affordable by pruning it as the reasoning grows. We find that this pruning sacrifices the image in multi-turn conversations: the image and the reasoning share one budget, so the growing reasoning crowds the visual entries out. A chart question that loses 8 points to the full cache when asked first loses 24 points when asked after a round of reasoning. Protecting a small visual reserve from eviction recovers most of this loss, while adding the same slots to the shared budget recovers considerably less. The image therefore lacks protection, not capacity. Based on this finding, we propose ShelfKV, a training-free method that works on top of existing retention policies. It keeps every visual entry in CPU memory and, at each decoding step, swaps the visual entries that the current query scores highest into the attention slots of the text entries it scores lowest. The image is never evicted, yet it occupies attention slots only while it is read. We evaluate ShelfKV on four benchmarks, three of them conversational, with two retention policies and two reasoning VLMs. In conversations, it improves the strongest existing policy, DBTrimKV, by up to 20.3 points at matched GPU memory, and still leads by 8.7 points when DBTrimKV uses twice the memory. It also consistently outperforms a fixed visual reserve of matched GPU memory in these settings, without hurting accuracy on standalone questions. These results show that the image should be protected from the reasoning but read only on demand.

AI.tldr: 推理型VLM的KV cache保留策略会与图像争夺预算，导致多轮对话中视觉信息被挤掉；ShelfKV将视觉条目存于CPU内存，仅在需要时换入注意力槽位，在多轮基准上显著优于现有策略。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM思考数千token，保留策略通过剪枝KV cache控制开销，但图像与推理共享同一预算，增长的推理内容会把视觉条目挤出。作者发现图像面临的是"缺乏保护"而非"缺乏容量"：先提问的图表题在剪枝下掉8分，而在推理轮后提问掉24分；固定视觉保留区能挽回大部分损失，而把相同槽位加入共享预算收效甚微。
AI.method: 提出ShelfKV，一种无需训练、可叠加在现有保留策略上的方法：所有视觉条目常驻CPU内存，每一步解码时，将当前查询得分最高的视觉条目换入得分最低的文本条目所占的注意力槽位。图像永不被驱逐，但仅在需要读取时占用注意力槽位。
AI.result: 在四个基准（其中三个为多轮对话）上，用两种保留策略和两种推理VLM评估。多轮对话中，在相同GPU内存下比最强现有策略DBTrimKV最高提升20.3分；即使DBTrimKV使用两倍内存仍领先8.7分；并稳定优于同等GPU内存的固定视觉保留区，同时在单轮问题上不损失准确率。
AI.conclusion: 图像应当被保护以免受推理内容侵蚀，但应仅在需要时按需读取（保护于外、按需读入），这一设计在保缓存可控的同时保住了多轮视觉理解性能。

title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
summary: Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model's own judgment and the user's reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and $τ^2$-bench. We compare the true outcome, the user's stated verdict and the model's own judgment with a separate, frozen "feedback sense" that reads the user's reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ($τ^2$-bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.

AI.tldr: 研究设备端小型语言模型夜间自我学习，比较真实结果、用户判定、模型自判与外部"反馈感官"三种监督来源；发现只有能识别失败并排除失败、且用户能看到结果时，从用户反应中学习才有效。
AI.motivation: 设备端小模型若能每天从自身工作中持续学习会很有价值，但没有真实结果标签时，必须决定哪些尝试值得学习；模型自判和用户反应都可能出错，因此需要研究不同监督信号的可信度。
AI.method: 用Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B加LoRA适配器，在WebShop与τ²-bench上做127段最长一年的"人生"实验，每晚对被判定接受的尝试微调；对比真实结果、用户明示判定、模型自判，以及三种版本的冻结"反馈感官"（读取用户反应，其中一版先判断用户是否给出明确判定）。共97段人生分析。
AI.result: 自判会先提升后衰减；把礼貌性放弃当成功的感官使5段中3段崩溃；为辨别而设计的版本使4/5段两周内接近oracle，但因干净样本少而衰退至第60天与自判相当。在用户看不到结果的τ²-bench上，80%的课程是顾客致谢的失败；失败样本占比可预测结果（Spearman ρ=-0.81）。
AI.conclusion: 从用户学习只在判定器能排除失败且用户能看到结果时才成立；课程样本失衡（偏斜）可能还会使模型变窄。后续应重视监督信号质量与结果可见性。

title: When Code Works but the License Doesn't: Evaluating License Constraint Handling in Coding Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 VeriCode Workshop
summary:
Coding agents increasingly undertake repository-level development, including dependency selection, source modification, and software deployment. However, existing evaluations prioritize functional success over licensing correctness and commercial suitability.
  We investigate whether agents recognize and preserve software-license constraints when developing proprietary software. Experiments across multiple agents examine permissive and copyleft licenses, missing licensing information, transitive dependencies, source modification, dual licensing, vendoring, and distribution contexts. Agent traces, repository changes, and final artifacts are evaluated against licensing ground truth.
  Results reveal a persistent gap between functional and licensing correctness. Agents can successfully build and test software while overlooking licensing constraints involving provenance, authorization, and distribution. Better outcomes emerge when licensing information translates into engineering actions such as dependency substitution, architectural changes, and release gating. We argue that licensing in agentic development requires contextual constraint recognition and preservation across the software lifecycle, not merely license classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究编码智能体在仓库级专有软件开发中是否能识别并保持软件许可证约束，发现功能正确性与许可证正确性之间存在持续差距。
AI.motivation: 现有评测优先关注功能成功，忽视许可证正确性与商业适用性；而智能体已开始承担依赖选择、源码修改和部署等仓库级开发任务，许可证合规风险显著。
AI.method: 在多个智能体上开展实验，覆盖宽松许可证、copyleft 许可证、缺失许可信息、传递依赖、源码修改、双许可证、vendoring 与分发场景；通过分析智能体轨迹、仓库变更与最终产物，对照许可证基准真值进行评估。
AI.result: 结果显示功能与许可证正确性之间存在持续差距：智能体能成功构建和测试软件，却忽视涉及来源、授权与分发的许可证约束；当许可证信息转化为工程行动（如依赖替换、架构调整、发布门禁）时效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 智能体开发中的许可证问题需要跨软件生命周期的上下文约束识别与保持，而不仅是许可证分类。

title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.

AI.tldr: Chiron是一个用于测量与预测人类行为的基础模型，通过联合微调LLM来表征心理构念、预测个体行为并使群体响应分布与人类统计对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM虽能生成看似合理的心理与行为响应，却常常误表征个体并扭曲群体统计，难以可靠用于心理测量与行为预测。
AI.method: 联合微调一个LLM，同时完成三项目标：表征心理构念、预测个体行为、将群体响应分布与人类统计对齐；数据涵盖36个行为领域、78个社会科学实验、288,307条个人记录、1,411,750个原子行为决策、99,953份心理测量评估（109个心理构念）。
AI.result: 心理测量更接近人类自我报告且偏倚更少；个体行为预测优于前沿LLM（相对提升最高28.4%）；社会科学实验仿真中效应量估计误差降低82.2–94.3%，更准确捕捉实验效应的方向与幅度。
AI.conclusion: Chiron可作为测量与预测人类行为的统一计算工具。

title: Can you make models believe false facts in the prompt?
summary: Making LLMs believe false facts is useful for alignment evaluations and for building model organisms. Previous work explored doing so with Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF). But SDF requires fine-tuning one new model for each set of injected false beliefs. To enable larger scale SDF-powered alignment evaluations, we attempt to produce a single model that believes any fact placed in a <facts> tag in the prompt. To do so, we explore doing prompt-conditioned SDF: fine-tuning a model on synthetic documents covering thousands of facts, with each document conditioned on a fact presented in the prompt. We evaluate how deeply the model believes the facts provided in the prompt using evaluations from prior work and a new Jacobian lens evaluation. We find that the belief depth on unseen facts scales roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts, making this a cheap, promising avenue for making models believe false facts, though preliminary experiments on applying it to alignment audits on the small model we studied showed negative results due to these small models often already acting as if they believed facts provided in regular honeypot system prompts. Using RL to reduce the rate at which models verbalize following a false fact in the prompt, on top of prompt-conditioned SDF, generalizes to held-out evals and almost matches SDF on some evaluations. But training against one of our metrics for belief depth makes it harder to trust those evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出"提示条件化SDF"：用prompt中<facts>标签内的事实条件化合成文档进行微调，使单一模型相信任意被注入的事实；相信深度随训练事实数量约呈对数线性增长。
AI.motivation: 原始SDF每注入一组虚假信念都需微调一个新模型，成本高，难以支撑大规模对齐评估与模型生物构建；希望单一模型能相信任意提示中给出的事实。
AI.method: 在覆盖数千条事实的合成文档上做提示条件化微调（每篇文档以提示中的事实为条件）；用先前工作的评估及新的Jacobian lens评估信念深度；并用RL在提示条件化SDF之上降低模型复述虚假事实的比率。
AI.result: 未见过事实上的相信深度随训练事实数量大致对数线性增长；在小模型上的对齐审计因这些模型本就像相信常规蜜罐系统提示中的事实而呈负面结果；RL可泛化到留出评估并在部分评估上接近SDF，但针对某一信念深度指标训练会削弱对该评估的信任。
AI.conclusion: 提示条件化SDF是一种廉价且有前景的让模型相信虚假事实的途径，可支持更大规模对齐评估；但其在小模型审计中效果有限，且RL做法会带来评估可信度问题，需谨慎解读。

title: DetectViT: Test-time Backdoor Detection for Vision Transformers via Inter-Head Attention Discrepancy
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) now underpin the visual encoders of most multimodal models, but this success comes at a cost: relying on third-party pretrained checkpoints leaves these systems open to backdoor attacks. Existing test-time detection methods rely on either the predicted label or intermediate embeddings, limiting their applicability across diverse tasks and incurring substantial computational overhead. In this work, we study how backdoor triggers affect the multi-head attention mechanism of ViTs and identify two distinct anomalous patterns: $\textit{complete attention hijacking}$, causing the attention to exhibit abnormally high inter-head spatial overlap, and $\textit{partial attention hijacking}$, causing an abnormally large variance in the concentration of the attention distribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{DetectViT}$, a test-time backdoor detection method that requires neither training data, model outputs, nor any prior knowledge of the trigger. DetectViT quantifies the two hijacking phenomena via an inter-head consistency score and an inter-head entropy variance score, with thresholds estimated from a small out-of-distribution (OOD) calibration set drawn from an arbitrary source. Across four representative attacks, diverse architectures (DeiT, CLIP, and LLaVA), and downstream tasks (image classification and captioning), DetectViT substantially outperforms all baselines with as few as 64--128 OOD calibration samples, achieving a true positive rate of $100\%$ and a false positive rate of $0.17\%$ on BadCLIP. Notably, it introduces negligible additional overhead by relying solely on attention weights already computed during inference. Code is available at: https://github.com/siquanhuang/DetectViT.

AI.tldr: DetectViT：一种无需训练数据、模型输出或触发器先验的ViT测试时后门检测方法，通过多头注意力一致性分数与头间熵方差分数识别"完全/部分注意力劫持"，仅用64–128个OOD样本即可达100% TPR、0.17% FPR。
AI.motivation: ViT作为多模态视觉编码器广泛依赖第三方预训练权重，存在后门风险；现有测试时检测方法依赖预测标签或中间嵌入，任务泛化性差且计算开销大。
AI.method: 分析后门触发对多头注意力的影响，发现两种异常模式（完全劫持：头间空间重叠异常高；部分劫持：注意力分布集中度方差异常大），据此提出头间一致性分数与头间熵方差分数，阈值由小型OOD校准集估计，仅利用推理中已有的注意力权重。
AI.result: 在4种攻击、DeiT/CLIP/LLaVA多种架构及分类与描述任务上显著优于基线；仅需64–128个OOD样本，BadCLIP上TPR 100%、FPR 0.17%，额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 注意力层面的头间统计规律可作为通用、轻量、无需标签的ViT后门检测信号，具备跨任务与跨架构的实用价值。

title: HypoLoop: Revising Weight-Editing Plans from Scientific Feedback
summary: Scientific experiments continually reveal prediction errors. Effective updates depend on which parameters change and which errors drive the correction. We introduce HypoLoop, a family of native weight-editing methods that connects these choices to experimental feedback. Fixed, numerically adaptive, and LLM-guided policies produce editing plans; numerical solvers compute weight patches, and internal validation selects the deployed predictor. Successive observations and validation records support revisions to editable locations and fitting rules. Experiments cover 22 scientific tasks and both DeepSeek and Claude. On Burgers, reallocating a matched parameter budget reduces error by 58.80% and 47.72% relative to fixed locations. On DIODE, positive-residual weighting reduces absolute relative error (AbsRel) by 13.35% in internal cross-validation, with the same 33 editable coordinates. Revising the complete plan across rounds lowers final AbsRel by 10.59% relative to keeping the initial plan fixed. SpaceNet7 and Make3D connect accepted edits to improved spatial predictions. These results show how experimental evidence can shape the update problem itself. Code: https://github.com/limengran98/HypoLoop.

AI.tldr: HypoLoop是一类原生权重编辑方法，将"哪些参数可改"和"哪些误差驱动修正"这两个选择与实验反馈相连，通过固定、数值自适应和LLM引导三种策略生成编辑方案，结合数值求解器计算权重补丁，并由内部验证选出部署的预测器，在22个科学任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 科学实验不断暴露预测误差，而有效更新取决于改哪些参数、由哪些误差驱动修正。现有方法未将这两个关键选择与实验反馈闭环联系起来。
AI.method: 提出HypoLoop家族的原生权重编辑方法：固定、数值自适应、LLM引导三种策略生成编辑计划；数值求解器计算权重补丁；内部验证选择部署预测器；连续观测与验证记录支持对可编辑位置和拟合规则的修订。
AI.result: 覆盖22个科学任务及DeepSeek、Claude。Burgers上将匹配参数预算重新分配，误差相比固定位置降低58.80%和47.72%；DIODE上正残差加权使AbsRel降低13.35%（相同33个可编辑坐标）；跨轮修订完整方案比保持初始方案固定最终AbsRel降低10.59%；SpaceNet7和Make3D显示被接受的编辑带来空间预测改进。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据能够塑造更新问题本身（可编辑位置与拟合规则），验证了将实验反馈纳入权重编辑决策闭环的有效性。

title: Optimal Development Path: An Empirical Evaluation of Tiered Dependency-Aware Sequencing
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Public aggregate benchmark results available on Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23762369
summary: The Optimal Development Path (ODP) in D-POAF orders Feature Blocks in a Wave Candidate by choosing the eligible block with the lowest effort-and-risk-to-value ratio (ERS/BVS), while respecting declared prerequisites. We evaluate native ODP (L0) against four dependency-aware strategies: unlock count (L1), unlocked value (L2), multi-hop potential (L3), and one-step rollout (L4), alongside local search, Sidney decomposition, and an exact reference. On held-out synthetic graphs with about one prerequisite per block, L0 attains 0.978 of the surrogate optimum at 12 blocks, versus 0.993 for L2 and 0.994 for L4. At 100 blocks, L0 attains 0.942 and L2 0.983. In contrast, 373 historical Jira sprints from 21 open-source projects in TAWOS, used as scheduling proxies rather than D-POAF Waves, contain sparse recorded dependencies. On these instances, L0 attains 0.998 of the surrogate optimum and is exactly optimal in 69% of sprints. Unlock bonuses calibrated on synthetic graphs do not deliver significant average gains on these sprint-derived instances and can worsen the surrogate. L4 never worsens the declared surrogate relative to L0, but this guarantee does not extend to operational outcomes. Retrospective calendar replays using recorded Jira durations show that surrogate improvements do not reliably improve value-weighted completion. The findings support keeping L0 as the default and presenting rollout and exact references as auditable alternatives. Dependency-valid sequences expose prerequisite readiness, but their effects on interruptions, rework, costs, and delivery times remain unmeasured.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估了D-POAF中默认的“最优开发路径”(ODP, L0)与多种依赖感知排序策略，发现L0在真实Jira冲刺数据上已接近最优，合成图上更复杂的策略虽能提升代理指标但无法可靠改善实际运营结果，故建议保留L0作为默认方案。
AI.motivation: D-POAF框架默认按“工作量与风险对价值比”(ERS/BVS)最低的合格块排序(ODP/L0)，但该启发式是否会因忽视依赖结构的全局收益(解锁后续块、多跳潜力等)而次优，缺乏实证。作者希望检验更复杂的依赖感知策略是否值得替代默认规则。
AI.method: 构造约每块一条前置依赖的合成图，将L0与四种依赖感知策略(L1解锁数、L2解锁价值、L3多跳潜力、L4一步rollout)以及局部搜索、Sidney分解和精确参考解对比，测量代理最优值比例；再用TAWOS中21个开源项目373个历史Jira冲刺(作为调度代理)复现，并用记录的Jira时长的日历回放评估实际价值加权完成情况。
AI.result: 合成图上12块时L0达代理最优的0.978，L2为0.993、L4为0.994；100块时L0为0.942、L2为0.983。Jira冲刺依赖稀疏，L0达0.998且在69%冲刺中精确最优；合成图校准的解锁奖励在冲刺实例上无显著平均增益甚至有损。L4不会劣化声明的代理指标，但该保证不延伸到运营结果；日历回放显示代理指标提升不能可靠改善价值加权完成。
AI.conclusion: 建议将L0保留为默认策略，把rollout与精确参考作为可审计的备选。依赖有效序列揭示了前置就绪性，但其对中断、返工、成本与交付时间的影响仍未经测量。

title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
summary: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.

AI.tldr: 语言模型从训练数据中获得能力，开发者通过隐藏部分数据来阻止模型学到可能被滥用的能力。本文发现，模型在其余训练数据上的整体进展可以"替代"被隐藏的数据；数据过滤只是延迟能力出现，且随着模型变强，重新获得该能力所需的数据量递减。
AI.motivation: 开发者常扣留训练数据以防止模型习得可被滥用的能力，但尚不清楚这种扣留能把能力延迟多久，以及日后重新习得需要多少数据。
AI.method: 在国际象棋、黑白棋（Othello）、分子字符串、括号语言和网页文本上，分别扣留单项技能的训练信号；比较大小模型的能力延迟；再用被扣留数据重新训练，测量重新习得所需数据量；并设置等难度对照规则，以及在70亿参数模型上扣留一门编程语言做验证。
AI.result: 大模型中被扣留技能的出现延迟可由小模型预测；未显式训练"应将"的国际象棋模型，其合法应着排名几乎与专门训练的模型相当；用被扣留数据重训时，仅需从零训练所需数据的一小部分即可习得，且该比例随模型进展而下降；等难度对照规则学得慢得多；70亿参数模型中扣留的编程语言也以同样方式被重新掌握。
AI.conclusion: 数据过滤只能延迟一项能力的出现，而非阻止其习得；随着模型能力提升，重新获得被过滤能力所需的数据越来越少。

title: GLIDE: Scalable and Event-Aware Inductive Forecasting over Evolving Logistics Graphs
summary: Accurate forecasting of order volume at scale-effect hotspots (SEHs), spatially coherent groups of logistics flows that serve as distributed optimization units for real-time many-to-one dispatch, is a prerequisite for efficient order pooling in on-demand food delivery (OFD) platforms such as Meituan. However, real-world logistics networks present unique challenges that render standard spatiotemporal prediction model ineffective. (i) Dynamic Topology: Unlike static road networks, logistics graphs are ephemeral, with hotspot emerging and vanishing continuously; (ii) Scale--Volume Heterogeneity: Graph sizes vary from $10^2$ to $10^4$, while zero-inflated, long-tailed volumes create computational bottlenecks and bias predictions toward inactivity; and (iii) Event-Driven Disruption: Exogenous events (holidays, weather, academic calendars) induce systematic demand shifts that purely data-driven backbones cannot anticipate. In this paper, we present GLIDE, a production-ready framework that models evolving logistics graphs in a scalable latent space while adapting to heterogeneous demand regimes and event-driven shifts. GLIDE introduces a Graph-Guided Latent Aggregation mechanism, which dynamically projects varying physical subgraphs into a fixed-size, semantically stable latent space via a differentiable sparse assignment...

AI.tldr: GLIDE提出面向美团外卖实时多对一调度中"规模效应热点(SEH)"订单量预测的生产级框架，用可微稀疏分配将动态变化的物理子图投影到固定尺寸的语义稳定隐空间，以应对动态拓扑、尺度-体量异质性与事件驱动扰动。
AI.motivation: SEH订单量预测是订单合单池化的前提，但真实物流网络存在三类标准时空模型难以处理的问题：(i) 动态拓扑——物流图短暂易变，热点不断生成与消失；(ii) 尺度-体量异质性——图规模从10^2到10^4，零膨胀长尾体量造成计算瓶颈并使模型偏向预测"无单"；(iii) 事件驱动扰动——节假日、天气、校历等外生事件引发系统性需求偏移，纯数据驱动骨干无法预判。
AI.method: GLIDE框架：核心是Graph-Guided Latent Aggregation机制，通过可微稀疏分配把不同规模的物理子图动态投影到固定大小、语义稳定的隐空间；在此基础上建模异构需求状态并对事件驱动偏移进行自适应（摘要截断，后续模块细节未知）。
AI.result: 摘要原文未给出具体实验数据与量化结果（文本被截断），仅声称该框架为"production-ready"并已在美团等真实平台场景中应用导向。
AI.conclusion: GLIDE通过"固定尺寸隐空间+图引导聚合"的思路，将动态、多尺度、零膨胀的物流图预测问题转化为稳定的潜在空间建模问题，为大规模OFD平台的实时订单量预测提供可落地的解决方案。

title: When accuracy hides risk: risk-controlled confirmation of the critical view of safety under expert disagreement
summary: Automated assessment of the critical view of safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy has advanced rapidly, but a deployed check must decide, before the first clip, whether to confirm CVS. The standard rule calibrates a threshold so that false confirmations are rare on average. We show that this rule concentrates its errors on disputed videos, which one of three expert raters judged sufficient, and that the failure is structural. When reference labels are votes of a panel sampled from a larger expert pool, the rule that maximizes sensitivity at a fixed average false-confirmation rate also maximizes false confirmation of disputed videos, and for recognizers that recover expert judgement with less noise this rate rises with accuracy. We propose certified confirmation, a risk-controlled monitoring rule whose threshold is selected by multiple testing so that, with probability at least 1 - δ, false confirmation is at most α overall, among disputed videos, within vendor and country groups, and before CVS is visible, using disputed labels only to calibrate. In a pre-specified, hash-locked evaluation on the 300 test videos (18 countries) of the SAGES CVS Challenge, standard calibration falsely confirmed 8 of 39 disputed videos (0.21; one-sided p = 0.037 against α = 0.10), whereas certified confirmation confirmed 2 (one-sided 95% upper bound 0.15). On development data, protection held for vendor and country groups left out of calibration. The cost was confirming 10% rather than 35% of sufficient videos on time. Average accuracy hides this risk; disputed cases must be protected explicitly.
