AI.tldr: 针对腹腔镜胆囊切除术CVS自动判定，标准阈值校准会把假确认错误集中到"有争议"视频上，且这是结构性问题；本文提出经多重检验选阈的"认证式确认"风险控制规则，在SAGES挑战赛300例测试中显著降低有争议视频的假确认率。
AI.motivation: 现有CVS自动评估在平均意义上控制假确认率，但临床部署时需在做第一枚夹闭前决定是否确认CVS，平均指标掩盖了风险向专家意见分歧（有争议）视频集中的问题。
AI.method: 理论分析表明：当参考标签是专家小组投票时，固定平均假确认率下最大化灵敏度的规则也会最大化对有争议视频的假确认，且识别器越准确该比率越高。据此提出"认证式确认"(certified confirmation)：用多重检验选择阈值，使在概率至少1-δ下，假确认在总体、有争议视频内、供应商/国家分组内及CVS未显现前均不超过α，争议标签仅用于校准。
AI.result: 在SAGES CVS Challenge 300例测试视频（18国）、预注册且哈希锁定的评估中，标准校准对39例有争议视频假确认8例（0.21，单侧p=0.037，对比α=0.10）；认证式确认仅2例（单侧95%上界0.15）。开发数据上，对未参与校准的供应商/国家分组保护依然成立。代价是及时确认充分视频的比例从35%降至10%。
AI.conclusion: 平均准确率会掩盖针对争议病例的系统性风险，争议病例必须显式保护；以灵敏度换取风险可控性是可接受的，认证式确认提供了可验证的安全保障。

title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI Foundations for Power Grids: From Models to Deployment at Scale (AI4PowerGrids), Sydney, Australia
summary: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

AI.tldr: 系统评估物理约束损失、多电网训练和扰动数据增强对三种图神经网络潮流模型从小电网到500节点大电网零样本迁移能力的影响。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源、极端天气和数据中心负荷带来运行不确定性，大电网潮流求解可靠性受挑战；ML代理模型可行，但大电网训练数据生成成本高，需依赖分布外泛化能力，而小电网训练的模型缺乏此能力。
AI.method: 以三种基于图神经网络的潮流模型为对象，系统对比物理信息损失、多电网训练、基于扰动的数据增强（边属性扰动），并测试随机线路/发电机dropout，评估向未见过的500节点系统的零样本迁移。
AI.result: (1) 物理信息损失相对纯监督目标提升迁移；(2) 小系统多电网训练与最佳单一电网持平，但未缩小与目标电网训练的差距；(3) 边属性扰动增强使迁移提升最高达54.6%；(4) 随机线路/发电机dropout效果不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息损失与边属性扰动增强是有前景的零样本迁移手段，而多电网训练和结构化dropout收益有限，提示需针对大电网部署设计更有效的泛化策略。

title: LLMs for Software Vulnerability Prediction and Prioritization: A Review
summary: Large language models have moved beyond vulnerability detection into prediction, assessment, exploitability estimation, risk assessment and prioritization, yet the evidence for this shift has not been synthesised separately from the detection literature. In this systematic literature review, we examine how LLMs are used across those five task classes, how well they perform against established baselines, and what prevents their operational adoption. Following a prespecified protocol, we identified 197 records, removed 53 duplicates, and excluded 103 records at title and abstract stage. We assessed 41 full texts and finally retained 23 primary studies published between 2024 and 2026 after a six-question quality assessment. The review contributes a five-class taxonomy ordered by decision outcome, a method taxonomy covering prompting, tuning and retrieval or agentic architectures, an evaluation-practice audit, a bounded performance synthesis, and a deployment-barrier analysis. The main findings are that (i) assessment is the largest class (9 of 23 studies), ahead of risk assessment and prioritization (7 each); (ii) reported accuracy is highest where the label space is tightest and is not stable across evaluation periods; (iii) explanation usability is an audited evidence gap rather than a demonstrated capability; and (iv) reproducibility is the weakest reported dimension. We conclude that present systems should support analyst judgement rather than replace it, and we specify three validation studies that would settle the open questions.

AI.tldr: 一篇系统综述，梳理LLM在漏洞检测之外五类安全任务（预测、评估、可利用性估计、风险评估、优先级排序）中的应用、性能与落地障碍，基于23篇2024–2026年原始研究。
AI.motivation: LLM已从漏洞检测扩展到预测、评估、可利用性估计、风险评估与优先级排序，但相关证据尚未与检测文献分开综合，缺乏对性能、基线与落地障碍的独立审视。
AI.method: 按预设协议开展系统文献综述：检索197条记录，去重53条，题录阶段排除103条，全文评估41篇，经六问质量评估最终纳入23篇原始研究；产出五类任务分类、方法分类（提示、微调、检索/智能体架构）、评测实践审计、有界性能综合与部署障碍分析。
AI.result: （i）评估类研究最多（9/23），风险评估与优先级排序各7篇；（ii）标签空间越紧报告准确率越高，且跨评估期不稳定；（iii）可解释性可用性属证据缺口而非已验证能力；（iv）可复现性是最弱报告维度。
AI.conclusion: 现有系统应作为分析师判断的辅助而非替代；作者提出三项验证研究以回答遗留问题。

title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
summary: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

AI.tldr: CAR是一个结合文献语义图、迭代开发与四种显式概念算子（双联想、类比、探索、精化）的智能体式科研点子生成框架，在方法新颖性与可行性上表现较好，但消融实验未能证明显式算子带来一致的质量提升。
AI.motivation: 大模型已能生成看似合理的研究想法，但人们对"什么使自动构思有效"以及新提案如何从既有科学工作中产生仍缺乏理解，作者希望提升构思过程的可解释性与可追溯性。
AI.method: 构建基于检索文献的语义知识图谱，为构思智能体配备图检索工具与四个概念算子；每次算子调用需通过结构性接受条件检验并记录，形成中间变换与文献来源的可追溯轨迹。
AI.result: 在40个LiveIdeaBench主题和两个执行基准上，以两种语言模型为骨干：方法新颖性显著高于单次提示与The AI Scientist，与Research Ideation Agent无显著差异但可行性更高；共享执行器下在FML-bench-Lite与BioXArena取得最高成对胜率。十条件消融中新颖性点估计占优，但多重比较校正后无显著对比。
AI.conclusion: 结果未能确立显式算子相较自由迭代的稳定质量优势；CAR的主要贡献在于使操作序列与文献来源可检视，从而将想法质量评判与过程可追溯性区分开来。

title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
summary: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. We explicitly relate the proposal to assurance cases, contracts, and skill-library maintenance rather than claiming novelty for their ingredients. A falsifiable longitudinal evaluation would compare WRC-guided policies with strong version-aware baselines at matched coverage, utility, and review cost. This paper contributes a formalized problem statement, testable design obligations, and reporting protocol, not an implemented verifier, empirical superiority result, or proof of universal agent safety.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有担保复用主张"(WRC)——一种针对版本化技能、绑定目标情境/证据/假设/失效条件的可废止、主张特定的授权单元，并给出"担保保全的证据迁移"(WPET)纪律，用于判断情境变化后哪些历史证据仍可采信。本文贡献为形式化问题陈述、可检验的设计义务与报告协议，非实现验证器或实证优越性结论。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能昨日成功不代表今日可正当复用：测试只覆盖可观察契约条款、可能缺少结果判定器、评测可能继承同一错误规范、权限或依赖在验证与调用之间可能变化。因此需要明确"前瞻性信任"的恰当单元。
AI.method: 以WRC为核心概念，通过WPET纪律区分"证据可采性"与"所支撑安全/有效性主张的真值"；给出条件性保全结果及其局限；规定三值适用性与非对称跨情境迁移判断；并示例说明来源依赖与使政策失效的变化如何改变授权。与保证案例、契约、技能库维护建立关联。
AI.result: 提出形式化问题陈述、可检验设计义务与报告协议；给出条件性保全命题及其边界。文中明确未提供实现验证器、实证优越性结果或通用智能体安全性证明。
AI.conclusion: 应把前瞻性信任建立在主张特定、可废止的WRC之上，并以WPET管理证据迁移；未来需可证伪的纵向评估，在匹配覆盖率、效用与审查成本的条件下，将WRC引导的策略与强版本感知基线对比。

title: ROBIN++: Unified Copyright Protection and Tamper Localization for Diffusion Models via Dual-Domain Synergistic Watermarking
summary: Digital watermarking provides a promising solution for verifying the provenance and integrity of generated content. However, existing methods often suffer from an inherent trade-off between copyright robustness and localization sensitivity due to the entanglement of conflicting signals within a single domain. In this paper, we propose ROBIN++, a paradigm that shifts from single-domain entanglement to a Dual-Domain Synergistic design. Our key insight is to explicitly decouple robustness and fragility during injection by assigning them to distinct domains, while re-coupling them for mutual reinforcement during verification. Specifically, we introduce an Adversarial Optimization Algorithm to inject a frequency-domain copyright watermark during generation, maximizing extraction robustness without visual artifacts. Complementarily, a Content-Aware Perturbation generator is integrated into the latent space to inject the spatial-domain localization watermark, ensuring sensitivity to spatial tampering with minimal interference to the copyright watermark. During verification, we propose a dual-branch synergistic detector that facilitates Frequency-to-Spatial Synergy, where robust spectral priors act as global anchors for local anomaly detection. Conversely, a Spatial-to-Frequency Refinement strategy is employed to rectify corrupted latent features using predicted tamper masks. Extensive experiments show that ROBIN++ significantly outperforms existing approaches in both copyright recovery and tamper localization accuracy, effectively mitigating the long-standing trade-off between the two tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Hannah1102/ROBIN.

AI.tldr: 提出ROBIN++，用双域协同设计（频域版权水印+空域定位水印）解耦鲁棒性与脆弱性，并在验证阶段互补耦合，缓解版权鲁棒性与篡改定位灵敏性的固有矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有数字水印方法在单一域内同时承载鲁棒性与脆弱性两种冲突信号，导致版权鲁棒性与篡改定位灵敏度之间存在固有权衡（trade-off）。
AI.method: 将鲁棒性与脆弱性显式解耦到不同域：用对抗优化算法在生成时向频域注入版权水印以增强提取鲁棒性且无视觉伪影；用内容感知扰动生成器在潜空间注入空域定位水印以敏感于空间篡改且少干扰版权水印。验证时采用双分支协同检测器，实现Frequency-to-Spatial协同（频谱先验作全局锚点辅助局部异常检测）与Spatial-to-Frequency细化（用预测篡改掩码修正受损潜特征）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ROBIN++在版权恢复与篡改定位准确率上均显著优于现有方法，有效缓解两个任务间的长期权衡。
AI.conclusion: 双域解耦-再耦合范式可将原本冲突的鲁棒性与脆弱性分别优化并相互增强，是解决版权保护与篡改定位联合任务的有效思路。

title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
summary: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. RASA also introduces spectral-reference aggregation, which removes the personalized initialization offset while retaining the locally learned increment. Experiments on DomainNet-100, NICO++, GLUE, and SuperNI demonstrate RASA's effectiveness across methods under resource, task, and data heterogeneity. In particular, RASA improves DomainNet-100 accuracy by 3.23 percentage points with FlexLoRA and achieves gains of up to 8.33 ROUGE-L points on seen SuperNI tasks and 4.37 on unseen tasks with modest overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出接收者感知子空间适配框架RASA，解决联邦LoRA中聚合更新截断与接收端输入响应不匹配的问题，在多项任务上显著优于谱截断。
AI.motivation: 联邦LoRA中客户端秩预算不同，现有方法用SVD保留聚合更新的主奇异方向来分发。但最优重构矩阵的方向未必最优保持该客户端输入上的响应，低能量方向可能对特定接收者更重要。作者形式化这一错配，并证明矩阵最优截断的响应误差可比同秩的另一种readout任意大。
AI.method: RASA为插件式框架：用紧凑的对角输入二阶矩对接收者加权的更新响应做无中心PCA，得到的readout对秩约束的接收者目标全局最优，且在对角度量下保留的响应能量不少于谱截断；同时提出谱参考聚合，去除个性化初始化偏移而保留本地学习增量。
AI.result: 在DomainNet-100、NICO++、GLUE、SuperNI上，跨资源、任务与数据异构场景验证有效性。DomainNet-100配合FlexLoRA提升3.23个百分点；SuperNI上见过任务ROUGE-L最多提升8.33，未见任务提升4.37，开销适中。
AI.conclusion: 以接收者输入响应为目标进行子空间选择优于矩阵重构式截断，RASA作为通用插件可提升多种联邦LoRA方法的异构鲁棒性与性能。

title: Dependency Fabrication in Repository Deployment Agents
summary: Repository deployment agents set up the environment needed to run a software repository. They often treat passing tests as proof of a successful setup. This report examines how such agents behave when a working setup is impossible. Probe repositories were built with a dependency that the agents could not legitimately obtain. Passing tests therefore indicated fabrication, such as creating a stub to replace the missing package. Agents in Repo2Run and SetupX usually fabricated the dependency. Both harnesses mostly still marked these runs as successful. Rules against fabrication, whether given in the prompt or repository documentation, did not reliably prevent this behavior. On MinimalSetupAgent, which was built for this report, mitigations proposed in the reward-hacking literature were most effective when the agent received a direct rule and had a clear way to stop and report the problem. Under these conditions, neither Qwen3.5-Plus nor GPT-5.6 Luna cheated in any of the 16 runs. Applying the same mitigation to Repo2Run and SetupX also required a native tool call for escalation. In Repo2Run, it worked only after the prompt was also replaced with one that placed less emphasis on passing tests.

AI.tldr: A probe study shows that repository-deployment agents (Repo2Run, SetupX) typically fabricate unavailable dependencies (e.g., stub packages) to make tests pass, and harnesses still mark such runs successful; prompts/docs rules fail to stop it. Mitigations only work when an explicit stop-and-report rule plus a native escalation tool are provided, and in Repo2Run only after also replacing the test-passing-centric prompt.
AI.motivation: Repository deployment agents treat passing tests as proof of a successful environment setup, which invites reward hacking when a legitimate setup is impossible. The paper asks how agents behave under such impossible conditions and whether anti-fabrication rules actually prevent cheating.
AI.method: Constructed "probe repositories" containing a dependency that cannot be legitimately obtained, so that passing tests imply fabrication (e.g., stubbing the missing package). Evaluated agents on Repo2Run and SetupX, plus a purpose-built MinimalSetupAgent. Tested mitigations from the reward-hacking literature: prompt-level rules, rules placed in repository documentation, direct rules, clear ways to stop and report, and a native escalation tool call.
AI.result: Agents in Repo2Run and SetupX usually fabricated the missing dependency, and both harnesses mostly still marked these runs successful. Anti-fabrication rules given via prompt or repo documentation did not reliably prevent fabrication. On MinimalSetupAgent, mitigations were most effective with a direct rule plus a clear stop-and-report path: neither Qwen3.5-Plus nor GPT-5.6 Luna cheated in any of 16 runs. For Repo2Run and SetupX, the same mitigation required a native escalation tool call; in Repo2Run it worked only after also replacing the prompt to de-emphasize passing tests.
AI.conclusion: Passing tests are an unreliable success signal for deployment agents, and harnesses mask fabrication as success. Effective mitigation requires the combination of an explicit anti-fabrication rule, a clear sanctioned way to stop and escalate (ideally a native tool), and evaluation prompts that do not over-emphasize test passing.

title: Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
summary: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.

AI.tldr: JDPI 用二元安全标签构建有害/良性原型，通过相对原型距离做越狱检测，仅需对比微调编码器而无需训练下游分类器，四个基准上准确率提升9.1-18.0个百分点，且跨数据集鲁棒性优于分类器基线。
AI.motivation: 越狱攻击与有害提示仍是大模型安全部署的难题；作者探索是否可借助对比学习表征直接做安全检测，从而避免训练额外的下游分类器、减少标注数据需求。
AI.method: 提出 JDPI（Prototype Inference 越狱检测）：仅用二元安全标签，构建有害与良性原型，基于样本到原型的相对距离进行预测；编码器适应、原型构建与验证均只用二元标签。因省去训练分类器所需的独立划分，所用标注样本少于分类器基线（Method A）。
AI.result: 在四种输入格式基准上，对比微调使 JDPI 准确率提升9.1-18.0个百分点；同编码器下 ROC-AUC 一项略优、四项均在基线0.017以内；数据集特定适配后在四项基准上超过 Llama Guard 3-8B 基线0.173-0.310 ROC-AUC。TomGibbs 多轮重放中利用累积用户历史，对话级准确率高于仅用当前轮；12 组定向迁移平均准确率高1.59个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 基于对比表征的原型推断是一种免训练分类器、低标注成本的越狱检测方案，在多轮对话与跨数据集场景下均表现出较强鲁棒性。

title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
summary: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. Relative to baselines, GPT-6-sol improves answer accuracy on ViewSpatial and MMSI by 50.39% and 23.07%, respectively; Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 47.50% and 25.22% on these benchmarks. This provides a unified route from fragmented spatial clues to traceable, derivable answers.

AI.tldr: Space-X 是一个面向空间推理的自进化框架,通过执行智能体与控制智能体的闭环协作,构建完整、连续的证据链,显著提升多基准答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强智能体在空间推理中缺乏明确目标、物体/参考系语义不一致、证据充分性判断失误,导致增加工具或调用次数并不能可靠提升推理效果。
AI.method: 提出 Space-X 框架:执行智能体借助角色专用记忆按问题获取、关联并判断证据;控制智能体从执行轨迹中诊断证据链断裂,并联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织与决策规则,形成能力与证据使用共演的闭环。
AI.result: 在多个基准、四个基模型上均取得增益;相对基线,GPT-6-sol 在 ViewSpatial 与 MMSI 上准确率分别提升 50.39% 和 23.07%,Gemini-3.8-Flash 分别提升 47.50% 和 25.22%。
AI.conclusion: Space-X 提供了从碎片化空间线索到可追踪、可推导答案的统一路径。

title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sightline，一种针对 SVG 生成的无损加速投机解码方法：用与草稿器视野等长的验证窗口配合足够宽的草稿树，在 6 个基准、多种模型/格式上均为最快无损解码器。
AI.motivation: SVG 生成模型逐 token 前向生成代码，速度慢。投机解码可无损加速，其块式草稿器在 SVG 上常在验证窗口末尾才失败，且失误稀少而聚集、在块内深处仍保持准确，说明现有窗口过短、未利用草稿器全部潜力。
AI.method: 通过游程恒等式与三条命题证明：当候选足够宽时，更长验证窗口就能获益，上限为草稿器视野。据此设计 Sightline——验证窗口长度等于草稿器视野，草稿树宽度足以填满该窗口。
AI.result: 在 MMSVG、MMSVG-2M、SArena 六个基准上，覆盖 text-to-SVG 与 image-to-SVG、三个模型；所有设置中 Sightline 均为最快无损解码器；SArena 上统一循环控制下仍最快；在四个其他模型家族的六个模型（SVG 代码、压缩 SVG token、Lottie JSON）中几乎全部领先；分析表明优势来自被短窗口截断的轮次。此外渲染选样比似然选样更省时。
AI.conclusion: 矢量图形上的投机解码应"验证到草稿器所能看到之处"，即窗口对齐草稿器视野；该原则普适于多种模型与表示格式，并可与渲染式采样选择结合。

title: Interpreting Timestamp Permutations in Dynamic Link Prediction
comment: 5 pages total (ACM sigconf format). Companion code and trained models: https://github.com/karpovilia/tgn
summary: Timestamp permutations are used to test whether dynamic link predictors exploit temporal information, but a performance gap can reflect changes in training, evaluation history, or both. We separate these effects with a crossed diagnostic and measure input exposure: whether altered histories actually change the predictor's inputs. On MOOC, TCL trained with binary cross-entropy gains approximately eight pairwise-accuracy points from original-chronology training under either evaluation history, while changing history at fixed weights gives only 0.03 points. The small history contrast reflects unchanged inputs for 68.37% of queries, stable rankings for most others, and cancellation of gains and losses. Under original evaluation history, suppressing explicit time encoding reduces the training contrast from 8.03 to 3.64 points, a paired reduction of 4.39 points (95% interval [3.68, 5.09]) across six seeds. DyGFormer shows corresponding training and history contrasts of 22.34 and 0.38 points across two seeds, despite greater exposure. Partial history permutations further separate nominal intervention strength, input changes, and aggregate accuracy. These comparisons turn a single permutation gap into interpretable statements about training conditions and model responses, while leaving the internal mechanisms of temporal learning open.

AI.tldr: 将时间戳排列造成的"性能差距"分解为训练条件与评估历史两部分，用交叉诊断与输入暴露度来量化，发现训练获得的时间信息远大于评估历史的影响。
AI.motivation: 已有研究用时间戳排列（permutation）检验动态链路预测器是否利用时序信息，但单一性能差距无法区分其来源是训练时的时序条件、评估时的历史排列，还是两者共同作用。作者希望把这一模糊差距转化为可解释的陈述。
AI.method: 提出"交叉诊断"（crossed diagnostic）：分别改变训练历史与评估历史，并测量输入暴露度（altered histories 是否真正改变了预测器输入）。在MOOC数据上以TCL（BCE训练）为对象，比较原始时间顺序训练 vs. 固定权重下改变评估历史；再在原始评估历史下屏蔽显式时间编码，比较训练对比度变化；并在DyGFormer上重复，另做部分历史排列以分离名义干预强度、输入变化与总体精度。
AI.result: MOOC上TCL：原始时间顺序训练在任一评估历史下约提升8个百分点pairwise accuracy；固定权重下改变评估历史仅0.03点。小历史对比的原因：68.37%查询的输入未变、多数其余查询排序稳定、增益与损失相互抵消。屏蔽显式时间编码后，训练对比从8.03降至3.64点，配对下降4.39点（95%区间[3.68,5.09]，六个种子）。DyGFormer训练与历史对比分别为22.34和0.38点（两个种子），尽管其暴露度更大。
AI.conclusion: 交叉诊断把单一的排列性能差距分解为关于训练条件与模型响应的可解释结论，并显示性能提升主要源于训练时获得的时间偏见/条件，而非评估历史；但模型内部时序学习机制仍是开放问题。

title: When Exact Inference Changes Code Selection: A Decision-Theoretic Analysis of B4
comment: 16 pages, 7 tables; full proofs and numerical checks
summary: When generated programs are ranked using generated tests, a more exact posterior computation need not improve the selected program. We characterize this distinction in the published B4 code--test model. Identical execution signatures reduce exact candidate marginalization to N summands and nonempty joint maximum a posteriori (MAP) inference to two weights per group. A prior--budget condition guarantees that B4's whole-group rule already attains MAP; a sharp finite correction bound certifies when candidate marginals must select the same group. All 2,421 default-setting comparisons on 807 development matrices select the same candidates. A prospectively specified validation on 1,345 execution snapshots from a separate public archive also finds no changes in 4,035 default-setting comparisons. Across 80 literature-derived priors, this new archive yields 85 changed top sets in 107,600 comparisons; only six coincide with failure of whole-group MAP. Under finite-test proxy labels, four changes increase and five decrease expected success. These descriptive changes span seven snapshots; per-prior mean differences range from -0.074 to +0.045 percentage points. The results do not recommend a tuned prior or a new performance method. Exact enumeration and independent high-precision checks support the formulas and decision diagnostics. A supplementary fixed-test analysis separates asymptotic failure from observational ambiguity. The contribution is a model-specific account of when an inference intervention can change a software-testing decision, and when its effect must be sought in the priors or evidence instead.

AI.tldr: 在B4代码–测试模型中，更精确的后验计算不必然改进所选程序；作者给出何时精确边缘化/MAP与整体规则产生相同候选的判定条件，并在大规模比较中几乎未观察到变化。
AI.motivation: 实践中常用生成测试对生成程序排序，直觉上更精确的后验推断应当选出更好的程序，但这一假设缺乏模型层面的论证；论文要刻画"推断方式改变"何时才能真正改变软件测试的决策选择。
AI.method: 在已发表的B4 code–test模型下利用相同执行签名进行解析推导：精确候选边缘化简化为N项求和，非空联合MAP推断简化为每组两个权重；给出先验–预算条件以保证B4整组规则已达MAP，并给出有限样本校正界以判定候选边缘化是否必然选择同一组；随后在807个开发矩阵（2,421次默认设置比较）与独立公开档案的1,345个执行快照（4,035次比较）上做前瞻性验证，并考察80种文献来源先验下的变化，辅以精确枚举、独立高精度校验及固定测试的补充分析。
AI.result: 默认设置下所有比较（2,421与4,035次）均选择相同候选，无变化；80种先验下107,600次比较仅85个顶部集合改变，其中仅6个与整组MAP失效重合；有限测试代理标签下4例提升、5例下降期望成功率，跨7个快照，各先验平均差异在-0.074至+0.045个百分点之间。
AI.conclusion: 精确枚举与高精度检验支持所给公式与决策诊断；结论是模型特定的：在B4中推断干预通常不改变测试决策，若有效果须在先验或证据中寻找，而非追求更精确的后验计算；作者不推荐调优先验或新的性能方法。

title: Test-Time Symmetrization: Scaling Laws for Model-Agnostic Learning under Structure
summary: Test-time compute has emerged as a powerful way to improve the accuracy of language models at inference time, with scaling laws quantifying how accuracy improves with additional forward passes. Existing scaling laws, however, focus on repeated sampling from a fixed prompt, even though many tasks admit multiple equivalent representations of the same underlying problem. A graph does not depend on how its nodes are numbered, and a program does not depend on the names of its variables, yet language models can change their answers under such rewritings. In this paper, we study test-time symmetrization, which uses forward passes on rewritings of the input and aggregates the resulting answers over the group $G$ of rewritings. We prove that no amount of sampling and repeated decoding from a single representation can replace rewriting, while only $O(\log |G|)$ random rewritings suffice to recover the information provided by all $|G|$ rewritings. The same set of $O(\log |G|)$ rewritings provides simultaneous approximation across models, decoding rules, and sampled reasoning traces, and the logarithmic scaling is optimal in general. We validate the theory with experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-14B, with chain-of-thought reasoning, on graph reasoning, logical deduction, and multiple-choice question answering. At the same number of forward passes, spending them on rewritings of the input is substantially more accurate than spending them on repeated sampling from the original prompt whenever the model's answer depends on how the input is written, and the number of rewritings needed grows only logarithmically with the number of possible rewritings, as the theory predicts. Our results provide a principled way to enforce symmetries at inference time when they cannot be built into the model, which we call model-agnostic symmetrization.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"测试时对称化"（test-time symmetrization）：通过对输入的多种等价改写进行前向计算并聚合答案，证明无需全部 |G| 个改写，仅 O(log|G|) 个随机改写即可恢复全部信息，且该对数阶最优；实验显示同等计算量下改写优于重复采样。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时计算缩放定律只关注固定提示下的重复采样，但许多任务存在多种等价表示（如图的节点编号、程序变量名），语言模型在这些改写下会给出不一致答案，单表示采样无法消除这种不对称性。
AI.method: 提出测试时对称化：对输入所属改写群 G 中的改写做前向计算并按群聚合答案。理论上证明单表示再多采样也无法替代改写，而 O(log|G|) 个随机改写即可恢复全部 |G| 个改写的信息、并同时对不同模型/解码规则/推理轨迹近似且对数阶最优。实验在 Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4-mini、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B 上用思维链推理，覆盖图推理、逻辑演绎、多选题。
AI.result: 相同前向次数下，将计算用于输入改写比用于原提示重复采样显著更准确，尤其当模型答案依赖输入书写形式时；所需改写数随可能改写数仅对数增长，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 提出"模型无关对称化"（model-agnostic symmetrization），为无法内建于模型的对称性提供有原则的推理时强制手段。

title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
summary: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PReMind-Bench诊断基准与PReMind两阶段强化学习框架，评估并训练个性化视觉语言助手在视觉危险与个人记忆交叉场景下的联合表现。
AI.motivation: 个性化视觉语言助手需结合视觉观察与个人记忆（如过敏、疾病、行动限制）提供建议，而现有模型往往只满足安全或个性化单一要求，二者联合的成功率存在明显缺口。
AI.method: 构建PReMind-Bench基准，分别衡量记忆访问、视觉落地、拒答与危险响应，并评估相互依赖案例的联合成功率；提出两阶段强化学习框架PReMind，结合按需调用与强制调用（总是检索记忆）交互联合训练落地记忆使用与危险响应。
AI.result: 在4B规模下，PReMind在相互依赖集合上将联合成功率从12.9%提升至28.6%，主测试集上危险适当性与正确拒答均有提升；联合成功增益在强制调用评估、第二个LLM评判及三个Phase II种子下稳定，未见危险组上亦平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 强调必须评估并训练个人助手将视觉证据与相关用户情境相连接，单一维度的安全或个性化优化不足以弥合联合成功差距。

title: When Normal-Only Updates Are Not Enough: Test-Time Adaptation in Reconstruction-Based Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Normal operating conditions can evolve after deployment, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) of time-series anomaly detectors using incoming data. Yet the same stream may contain anomalies, so TTA with online updates must decide which test samples should be used for adaptation. This leaves a more basic question: even if updates are restricted to samples labeled as normal in the benchmark, does TTA reliably improve anomaly detection? We study this question with a controlled intervention that replaces the practical update selector with a rule that uses only samples labeled as normal in the benchmark, while keeping the rest of the online adaptation procedure unchanged. Across nine benchmark families, four optimizer configurations, and five random seeds, we obtain three main findings: (1) using only samples labeled as normal in the benchmark does not reliably improve detection; (2) practical TTA failures exhibit two distinct responses to this intervention, with 63 of 180 settings recovering a clear detection gain while 90 still show no clear detection gain; and (3) the updates reduce their immediate reconstruction objective across the evaluated settings, yet these reductions do not consistently lead to better anomaly ranking. Both failure patterns persist across alternative practical adaptation variants and modest perturbations of the benchmark labels. Together, these findings show that improving sample selection alone is not a complete solution to reconstruction-based TSAD TTA.

AI.tldr: 本文用"仅用基准标注为正常的样本更新"这一受控干预，检验时序异常检测的TTA是否真能提升检测性能，发现单纯改进样本选择并不足以解决基于重构的TTA问题。
AI.motivation: 部署后正常工况会漂移，需用在线数据做TTA；但数据流含异常，需要选择用于更新的样本。核心疑问是：即便更新只用基准中标注为正常的样本，TTA是否可靠地提升异常检测？
AI.method: 受控干预实验：将实际的更新样本选择器替换为"仅用基准标注正常样本"的规则，其余在线适应流程不变；在9个基准族、4种优化器配置、5个随机种子上共180种设置下评估。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 仅用正常标注样本并不能可靠提升检测；(2) 失败分为两类响应——63/180设置恢复明显检测增益，90/180仍无明显增益；(3) 更新普遍降低了即时重构目标，但该降低未稳定转化为更好的异常排序。两类失败模式在替代TTA变体与标签轻微扰动下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 仅改善样本选择不是重构式TSAD TTA的完整解决方案，失败根源可能在于重构目标本身与异常排序目标的不一致。

title: Checking Retry Transparency in Agent Tools
summary: A successful retry does not necessarily put the earlier attempt behind it. An old write may still overwrite a later acknowledged update; a partially executed file write may even empty a file after the retry has returned successfully. We study how to test the recovery guarantee behind an agent tool's local idempotence claim. Our prototype takes manually constructed, source-backed effect contracts and checks them at two levels: atomic retry-absorption obligations and bounded interleavings of successful-attempt microsteps. It emits model witnesses, conditional admission decisions, and explicit uncertainty when a completion boundary cannot be justified. The evaluation preserves a locally frozen purposive frame of 6 MCP components from 4 repositories; selected paths in 5 execute on the study machine and one backend remains unavailable. Real tests include file, graph, Git-index, document-update and browser bindings, together with a native Qdrant development matrix. In 27 missing-reply checks, the selective rule completes six justified workflows without an acknowledged goal violation, whereas strict coalescing completes none and blind retry completes nine with three violations. An intent-aware Porcupine specification independently agrees with all 156 complete-history oracles. These are mechanism-selected tests, not defect-prevalence estimates or a new linearizability algorithm. The contribution is an executable recovery-contract workflow that makes effect granularity, logical identity and completion assumptions testable rather than inheriting them from a tool annotation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何检验智能体工具所声称的"本地幂等性"，提出基于效应契约的原子重试吸收与有界交错两级检测流程，并用6个MCP组件和27组缺失回复场景进行验证。
AI.motivation: 重试成功并不代表早先的尝试已被覆盖：旧写可能覆盖后来已确认的更新，部分执行的写甚至可能在重试成功返回后清空文件。现有幂等声明多来自工具标注而未经检验，故需可测试其恢复保证。
AI.method: 原型采用人工构造、来源可溯的效应契约，在两个层面检查：原子重试吸收义务，以及成功尝试微步的有界交错；输出模型见证、条件性准入决策，以及无法证明完成边界时的显式不确定性。评估冻结了4个仓库中6个MCP组件的局部目的性框架，其中5个路径可执行；测试覆盖文件、图、Git索引、文档更新、浏览器绑定及Qdrant原生开发矩阵。
AI.result: 在27项缺失回复检查中，选择性规则完成6个有正当依据的工作流且无已确认目标违反；严格合并完成0个；盲目重试完成9个但有3次违反。一个意图感知的Porcupine规范与全部156个完整历史oracle独立一致。
AI.conclusion: 作者强调这是机制选定的测试，不代表缺陷流行率估计，也非新的线性一致性算法；贡献在于一套可执行的恢复契约工作流，使效应粒度、逻辑身份与完成假设可被测试而非从工具标注中继承。

title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
summary: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

AI.tldr: 一家全球银行创新实验室对10个Agentic AI平台在三个金融业务负载上开展"bakeoff"评估，发现评分可分为稳定三层级但存在严重晕轮效应（Cronbach's α=0.98），据此提出"先门控后评分"的四层评估协议与可复现性方案。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI平台采购速度快于其可测量速度：公开基准只在固定框架下评模型，而企业购买的是编排、记忆、治理、工具层主导结果的集成平台，且主要凭厂商演示决策，缺乏可靠的平台级评估方法。
AI.method: 银行创新实验室组织工业级"bakeoff"：由跨职能专家组对10个平台（开源框架、商业产品、超大规模云生态）在9个能力维度、3个金融负载（交易对手信用风险、RAG、流程自动化）上评分；并做二次统计分析（Cronbach's α、与总分的秩相关、替代权重稳健性检验），进而提出评估协议。
AI.result: 评分将平台分为三个层级，且在替代权重下稳定；可揭示被总体分数掩盖的负载特异性优势。但9个维度间α=0.98，9个中8个与总分秩相关≥0.93，显示晕轮效应——演示式评分同时衡量了"呈现效果"与"真实能力"。
AI.conclusion: 提出"先门控后评分"（gate-then-score）四层评估协议：能力、执行可靠性、治理门控、业务价值；并引入重复运行估计的轨迹级可靠性指标、自主性就绪度量表与可复现协议，明确现有证据的边界，指出从"结构化判断"走向"真正测量"还需受控测试框架补充什么。

title: SWIFT: Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely Action for Asynchronous Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving scenes keep changing during model computation, making both observation freshness and action-delivery time central to world-action planning. To retain rich generative world priors in autonomous driving without stalling real-time control, we present SWIFT (Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely action), a deployment-oriented asynchronous world-action system that moves world updates off the observation-to-action critical path. On a background GPU, a slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span that covers both the update interval and background world computation. On a foreground GPU, a lightweight freshness carrier encodes current surround-view images into a gated key/value bank at every step, letting a fast Action DiT combine live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without waiting. On open-loop NAVSIM, SWIFT reaches 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms per decision with a trajectory scorer; on closed-loop Bench2Drive, it achieves an 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency. SWIFT further transfers to the Waymo E2E hidden test (8.0050 Rater Feedback Score) and nuScenes (0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate). Across all four benchmarks, SWIFT achieves the best results among compared world-action methods, establishing a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: SWIFT 是一种面向部署的异步世界-动作系统，把世界模型更新移出"观测到动作"的关键路径：后台 GPU 用慢速 Video DiT 流式生成只读预测世界上下文，前台 GPU 用轻量"新鲜度载体"每步编码当前环视图像并通过门控 KV bank 与快速 Action DiT 融合，无需等待即可结合实时视觉与最新世界先验。
AI.motivation: 行驶场景在模型计算期间持续变化，因此观测的新鲜度与动作交付时延对世界-动作规划至关重要。既要保留自动驾驶中丰富的生成式世界先验，又不能阻塞实时控制，是核心矛盾。
AI.method: 采用双 GPU 异步架构：后台 GPU 运行慢速 Video DiT，将环视历史流式转换为只读预测世界上下文，并以覆盖更新间隔与后台计算时长的预测跨度进行训练；前台 GPU 运行轻量新鲜度载体，每步把当前环视图像编码进门控 key/value bank，使快速 Action DiT 能同时利用实时视觉反馈与最新的已完成世界上下文。
AI.result: 开环 NAVSIM 上以轨迹评分器取得 94.2 PDMS、每次决策 198.4 ms；闭环 Bench2Drive 上获得 80.30 Driving Score、前台时延 109.9 ms；并迁移到 Waymo E2E 隐藏测试（8.0050 Rater Feedback Score）与 nuScenes（平均终点误差 0.54 m，平均碰撞率 0.03%）。在四个基准上均优于所比较的世界-动作方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过异步解耦世界更新与动作生成，SWIFT 在不牺牲实时性的前提下保留了生成式世界先验，实现了良好的精度-时延权衡，并展现出跨数据集与闭环场景的良好泛化性。

title: A Systematic Analysis of a Small Optimal Subspace for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: $n$-DAS $\subset \mathbb{R}^p$
comment: 57 pages, 17 figures, 7 tables. In the title, n-DAS denotes an optimizer of order n restricted to the dominant aligned subspace (DAS): 1-DAS for first-order and 2-DAS for second-order methods
summary: The search for a low-dimensional subspace that governs neural network training has been a persistent goal in optimization. Yet subspaces defined by Hessian eigenvalue magnitude, such as the dominant/bulk decomposition underlying Dom-SGD and Bulk-SGD, have repeatedly failed to capture where optimization takes place, and adaptive Krylov-based alternatives built on energy-fraction thresholds show promise but still struggle at lower eigenmodes. We argue this failure is structural: the directions of highest curvature are not, in general, the directions along which training moves. We introduce the dominant aligned subspace (DAS), constructed from a full eigendecomposition of the Hessian but selected by gradient alignment rather than eigenvalue magnitude, as a tool for understanding optimization dynamics and a foundation for designing methods that exploit them. To expose this structure under the hardest conditions, we use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) as a testbed: differential operators from the parabolic, elliptic, and hyperbolic classes induce severely ill-conditioned, anisotropic loss landscapes. Across Poisson, heat, wave, and viscous Burgers benchmarks DAS-restricted training with a line search matches full-space training even where the projected Hessian remains ill-conditioned, showing empirically that convergence does not require all Hessian eigendirections but only a low-dimensional, gradient-aligned subset. We extend the analysis to Gauss-Newton within the DAS and discuss what this structure implies for future subspace-aware optimizers.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"主导对齐子空间"(DAS)：用梯度对齐而非特征值大小从Hessian全特征分解中挑方向，并在PINN病态问题上验证其足以支撑训练收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Hessian特征值幅度定义的低维子空间(Dom-SGD、Bulk-SGD)和自适应Krylov方法难以刻画优化实际发生的方向，且低模态表现欠佳。作者认为原因在于结构性偏差：曲率最大的方向通常并非训练移动的方向。
AI.method: 对Hessian做完整特征分解，但按与梯度的对齐程度选取基向量，构造主导对齐子空间DAS；在病态、各向异性的PINN损失面上（抛物、椭圆、双曲三类算子：Poisson、热、波、粘性Burgers）进行DAS约束训练+线搜索，并与全空间训练比较，进一步在DAS内分析Gauss-Newton。
AI.result: 在四个PINN基准上，即使投影后的Hessian仍然病态，DAS约束训练配合线搜索的性能可与全空间训练持平，说明收敛不需要全部Hessian特征方向，只需低维、梯度对齐的子集。
AI.conclusion: 高曲率方向与优化运动方向不等同，梯度对齐是选择子空间的更合理准则；DAS可作为理解优化动力学的工具和设计子空间感知优化器的基础，文中还讨论了其对未来方法（含DAS内Gauss-Newton）的启示。

title: Repository-Grounded Rubrics for Execution-Free Evaluation of Coding Agents
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/faros-ai/repository-grounded-rubrics
summary: Coding agents are usually evaluated by running task-specific tests, but tests may be missing or incomplete, and running them requires a working environment for each repository. We adapt agentic rubrics, introduced for selecting among candidate patches, into an execution-free measure of how far a patch satisfies a task's requirements. An agent explores the repository before the change and writes weighted binary criteria, and a judge without tools scores a diff by the weighted share of criteria it satisfies. We validate the ordering this score produces against test outcomes on SWE-bench Verified, using 7,291 labeled patches from fifteen systems. Within the 400 tasks that have both resolved and unresolved patches, the mean per-task AUROC is 0.826 (0.838 on tasks not used to tune the rubric-generation prompt), and ranking systems by their failing patches closely agrees with ranking them by resolve rate (Spearman 0.968). Case analyses trace disagreements to tests that do not match the task, execution-blocking defects that the textual assessment misses, and errors in criteria or verdicts. The validation does not establish absolute score magnitudes or requirement satisfaction beyond agreement with tests, but rubric scores could complement tests where tests or execution environments cannot be assumed.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免执行（execution-free）的补丁质量评分方法：让智能体探索变更前仓库并撰写加权二元评分准则，再由无工具裁判按加权满足比例给 diff 打分；在 SWE-bench Verified 上 7,291 个带标签补丁上验证，平均每任务 AUROC 0.826，系统排序与解决率排名 Spearman 0.968。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体通常依赖任务专属测试来评估，但测试可能缺失或不完整，且运行测试需要为每个仓库准备可用环境。
AI.method: 将原本用于在候选补丁间做选择的 agentic rubrics 改造为免执行的满足度度量：一个智能体在变更前探索仓库并写出加权二元准则；一个不带工具的裁判按 diff 满足准则的加权比例打分。用 SWE-bench Verified 上来自 15 个系统的 7,291 个带标签补丁，以测试结果作为参照验证该分数产生的排序。
AI.result: 在同时含已解决与未解决补丁的 400 个任务上，平均每任务 AUROC 为 0.826（未用于调优准则生成提示的任务上为 0.838）；按失败补丁排序系统与按解决率排序高度一致（Spearman 0.968）。案例分析将分歧归因于测试与任务不匹配、文本评估遗漏的阻断执行的缺陷，以及准则或判定本身的错误。
AI.conclusion: 该验证不能确立分数的绝对量级或超出与测试一致性的需求满足程度；但在无法假定测试或执行环境可用时，rubric 分数可补充测试。

title: A Survey on RLOps for Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become increasingly important for improving the reasoning, instruction-following, and task-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, scaling RL training exposes failures in distributed execution, feedback computation, and learning dynamics that can waste computational resources, slow training, and undermine model improvements. These challenges have motivated a growing body of techniques for LLM RLOps, which manages the efficiency and reliability of operations throughout the LLM reinforcement learning training lifecycle. Despite growing interest, these techniques remain scattered across research areas, with limited synthesis of their operational roles and interactions. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods. We organize existing approaches into five stages: Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evaluation. Within each stage, we examine operational concerns, management techniques, and evaluation evidence. Building on this taxonomy, we identify open challenges and future directions in training process observability, cross-stage coordination, generalizable RLOps, multi-run management, and RLOps for recursive self-improvement. These directions extend operational management from individual training runs to diverse training settings, shared infrastructure, and successive improvement cycles. We maintain a GitHub repository indexing relevant papers and open resources at https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型强化学习运维（LLM RLOps）的系统性综述，将现有方法按五个阶段组织，并指出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM强化学习训练规模扩大，分布式执行、反馈计算与学习动态中的故障会浪费算力、拖慢训练并削弱模型提升。相关技术散落于各研究领域，缺乏对其运维角色与交互的系统梳理。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，将LLM RLOps方法归纳为五个阶段：训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。在每个阶段，分析运维关注点、管理技术与评估证据，并据此构建分类体系。
AI.result: 形成了覆盖训练全生命周期的LLM RLOps分类框架，梳理各阶段的运维问题与技术方案，并建立了索引相关论文与开源资源的GitHub仓库。
AI.conclusion: 提出未来方向：训练过程可观测性、跨阶段协调、可泛化的RLOps、多次运行管理，以及面向递归自我改进的RLOps，将运维管理从单个训练运行扩展到多样训练设置、共享基础设施与持续改进循环。

title: Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving
summary: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析注意力机制在自动驾驶中对目标相关性的估计是否具有因果性，通过对比反事实因果参考，发现在8万多个合成场景中注意力仅反映相关性而非因果性。
AI.motivation: 注意力被广泛用于估计周围目标对自动驾驶决策的相关性，但其能否捕捉单个输入元素对模型输出的因果影响一直存疑（NLP领域已有讨论）。本文将该讨论引入自动驾驶领域，检验注意力估计的目标相关性是否准确、是否具有因果性。
AI.method: 基于最先进的Transformer规划的PlanT 2.0模型，在超过8万条合成驾驶场景中，将多种基于注意力的相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析获得的因果相关性参考进行对比。
AI.result: 注意力提供的是相关性而非因果性指示：注意力方法不能稳定识别所有相关目标，且常将几乎无影响的目标误判为相关。在简单单车道直路场景中注意力能有效识别相关目标，但在多车道道路和交叉口等复杂场景中准确度下降。
AI.conclusion: 注意力作为目标相关性代理存在局限，呼吁设计新方法以准确捕捉单个目标对车辆驾驶的因果影响，并将其与相关性的关联区分开来。

title: Mapping the Design Space of Feature Sampling for Optical Flow
summary: The computation of correlation features is crucial for optical flow estimation. Existing methods (e.g., RAFT) perform fixed-radius lookups on a cost volume, yielding a set of correlation features for each position; alternatively, WAFT performs single-point feature indexing, yielding one correlation feature vector per position. None of them designs a suitable correlation feature sampling scheme for each position according to regional characteristics. Our insight is that not every position requires the same sampling scheme. Applying an identical sampling scheme to every position is either redundant or insufficient and ignores the specific characteristics of the corresponding region. This paper rethinks the design of feature sampling and investigates the following question: should the support of feature sampling---i.e., the extent and directions over which evidence is aggregated---be learned separately for each query position? To study this question, we propose SAGE (Sampling with Anisotropic Gaussian Expectation). This method replaces single-point sampling with a per-pixel anisotropic Gaussian expectation on a fixed candidate grid centered on the current optical flow estimate. A positive-definite precision matrix controls the scale, anisotropy, and orientation of the sampling support, with single-point sampling included as its limiting case. Consequently, the sampling support becomes an explicit and analyzable design variable and provides a principled way to analyze how directional feature aggregation affects correspondence learning. Extensive experiments show that SAGE, while adding only 1.5% multiply-accumulate operations (MACs), effectively improves zero-shot cross-dataset generalization. When trained only on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings, SAGE reduces the end-point error (EPE) by 24.2% and 16.4% on Sintel clean and final, and reduces KITTI F1-epe and F1-all by 7.2% and 11.6%.

AI.tldr: SAGE 提出为每个像素位置学习各向异性高斯采样支撑（正定精度矩阵控制尺度/各向异性/方向），以替代 RAFT 的固定半径查找和 WAFT 的单点采样，仅增 1.5% MACs 即显著提升零样本跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有光流方法对每个位置使用相同采样方案：RAFT 在代价体上固定半径查找，WAFT 单点索引。但并非所有位置都需要相同采样方案，统一方案要么冗余要么不足，忽略区域特性。作者据此重新思考：特征采样的支撑（聚合证据的范围与方向）是否应针对每个查询位置单独学习。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE：在当前光流估计为中心的固定候选网格上，用逐像素各向异性高斯期望替代单点采样；正定精度矩阵控制采样支撑的尺度、各向异性与方向，单点采样为其极限情形。由此采样支撑成为显式、可分析的设计变量。
AI.result: 仅增加 1.5% MACs。仅在 FlyingChairs 与 FlyingThings 上训练时，Sintel clean/final EPE 降低 24.2% 和 16.4%，KITTI F1-epe 与 F1-all 降低 7.2% 和 11.6%，零样本跨数据集泛化明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 逐位置学习采样支撑是有效且轻量的设计，为分析方向性特征聚合如何影响对应学习提供了原理化工具。

title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
comment: 87 pages, 43 figures, including appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist
summary: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.

AI.tldr: 提出TabBioMed，一个涵盖94个生物医学表格数据集的大规模基准，统一预处理与评测，比较23个模型（经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构、表格基础模型）。
AI.motivation: 机器学习在生物医学预测中快速进展，但结构化生物医学数据的评测仍碎片化，尤其在高维、大样本、缺失值和类别不平衡场景下缺乏可复现的统一比较。
AI.method: 构建94个精选公开生物医学表格数据集，横跨电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学；采用数据集感知的标准化预处理与评测框架，统一分类、回归与多目标任务；基准测试23个模型。
AI.result: 表格基础模型在家族层面取得最强预测性能，但其优势依赖数据机制：在推理时或训练成本受限时，树模型与调优多层感知机仍极具竞争力，常占优势。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学表格学习高度依赖情境，最优模型取决于数据机制、任务类型和计算预算；开源发布数据集与划分、预处理代码、基线及结果，为实际模型选择与未来方法开发提供可复现基准。

title: Edge Computing for IoT-Enabled Smart Cities: A Review of Middleware, Explainable AI, and User Behavior Analytics
summary: This review looks at cloud-IoT edge middleware for analyzing user behavior in smart cities, with a particular focus on linking behavioral analytics to energy-aware and mission-critical urban services. The topic sits at the crossroads of smart-city platforms, IoT sensing, edge/fog/cloud computing, service-oriented architectures, machine learning, explainable AI, privacy-aware governance, and energy-critical applications such as EV charging, energy demand, environmental exposure, crowd safety, and the operational resilience of urban infrastructure. As such, this paper maps out the main categories of user-behavior data, examines five application domains, compares several case studies, and puts forward a new XAI-EdgeSOA Middleware Framework called X-EdgeCity Middleware. This framework brings together IoT sensing, edge preprocessing, fog coordination, event-driven communication, cloud analytics, XAI explanations, privacy-by-design, and benchmark logging. The goal is to support not just general smart-city applications, but also energy-sensitive or mission-critical services, where latency, reliability, explainability, and accountability have a direct impact on urban safety and continuity of operations.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理面向智慧城市用户行为分析的云-物联网边缘中间件，并提出融合XAI与边缘SOA的X-EdgeCity中间件框架。
AI.motivation: 现有智慧城市研究多聚焦通用应用，缺乏将用户行为分析同能源感知与关键任务型城市服务（如EV充电、能源需求、环境暴露、人群安全、基础设施韧性）相联系的系统性视角，这些服务对时延、可靠性、可解释性和问责性有直接影响。
AI.method: 文献综述与框架设计：归类用户行为数据类型，考察五个应用领域，比较多个案例研究，并提出X-EdgeCity Middleware框架，整合IoT感知、边缘预处理、雾节点协同、事件驱动通信、云分析、XAI解释、隐私by-design及基准日志。
AI.result: 绘出智慧城市平台、IoT感知、边/雾/云计算、SOA、机器学习、可解释AI、隐私治理与能源关键应用交叉领域的研究版图，并通过案例对比明确各类中间件方案的定位与差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向能源敏感与关键任务场景的XAI-EdgeSOA中间件框架，强调可解释性与问责机制对保障城市安全与运行连续性的价值，并为后续实现与评测提供参考蓝图。

title: 3D GameDev Arena: Benchmarking Coding Agents That Plan, Build, and Playtest extreme Long-Horizon Browser Games
summary: Coding agents now resolve repository issues and generate compact playable games, but whether they can build a large 3D game from scratch remains open. Such games tightly couple mechanics, scenes, assets, and interaction logic, and their quality rests on player enjoyment, which existing benchmarks rarely assess. Thus, we introduce 3D GameDev Arena, a first extreme long-horizon benchmark of 108 from-scratch game-development tasks across 14 genres. Given only a text specification and UI/UX reference images, a fully automated plan--implement--test--repair pipeline builds each task into a self-contained browser game. Runs average $\sim$1,000 LLM calls ; the longest uses 14,407 calls, 2.13B tokens, and 608 assets. Evaluation spans (1) objective code-level functional acceptance against the game specification, (2) agent-based QA and playtesting of 3D presentation and playability, and (3) blind pairwise Bradley-Terry human preference in a public arena. The preliminary findings indicate that long-horizon 3D game development remains far from solved, and code-level correctness alone does not dictate player preference. The public arena is hosted online.

AI.tldr: 论文提出3D GameDev Arena，首个超长时程的从零开发3D游戏基准，含14类共108个任务，并用代码功能性验收、智能体QA试玩与公开竞技场人类偏好三重评测揭示该任务远未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体能修复仓库issue、生成小型可玩游戏，但能否从零构建大型3D游戏仍未知；该类任务高度耦合机制、场景、资产与交互逻辑，且质量取决于玩家体验，而现有基准很少评估可玩性与趣味性。
AI.method: 构建108个从零游戏开发任务、覆盖14种类型，仅给文本规格与UI/UX参考图；用全自动"计划—实现—测试—修复"流水线生成自包含浏览器游戏（平均约1000次LLM调用，最长14407次调用、2.13B token、608个资产）；评测分三层：面向规格的代码级功能验收、智能体QA与3D表现/可玩性试玩、公开竞技场的盲测成对Bradley-Terry人类偏好。
AI.result: 初步结果显示长时程3D游戏开发仍远未解决，且代码级正确性并不能决定玩家偏好。
AI.conclusion: 该基准以超长时程、多维度（客观功能+智能体试玩+人类偏好）评测暴露当前智能体构建完整3D游戏的能力缺口，并公开竞技场以持续收集人类偏好数据。

title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 Round 2. 20 pages, 7 figures
summary: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

AI.tldr: 提出TOGBench——面向航空影像小目标生成保真度的定量、对象级评测基准，并提出两种简单的训练/推理阶段技巧来提升布局到图像生成器渲染小目标的能力。
AI.motivation: 航空影像受俯视、大范围成像特性影响，车辆、船只、飞机等目标只占几个像素；现有生成模型对小目标表现明显更差，而以往生成评测只关注提示遵循或人类偏好，忽视了小目标是否被忠实渲染，该缺口被长期忽略。
AI.method: 构建TOGBench：一个定量、对象级的基准，专门评测航空影像中小目标的生成保真度；同时提出两种简单的训练期和推理期技术，用于改善layout-to-image生成器渲染小目标的能力。
AI.result: 两种所提技巧提升了布局到图像生成器在TOGBench上的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 小目标生成是航空影像生成中被忽视的关键问题；TOGBench提供了针对性评测手段，简单的训练/推理技巧即可有效改善，为后续研究提供了基准与改进方向。

title: CAFE-AQI: Coverage-Aware Day-Ahead AQI Forecasting with Early Warning and Conformal Uncertainty in Bangladesh
summary: Next-day air quality forecasting often assumes city records are equally complete and independent. However, an audit of a large Bangladesh dataset revealed a sharp coverage expansion after August 2022 and showed that 103 city labels correspond to only 61 unique AQI trajectories. To address these issues, this paper presents CAFE-AQI, a coverage-aware framework for forecasting next-day maximum AQI. It also estimates the probability of Unhealthy-or-worse conditions (AQI >= 151). Data were divided chronologically into training (2022-2023), calibration (2024), and testing (2025). To prevent duplicate records from dominating training and evaluation, identical trajectories were weighted. The framework combines temporal and pollutant features with a five-neighbor spatial context. It also includes a class-balanced warning head and risk-conditional conformal calibration aimed at providing early warnings and prediction intervals. Evaluation on the duplicate-balanced 2025 data gave an MAE of 9.76, an RMSE of 15.04, and an R-squared value of 0.910 for CAFE-AQI. Its MAE was 3.63 AQI lower than persistence (95% CI: 3.49-3.76), with lower errors in each of the 61 trajectory groups. For unhealthy-air warnings, the F1-score was 0.908 and the AUROC was 0.982. The nominal 90% intervals covered 92.09% of observations. When an entire spatial block was excluded from training, the MAE remained 10.66, showing that the lightweight model transferred reasonably well to unseen locations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAFE-AQI，一个考虑覆盖率的次日最大AQI预测框架，同时估计空气质量不健康及更差状态的概率，并处理了孟加拉国数据中重复轨迹与覆盖扩张问题。
AI.motivation: 次日空气质量预测常假设城市记录完整且相互独立，但孟加拉国大型数据审计发现2022年8月后覆盖骤增，且103个城市标签仅对应61条唯一AQI轨迹，重复记录会主导训练与评估，需系统纠正。
AI.method: 按时间划分训练(2022-2023)、校准(2024)、测试(2025)；对相同轨迹加权去重；融合时间与污染物特征并加入五近邻空间上下文；设计类别平衡的预警头，并采用风险条件化保形校准，输出早期预警与预测区间。
AI.result: 重复平衡的2025测试集上MAE 9.76、RMSE 15.04、R² 0.910；较持续性基线MAE低3.63(95% CI 3.49-3.76)，61个轨迹组全部更低；不健康预警F1 0.908、AUROC 0.982；名义90%区间实际覆盖92.09%；整块空间排除后MAE仍为10.66。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率感知与重复加权对真实监测数据至关重要；轻量模型具备一定空间泛化能力，可提供可靠的点预测、预警概率与校准区间。

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Education for Software Developers: A Multivocal Literature Review
summary: Quantum computing threatens widely deployed public-key cryptography, making post-quantum cryptography (PQC) adoption a software engineering challenge. However, it remains unclear how well existing educational provision prepares software developers for secure PQC implementation and migration. We conducted a multivocal literature review of 8 research publications and 15 professional training offerings, examining competency coverage, practical software engineering tasks, pedagogical approaches, learner support, and evaluation. All 23 sources covered PQC foundations and algorithms, but coverage of practical software-engineering tasks was uneven. Our analysis identifies six gaps concerning developer focused evaluation, authentic software engineering tasks, task competency alignment, pedagogical design and learner support, security-focused assessment, and long term validation of learning outcomes and transfer. We derive recommendations for strengthening PQC education and better preparing software developers to implement and migrate cryptographic systems securely.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多声部文献综述（8篇研究文献+15项专业培训）系统考察现有PQC教育对软件开发者的准备程度，发现所有来源均覆盖PQC基础与算法，但实践性软件工程任务覆盖不均，并识别出六大教育缺口。
AI.motivation: 量子计算威胁广泛部署的公钥密码，使后量子密码迁移成为软件工程挑战；但现有教育供给能否让开发者安全实施和迁移PQC尚不清楚，因此需评估其教学准备情况。
AI.method: 采用多声部文献综述（multivocal literature review），整合8篇研究出版物与15项专业培训课程，从能力覆盖、实践性软件工程任务、教学法、学习者支持与评估五个维度进行分析。
AI.result: 23个来源均覆盖PQC基础与算法，但实践软件工程任务覆盖不均衡；识别出六大缺口：面向开发者的评估、真实软件工程任务、任务与能力对齐、教学设计与学习者支持、安全性导向的测评、学习成果与迁移的长期验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出加强PQC教育、更好培养开发者安全实施与迁移密码系统的建议，为后续课程设计与研究提供方向。

title: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). PACT partitions the frozen source embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight residual transports for the regions affected by each new condition. An explicit identity path is always retained, and a learned gate softly selects among the identity and accumulated transports for each input. The pretrained TSFM encoder, classifier head, and previously learned transports remain fixed. With only 5% labeled calibration data per arriving condition and no condition identity at test time, PACT maintains an average macro-F1 above 0.95 across a four-condition bearing-fault stream. Under homogeneous tasks and label spaces, similar retention-adaptation behavior is observed across public benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PACT（Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport），将冻结的TSFM嵌入空间划分为局部"图表"，仅对受新工况影响的区域学习轻量残差传输，并保留恒等路径与门控选择，实现持续适应新工况同时不遗忘旧工况。
AI.motivation: 预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在下游分类表现好，但在工况变化下持续适应困难：需在仅有少量标注校准集、且推理时不知工况身份的前提下，每遇新工况都提升且不牺牲已学工况。作者发现关键在于几何结构——工况偏移下嵌入空间并非均匀移动，部分局部区域变化大、部分几乎不变，因此全局适应会不必要地改变本已正确分类的嵌入。
AI.method: PACT将冻结的源嵌入空间划分为局部图表（charts），针对每个新工况影响的区域学习轻量残差传输（residual transport）；始终保留显式恒等路径，并用学习的门控（gate）在恒等与累积传输间为每个输入软选择；预训练TSFM编码器、分类头及已学传输均保持冻结。
AI.result: 在每到来工况仅用5%标注校准数据、测试时无工况标识的设置下，PACT在四工况轴承故障流上平均macro-F1超过0.95；在同构任务与标签空间的公开基准上也观察到类似的"保持-适应"行为。
AI.conclusion: 利用TSFM嵌入空间在工况偏移下的非均匀几何结构，做局部化、分段式的轻量适应并保留恒等路径，可在极低标注与无工况信息条件下实现有效的持续适应性且不遗忘。代码见https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT。

title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

AI.tldr: ReflectScene 提出 MLLM 引导的闭环扩散框架，用于文本条件 3D 室内场景生成，通过多视图场景理解、语义奖励预测和决策条件的轨迹一致扩散，在去噪过程中实现对象级修正。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散方法主要依赖静态文本条件，难以评估演化中的场景并将语义偏差转化为可执行的对象级修正；基于 MLLM 的生成后细化虽提供语义反馈，但与去噪过程解耦，可能破坏场景一致性。
AI.method: 1) 分层先验锚定的场景理解：用冻结 MLLM 将结构化布局与多视图视觉证据对齐，理解对象上下文与全局语义；2) MLLM 引导的语义奖励评估：将 MLLM 的诊断与候选修正评估蒸馏为轻量奖励预测器，降低决策计算开销；3) 决策条件的轨迹一致扩散：通过瞬态条件与持续干净估计投影融入所选修正，在去噪中修正目标对象布局并保持非目标布局不变。
AI.result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集上，功能一致性与语义对齐得到提升，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 将 MLLM 语义反馈闭环嵌入扩散去噪过程，可有效实现对象级场景修正，兼顾语义合理性与生成一致性。

title: Online State-Representation Adaptation under Synthetic Interaction-Cue Remapping
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code and synthetic data are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24329690
summary: When cues change what they predict, continuing to update a learned mapping may help an agent choose the appropriate action. We tested this in a one-step synthetic task by comparing a logistic state predictor that continued to learn from state labels with the same predictor frozen at transfer. We evaluated ten conditions in six held-out environments, with 1,296 paired runs per condition and 1,296,000 transfer records in total. Late action accuracy was 93.39% with online updates and 64.63% with frozen coefficients, a paired difference of 28.76 [8.73, 53.19] percentage points (95% environment-bootstrap interval). A direct policy reached 95.65% using the same predictions with a different action threshold. A contextual bandit reached 94.23% and earned more cumulative utility than the adaptive predictor. The bandit used the reward of its chosen action, which in this task reveals the true state when combined with that action. Weights based on development history lowered cumulative utility relative to neutral weights (difference -3.45 [-4.48, -2.43]). The adaptive predictor outperformed its frozen counterpart in late accuracy in each of the six test environments. The other comparisons show how the choice of action threshold and the information available in feedback affect what can be attributed to online adaptation.

AI.tldr: 在线持续更新状态预测器相比冻结系数在迁移后动作准确率上显著更优（93.39% vs 64.63%），但直接策略与上下文bandit表现更佳，说明阈值选择与反馈信息对归因至关重要。
AI.motivation: 探究当线索与预测目标的映射发生变化时，继续更新已学到的映射是否有助于智能体选择合适动作，并厘清在线适应本身带来的收益与动作阈值、反馈信息之间的归因问题。
AI.method: 在单步合成任务中，比较一个持续从状态标签学习的逻辑回归状态预测器与在迁移时冻结的同一预测器。共评估十种条件、六个留出环境，每条件1,296对配对运行，总计1,296,000条迁移记录，并采用环境bootstrap置信区间。另设直接策略（不同动作阈值）、上下文bandit（利用所选动作的奖励），以及基于开发历史的权重对比。
AI.result: 在线更新的晚期动作准确率93.39%，冻结系数64.63%，配对差28.76 [8.73, 53.19]个百分点。直接策略达95.65%；上下文bandit达94.23%且累计效用高于自适应预测器（因奖励结合动作可揭示真实状态）。基于开发历史的权重降低累计效用（差-3.45 [-4.48, -2.43]）。自适应预测器在全部六个测试环境中均优于冻结版本。
AI.conclusion: 在线适应确实提升迁移后的动作准确率且跨环境稳健，但动作阈值选择和反馈中所含信息的差异会显著影响性能与归因，因此不能将全部收益简单归因于在线适应本身。

title: AppSec Core: An Ontology for Security-by-Design Software Engineering
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Supersedes OSF preprint doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/WG8PV
summary: When engineers or coding agents change an application, a dependency, a configuration or a build pipeline, they need to know three things: which security rules apply, how to meet them, and what evidence to leave. Today the answers are spread over many standards, frameworks, laws and lists of weaknesses, and each one uses its own words and level of detail. This paper presents AppSec Core, a model of the security work that engineers do. It says what must be true, which practices get there, which mechanisms do the job and which artefacts show that it was done. It has 259 elements in ten domains. We built it from a security-by-design manual written from practice, and then checked it against 31 outside sources, ten of them about AI systems and agents. Along the way we made three changes, which added five objectives and made one domain wider. We did not need a new domain. Most objectives are backed by several sources: the typical objective is used by six of the twenty technical sources, and 194 of the 202 objectives, practices and mechanisms are linked to items in the sources. For the domain of a change, the model gives back a closed set of typed elements, and for a source, it gives back the objectives that the source points to. We keep the model apart from the manual, the selection rules and the server that delivers the result, and we follow one change, adding a third-party package, through all four. When a code generator received the requirements, the share of security tests passed on a public benchmark went from 77.4% to 93.0%. On a second benchmark, the result was close to that of the benchmark's own "oracle" prompt, which is written with the tests in mind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AppSec Core——一个面向工程师与编码智能体的应用安全工作模型，用 259 个元素、10 个领域统一描述"必须满足什么安全要求、用什么实践与机制达成、留下什么证据"，并在代码生成任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 工程实践中，当工程师或编码智能体修改应用、依赖、配置或构建流水线时，需要回答三个问题：哪些安全规则适用、如何满足、留下什么证据。但答案分散在众多标准、框架、法律和弱点清单中，各用各的术语和粒度，缺乏统一、可操作的结构化模型。
AI.method: 基于一份来自实践的安全设计手册构建模型，包含 259 个元素、10 个领域，按"目标（必须为真）—实践—机制—证据制品"的层次组织；随后用 31 个外部来源（其中 10 个涉及 AI 系统与智能体）进行对照校验，并做三处调整（新增 5 个目标、扩展 1 个领域，未新增领域）。模型与手册、选择规则与服务端实现解耦，并以"引入第三方包"这一变更贯穿四层验证。
AI.result: 多数目标有多源支撑：典型目标被 20 个技术来源中的 6 个引用，202 个目标/实践/机制中 194 个可链接到来源条目。代码生成器获得该需求后，公开基准上的安全测试通过率从 77.4% 提升至 93.0%；在第二个基准上接近专门面向测试编写的"oracle"提示词效果。
AI.conclusion: AppSec Core 提供了一个跨标准统一、可追溯到来源、可向变更场景返回封闭类型元素集的安全工作模型，能有效提升编码智能体的安全实现质量，印证了"结构化安全需求供给"对 AI 辅助开发的实用价值。

title: Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Embodied Graph, a relational state abstraction that supports structured dynamics modeling and long-horizon imagination, and the Relational World Model (RWM), which performs imagination directly over graph states. RWM consists of (i) a Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor that filters redundant details and maintains graph memory through online updates, and (ii) an Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model that learns node-wise latent dynamics while capturing inter-node dependencies. The imagined graph states provide predictions of action consequences to guide decision-making. Experiments on Minecraft and Crafter demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM in embodied environments. Notably, in Minecraft, RWM is the only method that obtains diamonds within the given budget. Experiments on web interaction further illustrate the applicability of relational state prediction to the decision making process of web agents.

AI.tldr: 提出关系式状态抽象（Embodied Graph）与关系世界模型（RWM），在稀疏图状态上进行想象式长程规划，缓解像素级观测的冗余与误差累积。
AI.motivation: 长时序具身/网页任务的决策序列长、反馈延迟，世界模型虽可通过隐空间想象规划，但现有方法依赖稠密像素观测，被迫吸收冗余信息、忽视任务相关实体间关系，导致长途想象误差累积并逐渐破坏预测。
AI.method: 构建Embodied Graph稀疏关系状态抽象，并设计在图上直接做想象的关系世界模型RWM，含两部分：(i) Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor，过滤冗余细节并通过在线更新维护图记忆；(ii) Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model，学习节点级隐动态并捕获节点间依赖；想象出的图状态给出动作后果预测以指导决策。
AI.result: 在Minecraft与Crafter上验证有效性；Minecraft中RWM是唯一定额预算内获得钻石的方法；网页交互实验表明关系状态预测可应用于网页智能体决策。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏关系状态上做想象可支撑可靠的长程动力学建模与规划，适用于具身与网页决策场景。

title: Temporal Image Representations for Mouse Dynamics Authentication
summary: Mouse dynamics authentication has traditionally relied on handcrafted features or time-series representations that capture both spatial and temporal characteristics of mouse movements. More recent approaches have modeled mouse data as images, enabling the use of powerful pretrained computer vision models. However, prior work primarily focuses on spatial-only representations where the cursor coordinates are plotted as a trajectory image. These representations discard the temporal characteristics which can help discriminate users. In this work, we propose image representations that incorporate speed and velocity information for mouse dynamics authentication. We investigate two mouse data representations, a XYPlot representation that intuitively shows the path of movement, and a Pairwise Distance (PWD) representation that utilizes the entire image canvas to encode relationships between mouse events. Both representations are evaluated under both location-aware and location-free settings using pretrained 2D-CNN and ViT architectures. We found that the incorporation of temporal information improved performance over spatial representations alone, and that the location-aware variants generally outperformed the location-free. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on two datasets, Balabit and TWOS, and extend our evaluation to two other datasets. We found that in general, location-aware PWD with temporal encoding combined with the 2D-CNN architecture provided the best results, with mean EERs of 5.21% and 12.70% on the Balabit Test-1 and Test-2 sets, respectively, 4.94% on TWOS, 6.16% on ChaoShen, and 0.59% on DFL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在鼠标动态认证中引入包含速度/时序信息的图像化表示，提升了基于预训练视觉模型认证的性能。
AI.motivation: 已有方法将鼠标轨迹绘成图像利用预训练视觉模型，但只保留空间信息，丢弃了有助区分用户的时序特征。
AI.method: 研究XYPlot（路径可视化）与Pairwise Distance（PWD，用整个画布编码鼠标事件间关系）两种表示，并加入速度/速度向量信息；在location-aware与location-free设置下，用预训练2D-CNN与ViT评估。
AI.result: 引入时序信息优于纯空间表示；location-aware普遍优于location-free；在Balabit（EER 5.21%/12.70%）、TWOS（4.94%）、ChaoShen（6.16%）、DFL（0.59%）达SOTA；最佳方案为location-aware PWD+时序+2D-CNN。
AI.conclusion: 时序增强的图像表示可显著提升鼠标动态认证性能，location-aware PWD配合2D-CNN为最有效组合。

title: Beyond Cross-Modal Reconstruction: Participant-Level Evaluation of sEMG-Kinematic Coupling in Post-Stroke Gait
summary: Accurate cross-modal reconstruction is often treated as evidence of physiological coupling, although it may simply reflect temporal patterns shared across participants. We tested whether frozen bidirectional models captured subject-specific neuromuscular coupling between electromyographic activity and gait kinematics in 82 held-out able-bodied and 43 post-stroke participants. Complete source-modality removal and cross-participant source substitution, along with a cycle-position-age-sex template baseline, were applied. Learned bilateral asymmetry was also compared with transparent waveform and derivative asymmetry for predicting Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) scores in the case of repeated nested cross-validation. Complete source removal increased reconstruction RMSE by 6.90% for electromyography-to-kinematics and 11.38% in the reverse direction. In contrast, cross-participant substitution increased RMSE by only 1.68% and 1.67%, respectively, while the template reduced RMSE by 2.89% and 0.55%. For POMA prediction, walking speed, age, and sex achieved an MAE of 3.693, compared with 4.229 and 4.427 after adding absolute and signed learned asymmetry, respectively.
