In all of the 20 repeated evaluations, all asymmetry representations performed worse than the covariate baseline. No localized learned feature remained significant after covariate adjustment and false-discovery-rate correction. The model mainly relied on shared gait-phase patterns, with no clear subject-specific coupling or added clinical value. Participant-level controls are therefore needed before reconstruction accuracy is treated as evidence of individualized physiology.

AI.tldr: 冻结的双向跨模态模型看似捕捉了肌电与步态运动学之间的耦合，但消融实验表明其重建能力主要来自受试者共享的步态相位模式，而非个体特异的神经肌肉耦合，且学习到的特征无临床增益。
AI.motivation: 跨模态重建准确率常被当作生理耦合的证据，但这种高精度可能仅反映所有受试者共有的时间模式（如步态周期）。作者希望检验冻结双向模型是否真正学到了受试者特异的肌电-运动学耦合，并评估其临床价值。
AI.method: 对82名健康受试者和43名卒中后受试者，测试冻结双向EMG↔运动学模型；采用完整源模态移除、跨受试者源替换，以及周期位置-年龄-性别模板基线进行对照；并将学习到的双侧不对称性与透明波形/导数不对称性比较，用重复嵌套交叉验证预测POMA评分。
AI.result: 完整源移除使RMSE分别上升6.90%（EMG→运动学）和11.38%（反向）；跨受试者替换仅上升1.68%和1.67%，模板基线反而使RMSE降低2.89%和0.55%。POMA预测中，步速+年龄+性别MAE为3.693，加入绝对和带符号学习不对称性后分别变差至4.229和4.427；20次重复评估中所有不对称表征均不如协变量基线，协变量调整与FDR校正后无任何局部学习特征显著。
AI.conclusion: 模型主要依赖共享的步态相位模式，没有明确的受试者特异耦合，也无附加临床价值。在将重建精度视为个体化生理证据之前，需引入受试者层面的对照实验。

title: Model Discovery for Virtual Chaos Engineering with Incomplete Tracing: An eBPF Study
comment: Submitted to Software and Systems Modeling journal
summary: Model-based fault experiments can assess the consequences of component failures before intervening in a running application. Recent work on model discovery and graph simulation acquired operation models from application telemetry and used them for availability prediction. Applying this approach to operational legacy systems raises an acquisition problem: the required traces may be absent or incomplete, while introducing them can require changes across heterogeneous components. These systems continue to serve business operations during extended maintenance and modernization. External observation offers a possible route to model-based fault analysis before a tracing retrofit, but collecting telemetry does not by itself establish that an executable operation model can be obtained. We investigate this route using extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) observations and the existing graph-based modelling approach. A 108-case study varied application software development kit (SDK) tracing across absent, partial and full conditions in three public applications. Discovered dependencies were combined with declared operation requirements, deployment facts and scenario assumptions; model forecasts preceded independent execution checks. With SDK tracing disabled, the tested OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation path supported all seven operations in two applications across three repetitions. Forecasts agreed exactly in 17 of 21 operation-repetition groups; the maximum state-weighted discrepancy was 4.22 percentage points. Combining observed context links supported nine additional groups under partial tracing. The results establish an acquisition path for virtual fault experiments under the tested observation constraints and identify limits imposed by protocols, evidence association and operation semantics.

AI.tldr: 使用 eBPF 外部观测配合图模型发现，可在缺失 SDK 追踪的老旧系统中获得可执行的操作模型，用于故障实验与可用性预测。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的故障实验可在干预运行系统前评估组件失效后果，但该方法需要操作模型。现有方法依赖应用遥测中的追踪数据做模型发现与图仿真，而运维中的遗留系统追踪常常缺失或不完整，补插追踪又需跨异构组件改造。作者探讨能否在不改装追踪的情况下，仅靠外部观测先获得可执行模型。
AI.method: 采用 eBPF（OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation）观测，结合既有的图建模方法。设计 108 例研究，在三个公开应用中把 SDK 追踪设置为缺失、部分、完整三种条件；将发现的依赖与声明的操作需求、部署事实和场景假设结合，先做模型预测，再做独立的执行校验。
AI.result: 在 SDK 追踪完全关闭时，eBPF 路径支持两个应用的全部七个操作、三次重复。21 个"操作-重复"组中有 17 个预测完全一致，最大状态加权偏差 4.22 个百分点。部分追踪条件下结合观测到的上下文链接，额外支持 9 个组。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了一条在给定观测约束下开展虚拟故障实验的模型获取路径，同时指出了协议、证据关联与操作语义带来的限制。

title: Fast Bayesian Methods for Uncertainty Quantification in Sparse AI Evaluation
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI Measurement Science Workshop
summary: Estimating how an AI system will perform on a new benchmark need not require another large model. We use public evaluation counts to choose a weak Beta prior, then update it exactly from at most 31 revealed outcomes. The predictor uses no item semantics, pretrained weights, or inference API. Its single online evaluation in the AIMS competition returned a team-reported Brier ALC of 0.188477, a 24.6% reduction from the constant-0.5 reference. The complete submission is 7,754 bytes; a server microbenchmark measures 12.71 microseconds per prediction with 31 matching labels. We describe how source evaluations are compressed into 301 prior means and show why a concentration of two lets new evidence rapidly determine the prediction. The resulting posterior gives exact uncertainty about the modelled success rate without numerical integration or neural inference. A public evaluation covers 79 system-benchmark pairs and eight seeds, reaching Brier ALC 0.200250 for the submitted method. Accompanying code and sufficient statistics reconstruct the fitted prior byte for byte and replay all 632 evaluation trajectories. The result demonstrates how much predictive value a compact Bayesian model can extract from sparse target feedback at very low online cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种极轻量的贝叶斯预测器：用公开评测计数构造弱Beta先验，再用至多31个披露结果精确更新，在线预测新基准表现。AIMS竞赛Brier ALC为0.188477（较0.5常数基线降24.6%），提交仅7,754字节，单次预测12.71微秒。
AI.motivation: 预测AI系统在新基准上的表现通常依赖大模型或推理API，成本高。作者希望探索在没有项目语义、预训练权重和推理接口的情况下，仅凭稀疏反馈能否获得有竞争力的预测精度。
AI.method: 用公开评测计数压缩为301个先验均值，选出弱Beta先验（集中度取2），再对至多31个已披露结果做精确共轭更新，得到对成功率的精确后验。无需数值积分或神经推理；代码与充分统计量可逐字节重建先验并重放632条评测轨迹。
AI.result: AIMS竞赛单次在线评测得到Brier ALC 0.188477，相对常数0.5参考降低24.6%；公开评测覆盖79个系统-基准对、8个种子，所提交方法Brier ALC达0.200250。提交体积7,754字节，服务器微基准为12.71微秒/次预测（31个匹配标签）。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的贝叶斯模型可从稀疏目标反馈中提取可观预测价值，且在线成本极低、结果可复现，为基准表现预测提供了一种无需大模型的实用替代方案。

title: MobileWeave: Program-First Synthesis of Dependency-Linked Tasks for Training Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Native mobile GUI agents require large-scale training trajectories covering both individual app functions and multi-goal workflows within and across apps, which makes automatic task synthesis a promising way to scale training data. Existing synthesis pipelines, however, produce each task as free-form text, leaving implicit how its subgoals depend on one another. This matters because composition is a skill in its own right: a policy may complete each subtask of a workflow on its own, yet fail to chain these subtasks into the complete workflow. We present MobileWeave, which instead synthesizes every task as an executable program derived from the app implementations of a controllable simulator. MobileWeave abstracts each app into a typed capability graph with semantic types shared across apps, composes atomic programs into single- and cross-app composite programs through explicit value and object dependencies, and verifies each program by native execution, deriving both its instruction and its completion check from the same program. Trained on teacher trajectories collected for these tasks and on recovery supervision at the policy's own stalls, MobileWeave-8B improves its base model by 26.7 points on MobileGym and by 8.6, 21.3, and 17.6 points on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld, with comparable gains at 4B. Beyond these gains, we find that composition is learnable from task structure: explicit dependencies between subgoals act as a training signal that teaches a policy to compose skills it already masters. We release data, model, and code at https://maxxnotmarx.github.io/MobileWeave/ .

AI.tldr: MobileWeave 将移动端 GUI 任务合成为可执行程序（基于类型化能力图与显式依赖），并在模拟器中原生验证，从而显著提升智能体在多目标工作流上的组合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有合成管线把每个任务写成自由文本，未显式刻画子目标之间的依赖关系；而"组合"本身是一种独立技能——智能体能单独完成每个子任务，却可能在串联成完整工作流时失败。因此需要显式编码子目标依赖的任务结构来支撑大规模训练数据合成。
AI.method: MobileWeave 把每个 app 抽象为带跨应用共享语义类型的类型化能力图，通过显式的值依赖与对象依赖将原子程序组合为单应用与跨应用复合程序；每个程序在可控模拟器中原生执行验证，并由此程序同时派生指令与完成校验。训练上使用针对这些任务采集的教师轨迹，并在策略自身卡壳处加入恢复监督。
AI.result: MobileWeave-8B 相比基座模型在 MobileGym 上提升 26.7 分，在 AndroidWorld、AndroidLab、MobileWorld 上分别提升 8.6、21.3、17.6 分；4B 规模也有相当增益。
AI.conclusion: 除了性能提升，作者发现组合能力可以从任务结构中学习：子目标之间的显式依赖作为训练信号，能教会策略组合其已掌握的技能。数据、模型与代码已公开。

title: A Rank-One Bypass of Fixed Linear Erasure
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (poster). 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Linear concept erasure can make a target unreadable to a specified family of linear classifiers applied to a model's current internal features. In an open-weight release, however, an attacker can modify the layers that produce those features. We study a fixed affine erasure layer whose upstream model is allowed to change. If the layer transmits even one direction visible to an allowed downstream classifier, the attacker can write a target score into that direction and carry it through the layer. We show that this condition is also necessary, and that for a nonconstant linear target score the required change is a rank-one affine update. Across six CIFAR-10 class-pair tasks, the route restores nearly all pre-erasure target performance and can leave a deployed benign linear head's scores unchanged to numerical tolerance. We then price the attack: with eight target labels and 2,000 unlabelled calibration examples, a 10% mean relative feature edit yields 79.8% test accuracy, which is 91.2% of the fitted score's gain over chance; tighter edit limits sharply reduce success. Linear guardedness therefore remains a valid guarantee about the current representation, but it is not by itself a tamper-resistance guarantee for an editable open-weight model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在开放权重模型中，固定的仿射"概念擦除层"可被攻击者通过修改上游模型绕过，并给出攻击的充要条件（秩一仿射更新）与代价分析。
AI.motivation: 线性概念擦除只能保证当前内部特征对特定线性分类器不可读；但在开放权重发布中，攻击者可修改产生特征的层，因此需要评估擦除层本身是否具备防篡改能力。
AI.method: 将擦除层建模为固定仿射层、上游模型可变；分析擦除层若仍向下游允许分类器传递至少一个可见方向，则攻击者可把目标分数写入该方向并穿透该层。证明该条件为必要条件，且对非恒定线性目标分数所需改动为秩一仿射更新。在六个CIFAR-10类对任务上验证攻击，并量化特征编辑预算下的成功率。
AI.result: 六个CIFAR-10类对任务中，该路由恢复几乎全部擦除前目标性能，且可使部署的良性线性头分数在数值容差内不变；在8个目标标签、2000个无标签校准样本下，10%平均相对特征编辑达到79.8%测试准确率，相当于拟合分数相对随机增益的91.2%；更严格编辑限制会显著降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: 线性防护性仍是关于当前表示的有效保证，但并非对可编辑开放权重模型的防篡改保证。

title: YUL: Bringing Software Supply Chain Security to Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents choose and declare third-party dependencies on their own. They often declare a stale version that they recall from their training data. A stale dependency exposes the project to known vulnerabilities that the latest release already fixes. We present YUL, a design for coding agent harnesses that ensures that no stale dependencies are ever used. It does so by checking every dependency declaration against the package registry. If a dependency is stale or does not exist, YUL blocks the usage and tells the coding agent which version to use, so the coding agent retries with the fix. We evaluate YUL on 60 tasks across six ecosystems with Claude Code running Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenCode running DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Without YUL, Opus declares a stale version in 29% of runs and DeepSeek in 39%, and both declare a stale version in every GitHub Actions run. With YUL, the coding agents end on the latest release in 93% of stale Opus runs and in 96% of stale DeepSeek runs. YUL thus brings the best practices of software supply chain security to coding agents.

AI.tldr: YUL 通过将每次依赖声明与包注册表校验，阻止编码智能体使用过时依赖并在需要时提示正确版本，使 Opus 和 DeepSeek 的过时依赖问题大幅下降（结束于最新版本的比例分别为 93% 和 96%）。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体自主声明第三方依赖时常凭训练数据记忆给出过时版本，从而引入最新版本已修复的已知漏洞，威胁软件供应链安全。
AI.method: 提出 YUL 的编码智能体框架设计：对每个依赖声明与包注册表进行核对；若版本过时或不存在，则阻断该使用并告知智能体应使用的版本，使其重试修正。在六个生态的 60 个任务上，用 Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5 与 OpenCode + DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 进行评估。
AI.result: 无 YUL 时，Opus 有 29%、DeepSeek 有 39% 的运行声明过时版本，且两者在每次 GitHub Actions 运行中都会如此；加 YUL 后，过时场景中分别有 93%（Opus）与 96%（DeepSeek）最终采用最新版本。
AI.conclusion: YUL 将软件供应链安全的最佳实践引入编码智能体，可确保其不再使用过时依赖。

title: GALA: Gallery-Level Alignment for Real-Life Vision Decoding from EEG
summary: Neural decoding of visual experience from electroencephalography (EEG) has achieved strong performance in intra-subject settings, but current methods fail to generalize across individuals: on the standard 200-way benchmark THINGS-EEG-2, top-1 accuracy drops from above 80% within subjects to about 32% for an unseen subject. Adapting a pre-trained encoder to new subjects and sessions typically requires labeled data, a bottleneck whose collection time severely limits practical device deployment. In a practical Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), however, the possible outcomes are known in advance and form a gallery of candidates, and the unlabeled EEG of the user accumulates as soon as the device is used. We propose a new setting, incremental transductive calibration, in which the decoder is calibrated regularly on all the unlabeled EEG received so far and on the known gallery, without any labels. This setting is closer to the conditions of a deployed BCI than the zero-shot and batch evaluations in current use. We evaluate it with a protocol in which queries arrive one at a time, with unknown and possibly unequal frequencies, and each query is decoded before it is used for calibration. In this setting, we introduce GALA : GAllery-Level Alignment, a label-free calibration method which registers the unlabeled EEG embeddings onto the gallery through shrinkage whitening, hubness correction and a Sinkhorn--Procrustes alignment with query frequencies estimated from the buffer, updated after every query. On THINGS-EEG-2, with a gallery of 200 images, it raises the top-1 accuracy on a new subject from 28% to 67% over 53 minutes of use. Across 60 evaluation settings that vary the gallery size, the query frequencies and the number of repetitions averaged per query, GALA is the most accurate label-free method in every setting, 6.6 points above the best competing method on average at the end of the stream.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"增量直推校准"新设定并提出无标签方法GALA，通过在已知候选图库上对齐未标注EEG嵌入，将新被试的跨被试解码top-1从28%提升到67%。
AI.motivation: EEG视觉解码在被试内表现好，但跨被试泛化差（THINGS-EEG-2上从>80%降到约32%），且适配新被试/会话通常需标注数据，采集成本高、限制实用部署。实际BCI中候选结果已知、无标签EEG随使用持续积累，因此需要一种无需标签的在线校准方案。
AI.method: 提出新设定：增量直推校准——仅用迄今收到的全部无标签EEG和已知图库定期校准，查询逐条到达、频率未知可能不均，且每条查询先解码后用于校准。方法GALA（GAllery-Level Alignment）：对未标注EEG嵌入通过收缩白化、hubness校正、以及带从缓冲区估计并逐查询更新的查询频率的Sinkhorn–Procrustes对齐，将嵌入配准到图库上。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG-2（200图像图库）上，新被试top-1在53分钟内从28%提升至67%。60种评测设定（变化图库大小、查询频率、每查询平均重复次数）下，GALA在每个设定中均为最准确的无标签方法，流结束时平均比最佳竞品高6.6个点。
AI.conclusion: 增量直推校准更贴近实际部署BCI条件，GALA无需标签即可显著提升跨被试解码性能，具备稳健性与实用性。

title: Grounding Radiology Reports in 3D Chest CT: Results of the ReXGrounding Challenge
summary: Segmenting each reported finding in a radiology scan would allow findings to be measured and tracked over time and let AI systems generate reports that are verifiable, but so far AI models have performed poorly at this task. To advance this task, we organized the ReXGrounding Challenge at MICCAI 2026, the first challenge dedicated to it. Given a non-contrast chest CT scan and the set of findings from its report, participants trained models to produce the corresponding set of 3D segmentations. The challenge used 2,992 training and 200 validation scans from the ReXGroundingCT dataset, and evaluated methods on a held-out test set of 300 scans with 582 findings, exhaustively annotated by board-certified radiologists. In total, 48 teams from 15 countries made 760 submissions, and the best method reached a Dice of 0.375 and a hit rate of 0.77, matching agreement between two independent radiologist groups (Dice 0.32, hit rate 0.76, on a 50-scan subset). On the 100 scans of the pre-challenge benchmark, the winner reached a Dice of 0.390, against 0.285 for VoxTell, the best model before the challenge, which five of the six best teams fine-tuned. Non-focal findings remained far harder to segment than focal ones, instance F1 stayed below inter-reader agreement (0.34 vs. 0.47), and models sometimes segmented the right abnormality in the wrong location. Top methods thus match radiologist agreement in Dice, but non-focal findings, findings with multiple instances, and adherence to the anatomical location described in the text remain open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding Challenge：首个面向"报告发现→3D分割"的挑战赛。在非增强胸部CT上，输入报告中的findings集合，输出对应的3D分割集合。最优方法Dice 0.375、命中率0.77，与两位独立放射科医生的组间一致性（Dice 0.32、命中率0.76）相当；在100例预挑战基准上Dice 0.390，显著优于旧最佳模型VoxTell（0.285）。
AI.motivation: 对影像报告中每条发现进行分割，可支持随时间的测量与追踪，并使AI生成的报告可验证（verifiable）；但现有AI模型在此任务上表现很差，且缺乏统一的公共评测平台来推动进展，因此组织首个专门针对该任务的挑战赛。
AI.method: 构建挑战赛与数据集：使用ReXGroundingCT数据集（2,992例训练、200例验证），测试集为300例扫描共582个findings，由委员会认证放射科医生做穷尽式标注。任务设定为非增强胸部CT+报告findings集合→对应3D分割集合。共15国48支队伍、760次提交；用Dice、命中率（hit rate）、实例F1等指标评测，并与放射科医生组间一致性及赛前基线VoxTell对比。
AI.result: 最佳方法Dice 0.375、命中率0.77，达到两名独立放射科医生组间一致水平（50例子集上Dice 0.32、命中率0.76）；预挑战基准100例上冠军Dice 0.390，VoxTell为0.285，前六名中五队对VoxTell做了微调。仍存在的问题：非局灶性（non-focal）发现远难于局灶性发现；实例F1仅0.34，低于读者间一致性0.47；模型有时把正确异常分割到了错误位置。
AI.conclusion: 顶尖方法在Dice上已可与放射科医生一致性媲美，但非局灶性发现、多实例发现、以及对文本所述解剖位置的遵循仍是开放问题。该挑战赛确立了该任务的首个公开基准，并指出未来研究方向。

title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
summary: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA)：一种结合学习式非线性特征与协方差引导记忆更新的循环序列混合器，通过递归岭回归存储关联，具有精确时间核解释、上下文无关的推理状态和可并行训练能力。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力机制推理状态随上下文增长，而循环模型在非线性联想记忆与自适应写入方面能力有限，作者希望构建兼具两者优点、有理论依据的非线性自适应序列记忆。
AI.method: 核心是递归岭回归的记忆更新，利用历史 key 之间的相关性决定新观测如何修改记忆；引入内容依赖的 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 转移控制记忆保留并恢复写入不确定性；借助关联块映射与显式伴随实现并行训练，同时保持递归更新。
AI.result: 在受控语言建模实验中，KRA 的预测质量优于注意力和循环基线；在评估的循环模型中自然联想回忆更强；并取得实用的分布式训练吞吐。
AI.conclusion: KRA 具备精确时间核解释与上下文无关推理状态，为非线性、自适应的序列记忆提供了有原则的基础。

title: HydroMind: A Checkable Agent for Autonomous Hydrological Research
summary: General-purpose coding agents have written code for hydrological and Earth-system models. In these studies the researchers decided in advance how the model would be evaluated, for example the test period, the scoring function, and the standard the model had to meet. No study has tested what happens when the agent makes these decisions itself: how many of its claims are supported by its own data, code, and results, and whether readers can check them. Both may depend on the agent's harness, that is, the tools it can call and the written instructions it follows. We compared three harnesses: the agent's own harness; this harness plus the modeling tools of HydroMind, a hydrological modeling system we developed for general-purpose agents, which run every model through fixed commands and store its settings, trained model, and predictions; and both plus HydroMind's research procedure, under which the agent writes a research design before running any model and records every change to it. Under each harness, the same agent studied four open questions in hydrological model development and was given only the data. Under the three harnesses, the experiments submitted 23, 20, and 41 claims, each stating that one model or approach is better than, worse than, or similar to another. A claim does not hold if the difference recomputed from the experiment's own code and predictions disagrees with it, or if the code did not compare the two models or approaches the claim names. Under the three harnesses, 30%, 20%, and 5% of the claims did not hold. A statistical test, confidence interval, or decision rule that lets readers judge the stated difference was reported for 48%, 53%, and 83% of the claims. With the language model unchanged, changing only the harness reduced the share of claims that do not hold and increased the share that readers can check.

AI.tldr: 在语言模型不变的前提下，仅改变智能体"框架"（可调用的工具与书面指令）就能显著降低其不可靠结论的比例并提升结论的可核查性。
AI.motivation: 现有通用编码智能体用于水文与地球系统建模时，评价标准（测试时段、评分函数、达标门槛）都由研究者预先设定。尚无研究考察让智能体自主做这些决策时，其声称的结论有多少真被自身数据、代码与结果支持，以及读者能否核查。这两点可能取决于智能体的harness（可调用工具+书面指令）。
AI.method: 对比三种harness：(1) 智能体自带harness；(2) 加入HydroMind（作者开发的水文建模系统，通过固定命令运行模型并存储设置、训练模型与预测）；(3) 再加入HydroMind的研究流程（跑模型前须写研究设计并记录每次改动）。同一智能体在每种harness下研究四个水文建模开放问题，仅提供数据。
AI.result: 三种harness下分别提交23、20、41条"某模型/方法优/劣/相似"的论断。不成立论断比例分别为30%、20%、5%；报告了统计检验、置信区间或决策规则（供读者判断差异）的比例分别为48%、53%、83%。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型不变时，仅改进harness即可减少不成立的论断并提高读者可核查的比例，说明智能体的工具与流程设计对科研结论的可靠性至关重要。

title: Option-GRPO: Hierarchical RL Against AI Slop in Code Generation for Unseen SDKs
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 27 pages
summary: Large language models increasingly produce AI slop in generated code: verbose, redundant, non-idiomatic implementations that pass functional checks but bloat codebases. The problem compounds on SDKs released after the model's training cutoff, where the model has neither idiomatic priors nor compositional understanding. We present Option-GRPO, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts a code LLM to an unseen SDK from its source code alone, without human-written usage examples or test cases, and that explicitly optimizes for both functional correctness and code elegance. Our key insight is that SDK source code contains compositional structure that defines a hierarchy of reusable code patterns (code options) which simultaneously serve as the building blocks of a curriculum and the action space for efficient policy optimization. We show that code options induce a valid semi-Markov decision process, give conditional bounds under which shorter option description length implies more concise and, in expectation, more API-efficient programs, and analyze under stated assumptions how the option hierarchy improves credit assignment by a factor of $\sqrt{T/K}$. Using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with execution-based rewards at each curriculum level, Option-GRPO discovers SDK idioms, composes them into patterns, and assembles patterns into complete programs. Experiments on 12 unseen SDKs with a 32B-parameter base model demonstrate 61.4% pass@1, outperforming flat GRPO by 8.7 points, ExploraCoder by 11.2 points, and ReCode by 6.3 points. Option-GRPO produces solutions that use 34.7% fewer API calls and are 27% shorter than flat-GRPO outputs while maintaining higher correctness, directly attacking the slop problem.

AI.tldr: Option-GRPO 是一个分层强化学习框架，仅从 SDK 源码就让代码 LLM 适配未见过的 SDK，同时优化功能正确性与代码优雅性，显著减少"AI slop"。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的代码常出现"AI slop"——冗长、冗余、不符合惯用法，虽能通过功能测试却使代码库臃肿。尤其对训练截止后发布的 SDK，模型既无惯用先验也无组合理解。现有方法依赖人工示例或测试用例。
AI.method: 将 SDK 源码中的组合结构抽象为可复用代码模式（code options）层级：既作课程学习的构建块，又作策略优化的动作空间。证明 code options 诱导有效的半马尔可夫决策过程；给出条件界限说明更短的 option 描述意味着更简洁、更 API 高效的程序；分析 option 层级将信用分配改进 √(T/K) 倍。用 GRPO 在各课程层级上以执行奖励训练。
AI.result: 在 12 个未见 SDK 上、32B 基础模型取得 61.4% pass@1，比 flat GRPO 高 8.7 分、ExploraCoder 高 11.2 分、ReCode 高 6.3 分；API 调用减少 34.7%、代码长度缩短 27%，且正确性更高。
AI.conclusion: 分层 option 结构可直接从未见 SDK 源码中自动习得惯用法并组合成程序，在提升正确性的同时显著降低冗余，直接缓解 AI slop 问题，无需人工示例或测试用例。

title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
summary: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. A controller trained through supervised fine-tuning integrates these records with target responses, evaluator verdicts, and remaining budget to retain the workflow, refine instructions, restructure collaboration, or lock further editing. This design connects feedback to explicit changes in subsequent execution while allowing a useful organization to continue without repeated controller intervention. The evaluation protocol covers HarmBench with three execution backbones and two target models, together with component ablations, dataset transfer, and evaluator checks. Across the six executor-target configurations, L2C improves ASR over EvoSynth by 1.4 to 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean online tokens by 35.6% to 37.3%. L2C connects adaptive collaboration to the resource requirements of automated security evaluation.

AI.tldr: L2C是一个LLM引导的框架，为每个红队测试案例进化出可执行的多智能体工作流，通过将反馈映射为明确的图结构修改，在提升攻击成功率的同时显著降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: 自动红队测试的可扩展性取决于发现模型安全失败的资源开销。多智能体系统虽能整合互补能力，但重复规划、冗余交互和低效的信息路由导致协调成本高昂；而目标模型的回复只反映测试结果，无法指示应调整哪项协作决策。
AI.method: L2C将智能体职责、执行依赖和输入绑定表示为带版本信息的图，并为每个图关联实际传递与生成信息的记录。通过监督微调训练的控制器结合这些记录、目标回复、评估器判定和剩余预算，决定保留工作流、细化指令、重构协作或锁定编辑。
AI.result: 在HarmBench上使用三种执行骨干和两个目标模型评估，并辅以组件消融、数据集迁移与评估器检查。六种执行器-目标配置下，L2C相比EvoSynth的ASR提升1.4至4.5个百分点，同时平均在线token减少35.6%至37.3%。
AI.conclusion: L2C将自适应协作与自动安全评估的资源需求相连接，证明了结构化、可反馈驱动的多智能体协调能同时提升红队效果与效率。

title: On Demand, Not Uniformity: Adaptive Expert Orchestration for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to adapt to sequential instruction data while retaining previously acquired knowledge. While recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based methods mitigate forgetting by freezing historical experts and introducing new ones, they largely overlook the varying adaptation demands across tasks. Probing incoming tasks reveals pronounced heterogeneity in layer-wise gradient pressure and token-wise prediction difficulty. This observation highlights two unresolved decisions: where additional capacity is needed and how strongly new experts should contribute to individual tokens. To address both questions, we propose the Coverage-Calibrated Expert Injection and Residual Arbitration framework (CIRA-MoE), which derives expert acceptance margins via learnable threshold routing to serve as a unified coverage signal. Specifically, historical acceptance evidence guides the selective injection of new experts into insufficiently covered layers. Meanwhile, relative evidence between historical and current experts modulates token-wise residual contributions, coupled with arbitration-consistent regularization to promote expert specialization. Comprehensive experiments on UCIT and CoIN demonstrate that CIRA-MoE outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in MCIT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIRA-MoE框架，用于多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）。它通过可学习阈值路由得到的专家接受边界作为统一的覆盖信号，指导新专家在哪一层注入，并调节新旧专家在token级别上的残差贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MoE的MCIT方法通过冻结历史专家并添加新专家来缓解遗忘，但忽视不同任务间差异化的适配需求：层间梯度压力以及token级预测难度存在显著异质性，因此"何处需要额外容量"和"新专家对每个token应贡献多大"两个问题尚未解决。
AI.method: CIRA-MoE包含覆盖校准的专家注入和残差仲裁两部分：（1）通过可学习阈值路由推导专家接受边界，作为统一覆盖信号，并利用历史接受证据在覆盖不足的层选择性注入新专家；（2）利用历史专家与当前专家的相对证据调制token级残差贡献，并加入仲裁一致性正则化以促进专家专精。
AI.result: 在UCIT和CoIN两个基准上的综合实验表明，CIRA-MoE优于现有MCIT的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: CIRA-MoE通过覆盖校准的专家注入与残差仲裁，针对层间和token级的异质性适配需求，有效提升了多模态持续指令微调的性能并缓解遗忘。

title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at KDD 2027, Applied Data Science (ADS) Track. This is the original submission version, prior to reviewer revisions
summary: Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all three tasks, reduces manual verification costs by 95%, and increases update frequency from weekly to hourly. These results demonstrate a practical and cost-effective industrial solution for road-network map updating.

AI.tldr: PGU-Decoder 是一个面向道路网地图更新的生产级统一解码框架，用点级先验查询和关系图注意力在一个模型中同时完成路口内路网生成、汇入/分出检测和可行驶区域检测，并在中国360多个城市大规模验证与高德地图部署中取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 道路网地图的及时更新对导航和自动驾驶至关重要，涉及拓扑、几何、属性三类任务（路口内路网生成、汇入/分出检测、可行驶区域检测）。分立的流水线导致规则维护、质量保障和人工核验重复，运营成本高，因此需要统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 PGU-Decoder 统一解码框架：Prior Query Module（PQM）从路网几何采样位置构建点级先验查询，固定参考点在解码过程中保持位置先验以聚焦周边上下文；点级表示聚合为实例级表示，并用 Relational Graph Attention Network（RGAT）建模实例间依赖；最后由任务专用头输出预测。
AI.result: 在中国360多个城市的大规模自动化路网地图更新中验证，一致优于7个基线；在高德地图部署后三项任务质量分均超过98%，人工核验成本降低95%，更新频率由每周提升至每小时。
AI.conclusion: PGU-Decoder 为道路网地图更新提供了实用且具成本效益的工业级统一方案，证明单框架多任务语义预测可替代分立流水线。

title: A level is not a rank: an empirical audit of quantile-to-index conversion in 10 released conformal-prediction libraries
comment: 34 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Online Resource (45 pages) included as an ancillary file. Code, probe outputs and pinned environments: doi:10.5281/zenodo.21799203
summary: Context. A conformal interval at 0.90 keeps that guarantee only at the right rank: a fresh score falls at or below the rth smallest of n with probability r/(n + 1). The libraries we study instead hand a level to a quantile function, which can land elsewhere. At n = 20, the upper end of statsforecast's interval sits at position 18.05 where rank 19 is required. Objective. Where does installed code resolve the wrong rank, at what cost in coverage, and what does it return when no rank reaches the level? Method. We audit 39 sites where a level becomes an index in 10 pinned packages, a named set rather than a systematic search. 12 are classified by running them, 11 through their shared numpy method, the rest from source. Coverage is paired against the required rank on the same scores. Results. All 7 tabular implementations reach the required rank. In darts, on one code path, coverage is unchanged (0.0000) where the ranks agree and 0.0280 to 0.0560 lower where they differ; a second archive repeats that split but not its range. Below the feasibility floor, $n < 1/α- 1$, of 14 public call paths 5 silently return a finite number; the rest raise or warn. Conclusions. Quantile interfaces take only a level; statsforecast's default calibrates below its floor. 6 of 19 upstream filings have merged, one fixing a coverage shortfall. A conformance suite classifies helpers by the rank they reach, and a checklist guides review.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计10个固定包中39处"水平→秩"转换代码，发现多数统计/表格实现正确，但部分库（如darts、statsforecast）在分位数接口下取错秩，导致覆盖率下降或在样本量不足时静默返回有限值。
AI.motivation: Conformal区间保证只在特定秩成立（r/(n+1)），但现有库把水平直接传给quantile函数，可能落到错误的秩，从而破坏覆盖保证；作者希望量化这一错误出现的环节及其覆盖代价。
AI.method: 审计39处"level变index"的代码点（10个pin住的包）；12处通过实际运行分类，11处通过共享numpy方法，其余读源码；将覆盖率与同一分数上所需秩配对比较；并考察低于可行性下限 n < 1/α−1 时的行为。
AI.result: 7个表格实现均达到所需秩；darts在秩一致处覆盖不变（0.0000），不一致处低0.0280–0.0560；14条公开调用路径中5条在下限以下静默返回有限值，其余报错或警告；19份上游提交中6份已合并，其中一份修复了覆盖不足。
AI.conclusion: 分位数接口仅接受水平易致错秩；statsforecast默认低于其下限校准；作者提出按秩分类helper的一致性测试套件与审查清单。

title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
summary: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna repair reduces attack violations from 10.7% to 0% and increases safe task completion from 89.7% to 100%; a broad handwritten authority rule matches these outcomes. Under stronger attacks, a repair transferred from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen3-14B reduces violations from 69.0% to 17.9% and increases safe task completion from 19.5% to 64.4%. Separate runtime probes examine memory-entry deletion and identify missing local OAuth scope checks in the evaluated snapshot.

AI.tldr: Kicker 提出 Safe Personal RSI，仅通过提示词更新进行受限自我改进，在采纳前用可执行基准（29 个任务+安全探针）评估任务与安全表现，从而拒绝危险更新并接纳有益修复。
AI.motivation: 个人健康助手 Kicker 的可复用指令修改虽能改善任务处理，却可能改变信息披露、指令遵循与行为汇报方式，因此需要在采纳更新前进行安全评估。
AI.method: 将递归自我改进限定为提示词更新（权重与运行代码固定）；流程包括并行测试新旧指令、重复失败用例、临时回滚变更以引导修复，并在采纳前检查安全性与任务性能；无版本通过则保留当前指令。基准含 29 个邮件/日历/健康/市场用例，并设授权复用、记忆、工具输出注入探针。
AI.result: 三种模型、两种高风险编辑下，21 次更新尝试中拒绝 20 次；GPT-5.6 Luna 修复使攻击违规从 10.7% 降至 0%，安全任务完成从 89.7% 升至 100%，与人工宽泛权限规则效果相当；跨模型迁移修复（Qwen2.5-7B→Qwen3-14B）在更强攻击下违规从 69.0% 降至 17.9%，完成率从 19.5% 升至 64.4%。运行期探测还考察记忆条目删除，并发现快照缺少本地 OAuth 作用域检查。
AI.conclusion: 受限范围（仅提示词）的 RSI 配合基于执行的采纳前评估可有效拦截危险更新、提升安全性而少损任务性能，且修复具一定跨模型迁移性；但运行时安全（记忆删除、OAuth 作用域校验）仍需单独审查。

title: From Points to Trajectories: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment for Physical Events
summary: Advancing physical artificial intelligence (Physical AI) requires moving beyond static object recognition to ground how real-world mechanics (e.g., impact, friction, and force transfer) unfold over time. While multimodal aligners seek to capture these interactions by matching multi-sensor streams, prevailing architectures compress each temporal sequence into a single pooled embedding. We show that this paradigm fails on twin events: distinct physical executions recorded under identical task conditions. Collapsing the temporal dimension averages out transient cross-modal dynamics, effectively reducing physical event alignment to static scene recognition. Formally, we prove that as sequence length increases, any temporally pooled representation converges to the stationary recording condition. Consequently, as windows grow, no choice of loss function or embedding geometry can disambiguate twin events from pooled features alone. Instead, we show that physical events are uniquely identified by the event gap, namely the instantaneous, synchronous co-fluctuations across modalities that are erased by pooling and accumulate only along unpooled trajectories. To recover this signal, we introduce CounterPoint, a lightweight plug-in module that strips out each modality's temporal mean to score frame-level cross-modal agreement. Integrated across four state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal aligners, CounterPoint shifts representations from coarse condition matching to fine-grained physical event alignment, consistently outperforming existing temporal alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，主流多模态对齐器把时序序列池化为单一嵌入，会丢失瞬态跨模态动态，无法区分"孪生事件"；并证明序列越长，池化表示越趋向静态记录条件。作者提出轻量插件 CounterPoint，通过去除各模态时间均值、对帧级跨模态一致性打分来恢复"事件间隙"信号，接入四个SOTA对齐器后均优于现有时间对齐方法。
AI.motivation: Physical AI 需要理解撞击、摩擦、力传递等随时间演化的真实物理机制，而不是静态物体识别。现有多模态对齐器虽用多传感器流匹配交互，但普遍将时间序列压缩为单一池化嵌入，导致物理事件对齐退化为静态场景识别。
AI.method: 形式化证明：随序列长度增加，任何时间池化表示都收敛到平稳记录条件，因此仅凭池化特征，无论损失函数或嵌入几何如何选择都无法区分孪生事件。论文据此提出"事件间隙"概念，即不随池化的瞬时跨模态同步共波动。相应方法 CounterPoint 为轻量插件模块：剥离每个模态的时间均值，在帧级别对跨模态一致性进行打分，从而恢复该信号。
AI.result: CounterPoint 集成到四个SOTA多模态对齐器后，表示从粗略条件匹配转向细粒度物理事件对齐，并一致优于现有时间对齐方法。
AI.conclusion: 时间池化是物理事件对齐的结构性瓶颈；恢复帧级的跨模态共波动（事件间隙）是实现细粒度物理事件对齐的有效路径，且该方案可作为轻量插件通用地接入现有对齐器。

title: HOForce: Motion and Force Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction Using a Single-View RGB-D Video
summary: Reconstructing hand-object interactions is an important task, and achieving it with a single camera makes large-scale capture practical but challenging due to heavy occlusions. We introduce HOForce to track hands and objects, and further recover interaction forces from single-view RGB-D video and known object properties. For two-hand manipulation, we jointly model fingertip forces of both hands and the contact forces between objects when two objects are presented. The reconstructed forces also improve motion tracking by giving pose constraints in the occluded regions. HOForce recovers hand and object motion more accurately on DexYCB and TACO and produces less hand-object penetration than interaction baselines on DexYCB. On our dataset of fingertip forces recorded with tactile sensors, HOForce reduces normal-force MAE by 24.5% relative to the strongest baseline. The recovered forces reproduce object motion in MuJoCo and transfer to other engines after adaptation.

AI.tldr: HOForce 从单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性中跟踪双手与物体，并首次恢复手物交互力（含双手指尖力与物体间接触力），重建的力又反过来作为遮挡区域的位姿约束提升跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 单相机采集手物交互可支持大规模数据获取，但严重遮挡使跟踪困难；已有工作多只做运动跟踪，忽略了交互力这一关键物理量，且遮挡区域缺乏约束。
AI.method: 输入单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性；联合建模双手指尖力，并在存在两个物体时建模物体间接触力；将重建的力作为遮挡区域的位姿约束，与手物运动跟踪联合优化，形成力与运动的相互促进。
AI.result: 在 DexYCB 与 TACO 上运动跟踪更准确，DexYCB 上手物穿透少于交互基线；在自建触觉传感器指尖力数据集上，法向力 MAE 相对最强基线降低 24.5%；恢复的力可在 MuJoCo 中复现物体运动，并经验适配后迁移到其他引擎。
AI.conclusion: 单视角视频中恢复交互力是可行且有益的：力估计精度提升的同时，还可作为物理约束改善遮挡下的手物跟踪，并具备跨物理引擎的可迁移性。

title: OMNIS+: Semantic RAN Slicing and Quantization for Dynamic Split Neural Networks
summary: Edge computing enables resource-constrained devices to execute machine learning (ML) applications via task offloading, with radio access network (RAN) slicing playing a crucial role in provisioning joint communication and computing resources. However, existing RAN slicing frameworks rely on static computing models, limiting their ability to exploit dynamic semantic data representations enabled by modern neural architectures. To address this limitation, we propose OMNIS+, a semantic RAN slicing framework for multi-cell edge computing built upon a new generation of dynamic split neural models. OMNIS+ incorporates dynamic neural compression paired with adaptive quantization for task offloading, providing a versatile decision space across communication payload and compute dimensions. We leveraged a novel ``box'' quantization scheme that markedly enhances resilience to transmission bit errors across diverse compression rates. Considering partial system observability and distinct node objectives, we formulate two interdependent optimization problems: (i)~mobile devices (MDs) maximize inference accuracy under quality-of-service (QoS) and queue-stability constraints by jointly adapting dynamic split deep neural network (DNN) branches and cell association; and (ii)~each edge server (ES) allocates bandwidth, graphics processing unit (GPU) frequency, and modulation and coding scheme (MCS) to maximize the max--min inference accuracy among associated MDs under cell capacity limits. We solve these problems using a multi-agent distributed optimization framework, where MDs act as causal contextual multi-armed bandit (MAB) agents under backlog-aware Lyapunov control, while each ES executes resource allocation via block coordinate descent (BCD). Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, OMNIS+ reduces the QoS violation probability by up to 1.75 while achieving a better accuracy--violation trade-off.

AI.tldr: OMNIS+ 是一个面向多小区边缘计算的语义RAN切片框架，基于动态拆分神经网络与"box"量化，联合优化设备端DNN分支/小区关联与边缘端资源分配，在QoS约束下最大化推理精度。
AI.motivation: 现有RAN切片框架依赖静态计算模型，无法利用现代神经架构带来的动态语义数据表示能力，难以在通信负载与计算维度之间灵活权衡。
AI.method: 采用动态神经压缩+自适应量化（含新型"box"量化，提升对传输比特错误的鲁棒性）构建多样化决策空间；将问题分解为两个相互依赖的优化问题：MD联合调整动态拆分DNN分支与小区关联以最大化精度；ES在小区容量约束下分配带宽、GPU频率与MCS以最大化关联MD间的最小精度。求解上，MD作为因果上下文多臂老虎机智能体，结合积压感知的Lyapunov控制；ES采用块坐标下降（BCD）进行资源分配。
AI.result: 相较SOTA基线，OMNIS+将QoS违规概率最多降低1.75（相对量），并获得更优的精度—违规权衡。
AI.conclusion: 语义RAN切片结合动态拆分神经模型可有效提升多小区边缘计算的QoS保障与精度表现，验证了动态压缩与量化在资源受限场景中的价值。

title: Training for sustainable scientific software in the AI era: from code production to scientific stewardship
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Submitted to Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are changing how researchers interact with scientific software. Their effects on productivity vary across tasks and users, but they can weaken the connection between producing a successful computational artifact and retaining scientific command over the consequential choices and evidence on which it depends. For high-energy physics, this shifts part of the training challenge from code production toward scientific stewardship: researchers must be able to validate, explain, reproduce, maintain, and justify software and workflows partly generated or modified by AI. We argue that AI-aware software training should therefore combine dedicated instruction on AI systems with the integration of AI into established software and analysis training. Testing, provenance, reproducibility, resource judgment, and scientific validation should be exercised in AI-assisted workflows, with competence judged by the evidence supporting a result rather than by code generation alone. We frame this as a problem of sustainable scientific software: AI-assisted workflows should remain trustworthy and maintainable, use computational resources responsibly, and avoid making core competence unnecessarily dependent on privileged access to particular tools or infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 生成式与智能体式AI正改变高能物理科研软件的开发方式，但其削弱了"产出可用计算工件"与"保有科学掌控力"之间的联系。作者主张开展"AI感知"的软件训练，把AI系统专门教学与既有软件/分析训练相融合，以证据而非代码生成量评判能力，并将之视为"可持续科学软件"问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式与智能体AI虽提升效率，但效果因任务与用户而异；更关键的是，它可能弱化研究者对关键决策与证据的科学掌控（scientific command），使训练挑战从"写代码"转向"科学治理"（validation、解释、复现、维护与论证）。同时需避免核心能力过度依赖特定工具或基础设施的特权访问。
AI.method: 立场/观点论文（perspective）。提出AI感知软件训练框架：1）专门讲授AI系统原理；2）将AI集成进既有软件与分析训练；3）在AI辅助工作流中训练测试、溯源（provenance）、可复现性、资源判断与科学验证；4）以支撑结果的证据而非代码生成来评判胜任力，并以"可持续科学软件"为框架组织。
AI.result: 本文为观点性论述，无实证数据；其"结果"是提出训练重心应由代码生产转向科学治理，并给出可操作的能力维度（验证、解释、复现、维护、论证）与评价原则（基于证据）。
AI.conclusion: 高能物理的AI时代软件训练应兼顾AI素养与既有软件/分析训练的融合；应以AI辅助工作流的可信性、可维护性、资源责任性与可及性为目标，使科研工作流可持续，且不使核心能力依赖于特权资源。

title: FedE2E: One-Shot Federated Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Closed-Loop Evaluation
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing datasets. However, existing federated learning methods for autonomous driving typically require multi-round communication and lack closed-loop evaluation, while one-shot methods mainly focus on perception tasks. To address these limitations, we propose \method, a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving. It comprises multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation to distill knowledge from heterogeneous models. Closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive demonstrates the effectiveness of \method in both one-shot and multi-round federated learning. In the one-shot setting, it achieves a Driving Score of 55.85, which is 4.07 points higher than prior work. In the multi-round setting, it reaches 60.35 after five communication rounds, the best performance among all compared methods under the same number of communication rounds.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向端到端自动驾驶的一次性联邦学习方法，通过多客户端校准、锚点特征对齐与token级共识蒸馏，在Bench2Drive闭环评测中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶联邦学习方法通常需要多轮通信且缺乏闭环评测，而一次性方法主要局限于感知任务，无法满足端到端驾驶的需求。
AI.method: 包含三个组件：多客户端校准（multi-client calibration）、基于锚点的特征对齐（anchor-based feature alignment）和token级共识蒸馏（token-wise consensus distillation），用于从异构模型中蒸馏知识。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive闭环评测中，一次性设置下驾驶得分达55.85，比先前工作高4.07分；多轮设置下经五轮通信达到60.35，在相同通信轮数下为所有对比方法中最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在一次性与多轮联邦学习场景下均有效，为端到端自动驾驶提供了高效且可闭环验证的联邦学习方案。

title: Keep the Image in Mind: A Visual Board for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multi-step visual reasoning suffers when early visual misinterpretations persist as incorrect premises in subsequent reasoning. We argue that how visual evidence is represented during reasoning matters as much as how much of it is gathered. Rather than appending observations and inferences to an ever-growing dialogue, we introduce a Visual Board-centered harness that separates visual observations, uncertain interpretations, and derived reasoning within a structured, capacity-bounded, and revisable workspace. This separation makes each premise explicit and auditable, so that conflicts between what is seen and what is derived become detectable even by a text-only critic and can trigger targeted reinspection of the original image. Without task-specific training, our harness consistently outperforms standalone models across 4B, 8B, Qwen3-VL-Flash, and 32B configurations on Euclid30K, SolidGeo, and ChartQA bar charts, with gains of up to 11.68, 18.42, and 24.82 percentage points, respectively. Under identical tools, critic, and interaction limits, the structured Board outperforms shared free-form notes by 6.67 to 13.00 points and no-Board retries by 7.35 to 18.80 points while using 7.9\% to 38.2\% fewer tokens. Supervised fine-tuning on harness trajectories further improves direct answering and critic-free tool use, with positive transfer to chart reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以Visual Board为中心的多步视觉推理框架，将视觉观察、不确定解释与派生推理分离在结构化、容量受限、可修订的工作区中，使前提显式可审计、冲突可检测，从而触发针对性重检，无需任务特定训练即可显著提升多模型几何与图表推理表现。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉推理中，早期视觉误判会作为错误前提持续污染后续推理。作者认为视觉证据在推理过程中的“表示方式”与“采集数量”同等重要；而传统把观察与推断不断追加到冗长对话中的做法，会让前提隐含、难以审计，冲突不易发现。
AI.method: 提出Visual Board-centered harness：在一个结构化、容量有界、可修订的工作区中，明确区分视觉观察、不确定的解释、以及派生推理三类内容；由此使每个前提显式且可审计，即使在纯文本critic下也能检测“所见”与“所推”之间的冲突，并触发对原始图像的目标性重检。整套方法不依赖任务特定训练，并进一步用harness轨迹做监督微调。
AI.result: 在Euclid30K、SolidGeo和ChartQA柱状图上，4B、8B、Qwen3-VL-Flash、32B各配置均稳定超越独立模型，最大提升分别为11.68、18.42、24.82个百分点。在相同工具、critic与交互次数限制下，结构化Board比共享自由笔记高6.67–13.00分，比无Board重试高7.35–18.80分，且token用量减少7.9%–38.2%。对harness轨迹做监督微调可进一步改善直接作答与无critic工具使用，并向图表推理正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据的组织结构是多步视觉推理的关键因素；结构化可审计的Board工作区配合冲突检测与重检机制，能在不训练的情况下大幅提升性能并降低token开销，且其轨迹可用于微调带来额外收益与跨任务迁移。

title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning
summary: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.

AI.tldr: 潜空间CoT推理并非越长越好；通过估计"剩余构造性进展"自适应调整潜推理步数,可在不重训LLM的情况下提升精度并减少计算。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间推理器在推理时使用预设的固定潜推理时长（latent horizon），直觉上更长的horizon应带来更多推理机会，但作者发现把潜CoT扩展到整个预设horizon反而可能降低推理表现：潜CoT经历不同功能阶段，早期计算形成前沿推理状态，后期计算主要是对已有候选的重组，并可能削弱正确候选的支持。因此需要重新审视固定horizon的潜推理方式。
AI.method: 用"已实现的构造性进展"和"剩余的构造性进展"来刻画潜CoT的推理收益。经验上，已实现进展越高对应当前推理精度越高，剩余进展越多则继续潜CoT带来的未来增益越大。基于此，提出一种轻量方法，估计剩余推理进展并在推理过程中自适应调整潜horizon。
AI.result: 在多个代表性潜CoT推理器和多个算术基准上，该方法将推理精度最多提升7.2个百分点，同时将潜计算量最多减少29.0%，且无需重新训练LLM。
AI.conclusion: 固定horizon的潜CoT推理存在后期无效甚至有害计算；依据剩余构造性进展自适应控制潜推理长度，是一种无需重训、兼顾精度与效率的有效策略。

title: What Should an LLM Know? Knowledge-Guided Warm Starts for Software Optimization
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) process gigabytes in minutes; human experts work far more slowly. Prior studies that explored combinations of human/AI optimizers ignore this gap. Those studies asked systems or humans to label too many examples (e.g., SynthCore needs over four dozen per trial). Here, we test human and AI knowledge under a budget where evaluation is practical (a few dozen labels or fewer).
  We compare five baselines (random search, RRP, EZR, few-shot prompting, and a budget-matched SynthCore variant) against three ways to give an LLM domain knowledge before it proposes its first configurations: (1) AMP lists the domain's rules, then checks each candidate against them; (2) HKMA adds scouted data or documentation to the prompt; and (3) H-DKP has human experts correct the LLM's rules.
  We find that domain knowledge improves the "start-up" phase of LLM optimization, but only when that knowledge is checked, by the LLM itself or by a human expert. Across 49 datasets, unchecked knowledge did no better than few-shot prompting or EZR. On the other hand, AMP's self-checking variant (AMP-4) reached the best statistical rank in 44 of 49 datasets (budget-matched SynthCore: 23 of 49), and H-DKP did so in 7 of 8 expert studies. These checks cost little: half a cent of LLM calls per trial, or 6 to 10 expert contacts.
  Hence we say LLMs may not need more data, but rather their knowledge needs checking (and checking is cheap).

AI.tldr: 在低预算（几十个标签以内）条件下，给LLM注入领域知识只有在经过校验（LLM自查或人类专家纠错）时，才能提升优化的“启动”阶段表现。
AI.motivation: 以往人类/AI优化器结合的研究忽略了LLM处理速度远超人类这一差距，要求标注的样本过多（如SynthCore每次试验需40+个标签），在实际可承受的评估预算下不可行，因此需在现实预算内重新比较注入知识的策略。
AI.method: 在预算匹配（几十个标签或更少）下，比较5个基线（随机搜索、RRP、EZR、few-shot prompting、预算匹配的SynthCore变体）与3种注入领域知识的方法：(1) AMP——LLM列出领域规则并逐候选校验；(2) HKMA——向提示中加入搜集的数据或文档；(3) H-DKP——由人类专家纠正LLM的规则。
AI.result: 未校验的知识效果不比few-shot prompting或EZR更好。AMP的自校验变体AMP-4在49个数据集中有44个取得最佳统计排名（预算匹配SynthCore为23/49），H-DKP在8个专家研究中有7个取得最佳；校验成本很低，每次试验LLM调用约0.5美分，或6–10次专家沟通。
AI.conclusion: LLM可能不需要更多数据，而是需要对其知识进行校验，且校验成本低廉。

title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
comment: This is the accepted, prepublication version of a paper forthcoming in Computer Music Journal, MIT Press. Beyond routine editorial and typesetting amendments, the content remains subject to further revision before final publication
summary: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体管弦乐团"框架，用参数化量子电路作为音乐智能体，通过试错与音乐环境交互演化出不同"心态"，实现量子辅助音乐创作与表演。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐生成多依赖大规模数据训练与模仿，缺乏基于交互的涌现式、过程导向的创作方式；同时量子强化学习在音乐领域的应用尚未探索。
AI.method: 将智能体实现为参数化量子电路，在混合量子-经典循环中利用叠加与纠缠探索音乐决策空间；设计原子式（音高/节奏独立）与整体式（音高-时值统一为音符事件）两种架构，并用可组合加权的音乐性奖励塑造不同心态。
AI.result: 智能体演化出不同创作行为并能泛化到未见素材；支持MIDI交互式与离线批处理两种模式；在IBM量子硬件上的实验证实现有量子计算机可实现有音乐意义的学习。
AI.conclusion: 量子智能体应定位为自适应音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，通过交互而非模仿发展个人音乐人格；为量子计算辅助音乐创作提供可扩展基础。

title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. Target affinities are calibrated against these same-position references into right-tail Monte Carlo p-values, which are discrete super-uniform under a conditional exchangeability assumption. Calibrated screening and a high-recall semantic guard produce candidate tokens for deterministic visual deduplication and joint spatiotemporal budget allocation. To validate NullTok, we apply it to two representative MLLMs and conduct extensive experiments on a set of video benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness under a bounded visual token budget. For example, it achieves 65.81% and 68.85% on Video-MME using frozen LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones, respectively, at a cap of 64 full-frame equivalents (FFE), without subtitles or audio. These results outperform all evaluated baselines on Video-MME under the same budget for both backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/potato-kitty/NullTok.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 NullTok 方法，通过经验零分布校准与蒙特卡洛 p 值筛选视频 token，在有限视觉 token 预算下显著提升长视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频中视觉 token 数量庞大，现有"先选帧再剪 token"的两阶段范式依赖噪声较大的帧级相关性估计，会造成不可逆的证据丢失。作者希望从查询相关证据的时空分布角度重新审视这一问题。
AI.method: 对每一帧每个 patch，利用 64 个组匹配的无关控制查询构建经验零分布，表示无目标证据时的期望得分；将目标亲和度与同位置参考对比，校准为右尾蒙特卡洛 p 值（在条件可交换假设下离散超均匀）；再经校准筛选与高召回语义守门得到候选 token，进行确定性的视觉去重与联合时空预算分配。
AI.result: 在冻结的 LLaVA-Video-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，于 64 个全帧等效（FFE）token 预算、无字幕无音频条件下，Video-MME 分别取得 65.81% 与 68.85%，在两个骨干上均优于同预算下所有评估基线。
AI.conclusion: NullTok 为长视频 MLLM 提供了一种免训练、有统计依据的 token 筛选方案，能在严格 token 预算下有效保留查询相关证据并提升长视频理解表现，代码已开源。

title: Algorithmic Market Making Can Lead to Rough Volatility Through the Order Book
summary: Existing work suggests that markets can show volatility with paths rougher than those of Brownian motion. In theory this can happen when the order flow is close to instability with memory that decays as a power law. However, it is not fully clear how such order flow could arise from the predominantly algorithmic market making that characterizes order book dynamics. We show one such consistent mechanism. We treat each market maker as a desk that uses a first-order gradient rule to move the distances of its orders from the mid price toward target distances provided by an unknown oracle. We assume that distinct desks do not act synchronously in time but act whenever new information relevant to their respective oracles arrives, which each desk samples over its own characteristic lookback horizon. Across all desks the rule therefore takes the form of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with information-driven (mini-batch) noise. In the continuum limit this update rule makes the volume of the order book follow a conservative stochastic partial differential equation (the Dean--Kawasaki equation) whose fluctuations drive the order flow. The distinct horizons of the desks further induce a persistent memory in the order flow that decays as a power law. Standard scaling arguments then lead to rough volatility. We confirm the key predictions of the model on simulated agents and on six months of Binance data with about 790 million orders. In liquid markets governed mainly by market makers, such as the perpetual futures of Binance, the order books are consistent with how our desks change the book.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个从算法做市微观机制推导粗波动率的模型：将做市商视为用一阶梯度规则调整挂单距中间价距离的"desk"，其异步、信息驱动的更新在连续极限下等价于带信息驱动噪声的SGD，使订单簿成交量服从Dean–Kawasaki型保守SPDE，并因各desk不同回看期限产生幂律衰减记忆，进而经标准标度论证得到粗波动率；在模拟智能体与约7.9亿笔Binance订单上验证了关键预测。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明市场波动路径比布朗运动更"粗糙"，理论上这源于订单流接近不稳定且记忆呈幂律衰减；但订单簿动态主要由算法做市主导，这种订单流如何从算法做市中产生尚不清楚。本文旨在给出一个自洽的微观机制解释。
AI.method: 把每个做市商建模为一个desk，用一阶梯度规则将其挂单与中间价的距离调整向未知oracle给出的目标距离；假设不同desk不同步行动，而是在各自oracle相关信息到达时行动，并按各自特征回看期限采样。整体规则因而成为带信息驱动（mini-batch）噪声的SGD。在连续极限下，该更新规则使订单簿成交量服从保守SPDE（Dean–Kawasaki方程），其涨落驱动订单流；各desk回看期限的异质性引入幂律持续记忆，再经标准标度论证导出粗波动率。用模拟智能体与六个月的Binance数据（约7.9亿笔订单）进行验证。
AI.result: 模型的关键预测在模拟智能体以及与约7.9亿笔Binance订单的实证数据上均得到确认；在主要由做市商主导的流动性市场（如Binance永续合约）中，订单簿行为与模型所描述的desk改变订单簿的方式一致。
AI.conclusion: 算法做市的异步、信息驱动挂单调整可机制性地产生带幂律记忆的订单流，进而导致粗波动率；该机制在真实高流动性市场中与数据相符。

title: Integrating AI Coding Agents Into Scientific Research
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Software publicly available at https://github.com/RoryBarnes/vaibify
summary: New software tools have emerged that enable AI agents to quickly develop code that analyzes data and generates figures, but their mistakes can also harm a researcher's computer, require extensive resources for validation, and cause the results to be received more skeptically. These concerns could be mitigated if scientific software is developed in a secure environment with a system for monitoring file changes and well-defined standards for handling AI agents. This paper first describes how coding agents change eleven aspects of generating, verifying, and reproducing numerical results. A six-level scale is then proposed for classifying AI-assisted numerical experiments by their provenance, reproducibility, openness, oversight, and falsifiability (PROOF). The scale begins with locally self-consistent, version-controlled, human-verified results and culminates in a publicly accessible and curated archive of the files, change history, prompt transcripts, independent agent regeneration of the analysis, and multiple cryptographically verifiable attestations of regeneration by independent researchers. These aspects of AI-assisted scientific software development have been synthesized into a new open source software package called vaibify that optimizes the agentic development of computational experiments ascending the PROOF Ladder. Docker containers sequester the agents while a GUI enables researchers to prompt command line agents, monitor the current status of local and remote files, and drive a project to PROOF Level 3 (reproducible). The methods described in this paper could help researchers reduce the time required to verify agent-written software and efficiently communicate trust in AI-assisted science.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用 PROOF 六级量表对 AI 辅助数值实验的可信度分层，并发布开源工具 vaibify，用 Docker 隔离智能体、GUI 监控文件变化，帮助项目升至 PROOF Level 3（可复现）。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体能快速生成数据分析与绘图代码，但其错误可能损害研究者计算机、验证成本高、结果也更易被质疑；现有科学软件开发缺少安全环境、文件变更监控与 AI 智能体使用规范。
AI.method: 先论述编码智能体对数值结果生成、验证与复现的 11 个方面的影响；再提出按来源、可复现性、开放性、监督与可证伪性（PROOF）分类的六级量表，从本地自洽、版本控制、人工验证，到含提示记录、智能体独立重生成及多方密码学证明的公开策展档案；最后实现开源包 vaibify，以 Docker 容器隔离智能体并提供 GUI，用于下达提示、监控本地与远程文件状态并推动项目达标。
AI.result: vaibify 可使研究项目推进至 PROOF Level 3（可复现），支持研究者提示命令行智能体并实时监控文件变化，虽未给出量化评测数据，但工具已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有望缩短验证智能体所写软件所需时间，并高效传达 AI 辅助科学的可信程度，为 AI 参与科研提供可分级、可审计的规范框架。

title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
summary: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniKE任务与OmniKE-Bench基准，并发布KnowledgeClaw系统，在六项任务上均排名第一（OKE 55.9，超最强基线14.6）。
AI.motivation: 知识工程已从分块/图RAG发展到记忆代理、代理式KE与多模态KE，但一个"活"知识库需同时具备全模态、闭环生命周期与多粒度应用三项能力；现有系统最多满足两项，且没有基准能同时衡量三者。
AI.method: 形式化定义全模态知识工程（OmniKE）；构建OmniKE-Bench（6任务、1829个无需模型评判的条目、3960个真实文件、5种模态）；提出KnowledgeClaw——构建全模态类型化超图，用闭环生命周期代理维护更新，并按查询需求路由到合适粒度。
AI.result: 对比30个基线，六项任务全部第一，综合OKE 55.9，较最强基线提升14.6；软件与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: OmniKE确立了三位一体的知识工程新范式，OmniKE-Bench提供可复现评测，KnowledgeClaw验证了统一方案的显著优势。

title: Can AI Understand Indonesian Children's Book Illustrations? Compliance, Safety, and the Cultural Alignment Gap
comment: Accepted at Workshop on Computer Vision for Children (CV4CHL) at CVPR 2026 (Non-Proceeding Track)
summary: Children's book illustrations carry developmental, pedagogical, and cultural responsibilities that are often formally codified in guidelines. As AI systems begin entering children's publishing pipelines, both as evaluators and as generators, a natural question arises: can they reliably meet the structural, safety, and cultural standards required? We investigate this across three criteria: guideline compliance, safety, and cultural alignment, using Indonesia's Book Leveling Guideline as a government-issued evaluation framework with explicit visual criteria for four reading levels. To understand how well VLMs can identify and apply these guideline criteria, we first evaluate them on real published children's book pages and compare their assessments against a human baseline. To then examine whether AI-generated illustrations meet the same standards, we apply the VLM judge to images produced by two generation models and cross-check them against a subset of human illustrator raters. We find that VLMs are reliable on explicit criteria such as compliance and safety, but fall short on cultural alignment, systematically missing content that human raters flag as culturally inappropriate. AI-generated illustrations show the same blind spot: they satisfy structural and safety criteria but fail to capture implicit cultural details that human raters consistently identify.

AI.tldr: 该论文以印尼《Book Leveling Guideline》为评估框架，检验视觉语言模型（VLM）在儿童绘本插画的合规性、安全性与文化契合度三方面的表现，发现VLM在显性标准上可靠，但在文化契合度上系统性失效，AI生成插画也存在同样的"文化盲点"。
AI.motivation: 儿童绘本插画承担发展、教学与文化责任，且多被正式指南规范。随着AI系统进入童书出版流程（既作评估者又作生成者），需要回答它们能否可靠满足结构、安全与文化标准。
AI.method: 采用印尼政府《Book Leveling Guideline》（含四个阅读层级的明确视觉标准）作为评估框架。(1) 先在真实出版童书页面上评估VLM识别与应用指南标准的能力，并与人类基线对比；(2) 再用VLM评判两个生成模型产出的插画，并与部分人类插画师评分交叉验证。
AI.result: VLM在合规性、安全性等显性标准上表现可靠，但在文化契合度上表现不足，会系统性遗漏人类评分者标记为文化不当的内容。AI生成插画呈现同样的盲点：满足结构与安全标准，却未能捕捉人类评分者一致识别的隐性文化细节。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM与AI生成插画尚不能可靠承担文化层面的童书标准，未来需加强对隐性文化细节的识别与生成能力，谨慎将AI纳入儿童出版流程。

title: From Data to Valves: A Self-Learning, Production-Grade Edge Stack for Sustainable HVAC Control
summary: Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions alone, with a behaviour anchor and critic calibration terms, is scored by four model-free metrics and promoted by atomic hot-swap. (c) A change-point regression baseline held to ASHRAE Guideline 14 supplies the counterfactual against which savings are certified. On eighteen months of data from a hotel the forecaster converges from random weights within a week and reaches 0.37, 0.39 and 0.11 degree C MAE for air-handling, fresh-air and fan-coil units with no retraining event; on a different hotel the baseline reproduces a 46-day held-out period to within 0.07%. The RL agent has completed its in-simulator campaign and runs in shadow on 104 units; we report measured latency and memory of every service on a shared 15 GB device, the systems lessons of the campaign, and precisely what the evidence does and does not yet establish.

AI.tldr: 提出一套部署于每栋建筑单台Jetson Orin网关上的HVAC学习控制生产栈：含在线预序学习的设备级温度预测器、在设备端夜间训练并可原子热切换的DSAC冷水阀控制策略、以及基于ASHRAE Guideline 14的变化点回归节能量基准，并如实报告验证结果与证据边界。
AI.motivation: 学习型HVAC控制器大多停留在仿真中，少数部署的也只是离线训练、部署后冻结、依赖云端重训，缺乏可持续自适应、安全约束与可核证节能的完整生产方案。
AI.method: 三个组件同机运行在单台Jetson Orin边缘网关上：(a)紧凑transformer编码器预测器，按设备组划分并带学习型单机嵌入，以每5分钟一个梯度步的预序方式学习，并有五道独立门控限制异常读数的梯度影响；(b)跨设备类型共享策略的分布式SAC智能体，将状态映射为冷冻水阀开度，受不可被学习组件放宽的结构性安全包络约束，第二代每晚用设备上录制的转移数据训练（含行为锚定与critic校准项），以四项无模型指标评分并原子热切换晋级；(c)遵循ASHRAE Guideline 14的变化点回归基线提供反事实。
AI.result: 某酒店18个月数据上，预测器一周内从随机权重收敛且此后无重训，AHU、新风、风机盘管MAE分别0.37、0.39、0.11℃；另一酒店基线在46天留出期误差0.07%以内；RL智能体已完成仿真阶段并在104台设备上影子运行，并报告了15GB共享设备上各服务的实测延迟与内存。
AI.conclusion: 证明了学习型HVAC控制可在单台边缘网关上持续自适应、带安全保障并自验证其效果，同时明确界定了现有证据能支持与尚不能支持的结论。

title: RootSink: Reproducible C/C++ Crashes with Tested Repair Sites
summary: When a C or C++ program crashes on a crafted input, the line that crashes is often not the line that is wrong. Tools and models that repair or locate vulnerabilities need examples showing both, with evidence for each, which existing datasets rarely provide. RootSink provides 3341 records from 354 open-source projects. Most give the crash site a memory-error detector reported and a candidate location for its root cause, and label each with a weakness type and its evidence. For the 1954 records in the Reproduced tier, we re-ran the crash ourselves and confirmed that the fixed version runs cleanly. In 1275 of these, a single hunk of the developer's fix stopped the crash on its own. That marks a tested repair site, though not necessarily the defect, and 1273 records use it as the root. In a blind audit of an earlier version, two co-author raters called 68% and 92% of the tested repair sites they saw the defect, but only 37% and 51% of that version's located Reproduced-tier roots. RootSink ships with tasks, a patch scorer and run logs.

AI.tldr: RootSink 发布了 3341 条来自 354 个开源项目的 C/C++ 崩溃记录，同时标注崩溃点与根因候选位置，用于漏洞定位与修复任务。
AI.motivation: 程序崩溃的行往往不是出错的行，但现有数据集很少同时提供崩溃点和根因位置及其证据，导致修复与漏洞定位工具缺乏训练和评测素材。
AI.method: 从 354 个开源项目收集 3341 条记录，多数含检测器报告的崩溃点和根因候选位置，并标注弱点类型及证据；其中 1954 条为 Reproduced 层，作者亲自复现崩溃并确认修复版运行正常，1275 条中开发者的单个修复 hunk 即可单独阻止崩溃，1273 条以此作为根因。
AI.result: 在早期版本的盲审中，两名共同作者评审者将所见已测试修复点的 68% 和 92% 判为缺陷，但对该版本 Reproduced 层已定位根因仅分别判为 37% 和 51%。
AI.conclusion: RootSink 提供带任务、补丁评分器和运行日志的数据集，强调"已测试修复点"与"真实缺陷"的区别，可作为漏洞定位与修复评测基准。

title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution
summary: Building autonomous agents that continually explore open worlds and acquire new capabilities through experience is a long-standing aspiration in artificial intelligence. Existing research often pursues lifelong learning within predefined tasks, curricula, or objectives, with self-improvement largely confined to individual agents. We introduce OpenKAGE, an agent-group evolution framework for open-ended lifelong learning. Within this framework, agents autonomously explore open worlds and continually acquire new capabilities by accumulating and reusing knowledge from their own interactions and the experience of others. OpenKAGE builds on two key mechanisms: (1) a two-layer knowledge representation, with a memory layer for situated memories and an experience layer for transferable experience and skills that retains the applicability conditions needed for reuse; and (2) a knowledge-sharing mechanism that semantically consolidates textual experience into a continuously evolving shared knowledge graph, while executable skills are shared verbatim. In Minecraft, OpenKAGE supports open-ended lifelong learning, enabling agent groups to sustain exploration and reach advanced technological milestones. Furthermore, the accumulated knowledge can be transferred to a newly initialized agent group on a different backbone model, improving its survival and exploration progress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenKAGE，一个面向开放世界终身学习的智能体群体进化框架。智能体自主探索并通过积累/复用自身与他人经验持续获得新能力，可为不同后端的全新智能体群体提供可迁移知识。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在预设任务、课程或目标内做终身学习，自我提升也局限于单个智能体；缺少在开放世界中自主探索、并在群体层面共享与复用经验以实现开放式终身学习的机制。
AI.method: 提出 OpenKAGE 框架，包含两大机制：(1) 双层知识表示——记忆层存情景化记忆，经验层存可迁移的经验与技能，并保留其复用所需的适用条件；(2) 知识共享机制——将文本经验语义化整合为持续演化的共享知识图谱，可执行技能则以原文逐字共享。
AI.result: 在 Minecraft 中实现开放式终身学习，智能体群体能持续探索并达到高级技术里程碑；积累的知识可迁移至基于不同骨干模型新初始化的智能体群体，提升其生存能力与探索进度。
AI.conclusion: 群体层面的知识积累、复用与迁移是实现开放世界终身学习与能力自我提升的有效路径。

title: Beyond Additive Composition: Interventional Modeling of State-Dependent Cross-Degradation Responses for Composite Image Restoration
summary: Composite image restoration aims to recover images corrupted by multiple coexisting degradations. Existing methods predominantly decompose composite corruptions into individual factors, relying on these isolated priors to guide restoration. However, coexisting degradations are inherently interdependent: the manifestation of one degradation dynamically shifts with the states of others, inducing non-additive interactions that factor-wise paradigms fail to capture. To bridge this gap, we formulate state-dependent cross-degradation responses and propose PROBE, an interventional framework that explicitly models how coexisting degradations influence one another. Specifically, we first construct unified degradation axes by aligning visual and textual degraded-clean offsets. Along these axes, a calibrated coordinate head estimates current degradation states, while bidirectional feature perturbations are injected to probe cross-coordinate responses under the current states. Contrasting these responses with corresponding intensity-matched single-degradation references quantifies intrinsic non-additive deviations, allowing the resulting response descriptors and state coordinates to jointly guide restoration. For comprehensive evaluation, we introduce SCD-15, a new benchmark covering all 15 nonempty combinations of four degradation factors at three severity levels. Experiments demonstrate that PROBE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the CDD-11, AWMM-100K, and SCD-15 composite restoration datasets using a compact model with modest GPU memory requirements.

AI.tldr: PROBE提出一种干预式框架，显式建模复合退化间的状态依赖交叉响应，通过统一退化轴与双向特征扰动探测非加性偏差，在多个复合复原基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有复合图像复原方法将复合退化分解为独立因素并依赖孤立先验，但共存退化本质相互依赖——一种退化的表现随其他退化状态动态变化，产生非加性交互，因素式范式无法捕捉。
AI.method: 首先通过对齐视觉与文本的退化-干净偏移构建统一退化轴；在轴上用校准坐标头估计当前退化状态，并注入双向特征扰动以探测当前状态下的跨坐标响应；将响应对照强度匹配的单退化参考，量化内在非加性偏差，最终以响应描述子与状态坐标共同引导复原。另构建SCD-15基准，覆盖四种退化因子全部15种非空组合、三种严重程度。
AI.result: 在CDD-11、AWMM-100K和SCD-15三个复合复原数据集上达到SOTA，且模型紧凑、GPU显存需求适中。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模退化间状态依赖交互比因素分解范式更有效，为复合图像复原提供了干预式建模范式与更全面的评测基准。

title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure; includes supplementary proofs and reproduction code
summary: Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[μ,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $χ\in[1,L/μ]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-μχ)/(2μL\sqrtχ)$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在给定条件数约束下，联邦本地更新可实现的最小最坏情况偏差，并给出精确的偏差率 $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$，证明本地梯度下降与近端更新可达该界。
AI.motivation: 本地计算能改善联邦更新的条件数，但会引入偏差，使不动点偏离全局最优解。作者希望弄清在固定条件数约束下，可达到的最小最坏情况偏差究竟是多少。
AI.method: 考虑强凸二次客户端目标，Hessian 特征值位于 $[\mu,L]$，本地更新由共享的正谱滤波器表示；用全局最优点的均方根梯度衡量异构性。作者将任意维度、含非交换 Hessian 的总体归约为标量曲率上的分布，从而给出最优性证书与最坏情况构造（最多三个标量客户端）。
AI.result: 对受限于 $\chi\in[1,L/\mu]$ 的一致代理条件数，精确最坏偏差为每单位异构性 $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$，且步长足够小的本地梯度下降与近端更新可达此界。该尖锐近端偏差界进一步推广到二次型之外的平滑强凸目标，并量化了不精确本地求解带来的误差。
AI.conclusion: 本地计算的条件数改善与偏差之间存在精确的权衡关系，作者给出的界是最优的，可指导联邦优化中本地更新策略的设计。

title: Systematic Mapping Protocol. Generative AI-Augmented Requirements Engineering: A Systematic Mapping Study of Practices, Specifications, and Reuse in Software Development
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), particularly large language models (LLMs), is rapidly being adopted in requirements engineering (RE). Existing secondary studies have characterized which RE activities are supported and which prompting strategies are used, but little is known about the specifications that GenAI-augmented RE produces and how they are used in subsequent activities such as specification-driven development (SDD), design and code generation, test derivation, verification, and reuse. This document presents the protocol of a systematic mapping study (SMS) that will identify and classify research on GenAI-augmented RE, with particular attention to the work products it generates and their downstream use. The protocol defines the research questions and their classification schemes, the search strategy, the study selection procedure, the data extraction form, the analysis approach, the tool support, and the threats to validity. It is published in advance to establish a prior commitment and to support the transparency and repeatability of the study.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份系统映射研究(SMS)的方案(protocol)，将对GenAI增强的需求工程(RE)研究进行识别与分类，重点关注其产生的工作产物及其在下游活动中的使用。
AI.motivation: GenAI/LLM已被快速引入需求工程，已有综述研究刻画了其支持的RE活动和提示策略，但其生成的规格说明是什么样的、如何在规格驱动开发(SDD)、设计、代码生成、测试派生、验证与复用等下游活动中被使用，仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 预先发布系统映射研究方案，定义研究问题及其分类框架、检索策略、研究筛选流程、数据抽取表、分析方法、工具支持与效度威胁。
AI.result: 本文为方案性文档，尚未给出研究结果；其产出是可供透明、可重复执行的SMS流程规范，并作为事先承诺。
AI.conclusion: 通过提前公开方案，确立事先承诺，提升研究的透明度与可重复性，为后续识别和分类GenAI增强RE及其产物下游使用的研究奠定基础。

title: Benchmarking LLM abilities on postdoc-level natural science problems
summary: Scientific problems have no answer key, so evaluating an agent means deciding what counts as a better solution before any agent is run. Existing benchmarks either match a symbolic answer against a key or, where they require executable work, score it by unit tests, by a rubric, or by position on a competition leaderboard. None of these is the criterion by which a field decides that one published method beats another. STEMBench adopts that criterion directly. Each of its twelve research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics and neuroscience is scored by its own field's figure of merit, and each comes with two measured anchors: a submission that uses no domain knowledge, and an expert reference reproducing a published method, both obtained by running code shipped with the benchmark. The interval between them states how much of a problem is crossed by scientific insight rather than by engineering. Across eight frontier models, task-level wins and domain-level leadership dissociate: a model that wins five of the twelve tasks leads no domain mean. In the high-effort cross-model comparison, at least one model's mean score exceeds the expert anchor on seven of twelve tasks. The remaining five span uncertainty estimation, latent and causal inference, and cross-site clinical classification. Numerical scores and official-submission validity capture different aspects of performance and are reported separately. We release the tasks, graders, anchors and harness.

AI.tldr: STEMBench 提出以各学科自身的"figure of merit"（领域公认评价指标）而非答案匹配或单元测试来评判科研型智能体，为 12 个高能物理、天体物理与神经科学问题各设置"无领域知识"与"专家复现已发表方法"两个实测锚点，用以衡量科学洞见跨越的比例。
AI.motivation: 科学问题没有标准答案，现有基准要么比对符号答案，要么用单元测试、评分量表或竞赛排行榜位置来打分，都不能反映学界判定"某方法优于另一方法"的真实标准。因此需要一个直接采用领域图优值指标的评价框架。
AI.method: 构建含 12 个前沿科研问题（高能物理、天体物理、神经科学）的基准，每题采用本领域的图优值指标评分；每题提供两个通过基准自带代码实测得到的锚点——不使用领域知识的提交，以及复现已发表方法的专家参考解；两锚点之间的区间刻画由科学洞见（而非工程实现）所跨越的部分。对 8 个前沿模型进行任务级与领域级评估，并做高算力下的跨模型比较；同时分别报告数值分数与官方提交有效性。
AI.result: 任务级胜出与领域级领先出现分离：某模型在 12 个任务中赢下 5 个，却在任何领域的平均分上都不领先。在高投入跨模型比较中，至少有一个模型在 7/12 个任务上的平均分超过专家锚点；剩余 5 个任务涉及不确定性估计、潜变量与因果推断、跨站点临床分类。数值分数与官方提交有效性反映不同侧面，需分开报告。
AI.conclusion: 以领域图优值与实测锚点为评判标准，可更贴近科研实践地衡量智能体的科学能力，并揭示单项任务表现与整体领域领导力的不一致；任务、评分器、锚点与运行框架将全部开源发布。

title: SixthView: A Benchmark for Hidden-View Reconstruction and 3D Assembly Reasoning
summary: Inferring the unseen side of a 3D assembly requires reasoning about part placement and occlusion. Different assemblies can match the observed views while producing different hidden views, leaving the target ambiguous. We introduce SixthView, a benchmark in which models predict a sixth orthographic view from five observed views and information about the component shapes. The benchmark contains 602 synthetic polycube assemblies with 2--10 parts and requires a dense grid of part labels for the missing view, allowing both exact-view and cell-level evaluation. For each item, we exhaustively verify that all legal assemblies consistent with the exact component geometry and observed label grids yield the same target view.
