With these inputs, the task tests symbolic assembly and coordinate reasoning. The image-only variants additionally require shape recovery from rendered views, where occlusion can make different 3D shapes look identical. We evaluate three vision-language models under four input conditions. Across 552 items with complete evaluations, exact-grid accuracy with images plus exact text ranges from 33.2% to 85.4%. Adding exact text to separate images improves accuracy by 19.7--63.0 percentage points, whereas adding images to exact text changes it by only $-0.5$ to $+2.1$ points. Separate image panels outperform a merged sheet by 6.7--11.1 points. The results show that performance depends strongly on access to exact symbolic information, with little further improvement from images once the geometry is specified. GitHub: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sixthview_benchmark

AI.tldr: 提出 SixthView 基准：由五个正交视图与部件几何信息预测第六视图，需输出稠密部件标签网格；用于考察三维装配与遮挡推理。
AI.motivation: 推断 3D 装配的不可见一侧需推理部件放置与遮挡；不同装配可匹配观测视图却产生不同隐藏视图，导致目标歧义。现有任务缺乏对"唯一可验证"隐藏视图与符号化装配推理的严格评测。
AI.method: 构建 602 个合成 polycube 装配（2–10 个部件），要求预测第六正交视图的稠密部件标签网格，支持精确视图与单元格级评估；对每项穷举验证所有与部件几何和观测标签网格一致的合法装配，确保目标视图唯一。含纯图像变体（需从渲染视图恢复形状）。评测 3 个视觉语言模型、4 种输入条件。
AI.result: 552 项完整评测中，"图像+精确文本"的精确网格准确率为 33.2%–85.4%；在独立图像中加入精确文本提升 19.7–63.0 个百分点，而在精确文本中加入图像仅变化 −0.5 至 +2.1 点；分离图像面板比合并图优 6.7–11.1 点。
AI.conclusion: 性能强烈依赖能否获得精确符号信息；一旦几何被明确给定，图像几乎不带来额外提升。这表明当前模型的瓶颈在于符号化装配与坐标推理，而非视觉感知。

title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
summary: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.

AI.tldr: 提出多专家回放策略蒸馏（MRPD），直接复用各领域专家RL训练日志（含采样概率与奖励），按专家学习顺序回放并重建策略梯度、在已记录前缀上蒸馏最终专家分布，实现无需采样、无需环境与奖励模型的低成本专家合并，效果优于MOPD且算力仅为专家训练的约1/7。
AI.motivation: 主流后训练范式是先分领域RL训练专家，再用多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）合并，但MOPD需重新采样、专家对每个token打分，成本高，且学生易继承教师漂移；而专家RL过程其实已产出带概率和奖励的rollout，可直接利用。
AI.method: MRPD在各专家自身的训练日志上回放：按专家学习顺序将带评分的轨迹传给当前学生，每步在这些轨迹上重算策略梯度，并在记录的前缀处蒸馏最终专家的分布。回放跟随专家自身轨迹可降低训练-推理不匹配并使学生在clip范围内，从而虽源于off-policy但整个合并过程近似on-policy。全过程不采样、不调用环境或奖励模型，训练器单进程运行。
AI.result: 在推理、搜索、SQL三个长程智能体任务上，MRPD得到最佳学生模型，显著超过在线RL基线，以远低于MOPD的成本超越同源专家的MOPD。分析表明，回放轨迹带来主要增益，策略梯度与蒸馏项均有贡献；日志顺序的影响比数据量或奖励更大。
AI.conclusion: 专家RL训练日志本身即可支撑高效合并；合并成本仅为训练专家的约1/7。日志应被视为课程（curriculum）而非数据混合，顺序至为关键。

title: Idempotency Is Not Recovery: A Fault-Injection Study of Language-Model Agent Tool Actions
summary: When a language-model agent's tool call is interrupted, the action may already have changed an external system without confirmation. Retrying risks duplication; assuming success may conceal an action that never occurred. We study these failure modes in a controlled agent runtime combining authorization, an action ledger, target-side idempotency, reconciliation, and evidence sealing. We inject ten single-host fault classes and compare four configurations and three ablations using a target-side oracle separate from the runtime ledger. On each of Windows and Linux, 7,513 trials used 96 captured model responses from 24 constructed cases. In 200 known original crash and replay pairs, the full configuration recorded 0/200 repeated effects versus 117/200 for each simpler baseline. A ledger-related ablation had 170/170 orphaned effects versus 0/170 and 200/300 recovery successes versus 300/300 for the full configuration. Disabling reconciliation left 100/100 known post-effect crash outcomes ambiguous despite no observed duplicates. A separate supplement designed after the initial results and reusing the same inputs found a similar pattern under response loss or delay. The full runtime had about one-seventh of fail-open throughput, while injected evidence-write faults left 75/100 trials per platform unresolved. These findings distinguish duplicate suppression from recovery and identify their measured reliability and performance tradeoffs within the tested benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型智能体工具调用被中断时的重复执行与丢失两类失败模式，构建了包含授权、动作账本、目标端幂等、对账与证据封存的受控运行时，并通过故障注入实验量化不同配置的可靠性—性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 工具调用被中断时，动作可能已在外部系统生效却未获确认：重试会导致重复副作用，假定成功则会掩盖从未发生的动作，需要区分并量化这两种失败模式及可恢复性。
AI.method: 构建受控智能体运行时（授权+动作账本+目标端幂等+对账+证据封存），注入10类单主机故障，比较4种配置与3种消融；使用与运行时账本独立的"目标端预言机"验证效果。Windows与Linux各7,513次试验，基于24个构造案例的96条模型回复；另做一项在初始结果之后设计、复用相同输入的补充实验（响应丢失/延迟）。
AI.result: 已知原始崩溃—重放对中，完整配置重复效果0/200，各简化基线均为117/200；账本相关消融中孤儿效果170/170（完整配置0/170），恢复成功200/300（完整配置300/300）；禁用对账导致100/100已知效果后崩溃结果不确定（但未观测到重复）。完整运行时吞吐约为基线的1/7（fail-open）；证据写入故障导致每平台75/100试验无法裁定。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确区分了"重复抑制"与"恢复"两类能力，并给出其在本基准下的可靠性与性能代价；证据封存本身是新的失效点，完整配置以显著吞吐下降换取可靠性。

title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
summary:
AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy.
  We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. Following this observation, we show that by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy. Strikingly, this simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style task router, highlighting a practical path for deploying cost-aware coding agents in production without complex learned task routers and with minimal engineering complexity.

AI.tldr: 论文比较36个2024年后发布的开源大小模型在软件工程基准上的表现，发现小模型在简单/中等任务上已接近大模型，据此提出"先小模型、失败再升级大模型"的级联推理策略，可在不损失精度下降低最高33%的GPU小时成本。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体广受欢迎，但消耗大量GPU算力，影响盈利性与大规模可行性；作者想验证更小更便宜的模型能否在不牺牲准确率的前提下降低成本。
AI.method: 在软件工程基准上评测2024年以来发布的36个主流开源大/小模型，分析大小模型精度差距的结构（集中于困难任务），并据此设计混合推理策略：先尝试小模型，必要时才升级到大模型（级联/esc alation），并与oracle式任务路由器对比。
AI.result: 差距高度集中在小模型无法解决的困难任务，简单和中等任务准确率已相当好；级联策略在SWE-bench Verified全部任务上实现最高33%的GPU小时成本下降、16.4%（平均）成本降低，且不损失精度；效果近乎媲美oracle任务路由器。
AI.conclusion: 简单的级联式混合推理即可实现成本感知的编码智能体部署，无需复杂的可学习任务路由器，工程复杂度低，具备生产可行性。

title: ProxySearch: Decoupled Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models via Asymmetric Noise-Rank Transfer
summary: Noise search at inference time improves text-to-image diffusion but requires many multi-step teacher rollouts per query. Distilled few-step models are now routinely released, yet their potential as proxies inside noise search is uncharacterized. We measure proxy-teacher rank agreement across three distillation regimes and three backbones (DiT, MMDiT, UNet) and find a sharp asymmetry. On our main pool, closed-form image statistics transfer from the proxy to the teacher (Spearman $ρ$ up to 0.80), while learned semantic scorers do not ($ρ\le$ 0.12). Paired null controls trace this rank to the first denoising step for coarse statistics and to distillation for finer ones. We use the asymmetry for noise search under a joint constraint: a semantic reward specifies content, and a numeric target specifies image statistics. In PROXYSEARCH, the proxy filters candidates by statistical match in 1 step, and the teacher returns the survivor with the highest semantic reward. No weight trades one objective against the other. On FLUX-1024, PROXYSEARCH tightens the statistical target by 21-23% at the same number of teacher trajectories, with no detected loss on the optimized reward.

AI.tldr: 蒸馏少步模型在噪声搜索中可作代理：图像统计量可从代理迁移到教师（ρ≤0.80），但学习式语义打分器不能（ρ≤0.12）；据此提出 PROXYSEARCH，用代理单步过滤统计匹配候选、教师按语义奖励选优。
AI.motivation: 推理时噪声搜索能提升文生图扩散质量，但每查询需多次多步教师rollout，代价高昂。少步蒸馏模型已普遍发布，但其作为代理的可行性尚缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 在3种蒸馏范式×3种骨干（DiT、MMDiT、UNet）上测量代理-教师排序一致性，并用配对零对照追溯排序来源；据此设计 PROXYSEARCH：代理1步按统计匹配筛选候选，教师对幸存者返回语义奖励最高者，双目标不互为权重折中。
AI.result: 发现尖锐不对称：闭式图像统计量可从代理迁移到教师（Spearman ρ最高0.80），学习式语义打分器则不行（ρ≤0.12）；粗统计的排序源于第一步去噪，细粒度源于蒸馏。FLUX-1024上同等教师轨迹数下统计目标收紧21-23%，优化的奖励无检测到的损失。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏少步模型是"统计可靠、语义不可靠"的部分代理，可用于约束式噪声搜索实现零成本双目标满足。

title: FDM+: A Framework for Constrained Control of the 2D Radiative Transport Equation
summary: Applying the frozen diffusion model (FDM) [29] to the constrained control of the 2D radiative transport equation presents several challenges. These include the dimensional difference between control variables and state functions, the resolution mismatch between traditional numerical solvers and deep learning models, and solution non-uniqueness. To address these obstacles, we propose a novel approach, FDM+, which includes three key improvements. Firstly, a decoupled prediction architecture is introduced to address the dimensional heterogeneity. Secondly, an efficient parameterization strategy resolves the resolution mismatch. Meanwhile, we derive a total error bound to analyze how the parameterization error and the model estimation error jointly affect the performance. Thirdly, the conditional distribution learned by the diffusion model is leveraged to perform design space exploration for multi-solution problems. A series of numerical experiments demonstrate that FDM+ outperforms existing methods in reconstruction accuracy and design flexibility.

AI.tldr: 提出FDM+方法，通过三项改进（解耦预测架构、高效参数化策略、利用扩散模型条件分布探索设计空间）解决冻结扩散模型在二维辐射传输方程约束控制中的挑战。
AI.motivation: 将冻结扩散模型(FDM)用于二维辐射传输方程的约束控制面临三大难题：控制变量与状态函数之间的维度差异、传统数值求解器与深度学习模型之间的分辨率不匹配、以及解的非唯一性。
AI.method: FDM+包含三项关键改进：(1)解耦预测架构处理维度异构性；(2)高效参数化策略解决分辨率不匹配，并推导总误差界分析参数化误差与模型估计误差的联合影响；(3)利用扩散模型学到的条件分布进行多解问题的设计空间探索。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，FDM+在重建精度和设计灵活性上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FDM+有效克服了维度异构、分辨率不匹配和多解问题，为扩散模型在辐射传输约束控制中的应用提供了更优方案。

title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

AI.tldr: MoE-Context 借鉴人类"按需回忆"的机制，将上下文分块，每步用快速二分类决定需要哪些块，其余块压缩成一行笔记保留、不删除；通过单一 KV cache 掩码而非移除实现。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上的合成查找任务中，仅显示所需块可将准确率从 93/120 提升到 119/120。
AI.motivation: AI agent 在每一步都读取完整历史，效率低且不符合人类工作方式。人类只保留当下所需信息，其余作为粗略笔记待召回。作者希望把这种"按需上下文"机制引入语言模型。
AI.method: 将上下文切分为块；每步前用一个快速的 yes/no 前向判断该步需要哪些块，其余块以单行摘要保留并可召回，信息不删除。具体实现中由单个模型先做选择再作答，共享单一 KV cache，隐藏块以掩码方式处理。此外尝试把监督线性探针写入模型空闲输出行以改善选择能力。
AI.result: 笔记本上 Qwen3-1.7B + 合成查找任务：仅展示所需块使准确率从 93/120 升至 119/120；掩码块与删除块效果等同。模型自主选择较弱（80/120），监督线性探针将其提升至 110/120，但简单关键词搜索在此任务上表现完美，且探针无法迁移到第二个任务。
AI.conclusion: 块切换机制可行且能带来准确率提升，但模型自主选择块仍是薄弱环节；关键词基线揭示合成任务过于简单，探针泛化性不足。作者坦诚报告结果，并提出该机制支持两种低成本用法：撤销失败尝试、无新上下文运行子代理。

title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
summary: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 automodel，一个可移植的“智能体技能”，让通用编码智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex）遵循一套模型发现方法论，从而在多个科学领域自动化地发现或改进模型。
AI.motivation: 模型发现（解析方程或神经网络架构）正从人工设计转向数据驱动自动化，但现有算法（从穷举搜索到 AlphaEvolve）多为领域专用流水线，通用性差；同时通用编码智能体能力日益强大，作者由此追问：仅提供一套“模型发现配方”是否足以让这些智能体发现或改进模型。
AI.method: 将模型发现方法论编码为可移植的智能体技能 automodel，配备给商用编码智能体，并通过天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流、车辆轮胎动力学五个案例研究进行验证。
AI.result: 配备 automodel 的商用智能体在五个领域中成功识别出新颖且具有科学相关性的模型。
AI.conclusion: 把模型发现方法论编码为可移植智能体技能，可作为领域专用自动化发现流水线的一种简单、可交互、强大且广泛适用的替代方案；技能已开源发布。

title: TRoPE: Topology-aware Relative Positional Encoding for 4D Generation
summary: Video-to-4D mesh generation has made substantial progress in recovering dynamic 3D geometry and motion from monocular videos. However, commonly used feed-forward approaches remain prone to sticking artifacts, where geodesically distant vertices move together incorrectly when they become spatially close. We attribute this failure to cross-part motion leakage: spatially nearby yet structurally distant vertices may retrieve similar motion information when motion decoding fails to distinguish spatial proximity from mesh connectivity. To address this issue, we introduce TRoPE, a topology-aware relative positional encoding that makes mesh connectivity explicit in the interaction between vertex queries and mesh-supported motion sources. TRoPE derives spectral features from the graph Laplacian and constructs pairwise topological relations from distances between multi-scale diffusion features, using these relations to modulate vertex--anchor attention through rotary phases. We further introduce a vertex-wise tail-risk objective that emphasizes persistently high-error vertices to explicitly suppress sticking artifacts. To better characterize and quantify these failures, we introduce MeshSticking-4D, a dedicated benchmark for this failure mode. Experiments on MeshSticking-4D show that TRoPE suppresses sticking artifacts while improving overall motion accuracy. Compared with the baseline, it reduces the worst-vertex error by 39.4% and lowers the separation failure rate from 49.35% to 34.90%. Additional evaluations on Motion-80 and Motion324-Subset show lower tail errors on diverse objects, while transfer to Mesh4D demonstrates applicability across backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRoPE，一种拓扑感知的相对位置编码，用于视频到4D网格生成，抑制"粘连"(sticking)伪影；并提出针对高误差顶点的尾部风险目标与MeshSticking-4D基准。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式视频到4D网格方法易出现sticking伪影：测地距离远但空间接近的顶点被错误地一起运动。作者将原因归为"跨部件运动泄漏"——运动解码无法区分空间邻近与网格连通性。
AI.method: TRoPE从图拉普拉斯中提取谱特征，基于多尺度扩散特征间距离构建成对拓扑关系，并通过旋转相位调制顶点-锚点注意力。另引入顶点级尾部风险目标，强调持续高误差顶点。
AI.result: 在MeshSticking-4D上，最差顶点误差降低39.4%，分离失败率从49.35%降至34.90%；在Motion-80与Motion324-Subset上尾部误差更低，并可迁移至Mesh4D骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: TRoPE通过显式编码网格连通性有效抑制sticking伪影并提升运动精度，具有良好的跨数据集与跨骨干适用性。

title: VESPA: Verifiable Symbolic Policy Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to prevent agents from taking actions that are dangerous or destructive to their environment. This is especially important for safety-critical domains, such as robotics or autonomous driving. Formal verification can be used to prove agent safety through safety constraints. However, in practice, many policies do violate safety constraints, and thus are verified to be unsafe. Since the goal is to obtain a safe policy, we would need to retrain a new policy from scratch and then verify it again until a candidate happens to pass. Both training and verification are usually not cheap, which makes this process inefficient. We introduce VESPA ($\textbf{VE}$rifiable $\textbf{S}$ymbolic $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{A}$daptation), a framework for targeted fine-tuning of decision tree policies. We show that using counterexamples for policy adaptation can make existing unsafe policies safe, or at least make considerable progress towards safety. Targeted fine-tuning of the existing policy on those counterexamples enables it to learn how to avoid violating safety constraints. We thus use the result of a formal verification as a training signal for fine-tuning. On CartPole, VESPA raises the mean number of verified safe steps from 63.8 to at least 92.7, reaching after two iterations what the same loop without counterexamples reaches after ten. On MountainCarContinuous, VESPA turns an unsafe policy into a safe policy in 53 of 60 runs. We conclude that counterexamples from a verifier are an effective training signal, which can be utilized to systematically improve the safety of policies. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VESPA-Submission/

AI.tldr: VESPA利用形式验证产生的反例作为训练信号，对决策树策略进行定向微调，使原本不安全的策略变安全，避免从头重训练。
AI.motivation: 安全强化学习中形式验证可证明策略安全性，但实践中许多策略违反安全约束而被验证为不安全；若从头重训练再验证的循环低效昂贵。
AI.method: 提出VESPA框架，对决策树策略做定向微调：将形式验证输出的反例作为训练信号，在反例上微调现有策略，使其学会避免违反安全约束。
AI.result: CartPole上验证安全步数均值从63.8提升到至少92.7，两次迭代即达到无返例循环十次的效果；MountainCarContinuous上，60次运行中53次将不安全策略转为安全策略。
AI.conclusion: 验证器产生的反例是有效的训练信号，可系统地提升策略安全性。

title: Record Sufficiency: What a Decision Record Must Preserve When an Unsettled Claim Becomes an Operative Status
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files: schema, records, checks, 25 real statements of reasons with protocol and coding, and a one-command reproduction script
summary: Organisations keep evidence, logs and approvals, but often not the step by which an unsettled claim became an operative status, such as an accepted label or a released image, so later readers cannot tell what the status was allowed to mean. We call a decision record sufficient if it is true and a reader who has only the record and the items it cites can explain the status, bound it, re-derive it and challenge it. From these four uses we argue for ten questions a record must answer, map them onto the author's earlier JSON Schema for decision records (DRK v0.1), and define four mechanical checks. We separate conformance, which the checks decide; adequacy, whether the answers are specific enough to use, which needs a reader; fidelity, which no check on the record decides; and merits, which sufficiency does not require. On 164 single-defect variants of three synthetic records, schema validation, the only check DRK v0.1 implements, rejects every variant with a deleted required property and none of the others, and it accepts a record whose claim, rule, scope, limits and challenge route are empty. These are properties of the schema shown on defects we seeded, not estimates of performance on real records. A false record passes every check. The statement-of-reasons schema of the EU Digital Services Act Transparency Database answers 4 of the questions in full, 2 in part and 4 not at all: why the matter was unsettled, what the status depends on, whether it can be re-derived, and how to challenge it. In 25 real statements from 25 platforms, drawn by a seeded rule and coded by a language model and checked by the author, free text addressed any of those four in only 2, and in 18 (24 under a stricter reading adopted during coding) no free text said why the item fell under the rule. No deployment or legal claim is made.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"决策记录充分性"概念(如实、可解释、可界定、可再推导、可质疑),据此提炼记录需回答的10个问题,映射到DRK v0.1 JSON Schema并定义四项机械检查;实验显示现有schema校验只能拦截删除必填字段的缺陷,且允许空洞记录通过;DSA透明度数据库的理由陈述仅完整回答4/10问题,25份真实陈述中自由文本几乎没有回应关键四项。
AI.motivation: 组织保存证据、日志与审批,但往往不保留"未定事项如何变为生效状态"的过程,导致后续读者无法判断该状态的含义与边界,因此需要界定"充分的决策记录"。
AI.method: 以四种用途(解释、界定、再推导、质疑)推出记录须回答的十个问题,映射到作者此前的DRK v0.1 JSON Schema,定义四项机械检查;在3份合成记录的164个单缺陷变体上测试;并用其框架评估EU DSA透明度数据库的理由陈述schema及25份真实陈述(种子规则抽样+语言模型编码+作者核验)。
AI.result: schema校验对删除必填属性的变体全部拒绝、对其他缺陷全部放行,且会接受claim、rule、scope、limits、challenge route均为空的记录;虚假记录可通过所有检查。DSA理由schema完整回答4/10问题、部分回答2个、完全未答4个。25份真实陈述中自由文本仅2份涉及这些未答问题,18份(严格读法24份)未说明为何适用该规则。
AI.conclusion: 区分一致性(检查可判)、充分性(需读者判断)、忠实性(检查无法判定)与价值性;所报结果是种子缺陷下的schema性质,非真实记录的性能估计;不作出部署或法律主张。

title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
comment: 5 figures, 5 extended data figures, 5 extended data tables; includes Supplementary Information
summary: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.

AI.tldr: 将用于刻画大脑皮层组织的扩散映射嵌入用于对比基座与推理训练模型，发现存在一个可迁移的"推理相关层段"，其权重移植可提升宿主数学推理且干扰小。
AI.motivation: 人类皮层发育中功能系统逐渐分化；作者想检验语言模型推理能力的提升是否伴随类似的区域重组，并寻找可迁移的推理相关区域。
AI.method: 对三个模型家族的基座模型与推理训练模型施加扩散映射嵌入，比较梯度剖面；将特定层段的权重"嫁接"到指令微调宿主模型中，检验数学推理表现、区域重叠度、对已解问题的影响，并追踪训练过程中该层段的形成。
AI.result: 梯度剖面总体保持、局部变化集中于一个连续层段；嫁接该层段平均提升数学推理，增益随区域重叠度上升，且比其它位置的嫁接保留更多已解问题；该层段在性能早期上升阶段逐步形成，中间阶段嫁接亦有效；嫁接使宿主部分向供体行为偏移，有时还能解决供体失败的问题；在医学模型中同样定位到可迁移层段。
AI.conclusion: 存在一个与推理相关的区域，其权重能在低干扰宿主已有数学能力的前提下提升推理，提示模型推理能力具有可定位、可迁移的局部组织。

title: When Figures Disagree with Text: Evaluating Autonomous Visual Evidence Verification in Scientific Papers
summary: Scientific figures carry evidence for the claims that cite them, so reviewing a paper means checking that a figure agrees with the text, and not only describing what the figure shows. Benchmarks of figure-text verification typically hand the model the figure, the claim, or the knowledge that an inconsistency exists, which leaves untested whether a model can find the figure worth checking in a complete paper, relate a visual element to the claim it conflicts with, and recognize the conflict. We study this autonomous setting on 31 full manuscripts, each carrying a reviewer-documented figure-text inconsistency from PRISMM-Bench that is hidden from the model. Six multimodal models review each PDF under a neutral prompt, and we then add one input at a time to the same manuscripts. Of 1,445 open-ended reviews, 60.6% mention the flawed figure, yet a grading rubric accepts only 3.3% as diagnosing its contradiction; a blind audit finds the rubric lenient, so we read these as rubric-accepted rates and compare conditions rather than absolute values. In a separate controlled run, naming the figure, without stating that it is flawed, raises rubric-accepted diagnosis from 4.3% to 20.4%, while a consistency instruction and coarse visual cues do not. When the contradiction is visible only in the rendered figure, text-only review yields no accepted diagnosis, while review of the rendered pages with the figure named reaches 15.8%. A baseline that lets the model choose which figures to check, ranked by centrality, stays at 4.8%. Deciding what to verify is thus a large part of the difficulty, and the selection rule we tested does not resolve it. Multimodal document understanding should be evaluated on whether a model can propose what to verify, not only answer questions about a figure it is handed.

AI.tldr: 研究"自主图-文一致性核查"：31篇完整手稿中隐藏审稿人记录的图文矛盾，六个多模态模型自由评审。60.6%的综述提到问题图，但仅3.3%被评分标准认定为诊断出矛盾；点名图号可将诊断率从4.3%提升到20.4%，而一致性提示与粗粒度视觉线索无效。故"决定核查什么"是主要难点。
AI.motivation: 现有图文验证基准通常直接把图、论断或"存在不一致"这一知识喂给模型，因此无法检验模型能否在完整论文中自主发现值得核查的图、将视觉元素与其冲突的论断关联并识别冲突。作者希望在自主（不提示矛盾）的设置下评测这一能力。
AI.method: 以31篇含PRISMM-Bench中审稿人记录、且对模型隐藏的图文矛盾完整手稿为材料。六个多模态模型在中性提示下评审PDF，再逐一添加单一输入（点名图号、一致性指令、粗粒度视觉线索等）做条件对比；另设纯文本评审与渲染页面评审对照，并以按中心度排序的"模型自选核查图"作为基线。共1,445份开放式评审，另有盲审评估评分标准的宽松度。
AI.result: 60.6%的评审提及有问题图，但仅3.3%被评分标准接受为诊断出矛盾（盲审认为标准偏宽容，故仅作条件间比较）。仅点名图号而不告知其有缺陷，可使接受率从4.3%升至20.4%；一致性指令与粗粒度视觉线索无显著效果。矛盾仅在渲染图中可见时，纯文本评审为0%，渲染页+点名图号达15.8%；按中心度自选核查图的基线仅4.8%。
AI.conclusion: 发现缺陷图容易，但真正将其归因于与论断的矛盾很难。"决定核查什么"是困难的主要来源，且所测试的中心度选择规则无法解决。多模态文档理解评测应考察模型能否自主提出待验证对象，而非仅回答关于给定图的问题。

title: What Right-Angle Corners Reveal About an Uncalibrated Camera: Convex Cones, Certified Bounds and Identifiability
summary: The corner of a box or a room, where three perpendicular edges meet, appears in an image as three segments meeting at a point. We ask what such junctions reveal about an uncalibrated camera's intrinsic parameters. Each junction is consistent with an explicit convex set of cameras; when only the focal length is unknown, this set is an interval in closed form. These sets are computed from the image alone, so calibrating from many junctions is a convex feasibility problem. Almost every junction bounds the focal length from below; we characterize when one also bounds it from above, and when many junctions determine it exactly. For a known vertex, the bounds can be certified against any bounded error in the measured edge directions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了图像中由三条互相垂直的棱交于一点形成的角点（盒角/墙角）对未标定相机内参的约束，证明每个角点对应一个显式凸相机集合，仅焦距未知时为闭式区间，从而可用凸可行性问题从多个角点标定相机。
AI.motivation: 现有单视图标定方法（如基于正交消失点的标定）多依赖特殊结构或启发式，缺乏对角点几何约束的完整刻画。作者希望通过纯粹的图像观测理解角点能对角点约束相机内参到什么程度。
AI.method: 将每个三垂直棱角点建模为对相机内参的约束，推导出与其一致的显式凸集；焦距未知时以闭式区间表示。对多个角点，构造凸可行性问题求解。分析角点对焦距的单侧/双侧界条件及精确确定条件，并对已知顶点情形给出对边缘方向有界误差的认证方法。
AI.result: 几乎所有角点给出焦距的下界；刻画了何时也给出上界，以及何时多个角点可精确确定焦距。仅由图像即可计算这些集合，且结果对测量误差可认证。
AI.conclusion: 每个三垂直角点在图像上界定一个凸相机集合，使标定化为凸可行性问题；该理论给出了角点对焦距约束的完整刻画及误差鲁棒的界认证。

title: UCLIR: Unsupervised Continual Learning using Independent Representations
summary: In continual learning, regularization-based methods aim to mimic neuroplasticity by updating network weights to learn new tasks while constraining changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks through penalty terms. However, as the number of tasks increases, preserving knowledge from earlier tasks becomes less effective. This is mainly because updates for new tasks are distributed across the entire network, where parameters are highly interdependent due to the dense connectivity between neurons. Inspired by the Exponential Distance Rule (EDR), which states that the number of neural connections decreases with increasing physical distance, learning is naturally locally correlated while inter-area updates remain less task-dependent. Motivated by this principle, in this paper we demonstrate that applying weight regularization to multiple small and independently learned complementary representations is more effective than regularizing a single large shared representation. By decomposing the input into independently learned components, learning new tasks induces only localized parameter updates within specific representation, which limit interference and improve knowledge retention across tasks. We employ independent autoencoders that learn different parts of the input independently through unsupervised regularization. At inference time, a linear classifier is used for evaluation. The experimental results on a sequence of tasks using 5-Splits MNIST, sequence of 5-datasets, 5-Splits CIFAR-10, 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet shows competitive results with supervised and replay-based methods. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 通过将输入分解为多个独立学习的小表示并用独立自编码器分别学习，实现局部化参数更新，从而提升持续学习中的知识保留。
AI.motivation: 基于正则化的持续学习方法随着任务增多，对早期任务知识的保留效果下降。原因是新任务更新分布在整个稠密连接的网络中，参数高度相互依赖，导致干扰。
AI.method: 受指数距离规则（EDR）启发——神经连接数随物理距离增加而减少、学习呈局部相关——对多个小型、独立学习的互补表示施加权重正则化，而非对单一大型共享表示正则化。将输入分解为独立学习的组件，用独立自编码器通过无监督正则化分别学习输入的不同部分，使新任务只引起特定表示的局部参数更新。推理时用线性分类器评估。
AI.result: 在5-Splits MNIST、5-datasets序列、5-Splits CIFAR-10、10-Splits Tiny ImageNet任务序列上取得与监督方法和基于回放方法相当（有竞争力）的结果。
AI.conclusion: 对多个独立学习的小表示做正则化优于对单一共享大表示做正则化，局部化更新可限制干扰并改善跨任务知识保留。

title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.

AI.tldr: 在 Mistral-7B 指令微调骨干上，用 LoRA+PPO 结合简单的自监督奖励（偏好更长、词汇多样、标点规范、惩罚过短）对 2,000 条 Meerkat 医疗提示做约 170 步强化学习，可稳定提升奖励并使模型生成更长、更有组织、多要点的医学解释，同时保持医学内容不变。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型（SLM）适合隐私保护、本地化临床部署，但其医学解释相较 LLM 偏短且结构差；现有 Meerkat 等监督式思维链迁移方法的训练目标并不直接针对解释的风格与组织，因此探索无需人类偏好标签的轻量 RL 步骤能否改善解释结构。
AI.method: 以指令微调的 Mistral-7B 为骨干，采用 LoRA 适配的 PPO，在 2,000 条 Meerkat 衍生医疗提示上训练；奖励为简单的自监督信号：奖励更长、词汇多样、标点良好，惩罚过短回复；单张 A100 上约 170 步 PPO。
AI.result: 平均奖励稳定上升；定量与定性比较显示 RL 调优后的模型输出更长、更有组织、多要点的解释，同时保留底层医学内容。
AI.conclusion: 自奖励 RL 能在无人类偏好标签下有效塑造医学解释的风格与结构；论文亦讨论了该方法的前景与局限。

title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
summary:
Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls.
  Empirically, SCH improves long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost. In a controlled 150-task SWE-bench study, SCH's evidence recovery improves Pass@1 from $80.0\%$ to $86.9\%$ at essentially unchanged token use and execution time. In the complete-system comparison, SCH achieves 86.9% Pass@1 while using 43% fewer tokens and 41% less wall-clock time than the strongest baseline by task performance. Across models and benchmarks, SCH consistently reduces token use relative to full-history prompting while remaining competitive with or improving upon the evaluated baselines. Trajectory analysis confirms that SCH recovers evidence from substantially earlier parts of the interaction history rather than merely preserving a recent context window.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义上下文交接（SCH），以"状态—证据分离"为核心：紧凑语义状态承载当前理解，动作—观测证据单独可寻址、按需重新入上下文，从而在长程LLM智能体中兼顾低成本与高性能。
AI.motivation: 传统长程智能体用全历史提示传递上下文，历史不断增长导致推理成本上升、准确率可能下降；现有压缩方法只保留精简结论而删除早期观测，但会丢失后续变得相关的证据。
AI.method: SCH 将上下文拆为两部分：紧凑的语义状态（当前解释/结论）与可单独索引、可寻址的动作—观测证据库。执行中当后续步骤使某证据相关时，证据可直接重新进入上下文，无需额外摘要生成或检索模型调用。
AI.result: 150任务SWE-bench受控实验中，证据恢复将Pass@1从80.0%提升至86.9%，token与时间基本不变；完整系统对比中SCH达86.9% Pass@1，比最强基线少43% token、41%墙钟时间。跨模型跨基准均稳定降低token使用，与基线持平或更优；轨迹分析显示SCH恢复了远早于近期窗口的历史证据。
AI.conclusion: 状态—证据分离是一种有效且低成本的长程上下文管理范式，既能避免全历史膨胀，又能保留可回溯的关键证据，显著提升长程智能体表现与效率。

title: Angular Conditional Distillation: Overcoming Classifier Geometry Mismatch
summary: Classifier outputs provide a fundamental and univer- sally available knowledge interface for knowledge distil- lation (KD). However, standard logit objectives entangle transferable semantic relations with architecture-dependent parameterization artifacts, causing a classifier geometry mismatch that makes direct knowledge transfer unreliable. To address this, we propose Angular Conditional Distilla- tion (ACD). First, the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) reconstructs the student classifier using angular coordi- nates, suppressing magnitude and bias effects to provide a geometry-compatible space. Then, Scale-Invariant Condi- tional Distillation (SICD) standardizes outputs and exclu- sively transfers conditional non-target relations, filtering out untransferable absolute confidence. Together, ACI de- fines where to transfer, while SICD defines what to transfer. Extensive experiments show that ACD achieves state-of-the- art performance over existing KD methods. Moreover, as a universal drop-in replacement, it consistently improves existing distillation pipelines while requiring no feature adapters or additional inference-time cost. Code is avail- able at https://github.com/laniusnan/ACD.

AI.tldr: 提出角条件蒸馏（ACD），通过角坐标接口（ACI）与尺度不变条件蒸馏（SICD）分别解决"在哪迁移"和"迁移什么"的问题，缓解分类器几何不匹配，达到SOTA且可即插即用。
AI.motivation: 分类器输出是知识蒸馏中最通用可得的接口，但标准logit目标把可迁移的语义关系与依赖架构的参数化伪影纠缠在一起，导致分类器几何不匹配，直接知识迁移不可靠。
AI.method: ACD包含两部分：ACI用角坐标重建学生分类器，抑制幅度与偏置效应，构造几何兼容空间；SICD对输出做标准化，只迁移条件性的非目标类关系，过滤不可迁移的绝对置信度。ACI定义迁移空间，SICD定义迁移内容。
AI.result: 大量实验显示ACD优于现有KD方法，达到SOTA；作为通用即插即用模块可稳定提升现有蒸馏流程，且无需特征适配器、无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 解除logit中几何伪影对知识迁移的干扰是提升蒸馏可靠性的关键；基于角度几何与尺度不变条件关系的解耦设计简单有效，具备良好的通用性与实用性。

title: The 7th International Verification of Neural Networks Competition (VNN-COMP 2026): Summary and Results
summary: This report summarizes the seventh International Verification of Neural Networks Com- petition (VNN-COMP 2026), held as part of the Symposium on AI Verification (SAIV) co-located with the International Conference on Computer-Aided Verification (CAV) at FLoC 2026 in Lisbon, Portugal. The goal of the competition is to provide an objective comparison of the state-of-the-art methods in neural network verification, in terms of scal- ability and speed. Along this line, we used standard formats (ONNX for neural networks and VNNLIB for specifications), standard hardware (all tools are run by the organizers on AWS), and tool parameters provided by the tool authors. This report summarizes the rules, benchmarks, participating tools, results, and lessons learned from this competition.

AI.tldr: 本文是第七届国际神经网络验证竞赛 VNN-COMP 2026 的总结报告，介绍其目标、规则、基准、工具与结果。
AI.motivation: 对神经网络验证领域的最新方法进行客观比较，从可扩展性和速度两方面评估各工具的水平，并通过统一标准避免评测偏差。
AI.method: 采用统一标准格式（ONNX 表示网络、VNNLIB 表示规约）、统一硬件（由组织者在 AWS 上运行所有工具），并使用工具作者提供的参数进行公平对比。
AI.result: 报告汇总了竞赛规则、基准集、参赛工具以及最终比赛结果。
AI.conclusion: 给出了本届竞赛的经验与教训，为神经网络验证领域的后续研究与发展提供参考。

title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
comment: 41 pages. Ancillary files: a public sample of 48 development instances with scripted-oracle episodes. Hosted evaluation: https://eval.openhagen.ai
summary: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.

AI.tldr: 提出 Openhagen Worlds：27 个程序化生成环境、178 个经校准的难度关卡（含有限真值空间），用于严格隔离"设计实验+从结果推理"的能力，并以确定性验证器和完整公开评分规则消除recall、隐藏规则与捷径；最强模型在84个保留前沿实例上仍显著低于oracle，八阶段长战役差距最大。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现类基准无法把"选择信息量大的实验并据此推理"这一技能与记忆召回、未公开的评分规则、捷径策略区分开来，因此需要一个可校准、规则完全透明、能测出真实推理能力的评测套件与训练环境。
AI.method: 构建 27 个程序化生成环境（从经典实验推理谜题到基于模拟器的物理/化学），智能体在预算内做实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器对照隐藏真值判分；每条观测公开完整评分规则；每个关卡须在64个开发实例上通过准入校准：脚本化 oracle ≥0.75、最强非演绎策略 ≤0.25、各受门控捷径 ≤0.35。共178关：92个核心关（覆盖27族、面向小模型训练）、86个前沿关（15个发现世界，更难问题+3/5/8+阶段的长战役）。训练侧采用 on-policy expert iteration。
AI.result: 同一批84个保留前沿实例上：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 默认推理强度（每调用16,384 tokens）解出32个，最高强度（最多393,216 tokens/调用）解出57个，oracle 为79，剩余差距在八阶段战役中最大。on-policy expert iteration 使9B模型在核心层已训练族上成功率由0.090升至0.148（部分来自动作格式改善），GPQA Diamond 无可检测退化。
AI.conclusion: 该套件能有效分离实验设计与证据推理能力，并揭示当前最强模型在长程多阶段科学发现任务上仍有大量提升空间；同时表明小模型可通过专家迭代获得温和提升而基本不损通用知识表现，提供了可训练、可校准的发现能力评测基础。

title: SIGNTOK: A Text-Aligned Continuous Pose Tokenizer for Sign Language Generation
summary: Text-conditioned sign language generation (SLG) depends not only on the generator but also on the space in which signing is generated. Existing approaches generate directly in pose space, in quantized code spaces, or in learned latent spaces trained for reconstruction. We find that these spaces are organized largely by signer identity rather than linguistic content: on CSL-Daily, a test clip's nearest neighbor in raw pose space is the same sentence signed by another person in only 2% of cases. To address this, we propose SIGNTOK, a continuous pose tokenizer whose latent space is shaped by three training-only heads: a kinematics head that predicts motion dynamics, a sentence-level head that aligns signing with the overall text, and a word-level head that aligns short motion windows with content words. Together, these objectives raise the same-sentence cross-signer nearest-neighbor rate to 82%. On three sign language benchmarks, the same generator trained in the SIGNTOK latent instead of pose space raises back-translation BLEU-4 in five of six benchmark-scorer settings at comparable joint accuracy, and word-level alignment gives higher back-translation scores than sentence-level alignment on every benchmark.

AI.tldr: SIGNTOK：一种由运动学、句级、词级三个仅训练用对齐头塑形潜空间的连续姿态分词器，使潜空间按语言内容而非签名者身份组织，显著提升文本条件手语生成效果。
AI.motivation: 现有手语生成在姿态空间、量化码空间或重构导向潜空间中进行，但这些空间主要由签名者身份而非语言内容组织（CSL-Daily上原始姿态空间中同句另一人签名的最近邻率仅2%），限制了生成质量。
AI.method: 提出连续姿态分词器SIGNTOK，用三个仅在训练时使用的头塑造潜空间：运动学头预测运动动态，句级头对齐整段手语与整体文本，词级头对齐短运动窗口与内容词。
AI.result: 同句跨签名者最近邻率从2%提升至82%；在三个手语基准上，同一生成器改用SIGNTOK潜空间后，在六个基准-评分器设置中有五个提升回译BLEU-4且关节精度相当；词级对齐在每个基准上均优于句级对齐。
AI.conclusion: 生成空间的组织方式对文本条件手语生成至关重要；以语言内容塑形的潜空间优于传统姿态空间，且细粒度词级监督比句级更有效。

title: QuantAtlas-OM: Taming Neural Spectral Bias in Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Ocean Dynamics
summary: Autoregressive neural networks exhibit spectral bias in long-horizon spatiotemporal prediction. As rollouts progress, high-frequency details decay, blurring the predicted fields and destabilizing long-range forecasts. Ocean dynamics offer a particularly stringent test because kinetic energy is concentrated in mesoscale eddies and fronts spanning tens of kilometers. This degradation stems from coupling large-scale phase evolution and small-scale energy retention in a shared feature space. Evolution on a coarse grid smooths out high-wavenumber eddies, whereas evolution on a fine grid amplifies small-scale phase errors and triggers rollout instability. We introduce QuantAtlas-OM (QuantAtlas Ocean Model), a scale-spectral decoupling framework that confines deep temporal evolution to a low-wavenumber latent manifold for long-term stability while routing full-resolution eddy and front residuals through an outer bypass to the decoder. Across physical regimes, the evolution core pairs non-local attention with resolution-invariant dilated spatial gating. Across three western boundary currents, QuantAtlas-OM retains $43.7\%$ to $86.5\%$ of mesoscale spectral energy along the $k^{-3}$ cascade at Day $120$, sustains anomaly correlation coefficients of $0.81$ to $0.88$ at Day $60$, and reaches $0.66$ at Day $120$ in the Kuroshio ($2.5\times$ to $7.7\times$ the best baselines). Trained at $0.25^\circ$, QuantAtlas-OM transfers zero-shot to a global $0.125^\circ$ grid ($0.81$ Day-$10$ spatial correlation) and leads global $0.25^\circ$, $23$-level 3D ocean simulations ($120$ days) and coupled ocean-atmosphere forecasts ($60$ days), ranking first on $15$ of $16$ metrics and cutting $60$- to $120$-day salinity RMSE by $13\%$ to $27\%$ across global ocean basins.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度-频谱解耦框架QuantAtlas-OM，缓解自回归长时海洋预测的频谱偏差与高频信息衰减，在多区域与全球三维海洋/海气耦合预报中取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 自回归神经网络做长时时空预测存在频谱偏差，随rollout推进高频细节衰减、场变模糊并导致长期预报不稳定。海洋动力学因动能集中于数十公里尺度的中尺度涡旋和锋面，是极端严苛的测试场景。根源在于大尺度相位演化与小尺度能量保持被耦合在共享特征空间中：粗网格演化会抹平高波数涡旋，细网格演化会放大相位误差并引发不稳定。
AI.method: QuantAtlas-OM为尺度-频谱解耦框架：将深层时间演化限制在低波数潜流形上以获得长期稳定，同时把全分辨率涡旋与锋面残差通过外部旁路直接送入解码器；演化核心在不同物理区域下结合非局部注意力与分辨率不变的膨胀空间门控。
AI.result: 在三支西边界流中，Day 120保留k⁻³级联上43.7%–86.5%的中尺度谱能量；Day 60异常相关系数达0.81–0.88，黑潮Day 120达0.66（为最佳基线的2.5–7.7倍）。0.25°训练可零样本迁移到全球0.125°网格（Day 10空间相关0.81）；并驱动全球0.25°、23层三维海洋模拟（120天）与海气耦合预报（60天），16项指标中15项排名第一，全球各海盆60–120天盐度RMSE降低13%–27%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将大尺度相位演化与小尺度能量保持解耦，可在保持长程稳定性的同时保留中尺度涡旋与锋面细节，验证了该方法在多物理区域、跨分辨率迁移及全球三维海洋与耦合预报中的通用有效性。

title: CratesBump: A Version-Bump Dataset for the Rust Ecosystem
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Dataset and tool: https://github.com/muhammad-hassnain/CratesBump
summary: We release CratesBump, the first public dataset for predicting version bumps in the Rust ecosystem, together with semver-extract, the tool that builds it. CratesBump is built from every crate on crates$.$io with at least two releases before 14 September 2026 (about 220,000 crates), giving over two million consecutive release pairs. Each pair has 41 features (code changes from AST diffs, dependency changes, complexity, release cadence, GitHub commit and issue activity), its source repository where listed, and two labels: the literal reading of MAJOR$.$MINOR$.$PATCH, and Cargo's rule, under which a 0.y bump is a breaking change. semver-extract regenerates the dataset from public crates$.$io data and the GitHub API. To illustrate its use we (i) benchmark bump predictors on held-out repositories, finding the task learnable but far from solved, with lower scores on later releases; (ii) measure which feature groups carry the signal; (iii) check, against declared dependency ranges, how often Cargo's rule shields dependents from pre-1.0 breaking releases; and (iv) audit a sample of releases with cargo-semver-checks, finding minor and patch releases that break the public API despite their version number. Dataset and tool are released under open licenses.

AI.tldr: 论文发布首个Rust生态版本号变更预测数据集CratesBump及其构建工具semver-extract，覆盖约22万crate、超200万连续发布对，每对含41个特征与两种语义化版本标签，并展示了四类应用实验。
AI.motivation: Rust生态缺乏公开的版本号变更（version bump）预测数据集，导致该任务难以系统性研究与基准比较；同时Cargo对0.y版本的特殊规则及依赖范围的实际保护效果、版本号与真实API兼容性的一致性均缺少数据支撑的实证分析。
AI.method: 从crates.io抓取2026年9月14日前至少有两个版本的约22万crate，构造超过200万连续发布对；每对提取41个特征（AST diff代码变更、依赖变更、复杂度、发布节奏、GitHub提交与issue活动），标注两种标签：MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH字面解读与Cargo 0.y视为破坏性变更的规则；工具semver-extract可基于公开crates.io数据与GitHub API重新生成。
AI.result: 在留出仓库上基准测试显示任务可学习但远未解决，且后续版本得分更低；分析了各类特征组的信号贡献；对照声明依赖范围统计Cargo规则对1.0前破坏性发布的防护频率；用cargo-semver-checks审计样本发现部分minor与patch发布实际破坏公共API。
AI.conclusion: CratesBump与semver-extract以开放许可发布，为Rust版本变更预测、依赖安全与版本语义一致性研究提供可复现的公共基础，并揭示版本号与真实破坏性变更之间存在明显偏差。

title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

AI.tldr: DRIFT：轻量化LM（<150M）驱动的端到端自动驾驶框架，通过将驾驶中间表示投影到语言嵌入空间实现场景描述与动作解说，并用蒸馏代理推理特征+可运行时切换的柔性规划模块，在Bench2Drive上以255M参数达到DS 97.03/成功率89.39%。
AI.motivation: VLM接入端到端自动驾驶虽能提供场景描述与推理能力，但计算开销大，且无法在不损失闭环性能的前提下于运行时开/关语言推理，阻碍实际部署。
AI.method: 提出DRIFT框架：1）用轻量LM做VQA与动作解说，高效将驾驶中间表示投影到语言嵌入空间；2）引入运行时柔性规划模块，训练于从LM蒸馏得到的代理推理特征，推理时可条件化于LM输出或代理特征，从而在部署受限时完全绕过LM。
AI.result: 仅255M参数，在Bench2Drive上以选定推理率交错LM与代理推理，DS达97.03、成功率89.39%（三次运行均值），媲美最强非语言模型且远小于现有VLM方案；在真实NAVSIM与AlpaSim基准上取得有竞争力结果，计算成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量LM+蒸馏代理特征+可切换规划，DRIFT实现了紧凑、可部署且性能不降的VLM式端到端驾驶，证明语言推理可按部署约束灵活取舍。

title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
summary: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/thisissyu/cado.

AI.tldr: CaDO是一个由因果引擎引导的多智能体框架，可自动诊断与修复因果推理数据集，在18个实验设置中16项优于五个数据清洗基线，下游准确率最高提升9.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有因果推理数据集普遍存在标注错误与结构失衡（如查询类型覆盖不足、标签分布偏斜），导致模型产生有偏预测、泛化受限，亟需自动化手段诊断与修复数据集质量问题。
AI.method: 三阶段多智能体框架：（1）Formalizer Agent将自然语言问题转写为形式化因果查询，减少语义偏差、便于检索验证；（2）双层诊断机制，由独立Critic Agents进行样本级错误识别，并分析查询类型覆盖与标签分布以检测数据集级结构失衡；（3）基于形式化因果语义的可复用修复算子纠正错误样本，并由Explorer与Expander Agent协同生成多样且语义一致的新样本。
AI.result: 在18个实验设置中16项显著优于最强基线，下游模型准确率最高提升9.1%；CaDO标记的样本中至少95%确为缺陷样本；在CLadder上，其错误修改正确标签的数量比基于LLM的评判器少92.2%。
AI.conclusion: CaDO能够有效且可靠地诊断、修复并扩充因果推理数据集，兼顾精确性与下游性能提升，代码与数据已公开。

title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

AI.tldr: 在 MobileGym 中逐维度调整 GUI 环境覆盖率并训练 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，发现奖励与数据覆盖必须完整、冗余特征反而有害，据此构建的 MobileGym-Lite 以更低成本取得 55.48% 成功率（Full 为 51.61%）。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体需在可执行环境中训练，为降成本、批量搭建，各工作都牺牲部分环境完整性，但这些取舍仅凭工程经验、缺乏对训练效果的系统度量。作者想回答：环境要多完整才能训练出强智能体，且在哪些维度上。
AI.method: 提出三维度框架：奖励覆盖（验证器奖励的达成路径）、数据覆盖（任务读写之外的应用数据）、特征覆盖（任务之外的功能）。在 MobileGym 中分别单独调整每一维度训练 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，并在原始完整环境中统一评估；另做按 episode 等权与按长度加权等不同加权方式的消融分析。
AI.result: 仅奖励单一参考路径的验证器使成功率下降 10.53 点；删除任务外无关记录（降低数据覆盖）同样降低成功率；剪除无关功能却将成功率从 51.61% 提至 56.13%，且增益全部来自环境未变的任务。该增益在按 episode 等权时反转，仅在剪枝任务上做平衡时消失——说明不剪枝时按长度加权会强化长绕路成功，从而侵蚀其他任务技能。
AI.conclusion: 环境完整性各维度并不等价：奖励与数据覆盖应保持完整，冗余特征应剪除。据此构建的 MobileGym-Lite 同时超越 Full（55.48% vs 51.61%），且构建成本更低。

title: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
summary: Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. Across standard image-classification benchmarks, SoU-RHS recovers substantially smaller architectures than deterministic structured-sparsity baselines, while maintaining competitive accuracy, achieving lower negative log-likelihood in every evaluated configuration and generally lower expected calibration error.

AI.tldr: 提出SoU-RHS贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法，从大模型恢复紧凑架构，具有跨初始宽度与阈值的稳定性，并优于确定性基线。
AI.motivation: 高度参数化CNN性能强，但内存、计算与部署成本高，需要从大参考模型中恢复紧凑架构的方法。
AI.method: 在Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage（RHS）基础上引入Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local机制（SoU-SGL），构成贝叶斯结构化稀疏过程，强化活跃/非活跃滤波器间的区分。
AI.result: 在不同过参数化初始宽度及合理剪枝阈值范围内，恢复出总规模与逐层分配相似的紧凑架构；在标准图像分类基准上比确定性结构化稀疏基线更小，精度具竞争力，且在所有配置下NLL更低、ECE总体更低。
AI.conclusion: SoU-RHS识别的是适配数据的紧凑结构而非单纯压缩，具有良好的稳定性与校准优势。

title: Reliability is a user-specific property of large language models
summary: Public benchmarks support comparisons of large language model (LLM) capabilities, yet users can experience the same highly ranked model differently. Drawing on traditional software reliability, we argue that the reliability of an LLM service should be assessed for specified users and conditions of use. This requires more than a capability score: evaluation evidence must support a claim about failure during future operation. We distinguish testing to discover faults from testing to assess reliability and identify ten modelling considerations behind such claims. We propose a six-workstream research roadmap linking claim specification, dynamic operational profiles, graded outcomes and noisy judgements, local probabilistic robustness, interaction dependence, and statistical inference with reassessment. Local probabilistic robustness addresses the behavioural variation hidden when different concrete inputs are treated as the same task. Published findings and an illustrative customer-support example motivate the roadmap; its integrated validation remains an open research task. Reliability claims complement, but do not replace, separate safety and security arguments. Capability scores should therefore be complemented by versioned operational claims that state whose requirements are covered, under which conditions, and with what uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文主张应从传统软件可靠性视角评估LLM服务的"运行可靠性"，而非仅依赖能力评分；提出六个研究方向的路线图，以支撑"未来运行中失败"的可验证声明。
AI.motivation: 公开基准上排名相同的模型，不同用户体验却可能差异很大。能力分数无法支撑关于未来实际运行失败的解释性声明，因此需要面向特定用户与使用条件的可靠性评估。
AI.method: 概念与立场分析：区分"发现故障的测试"与"评估可靠性的测试"，提出构建可靠性声明所需的十项建模考量，并设计含六个工作流的整合路线图（声明规约、动态运行剖面、分级结果与噪声判定、局部概率鲁棒性、交互依赖性、统计推断与再评估）。
AI.result: 以已发表发现和一个客户支持示例说明路线图的动机；其中"局部概率鲁棒性"揭示把不同具体输入视作同一任务时所掩盖的行为变异；路线图的整合验证仍为待解研究课题。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性声明补充但不替代安全与安保论证；能力分数应辅以带版本号的运行声明，明确覆盖谁的需求、在何种条件下、以及不确定性如何。

title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
summary: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.

AI.tldr: 提出V-lens，利用统一多模态模型的图像生成器可视化任意token的隐藏状态，无需训练解码器即可揭示推理中间概念，并通过lens tuning显著提升可视化正确率与文本答案表现。
AI.motivation: 可视化中间表征有助于检查模型输出背后的推理步骤，但现有方法通常需要专门训练解码器。统一多模态模型在同一架构中结合理解与生成，其图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表征，为免解码器可视化提供了契机。
AI.method: 提出V-lens，借助统一模型中生成器与文本表征之间的连接，可视化指定token的隐藏状态。在四个扩散型与两个纯自回归统一模型上验证。随后提出lens tuning，用V-lens生成的图片对选定隐藏状态进行监督。
AI.result: 可视化图像能揭示连接问题与答案的关键中间概念，即使这些概念从未被显式命名；受控实验显示内容随上下文、token位置和深度变化。在BAGEL、SenseNova-U1、HunyuanImage-3.0上，代词指代可视化正确率从2-11%升至86-94%，且该视觉监督还能在不直接监督答案token的情况下提升文本答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型的生成通路可作为解读内部表征的天然探针，V-lens实现免训练可视化，lens tuning表明对隐藏状态的视觉监督可反向增强文本推理能力。

title: Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control
summary: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. To intervene selectively while preserving safe nominal behavior, RTS uses the same predicted prefix-risk criterion as both the search trigger gate and hard feasibility gate: safe nominal plans execute directly, whereas alarms trigger local Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) search to minimize nominal deviation within the feasible set. To prevent isotropic Euclidean minimal modification from shrinking obstacle-directed actions into zero-amplitude stalling, we introduce an amplitude-preserving metric $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$ that retains tangential progression while maintaining a unique zero at the nominal plan. Under unified gating and this unique-zero condition, bypassing safe-state search yields closed-loop trajectories strictly identical to every-step same-kernel search. Evaluated under a process-safety benchmark and Safe Arrival Rate (SAR) metric across five tasks, RTS improves SAR over Direct by 12.67--41.67 percentage points on navigation and articulated control and +2.08/+4.17 pp on Cube/PushT boundary cohorts, maintaining 100% action identity with every-step search while cutting controller time by 17.71%--70.41% across 1,968 paired trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出风险触发搜索（RTS），在冻结的JEPA世界模型中展开动作条件的未来潜在前缀并训练轻量风险头，用同一前缀风险准则作为搜索触发门与可行性门，结合保幅度量d_AP，实现安全且高效的多步动作规划。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉世界模型虽能生成多步动作计划，但仅以终端接近度为目标无法避免穿越禁区或刚体碰撞滑移；纯视觉接口缺乏解析动力学、结构化状态和显式碰撞几何，需在内部预测动作条件的全过程风险。
AI.method: 针对冻结JEPA世界模型：展开动作条件的未来潜在前缀，用过程违规监督训练轻量风险头；以同一预测前缀风险准则同时充当搜索触发门和硬可行性门；安全名义计划直接执行，告警时触发局部CEM搜索在可行集内最小化名义偏离；引入保幅度量d_AP，保留切向推进且保证名义计划处唯一零点。
AI.result: 在五任务过程安全基准与SAR指标下，RTS相较Direct在导航与关节控制上SAR提升12.67–41.67个百分点，在Cube/PushT边界组提升+2.08/+4.17 pp；与每步同核搜索保持100%动作一致性，同时控制器时间减少17.71%–70.41%（1,968条配对轨迹）。
AI.conclusion: 在统一门控与唯一零点条件下，跳过安全态搜索的闭环轨迹与每步同核搜索严格一致，RTS在保持安全性与行为一致性的同时显著降低计算开销。

title: VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
summary: Recent video foundation models generate high-quality and limited-length clips, but orchestrating them into minute-level, story-coherent films remains an open problem. Existing video agents highly rely on natural-language planning or predefined workflows, which make their production hard to program, customize, and extend. Therefore, we introduce VOL-Agent, a programmable video agent built on a Video Orchestration Language (VOL). With static compilation and verification, followed by runtime dynamic loading, VOL-Agent decouples structural reliability from execution flexibility. Through the skill-driven executor, VOL-Agent dynamically resolves tools and skills from an open-world repository and supports user-defined skills in natural language. Moreover, VOL-Agent is capable of crafting new director skills from learned knowledge and improves itself through feedback to accumulate filmmaking knowledge. To overcome the disconnect between different segments, we apply a structural memory mechanism to record and recall world and entity states, sustaining entity and scene consistency across different shots. Critic feedback supports local revision, while reusable filmmaking knowledge and experiences can be retained for subsequent tasks. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VOL-Agent generates minute-scale videos with strong overall quality and limited cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 VOL-Agent：基于视频编排语言（VOL）的可编程视频智能体，将分钟级叙事连贯视频的生成解耦为静态编译验证与运行时动态加载，配合技能驱动执行器、结构化记忆与自我进化机制，在三个基准上实现高质量、低成本的分钟级视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基础模型只能生成高质量但时长有限的片段，难以编排成分钟级、故事连贯的影片；而现有视频智能体过度依赖自然语言规划或预定义工作流，导致制作过程难以编程、定制和扩展。
AI.method: 1) 设计视频编排语言 VOL，通过静态编译与验证保证结构可靠性，运行时动态加载保证执行灵活性，实现二者解耦；2) 采用技能驱动执行器，从开放世界仓库动态解析工具与技能，并支持自然语言定义的用户技能；3) 智能体可从学习中创造新导演技能，并通过反馈自我改进、积累影视制作知识；4) 使用结构化记忆机制记录和召回世界与实体状态，维持跨镜头实体与场景一致性；5) 借助评论者（critic）反馈进行局部修订，并保留可复用的制作知识与经验。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的实验表明，VOL-Agent 能生成分钟级视频，整体质量强且成本有限。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视频生成编排语言化、技能化与记忆化，VOL-Agent 在可编程性、可扩展性和跨镜头一致性上取得优势，实现了低成本的高质量分钟级叙事视频生成。

title: Adaptive Action Horizon Selection via Flow-Field Uncertainty
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimates are important for adaptive execution in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Existing approaches such as Adaptive Action Chunking (AAC) estimate action entropy from multiple sampled action chunks, introducing additional inference cost and capturing both uncertainty within an action trajectory and diversity across alternative strategies. We introduce Divergence-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Action Chunking (DUAC), a post-hoc method that extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA. Building on a closed-form flow-posterior covariance formulation, DUAC derives action-level uncertainty scores from a single generated chunk using Jacobian-vector products, without retraining or multiple endpoint samples. DUAC strongly correlates with AAC, while capturing distinct information: AAC measures global dispersion across sampled chunks, whereas DUAC measures local uncertainty around the trajectory selected for execution. Consequently, DUAC is less sensitive to diversity among distinct but valid action strategies. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa, DUAC-based adaptive horizon selection performs favorably among the evaluated methods, combining strong task success with low uncertainty-estimation latency. These results establish the flow vector field as an efficient, trajectory-conditioned source of predictive uncertainty for robot decision making.

AI.tldr: 提出DUAC，一种后处理式方法，从预训练VLA的流场中提取"轨迹条件"预测不确定性，仅用单次生成的动作块即可实现自适应动作分块，无需重训或多端点采样。
AI.motivation: VLA模型自适应执行需要可靠的不确定性估计。现有Adaptive Action Chunking（AAC）通过多次采样动作块估计动作熵，带来额外推理开销，且把"轨迹内不确定性"与"不同策略间多样性"混在一起，难以区分。
AI.method: 基于闭式flow-posterior协方差公式，利用Jacobian-vector乘积从单个生成chunk的动作向量场中推导动作级不确定性分数；纯事后处理，无需重训练、无需多端点采样。
AI.result: DUAC与AAC高度相关但信息互补：AAC度量采样chunk的全局离散度，DUAC度量所选执行轨迹周围的局部不确定性，对多个有效策略间的多样性更鲁棒。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa上，基于DUAC的自适应horizon选择在对比方法中表现较优，兼顾高任务成功率与低不确定性估计延迟。
AI.conclusion: 流向量场可作为机器人决策中高效、轨迹条件的预测不确定性来源。

title: Re-Testing LLM-Based C-to-Rust Translations Against Their Original C
summary: Most C-to-Rust translators use large language models (LLMs), and each reports a success rate from its own correctness check. We survey 34 C-to-Rust translators that use LLMs. Only one reports testing its check, and eleven release the original C and their Rust in runnable form. We re-test all eleven. We run the C and the Rust on generated inputs, compare every output, and count a divergence only where the C has no undefined behavior. All eleven release defective translations: we find 160 defects, 93 of them outright errors on ordinary inputs. Their own checks accepted 86 defective translations. For 81 of them, the released check never compared the programs on an input that exposes the defect. For three of the other five, it ran one but compared only part of the output. A success rate is only as good as its check. Before counting a translation as a success, authors should compare every output with the C's on inputs the repair loop never saw, check that a verifier reaches its assertion, release exactly what the check accepted, and report how they tested the check.

AI.tldr: 研究发现34个基于大语言模型的C到Rust翻译器中，只有1个报告测试了其正确性检查，11个提供了可运行的C和Rust代码。重新测试这11个，全部存在缺陷：共发现160个缺陷，93个是普通输入上的明显错误，而它们自身的检查却接受了86个有缺陷的翻译。报告的成功率取决于其检查质量的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前C到Rust翻译器各自报告基于自身正确性检查的成功率，但缺乏对这些检查本身是否可靠、是否真正验证了翻译正确性的系统评估，作者希望揭示"成功率"背后检查方法的薄弱。
AI.method: 调查34个使用大语言模型的C到Rust翻译器，找出11个以可运行形式发布原始C和翻译后Rust代码的；对每个翻译器生成输入，运行C和Rust并逐输出比较，仅在C无未定义行为时计入差异（分歧）。
AI.result: 11个翻译器全部发布了有缺陷的翻译，共发现160个缺陷，其中93个是普通输入上的明显错误。它们自身的检查接受了86个有缺陷的翻译：81个情况下，发布的检查从未在暴露缺陷的输入上比较程序；另有5个中3个虽运行了相应输入，但只比较了部分输出。
AI.conclusion: 成功率的可信度取决于其检查的质量。作者建议：在将翻译计为成功前，应在修复循环从未见过的输入上逐输出与C比较；确认验证器到达其断言；精确发布检查所接受的代码；并报告检查本身是如何被测试的。

title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
comment: Technical report. 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
summary: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

AI.tldr: Vibe-Trading是一个agent原生的一体化金融交易框架与工作空间，核心在于让结果、证据、研究历史与交易权限在整个"研究到执行"流程中保持可追溯、可复现，并通过权限门控隔离研究与实盘执行。
AI.motivation: 现有AI agent多基于相对静态的工作流，环境变化时难以保持可靠状态。金融交易中价格、新闻、市场条件、持仓与资金持续演化，结果只有在正确绑定时间、数据快照与执行上下文时才有意义，因此需要能维持状态一致性的架构。
AI.method: 提出agent原生交易框架，整合市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、组合分析、模拟交易、多智能体协作与可选券商执行。关键设计包括：每个结果保留来源、时间范围、配置与生成run；共享证据基座支持核验；版本化研究记录支持可复现续接；显式权限门控将策略研究与实盘执行分离。
AI.result: 形成一体化工作空间，使交易智能体的结果可被追溯、可复现，并仅在显式授权下才可执行，为研究到行动的闭环提供实践基础。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以可追溯性、可复现性与权限分控为核心理念，为金融交易智能体提供了兼顾研究灵活性与执行安全性的实用基础。

title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
summary: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.

AI.tldr: 提出"分辨率即注意力"(RAA)机制，用视觉分辨率作为交互历史的注意力分配手段，动态调整历史交互的渲染清晰度以减少视觉token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中积累大量交互历史，现有记忆管理方法只关注"保留什么/检索什么"，忽略了如何为每个历史交互分配多少感知细节。作者认为有效记忆不仅取决于保留的信息，还取决于感知粒度。
AI.method: 将历史交互渲染为图像，每一步根据其与即将做出决策的相关性动态调整分辨率：关键交互保留细粒度信息，不相关的降低视觉token消耗。用教师模型指导训练轻量级相关性估计器，并进一步优化以在降低视觉token成本的同时保持智能体决策一致性。
AI.result: 多任务、多骨干模型实验中，RAA在50%以上减少token消耗的同时不损害任务性能；作为即插即用的感知层与现有记忆管理方法结合可带来额外token节省。
AI.conclusion: 自适应感知是智能体记忆的一个互补维度，分辨率可作为注意力分配的有效信号。

title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
summary: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. The hazard turns division timing into a survival likelihood that can be tested against real cycle lengths. On 325 held-out MitoCheck tracks spanning 17 knockdowns and a control, MitoWorld lowers FID by 34.6\% and the video metric JEDi by 45.6\% relative to the strongest baselines. Its latent-space prediction intervals achieve near-nominal 90\% coverage, are 35\% narrower than those of a model with freely fitted noise. The hazard also yields cell-cycle length distributions with KS distance close to the model-based finite-sample reference. Testable single-cell stochastic dynamics thus offer a generative tool for time-lapse perturbation screens.

AI.tldr: MitoWorld：随机世界模型，联合建模单细胞表观轨迹与分裂时间。
AI.motivation: 基因敲低后的细胞未来表观演化与分裂时刻均不确定，现有方法只预测端点或群体级变化，未联合建模个体轨迹与分裂时间。
AI.method: 构建随机世界模型：在高斯参考潜空间中进行连续演化，以分裂风险函数终止轨迹，再由条件扩散渲染器转成图像；普通转移可证明保持高斯参考（噪声与动态绑定），配对观测可辨识离散转移；风险函数把分裂时间转为可检验的生存似然。
AI.result: 325 条 held-out MitoCheck 轨迹（17 种敲低+对照）上，FID 降 34.6%、JEDi 降 45.6%；潜空间 90% 预测区间接近名义覆盖率且比自由拟合噪声模型窄 35%；细胞周期长度分布 KS 距离接近有限样本参考。
AI.conclusion: 提供可检验的单细胞随机动力学生成工具，适用于延时扰动筛选。

title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

AI.tldr: LwU统一框架在单个突触层面同时解决持续学习与机器遗忘的冲突，通过权重双重评分与四区划分，无需重训练即可兼顾保留与删除。
AI.motivation: 持续学习要求模型获取新知识而不遗忘旧知识，机器遗忘要求破坏特定知识而不损伤其余部分。二者作用于同一权重上，为一方做的编辑会伤害另一方，因此在同一系统中整合二者存在根本冲突。
AI.method: 提出Learning with Unlearning (LwU)：对每个权重进行双重评分（分别针对需保留数据和需删除数据），将网络划分为四个区域并采用独立更新规则——仅需保留的权重被冻结；仅需删除的权重被清零并作为空闲容量归还网络；冲突权重采用正交于保留梯度的投影梯度上升步；剩余容量通过特权教师的自蒸馏学习新任务。删除事后完成，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在CL与MU两类任务上，LwU优于或匹配最强基线；在作者自建的Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI)数据集上验证了实际可行性；在图像生成任务与危险内容移除任务中超越最接近的基线（见图1）。
AI.conclusion: LwU通过在突触层面化解持续学习与机器遗忘的冲突，实现了无需重训练的统一框架，并在多类任务与真实场景中表现出优于或持平最强基线的性能。

title: SWE-growth: Teacher-Guided Adaptive Self-Play for Software Engineering Agents
summary: Self-play offers a scalable way to train software engineering agents by generating repository-level repair tasks. However, with binary repair rewards and finite rollout budgets, all-fail groups provide no reward-based group-relative advantage. Such tasks may still offer learning opportunities when a Teacher can provide verified repairs absent from the Student's own attempts. We introduce SWE-Growth, a teacher-guided adaptive self-play framework that uses verified Teacher outcomes to identify learning opportunities for the current Student. Tasks with all students failure but reliable Teacher success provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and post-SFT Student rollouts identify mixed-outcome tasks with a positive Teacher--Student gap for reinforcement learning. Task eligibility also guides Injector updates, connecting Student training with subsequent task generation. Starting from 101 seed issues, \textsc{SWE-Growth} improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 27.7% to 31.7% on SWE-bench Pro and from 11.0% to 17.2% on held-out TerminalBench 2.1 by Round~2. It exceeds Student-only self-play by 2.6 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively, and Teacher-augmented self-play by 1.8 and 2.5 points under approximately matched budgets. These results support adapting both supervision and task selection to the Student's evolving repair capability.

AI.tldr: SWE-Growth：教师引导的自适应自我博弈框架，利用教师验证修复识别学生学习机会，SFT+RL两阶段提升软件工程智能体的仓库级修复能力。
AI.motivation: 自我博弈可扩展地生成仓库级修复任务，但在二值修复奖励与有限rollout预算下，"全失败"任务组无法提供基于奖励的组内相对优势，被浪费；而这些任务在教师能提供已验证修复时仍有学习价值。
AI.method: 教师引导的自适应自我博弈：(1) 学生全失败但教师可靠成功的任务作为演示用于SFT；(2) SFT后学生rollout识别混合结果且教师-学生存在正差距的任务用于RL；(3) 任务资格同时指导Injector更新，将学生训练与后续任务生成相连接。从101个种子issue出发。
AI.result: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 从27.7%提升至31.7%（SWE-bench Pro），从11.0%提升至17.2%（留出TerminalBench 2.1），均在第2轮达成。相比纯学生自我博弈分别高2.6和4.1个百分点；相比教师增强自我博弈在近似匹配预算下高1.8和2.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将监督信号与任务选择都适配到学生不断演化的修复能力上，是提升仓库级软件工程智能体的有效途径。

title: From real to synthetic: PSG-GAN learns sleep apnea signal dynamics for AI training
summary: Synthetic polysomnography (PSG) data has great potential in healthcare applications, for example in substituting real data that is sensitive and challenging to collect. Previous research on synthetic PSG data has been largely focused on short segments of individual signals, overlooking the inter-signal dynamics related to sleep disorders. In this study, we developed a generative adversarial network (PSG-GAN) for co-synthesizing longer segments of multiple PSG signals with diverse and complex characteristics typical of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The synthetic signals appeared realistic, and the electroencephalography and electrooculography band powers were similarly distributed across sleep stages. Moreover, the PSG-GAN learned to mirror signal interactions such as changes in photoplethysmography-based heart rate during and after breathing obstructions. An automatic scoring model trained solely with automatically scored synthetic signals reached good performance on sleep staging (\k{appa}=0.71 and 0.63) and respiratory event segmentation (\k{appa}=0.57 and 0.60), on two test sets consisting of healthy volunteers and OSA patients, respectively. This demonstrates the potential of synthetic data in supporting algorithm development for sleep diagnostics. The source code is available at https://github.com/rikuhuttunen/psg-gan.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PSG-GAN，能共合成包含 OSA 特征的多通道、较长片段 PSG 数据，合成数据可训练出性能良好的睡眠分期与呼吸事件分割模型。
AI.motivation: 真实 PSG 数据敏感且采集困难，但既有合成研究多聚焦于单信号短片段，忽略了与睡眠障碍相关的跨信号动态关系。
