AI.method: 开发生成对抗网络 PSG-GAN，共合成多通道、较长片段的 PSG 信号，覆盖 OSA 的多样复杂特征；用其自动打分的合成数据训练自动评分模型并在健康与 OSA 测试集上评估。
AI.result: 合成信号逼真，EEG/EOG 各睡眠阶段频带功率分布相似，并再现呼吸阻塞前后 PPG 心率变化等信号交互；纯合成数据训练模型在睡眠分期（kappa 0.71/0.63）和呼吸事件分割（kappa 0.57/0.60）上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 合成 PSG 数据可用于支撑睡眠诊断算法开发，代码已开源。

title: SimplePro: A Simple Baseline for Proactive Video Understanding
summary: Proactive video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to decide not only what to answer as a video unfolds, but also when newly arrived evidence warrants a response and when to remain silent. Although modern VLMs excel at offline long-video understanding, they struggle in proactive streaming settings, leading prior work to introduce task-specific reinforcement learning or auxiliary triggering modules. We find that explicit reporting rules and structured streaming context substantially improve a frozen VLM's proactive response performance. We exploit this observation to build SIMPLEPRO, a training-free baseline for proactive video understanding. At each decision step, the model combines recent high-resolution frames, bounded historical observations, and prior answer records to determine whether new information warrants a response and, when needed, generate a concise answer. The system then filters consecutive duplicate answers while retaining the raw outputs as context for subsequent decisions. Without any parameter updates or auxiliary triggers, SIMPLEPRO with a 4B backbone consistently outperforms specialized proactive systems across OVO-Bench, StreamingBench-PO, and ProactiveVideoQA. SIMPLEPRO shows overall performance gains as backbone size increases from 2B to 32B. We hope this simple yet effective method will serve as a strong baseline for proactive video understanding, and we will release our code and inference pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 SIMPLEPRO 基线：通过显式报告规则与结构化流式上下文，让冻结 VLM 在主动视频理解中决定何时回答、何时沉默。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 擅长离线长视频理解，但在主动流式场景表现不佳，先前工作多依赖任务特定强化学习或额外触发模块，复杂且需训练。
AI.method: 每个决策步综合近期高分辨率帧、有界历史观测及既往回答记录，判断新信息是否值得响应并生成简洁答案；随后过滤连续重复答案，同时保留原始输出作为后续决策上下文；无参数更新、无辅助触发器。
AI.result: 4B 骨干在 OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO、ProactiveVideoQA 上一致超越专用主动系统；骨干从 2B 增至 32B 时整体性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 简单有效的方法可作为主动视频理解的强基线，作者将开源代码与推理流程。

title: Continuous Noisy-Loop Models
summary: Efficient learning and inference need not imply a compact probabilistic circuit. We quantify this distinction for continuous noisy readings of agreement between adjacent latent spins on a known square grid with $d$ edges. With known margins and bounded Lipschitz channels, minimax squared Hellinger risk is $Θ(\min\{1,dN^{-2/3}\})$ from $N$ independent vectors, without a reliability lower bound. A spline estimator reaches this rate in polynomial arithmetic time given a fixed positive reliability bound; an exponential-size mixture removes that requirement. At fixed positive reliability, nonnegative decomposable circuits need $\exp(Θ(\sqrt d))$ nodes for fixed total-variation error below one, even when each leaf uses at most $αd$ coordinates, $0<α<1$. Optimal Kullback--Leibler (KL) approximation error is $Θ(d/\max\{\log d,\sqrt\ell\})$ in either direction with at most $d^r$ nodes and leaf scopes $\ell\leqαd$, for fixed $r>1$ and $0<α<2/3$. Node counts exclude leaf computation. For three fixed masks, optimal joint conditional KL has order $d/\log d$ when $\ell\leq(\log d)^2$. Local cycle identities relate joint divergence to identifiable channel products and separate weak-channel recovery from density estimation. Factorized evidence preserves a planar zero-field Ising model: given local integrals, exact queries cost $O(d^{3/2})$ arithmetic operations and one root extraction.

AI.tldr: 该文量化了"高效学习/推断"与"紧凑概率电路"之间的本质区别：在方形网格上相邻潜在自旋的连续噪声观测下，确立了极小极大Hellinger风险速率Θ(min{1,dN^{-2/3}})，并证明可靠正界下非负可分解电路需exp(Θ(√d))节点才能达到固定TV误差，而KL最优逼近误差为Θ(d/max{log d,√ℓ})。
AI.motivation: 高效的学习与推断并不必然意味着存在紧凑的概率电路，但此前缺乏对二者区别的严格量化。作者希望在具有已知结构的平面模型（方形网格上的相邻自旋一致性观测）上，把统计最优速率、电路规模下界与逼近误差阶数区分清楚。
AI.method: 设定为已知方形网格上d条边上相邻潜在自旋的一致性连续噪声读数，已知边缘分布、通道有界Lipschitz。用极小极大平方Hellinger风险刻画统计速率；构造样条估计器（多项式时间）与指数规模混合分布作为对照；对非负可分解电路给出节点数下界；在叶作用域ℓ≤αd约束下推导双向最优KL逼近误差；并用局部环恒等式把联合散度与可识别的通道乘积联系起来。
AI.result: 极小极大平方Hellinger风险为Θ(min{1,dN^{-2/3}})（N个独立向量，无需可靠性下界）；固定正可靠性界下样条估计器达到该速率，指数规模混合可去除该要求。固定正可靠性时，非负可分解电路达到固定TV误差需exp(Θ(√d))节点，即使每叶仅用αd个坐标。最优KL误差为Θ(d/max{log d,√ℓ})（双向，节点数≤d^r、叶作用域ℓ≤αd）。三固定掩码下，ℓ≤(log d)^2时最优联合条件KL阶为d/log d。局部环恒等式区分弱通道恢复与密度估计。给定局部积分，平面零场Ising模型的精确查询需O(d^{3/2})算术运算和一次开根。
AI.conclusion: 统计可学习性与推断效率不等于存在紧凑概率电路：存在需要指数规模电路才能逼近的分布族，而逼近误差存在明确的Θ(d/log d)级阶数；局部环恒等式提供了从联合散度到可识别通道参数的桥梁，并为平面Ising证据计算给出高效精确算法（O(d^{3/2})）。

title: Quantifying the Intrusiveness of Retrofitting Retrieval-Augmented Generation onto Legacy Software Systems
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Sustainable Technologies for Industry 5.0 (STI 2026), Dhaka, Bangladesh, 4-5 December 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/TahlilMahfuz/Quantifying-the-Intrusiveness-of-Retrofitting-RAG-onto-Legacy-Software-Systems
summary: Enterprises increasingly add retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to existing REST and monolithic systems, usually by writing an ad hoc HTTP call into a handler, and have no way to quantify how intrusive that choice is. We present (1) a taxonomy of three retrofit patterns, sidecar, SDK-embed and naive-invasive; (2) the Legacy Intrusion Score (LIS), three code sub-metrics (churn, breadth, coupling), and an extension, LIS-X, with three operational sub-metrics measured on a live system (run-time overhead, fault propagation and silent feature degradation); (3) a static evaluation on five legacy systems, two of them real open-source codebases fetched from their repositories at pinned commits; and (4) a live case study that deploys all three patterns as separate OS processes. The code-level ranking sidecar < SDK-embed < naive-invasive holds in all five systems and under 2,000 random weightings, but it follows from component-wise dominance of the sub-metrics, so it validates the metric rather than testing a hypothesis. In the live study, outcomes are not fixed by definition. The sidecar adds no detectable latency to the legacy endpoint (0.07 ms, 95% CI [-0.10, 0.24]), whereas SDK-embed and naive-invasive add 569 and 475 ms and are not distinguishable from each other (p=0.62). Both pass a 2 s dependency delay on to legacy requests, and when the RAG layer fails fast they keep returning successful responses that no longer contain the AI field. Load on the RAG layer slows the legacy service by 1.51-1.57x on a shared host, and sidecar staleness averages 911 ms with a 2 s polling interval. Retrieval hit@1 is 0.95; three hosted LLMs answer all 12 test questions correctly and a local model 9/12, and the four backends are swapped by changing one request field. All dynamic results come from one host and one system.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAG集成到遗留系统的三种改造模式分类与可量化的侵入性度量LIS/LIS-X，在五个遗留系统上验证静态规模排序，并通过真实部署实验揭示静态排序不能预测运行时行为。
AI.motivation: 企业越来越把RAG加入既有REST与单体系统，通常只是在handler里随手写一个HTTP调用，却无法量化这种改造的侵入程度。作者想提供模式分类和可度量的指标，让改造选择的代价可见。
AI.method: (1) 提出三种改造模式分类：sidecar、SDK-embed、naive-invasive；(2) 定义Legacy Intrusion Score(LIS)，含代码改动量、波及广度、耦合三个子指标，并扩展LIS-X加入运行时开销、故障传播、静默功能退化三个运行期子指标；(3) 在五个遗留系统上做静态评估，其中两个是固定commit拉取的真实开源项目；(4) 将三种模式作为独立OS进程部署，做活体案例研究。
AI.result: 代码层排序sidecar<SDK-embed<naive-invasive在五个系统及2000次随机加权下均成立，但该结果源于子指标的逐项占优，只验证了度量本身而非假设。活体实验中：sidecar对遗留端点无可测延迟(0.07ms)，SDK-embed与naive-invasive分别增加569ms与475ms且二者无显著差异(p=0.62)；两者都会把2s依赖延迟传给遗留请求，并在RAG层快速失败时仍返回不含AI字段的成功响应。RAG层负载会在共享主机上拖慢遗留服务1.51-1.57倍；sidecar在2s轮询下陈旧延迟平均911ms。检索hit@1为0.95，三个托管LLM均答对12题全部，本地模型9/12，且切换一个请求字段即可更换四种后端。
AI.conclusion: 静态代码侵入性排序不能预测运行时后果，两类指标需并用。sidecar在延迟与故障隔离上最优但存在数据陈旧，SDK-embed与naive-invasive风险相当。结果仅来自单一主机与单一系统，属初步证据，需更多部署验证。

title: Study and Improvement of Search Algorithms in Stochastic Perfect-Information
summary: In this article, we generalize Unbounded Minimax, the state- of-the-art search algorithm for deterministic zero-sum two- player games with perfect information to the framework of stochastic zero-sum two-player games with perfect informa- tion. We experimentally show that this generalized algorithm achieves better performance than the main stochastic search algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文将确定性完全信息零和博弈中的最优搜索算法Unbounded Minimax推广到随机零和完全信息二人博弈框架，实验表明其性能优于主流随机搜索算法。
AI.motivation: Unbounded Minimax是确定性零和完全信息二人博弈的最先进搜索算法，但此前仅限于确定性场景，无法直接处理含随机性的博弈问题。
AI.method: 将Unbounded Minimax算法从确定性零和完全信息二人博弈推广到随机（stochastic）零和完全信息二人博弈框架下。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该推广算法相比主要的随机博弈搜索算法取得了更好的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: Unbounded Minimax可有效扩展至随机博弈场景，并优于现有随机搜索方法，为随机完全信息博弈提供了更优的搜索方案。

title: DORMS: Image Segmentation via Depth-Ordered Region Merge Trees
summary: We introduce DORMS (Depth-Ordered Region Merging for Segmentation), a purely algorithmic approach to image segmentation from monocular depth maps, requiring no neural networks or learned parameters in the segmentation process. An off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator provides the input depth maps. Our method constructs depth-ordered merge trees through a deterministic union-find sweep, combining component area, depth persistence, and spatial contact constraints to guide region merging. A threshold search determines the segmentation granularity according to a specified target region count, while global depth detrending improves the separation of local geometric structures. Extensive experiments on COCO Panoptic, Cityscapes, and ADE20K demonstrate consistent improvements over classical segmentation baselines and competitive performance against zero-shot neural segmentation models. Notably, our method outperforms all evaluated zero-shot models on Cityscapes, while remaining competitive with several approaches on COCO and ADE20K. These results highlight the potential of purely algorithmic geometric reasoning for image segmentation without learned segmentation models.

AI.tldr: DORMS 是一种纯算法（无神经网络、无可学习参数）的单目深度图分割方法，通过深度排序合并树实现区域合并，在多个基准上与零样本神经分割模型表现相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 探索不依赖学习的分割模型，仅利用单目深度图的几何信息进行图像分割，验证纯算法几何推理的潜力。
AI.method: 输入来自现成单目深度估计器的深度图；通过确定性并查集扫描构建按深度排序的合并树，结合区域面积、深度持久性和空间接触约束引导区域合并；用阈值搜索按目标区域数量确定分割粒度；并引入全局深度去趋势以增强局部几何结构的分离度。
AI.result: 在 COCO Panoptic、Cityscapes、ADE20K 上稳定优于经典分割基线；与零样本神经分割模型相比具竞争力，在 Cityscapes 上优于所有评估的零样本模型，在 COCO 与 ADE20K 上与多种方法持平。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明纯算法几何推理可在不使用学习式分割模型的情况下实现有效分割，凸显其潜力。

title: Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Scaling laws are widely used to predict foundation model performance and guide compute allocation. However, tabular foundation models (TFMs) differ from conventional foundation models in that they are pretrained on virtually unlimited synthetic data from configurable distributions, while ultimately being evaluated on real-world datasets. We investigate whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models reliably extrapolate to larger compute budgets and generalize across evaluation settings. Our analysis reveals differences between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior and shows that accurately fitting a scaling law does not necessarily yield reliable prescriptions on unseen datasets. In particular, selecting configurations using too few evaluation datasets leads to systematically over-optimistic performance estimates. We further demonstrate that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes alongside model size and training compute. Increasing the maximum numbers of rows and features sampled during pretraining improves performance and produces more predictable scaling trends. These insights guide the training of more efficient TabPFNv2-like models, using the open-source training pipeline of nanoTabPFN.

AI.tldr: 本文检验TabPFNv2类表格基础模型(TFM)的缩放定律是否可靠外推与跨评测设置泛化，发现合成数据与真实数据缩放行为存在差异，拟合良好并不意味着可给出可靠的配置处方。
AI.motivation: TFM用近乎无限的合成数据预训练，却在真实数据集上评测，与传统基础模型不同，因此缩放定律的可迁移性与可靠性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于nanoTabPFN开源训练流程，系统分析TabPFNv2风格的缩放规律：比较合成与真实数据上的缩放行为，考察评测数据集数量对配置选择的影响，并将合成预训练数据规模（最大行数与特征数）与模型规模、训练算力一同纳入缩放分析。
AI.result: 使用过少评测数据集选择配置会系统性高估性能；算力最优缩放需要同时扩大合成预训练数据集规模；提高预训练采样的最大行数与特征数能提升性能并使缩放趋势更可预测。
AI.conclusion: 缩放定律拟合准确不等于处方可靠，TFM的算力最优缩放应同步扩展合成数据规模，为更高效的TabPFNv2类模型训练提供指导。

title: Characterizing GitHub Security Actions Alerts For Web Application Tutorials
summary: The high frequency of cybersecurity incidents involving web applications highlights the importance of secure software development practices. Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools help identify potential vulnerabilities in source code without executing the code. Integrating SAST tools into GitHub Security Actions enables security alerts to be reported during development. However, the characteristics of these alerts can make them difficult for developers with limited security expertise to understand, prioritize, and address. Many tutorials for learning web application development also involve source code with security implications. We investigated the properties of SAST alerts relevant to this learning context. We analyzed 6,609 alerts from four default GitHub Security Actions configurations across 60 Django and Spring tutorial repositories. We evaluated the alerts along four dimensions: alert volume, alert relevance, conceptual breadth, and remediation usability. Of the 6,609 alerts, 3,750 (56.7\%) targeted tutorial-related files, while 2,859 (43.3\%) targeted other repository files. The configurations triggered between 34 and 646 distinct rules, and the five most frequently triggered rules accounted for 25.2\%--68.2\% of alerts, depending on the configuration. Across configurations, 0.4\%--32.1\% of alert messages named concrete framework or code constructs, and 0\%--8.1\% met our operational criteria for remediation specificity. Overall, default GitHub Security Actions report a diverse set of security alerts, but these alerts do not consistently focus on tutorial code or provide concrete guidance for addressing the reported issues.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了60个Django与Spring教程仓库中4种默认GitHub Security Actions配置产生的6609条SAST告警，从告警数量、相关性、概念广度、修复可用性四维度评估，发现大部分告警针对教程文件但普遍缺乏具体框架信息和可操作修复指导。
AI.motivation: 网络安全事件频发凸显安全开发实践的重要性；SAST工具集成到GitHub Security Actions可在开发中报告告警，但告警特性使安全知识有限的开发者难以理解、排序和修复；同时许多Web开发教程代码本身存在安全隐患，因此需了解SAST告警在这一学习场景中的特征。
AI.method: 对60个Django和Spring教程仓库，采用4种默认GitHub Security Actions配置，收集6609条SAST告警，并从告警数量、相关性、概念广度和修复可用性四个维度进行量化分析（如统计规则数量、高频规则占比、提及具体框架/代码构造的告警比例及符合修复具体性标准的比例）。
AI.result: 6609条告警中3750条(56.7%)指向教程相关文件，2859条(43.3%)指向其他文件；不同配置触发34至646条不同规则，前5条高频规则占告警的25.2%–68.2%；仅0.4%–32.1%的告警消息提到具体框架或代码构造，0%–8.1%满足修复具体性的操作标准。
AI.conclusion: 默认GitHub Security Actions虽能报告多样化安全告警，但并未稳定聚焦于教程代码，也未就所报问题给出具体修复指导，对学习场景中的开发者支持有限。

title: The Largest Tractable Subclass of Multi-Scale Allen Temporal Reasoning
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel model for temporal reasoning over multi-scale intervals. We show that this model yields a complete reasoning framework and exhibits other particularly interesting properties. Furthermore, we identify the maximal tractable subalgebra for this model, as well as for the other complete model, in the qualitative scales context, which exhibits weaker properties but whose results can be derived by transfer from our new model.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向多尺度区间时间推理的新模型，给出完整推理框架，并确定该模型与另一完整模型在定性尺度下的最大可处理子代数。
AI.motivation: 现有多尺度区间时间推理模型在表达能力与可处理性之间存在权衡：完整模型未必可处理，而可处理模型往往不完备，缺少对可处理边界的明确刻画。
AI.method: 构建一个新的多尺度区间关系模型，证明其推理框架的完备性并分析其性质；随后通过刻画最大可处理子代数确定可处理边界，并利用"转移"技术把结果推广到另一完整模型。
AI.result: 得到完备的多尺度区间推理框架，识别出该模型的最大可处理子代数，同时确定定性尺度情境下另一完整模型的最大可处理子代数（后者性质较弱，但其结论可经由本文模型转移得到）。
AI.conclusion: 新模型在多尺度区间推理上兼具完备性与良好性质，并可作为统一工具，通过结果转移覆盖已有完整模型的可处理性分析。

title: SEE: Unlocking the Hidden Perception of Frozen VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) grasp the overall content of an image but often miss the fine details a question hinges on, such as a small object in a large photo or a number in a dense infographic. Yet even when their answer is wrong, the region they point to often contains the evidence. We introduce Self-Elicited Evidence (SEE), a training-free method that lets a frozen VLM look again where it points. When the initial answer has low confidence, SEE prompts the model to propose regions where the details may appear, answers the question on these enlarged crops, and aggregates the answers with the original prediction through confidence-weighted voting. The model also answers with its own transcript, which helps on text-rich images. SEE needs no detector or OCR engine. Across five backbones, SEE improves every small-object benchmark by 2.3-13.1 points and outperforms five training-free baselines on small objects. With SEE, Qwen3.5-4B surpasses the direct answer of Qwen3.5-9B and matches the 6 times larger Qwen3.5-27B.

AI.tldr: SEE 是一种免训练方法，让冻结的 VLM 在低置信度时重新聚焦自己指出的区域（放大裁剪后再作答），并用置信度加权投票融合答案，从而显著提升小目标与图文密集任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能把握图像整体内容，却常遗漏问题所依赖的细粒度信息（如大图中的小物体、密集信息图中的数字）；不过即使答错，模型指出的区域往往仍包含证据。
AI.method: 训练无关：初始答案置信度低时，提示模型提出可能包含细节的区域，在这些放大裁剪上重新作答，同时让模型给出自转录以应对文本密集图像，最后与原预测做置信度加权投票；无需检测器或 OCR 引擎。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型上，SEE 使所有小物体基准提升 2.3–13.1 分，并在小物体任务上优于五个免训练基线；Qwen3.5-4B 借助 SEE 超过 Qwen3.5-9B 的直接作答，并追平大 6 倍的 Qwen3.5-27B。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型自身的注意力指向作为证据线索进行"再看一次"，是一种低成本、通用的免训练增强手段，可有效弥补 VLM 的细粒度感知短板。

title: TRESS: A Fixed-Size History Representation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
summary: A fixed number of recent observations may span minutes for one variable and days for another. Earlier measurements can still reveal whether the latest value is unusual for that variable. We propose TRESS (Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries), a forecasting model that retains the latest observations at their original times and summarises the full history of each variable. For a given set of variables and event budget, this representation stays the same size as the record grows. Its query-conditioned event lifting module weights deviations from the latest value according to the age of each observation and the forecast horizon. A channel-specific decoder combines the resulting features with historical statistics and a summary shared across variables to predict a correction to the latest value. Retaining 8 to 16 observations per variable, TRESS records the lowest mean test MSE and MAE among the methods compared on all four benchmarks. Serving 32 successive query times from one encoded history reduces CPU inference time by a factor of 2.12--2.60 across the four datasets. The code is at https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-TRESS.

AI.tldr: 提出 TRESS 预测模型：保留每个变量最近观测的原始时间戳并压缩全历史统计，在固定事件预算下表示大小不随记录增长；查询条件事件提升模块按观测年龄和预测步长加权偏差，通道专属解码器预测对最新值的修正。四个基准上 MSE/MAE 最低，单次编码服务 32 个查询点使 CPU 推理提速 2.12–2.60 倍。
AI.motivation: 多元时序中各变量采样频率差异巨大，固定数量的"最近观测"对某些变量只覆盖几分钟、对另一些却跨越数天；同时早期测量对判断最新值是否异常仍有价值。因此需要一种既保留最近观测原始时间信息、又能压缩全历史、且表示规模不随记录增长的建模方式。
AI.method: TRESS（Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries）：(1) 表示层保留每个变量最近观测及其原始时间戳，并对每个变量的完整历史做统计摘要，在给定变量集合与事件预算下表示大小恒定；(2) 查询条件事件提升模块根据观测年龄与预测步长，对"相对最新值的偏差"加权；(3) 通道专属解码器将事件特征与历史统计、跨变量共享摘要结合，输出对最新值的修正量。
AI.result: 每个变量保留 8–16 个观测时，TRESS 在四个基准上取得对比方法中最低的平均测试 MSE 与 MAE；由一次编码历史连续服务 32 个查询时刻，在四个数据集上使 CPU 推理时间降低 2.12–2.60 倍。
AI.conclusion: 结合时间戳化近期事件与统计摘要的恒定规模表示，配合查询条件加权和残差式解码，能在多采样率历史数据上同时提升预测精度与推理效率。代码已开源。

title: OmegaHyper: Explicit-State HyperLTL Model Checking on an omega-Automaton Diet
summary: HyperLTL extends LTL with quantification over traces. AUtoHyper is the de facto explicit-state model checker for HyperLTL, complete for an arbitrary quantifier prefix: it eliminates quantifiers through products of the formula's omega-automaton with the systems, complementing on quantifier alternations. However, it suffers from state explosion, as it fully materializes input systems and intermediate automata. We present OmegaHyper, an overhaul of AutoHyper that keeps its algorithm but decomposes and reduces the size of the processed automata, and integrates the Kofola omega-automaton complementation tool. We compare OmegaHyper with existing explicit-state and symbolic HyperLTL model checkers, on 120 benchmarks from their published suites. OmegaHyper improves the performance of explicit-state HyperLTL model checking by up to orders of magnitude; bounded symbolic tools still reach further on violated instances with short counterexamples, as expected.

AI.tldr: OmegaHyper 是 AutoHyper 的重构版 HyperLTL 显式状态模型检验器，保留原算法但分解并缩减自动机规模，并集成 Kofola 补全过程；在 120 个基准上显式状态检验性能提升可达数量级。
AI.motivation: HyperLTL 通过轨迹量化扩展 LTL，AutoHyper 是事实标准的显式状态模型检验器，对任意量词前缀完备，但其将输入系统与中间自动机完全物化，导致状态爆炸。
AI.method: OmegaHyper 保留 AutoHyper 的量化消去算法（公式 ω-自动机与系统的乘积、量词交替时补全），但对被处理的自动机进行分解与规模缩减，并集成 Kofola ω-自动机补全工具。
AI.result: 在已发表测试集的 120 个基准上，与现有显式状态和符号 HyperLTL 模型检验器对比，OmegaHyper 将显式状态 HyperLTL 模型检验性能提升最多达数量级；有界符号工具在带短反例的违规实例上仍然更强，符合预期。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动机分解、缩减与更好的补全工具集成，可显著缓解显式状态 HyperLTL 检验的状态爆炸问题，且保持对任意量词前缀的完备性。

title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
summary: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出 ABSClaw：零代码智能体，将自然语言请求编译为基于真实数据的可执行社会仿真，并用 26 个原子操作表达状态转移；同时发布 193 任务基准 ABSBench。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 人工社会缺乏科学根基：人物设定与环境是假设的、交互网络是合成的、模拟器由自由形式代码生成，导致结果难以对应真实人群，且对骨干模型敏感。
AI.method: 主张仿真世界应从观测数据中采样，仿真逻辑应由共享、任务无关的词汇表组合而成。ABSClaw 将"谁在行动、在哪行动、与谁交互"锚定于调查与普查数据、地理空间来源和真实网络；用 26 个原子操作表达状态转移；并支持以生命周期作用域的技能扩展能力而不改动内核。另构建 ABSBench 基准（193 个真实社会仿真任务）。
AI.result: 在 ABSBench 上，ABSClaw 在被评估的社会仿真器中整体表现最佳。三个真实案例表明：分别锚定人物、环境与交互网络均能提升与观测结果的一致度。借助一个运行时技能，ABSClaw 执行 13 个群体规模仿真，累计涉及 2500 万智能体。
AI.conclusion: ABSClaw 展现了真实世界保真度、可扩展性与可伸缩性，为有科学根基的 LLM 社会仿真提供了开放、可扩展的范式。

title: Dual-Manifold Variational Autoencoders
summary: In latent diffusion models, expanding the latent dimension of variational autoencoders (VAEs) is essential to push the upper bound of reconstruction quality. However, without explicit structural constraints, such unregularized expansion easily yields a rugged and ill-conditioned latent manifold, causing generated latents to drift off the manifold during generation (i.e., off-manifold problem). Recent works smooth this manifold by using external foundation models (e.g., DINOv2) as a topological regularizer. However, we argue that tying the latent space to frozen external priors inherently restricts generalization: bound by their pre-training distributions and semantic biases, they may fail to capture faithful visual details on out-of-distribution domains. Observing that low-dimensional latents naturally form a smoother, generation-friendly manifold, we propose dual-manifold VAE (DM-VAE) to leverage internal representations as a topological regularizer. Specifically, DM-VAE pairs a high-dimensional reconstructive branch with a low-dimensional branch that extracts a clean topological skeleton, anchoring the high-dimensional manifold to this smooth subspace. Building upon this framework, we further introduce topological representation alignment (TRA) to supervise intermediate generator features during training, and internal guidance with topological skeleton (IG_TS) to guide structural components while preserving high-frequency details at inference. On ImageNet-1K (256x256), our foundation-model-free DM-VAE achieves a state-of-the-art rFID of 0.12 and a generation FID50K of 1.28 (w/o CFG) and 1.20 (w/CFG), and further reaches 1.11 when orthogonally combined with DINOv2.

AI.tldr: DM-VAE 通过高维重建分支与低维拓扑骨架分支构成双流形 VAE，用内部低维表示作为拓扑正则项替代外部基础模型，配合 TRA 与 IG_TS，在 ImageNet-1K 256x256 上无基础模型即达 rFID 0.12、FID50K 1.28/1.20。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散模型中扩大 VAE 潜维度可提升重建上限，但无结构约束会使潜流形崎岖病态，生成时潜变量偏离流形（off-manifold）。现有用 DINOv2 等冻结外部基础模型做拓扑正则，受其预训练分布与语义偏置限制，在分布外域难以捕捉真实视觉细节，阻碍泛化。
AI.method: 观察到低维潜变量天然形成更平滑、利于生成的流形，提出双流形 VAE（DM-VAE）：高维重建分支配对低维分支，低维分支提取干净拓扑骨架，将高维流形锚定到该平滑子空间。并引入拓扑表示对齐（TRA），在训练中监督生成器中间特征；以及内部拓扑骨架引导（IG_TS），推理时引导结构成分同时保留高频细节。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K (256x256) 上，无基础模型的 DM-VAE 取得 SOTA rFID 0.12，生成 FID50K 为 1.28（无 CFG）与 1.20（有 CFG）；与 DINOv2 正交结合后进一步达到 1.11。
AI.conclusion: 以内部低维表示作为拓扑正则可替代外部冻结先验，既获得平滑且病态性更低的潜流形，又避免外部语义偏置带来的泛化限制；且该方法与外部先验正交，可叠加增益。

title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
comment: This paper is submitted to Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. Evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid architecture achieves the strongest predictive performance among all evaluated models. The proposed hybrid model achieves the best performance with an R^2 score of 0.8022 and mean absolute error of 2.879 MPa, highlighting the importance of incorporating mesh topology in biomechanical prediction tasks. The proposed framework provides a scalable and computationally efficient alternative for FEM-based orthopedic analyses and fracture risk assessment. The code is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种混合图神经网络框架 GCN-SAGE-Residual，用图结构有限元数据预测股骨应力，以低计算成本替代有限元分析，取得 R²=0.8022、MAE=2.879 MPa 的最优效果。
AI.motivation: 髋部骨折导致失能与死亡风险高，且随老龄化加剧。有限元分析能评估股骨强度但计算成本高；传统机器学习代理模型虽快，却无法捕捉有限元网格的空间与拓扑结构信息。
AI.method: 将有限元网格建模为图数据，提出 GCN-SAGE-Residual 混合架构，融合图卷积、邻域聚合（GraphSAGE）与残差学习，以建模网格单元间的空间依赖与应力传播。实验对比 14 个模型（经典机器学习与基线 GNN），并进行针对性的架构消融实验以分离各组件贡献。
AI.result: 所提混合模型在所有评测模型中性能最优，R² = 0.8022，MAE = 2.879 MPa；消融实验验证了各组件及网格拓扑信息的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 引入网格拓扑的 GNN 代理模型为基于有限元的骨科分析与骨折风险评估提供了一种可扩展、计算高效的替代方案，代码已公开。

title: The Comprehension Gap in LLM-Assisted Software Development: An Experiment
summary: When LLM tools are pushed beyond their capabilities for software development tasks, developers must be able to step in. However, the comprehension that developers acquire during development might be negatively impacted due to excessive code generation. This could create a cognitive debt that needs to be resolved before tasks can be solved efficiently again. We explore how well developers understand code they generated by prompting in comparison to self-written and unseen code and how they reflect on their comprehension. We conduct a crossover experiment and interviews with 35 participants consisting of students, academic personnel, and software developers. After completing two programming tasks with or without LLM chat usage, respectively, participants are tasked with finding introduced mutations in the produced and additional unseen code. We use insights from interviews and screen recordings to supplement our results. Regarding the experiment, 36% of participants report a better understanding of self-written code compared to their generated code. On average, participants solved the comprehension task 20% faster for self-written code than for generated code and found 11% more mutations. Participants needed significantly less time to solve programming tasks when working with the LLM. However, participants with high reliance on the LLM chat and low task engagement showed significantly decreased comprehension. Our qualitative results show great variability in individual perspectives on comprehension differences and strategies to mitigate issues. Strategies for dealing with comprehension differences range from accepting comprehension differences to adapting their LLM interactions or avoiding the tools altogether. Our results warrant further investigation into cognitive debt in larger systems and developer practices to mitigate issues.

AI.tldr: 通过交叉实验与访谈（35人）发现：依赖LLM生成的代码理解较自写代码慢20%、少发现11%变异；高依赖低投入者理解显著下降，但个体差异与缓解策略多样。
AI.motivation: LLM工具被用于超出其能力的开发任务时需开发者介入，但过度代码生成可能损害开发者对代码的理解，形成需先消解的"认知债务"，从而影响后续任务效率。作者希望量化这种理解损失并了解开发者的自我反思。
AI.method: 交叉实验+访谈，35名参与者（学生、学术人员、软件开发者）。每人分别在有/无LLM聊天辅助下完成两个编程任务，随后在产出代码及额外未见代码中寻找植入的变异（mutation）。结合访谈与录屏分析补充定量结果。
AI.result: 36%参与者自评对自写代码理解更好；理解任务上自写代码平均快20%、多发现11%变异；用LLM时编程任务耗时显著更少；但高LLM依赖且低任务投入者理解显著下降。定性结果显示对理解差异的认知与应对策略个体差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对更大规模系统中的"认知债务"及开发者缓解实践开展进一步研究；策略从接受差异到调整LLM交互方式乃至完全回避工具不等。

title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

AI.tldr: NaviGATE是一个噪声感知的生成式多模态知识图谱推理框架，通过结构对齐、结构感知内部知识激活、噪声感知双视图指令微调和结构约束解码，在标准基准上超越强基线并对噪声检索保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有基于嵌入的方法虽能捕捉图拓扑，但固定的多模态表示难以进行查询特定的细粒度语义推理；基于生成的方法则易受噪声检索影响，且可能生成无效实体。
AI.method: 1) 将图导出的结构表示与文本语义对齐；2) 用多模态实体摘要和注入的结构token微调多模态语言模型，实现结构感知的内部知识激活；3) 噪声感知双视图指令微调，联合优化无检索与有检索视图：对可靠检索候选采用对比logit锐化强化，对误导候选采用参数一致性蒸馏抑制；4) 推理时用结构约束解码，将生成限制在目标知识图谱的合法实体中。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，NaviGATE持续优于强单模态、多模态及生成式基线，并在噪声检索场景下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 结合结构感知激活、噪声感知双视图微调与结构约束解码的生成式框架，可有效提升多模态知识图谱推理性能与鲁棒性。

title: TOMAS: Topology-Aware Operation Modeling and Adaptive Staging for Egocentric Hand Forecasting
summary: Forecasting future hand movements from egocentric videos plays an important role in understanding human intentions and hand-object interactions. However, different manipulation intentions can lead to substantially different hand trajectories even when interacting with the same object. Existing methods have not sufficiently explored the intrinsic relationships between articulated hand movements and object semantics to capture such operation-dependent motion patterns. Therefore, we propose TOMAS, a topology-aware operation modeling and adaptive staging framework for egocentric hand forecasting. Specifically, we develop a topology-aware hand-object reasoning mechanism that associates hand skeletal structures and articulation dynamics with object semantics and spatial relationships to jointly infer potential interaction targets and latent manipulation operations. The resulting object-operation representations provide interaction conditions for future hand trajectory prediction, with supervision adapted to the annotations available in each dataset. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive staging mechanism that organizes future hand movements into ordered latent stages with learnable temporal boundaries. Stage-specific geometric subgoals are then incorporated to guide trajectory refinement according to the underlying manipulation patterns. Experimental results on multiple publicly available benchmarks demonstrate that TOMAS achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-dimensional and multi-target hand motion forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOMAS框架，通过拓扑感知的"物体-操作"推理与自适应分段机制，提升自我中心视频中手部轨迹的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 同一物体在不同操作意图下会对应差异很大的手部轨迹，现有方法未充分挖掘关节手部运动与物体语义之间的内在关系，难以捕捉依赖操作的动模式。
AI.method: 包含两个核心模块：(1) 拓扑感知的手-物推理机制，将手部骨骼结构与关节动力学同物体语义及空间关系关联，联合推断潜在交互目标与操作意图，形成"物体-操作"表征作为预测条件，并按各数据集标注自适应调整监督；(2) 自适应分段机制，将未来手部运动组织为带可学习时间边界的有序潜阶段，并引入阶段级几何子目标引导轨迹细化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上取得最优性能，在多维度、多目标手部运动预测任务中均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模手-物拓扑关系与操作语义、并结合分阶段子目标引导，是提升未来手部轨迹预测的有效途径。

title: Supervised Hebbian Class Networks: Learning Without Backpropagation
summary: This paper introduces Supervised Hebbian Class Networks as a method for training multi- layer perceptrons and convolutional networks without gradient calculations or backpropa- gation. Each neuron in a learned layer is assigned a class, while connections follow the usual fully connected or convolutional pattern. The method combines a class-based supervision rule shared across layers with a Lion optimizer adapted to Hebbian activity products. All layers train together throughout the run, and their activities provide class predictions di- rectly, without a separately trained classifier. The experiments test the method on MNIST with a multilayer perceptron and on CIFAR-10 with a convolutional networ

AI.tldr: 提出Supervised Hebbian Class Networks，用类监督Hebbian规则配合适配的Lion优化器训练MLP和CNN，无需梯度计算与反向传播。
AI.motivation: 探索能否在不使用梯度计算和反向传播的情况下训练多层感知机和卷积网络。
AI.method: 为学习层每个神经元分配类别，连接沿用全连接或卷积模式；各层共享类别监督规则，并采用适配Hebbian活动乘积的Lion优化器；所有层联合训练，其活动直接给出类别预测，无需单独训练分类器。
AI.result: 在MNIST上用多层感知机、在CIFAR-10上用卷积网络进行实验（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 该方���验证了基于Hebbian类监督的多层/卷积网络可端到端训练且直接输出类别预测，为无反向传播训练提供了一种可行途径。

title: Keeping Up with the Kernel: Can LLMs Adapt Linux Drivers to Interface Changes?
summary: We analyze collateral evolution in Linux, the coordinated updates that drivers require when the kernel interfaces they depend on change, over the 20 years since it was first studied, covering releases from v3.0 to v7.2. Since v2.6.13, the number of driver files and support libraries has grown about eightfold, a single change to the most widely used library can now reach about 5.3k driver files, and such changes arrive either in bursts or spread over many releases. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that asks models to adapt an old driver module to a target kernel and evaluates the result against the developer's reference patch. The benchmark contains 316 manually confirmed tasks from 202 mainline commits and 268 modules, spanning kernel releases v6.19 to v7.2. It distinguishes 134 build-breaking tasks, where the old driver fails to compile, from 182 build-compatible tasks, where the old usage still builds. Using CoEvoAgent, we evaluate Direct, SmPL, and mini-SWE-agent with DeepSeek Flash, and compare Direct with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol. With DeepSeek, default Direct generation achieves strict reference agreement on 41.0% of build-breaking tasks but only 3.3% of build-compatible tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Linux 20年间驱动所需的协同更新（collateral evolution），发现驱动规模增长约8倍、单个库改动影响可达约5.3k文件；为此提出基准CoEvoBench（316个经人工确认的任务），并显示LLM在"构建破坏型"任务上尚可、在"构建兼容型"任务上表现极差。
AI.motivation: Linux内核接口变化时，驱动需同步更新，而自上次研究以来规模已大幅膨胀；需要重新量化这一协同更新现象，并建立一个可评估模型能否自动完成此类驱动适配的基准。
AI.method: 覆盖v3.0至v7.2版本，统计驱动文件与支持库的变化规模、影响范围与到达模式；构建CoEvoBench，包含来自202个主线提交、268个模块的316个人工确认任务，以开发者参考补丁为标准自动评估；将任务分为134个构建破坏型与182个构建兼容型；通过CoEvoAgent对Direct、SmPL、mini-SWE-agent（DeepSeek Flash）及Direct配Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol进行对比。
AI.result: 自v2.6.13以来驱动文件与支持库数量增长约8倍，最常用库的单次改动可波及约5.3k个驱动文件，改动呈突发或跨多个版本分布两种模式。DeepSeek下默认Direct生成在构建破坏型任务上与参考补丁严格一致率为41.0%，而在构建兼容型任务上仅3.3%。
AI.conclusion: Linux驱动协同更新的规模与复杂度显著上升；现有LLM智能体在"编译失败显然需要改"的场景中有效，但在旧代码仍可编译、需隐蔽语义适配的场景中严重不足，这构成未来研究的关键挑战。

title: AGAMOTTO: An AI-Enabled Framework for Time-Critical Tactical Course-of-Action Evaluation and Generation
summary: Current command and control (C2) platforms lack integrated simulation capabilities that would allow commanders to dynamically explore courses of action (COAs) during live operations. This paper presents ongoing research and contributions to the development of AGAMOTTO (Advanced Guidance and Analytics for Military Operations, Tactical Threats, and Outcomes) as part of the overarching NGC2 program, which advances the Army's efforts to modernize C2 systems, such as the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK). The paper outlines the current design, preliminary findings, and the remaining research tasks, with an emphasis on how the completed work will support tactical decision-making in future time-constrained environments. While the full system is still under development, initial development and results demonstrate the feasibility of AGAMOTTO. Early experiments highlight both the potential benefits and practical constraints of deploying AI-enabled tools in operational settings, and introduce lessons learned and a viable training strategy to make AI-generated COAs feasible in tactical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍AGAMOTTO系统，为现有C2平台（如TAK）加入集成仿真与AI能力，使指挥官能在实时作战中动态探索行动方案（COA）。该系统仍在开发中，但初步实验已验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 当前指挥控制（C2）平台缺乏集成的仿真能力，指挥官无法在实时作战中动态探索行动方案，难以在时间紧迫的环境中做出有效战术决策。
AI.method: 作为NGC2计划的一部分，设计并开发AGAMOTTO系统（面向军事行动、战术威胁与结果的高级引导与分析），集成仿真与AI分析能力，并与TAK等C2系统现代化工作衔接；通过早期实验评估其在作战环境中的部署。
AI.result: 早期实验证明了AGAMOTTO的可行性，既揭示了AI工具在作战环境中部署的潜在收益，也暴露了实际约束，并总结了经验教训与可行的训练策略。
AI.conclusion: AGAMOTTO在战术场景中生成可用COA具有可行性，但系统仍处于开发阶段，需完成剩余研究任务，并配合训练策略以支撑未来时间受限环境下的战术决策。

title: Agreement Is Not Accuracy: LiDAR Elevation Errors Hidden in LiDAR-Camera Extrinsics
summary: LiDAR and cameras provide complementary measurements for 3D vision, yet agreement between their observations does not establish the accuracy of either sensor's internal geometry. We show that systematic LiDAR elevation biases can be absorbed into the estimated extrinsics. Using synchronized LiDAR intensities and camera-estimated checkerboard poses, we jointly estimate a sensor-specific elevation correction shared across recordings and extrinsics for each recording. Ray-plane intersections locate the checker pattern without using reported ranges, preventing range errors from directly moving the lookup. Under matched intensity and correction models, this lookup gives smaller camera-consistency residuals than measured-point lookup. Across six identically designed rigs using the same sensor models, recording-excluded corrections reduce the mean translation-reference distance from 7.57 to 3.04 mm. On separate structures, they reduce inter-plane angle errors against references from independent dense camera scans and improve image-edge alignment. Rolling the rigs shifts the plane pairs exhibiting the largest angular improvements, as predicted for an elevation-only correction. Within the ray-plane model, calibration-target projections and loop-consistency residuals change little despite these geometric improvements. These findings show why agreement after extrinsic calibration need not establish correct internal LiDAR geometry. Synchronized observations of a familiar checkerboard provide a practical route to estimating and testing elevation corrections without a dedicated large calibration field. We plan to release code and data for reproducing the main results.

AI.tldr: LiDAR与相机标定中外参可吸收LiDAR系统高程偏差，作者用同步强度与棋盘位姿联合估计共享高程校正与外参，显著提升几何一致性。
AI.motivation: LiDAR与相机观测虽相互吻合，但一致并不代表任一传感器内部几何正确；系统性的LiDAR高程偏差可被外参估计吸收，因此需要区分并校正内部几何误差。
AI.method: 利用同步LiDAR强度与相机估计的棋盘位姿，联合估计跨录像共享的传感器特定高程校正与各段录像的外参；通过光线-平面求交定位棋盘格而不使用报距，避免测距误差直接影响查找。
AI.result: 匹配强度与校正模型下残差小于实测点查找；六个同型平台平均平移参考距离由7.57mm降至3.04mm；独立密集相机扫描参考下减小平面间夹角误差并改善图像边缘对齐；滚动平台时最大改善平面对随之转移，符合仅高程校正的预测；标定靶投影与回路一致性残差变化不大。
AI.conclusion: 外参标定后的一致性不能证明LiDAR内部几何正确；同步观测常见棋盘格可在无需大型标定场的情况下估计并检验高程校正，代码与数据将公开。

title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
summary: Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and validation-tuned shape penalties, demonstrating global structural validity without penalty tuning while maintaining competitive approximation accuracy. Overall, the results identify recoverable convex latent structure as the key mechanism enabling gradient-level structure-preserving approximation beyond convexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究输入凸神经网络（ICNN）的结构保持逼近框架如何推广到半凸、拟凸及凸可变换函数，并给出sharp逼近率、精确表示定理与IqCNN构造，最后通过PDE数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: ICNN能以架构约束全局强制凸性，但现有理论主要局限于凸函数，缺乏对半凸、拟凸、凸可变换等更广泛函数类的结构保持逼近保证，也缺少关于逼近率是否为sharp、表示复杂度如何、以及能否摆脱形状惩罚调参的系统回答。
AI.method: 对紧凸域上C^{1,1}凸函数，在m个仿射片段的max-affine逼近下建立W^{1,p}误差率m^{-1/d}并证明其sharp，同时证明每个max-affine函数都有复杂度线性于m的有界宽度ICNN精确表示；通过二次提升把结果推广到半凸函数，通过单调复合推广到凸可变换函数；对一般Lipschitz拟凸函数，建立基于仿射投影单调响应的定量有限探针逼近理论，构造具L^∞保证的结构保持IqCNN；并证明结果可迁移到ReLU可迁移的平滑激活（Softplus、ELU）。
AI.result: 得到C^{1,1}凸函数在max-affine逼近下的sharp W^{1,p}极小极大率m^{-1/d}，以及线性复杂度、有界宽度的精确ICNN表示；同一W^{1,p}率经二次提升与单调复合扩展到半凸和凸可变换函数；对Lipschitz拟凸函数得到具L^∞逼近保证的IqCNN；结果可迁移到Softplus、ELU等平滑激活。PDE数值实验显示所提架构在无需惩罚调参的情况下保持全局结构有效性，同时与参数匹配的MLP及经调参的形状惩罚方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复的凸隐结构是使梯度级结构保持逼近超越凸性、扩展到更广函数类的关键机制；结构保持性可由架构本身而非惩罚项实现。

title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) let users analyse data in natural language, either by giving the data to the model to read directly or by having the model generate code to process it. Both routes send the data, or fragments of it, to the model; both pay for inference on every run; and the code a model writes to answer a question is usually discarded once the question is answered. We present Metadata-Driven AI, an architectural pattern that keeps the data away from the model and turns each analysis into a reusable program. Only metadata (not the actual data) crosses a one-way inference boundary to the LLM. The program the LLM returns runs next to the data and is kept, so that inference is paid once per analysis rather than once per run. We describe the pattern together with a simple cost model, a measurement of how little information crosses the boundary on public datasets, and a benchmark showing that a small, locally hosted model can serve as the generator. We illustrate the pattern on three applications, each built on a different implementation of it: geospatial photovoltaic prospection over live public APIs, extraction of portfolio positions from bank statements, and a conversational assistant over smart-city dashboards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"元数据驱动AI"架构模式：数据不进入模型，只有元数据单向传递给LLM；LLM返回的可复用程序在数据旁运行并被保留，实现"每次分析付一次推理"而非"每次运行付一次"。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM数据分析方式（直接喂数据或让模型生成代码）都会把数据或片段发送给模型，每次运行都要付费推理，且生成的代码用完即弃，存在隐私、成本与复用性三方面问题。
AI.method: 设计元数据驱动的单向推理边界架构：仅元数据跨边界传给LLM，返回程序在数据本地执行并持久保存；配套给出简单成本模型、公共数据集上"跨界信息量"的测量，以及小规模本地模型作为生成器的基准测试；在三个基于不同实现的应
AI.result: 测量显示跨边界传递的信息量极少；基准表明小型本地托管模型即可胜任代码生成器角色；三个应用（基于公共API的光伏选址、银行对账单持仓提取、智慧城市仪表盘对话助手）验证了模式可行性。
AI.conclusion: 将数据与模型隔离、把分析转化为可复用程序，可在保证隐私的同时显著降低推理成本，并具备跨场景的通用性。

title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
summary: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame

AI.tldr: 论文比较"模型即策略"与"代码即策略"两种自我改进方式，发现让大模型离线思考、把学到的知识写成程序实时执行，效果远好于联合训练控制器，后者仅小幅提升。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型虽能读屏、能推理游戏，但面对陌生游戏仍需学习如何玩；且实时视觉游戏中智能体只能看屏幕，游戏在它思考时继续运行，如何用少量自我尝试快速自我改进是核心问题。
AI.method: 提出并对比两类可承载自我改进的策略：（1）模型即策略——模型在游玩中选动作，采用实时分块（real-time chunking）让已提交动作在模型推理时继续执行，并训练一个2B控制器适配该接口；（2）代码即策略——模型在两次尝试间编写、测试并修订程序，由程序实时游玩。另做单游戏权重微调作为对照。
AI.result: 在170个GameWorld任务上，每次运行最多8次一分钟执行：代码即策略平均进度47.80%，训练控制器为30.90%，且代码即策略在全部五类游戏中领先；单游戏权重改进仅带来有限收益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持让模型离线思考、将所学知识存为在实时环境中行动的程序，而非依赖模型权重在线改进；代码即策略是实时视觉游戏自我改进的更有效范式。

title: SIRAZ: Sparse Inter-Layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-Shot Visual Neural Decoding
summary: Brain-computer interfaces aim to establish direct communication between neural activity and external systems, making interpretation of brain signals an important problem. In this context, neural visual decoding seeks to infer visual information from neural activity by learning a mapping between brain responses and the corresponding visual stimuli. It investigates how visual information emerges from neural signals and relates to perceptual processing while enabling the reconstruction or retrieval of visual stimuli from neural signals. Our brain primarily follows a hierarchical pathway to process visual information captured by the eye. However, neural representations learned by existing methods differ fundamentally from those produced by the biological visual system. To bridge this gap and mimic the human vision hierarchy, we introduce Sparse Inter-layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-shot (SIRAZ). SIRAZ is a framework that aligns neural visual representations by jointly modeling early visual processes via fovea- and magnocellular-pathway-inspired Difference-of-Gaussians transformations. To align the semantic information with neural information, it extracts multiple intermediate representations of the image at multiple depths and passes them through the Residual Gated Adapter Mechanism. To study the temporal dynamics of neural signals, the Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention Encoder is introduced to align the learned neural representation with the final visual representation. The proposed framework achieves 92.5% top-1 and 99.27% top-5 accuracy in the intra-subject setting on the THINGS-EEG dataset, and 50.25% and 75% top-1 and top-5 accuracy in the THINGS-MEG dataset. The results indicate that combining biologically motivated visual representations with the structured modalities of neural dynamics improves cross-modal alignment and zero-shot image retrieval.

AI.tldr: SIRAZ：通过仿生视觉层次结构与时间注意力机制对齐脑信号与视觉表征，实现零样本图像检索，THINGS-EEG达92.5% top-1。
AI.motivation: 神经视觉解码需学习脑响应与视觉刺激间的映射，但现有方法学到的神经表征与生物视觉系统的层次化处理机制存在本质差异，需弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出SIRAZ框架：用受中央凹与巨细胞通路启发的Difference-of-Gaussians变换联合建模早期视觉过程；从多深度提取图像中间表征并经残差门控适配器（Residual Gated Adapter）对齐语义与神经信息；用方向感知多尺度时间注意力编码器（Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention Encoder）建模神经信号时间动态，并将其与最终视觉表征对齐。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG被试内设定下top-1 92.5%、top-5 99.27%；THINGS-MEG上top-1 50.25%、top-5 75%。
AI.conclusion: 将生物启发的视觉表征与结构化神经动态模态相结合，可改善跨模态对齐与零样本图像检索性能。

title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Weather Forecasting: Conformal Prediction Under Spatiotemporal Dependence
summary: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage and has begun to be applied to gridded weather forecasts. Marginal coverage concerns the long-run fraction of covered points at a location, not how coverage behaves jointly across space and time on a given day. I benchmark eight interval-construction procedures (Gaussian, pooled and per-cell split conformal, per-season, adaptive conformal inference and rolling windows) for gridded 2 m temperature forecasts at eight lead times from 6 hours to 10 days, using ERA5 at 5.625 degree resolution, a deliberately modest convolutional forecaster and ECMWF's operational HRES, with calibration in 2017-2018 and testing in 2019-2021. Alongside coverage, width and interval score, I report dependence diagnostics: a spatial overdispersion index, quantiles of daily spatial coverage and miss persistence relative to a shuffled-days null. Per-cell methods reach near-nominal marginal coverage, yet the day-to-day variance of the fraction of cells covered is roughly 3 to 10 times what independent cells would give, and misses cluster in time; both effects grow with lead time for the CNN, also appear for HRES, and are shared by all methods. An oracle that divides each day's normalised errors by that day's mean removes 81 to 92 percent of the excess dispersion for the CNN and 93 to 98 percent for HRES, so days of large errors across much of the grid account for most of it. A day-scale predicted from seasonal terms and already-verified errors lowers the overdispersion index without widening intervals but improves interval score by at most 0.6 percent; on HRES from 12 hours to 3 days it has the lowest overdispersion index while ACI or season-conditional calibration has the best interval score, so no method is best on both. The study covers one variable, one coarse grid, a reanalysis target and two forecasters.

AI.tldr: 该论文对网格化2米温度预报的8种共形区间方法做基准测试，发现虽然逐格方法可达近似名义边际覆盖率，但覆盖率在空间和时间上存在严重依赖（日间覆盖波动为独立假设的3–10倍、miss聚集），且这是所有方法与预报器共有问题；日尺度误差主导该超额离散。
AI.motivation: 共形预测只保证边际覆盖率（长期覆盖比例），不保证某一天内覆盖率在空间和时间上的联合表现。现有网格天气预报应用忽视了这种依赖性，作者希望量化并比较不同区间方法在空间-时间覆盖行为上的差异。
AI.method: 在ERA5 5.625°分辨率下，对6小时至10天的8个预见期、一个较简朴的卷积预报器和ECMWF HRES业务模式做测试（2017–2018标定、2019–2021测试）。比较8种区间构建方法：Gaussian、pooled与逐格split conformal、分季节、ACI、滚动窗口。除覆盖率、宽度、interval score外，还引入空间过度离散指数、每日空间覆盖率分位数、miss持续性（相对打乱日零假设）等依赖诊断，并用oracle与日尺度预测做消融。
AI.result: 逐格方法边际覆盖接近名义值，但每日覆盖格点比例方差为独立情形的约3–10倍，miss在时间上聚集，且随预见期增加而加剧（CNN），HRES也出现且所有方法共有。oracle按日归一化误差去除81–92%（CNN）、93–98%（HRES）的超额离散，说明大面积大误差日主导。基于季节项+已验证误差的日尺度预测在不加宽区间下降低过度离散，interval score改善最多0.6%；HRES 12小时–3天时该方法离散指数最低，而ACI或季节条件标定interval score最佳，没有方法两者兼优。
AI.conclusion: 网格预报的共形区间存在显著的时空覆盖依赖，源于日尺度大范围误差，不能靠单一方法同时优化离散度与interval score。研究局限于单变量、粗网格、再分析目标与两个预报器，结论外推需谨慎。

title: MLIR-MRacle: Memory-Model-Aware Metamorphic Fuzzing of Concurrent MLIR
summary: Multi-level compilers built on MLIR lower concurrent programs through many stages towards targets with potentially drastically different memory models, where an optimisation which appears reasonable, can silently change program behaviour. Testing these lowerings is hard: a concurrent program often has no single expected outcome, and existing MLIR fuzzers often assume determinism. We present MLIR-MRacle, a memory-model-aware metamorphic fuzzer for concurrent MLIR programs. MLIR-MRacle applies metamorphic relations gated by the target memory model, so that both the original and transformed programs remain well defined - executing both repeatedly, and comparing their outcome sets or distributions withone of two statistical oracles. A coverage guided campaign driver built on libafl is used to perform continuous fuzzing. MRs, memory models, oracles, and execution backends all provide extension points for future researchers and compiler engineers to build off this package. In a case study on Armv8 hardware, MLIR-MRacle ran over 145k trials across four configurations, reaching up to 93.6k compiler coverage edges, and found a bug in the OpenMP dialect verifier that has since been fixed upstream. Video: https://youtu.be/lKtGk0H97Ts?si=dWLUHl2CJ24ep6JY

AI.tldr: MLIR-MRacle：面向并发MLIR程序、感知内存模型的蜕变模糊测试器，支持MLIR多级编译中并发lowering的正确性检测。
AI.motivation: MLIR多级编译把并发程序经由多阶段lowering到内存模型差异巨大的目标平台上，某些看似合理的优化会静默改变程序行为。并发程序往往没有唯一预期结果，而现有MLIR模糊测试器多假设程序具有确定性，因此这类lowering极难测试。
AI.method: 提出MLIR-MRacle：以目标内存模型为门控条件施加蜕变关系（MR），保证变换前后程序均保持良定义（well-defined）；对原程序与变换后程序重复执行，并用两种统计型oracle比较其结果集合或结果分布。基于libafl构建覆盖引导的campaign驱动进行持续模糊测试。MR、内存模型、oracle与执行后端均提供扩展点。
AI.result: 在Armv8硬件案例研究中，MLIR-MRacle在四种配置下运行超过14.5万次试验，编译器覆盖边数最高达93.6k，并发现OpenMP方言verifier中的一个bug，该bug已被上游修复。
AI.conclusion: MLIR-MRacle为并发MLIR程序的lowering正确性提供了可扩展的、内存模型感知的蜕变模糊测试框架，实证其可行性与有效性（高覆盖率并发现真实bug），并为后续研究者与编译器工程师留下MR、内存模型、oracle、后端等扩展接口。

title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.

AI.tldr: GateWatch 提出一种紧凑、可解释的激活探针：将整个决策规则表达为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔电路，并以高效服务系统支持多分类器并行推理。
AI.motivation: LLM 与智能体部署后需要监控其不安全或非预期行为。现有激活探针存在精度、可解释性与计算开销的权衡：原始激活探针缺乏可解释输入，SAE 探针虽用可解释特征但依赖加性分类器与大编码器，可解释性受限且内存开销高。
AI.method: 将分类器设计为对少量二值化 SAE 特征的显式布尔逻辑电路；在给定门预算下探索三种电路构建方法；提出 GateWatchServe：仅计算被选中的 SAE 特征、跨层流式传递二值值、用紧凑查找表并行评估多个 GateWatch 分类器。
AI.result: 在 Gemma-2-9B 的 24 个任务上，平均仅用 3.8 个 SAE 特征和 3.5 个逻辑门，平均测试准确率达 80.49%，仅比完整 16K 特征 SAE 探针低 1.17 个百分点，在 10 个任务上持平或更优，探针内存减少 99.98%。在 vLLM 中，1000 个并发的多层多 token 分类器保持 97–98% 基线吞吐与 99.8% KV-cache 容量。
AI.conclusion: GateWatch 在精度几乎不损的前提下显著提升可解释性与内存效率，并具备良好的实际部署性能，为 LLM 行为监控提供了可行方案。

title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.

AI.tldr: WaveView 通过 DT-CWPT 将源视点 warp 结果注入预训练生成器初始噪声的相位，实现局部、各向异性的相机条件注入，几乎无额外开销，在 DL3DV 与动态 NVS 上均超越 MetaView/AnyView。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式新视角合成中，显式 warp 方法依赖视频扩散模型做重投影，隐式方法编码相机参数或 3D 线索，二者都增加推理开销，且生成布局常偏离真值，因此需要一个高效、约束更贴合几何的条件注入方式。
AI.method: 把 warp 后的源图像注入初始噪声的相位而非直接生成条件；用双树复小波包变换（DT-CWPT）在频域做局部且各向异性的相位注入，使生成器在遮挡区和极线方向上受到的约束更弱。保持原架构不变，开销可忽略。
AI.result: DL3DV 基准上每个重叠率分箱均优于所有基线；最难分箱中共视区域 PSNR 比共享生成器的 MetaView 高 0.84 dB，速度快 2.1 倍。动态 NVS 中，用同样的噪声微调 AnyView，使其在 AnyViewBench 的零样本 PSNR 从 11.58 dB 提升至 12.35 dB。
AI.conclusion: 相位域注入是一种低成本、架构无关的 NVS 条件注入范式，兼顾几何一致性与生成自由度，并可推广到动态场景与现有模型微调。

title: OpenGNS: An Open Dataset of the Gradient Noise Scale across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
summary: The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. Building on this dataset, we study how the GNS depends on hyperparameters, scale, and training progress, and how it relates to the CBS. We find that the GNS behaves as a consistent "temperature of training", remaining stable across model sizes under muP at equivalent loss, and our results suggest task-dependent biases in its relation to the CBS: a tendency to overestimate the CBS for classification and to underestimate it for generative tasks, consistent in direction across common CBS definitions. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/olympique-marcel/OpenGNS

AI.tldr: 发布OpenGNS数据集（400+条GNS测量轨迹，覆盖ResNet、GPT、DiT，11M–1B参数，muP下批量大小与学习率扫描），发现GNS如"训练温度"在等效loss下跨规模稳定，且其与临界批大小的关系存在任务相关偏差。
AI.motivation: 梯度噪声尺度（GNS）可近似临界批大小（CBS），虽在前沿模型技术报告中出现，但缺乏跨现代架构的公开测量数据集，阻碍系统研究。
AI.method: 构建并公开OpenGNS数据集，涵盖三个领域：ResNet图像分类、GPT自回归语言建模、DiT图像生成；模型11M–1B参数，在Maximal Update Parameterization（muP）下进行密集批大小与学习率扫描；基于该数据研究GNS对超参、规模、训练进程的依赖及其与CBS的关系。
AI.result: GNS表现为一致的"训练温度"，在muP下等效loss处跨模型规模稳定；GNS与CBS关系存在任务依赖偏差——分类任务倾向高估CBS，生成任务倾向低估，且在常见CBS定义下方向一致。
AI.conclusion: OpenGNS填补了GNS跨架构公开数据的空白，揭示GNS的规模稳定特性及与CBS的任务依赖偏差，为超参迁移与批大小选择提供实证基础。

title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
summary: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. The loop consists of three steps: (1) User-driven evaluation lets simulated users raise their requirements as issues while they work with the harness over multiple turns. (2) Team-based modification implements those requirements as generalizable changes rather than task-specific patches. (3) Requirement-driven selection merges a change only when it resolves a verified requirement and passes review. Empirically, on held-out tasks, AHE-Beta raises pass@1 from 21.9% to 33.3% while using 40.8% fewer tokens than Base Harness, and achieves higher pass@1 than Claude Code, Meta-Harness, and AHE. In a blind human A/B test, real users prefer AHE-Beta in 31 of 48 valid pairs and rate it higher on all five dimensions, matching the directional preference of the user simulator. The human A/B results show that AHE-Beta achieves its goal of aligning harness evolution with real-world user requirements. Without further evolution, the gains transfer to GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with pass@1 improvements of 15.8% and 5.3% over Base Harness. Together, these results show that requirement-centered harness evolution is a more general method for improving agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: AHE-Beta提出以需求为中心的框架演化循环，包含用户驱动评估、团队式修改、需求驱动选择三步，在留出任务上把pass@1从21.9%提升到33.3%并减少40.8%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有框架（harness）演化方法忽视隐式需求与交互需求，且依赖单一演化智能体、以基准分数作为选择标准，容易产出狭窄补丁并陷入基准特定的局部最优。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta)三阶段循环：(1) 用户驱动评估——模拟用户在多轮交互中以issue形式提出需求；(2) 团队式修改——将需求实现为可泛化的改动而非任务特定补丁；(3) 需求驱动选择——仅在改动解决已验证需求并通过评审时才合并。
AI.result: 留出任务上pass@1由21.9%升至33.3%，token用量比Base Harness少40.8%，优于Claude Code、Meta-Harness与AHE；48组盲测人类A/B中31组偏好AHE-Beta，五个维度评分均更高，且与用户模拟器方向一致；无需再演化即可迁移至GLM-5.3与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，pass@1分别提升15.8%与5.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以需求为中心的框架演化是一个提升智能体能力更通用的方法，且能与真实用户偏好对齐。

title: ReSynth: Constructing Synthetic Supervision for Multi-Image Understanding
summary: People often understand the world by comparing different views of it. Vision-language models (VLMs), however, receive these views as separate images and still struggle to relate them. One problem is data. Training on these tasks requires groups of images with a known relationship: the same object from different viewpoints, or the same scene before and after a change. Such examples are hard to collect at scale from existing photo collections. We introduce ReSynth, which turns single-image perception and controllable image generation into cross-image relational supervision. Localized editing produces before-and-after pairs, viewpoint generation produces multiple views of the same instance, and verified scene contents support comparisons of counts and attributes. ReSynth combines Qwen3-VL-8B's captioning, grounding, and counting capabilities with Qwen-Image-2.1's generation and editing capabilities. It verifies single-image facts such as object counts and attributes, then combines these facts to construct multi-image QA. Using GRPO on approximately 440K ReSynth questions, with no real images during training, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B improve by 17.73 and 6.10 average points on BLINK, MUIRBench, and VLM2-Bench, while single-image performance is broadly preserved on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and improves across all four evaluated benchmarks on Qwen3-VL-8B. Notably, this supervision enables the 8B perception model itself to outperform Qwen3-VL-235B on BLINK and MUIRBench.

AI.tldr: ReSynth 将单图感知与可控图像生成转化为跨图像关系监督数据，用纯合成数据训练 VLM 提升多图关系理解能力。
AI.motivation: VLM 以独立图像方式接收多视角输入，难以关联比较不同视图；而此类训练数据（同物体多视角、变化前后对照）难以从现有图片库大规模收集。
AI.method: 结合 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 captioning/grounding/counting 与 Qwen-Image-2.1 的生成编辑能力：局部编辑生成前后对比对、视角生成生成同一实例多视图、验证过的场景内容支持计数与属性比较；先校验单图事实，再组合成多图 QA，最后用 GRPO 在约 44 万条问题上训练。
AI.result: 训练未使用任何真实图像；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 BLINK、MUIRBench、VLM2-Bench 上平均提升 17.73 与 6.10 分；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 单图性能基本保持，Qwen3-VL-8B 在四个评测基准上全部提升。
AI.conclusion: 该监督使 8B 感知模型在 BLINK 与 MUIRBench 上超过 Qwen3-VL-235B，说明高质量合成关系数据可替代真实图像大规模训练多图关系能力。

title: Tell Me How Sure You Are: Communicating Uncertainty in Auxiliary Evidence to Foundation Models
summary:
In many queries, the context information provided to generative foundation models, such as LLMs and VLMs, is inherently uncertain, including its representations of the physical world. While conventional prompting discards the associated uncertainty, this paper, for the first time in the literature, systematically demonstrates that communicating such uncertainty in context provides useful additional cues for downstream decisions and yields improvements across a wide range of settings.
  We formulate the decision-making problem as a zero-shot foundation model-assisted image classification task supported by auxiliary text-based characteristics. We choose this due to the availability of well-defined auxiliary properties, associated uncertainty, and unambiguous task correctness. Using five downstream foundation models across three datasets, we extensively evaluate uncertainty arising from both humans and learned models when observing or predicting auxiliary evidence. Across all settings, we find that communicating uncertainty substantially improves downstream LLM classification performance: macro-F1 improves up to $26.18$ percentage points compared to when the uncertainty information is not communicated.
  We further observe how the foundation models process such uncertainty information and find that auxiliary uncertainty contains predictive information about the correctness of downstream decisions. Together, these results establish uncertainty as useful contextual information and motivate more systematic consideration of uncertainty communication in future foundation-model inference pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地证明：在提示生成式基础模型（LLM/VLM）时，将上下文中辅助证据的不确定性一并传达，能为下游决策提供有用线索，在所有实验设置下显著提升零样本图像分类性能（macro-F1最高提升26.18个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 现实中给LLM/VLM的上下文（尤其对物理世界的表征）本质上是带有不确定性的，但传统提示方法通常直接丢弃这一不确定性信息，作者希望探究把不确定性显式传达给模型是否有益。
AI.method: 将决策问题形式化为"零样本基础模型辅助的图像分类"任务，由文本形式的辅助特征支撑（因其辅助属性、相关不确定性与任务正确性均有明确定义）。使用三个数据集上的五个下游基础模型，广泛评估来自人类观察与学习模型预测的辅助证据不确定性，并比较传达与不传达不确定性时的表现。
AI.result: 在所有设置下传达不确定性都带来显著提升，macro-F1相比不传达时最多提升26.18个百分点；进一步分析发现基础模型确实会利用这类不确定性信息，且辅助不确定性本身包含对下游决策正确性的预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性应被视为有用的上下文信息，未来基础模型推理流程应更系统地考虑不确定性的传达。

title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
summary: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8% on ChestXray14, CheXpert, PadChest, RSNA, and SIIM-ACR, respectively. Relative to the matched global-only controls, the findings and relation objectives yield consistent gains across the evaluated datasets. These results demonstrate the practical value of treating observed and unobserved report concepts differently during medical image--text representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种医学图像-文本表示学习框架，通过在全局图文对齐之外引入观察掩码的发现监督和 affirmed 概念上的软关系目标，区分报告中的肯定发现、明确否定与未提及概念，在3个CT和5个胸片基准上取得较强宏AUROC。
AI.motivation: 放射报告区分肯定发现、明确否定和未提及概念，但传统全局图像-报告对比学习将这些不同证据状态压缩为单一研究级目标，损失了细粒度监督信息。
AI.method: 框架结合对称全局图像-报告对齐、观察掩码的发现监督、以及针对肯定报告概念的软关系目标；文本衍生的发现原型与局部视觉token对齐，不确定与未提及概念被排除在直接发现标签之外。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE、RAD-ChestCT、INSPECT上宏AUROC为73.6%、66.5%、68.8%；在ChestXray14、CheXpert、PadChest、RSNA、SIIM-ACR上为80.2%、91.4%、78.5%、86.5%、90.8%。相对匹配的全局-only对照，发现与关系目标在各数据集上均带来一致增益；并有多项检索、定位、鲁棒性、校准与逐发现分析。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式区分报告中已观察与未观察概念，在医学图像-文本表示学习中具有实际价值。

title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
summary: Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. Predictive performance and training time identify useful operating points and the limits of compression.

AI.tldr: 提出VAFL垂直分析联邦学习框架，用正则化最小二乘在固定本地表示上拟合分类/回归头，并给出全维等价求解与两种降宽策略，在五个基准上评估精度-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 智能服务需要多机构互补信息，但无法集中原始数据，需垂直联邦学习；同时希望避免对本地表示做联合微调的高昂开销，仅在固定表示上高效完成下游预测任务。
AI.method: VAFL框架：代理辅助的受保护计算流程，支持两方与多方协作；采用正则化最小二乘拟合分类与回归头；提出全维等价求解，将分块因子直接作用于目标矩阵以避免构造完整逆矩阵；研究两种降宽策略——(1) 本地谱投影+系数提升（压缩预测空间），(2) 全维本地拟合+低秩跨方修正（保留协作子空间外的本地成分），并给出其代数性质与计算范围分析。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上实验，展示两种降宽策略的精度-成本权衡，验证其与多种冻结骨干网络的兼容性；预测性能与训练时间揭示了有效操作点及压缩的极限。
AI.conclusion: VAFL在无需联合微调的条件下实现高效的垂直联邦分类/回归，全维等价求解降低拟合开销，两种降宽策略各有适用场景，为联邦场景下精度与成本折中提供了可解释的代数与实验依据。

title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出"策略诱导能力区域"视角，将稀疏奖励的长程智能体RL分解为"到达更可解状态"和"从该状态完成任务"两个耦合子问题，用配对优势与渐进式逆向到前向课程解决，在ALFWorld/WebShop上大幅领先。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务上用稀疏终端奖励做RL时，信用分配与探索都很困难；现有方法难以在目标遥远时获得有效学习信号。
AI.method: 定义"策略诱导能力区域"（当前策略能可靠完成任务的起始状态集合）。边界附近只需少量动作即可到达更可解状态，据此将长程学习分解为两子问题：1) 配对优势（paired advantages）分别提供"到达更可解状态"和"从该状态完成任务"的信号；2) 渐进式逆向到前向课程——沿成功参考轨迹向后扩展能力区域，再通过在线策略探索扩展到偏离参考的状态。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，两个模型尺寸均优于竞争性智能体RL方法；Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 成功率分别为 ALFWorld 90.1%/96.1%，WebShop 80.2%/82.6%。
AI.conclusion: 以能力区域边界为切入点、配合配对优势与双向课程，可有效缓解长程稀疏奖励RL的信用分配与探索难题，并在多个基准和模型规模上取得一致提升。

title: Choosing Supervised Post-Processing for Frozen Person Detectors: Information, Object Changes, and Complete Cost
summary: A frozen detector computes hypotheses that can support better final outputs through supervised post-processing. Choosing a readout requires knowing which available information improves detection and what its processing costs. We compare candidate scores, class distributions, geometry, native-set summaries and adapted neighborhood meta classification under common candidate, supervision and operating-point conditions. On 320 held-out CrowdHuman images, adding native-set context to a 97-dimensional readout yields 275 more matches and 96 more unmatched predictions. On a separate 319-image cohort, Full100 matches 6004 objects,versus 5848 for source-selected raw WBF and 6002 for a MetaDetect-style adaptation. Its gain over raw contains 300 added and 144 lost discoveries. After execution-equivalent optimization, Full100 and the meta-statistics readout both take approximately 95 ms per complete warm request on a fixed 64-image workload. Source-frozen transfer gives positive point results on 223 MOT17Det frames from seven sequences, while the main MIAP result shows no improvement. The study supports using sufficiently informative output readouts while retaining optimized meta classification as a competitive option. It also shows why feature dimension and net detection gain alone are unreliable guides to adoption.

AI.tldr: 对比多种"读出"后处理方案（候选分数、类分布、几何、原生集合摘要、邻域元分类），在统一条件下做等价优化执行，讨论特征维度/净增益作为采纳依据的不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 冻结检测器产生的候选假设可通过监督式后处理改善最终输出，但选择读出层需知道哪些可用信息真正提升检测、以及其处理代价。
AI.method: 在同一候选集、监督与工作点条件下比较候选分数、类分布、几何、原生集合摘要（native-set context）与适配的邻域元分类；加入执行等价优化以便公平比较耗时；并在 CrowdHuman、MOT17Det、MIAP 上评估。
AI.result: 320 张 CrowdHuman 留出图：在 97 维读出中加入原生集合上下文后多得 275 个匹配、多 96 个未匹配预测；另 319 图队列上 Full100 匹配 6004 个目标，源选择原始 WBF 为 5848，MetaDetect 式适配为 6002，Full100 相对原始的增益含 300 新增与 144 丢失。等价执行优化后，Full100 与元统计读出约 95 ms/完整热请求（64 图固定负载）。源冻结迁移在 7 序列 223 帧 MOT17Det 上点结果为正向，但 MIAP 主结果无提升。
AI.conclusion: 支持使用信息量充分的输出读出，同时保留优化后的元分类作为有竞争力的选项；特征维度和净检测增益本身不能作为采纳依据。

title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化（MFBO），将专家关于LF模型缺失物理的定性知识经LLM转化为设计对的残差修正判断，并用成对高斯过程构成知识基，与数值MF模型结合，在锂离子电池设计中将传统MFBO的遗憾AUC降低61%。
AI.motivation: MFBO依赖LF-HF差异学习，但HF数据稀缺时偏差难以从数值数据中学到，尤其当LF模型省略的物理效应随设计变化时；而专家往往已知缺失何种物理及其影响增长的条件，现有MF模型无法直接利用这类定性知识。
AI.method: 在传统MF模型上增加"知识基"：由专家描述被省略的物理，让LLM判断两个设计中哪一个需要更大的有符号残差修正，再用成对高斯过程将这些判断转化为基函数；HF数据用于校准该基的贡献与符号，避免盲目信任知识。
AI.result: 锂离子电池设计问题上，遗憾AUC较传统MFBO降低61%；独立变化知识质量与LLM选择的对照实验表明，决定加速效果的是知识质量而非LLM选择；知识级消融进一步量化了每条知识陈述的贡献。
AI.conclusion: LLM解读的专家知识可作为MFBO中与数值数据互补的信息源，在HF数据稀缺时有效加速搜索。

title: F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
summary: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. Trained once on only 200 examples and deployed with a growing experience library, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on MolmoSpaces and RoboLab without any training on RoboLab: over native Cosmos 3 Nano, it raises success by 12.0 pp and 10.8 pp, reduces steps to success by 12.2% and 11.3%, and cuts regressions by 57%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 F³ 框架，通过 Form（形式化）、Fit（适配）、Fusion（融合）三个环节决定世界-动作模型（WAM）应如何从自身经验中获益，仅用 200 个样本训练即在 MolmoSpaces 与 RoboLab 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 已部署的世界-动作模型（WAM）要持续提升，必须善用自身经验。但现有方法把检索到的 rollout 或示范作为上下文喂给策略，反而常把原本已解决的任务变为失败。因此需要回答：什么样的经验才对 WAM 有用？作者认为经验的价值不在于源 rollout 是否成功，而在于"存什么、何时用、注入何处"。
AI.method: 提出 F³，由三部分组成：Form——将成功与失败的 rollout 统一压缩为简短且经验证的操作记录；Fit——训练策略读取记录并预测该记录何时有帮助；Fusion——将记录中的图像、文本与动作以 prefix 和 action prior 的形式注入策略。仅在 200 个样本上训练一次，部署时配合不断增长的经验库。
AI.result: 在 MolmoSpaces 和 RoboLab 上均达 SOTA，且未在 RoboLab 上训练。相比原生 Cosmos 3 Nano，成功率分别提升 12.0 与 10.8 个百分点，成功所需步数减少 12.2% 与 11.3%，回退（regression）减少 57%。
AI.conclusion: 经验的价值取决于使用方式而非来源成败；将失败经验也纳入统一记录、并让策略学会判断经验何时有益、再以 prefix 与 action prior 注入，可实现轻量训练下的持续自我改进与强跨环境泛化。

title: Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes
