summary: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: FreeForward4D 用统一度量坐标系的视觉先验替代数据集标注，实现仅需 RGB 视频的前馈 4D 驾驶场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 4D 重建方法依赖数据集提供的相机参数、LiDAR 深度或 3D 框标注，难以用于无标注驾驶视频；而预训练视觉模型的预测（多视窗短窗口、独立尺度与坐标系，单目深度仅单图度量）几何上互不一致。
AI.method: 将重叠的预测窗口与单目度量深度对齐进行标定，并跨时间配准到单一坐标系；在该几何上跨相机做 3D 2D 轨迹关联；目标运动采用分层运动建模，即共享物体速度加局部高斯修正，训练与推理均只用 RGB 视频。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 上达到 27.66 dB PSNR 和 0.836 SSIM，无需尺度对齐即可恢复度量尺度相机与深度；全图 PSNR 超过依赖标注的 STORM、SLARM-F、UFO、DGGT、StreetForward，并在 8 秒窗口上取得最佳 RGB 保真度；仅用 RGB 微调可迁移至 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2。
AI.conclusion: 统一度量标定的视觉先验足以替代数据集标注用于前馈 4D 重建，实现标注-free 的驾驶场景仿真，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
summary: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same tweets, and that of BERT-base reaches 70.0 $\pm$ 0.5% with order selection and 63.7 $\pm$ 1.2% with rule selection against 77.8%. The circuit needs no multiplier and no weight traffic, and its exported hardware description reproduces it bit for bit. By a synthesis-based estimate it classifies one tweet in about 1-2 $μ$s (DistilGPT2) and 3-5 $μ$s (BERT) on an FPGA card and in 5-9 $μ$s on a palm-sized board whose module draws 7.5-15 W, two to three orders of magnitude faster than the network on a GPU at batch 1 (measured, 0.9-2.6 ms for DistilGPT2 including an optimised CUDA-graph baseline), at a cost of 8.5 (DistilGPT2) and 8.6 (BERT) points of gold accuracy for the synthesised seed-0 circuits.

AI.tldr: 将训练好的注意力网络（含注意力）整体转化为硬逻辑谓词电路，在保持可比精度的同时实现无乘法器、无权重搬运的FPGA级超低延迟推理。
AI.motivation: GPU上batch-1推理延迟高（0.9-2.6 ms），注意力网络难以在边缘/嵌入式硬件上高效部署；希望把软网络替换为可综合、位精确复现的硬逻辑电路，以换取数量级的速度与功耗优势。
AI.method: 以"忒修斯之船"式逐块替换：从输出层往上，每次将一块网络替换为0/1谓词电路（每单元为token上的谓词，谓词间映射为最小化真值表），冻结已替换部分后让剩余软部分重新适配。短真值表（如query码×key码之积）精确最小化，宽特征转换用容噪最小化转成蕴含规则。注意力选择有两种形式：按整数分数的行内比较（order selection）与学习规则（rule selection）。两者仅用训练集、且仅用教师分类正确的样本拟合，以模仿正确的教师行为。
AI.result: TweetEval-emotion上，DistilGPT2完整电路测试金标准准确率66.5±1.3%（order）/57.4±2.5%（rule），教师74.7%，同数据词袋64.0%；BERT-base为70.0±0.5%/63.7±1.2%，教师77.8%。电路无乘法器、无权重流量传输，导出硬件描述可逐位复现。综合估算：FPGA卡上每条推文约1-2 μs（DistilGPT2）/3-5 μs（BERT），掌心大小板卡（模块功耗7.5-15 W）上5-9 μs，比GPU batch-1快2-3个数量级；代价是种子0电路精度下降8.5（DistilGPT2）和8.6（BERT）个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 注意力网络可被完整编译为纯布尔谓词电路，在精度小幅下降的前提下获得2-3个数量级延迟与能效收益，并具可综合、位精确的硬件实现能力。

title: HHW-Ego: DSLR-Quality Enhancement for Multi-Source Wearable Ego Imaging
summary: Wearable ego-centric images are now in high demand for scenarios ranging from daily smart glass usage to embodied intelligence. But the image quality is far behind smart phone due to the lacking paired high-quality reference images and the dedicated enhancement systems. To solve this, a customized degradation pipeline is designed to generate paired samples matching wearable camera images, boosting the upper limit of enhancement performance. Besides a two-stage enhancement framework is further built: first, tuning an efficient model on the paired dataset to enhance real wearable images; second, using hyperspectral data to refine color temperature for better quality. Moreover we present HHW-Ego, a multi-source paired dataset integrating with Hyperspectral, High-dynamic range and Wearable Ego-centric data, which includes 5,000 image groups spanning indoor/outdoor and day/night scenes. On held-out paired data, Stage-1 fine-tuning improves PSNR, SSIM, Lab distance, and LPIPS for Real-ESRGAN and PFT-SR. On real wearable images, no-reference metrics, human preference, gamut analysis, and visual comparisons characterize the effects of Stage 2.

AI.tldr: 提出定制退化管线与两阶段增强框架，并发布融合高光谱、HDR与可穿戴第一视角数据的HHW-Ego配对数据集，用于提升可穿戴图像质量。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴第一视角图像需求旺盛，但因缺乏配对高质量参考图像与专用增强系统，画质远落后于手机。
AI.method: 设计定制退化管线生成与可穿戴相机图像匹配的配对样本；构建两阶段增强框架：第一阶段在配对数据上微调高效模型以增强真实可穿戴图像，第二阶段利用高光谱数据细化色温；并构建HHW-Ego多源配对数据集（高光谱+HDR+可穿戴第一视角，5000组图像，覆盖室内外昼夜）。
AI.result: 在留出配对数据上，Stage-1微调提升了Real-ESRGAN与PFT-SR的PSNR、SSIM、Lab距离和LPIPS；在真实可穿戴图像上，通过无参考指标、人偏好、色域分析与视觉对比刻画了Stage-2效果。
AI.conclusion: 退化管线+两阶段增强+多源配对数据集可有效提升可穿戴第一视角图像质量，高光谱辅助的色温细化进一步改善真实图像观感。

title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. On controlled sequence tasks, the resulting model exhibits rapid learning despite remaining strictly within a standard RNN formulation. Our results demonstrate that RNN performance is governed by the evolution and preservation of temporal rank, and suggest that mitigating gradient pathologies alone is insufficient without explicitly maintaining temporal capacity.

AI.tldr: 该文指出RNN的核心限制是隐藏状态动力学秩约束导致的信息瓶颈，而非传统认为的梯度消失/爆炸，并提出结构化高维状态动力学来保持时序可分性与输入到状态雅可比的非饱和。
AI.motivation: RNN因顺序不可并行及长程依赖难捕捉（常归因于梯度消失/爆炸）而被低估；作者认为存在一个被忽视的独立限制——由秩约束隐藏状态动力学引起的信息瓶颈，限制了随时间保留的独立输入方向数量，且该限制与梯度稳定性无关。
AI.method: 从输入到状态映射的秩角度定义时序容量，分析秩约束如何独立于梯度稳定性限制容量；进而提出结构化高维状态动力学，以保持时序可分性并防止输入到状态雅可比随时间饱和，且模型仍严格属于标准RNN框架。
AI.result: 在受控序列任务上，所得模型尽管保持标准RNN形式，仍表现出快速学习；表明RNN性能受时序秩的演化与保持所支配。
AI.conclusion: 单独缓解梯度病理不足以维持时序容量，必须显式保持时序秩；RNN的瓶颈应理解为秩约束导致的信息瓶颈。

title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
summary: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. The resulting accounting decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss, separating planning from fixed-role heuristics. Across forty paired routing anchors, five open-weight

AI.tldr: 论文提出"预算配对反事实审计"，通过固定公开证据与区域绑定、仅扰动剩余预算或任务参数，并将每个已获取的历史归于精确的续延价值，从而把答案准确率分解为逐步获取损失与终端决策损失。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体读取密集文档时须在有限观察预算下分配注意力，但传统"答案准确率"混同了三件不同的事：智能体看向何处、如何适应剩余读取、以及在停止观察后如何作答，因而无法区分规划能力与固定规则启发式。
AI.method: 引入预算配对反事实审计评估协议（budget-paired counterfactual audits）：保持公共证据与区域绑定不变，只扰动剩余预算或声明的任务参数；对每个获取历史计算精确的续延价值，并据此做会计分解，将期望准确率的损失拆分为步进式获取损失和终端决策损失。在四十个配对路由锚点、五种开放权重模型上评估。
AI.result: 通过该会计分解，可将因预算受限导致的期望准确率下降分别归因于获取阶段规划不当与终止后决策不完善；据摘要，实验覆盖40个配对路由锚点与五个开放权重模型（摘要在此处截断，未见具体数值结论）。
AI.conclusion: 准确的预算感知评估应把"看哪里/怎么适应/怎么答"解耦，而非只看最终答案正确率；预算配对反事实审计提供了一种可分解、可诊断的评估框架。

title: FlyVQA: Seeing Video Frame Interpolation Quality through Fly Eyes
summary: The ultimate ambition of visual quality assessment is to reproduce the neural computations of human vision and thereby achieve full alignment with human perception. However, the immense complexity of human visual circuitry makes this goal difficult to realize. Recently released fly visual connectomes provide a tractable biological starting point. Despite differences between fly and human vision, the fly's well-characterized motion pathways motivate us to investigate their potential for assessing the perceptual impact of temporal distortions. In this paper, we use a shared, frozen fly visual circuit to perform full-reference quality assessment of frame-interpolated videos, whose artifacts can disrupt temporal consistency. Specifically, compound-eye sampling maps reference and distorted sequences into the circuit, while a connectome-aware readout quantifies discrepancies in cell-type-specific activity and excitatory--inhibitory synaptic dynamics. Reference-guided temporal pooling and a lightweight regression head integrate these differences into a quality score. Experiments across multiple interpolation methods demonstrate better agreement with human ratings than CNN, RNN, and Transformer baselines with comparable parameters, supporting a biologically grounded approach to perceptual quality modeling.

AI.tldr: 利用冻结的果蝇视觉连接组电路对帧插值视频做全参考质量评估，通过复眼采样、连接组感知读出与参考引导时序池化预测质量分数，性能优于同等参数量的CNN/RNN/Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉质量评估的终极目标是复现人类视觉的神经计算，但人脑视觉回路过于复杂；新发布的果蝇视觉连接组提供了可操作的生物学起点，其运动通路刻画充分，值得探究其评估时序失真感知影响的潜力。
AI.method: 共享且冻结的果蝇视觉电路；复眼采样将参考与失真序列映射入电路；连接组感知读出量化细胞类型特异性活动及兴奋—抑制突触动态差异；结合参考引导的时序池化与轻量回归头输出质量分。
AI.result: 在多种插值方法的实验中，与参数量相当的CNN、RNN、Transformer基线相比，该方法与人类主观评分的吻合度更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以生物学为基础构建感知质量模型，表明果蝇运动通路可用于评估时序失真（如帧插值伪影）的感知影响。

title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
summary: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve production-scale training and inference performance, but identifying effective optimization strategies and consistently translating local improvements into end-to-end gains remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 提出RSIBench-Infra，一个涵盖20个训练与推理任务、跨NVIDIA GPU与昇腾NPU（最高32卡）的端到端基础设施优化基准，评估agent能否在全栈（引擎/算子/指令）层面带来生产级性能提升。结果显示66.2%的任务实现经校验的>1.10×加速。
AI.motivation: 训练与推理基础设施效率是递归自我改进的实用组成；但现有agent驱动优化基准多聚焦单一软件层（如kernel），无法说明agent能否在生产负载下取得端到端性能收益。
AI.method: 构建RSIBench-Infra：20个任务，覆盖多种模型族与模态；部署规模达32卡，含NVIDIA GPU与Ascend NPU；agent从官方recipe派生的可运行基线出发，可跨引擎、算子、指令层修改软件栈；采用OCI镜像层提交协议保证可复现部署；独立评测在任务特定质量约束下测端到端性能。
AI.result: 全部任务结果中66.2%超过经校验的1.10×加速。
AI.conclusion: 当前agent已能提升生产规模训练与推理性能，但识别有效优化策略、并将局部改进稳定转化为端到端收益仍是难点。

title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
summary: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldRuler，用可执行 3D 规则图将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈闭环，实现用户自定义规则驱动的可定制交互世界生成，并构建 RuleVerse 数据集。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型需遵循超越真实物理的用户自定义规则以支持可定制玩法，但存在两大挑战：规则-状态持久化（规则定义、依赖与世界状态在存档/读档间保持一致）与规则到视觉实现（在被影响对象尚未可见时，准确将规则引起的改变落实到指定对象与属性上）。
AI.method: 1) 用可执行 3D 规则图组织规则定义、依赖与对象状态，支撑规则与状态的联合保存与恢复；2) 动态对象绑定将规则指定实体映射到视觉实例，并用存储状态从首次出现起约束生成；3) 引入对象属性状态替换与反事实重建训练，实现精确属性控制并减少对无关内容的干扰；4) 基于 GTA-V 与 Habitat 搭建自动数据采集标注流程，构建 RuleVerse 数据集（含规则先于对象可见生效的案例）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，WorldRuler 能在保存与加载过程中保持规则-状态一致性，并准确在指定对象与属性上实现规则效果。
AI.conclusion: 以规则图为核心的闭环框架可有效实现用户自定义规则的可视化世界生成，Rule-State 持久化与规则到视觉落实问题得到验证性解决。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Targets in Radiology Language-Image Pretraining
summary: CLIP-style contrastive image-text pretraining is widely used in radiology data, where each image is paired with one report and every other report in the batch is treated as a negative. Under this recipe, two failures appear, neither of which is systematically addressed by existing contrastive learning theory: zero-shot evaluation peaks then degrades while training loss keeps decreasing, and training fails to learn from large batches. We hypothesize the cause is structural rather than radiology-specific: many unpaired reports share clinical findings with a given image, so CLIP's paired-identity target is systematically biased, not merely noisy. To test this, we construct CLEVR-Radiology, a synthetic testbed that preserves only this overlapping-fact structure and reproduces both failures. With evidence that the structure is sufficient to reproduce the failures, we develop a target-misspecification theory that explains both failures from a single deterministic gradient bias amplified by batch size, and use it to motivate a minimal compatibility-based correction, CorLIP: text is treated as positive whenever its clinical assertions agree with the image, with no architecture changes. Beyond benchmark improvements, CorLIP largely removes the post-peak degradation, makes large-batch training succeed where it previously collapsed, substantially amplifies the gains from more data, and is the only configuration that remains stable up to B=2048. The correction transfers from chest X-ray to 3D CT modalities.

AI.tldr: 放射学CLIP预训练中零样本性能先升后降、大batch训练失效，根源是配对身份目标在"共享临床发现"结构下的系统性偏差；作者用合成数据CLEVR-Radiology验证该结构足以复现失败，提出目标误设理论（单一确定性梯度偏差随batch放大），并给出无需改架构的兼容性修正CorLIP。
AI.motivation: CLIP式对比学习把batch内其他报告当作负样本，但放射学中许多"未配对"报告与给定图像共享临床发现，因此配对身份目标是有系统性偏差而非仅噪声。现有对比学习理论未系统解释两种失败：零样本评估达峰后随训练损失下降而退化，以及大batch训练无法获益。
AI.method: 构造CLEVR-Radiology合成测试床，仅保留"重叠事实"结构以复现两种失败，验证该结构充分性；据此建立目标误设理论，从单一确定性梯度偏差（由batch size放大）解释两种失败；提出最小化的兼容性修正CorLIP：只要文本的临床断言与图像一致即视为正样本，不做架构改动。
AI.result: CLEVR-Radiology复现了两种失败，证明重叠事实结构充分；理论统一解释峰后退化与大batch失效。CorLIP在基准上提升，基本消除峰后退化，使大batch训练由崩溃转为成功，显著放大多数据收益，是唯一在B=2048仍稳定的配置，并从胸部X光迁移到3D CT。
AI.conclusion: 放射学对比预训练的失败源于固有的配对目标误设，而非领域特异噪声；基于临床一致性的正样本重定义是简单有效的通用修正，可跨模态迁移。

title: MINT: Meeting-time Indicators for Truncation in Multi-Step Off-Policy RL
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 81 pages, 40 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/seungyubhan/mint
summary: Many multi-step off-policy temporal-difference methods handle policy mismatch through products of per-step trace coefficients, leading to a trade-off between variance control and long-horizon signal. The maximum trace length consequently becomes a sensitive hyperparameter. We propose MINT (Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation), which replaces these products with a binary stopping indicator: one until coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, zero thereafter. At the true value function, the indicator's idempotence yields a variance bound governed by meeting-time survival. For practical implementation, a single sampled action provides a model-free surrogate for the stopping rule, requiring no transition model or mixing-time estimate. We derive separate sufficient conditions for contraction of the state-coupled operator and its practical surrogate under fixed-policy evaluation. On MuJoCo and DeepMind Control tasks, MINT outperforms the reported multi-step baselines; the main MuJoCo comparison uses a common cap without per-task cap-length tuning. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of MINT on Atari 100k, RWRL, and OGBench experiments; MINT adapts the backup horizon to reduce target variability relative to long fixed-horizon backups across tasks and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出 MINT，用二元“停止指示器”替代多步 off-policy TD 中逐步骤迹系数的连乘，以自适应截断回撤视野并控制方差。
AI.motivation: 多步 off-policy 时序差分方法通过连乘逐步迹系数处理策略不匹配，导致方差控制与长视野信号之间的权衡，最大迹长度成为敏感超参数。
AI.method: MINT（Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation）：用二元停止指示器替换迹系数连乘，行为轨迹与目标轨迹首次“相遇”前为 1、之后为 0；真值函数下指示器的幂等性给出由相遇时间生存率控制的方差界。实现上用单次采样动作作为无模型停止规则代理，无需转移模型或混合时间估计；并分别给出状态耦合算子及其实际代理在固定策略评估下的收缩充分条件。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 与 DeepMind Control 上优于所报告的多步基线，主实验使用统一上限而非逐任务调参；在 Atari 100k、RWRL、OGBench 上同样有效，MINT 能自适应回撤视野，相较固定长视野回撤降低目标方差。
AI.conclusion: MINT 以免调、无模型的相遇时间截断机制，缓解了多步 off-policy TD 的方差—长视野权衡，并在多类基准任务上验证了有效性与泛化性。

title: Predicting Process-Level Behavior: A Benchmarking Study
comment: Accepted as main track paper at International Conference on Process Mining (ICPM) 2027
summary: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) typically forecasts the future of individual process instances, hence operating on trace level. Process managers, however, typically operate on process level, e.g., when assigning staff or calculating KPIs. The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions. We answer this question through a comprehensive benchmarking study of two process-level prediction tasks: concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction. Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level. We assess which modeling paradigms are most suitable for predicting process-level behavior and whether existing trace-level PPM can be effectively repurposed for this task. Our results show substantial variation in performance across approaches. Notably, aggregated trace-level predictions cause errors to compound on process-level, reducing accuracy and highlighting process-level prediction as a distinct predictive task that warrants dedicated research.

AI.tldr: 该文通过大规模基准测试研究过程级预测任务（并发轨迹数预测与平均吞吐时间预测），发现现有轨迹级PPM聚合到过程级时误差会累积，过程级预测应作为独立任务专门研究。
AI.motivation: PPM研究主要聚焦轨迹（单实例）级预测，而流程管理者实际在过程级做决策（如人员配置、KPI计算）。现有方法能否有效支撑过程级决策尚不清楚，PPM研究此前也未关注过程级预测。
AI.method: 对两个过程级预测任务（并发轨迹预测、平均吞吐时间预测）开展综合基准测评，在合成与真实事件日志上比较统计方法、机器学习方法、基础模型、业务流程仿真，以及将既有轨迹级PPM预测聚合到过程级的方法。
AI.result: 各方法性能差异显著。聚合轨迹级预测会导致误差在过程级累积，降低准确度。
AI.conclusion: 过程级预测是一个独特的预测任务，需要专门研究，不能简单沿用轨迹级PPM的聚合方案。

title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. However, existing work focuses mainly on what the agent can achieve with cloud-hosted models. What a local deployment costs in power, energy, tokens and time on real simulation tasks, and what its choices trade against one another, has received little quantitative investigation under comparable conditions. To address this gap, a systematic evaluation framework is presented in this paper. It applies locally served models to agentic power electronics tasks, from the converter level to the system level, and measures their power, energy, token and time costs. Based on these measurements, the capability boundary of a local agent on such tasks and the cost per solved task are characterized. The results are expected to provide practical insight for the use of agentic AI in power electronics and the power systems it serves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个系统评估框架，将本地部署的模型用于电源电子代理式任务，量化其功耗、能耗、token与时间成本，刻画本地代理能力边界及单位解题成本。
AI.motivation: 代理式AI正用于电源电子仿真闭环，但对涉密/出口管制等无法上云的组织须本地部署；此时代理成为本地设备的电力负载，其功率、能耗、token与时间成本及权衡关系缺乏可比条件下的定量研究（现有工作多关注云端模型。
AI.method: 构建系统评估框架，在本地服务模型上执行从变换器级到系统级的代理式电源电子任务，测量功率、能量、token与时间消耗，并据此分析能力边界与每解一题成本。
AI.result: （摘要未给出具体数值）预期刻画本地代理在任务上的能力边界，并量化每个已解任务的成本及其在不同指标间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 为电源电子及其服务的电力系统中代理式AI的实际使用提供可操作的实践洞见，尤其针对本地部署的成本-能力权衡。

title: Semi-Supervised GAN-Based Segmentation of CTPA Scans for Pulmonary Emboli Boundary Extraction
comment: 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a pulmonary vascular disease associated with high morbidity and mortality, where delayed diagnosis can be fatal. While computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the clinical gold standard for PE detection, interpreting these scans manually is time-consuming and error-prone. In this work, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation method, employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to leverage large pools of unlabeled CTPA scans. The proposed method addresses more effectively the challenges of CTPA image segmentation than previous methods by employing the dice loss and the cross-entropy loss to tackle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA scans, the feature matching loss to encourage the generator to produce anatomically plausible segmentation maps that are indistinguishable from ground truth, as well as the self-training loss to reinforce learning from highly-confident pseudo-labeled samples. The experimental evaluation on a publicly available dataset shows that the proposed method maintains accurate segmentation, despite a limited number of labeled CTPA scans. with a Dice coefficient of 88.75% and a 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of 1.74, outperforming fully supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于GAN的半监督肺栓塞(PE)分割方法，利用大量无标注CTPA扫描，结合Dice/交叉熵损失、特征匹配损失与自训练损失，在有限标注下实现高精度分割。
AI.motivation: 肺栓塞是高风险肺部血管疾病，延误诊断可致命；CTPA是临床金标准，但人工判读耗时且易出错。标注数据稀缺，亟需能在有限标注下有效利用大量无标注CTPA扫描的分割方法。
AI.method: 采用生成对抗网络的半监督分割框架。针对CTPA高度类不平衡，使用Dice损失与交叉熵损失；用特征匹配损失促使生成器产生与真实标注难以区分的、解剖上合理的分割图；用自训练损失从高置信度伪标签样本中强化学习。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，尽管标注CTPA扫描数量有限，仍保持准确分割，Dice系数达88.75%，HD95为1.74，优于全监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效克服CTPA分割中的挑战，在标注数据有限条件下优于全监督基线，为PE自动检测提供可行方案。

title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
summary: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验运动扩散模型中是否真的存在"隐藏"的物理知识。控制读出方式后，模型自身估计已在平衡与滞空上基本追平各层激活，唯跳落速率在去噪早期确有约0.08的R²增益，Wan 2.1视频模型中经一个固定非线性后也可读出。
AI.motivation: 此前研究称视频扩散模型"知道得比展现的多"，认为激活比输入/输出更易解码物理属性。但扩散模型的输出本就由其激活计算而来，这种比较实际上只衡量了读出的难易，并未回答模型是否真的隐藏了知识。作者希望在物理量可精确计算的运动扩散模型上严格检验这一问题。
AI.method: 以MDM（两个检查点）与MotionDiffuse为对象，在采样轨迹上记录每一层的激活，并计算每个中间估计的物理属性（平衡、滞空、跳落速率）。在统一调参的读出设置下，将各层读出的结果与模型自身估计进行对比，并设置正对照以验证检测灵敏度；同时考察模型无需训练即可标记漂浮样本的能力，并在Wan 2.1视频模型的干净潜变量上测试线性探针与固定非线性后的可读性。
AI.result: 在统一调参下，平衡与滞空上加入层最多只带来0.01的提升（正对照显示该量级可被检出），说明估计已基本追平。跳落速率是唯一明确例外：去噪早期MDM各层可提供约0.08（重拟合下达0.11）的R²增益，且随采样推进而消退；MotionDiffuse上该增益较小且不稳健。模型估计可无训练地标记漂浮样本，但提前中止仅节省不到十分之一的算力。Wan 2.1的干净潜变量中线性探针无法读出的合理性，在经过一个固定非线性后变得可读。
AI.conclusion: "模型隐藏物理知识"这一说法在很大程度上是读出方式造成的假象；除跳落速率在去噪早期的有限场景外，运动扩散模型的自身估计已包含大部分可读物理信息。视频模型中的"隐藏知识"可能更多源于读出能力的限制而非模型内部的知识差距。

title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
summary: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DrawScore，用三视图投影+饱和惩罚实现局部误差敏感的CAD生成评价指标。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成评价指标（volumetric IoU、Chamfer Distance、surface F-score）几乎不惩罚仅占零件体积或表面积很小比例的局部错误，如孔位置错、槽开错面，而这类错误对制造至关重要。
AI.method: 将现有指标统一表示为积分形式，分析出局部误差权重按其尺寸的(k+q)次幂衰减（k为积分域维度，q由惩罚函数决定）。据此提出DrawScore：把模型投影为含可见线与隐藏线的三视图（类似工程图），沿投影曲线施加饱和惩罚，使局部误差权重仅线性衰减。
AI.result: 受控实验验证了预测的衰减阶数；在现有CAD生成智能体输出上，DrawScore能揭示被IoU评为近乎完美的输出中的错误；作为强化学习奖励可提升生成质量；在图纸到CAD生成任务中可作无3D真值、无需额外奖励模型的测试时验证器。
AI.conclusion: DrawScore是一种对局部细节敏感的CAD生成评价指标，兼具评价、强化学习奖励与测试时验证三种用途。

title: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
comment: Accepted at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS), Edinburgh, United Kingdom, October 6-9, 2026. Awarded one of 2026 Ada Lovelace Awardees for Excellent Paper Submissions to ACS
summary: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer's behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model's self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"审查者价值"的元认知校准理论：人类审查者对人机协作决策的价值由置信度与判断正确性的对齐（校准）决定，而非活动量、速度、一致性或资历。基于某AI辅助会计系统6个月生产数据（541,621条审查事件、483名审查者）验证五条理论主张。
AI.motivation: 在模型能力日益增强的人机协作决策场景中，究竟什么样的审查者仍能增加价值尚不清楚。既有评估依赖活动量、速度、一致率、资历等行为指标，但这些指标是否真实反映审查者价值缺乏理论界定与实证检验。
AI.method: 构建"审查者价值特质的理论"（trait theory），提出五条可检验主张：(1)价值由校准而非活动/速度/一致性/资历决定；(2)校准在行为遥测中留下可观测痕迹；(3)这些痕迹单独不具诊断力——校准专家的"快速、低修改"特征与自信新手无法区分，须以最终结果作为门控；(4)人类校准与模型自我知识是同一构念，联合系统应逐项让位于校准更优的一方；(5)个体校准只能在单次判断之上层面被因果识别。以AI辅助会计系统6个月生产窗口进行实证检验。
AI.result: (1)纯行为"专家画像"会颠覆真相：将过度自信群体（更正存活率5.2%）评分高于真正专家（99.2%）；(2)审查者质量随资历基本不变，说明该特质并非在岗习得；(3)将区分好坏审查者的同一校准逻辑应用于模型，可将92.5%的人类工作量集中于真实错误。
AI.conclusion: 审查者价值应重新定义为元认知校准，而非行为活跃度或经验积累；行为信号须与结果门控结合才能诊断，且该逻辑可迁移至模型侧以优化人机分工。理论须承认边界：在多数投票聚合机制下，个体因果价值不可识别。

title: STAR++: A Physical-Aware Benchmark and Framework for Astronomical Super-Resolution across Multiple Filters
summary: Astronomical super-resolution (ASR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution star fields from low-resolution telescope observations across multiple filters for astrophysical analysis. However, developing a physics-aware ASR framework faces two challenges: 1) Data view: no large-scale benchmark supports field-level ASR, especially on unseen filters. 2) Method view: Existing ASR methods often fail to preserve stellar flux across spatial resolutions. Moreover, ASR requires reconstructing high-frequency components, including accurate star locations and profiles, making it more ill-posed than natural-image SR. To tackle these problems, we introduce STAR++, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 1.7 million flux-consistent image pairs across 36 filters, derived from Hubble Space Telescope (HST) observations. STAR++ uses a flux-preserving data generation pipeline to ensure photometric consistency across resolutions and provides the Flux Error (FE) metric to evaluate ASR models from a physical perspective. To address method-level challenges, we propose a Flux-Invariant Super-Resolution Plus (FISR++) model that generalizes to unseen filters while accurately reconstructing flux-consistent high-resolution images. Beyond the flux-preserving modules, FISR++ introduces two novel components. Specifically, a Filter-Aware Adapter (FAA) incorporates filter metadata to adapt image representations to varying spectral and optical conditions. In addition, a Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss (SADL) models spatial ambiguity as pixel-shift uncertainty, mitigating the smoothing of learned conditional mean reconstructions caused by this ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FISR++ consistently outperforms existing ASR methods in reconstruction quality and flux accuracy, while generalizing to unseen filters, highlighting its effectiveness for photometrically faithful ASR.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出大规模基准 STAR++（约170万流量一致图像对、36个滤镜）和通量不变超分模型 FISR++，通过滤镜感知适配器与空间歧义解耦损失，实现跨未见滤镜的通量保真天文超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 天文超分（ASR）需要跨滤镜从低分辨率望远镜观测重建高分辨率星场，但存在两大障碍：数据层面缺乏支持场级ASR的大规模基准，尤其在未见滤镜上；方法层面现有ASR难以在空间分辨率变化时保持恒星通量，且需重建星点位置与轮廓等高频成分，比自然图像超分更病态。
AI.method: 数据侧构建 STAR++：基于HST观测、约170万流量一致图像对、36个滤镜，采用保通量数据生成流程保证跨分辨率光度一致性，并提出通量误差（FE）指标从物理角度评估。方法侧提出 FISR++：在保通量模块基础上，引入滤镜感知适配器（FAA）利用滤镜元数据适配不同光谱与光学条件，以及空间歧义解耦损失（SADL）将空间歧义建模为像素位移不确定性，缓解条件均值重建的过度平滑。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FISR++ 在重建质量和通量精度上均持续优于现有ASR方法，并能泛化到未见滤镜。
AI.conclusion: FISR++ 结合 STAR++ 基准，展示了光度忠实的天文超分可行性，为物理感知ASR提供了数据、指标与模型的一体化方案。

title: Semantic-aware Contrasting with Explicitly Disentangled Representations for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of AI-generated videos (AIGVs) has raised critical concerns about content authenticity. Existing benchmarks suffer from a fundamental limitation: real and fake videos are often collected or generated from different semantic distributions. As a result, detectors may rely on spurious correlations involving objects, scenes, or actions rather than intrinsic artifacts introduced by generative models. To this end, we introduce SAVGE, a large-scale semantically aligned AIGV detection dataset comprising 2,369,822 videos, including 424,115 real videos and 1,945,707 generated videos. SAVGE organizes samples into real-fake semantic groups by using captions paired with real videos as prompts for text-to-video generation, thereby providing both group-level correspondence and textual semantic anchors. Based on SAVGE, we further propose Explicit Disentangling and Semantic-aware Contrasting (EDSC), a model-agnostic training framework for learning artifact-focused representations with reduced semantic interference. EDSC first extracts and aligns visual semantic features with textual representations, and then explicitly suppresses semantic information in the artifact branch while contrasting real and fake samples within each semantic group. By integrating caption-guided semantic supervision with intra-group contrastive learning in a two-phase optimization strategy, EDSC encourages detectors to capture generation-related cues under matched semantic conditions. Extensive experiments on SAVGE and GenVideo demonstrate that EDSC improves most evaluated backbone-metric combinations, enhances robustness under challenging evaluation settings, and strengthens cross-dataset generalization. These results highlight the importance of semantic alignment in AIGV detection and validate explicit semantic-artifact disentanglement as an effective strategy for robust detector learning.

AI.tldr: 提出语义对齐的大规模AI生成视频检测数据集SAVGE及模型无关训练框架EDSC，通过显式解耦语义与伪影、组内对比学习提升检测鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGV检测基准中，真实与伪造视频往往来自不同语义分布，检测器易依赖物体、场景、动作等虚假相关性，而非生成模型固有的伪影，导致性能虚高、泛化差。
AI.method: 构建SAVGE数据集（236万视频，含42万真实、194万生成），用与真实视频配对的字幕作为文生视频提示，形成真-假语义组，提供组级对应与文本语义锚点；并提出EDSC框架：先将视觉语义特征与文本表示对齐，再在伪影分支显式抑制语义信息，同时在各语义组内对比真假样本，以两阶段优化整合字幕引导的语义监督与组内对比学习。
AI.result: 在SAVGE和GenVideo上的大量实验表明，EDSC在多数骨干-指标组合上均有提升，在困难评测设置下更鲁棒，并增强跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐对AIGV检测至关重要，显式语义-伪影解耦是学习鲁棒检测器的有效策略。

title: DyNA-Mixer: Decoupling Time and Topology for Scalable Dynamic Node Affinity Prediction
summary: Continuous-time dynamic graphs preserve the ordering, timing, and evolving strength of interactions that static snapshots discard, making dynamic graph mining essential for evolving systems such as recommender systems, trade networks, and transaction platforms. Research in this area has centered on dynamic link prediction, which forecasts only whether a future interaction will occur, whereas many applications also need its intensity. The dynamic node affinity prediction (DNAP) problem generalizes this task to continuous targets and full-candidate ranking, making it more broadly applicable but substantially harder. This raises two coupled difficulties: ranking requires a predictor expressive enough to capture both multi-scale temporal evolution and graph-wide collaborative patterns, yet running such a predictor over every source--destination pair is computationally prohibitive. We propose DyNA-Mixer, which decouples temporal forecasting from collaborative structure modeling. It adopts a multi-scale temporal predictor for pair-specific affinity evolution, constructs a Virtual Collaborative Graph that infers query-time relationships and aggregates trends from related interactions, and fuses the two through a gated residual mechanism. A sparsity-aware evaluation strategy further restricts expensive forecasting to pairs with recent non-zero affinities. Experiments on four Temporal Graph Benchmark datasets for the DNAP problem show that DyNA-Mixer achieves new state-of-the-art NDCG@10 on every dataset, including a 17.8\% relative test improvement over the strongest baseline on tgbn-token, the largest dataset.

AI.tldr: DyNA-Mixer 通过解耦"时间预测"与"协同结构建模"来解决动态节点亲和度预测问题，在四个TGB数据集上刷新NDCG@10 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 连续时间动态图蕴含交互的顺序、时间与强度信息。现有研究集中于动态链接预测（仅预测是否发生），但推荐、交易等实际应用还需预测交互强度。为此提出动态节点亲和度预测（DNAP），将任务推广到连续目标与全候选排序，更具适用性但更难：排序需要能同时刻画多尺度时序演化与全图协同模式的表达能力，而对所有源-目标对逐一预测计算代价过高。
AI.method: DyNA-Mixer 将时序预测与协同结构建模解耦：1）采用多尺度时序预测器刻画逐对的亲和度演化；2）构建"虚拟协同图"，在查询时推断关系并聚合相关交互的趋势；3）通过门控残差机制融合两路信息；4）提出稀疏感知的评估策略，将昂贵预测限制在近期亲和度非零的候选对上。
AI.result: 在四个 Temporal Graph Benchmark 数据集的DNAP任务上，DyNA-Mixer在全部数据集取得新的 SOTA（NDCG@10）；在最大的 tgbn-token 数据集上测试指标相对提升 17.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将强度预测与协同结构建模解耦、并以虚拟协同图聚合趋势，可在保证可扩展性的同时显著提升全候选排序性能，使动态图挖掘从"是否发生"走向"多强发生"。

title: CURVTON-205K: A Mask-Free Difficulty-Stratified Synthetic Dataset for Robust and Scalable Virtual Try-On
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. Project page: https://curvton2.github.io/curvton
summary: Recent advances in 2D virtual try-on (VTON) have largely focused on architectural innovation, yet robust performance in diverse real-world conditions remains challenging. We argue that failure modes in VTON, such as inaccurate occlusion handling, unconstrained poses, and poor coverage of under-represented garments and appearance factors, are tightly coupled to dataset design choices and long-tail data regimes. We present a scalable data generation pipeline that coordinates specialized editing and generation models with vision-language model (VLM) guidance to synthesize triplets without requiring parsing masks or dense-pose annotations. Using this pipeline, we create CURVTON-205K, a curated synthetic dataset of 205K triplets: source person, target garment, and corresponding try-on image. CURVTON-205K is explicitly designed to broaden coverage across garments, person appearance, poses, occlusions, and visual conditions. Additionally, CURVTON-205K is organized into three difficulty tiers, enabling controlled evaluation under varying levels of difficulty and supporting difficulty-aware experimentation. We analyze the dataset diversity and demonstrate its potential to improve try-on fidelity across four VTON architectures and its cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展数据生成流水线，构建205K三元组合成数据集CURVTON-205K，按三级难度组织，覆盖服饰、姿态与遮挡长尾情形，提升VTON保真度与跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有2D虚拟试穿研究多聚焦架构创新，但在真实复杂条件下鲁棒性不足；遮挡处理不准、姿态不受约束、欠代表服饰与外观覆盖差等失效模式，与数据集设计选择及长尾分布密切相关。
AI.method: 构建可扩展数据生成流水线：协调专用编辑模型与生成模型，并以视觉语言模型（VLM）引导，在无需解析掩码与稠密姿态标注的情况下合成"源人物—目标服饰—试穿结果"三元组；据此生成CURVTON-205K，显式扩展服饰、人物外观、姿态、遮挡与视觉条件的覆盖，并划分为三个难度层级。
AI.result: 数据集包含205K三元组；分析表明其多样性良好，在四种VTON架构上均能提升试穿保真度，并改善跨数据集泛化能力，且支持难度感知实验。
AI.conclusion: 数据设计是VTON鲁棒性的关键杠杆；无需掩码/姿态标注的VLM引导合成流水线可有效缓解长尾与复杂场景失效，CURVTON-205K为难度可控的评估与训练提供基础。

title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures. Accepted at the AXIOM Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code and pretrained model: https://github.com/lauritsf/icicle
summary: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. Our release samples synthetic training tasks on the fly and provides a freeze-thaw scheduler for Ray Tune and an ONNX model for inference without JAX or PyTorch.

AI.tldr: ICICLE：一种轻量、尺寸不变的在上下文学习曲线外推代理模型，以共享集合编码器处理可变数量超参数，仅128万参数即在Meta-Album上超越经元训练的Quick-Tune。
AI.motivation: FT-PFN依赖固定十槽超参数编码器，难以适应超参数数量变化且模型庞大。作者希望构建能接受任意数量类型化超参数、更小、无需在目标基准上预训练/元训练的学习曲线外推代理，用于freeze-thaw贝叶斯优化。
AI.method: 提出ICICLE：基于PFN的在上下文代理（in-context surrogate），用共享集合编码器（shared set encoder）支持可变超参数数；在大规模合成先验上训练，先验涵盖类型化超参数、重尾噪声、量化与发散。在线采样合成训练任务；发布Ray Tune的freeze-thaw调度器及无需JAX/PyTorch的ONNX推理模型。
AI.result: 模型仅1.28M参数（FT-PFN的8.7%）。在LCBench、PD1、TaskSet上平均regret轨迹与FT-PFN相近；在含33个超参数的86任务Meta-Album上，其平均归一化regret在overall与extended上均低于Quick-Tune，mini/micro无明显差异，且无需在Meta-Album相关任务上元训练（Quick-Tune则需）。
AI.conclusion: ICICLE证明轻量、尺寸不变的集合编码在上下文代理可在更少参数、无目标基准元训练下与FT-PFN/Quick-Tune相当或更优，具备实用性与易部署性（Ray Tune调度器+ONNX）。

title: R$^{3}$Sieve: Suppressing Unconditional Information from Attention to Answers for High-Resolution VQA
summary: High-resolution visual question answering (VQA) requires models to identify question-relevant small objects in high-resolution images and select the correct answer based on what they recognize, demanding fine-grained perception. Previous methods focus on obtaining better visual evidence (image crops), but obtaining it alone is insufficient, using it effectively is equally crucial. Visual evidence should therefore be utilized as effectively as possible throughout inference. We argue that small-target evidence is obscured by unconditional information that remains observable in subsequent processing even after the condition on which it should depend is removed. Such information hinders the effective use of small-target evidence. We propose R$^{3}$Sieve (Residual-Region-Response Sieve), a training-free framework. We divide inference into three stages---localization, cropping, and answering---and introduce distinct counterfactual references to suppress interference at each stage. During localization, the Shared-Subspace Canceller (SSC) uses a generic image description to construct a counterfactual reference and obtain question-relevant attention maps. During cropping, the Unique-Contribution Spotter (UCS) constructs counterfactual references from visual and non-visual features to identify distinctive, complementary crop regions. During answering, the Content-Aligned Voter (CAV) constructs an image-free branch to calibrate answer responses. Experiments on three high-resolution VQA benchmarks show that R$^{3}$Sieve achieves the highest overall accuracy among compared methods across diverse settings, improving base models by up to 21.5 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架R³Sieve，通过三阶段反事实参考抑制干扰，有效利用小目标视觉证据，在高分辨率VQA基准上平均最高提升21.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率VQA需识别问题相关的小目标。以往方法只关注获取更好的视觉证据（裁剪图像），但"获取"不等于"有效利用"。论文指出：小目标证据会被无条件的残留信息所掩盖——即使移除了其应依赖的条件，这些信息仍在后续处理中可见，从而阻碍证据的有效利用。
AI.method: 免训练框架R³Sieve，将推理分为定位、裁剪、回答三阶段，各阶段引入不同反事实参考以抑制干扰：(1)定位阶段用Shared-Subspace Canceller(SSC)以通用图像描述构建反事实参考，得到问题相关注意力图；(2)裁剪阶段用Unique-Contribution Spotter(UCS)从视觉与非视觉特征构建反事实参考，识别有区分性、互补的裁剪区域；(3)回答阶段用Content-Aligned Voter(CAV)构建无图像分支来校准答案响应。
AI.result: 在三个高分辨率VQA基准上，R³Sieve在多种设置下总体准确率均优于对比方法，相比基座模型最高提升21.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅在推理阶段以反事实参考逐阶段抑制残留干扰、充分榨取视觉证据，即可在无需训练的情况下显著提升高分辨率VQA性能，说明"如何有效利用证据"与"获取证据"同等重要。

title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.

AI.tldr: 从无动作视频学习潜在动作空间并做目标条件策略改进的LAPIS方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LAM流程只用行为克隆训练潜在策略，缺少显式策略改进目标；而标准离线RL无法直接迁移到学到的潜在动作空间：直接在潜在动作上最大化价值或用单峰策略拟合，会产生物理上不可执行的潜在动作，且潜在表征可能合并奖励不同的物理控制。
AI.method: 先推导策略改进能传递到解码执行、以及潜在最优与物理最优对齐的条件；据此提出LAPIS：将基于价值的策略改进锚定在观测到的状态-潜在动作转移上，并用条件流策略建模其多峰结构。
AI.result: 在多数任务上优于基线，视觉操作任务收益最明显；仅用1%动作标签仍有效，而对比方法基本崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 对潜在动作结构做条件分析后，接地于真实转移+多峰流策略可让离线RL在潜在空间可靠地完成策略改进并支持低标签数据。

title: Benchmarking Reasoning Reliability,Prior_Evidence Contrast,and Spectral Discrimination in Remote-Sensing Geological Image Interpretation
summary: Reliable lithology interpretation requires accurate geological recognition and reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Although Multimodal Large Language Models show promise in remote sensing, their reliability in geological interpretation remains unclear. We introduce HyGeoBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 10,000 questions based on hyperspectral imagery across three dimensions: reasoning reliability, prior_evidence contrast, and spectral discrimination. It covers ten task types, with both multiple-choice and open-ended response formats. Integrating hyperspectral satellite imagery with geological annotations and verified evidence, HyGeoBench examines reasoning errors, conflicts between geological priors and visual evidence, and cross-band inconsistencies. Evaluations reveal limitations in fine-grained recognition and evidence-grounded interpretation. To address these challenges, we propose HyGeoAgent, a tool-augmented framework integrating region observation, text knowledge retrieval, same-band image retrieval, and native PCA analysis through adaptive tool use. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, improving geological image interpretation across diagnostic dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出高光谱遥感地质解译诊断基准HyGeoBench（1万题、三维度），并针对发现的细粒度识别与证据接地缺陷提出工具增强框架HyGeoAgent，取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在遥感领域有潜力，但其地质解译的可靠性（是否基于视觉证据进行准确识别与推理）尚不明确，缺乏系统性诊断手段。
AI.method: 构建基于高光谱影像的10,000题诊断基准，覆盖推理可靠性、先验-证据对比、光谱判别三个维度与十类任务，含选择题与开放题；融合卫星影像、地质标注与验证证据。并提出HyGeoAgent工具增强框架，集成区域观测、文本知识检索、同波段图像检索与原生PCA分析，实现自适应工具调用。
AI.result: 评测显示现有模型在细粒度识别与证据接地的解译上存在明显局限；HyGeoAgent在各诊断维度上相较对应基座模型取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 揭示多模态大模型地质解译的可靠性短板，并提供基准与可扩展的工具增强方案以改善证据驱动的岩性解译。

title: The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
summary: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are built using well-understood mathematical operations, yet their complex nature poses significant challenges to intuitively understanding their decision-making processes. This work introduces a method for visualizing and measuring ANN decision boundary geometry directly in the high-dimensional input space, avoiding distortions found with traditional projection-based techniques. We analyze boundary curvatures and distances in diverse inputs, architectures, and training methods. Boundary distances grow smoothly and slowly with consistent curvature as the size of the subspace increases, suggesting that decision boundaries are close to input samples within large, continuous subspaces. We also quantify how much boundary distances and curvatures reduce near dataset samples after adversarial training. Training methodology has a significantly stronger impact on boundary distance and curvature than architecture or test-set accuracy. These findings are contextualized within prior work, supporting or refuting several previously proposed theories of boundary behavior. Our analytically and empirically supported methodology lays the foundation for future studies to improve network interpretability and understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接在高维输入空间中可视化并度量ANN决策边界几何的方法，避免投影失真，揭示了边界距离与曲率随子空间增大的规律以及对抗训练的影响。
AI.motivation: ANN虽由可理解的数学运算构成，但其复杂决策过程难以直观理解；传统基于投影的可视化技术会引入失真，无法真实反映高维空间中的决策边界几何。
AI.method: 在高维输入空间中直接可视化并测量决策边界的几何特性，分析不同输入、架构和训练方法下的边界曲率与距离，避免投影失真；并对比对抗训练前后样本附近的边界距离与曲率变化。
AI.result: 随着子空间增大，边界距离平滑缓慢增长且曲率保持一致，表明在大而连续的子空间中决策边界靠近输入样本；对抗训练可显著降低数据集样本附近的边界距离与曲率；训练方法对边界距离和曲率的影响远大于架构或测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该分析与实证支持的方法为未来提升网络可解释性研究奠定基础，并支持或反驳了若干既有边界行为理论。

title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 8-page main paper with references and supplementary material (15 pages); 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI Project page: https://starsholic.github.io/AeroRSI/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight. Correcting these failures requires repairs, i.e., actions that avoid them at the states the policy itself reaches, which human pilots cannot label at scale and rule-based planners cannot supply reliably. In this paper, we present AeroRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial navigation policy iteratively learns from its own failures. Our key insight is that a failing policy should judge its own repairs by flying on from them. Judged in this way, its sampled actions and even rule-based proposals that hurt it when imitated directly become reliable supervision. Moreover, an episode terminates at its first failure, concealing subsequent failures until the earlier ones are repaired. AeroRSI thus renews its supervision in every round, anchoring the failures of the current policy, verifying repairs by its continuation, and distilling them while keeping its behavior elsewhere. On TravelUAV, three rounds raise the success rate of a supervised 2B-parameter policy from 46.4% to 67.5% and reduce collisions by half, surpassing the previous state of the art by 10.6 points from the same initialization without extra human labels or inference cost. Code and models are available at https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI.

AI.tldr: 提出AeroRSI递归自我改进框架，让空中导航策略从自身失败中迭代学习，通过"续飞验证"判定修复动作的可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型使无人机能跟随自然语言指令，但在闭环飞行中仍频繁失败。修正失败需要"修复"——即在策略自身到达的状态上避免失败的动作。这类数据人类飞行员无法大规模标注，规则规划器也无法可靠提供。
AI.method: 核心洞见：失败的策略应通过"从修复动作继续飞行"来评判修复质量。如此评判下，采样的动作乃至直接模仿会损害策略的规则提案都能成为可靠监督。由于回合在首次失败处终止会隐藏后续失败，AeroRSI每轮更新监督：锚定当前策略的失败、以续飞结果验证修复、蒸馏这些修复同时保持其他行为不变。
AI.result: 在TravelUAV上，三轮迭代将2B监督策略的成功率从46.4%提升至67.5%，碰撞减少一半，相同初始化下超过此前SOTA 10.6个点，且无需额外人工标注或推理成本。
AI.conclusion: AeroRSI证明策略可从自身失败中递归自我改进，续飞验证机制能将不可靠的规则/采样动作转化为有效监督，为无人机VLA闭环飞行提供无额外标注的高效改进方案。

title: From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
summary: Human motion perturbs wireless channels, making commodity Wi-Fi devices a practical platform for device-free activity recognition. Yet Channel State Information (CSI) also depends strongly on the person, receiver position, recording session, and surrounding environment, so a classifier can continue producing activity labels after its deployment conditions have moved away from those seen during training. We propose Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture in which four Variational Auto-Encoders learn compact distributions from raw Wi-Fi 6 CSI magnitudes and a delayed-fusion classifier combines their means and log-variances. On twelve activities from a public benchmark, Wi-HAR reaches 96.6% median recognition accuracy, compared with 70.8-81.5% for independently optimized single-antenna models, showing that the antennas provide complementary views of the same activity. We then use the same latent backbone to detect deployment shifts without using shifted samples for model selection or calibration. A class-conditional uncertainty score derived from Evidential Deep Learning achieves a macro-average ROC-AUC of 0.897 across eleven datasets that change receiver position, participant, recording session, or room, and detects 82.5% of shifted samples at a realized 5.2% in-distribution rejection rate. Detection performance nevertheless varies substantially across receiver positions, showing that the same physical change does not induce a uniform uncertainty response. The compact representation also supports shallow decision-tree analysis using variables from several antennas.

AI.tldr: Wi-HAR提出多天线Wi-Fi 6 CSI活动识别架构：四个VAE学习紧凑分布并由延迟融合分类器整合均值与对数方差；同一潜在骨干配合Evidential Deep Learning的不确定性评分可在不使用偏移样本训练/校准的情况下检测部署偏移。
AI.motivation: CSI强烈依赖人物、接收机位置、录制会话与周围环境，分类器在部署条件偏离训练分布后，仍会继续输出活动标签（静默失效），因此需要高精度识别并能在无标签、无校准偏移样本条件下检测分布偏移。
AI.method: 基于Wi-Fi 6 CSI幅度的多天线VAE架构：4个VAE分别学习紧凑分布，延迟融合分类器融合各天线的均值与对数方差；复用同一潜在骨干，用Evidential Deep Learning导出类条件不确定性分数进行部署偏移检测；并用浅层决策树分析多天线变量。
AI.result: 公共基准12类活动上中位准确率96.6%，单天线独立优化模型仅70.8–81.5%；跨11个数据集（改变接收位置、参与者、会话或房间）宏平均ROC-AUC 0.897，在5.2%的ID拒绝率下检测82.5%的偏移样本；但检测性能随接收位置显著波动。
AI.conclusion: 多天线提供互补视角显著提升识别精度；不确定性检测能有效发现部署偏移且各条件并非一致响应；紧凑潜在表示还支持可解释的浅层决策树分析。

title: APS: Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have significantly improved video understanding capabilities, yet processing long videos remains challenging due to the substantial computational cost of extensive visual inputs. Frame selection offers an efficient alternative, but many existing region-based methods rely on fixed or predefined temporal partitions, which may result in suboptimal temporal regions, compromising subsequent budget allocation and frame selection. In this work, we propose Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection (APS), a training-free framework that adapts temporal partitions to local variations in query-frame relevance. Specifically, APS formulates temporal partitioning as a complexity-regularized fitting problem, jointly optimizing partition boundaries and local models through dynamic programming. The resulting adaptive temporal partitions guide frame budget allocation based on query relevance and temporal extent, enabling informative frame selection under limited visual budgets. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that APS consistently improves performance across diverse LVLM backbones, achieving the highest average gains over uniform sampling among competing methods. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of adaptive partitioning and demonstrate its generalizability across model scales, similarity encoders, and advanced LVLMs.

AI.tldr: APS：一种免训练的自适应时间分区帧选择框架，将时间分区建模为复杂度正则化的拟合问题并用动态规划联合优化边界与局部模型，据查询相关性与时间跨度分配帧预算，在多个长视频基准上优于均匀采样及其他竞争方法。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解受限于大量视觉输入带来的高昂计算成本；帧选择是高效替代方案，但现有基于区域的方法依赖固定或预定义的时间划分，可能产生次优时间区域，进而损害后续预算分配与帧选择效果。
AI.method: 提出APS（Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection），免训练框架。将时间分区形式化为复杂度正则化的拟合问题，通过动态规划联合优化分区边界与局部模型，使分区自适应于查询-帧相关性的局部变化；再依据查询相关性与时间跨度分配帧预算，在有限视觉预算下选出具信息量的帧。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上，跨多种LVLM骨干均稳定提升性能，相对均匀采样的平均增益在竞争方法中最高；进一步分析验证了自适应分区的有效性，以及在模型规模、相似度编码器和先进LVLM上的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时间分区能有效提升长视频帧选择质量，APS作为一种即插即用的免训练方法具有良好通用性，可广泛适配不同LVLM骨干与设置。

title: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
summary: Plant reflectance spectroscopy across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared domain encodes foliar biochemical and anatomical traits into contiguous spectral signatures with locally differentiable structure; however, extreme inter-band collinearity and unfavorable sample-to-feature ratios challenge predictive modeling. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods routinely adopted in spectroscopy, are column-permutation invariant: they treat adjacent wavelengths as unordered tabular columns and discard the sequential differential geometry of absorption features. Here, we propose Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA), a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that projects contiguous spectra into a compact morpho-spectral subspace through three complementary blocks: (i) additive continuum-removed absorption depth, area, and red-edge inflection kinematics; (ii) local multi-order singular eigenmodes (0th, 1st, and 2nd derivatives) partitioned across contiguous radiative sub-windows; and (iii) global Fisher-weighted canonical subspaces regularized via trace-normalized isotropic covariance shrinkage. We validated MSPA across 8,963 spectra spanning five plant systems, coupled with six classical machine learning classifiers and four Tabular Foundation Models (TabPFN v3, TabICL v2, TabDPT v1.2, and TabFM). Despite compressing the 1,580-band spectrum by 96%, MSPA outperformed the full spectrum in 92.0% of all benchmarks and conventional reducers in 90.0% of all model-crop evaluations, raising the global mean macro-F1 from 0.7756 (full spectrum) to 0.8520, accelerating in-context inference by up to 126.5x. Designed as a self-contained spectral projection operator, the MSPA method can be directly integrated into spectroscopy workflows via the open-source code available at GitHub: https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa.

AI.tldr: 提出MSPA，一种有监督降维算子，将连续光谱投影到紧凑形态光谱子空间，压缩96%波段仍在92%基准上优于全光谱，宏观F1从0.7756升至0.8520。
AI.motivation: 植物反射光谱存在极端波段共线性与不利的样本-特征比，而传统降维方法列置换不变，把相邻波长当作无序表格列，丢弃了吸收特征的序列微分几何信息。
AI.method: MSPA由三个互补模块组成：(i) 加性连续统去除吸收深度、面积与红边拐点运动学；(ii) 在连续辐射子窗口上划分的局部多阶奇异特征模（0/1/2阶导数）；(iii) 经迹归一化各向同性协方差收缩正则化的全局Fisher加权典型子空间。
AI.result: 在五个植物系统共8963条光谱上，结合6种经典机器学习分类器与4种表格基础模型（TabPFN v3、TabICL v2、TabDPT v1.2、TabFM）验证：压缩96%波段下，MSPA在92.0%基准上优于全光谱，在90.0%模型-作物评估中优于传统降维器，全局平均宏观F1由0.7756提升至0.8520，上下文推理最高加速126.5倍。
AI.conclusion: MSPA是自包含的光谱投影算子，可直接集成到光谱学工作流，开源代码见GitHub。

title: CausalDrive: Causal Decomposition for Data-Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Efficient use of expert demonstrations is essential for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, directly imitating expert trajectories couples nominal intention, which specifies where the vehicle should go, with multimodal driving styles, which determine how that intention is executed. Different combinations of these factors can yield similar expert trajectories, obscuring their respective causal contributions and forcing the policy to learn both from a single entangled target. This ambiguity limits how effectively the policy can exploit expert demonstrations. We propose CausalDrive, a causal decomposition framework for data-efficient driving policy learning that separates deterministic nominal intention prediction from probabilistic driving style modeling. Specifically, we construct counterfactual nominal trajectories from navigation command, map topology, and ego state by removing style dependent effects, providing a Nominal Intention Planner with supervision independent of expert trajectories. Conditioned on the predicted nominal intention and surrounding agents, a diffusion-based Style Execution Policy models diverse driving styles as a multimodal distribution over residuals between nominal and expert trajectories. This causally structured supervision reduces redundant learning of shared nominal behavior in routine scenarios, directing expert supervision toward informative execution variations and improving data utilization. CausalDrive achieves 91.2 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.5 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. Further experiments demonstrate strong performance with limited expert data and clear advantages in challenging interactive scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出CausalDrive，用因果分解把驾驶策略学习拆成确定性的名义意图预测与概率化的驾驶风格建模，提升专家数据利用率，在NAVSIM v1/v2取得91.2 PDMS与89.5 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: 直接模仿专家轨迹会把"去哪"的名义意图与"怎么开"的多模态驾驶风格纠缠在同一目标中，不同组合可产生相似轨迹，导致因果贡献不清、策略需从单一混合目标中同时学习两者，限制了专家示范的利用效率。
AI.method: 构建因果分解框架：从导航指令、地图拓扑和自车状态出发，去除风格相关效应生成反事实名义轨迹，为Nominal Intention Planner提供独立于专家轨迹的监督；再以预测的名义意图与周围智能体为条件，用基于扩散的Style Execution Policy将驾驶风格建模为名义轨迹与专家轨迹残差上的多模态分布。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1上达到91.2 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到89.5 EPDMS，匹配或超越当前最优；在有限专家数据下仍表现良好，并在具有挑战性的交互场景中优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 因果结构化的监督减少了常规场景中共享名义行为的冗余学习，使专家监督聚焦于有信息量的执行变化，从而提高数据利用率与交互场景表现。

title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Location Encoding Methods for Species Distribution Modelling
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
summary: Understanding the spatial distribution of species is a key question in ecology. A variety of solutions, from statistical, traditional machine learning, through to deep learning-based methods have been proposed. These methods take sparse observations for a species of interest as input and aim to generate dense spatial outputs indicating the spatial range of the species. Orthogonal to the choice of statistical model used is the question of what input features are most informative. Thanks to recent developments, the number of options has greatly expanded, with choices spanning different climate variables, learning-based encodings, earth embedding models, or raw transformed geographic coordinates. In this work, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework and quantify the effectiveness of different location encodings in the context of species range estimation, both at the local and global scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个标准化评估框架，用于量化不同"位置编码"（location encoding）在物种分布范围估计任务中的有效性，涵盖局部与全球尺度。
AI.motivation: 物种空间分布建模中，除统计/机器学习模型的选择外，"使用哪些输入特征是信息量最大的"这一问题同样关键；近年来可选特征大幅增加（气候变量、学习式编码、地球嵌入模型、原始地理坐标变换等），但缺乏统一标准来比较它们的有效性。
AI.method: 构建标准化评估框架，以稀疏物种观测为输入、生成稠密空间分布输出，系统比较多种位置编码（气候变量、学习式编码、地球嵌入模型、变换后的地理坐标等）在局部与全球两个尺度上的表现。
AI.result: 通过统一框架定量给出不同位置编码在物种范围估计中的效果对比（局部与全球尺度）。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码的选择对物种分布范围估计有显著影响，标准化评估为特征选择提供了可比较的基准；不同尺度下最优编码可能不同。

title: Learning Where and How Much to Sample: Volume-Adaptive k-Space Acquisition for Accelerated MRI
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential medical imaging technique, but its high costs and long acquisition times can limit accessibility. Accelerated MRI reduces acquisition time through k-space undersampling, yet conventional methods often rely on predefined sampling patterns and uniform slice budgets, overlooking anatomical variations and inter-slice relationships. In this paper, we propose a volume-adaptive k-space acquisition framework that jointly learns where and how much to sample across an entire MRI volume. Using only acquired auto-calibration signal (ACS) measurements, our method exploits volume-wide anatomical information to adaptively allocate sampling budgets across slices while identifying informative k-space lines. A learned joint slice--frequency refinement module coordinates sampling decisions while preserving an exact total volume-level acquisition budget. To reconstruct the acquired measurements, we design a sensitivity-aware synchronous cross-slice reconstruction network that estimates coil sensitivities from ACS measurements and progressively refines neighboring-slice reconstructions while enforcing hard k-space data consistency. Both networks are jointly optimized using reconstruction-based supervision without requiring fully sampled k-space at inference. Experiments on knee and brain MRI across multiple contrasts and acceleration factors demonstrate the adaptive behavior of our acquisition framework and evaluate its reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种体积自适应k空间采集框架，仅用ACS测量联合学习整个MRI体积"采哪里、采多少"，配合灵敏度感知的跨切片同步重建网络，在膝/脑多对比度多加速倍数下实现自适应采集与重建。
AI.motivation: MRI成本高、采集时间长。加速MRI靠k空间欠采样缩短时间，但传统方法多用预定义采样模式与均匀的切片采样预算，忽略了不同切片间的解剖差异及切片相互关系。
AI.method: 1) 仅利用已采集的ACS数据，借助全卷解剖信息在切片间自适应分配采样预算，并挑选高信息量的k空间线；2) 学习式"切片—频率"联合细化模块协调采样决策，同时严格保持体积级总采样预算守恒；3) 设计灵敏度感知的跨切片同步重建网络，从ACS估计线圈灵敏度，逐步细化相邻切片重建并施加硬性k空间数据一致性；4) 两个网络以重建监督联合优化，推理时无需全采样k空间。
AI.result: 在膝关节和脑部MRI、多种对比度与加速倍数下的实验展示了采集框架的自适应行为，并评估了其重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出体积级联合学习"采样位置与预算分配"的自适应加速MRI框架，结合跨切片灵敏度感知重建与硬数据一致性，在无需全采样参考的条件下实现了对解剖变化的自适应采集。

title: From Restoration to Redrawing: Revitalizing Ancient Chinese Characters by SVG Code Generation and Editing
summary: Hanjian manuscripts written on Han Dynasty bamboo and wooden slips are invaluable heritage of ancient Chinese writing but suffer from damaged ink and incomplete strokes. Existing image-to-image restoration methods may alter observed strokes and offer limited control over stroke geometry. Inspired by experts' manual redrawing practices, we address these issues by introducing \textbf{ReDraw}, a two-stage vision-language model(VLM) that reformulates character restoration as Scalable Vector Graphics(SVG) code generation and editing. Stage one targets faithful vectorization of observed strokes geometry or conservative tracing of mildly degraded strokes. Guided by skeleton chain-of-thought reasoning and reinforcement learning with structure-aware rewards, stage two predicts skeletons before contours to redraw severely incomplete strokes by appending paths while keeping existing SVG paths unchanged. To support training, we develop a multi-layer data synthesis pipeline that disentangles ink, material, and degradation to generate 1.2M samples, and derive up to 6,400 adaptation pairs from 320 annotated real glyphs. Experiments demonstrate synthetic restoration performance and adaptability to real Hanjian glyphs. Code and demo will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReDraw，将汉代简牍文字修复重构为 SVG 矢量代码生成与编辑任务，用两阶段视觉语言模型，第一阶段忠实矢量化已观测笔画，第二阶段借骨架思维链和强化学习在保持已有路径不变的前提下追加路径、重绘严重残缺笔画，并用多层数据合成管线产出 120 万样本支撑训练。
AI.motivation: 汉简墨迹破损、笔画残缺；现有图像到图像修复方法可能篡改已观测笔画，且对笔画几何形状缺乏可控性。作者受专家手工描摹重绘实践的启发，希望以可控的矢量方式修复。
AI.method: 两阶段 VLM 框架：阶段一对观测笔画做忠实矢量化，对轻度退化笔画做保守描摹；阶段二先预测骨架后预测轮廓，通过骨架链式思维推理与结构感知奖励的强化学习，以"追加路径、不改动已有 SVG 路径"的方式重绘严重残缺笔画。数据方面构建解耦墨迹、材质与退化的多层合成管线，生成 1.2M 样本，并从 320 个标注真实字形派生至多 6,400 个适配对。
AI.result: 实验展示了合成数据上的修复效果，以及对真实汉简字形具备适应性。代码与演示待接收后公开。
AI.conclusion: 将文字修复表述为 SVG 代码生成与编辑、并以"只增不改"的策略保护已观测笔画，是兼顾保真与几何可控的一种可行思路；合成数据与少量真实标注的适配组合可支撑真实场景迁移。

title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
comment: Accepted at the AI4Mat Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. Across classification and regression tasks, TCAF outperforms MatterChat, with up to 47.8% lower RMSE, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and halving the overall training time. Further experiments incorporating UMA-S demonstrate TCAF's flexibility across encoder combinations, with the three-encoder configuration achieving the highest macro-average classification accuracy of 89.61%.

AI.tldr: 提出Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF)，用轻量注意力桥接模块根据目标性质自适应选择并融合多结构编码器（CHGNet与Zatom-1中间层）的表示，与材料语言对齐联合训练，性能超过MatterChat且更省参数与时间。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态材料语言模型（如MatterChat）依赖大型桥接模块和独立的对比对齐阶段，且默认使用编码器最终层特征；但作者发现监督式与生成式编码器信息互补，且Zatom-1的最有信息表示分布在不同深度、随目标性质变化，需要按任务自适应选择表征。
AI.method: TCAF：以任务条件化隐查询（task-conditioned latent queries）为核心的轻量注意力桥接，将CHGNet特征与Zatom-1的多个中间层表示进行自适应加权融合；桥接模块直接在下游预测任务上训练，表征选择与材料-语言对齐端到端联合学习，无需单独对比预训练。并扩展到三编码器（加入UMA-S）配置。
AI.result: 在分类与回归任务上均优于MatterChat，RMSE最多降低47.8%，可训练参数显著更少，总训练时间减半；三编码器配置取得最高宏平均分类准确率89.61%，显示对不同编码器组合的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 编码器信息互补且最优层级依赖任务，任务条件化的轻量注意力融合是替代大型桥接+对比对齐的有效方案；TCAF在精度、参数效率与训练成本上均具优势，并可自然扩展至多编码器组合。

title: Object Pose: The Link between Weak Perspective, Paraperspective, and Full Perspective
summary: Recently, DeMenthon and Davis [4,5] proposed a method for determining the pose of a 3-D object with respect to a camera from 3-D to 2-D point correspondences. The method consists of iteratively improving the pose computed with a weak perspective camera model to converge, at the limit, to a pose estimation computed with a perspective camera model. In this paper we give an algebraic derivation of DeMenthon and Davis' method and we show that it belongs to a larger class of methods where the perspective camera model is approximated either at zero order (weak perspective) or first order (paraperspective). We describe in detail an iterative paraperspective pose computation method for both non coplanar and coplanar object points. We analyse the convergence of these methods and we conclude that the iterative paraperspective method (proposed in this paper) has better convergence properties than the iterative weak perspective method. We introduce a simple way of taking into account the orthogonality constraint associated with the rotation matrix. We analyse the sensitivity to camera calibration errors and we define the optimal experimental setup with respect to imprecise camera calibration. We compare the results obtained with this method and with a non-linear optimization method.

AI.tldr: 本文从代数角度推导DeMenthon-Davis位姿估计方法，提出其属于透视相机模型零阶或一阶近似的更广方法类，并详细描述迭代paraperspective位姿计算方法，分析与比较其收敛性。
AI.motivation: DeMenthon和Davis提出的方法是迭代改进弱透视模型下的位姿估计，使其极限收敛于透视模型下的位姿。作者希望给出其代数推导，并将其推广到更一般的方法类，同时改进收敛性能。
AI.method: 给出DeMenthon-Davis方法的代数推导；指出该方法类可用零阶（弱透视）或一阶（paraperspective）近似透视相机模型；详细描述针对非共面与共面物点的迭代paraperspective位姿计算方法；引入处理旋转矩阵正交约束的简单方式；分析对相机标定误差的敏感性并定义最优实验布局；与非线性优化方法比较。
AI.result: 迭代paraperspective方法比迭代弱透视方法具有更好的收敛性；给出正交约束处理方式以及关于相机标定噪声下的最优实验布置；并与非线性优化方法的结果进行比较。
AI.conclusion: 迭代paraperspective位姿估计方法是对DeMenthon-Davis弱透视迭代方法的推广和改进，收敛性更优，并可用于共面与非共面点情形，具有对相机标定误差的实用指导意义。

title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
summary: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matching, tuned baselines and paired seeds. Orthogonalizing Q, K and V separately rather than as one fused matrix lowers the loss by 0.0250 nats and accounts for all of the gain of block-wise variants. A matmul-only, rotation-equivariant spectral tilt $σ^{-1/4}$ applied in the cooldown lowers the loss of this stronger baseline by a further 0.0120 nats, additively with NorMuon (0.0158 nats together, three seeds; the baseline needs about 4.3% more tokens to match), and by 0.0188 nats at 355M parameters (three seeds). Energy-matched Schatten-1 weight decay adds a further 0.0052 nats. Geometrically principled changes that do not act on the measured miscalibration, namely exact polar factors, steepest-descent input whitening and top-heavy decay, do not help.

AI.tldr: 本文用实测曲率诊断 Muon 的步长分配问题，发现其对高曲率奇异方向步长过大，并据此提出简单有效的改进（Q/K/V 分离正交化、σ^{-1/4} 谱倾斜等），在 124M 与 355M 模型上稳定降低损失。
AI.motivation: Muon 沿动量极因子方向更新，隐含地对所有奇异方向施加同一步长，并按 leverage score 决定各神经元步长，这些分配不参考损失曲率，其优劣无法由最速下降论证回答。
AI.method: 利用 held-out 梯度与 Hessian-vector product，按奇异值带和神经元组分解释 Muon 步长，计算各组二阶最优乘子；用 Lean 证明何种诊断可作为干预依据；在等步长范数、调优基线和配对种子下测试多种干预（Q/K/V 分开正交化、matmul-only 旋转等变 σ^{-1/4} 谱倾斜、NorMuon、能量匹配 Schatten-1 权重衰减），并设置几何上合理但不针对失配的对照（精确极因子、输入白化、top-heavy decay）。
AI.result: 124M 模型上乘子从顶部奇异方向到尾部单调上升，说明 Muon 对高曲率顶部过步；预测并验证：从顶部移出步长在中训练期和降温早期有益、降温末期无益。Q/K/V 分开正交化降低 0.0250 nats 并解释分块变体全部收益；σ^{-1/4} 谱倾斜再降 0.0120 nats（与 NorMuon 合计 0.0158 nats，三种子；基线需约 4.3% 更多 token），355M 上降 0.0188 nats；Schatten-1 权重衰减再降 0.0052 nats。
AI.conclusion: Muon 的谱分配存在可测量的曲率失配，针对该失配的简单几何干预稳定带来增益；而不作用于该失配的其余“几何上合理”的改动（精确极因子、输入白化、top-heavy decay）均无效，说明诊断-干预框架具有预测力。

title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to KDD 2027. Project page is at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page
summary: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RoughCut-Bench 基准和基于 LVLM 的智能体工作流，用于评估和自动生成视频粗剪方案。
AI.motivation: 视频粗剪是媒体制作核心环节，但借助大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的自动粗剪研究不足，缺乏全面评估基准和成熟的可执行剪辑方案生成流程。
AI.method: 构建 RoughCut-Bench，涵盖两种场景：(1) 视觉驱动场景（101 个案例、831 段原始视频、1476 个精彩片段标注），评估精彩片段检测与选择、源视频排序、用户需求遵循；(2) 语音驱动场景（84 个案例，基于 ASR 转写），评估填充词移除、重复表达去重、低价值内容裁剪。评估将剪辑方案与标注对比，视觉场景还用人类对齐的智能体评估器评估渲染成片质量。并提出引导 LVLM 生成结构化剪辑方案的智能体工作流。
AI.result: 实验表明当前 LVLM 在生成与专家对齐的剪辑方案方面仍然能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 论文填补了自动粗剪的评估空白，发布了基准、代码和提示词，并指出 LVLM 在此任务上仍有较大提升空间。

title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
summary: Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations.
