Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision. Budget-matched and correspondence-perturbed controls isolate the effect of relational supervision from improvements attributable to additional state observations or increased data volume. Designed as a plug-and-play training framework, TangentPDE integrates with diverse neural-operator backbones. Across four PDE systems and 20 task-backbone settings, TangentPDE lowers the three-seed mean state error in 18 settings and the corresponding Rollout@20 error in 18, while intrinsic finite-step response gains are strongest on DiffReact and remain task- and backbone-dependent elsewhere.

AI.tldr: TangentPDE：用有限差分从配对输入的状态输出构造方向导数监督，联合约束状态精度、响应方向对齐与幅值校准，让神经PDE算子不仅学算子值还学局部变化，且无需导数标签或伴随求解，作为即插即用框架提升多种骨干的下游误差。
AI.motivation: 现有神经PDE算子主要靠状态重构优化，只在观测输入处约束算子值，无法刻画算子对局部扰动的敏感性；忠实逼近算子行为既需准确状态预测，也需沿局部扰动方向的正确变化。
AI.method: 用有限差分近似方向导数：在稀疏成对输入上取参考求解器的状态输出，构造任务相关的有限步响应；目标函数同时约束状态保真、响应方向对齐与响应幅值校准。响应标签仅来自成对输入的状态输出，无需显式导数标签、线性化/伴随PDE求解或完整雅可比，适用于无导数接口的非线性求解器。另提出选择性执行的适应机制强化有限差分监督下的局部算子表示。设预算匹配与对应扰动对照组，以分离关系型监督与额外观测/数据量的贡献；作为即插即用框架接入多种神经算子骨干。
AI.result: 在4个PDE系统、20个任务-骨干设置中，TangentPDE在18个设置降低三seed平均状态误差，18个设置降低Rollout@20误差；内在有限步响应增益在DiffReact上最强，其余随任务与骨干而异。
AI.conclusion: 以有限差分关系型监督补充状态重构，可低成本地学得算子局部变化并普遍改善状态与rollout表现；但响应层面的收益并不稳定，具任务与骨干依赖性，需按情境选择使用。

title: DetailScale-SR: Decoupling Restoration and Continuous Detail Control for Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution often seeks the most detailed plausible reconstruction, although more detail is not always desirable. The same degraded image may require restrained restoration, faithful reconstruction, or enhanced visual detail according to user intent. We present DetailScale-SR, a preference-conditioned framework that continuously controls reconstructed detail for a fixed low-resolution input without altering the scene being restored. Rather than relying on post-processing or repeatedly rewriting prompts, it learns a continuous family of reconstructions while separating content recovery from detail preference. This enables a smooth transition from conservative restoration to richly textured results under consistent input and semantic constraints. Its controllable range also extends beyond conventional restoration: DetailScale-SR can enhance high-frequency structures and generate perceptually richer textures than the paired high-resolution reference. Text restoration is another distinct strength. For text-rich scenes, especially Chinese posters and signs, it recovers more legible and character-faithful text than prior generative SR methods under matched textual guidance. DetailScale-SR therefore unifies continuous detail control, beyond-reference enhancement, and reliable recovery of semantically important content. Our model is available at https://modelscope.cn/models/DiffSynth-Studio/Qwen-Image-2.1-SR

AI.tldr: DetailScale-SR：一个偏好条件化（preference-conditioned）的真实图像超分框架，可在不改变场景内容的前提下，对同一低分辨率输入连续控制重建细节量，实现从保守修复到丰富纹理的平滑过渡。
AI.motivation: 真实场景超分中"更多细节"并非总是所求：同一退化图像可能需按用户意图进行克制修复、忠实重建或增强视觉细节。现有方法依赖后处理或反复改写提示词，难以在同一输入与语义约束下灵活连续地调节细节程度。
AI.method: 提出偏好条件化框架，学习一族连续的重建结果，并将内容恢复与细节偏好解耦；无需后处理或重写提示，即可在一致的输入与语义约束下连续调节细节强度。
AI.result: 可实现从保守修复到高纹理结果的平滑过渡；控制范围超越常规修复，能增强高频结构并生成比配对高分辨率参考更具感知丰富度的纹理；在文本丰富场景（尤其中文海报与标牌）中，在匹配文本引导下比先前的生成式超分方法恢复出更易读、字形更忠实于原文的文字。
AI.conclusion: DetailScale-SR 统一了连续细节控制、超越参考的增强能力以及语义重要内容的可靠恢复，模型已开源发布于 ModelScope。

title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Models, prompts, replies with tool calls, and code: https://github.com/Chth1z/llm-black-box-model-audit
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.

AI.tldr: 研究检验了“用LLM解释临床预测模型”的三项承诺：忠实描述模型、发现模型缺陷、揭示新知识。在卒中试验数据上训练4类模型、植入24个人为缺陷并用8个干净模型混合成盲测集，GPT-6 Astra通过仅返回预测值的工具审计模型。结果：代理模型忠实度高（平均R²=0.976），植入缺陷召回率96%（69/72），但报告的问题和"新发现"中有相当比例经核查不成立或只是微小效应。
AI.motivation: LLM被宣称能解释临床预测模型——说清模型算什么、找出其缺陷、甚至揭示新知识。但在答案可被核验的场景中，这些承诺尚未被系统检验。作者要检验这三项承诺。
AI.method: 基于国际卒中试验数据，针对两个结局训练四种模型（逻辑回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络）；在24个副本中各植入一个缺陷（低估子群、风险因素方向反转、不合理阶梯），并与8个干净模型混合。GPT-6 Astra在仅能查询预测值的工具下，盲法各审计3次；判定规则事先确定并由程序执行。对照：人工拟合的42项加性代理模型、专门编写的检测脚本、回归扫描。
AI.result: 代理模型（中位128项）以平均R²=0.976 复现被审计模型的对数几率（人工42项加性代理为0.959）。植入缺陷在69/72次运行中被发现（96%，95%CI 80%–99%），专用脚本则检出全部24个。同时报告了大量额外问题：1,089条可检查报告中60%未通过预设的"与模型平均行为一致"检验，事后看多为真实但效应很小；15%的可检查报告在模型中并不存在。从干净模型读出的601个意外关系中，11%在后续随机患者中成立（随机配对6%；回归扫描最强候选28%）；经训练数据核查后为33%对30%。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭查询访问，LLM能相当忠实地描述黑箱模型，并能发现几乎所有植入缺陷（专用脚本也能做到）。但其报告的问题必须在模型上核验、其"新发现"必须在数据上核验，不能直接采信。

title: Target-Consistent Action Guidance via Semi-Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Drifting World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models let robots imagine the outcomes of their actions for planning and offline policy evaluation, but these uses need many rollouts, which multi-step diffusion makes expensive. Drifting models move the iteration from inference to training and generate samples in one network pass. DriftWorld brought this paradigm to action-conditioned world models; to strengthen action following, it repels predictions from the current frame, a construction borrowed from classifier-free guidance. We show that this accentuation has a target bias: the push persists even when a prediction matches the recorded future, in kernel, balanced, and unbalanced Wasserstein drifting fields alike. We introduce Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA) to remove this bias. MSA treats the current frame as a counterfactual destination competing with the recorded future in a semi-relaxed optimal transport problem; subtracting the closed-form share of the correct future makes the guidance vanish at the target, and the remainder is shared by all predictions. We prove that the recorded future is the unique fixed point along the motion direction for collapsed predictions, and that the guidance fades with prediction error. On Push-T, Robomimic, and BridgeV2, where trained models under-react rather than overshoot, MSA improves action ranking, response slope, and moving-region error over latent-space baselines at no inference cost, though these benchmarks do not isolate bias removal as the cause.

AI.tldr: 本文发现DriftWorld中借鉴无分类器引导的"排斥当前帧"做法存在目标偏差——即使预测已匹配真实未来，该排斥仍持续，导致动作跟随被扭曲。作者提出Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA)，将当前帧视为与真实未来竞争的"反事实目的地"，用半松弛最优传输减去真实未来的闭式份额，使引导在目标处归零。理论上证明真实未来是唯一不动点且引导随预测误差衰减；在Push-T、Robomimic、BridgeV2上零推理开销地改善了动作排序、响应斜率和运动区域误差。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型需要大量rollout用于规划和离线评估，多步扩散推理昂贵。DriftWorld将"漂移模型"的单步生成范式引入该领域，为增强动作跟随而借用无分类器引导式的"远离当前帧"排斥机制。但作者指出该做法带来了目标偏差：即使预测已准确匹配真实未来，排斥推力依然存在，扭曲了生成结果。
AI.method: 提出Mass-Share Accentuation（MSA）。将当前帧视为与真实未来相互竞争的"反事实目的地"，构建半松弛最优传输问题；通过减去正确未来所占的闭式份额，使引导项在目标处恰好消失，剩余部分由所有预测共享。该方法对kernel、balanced与unbalanced Wasserstein漂移场统一适用。
AI.result: 理论上证明：对塌缩预测，真实未来在运动方向上为唯一不动点，且引导强度随预测误差增大而衰减。实验在Push-T、Robomimic、BridgeV2上进行（这些数据上模型表现为欠反应而非过冲），MSA在无额外推理成本的情况下，相较潜空间基线提升了动作排序、响应斜率与运动区域误差。
AI.conclusion: MSA去除了DriftWorld中引导机制的目标偏差，理论上保证引导在真实目标处归零并提供唯一不动点，实验验证了其在多个基准上的有效性；但作者也指出，这些基准未能隔离证明性能提升确由偏差消除引起，偏差去除与最终效果的因果关系仍需进一步验证。

title: Monoculture Robust Learning
summary: We introduce a notion of monoculture robustness in Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning, as a way to mitigate the problem of algorithmic monoculture (Kleinberg and Raghavan, 2021): the tendency of models sharing the same components (e.g., training data) to fail on the same inputs. Specifically, we ask whether a learner with access to a single dataset can output $k$ individually accurate hypotheses whose joint failure probability is comparable to training on $k$ independent datasets. We say that such a learning procedure achieves monoculture robustness, and we quantify this by bounding the conjunctive error that all $k$ hypotheses misclassify points in an individual sense. We design methods for achieving this type of guarantee by drawing a surprising connection between replicability (Impagliazzo et al., 2022) and monoculture robustness. Specifically, we show that if the base learner is $ρ$-replicable, then running it independently $k$ times on the same sample yields individual monoculture error that shrinks exponentially with $k$, controlled by the single-run error of the base learner at the point and $ρ$. We complement these positive results with a lower bound: for individual monoculture robustness, we prove a worst-case lower bound showing that, for learners, driving the individual conjunctive error down to $γ$ can require a sample-size multiplier of $t = Ω(\log(1/γ))$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAC学习中的"单一栽培鲁棒性"概念，通过可复制性(replicability)与单一栽培鲁棒性的联系，证明ρ-可复制基学习器在相同样本上独立运行k次可使个体联合错误率随k指数衰减，并给出样本量倍数为Ω(log(1/γ))的下界。
AI.motivation: 算法单一栽培问题：共享相同组件（如训练数据）的模型倾向于在相同输入上失败。论文探究单一数据集下的学习器能否输出k个各自准确、且联合失败概率可比拟于用k个独立数据集训练的情形，以缓解该问题。
AI.method: 定义"单一栽培鲁棒性"并用量化k个假设全部误分类的合取错误来刻画；建立复制性与单一栽培鲁棒性之间的意外联系：若基学习器ρ-可复制，则在同一样本上独立运行k次，个体单一栽培错误随k指数收缩，受单次运行误差与ρ控制；并补充最坏情况下的下界证明。
AI.result: 正结果：ρ-可复制基学习器的个体合取错误随k指数衰减；负结果：对个体单一栽培鲁棒性，将合取错误降至γ最坏情况下需样本量倍数t=Ω(log(1/γ))。
AI.conclusion: 可复制性是实现单一栽培鲁棒性的有效途径，且样本量代价与log(1/γ)成正比，为同一数据下训练多样且联合可靠的模型提供了理论基础与下界刻画。

title: Training Denoising Models of Any Architecture Without Stored Images
summary: Can a pretrained denoising model replace the dataset used to train it? We investigate this question through teacher-supervised training, showing for the first time that continuous-time diffusion and flow models of any architecture and size can be trained from random initialization without stored images. Our students regress the teacher's velocity on a rolling pool of noisy samples, advanced along trajectories of random step counts to obtain independent, dense and approximately continuous noise levels. This saves considerable storage for large datasets and applies even when the data are unreleased or private. Our experiments include 12 teachers of 6 families and 6 datasets. Our method outperforms standard training of the same network on CIFAR-10 for students 4x smaller than the teacher, comes within 0.75 to 1.92 FID of it at the teacher's size and surpasses training on teacher-generated images and step reduction methods without teacher-based initialization. Our code is available at https://github.com/mever-team/ddm.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次证明任意架构与规模的连续时间扩散/流模型可以在不存储任何图像的情况下、从随机初始化开始，通过教师监督训练获得，并且效果超过在CIFAR-10上的标准训练。
AI.motivation: 大型数据集存储开销巨大，且很多数据未公开或涉及隐私，因此作者想探究预训练去噪模型能否替代其原始训练数据集来训练新模型。
AI.method: 采用教师监督训练：学生模型在滚动更新的噪声样本池上回归教师的速度场，样本沿随机步数的轨迹推进，从而获得独立、稠密且近似连续的噪声水平。
AI.result: 实验覆盖6个模型家族共12个教师和6个数据集；在CIFAR-10上，比教师小4倍的学生优于同网络标准训练，与教师同尺寸时FID差距仅0.75–1.92，并超过用教师生成图像训练及步数缩减方法（无教师初始化）。
AI.conclusion: 预训练扩散/流模型可作为数据集的替代来训练学生模型，能大幅节省存储并适用于数据未公开或私有的场景，代码已开源。

title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
summary: A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. It served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate precursor, though lower-priority work waited longer at backfill peaks. In steady-capacity real-engine replay, Track ran within 1% of the goodput of a fixed rate tuned above measured capacity, with about a quarter of that rate's refusal share. The shaper carries more than 300 million online requests and hundreds of terabytes of media a day. During a backfill, it handled 1.1 billion requests in its busiest 24 hours. Lessons include keeping queues inside inference engines just long enough to fill batches, steering dispatch by capacity refusals alone, keeping dispatch stateful, and sizing fleets by how long low-priority work can wait.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cap-and-Track，一种面向跨云服务商与内部 GPU 的异步推理调度设计：用饱和资源上的"快速失败"准入检查（Cap）产生拒绝信号，再由有状态调度器（Track）据此向上探测、遇阻退避，从而无需预测输出长度或人工调参即可实时跟随实际容量天花板。该方案在 Meta 已生产落地（图文与直播视频理解）。
AI.motivation: 固定派发速率在推理集群扩容/缩容、请求长度变化时会过时；生成式输出长度在准入时未知；共享服务商池还会掉容量。因此需要一个不依赖输出长度预测、也无需重调集群级速率的自适应调度机制。
AI.method: 1) 在饱和资源处设置 Cap 准入检查，快速失败并拒绝超额请求，作为后端当前容量上限的信号；2) 用持久化优先队列把超额工作（含被拒请求的重试）暂存在执行之外；3) Track 调度器仅依据拒绝信号进行有状态的上探与退避，跟随容量天花板；4) 队列保留在推理引擎内部仅足够凑批的时间。
AI.result: 并发同流量的生产 A/B 中，按副本 Cap+Track 的整形器用少 43% 的 H100 服务该分类器（低优先级任务在回填峰值等待更久）；稳态容量下真实引擎回放中，Track 的 goodput 与高于实测容量的固定速率相差 1% 以内，拒绝率约为其四分之一。系统日承载 3 亿+ 在线请求、数百 TB 媒体，回填期间最忙 24 小时处理 11 亿请求。
AI.conclusion: 经验教训：队列留在引擎内只到凑满批次、仅凭容量拒绝信号驱动派发、派发保持有状态、并按低优先级工作可等待时长来定集群规模。说明基于拒绝反馈的无预测自适应调度在大规模生产可行。

title: Psychometrics-Inspired Coreset Selection for Image Quality Assessment
summary: Collecting large-scale subjective annotations remains a critical bottleneck in training accurate image quality assessment (IQA) models. Coreset selection reduces this burden by selecting representative images before annotation. However, diversity in a visual feature space does not necessarily reflect diversity in perceptual quality, raising a fundamental question about which quality-related factors the representation should encode. We propose GRAM, a quality-aware representation learning framework inspired by the graded response model (GRM) from psychometrics. GRM describes how an individual's latent ability determines the probabilities of reaching successive assessment grades, with response sensitivity and grade thresholds governing this relationship. In this paper, we find that this principle naturally aligns with perceptual quality assessment, where the impact of image degradation depends on image content and distortion characteristics. Building on this connection, GRAM models quality judgments through three complementary factors: latent quality, content-dependent response sensitivity, and distortion-dependent grade thresholds. These factors jointly determine the probabilities of attaining different quality grades and the resulting expected quality score. The learned parameters provide a structured quality-aware representation that complements general visual features for coreset selection. Experiments on nine datasets demonstrate improvements across different selection strategies, downstream IQA models, and annotation budgets. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAM，一种受心理测量学等级反应模型(GRM)启发的质量感知表征学习框架，用潜质量、内容相关敏感性和失真相关阈值三因素建模主观质量判断，为IQA的核心集选择提供质量感知表征，在九个数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 大规模主观标注是训练IQA模型的关键瓶颈。核心集选择可减少标注负担，但视觉特征空间中的多样性未必反映感知质量维度的多样性，因此关键问题是：表征应编码哪些与质量相关的因素。
AI.method: 借鉴心理测量学GRM（潜在能力决定达到各级评分的概率，由响应敏感性与等级阈值调节），将其与感知质量评估对齐：图像退化的影响取决于内容与失真特性。GRAM通过潜质量、内容依赖的响应敏感性、失真依赖的等级阈值三个互补因素，联合决定达到不同质量等级的概率及期望质量分数；所学参数构成结构化质量感知表征，与通用视觉特征互补用于核心集选择。
AI.result: 在九个数据集上，跨不同选择策略、下游IQA模型和标注预算均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 将心理测量学模型引入IQA表征学习是可行且有效的，质量感知表征能显著改善核心集选择效果；代码将公开。

title: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
summary: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation suite that combines utility of user simulators for evaluating agents and two measures of fidelity to real users: population-level fidelity assesses collective interaction patterns, while trace-level fidelity assesses the preservation of individual users' goals, constraints, and persona. Under the same detection criterion, our evaluation suite detects all 10 perturbations. Evaluating six user simulators on 351 real multi-turn sessions in which 348 distinct users across 23 languages and agents work together to create and refine artifacts such as full-stack web apps, games, design assets, and automated workflows, we find that population-level measures can miss when a simulated user pursues the wrong goal, ignores a constraint, or behaves out of character, highlighting the need to assess fidelity at comprehensive granularities.

AI.tldr: 论文对用户模拟器的评估指标进行元评估，发现已有方法只能检测10种注入失败中的5-6种，甚至偏好"接受坏结果"的模拟人群；为此提出融合效用、群体级保真度与轨迹级保真度的新评估套件，可检测全部10种扰动。
AI.motivation: 用户模拟器可规模化评估交互式智能体，但其质量如何评估尚未充分研究。不清楚现有评估框架能否可靠检测模拟用户行为中的实质性失败，导致高分难以解释。作者因此对指标本身做元评估，弄清高分究竟说明什么。
AI.method: 构建对抗式元评估：人为扰动模拟回放，注入10类失败（改变目标、遗漏约束、过早停止、接受坏产出等），检验指标能否检出。随后提出新评估套件：包含模拟器用于评估智能体的效用，以及群体级保真度（集体交互模式）和轨迹级保真度（单用户目标、约束、人设的保持）。在351个真实多轮会话、348名用户、23种语言、多类产物（全栈Web应用、游戏、设计素材、自动化工作流）上评测6个模拟器。
AI.result: 三项先前研究的评估方法仅能检测10种扰动中的5-6种；其合成分数甚至更偏向被指示接受坏结果的模拟人群，而非未修改的对照组。新评估套件在同一检测标准下检出全部10种扰动。实测发现群体级指标会漏检模拟用户追错目标、忽略约束或人设失真等情况。
AI.conclusion: 现有用户模拟器评估指标可靠性不足，会掩盖关键失败甚至给出反向偏好；需在多个粒度上评估保真度。所提评估套件更敏感，强调群体级与轨迹级保真度结合的必要性。

title: ViLFlow: Parallel Vision-Language Generation with Continuous Latent Flows
summary: Vision-language generation has predominantly relied on autoregressive and discrete diffusion models. Autoregressive models generate tokens sequentially, while discrete diffusion models typically predict tokens independently within each denoising step. We propose ViLFlow (Vision-Language Flow), a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding. ViLFlow adapts pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning through learned image guidance and prediction-aware token decoding. A visually adapted teacher provides image-guided predictions as additional denoising supervision. The denoiser learns to reproduce these predictions directly, retaining one image-conditioned prediction per generation step. We train the token decoder on denoiser predictions and paired reference text to improve the conversion of continuous outputs into words. The decoder can be adapted independently, improving answering and captioning without further denoiser training. For captioning, it also supplies text feedback during late denoising, allowing decoded words to inform subsequent refinement. ViLFlow outperforms autoregressive and masked-diffusion baselines by up to 8.46 percentage points on VQAv2 and 4.50 points on GQA without GQA training. On COCO Karpathy test, it improves CIDEr by 16.25 over masked diffusion and 17.81 over sampled autoregression.

AI.tldr: ViLFlow 是一个连续流视觉-语言生成模型，将输出嵌入的联合建模与并行 token 解码结合，在 VQA 和图像描述任务上显著优于自回归与离散扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言生成主要依赖自回归模型（串行生成 token）和离散扩散模型（每步独立预测 token），前者速度受限，后者忽略 token 间依赖。作者希望利用预训练的连续语言生成能力，兼顾并行解码与联合建模。
AI.method: 提出 ViLFlow：将预训练连续语言生成适配到 VQA 与图像描述。核心包括：(1) 学习到的图像引导，由一个视觉适配的教师模型提供图像引导预测作为额外去噪监督，去噪器学习直接复现这些预测，每步保留一个图像条件预测；(2) 预测感知的 token 解码，用去噪器预测与配对参考文本训练解码器，可将连续输出转为词，且该解码器可独立适配而无需再训练去噪器；(3) 在图像描述中，解码器还在后期去噪阶段提供文本反馈，使已解码词参与后续细化。
AI.result: 在 VQAv2 上比自回归和掩码扩散基线最高提升 8.46 个百分点；在未用 GQA 训练的情况下 GQA 提升 4.50 个百分点；在 COCO Karpathy 测试集上，CIDEr 相比掩码扩散提升 16.25，相比采样式自回归提升 17.81。
AI.conclusion: ViLFlow 表明连续流建模结合并行 token 解码是视觉-语言生成的有效范式，可在无需额外去噪训练的情况下独立提升解码器性能，并在多项基准上取得显著收益。

title: Equivariant Modeling with Polynomial Features via Minimal Homogeneous Generators
summary: We present a general framework for modeling and learning equivariant functions between finite dimensional semisimple real group representations, unifying constructions developed across many application areas. Our model is a linear combination of equivariant polynomial features whose coefficients are arbitrary learnable functions of invariant polynomial features. We take as features minimal homogeneous generators for the invariant algebra and the covariant module over the invariant algebra, up to prescribed degrees. We provide a Python package that automatically computes these features and fits the resulting models to training data. The algorithm for feature computation requires explicit isotypic decompositions of the input and output representations, along with explicit Clebsch-Gordan decompositions of the tensor product of irreducible representations, and achieves speedups over alternative methods in computational algebra. Numerical experiments in scientific modeling demonstrate the full learning pipeline and yield accurate predictors with few trainable parameters, using the model both for end-to-end prediction and within layers of larger architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一框架，用于建模和学习有限维半单实群表示之间的等变函数，将众多应用领域的构造统一起来。
AI.motivation: 等变函数建模在不同应用领域中被各自独立地发展，缺乏统一框架；同时希望用可解释、参数极少的模型实现等变学习。
AI.method: 模型是不变多项式特征的可学习函数系数的等变多项式特征的线性组合；以不变代数及其协变模的极小齐次生成元（至指定次数）作为特征。提供Python包自动计算特征并拟合模型。特征算法需要输入/输出表示的显式同型分解，以及张量积不可约表示的显式Clebsch-Gordan分解，在计算代数上比替代方法更快。
AI.result: 在科学建模的数值实验中完整展示了学习流程，得到准确且可训练参数很少的预测器，既可用于端到端预测，也可嵌入更大架构的层中。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了等变函数学习的构造，兼具理论一般性、计算高效性和参数经济性，并有配套工具支持实际使用。

title: End-to-End Landsat Land Surface Temperature Reconstruction with AlphaEarth Embeddings
summary: Land surface temperature (LST) data at Landsat's 30 m resolution is important for many applications, but cloud contamination prevents its spatially continuous observations. Here, we propose A$^2$E$^2$, an end-to-end U-Net that integrates annual temperature cycle (ATC), coarse LST from Earth system modeling, and AlphaEarth embeddings for Landsat LST reconstruction. The ATC supplies a physics-guided thermal prior, the coarse LST provides a temporal background, and the U-Net converts the embedding field into day-specific fine-scale correction using observed pixels. Experimental results on four seasonally distributed Landsat 8/9 scenes over New York City in 2022 show that A$^2$E$^2$ achieves 0.78 K mean absolute error and 1.01 K root mean squared error, reducing error by 60.1% relative to baseline method without spatial correction and by 3.7% relative to the same U-Net guided by annual mean spectral reflectance. Sensitivity analysis shows stable performance regardless of distance to clear pixels and percentage of blocked pixels. Independent validation with ECOSTRESS LST shows that Earth foundation model embeddings have better performance than annual mean spectral bands for LST reconstruction.

AI.tldr: A$^2$E$^2$: 端到端U-Net重建Landsat 30 m地表温度，融合年温度循环、粗分辨率模型LST与AlphaEarth嵌入，在纽约2022年4景上达0.78 K MAE / 1.01 K RMSE。
AI.motivation: Landsat 30 m地表温度（LST）对诸多应用重要，但云污染导致无法获取空间连续观测，需要有效的重建方法。
AI.method: 提出A$^2$E$^2$端到端U-Net，融合三源信息：年温度循环（ATC）提供物理引导的热先验，地球系统模式的粗分辨率LST提供时间背景，AlphaEarth嵌入提供空间特征；U-Net利用观测像元将嵌入场转换为逐日精细尺度校正量。
AI.result: 纽约市2022年四季分布的4景Landsat 8/9影像上，MAE 0.78 K、RMSE 1.01 K，较无空间校正基线误差降低60.1%，较以年均光谱反射率引导的同结构U-Net降低3.7%；对晴空像元距离和被遮挡像元比例均表现稳定；ECOSTRESS LST独立验证显示地球基础模型嵌入优于年均光谱波段。
AI.conclusion: 物理先验与基础模型嵌入相结合可实现高精度、稳健的Landsat LST云下重建，嵌入特征比原始光谱波段更适合该任务。

title: Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation
summary: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. To reduce target fluctuations over long horizons, early goal commitment (EGC) fixes the execution target to the coordinate-wise median of the first $K$ predictions without extra trainable parameters. On Test Unseen, CityNav-VLA reduces NE by 21.2% and improves SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9%, respectively. It also reduces NE by 6.2% and improves SR and SPL by 5.6% and 23.2%, respectively, relative to the former SOTA after dataset refinement. Cumulative ablations show that navigation-map features yield the largest gains, while metric coordinates further improve endpoint accuracy. With a 4B-scale backbone, inference averages 0.68 s per decision with 8.6 GB peak memory on a single A100, presenting remarkable model efficiency.

AI.tldr: CityNav-VLA 提出双帧视觉-语言-动作模型，将动态自我中心感知与持久的异中心空间记忆结合，用于城市语言目标无人机导航。
AI.motivation: 语言目标空中导航需将不断变化的自我中心感知与锚定于稳定位置的空间证据关联起来以支持长距离导航，这是核心难点。
AI.method: 在固定北向地图（初始化地理与地标先验）上增量累积视觉观测，保持跨视角证据；用依赖指令、当前观测、UAV 状态与运动历史的动态查询检索记忆证据并预测地图坐标系目标；确定性控制器将目标转为机体系命令；提出早目标承诺（EGC），用前 K 次预测的逐坐标中位数固定执行目标。
AI.result: Test Unseen 上 NE 降低 21.2%，SR、SPL 提升 15.8% 与 30.9%；数据集精炼后相对前 SOTA，NE 降低 6.2%，SR、SPL 提升 5.6% 与 23.2%。累积消融显示导航地图特征增益最大，度量坐标进一步提升终点精度。4B 骨干下单 A100 平均 0.68 s/决策、峰值内存 8.6 GB。
AI.conclusion: 双帧记忆架构配合 EGC 在城市 UAV 语言导航中显著优于 SOTA，且推理高效、无需额外可训练参数。

title: One Shot, Any View: High-Fidelity Video Reshooting with Geometry Guidance and Visual References
summary: Filming a scene from an additional angle after production usually requires a costly reshoot. We present One Shot Any View, a system that takes a recorded clip and generates a reshot video of the same performance along a user-specified camera trajectory. As in recent geometry-grounded methods, the system conditions generation on the source video and an explicit 3D prior, namely a point video rendered along the requested trajectory from a feed-forward reconstruction of the source video. We target human-centric cinematic videos, which are often shot with long lenses, shallow depth of field, and low-key lighting, all of which degrade feed-forward reconstruction. Existing geometry-grounded methods tend to inherit the degraded point video, and their output quality drops visibly. Two designs make such point videos usable. First, in addition to rendered videos of 3D assets, we train on real-world multi-camera videos, whose point videos are produced by the same reconstruction pipeline as at inference. This training-inference consistency enables the generator to take only the composition of people and scene elements from the point video, and their appearance from the source video. Second, a geometry-anchored RoPE offset keeps the generated video temporally synchronized with the source while largely preventing the output from copying the degraded appearance of the point video. Meanwhile, since the generator is a pretrained reference-to-video (R2V) model, the system also accepts optional character and scene reference images, which supply the appearance of regions that the source never shows. In both objective and human evaluations, One Shot Any View outperforms existing reshooting methods.

AI.tldr: 提出One Shot Any View系统，从已拍摄视频和用户指定的相机轨迹生成同一表演的"补拍"视频，通过训练-推理一致的多相机真实数据训练与几何锚定RoPE偏移，使退化点云视频仍可被生成器有效利用，在客观与人工评测中超越现有重拍方法。
AI.motivation: 制作后追加角度拍摄通常需昂贵重拍。现有基于几何先验（前馈重建得到的点视频）的重拍方法，在长焦、浅景深、低调光的人像电影视频上重建质量差，生成器直接继承退化的点视频导致输出质量明显下降。
AI.method: 1) 条件化为源视频 + 沿目标轨迹渲染的显式3D点视频先验；2) 除3D资产渲染视频外，加入真实多相机视频训练，其点视频由与推理相同的重建流程产生，实现训练-推理一致性，使生成器仅从点视频取人物与场景的构图、从源视频取外观；3) 几何锚定RoPE偏移，保持生成视频与源视频时间同步，同时抑制复制点视频的退化外观；4) 基于预训练R2V模型，可接受可选的角色与场景参考图以补全源视频未展示区域的外观。
AI.result: 在客观指标与人工评测中，One Shot Any View均优于现有重拍方法，即便点视频因长焦/浅景深/低调光而退化仍能保持输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练-推理一致的数据设计与几何锚定RoPE偏移，可让退化的点视频在几何接地式视频生成中仍可用，实现单段素材的任意视角重拍，并借参考图扩展源视频未覆盖区域的外观。

title: Spark-H3: Adaptive Block Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Long video sequences make attention a substantial cost in video diffusion models. Block sparse attention (BSA) reduces this cost by computing selected blocks exactly while compressing the remaining blocks. However, fixed token grouping can place tokens with dissimilar attention preferences in the same group, while uniform key averaging can underestimate the attention mass of compressed blocks. We introduce Spark-Attn, a training-free BSA method comprising Spark-Reblock and Spark-Reweight. Spark-Reblock recursively groups tokens by attention preference while preserving regular block shapes for efficient GPU execution. Spark-Reweight uses the global mean query as an anchor to construct attention-weighted key-value representations and logit biases for the compressed blocks, calibrating their attention mass. We instantiate Spark-Attn in MiniMax-H3 as Spark-H3. At 10% exact-block density, Spark-H3 delivers a 2.49$\times$ DiT speedup and reaches 24.81 dB PSNR against the corresponding dense outputs on MiniMax-H3 (20 denoising steps, 345 frames, 1344$\times$768). Increasing the density to 20% further improves PSNR to 26.76 dB while still achieving a 2.26$\times$ DiT speedup. These results demonstrate that Spark-H3 achieves a state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-off for training-free BSA on video diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练块稀疏注意力方法Spark-Attn（含Spark-Reblock与Spark-Reweight），在视频扩散模型中实现高效且高质量的长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 长视频序列使注意力成为视频扩散模型的主要计算开销。块稀疏注意力(BSA)通过精确计算选中块、压缩其余块来降本，但固定的token分组会把注意力偏好不同的token分到同组，且均匀的key平均会低估压缩块的注意力质量。
AI.method: Spark-Attn为免训练BSA方法，包含两部分：Spark-Reblock按注意力偏好递归地对token分组，同时保持规则块形状以便GPU高效执行；Spark-Reweight以全局平均query为锚点，为压缩块构造注意力加权的key-value表示与logit偏置，以校准其注意力质量。方法在MiniMax-H3上实例化为Spark-H3。
AI.result: 10%精确块密度下，Spark-H3实现2.49× DiT加速，相对稠密输出达到24.81 dB PSNR（20步去噪、345帧、1344×768）；密度提升至20%时PSNR升至26.76 dB，仍有2.26×加速。
AI.conclusion: Spark-H3在视频扩散模型的免训练块稀疏注意力上取得了当前最优的质量-效率权衡。

title: Do Thinking VLMs Need to Keep Looking at Long Videos? Write It Down, Then Look Away
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) reason about long videos over hundreds to thousands of tokens. Every decoding step re-reads the key-value (KV) cache of the entire video. Must the model keep looking while it reasons? In LookAway, the model first writes timestamped notes on what the question needs and then puts the video away. Once the notes close, the inference engine hides the video's KV cache for the rest of the response. Across both hybrid and pure-attention VLMs, dependence on the video is concentrated early in the response. On Qwen3.6-27B, writing notes preserves accuracy better than free reasoning at the same withdrawal step. Replacing them with another video's notes harms accuracy, whereas keeping the video visible alongside the model's own notes adds no significant benefit. Without additional training, LookAway nearly matches full-video thinking accuracy at 0.12-0.13 times its modeled decode cost. To shorten this initial look, we fine-tune the model on its own correct LookAway responses. Reinforcement learning then rewards correct answers while penalizing KV reads. The trained model puts the video away after a median of 66-68 tokens. Across three held-out benchmarks, it writes more tokens than an identically trained full-video model yet reads only 27-35% as many KV positions at matched accuracy.

AI.tldr: LookAway 让视觉语言模型先为问题写带时间戳的笔记，随后在剩余推理中隐藏视频 KV cache，以 0.12–0.13 倍解码成本接近完整视频推理精度。
AI.motivation: 长视频 VLM 推理需处理数百至数千 token，每个解码步都要重读整段视频的 KV cache，代价高昂；作者质疑"边推理边必须一直看视频"这一默认假设。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) 免训练——模型先写带时间戳的笔记，笔记写完即让推理引擎隐藏视频 KV cache；(2) 微调——在模型自身正确的 LookAway 回答上微调，再用强化学习同时奖励答对、惩罚 KV 读取，以压缩初始"观看"阶段。
AI.result: 对视频的依赖集中在回答早期；相同撤回步上写笔记比自由推理保精度更好，换成其他视频的笔记会掉精度，而保留视频可见也无显著增益。免训练版精度接近全视频推理，成本仅 0.12–0.13 倍；训练版中位 66–68 token 即撤下视频，在三个留出基准上以持平精度仅读取 27–35% 的 KV 位置（token 数反而更多）。
AI.conclusion: 视频证据只需在推理早期被"记下"而无需持续重读，可大幅降低长视频 VLM 解码成本且不损精度；笔记质量是关键，且可通过自蒸馏+RL 学到更短的观看窗口。

title: Look Closer, Look Back, or Wait for Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video models must answer questions about a live video under strict memory and latency limits. Feeding only the latest few frames keeps present perception sharp, whereas adding past frames dilutes attention on the current scene and triggers hallucinations. Recent cascade methods retrieve past frames when uncertain, but they still fail when current frames are blurry or when decisive future clues have not appeared yet. We introduce ActiveForager, a streaming video agent that maintains a clean short working window and gathers extra evidence only on demand. For each query, the agent either answers directly, zooms into high-resolution recent frames, recalls past events from memory, or waits for upcoming frames. When recalling history, a shared-weight sub-agent verifies candidate clips in isolation and returns a compact evidence summary. A stream-decoupled attention mask then keeps historical evidence from interfering with present visual tokens. We train this policy using counterfactual information gain, which rewards a tool call only when the gathered evidence makes the true answer more likely and prevents tool collapse across all actions. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B on OVO-Bench, ActiveForager improves real-time perception, historical recall, and proactive response at once, lifting overall accuracy on Qwen3-VL-8B from 47.6% to 65.9%. It also doubles zero-shot accuracy on the multi-hop Video-Holmes benchmark while adding minimal visual tokens per query.

AI.tldr: ActiveForager：在流式视频问答中维护干净的短工作窗口，按需调用"放大/回忆/等待"工具，并用反事实信息增益训练策略，在Qwen3-VL-8B上把OVO-Bench总体准确率从47.6%提升到65.9%。
AI.motivation: 流式视频模型受内存与延迟限制：只用最近几帧则缺乏历史信息，加入历史帧又会稀释对当前场景的注意力并引发幻觉。现有级联式检索方法在不确信时才回看，但在当前帧模糊或关键线索尚未出现时会失败。
AI.method: 构建流式视频智能体：每查询可选直接回答、放大高清近帧、从记忆回忆过去事件、或等待未来帧。回忆时由共享权重子智能体独立核验候选片段并返回紧凑证据摘要；用流解耦注意力掩码阻止历史证据干扰当前视觉token；以反事实信息增益训练策略（仅当证据提高真实答案概率才奖励工具调用），防止工具坍缩。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与Qwen3-VL-8B上，OVO-Bench的实时感知、历史回忆与主动响应均提升，Qwen3-VL-8B总体准确率47.6%→65.9%；Video-Holmes多跳零样本准确率翻倍，且每查询仅增加极少视觉token。
AI.conclusion: 按需取证+干净工作窗口+流解耦注意力的主动式流式智能体，可在低延迟低内存约束下同时改善当前感知、历史回忆与前瞻响应。

title: Semantic Guidance for Joint Infrared-Visible Video Fusion and Frame Interpolation
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion at high frame rates requires recovering missing observations when camera rates differ or fall below the desired output rate. Cascading interpolation and fusion can accumulate errors and cause brightness fluctuations. Motion and occlusion further complicate content selection, particularly when missing visible frames also remove direct semantic guidance. We propose SAFI, which uses semantics at the target time to guide joint interpolation and fusion. When the visible frame rate exceeds the infrared rate, available visible frames provide semantic context directly. At times without visible observations, motion guides local matching, and propagation recovers semantics from neighboring frames. Semantic context complements aligned image features at the target time, while matching confidence helps select reliable infrared and visible information. Reconstruction and fusion share source selection within each scale, allowing supervision on missing frames to guide fusion. To preserve visible appearance and reduce flicker, we bound thermal enhancement and penalize brightness inconsistencies across frames while accounting for changes in thermal contrast. Experiments on three datasets show improved visual quality with less computation than cascaded baselines and consistent temporal gains when input rates differ. SAFI maintains strong downstream tracking performance despite missing frames. The code is available at https://github.com/XylonXu01/SAFI.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFI，用目标时刻的语义引导联合插值与融合，缓解红外-可见视频高帧率融合中的缺失帧问题。
AI.motivation: 红外与可见视频在相机帧率不同或低于目标输出帧率时需恢复缺失观测；级联插值+融合会累积误差并导致亮度波动；运动与遮挡使内容选择困难，且缺失可见帧会失去直接语义引导。
AI.method: SAFI在目标时刻使用语义引导联合插值与融合：可见帧率高于红外时直接用可见语义；无可见观测时用运动引导局部匹配并从邻近帧传播语义；语义上下文补充对齐后的图像特征，匹配置信度用于选择可靠的红外/可见信息；各尺度上重建与融合共享源选择，使缺失帧的监督可指导融合；限制热增强并惩罚跨帧亮度不一致（考虑热对比变化）以保持可见外观、减少闪烁。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上视觉质量提升，计算量低于级联基线；输入帧率不同时具有一致的时间增益；在缺失帧情况下仍保持较强的下游跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 联合语义引导的插值-融合框架能有效处理帧率不匹配与缺失帧，兼顾质量、效率与时序一致性，并支撑下游任务。

title: CROMPT: Adapting CLIP via Cross-Modal Prompting for Robust Zero-Shot Generalization under Adverse Weather
summary: Domain adaptation for semantic segmentation is challenging when target-domain images are unavailable during training. Zero-shot domain adaptation addresses this by adapting models using only textual descriptions of the target domain. However, existing prompt-learning methods are not well suited for ResNet-based CLIP vision backbones or pixel-level cross-modal feature alignment. We propose CROMPT, a prompt-learning framework for zero-shot domain adaptation in semantic segmentation. CROMPT introduces Cross-Modal Feature Augmentation (CROMA), combining Random Visual Prompting with Hybrid Textual Prompting (HTP) to jointly adapt visual and textual representations. We further propose CROMA-VL, which leverages vision-language models to generate domain-conditioned prompts, and a progressive easy-to-hard adaptation strategy for improved domain invariance. Experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods, achieving 1.63-2.63% mIoU gains while maintaining inference-time complexity. These results establish CROMPT as an effective and efficient framework for zero-shot multi-domain semantic segmentation. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=FxqFsIL685

AI.tldr: 提出CROMPT提示学习框架，用于训练时无目标域图像的零样本域自适应语义分割，通过跨模态特征增强联合适配视觉与文本表征，取得1.63-2.63% mIoU提升。
AI.motivation: 零样本域自适应语义分割中目标域图像不可用，仅依赖文本描述适配模型；但现有提示学习方法不适用于ResNet类CLIP视觉主干，也难以实现像素级跨模态特征对齐。
AI.method: CROMPT框架包含：跨模态特征增强CROMA，结合随机视觉提示与混合文本提示HTP联合适配视觉与文本表征；CROMA-VL利用视觉-语言模型生成域条件提示；以及由易到难的渐进式自适应策略以提升域不变性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上稳定优于强基线与SOTA方法，mIoU提升1.63-2.63%，且推理时复杂度保持不变。
AI.conclusion: CROMPT是面向零样本多域语义分割的有效且高效框架。

title: AnchorUp: Anchoring Feature Upsampling on a Classical Interpolation
summary: Vision foundation models produce semantically strong features on a coarse patch grid, and dense prediction needs them at pixel resolution. Existing learned upsamplers close that gap by regressing the high-resolution feature map from the low-resolution one, typically through cross-attention driven by the input image. We observe that most of what they regress needs no learning: plain bilinear interpolation already reproduces the smooth regions of the target, and recent benchmarks even report bilinear and bicubic on par with several learned upsamplers. The rest is mostly edges and fine details, which suggests that these learned upsamplers spend much of their capacity re-computing the smooth content that classical interpolation provides. We therefore introduce AnchorUp, which stops predicting the high-resolution feature map and predicts only its correction from the interpolation. It keeps a parameter-free classical upsampler as an anchor, obtains a second prediction from a small guidance network, and blends the two through a single learnable scalar gate. Because the anchor supplies the smooth content, the guidance network only has to correct what remains. An analysis of the learned correction confirms that it concentrates on edges and fine details, and so the network can be small: AnchorUp uses 167,425 parameters, a quarter of the budget of the strongest baseline, NAF, and runs at 64% of its latency. Trained once on DINOv3 with only the first of NAF's two training stages, and evaluated on that backbone plus six held-out ones, it is already on par with NAF trained through both stages on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes. Our method surpasses it on DAVIS-2017 video object segmentation; the gain holds on every backbone and is larger in contour accuracy F. Code is available at https://github.com/KotaroHorikawa/AnchorUp.

AI.tldr: AnchorUp提出残差式上采样：以无参数双线性插值为锚点，只学习高频校正项，并以单个标量门融合，用约1/4参数量达到甚至超过NAF的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型特征在粗patch网格上语义强，但密集预测需像素级分辨率。现有学习式上采样器从低分辨率特征回归高分辨率特征图（常借交叉注意力），但观察到大部分目标内容无需学习——平滑区域可由双线性/双三次插值直接获得，且基准显示经典插值已与多种学习式上采样器相当；真正需要学习的主要是边缘与细节，学习式方法把大量容量浪费在重复计算平滑内容上。
AI.method: 不再预测高分辨率特征图本身，而只预测其相对插值的校正量：1) 以无参数经典上采样器（双线性）作为锚点提供平滑内容；2) 小引导网络给出第二个预测；3) 通过一个可学习标量门将两者混合。对学习到的校正的分析验证其集中于边缘与细细节，因此引导网络可以很小（167,425参数，为最强基线NAF的1/4，延迟为其64%）。仅在DINOv3上单阶段训练（NAF两阶段中的第一阶段）。
AI.result: 在DINOv3及六个留出backbone上评测：Pascal VOC与Cityscapes上与经两阶段训练的NAF持平；在DAVIS-2017视频目标分割上优于NAF，且该增益在每个backbone上都成立，在轮廓精度F上提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: 将上采样重构为"经典插值锚点+小网络残差校正+标量门融合"是一种参数高效、低延迟的范式，说明学习式上采样器的容量大量冗余；方法泛化到多个未见backbone，尤其利于边界敏感任务。代码已开源。

title: Fuse to Recognize the Unseen: Class-Relative Infrared-Visible Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Visible-infrared image fusion leverages complementary thermal cues to enhance visual perception, particularly under challenging illumination. However, such perceptual complementarity does not readily translate into semantic gains in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS), where CLIP-based models are predominantly pretrained on RGB imagery. Directly introducing IR information may instead disrupt RGB-language alignment, turning promising thermal cues into semantic interference that undermines unseen-class recognition. Our pixel-level RGB-IR semantic analysis reveals that class-relevant thermal cues can correct certain RGB misclassifications while preserving reliable RGB predictions, motivating RGB-anchored, class-relative thermal cue selection. Based on this insight, we propose EmergeFuse, an infrared-visible fusion framework for OVSS that selectively converts complementary thermal evidence into unseen-class semantic corrections. Specifically, class-relative cue selection evaluates RGB-IR semantic responses and calibrated thermal evidence relative to RGB predictions, generating class-relative correction requests through competitive selection. Text-contrast image rectification then translates these selected requests into semantic rectification directions through text contrasts, guiding evidence-gated feature updates to realize complementary thermal evidence for unseen-class recognition. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate gains of up to 4.755% in unseen-class mIoU and 15.730% in strict complementary conversion rate over existing fusion methods, while maintaining competitive fusion quality.

AI.tldr: 提出EmergeFuse红外-可见光融合框架，通过类相对热线索选择将互补红外信息转化为开放词汇语义分割的未见类修正，避免破坏RGB-语言对齐。
AI.motivation: 可见-红外融合能提升视觉感知，但CLIP类模型在RGB图像上预训练，直接引入红外信息可能破坏RGB-语言对齐，反而造成语义干扰、损害开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）中的未见类识别。
AI.method: 像素级RGB-IR语义分析显示：类相关热线索可纠正部分RGB误分类同时保留可靠RGB预测，据此设计两模块：(1) 类相对线索选择——评估RGB-IR语义响应与校准热证据相对RGB预测的关系，经竞争式选择生成类相对修正请求；(2) 文本对比图像修正——用文本对比将修正请求转为语义修正方向，引导证据门控的特征更新。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，未见类mIoU最多提升4.755%，严格互补转化率最多提升15.730%，同时保持有竞争力的融合质量。
AI.conclusion: 以RGB为锚、相对类进行热线索选择，可将互补红外证据有效转化为未见类语义修正，在不损害RGB语义对齐的前提下提升OVSS性能。

title: Pixel2Perspective: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal and Multi-View Generalization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Embodied AI systems, such as drones and autonomous vehicles, improve navigation by enhancing perception in environments containing unseen objects. While Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer strong image understanding, their real-world application is underexplored. For effective deployment, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) models, leveraging models like CLIP to assign pixel-level labels from text, must be robust to outdoor conditions, adverse weather, and varying viewpoints. Despite their potential, these models encounter significant challenges in cross-domain generalization, hindering their practical use in embodied AI applications. In this work, we present Pixel2Perspective, a benchmark for multi-angle object localization and open-vocabulary segmentation across both aerial and ground perspectives. This benchmark supports thorough evaluation across different viewpoints and sensor modalities. We assess foundational models like CLIP and advanced OVSS models using a curated dataset that spans varied outdoor conditions, sim-to-real scenarios, and multiple sensors, including infrared, to support the development of robust and generalizable perception systems. We also present a novel framework, Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification (MSRIQ), which jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties across RGB and infrared imagery. This approach supports robust evaluation of open-vocabulary segmentation models across diverse environmental conditions. Our work sets a robustness-driven benchmark, providing key insights and laying the foundation for future research in open-world embodied AI perception. The benchmark and project page are available at https://aniruddhsikdar1.github.io/publications/pixel2perspective/

AI.tldr: 论文提出Pixel2Perspective基准，用于多视角（空中/地面）开放词汇目标定位与分割评测，并提出MSRIQ框架在RGB-IR上联合建模不确定性。
AI.motivation: 具身AI（无人机、自动驾驶）需在含未见物体的环境中提升感知。VLM图像理解强但落地不足；OVSS模型跨域泛化差，缺乏覆盖多视角、恶劣天气、仿真到现实、多传感器（含红外）的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Pixel2Perspective基准：跨空中与地面视角、覆盖多变户外条件、sim-to-real、多传感器（含红外）的精选数据集，支持多角度定位与OVSS评估；并评估CLIP等基础模型与先进OVSS模型。另提出MSRIQ框架，在RGB与红外图像上同时建模偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。
AI.result: 通过多视角、多模态、多条件下对CLIP及先进OVSS模型的评测，揭示其在跨域泛化上的不足；MSRIQ实现对开放词汇分割模型在多样环境下的稳健性量化评估。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了以鲁棒性为导向的基准，提供了关键洞见，为开放世界具身AI感知的后续研究奠定基础；基准与项目页已公开。

title: Can Weight-Space Programming Alter Learned Ethical Priorities?
summary: We investigate whether a weight edit can alter how a model trades off honoring a commitment against benefiting more people. In a concept-supervised text model, we alter fitted choice weights so that the benefit required to override a formal pledge is larger than for an ordinary promise. Across six independently trained text readers, the edit selects the larger group in both orders on 100% of targeted ordinary conflicts and 83.3% of targeted formal conflicts. It preserves the source model's success rates on smaller conflicts and its factual accuracy. The remaining formal-conflict failures coincide with errors reading a beneficiary number. A separate classifier demonstrates why this distinction matters: reusing a factual answer passes an unconditional choice test but fails to preserve small-gap promises. In a YOLO11n pilot on COCO128, a bias edit increased small-target matches from 3/43 to 9/43, and an equivalent score calibration reproduced the retained detections. These exploratory results show a way to test selective changes to learned priorities in a model with an exposed trade-off mechanism. Whether the method can discover such changes in less structured language models remains open.

AI.tldr: 研究通过权重编辑改变模型在"遵守承诺"与"惠及更多人"之间的权衡；定向编辑在多个文本模型上选择更大群体，且在视觉模型偏差编辑中也显示类似可定位效果。
AI.motivation: 作者想检验能否通过编辑模型权重来改变其学习到的价值优先级（承诺 vs. 惠及更多人），并区分"复述事实答案"与"真正保留小差距承诺"的不同。
AI.method: 在概念监督的文本模型上编辑拟合选择权重，使推翻正式誓言所需收益大于普通承诺；用六个独立训练的文本读取器测试定向冲突表现，并用分类器对比无条件选择测试与小差距承诺测试；另在COCO128上对YOLO11n做偏差编辑试点。
AI.result: 文本模型中，编辑在100%的定向普通冲突和83.3%的定向正式冲突上选择更大群体，并保留小冲突成功率与事实准确性；剩余失败与受益人数读取错误相关。YOLO11n上小目标匹配从3/43提升至9/43，等效分数校准可复现保留的检测。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了在具有显式权衡机制的模型中测试选择性优先级改变的方法；但能否在结构更弱的语言模型中发现此类改变仍待研究。

title: OCTR2A: Real-Time RGB-to-BEV Trajectory Projection and Forecasting at Urban Intersections
summary: Trajectory forecasting at urban intersections is often studied assuming that reliable bird's-eye-view (BEV) motion histories are available, which in practice requires costly resources such as LiDAR, aerial views, HD maps, or calibrated infrastructure. We address this upstream perception-to-forecasting problem by reconstructing and predicting agents' BEV trajectories only from paired opposite-corner RGB cameras mounted on existing urban infrastructure at variable heights at inference time. We introduce the Opposite-Corner Trajectory Reconstruction and Anticipation Architecture (OCTR2A), a modular pipeline integrating per-view detection with class refinement, geometric cross-camera matching, transformer-based BEV projection, and egocentric GRU forecasting, trained in cascade and mainly supervised with a soft multi-scale spatial-overlap loss. Since no public benchmark provides this sensing configuration, we introduce R3ST++, a Blender-based synthetic benchmark built from SIND trajectories that provides synchronized opposite-corner views, cross-view correspondences, and BEV ground truth, while also serving as a deployment-support simulator for site-specific fine-tuning. Experiments on these datasets show that, with 12 observed and 12 predicted frames at 10\,Hz, OCTR2A achieves projection~-~forecasting ADE/FDE of 0.144/0.140~-~0.154/0.241~meters in real time on a single consumer GPU. Evaluated on ground-truth BEV histories, the forecasting module improves over the strongest state-of-the-art methods on SIND by 66.7\%/41.7\% ADE/FDE. Transfer experiments on TUMTraf-V2X show that R3ST++ pretraining supports adaptation to real-world roadside domains with different sensing configurations.

AI.tldr: OCTR2A仅用现有城市基础设施上的对向角RGB相机，端到端重建并预测BEV轨迹，实时高精度，并配套R3ST++合成基准。
AI.motivation: 现有交叉口轨迹预测假设已有可靠BEV运动历史，实际需LiDAR、航拍、高精地图或标定设施等昂贵资源。本文直面上游“感知到预测”问题，探索仅用低成本对向角RGB相机完成BEV轨迹重建与预测。
AI.method: 提出模块化流水线OCTR2A：单视角检测+类别细化、几何跨相机匹配、基于Transformer的BEV投影、自中心GRU预测；级联训练，主要用软多尺度空间重叠损失监督。由于缺少公开基准，构建基于SIND轨迹的Blender合成基准R3ST++，提供同步对向视角、跨视角对应及BEV真值，并可作为部署支持的仿真器用于定点微调。
AI.result: 在12帧观测/12帧预测、10Hz下，单张消费级GPU实时运行，投影-预测ADE/FDE为0.144/0.140~0.154/0.241米；在GT BEV历史上，预测模块较SIND最强SOTA提升66.7%/41.7% ADE/FDE；在TUMTraf-V2X迁移实验表明R3ST++预训练可支持适应不同感知配置的真实路侧域。
AI.conclusion: 低成本对向角相机可实现实时的BEV轨迹重建与预测，合成预训练有助真实域迁移，为部署友好型路侧轨迹预测提供可行方案。

title: SCOUT: Risk-Guided Foundation-Model Escalation for Robust Tissue Detection in Whole-Slide Images
summary: Reliable tissue detection is essential for whole-slide image analysis, yet high average segmentation accuracy can conceal failures involving pale tissue, small fragments, and heterogeneous staining. Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations, but exhaustive inference is computationally demanding and may introduce false-positive tissue predictions. We propose SCOUT (Selective Correction of Uncertain Tissue), a risk-guided cascade that selectively refines an initial thumbnail-based tissue mask. A lightweight audit network estimates the spatial distribution of segmentation errors and prioritizes candidate regions for processing by a frozen pathology foundation model. An asymmetric consensus rule integrates the resulting predictions with the initial mask to recover missed tissue while limiting false positives. A calibrated slide-level review score additionally controls the marginal rate of unflagged case-group failures under the calibration assumptions. Evaluation on a public multi-source, multi-stain benchmark shows that SCOUT reduces the proportion of case groups requiring mask correction from 38.1% for the best released detector to 18.6%, with particularly pronounced improvements in immunohistochemistry. Source-held-out experiments demonstrate better generalization than a segmentation network trained on the same annotations, while selective inference achieves an observed failure rate no higher than processing all candidate regions. Downstream, lymph-node classification with SCOUT masks is non-inferior to that obtained with two of the three released detectors evaluated. A variant built on an openly licensed foundation model is publicly released as an installable Python package with trained weights. These results support risk-guided foundation-model inference as an effective approach to tissue detection across heterogeneous histopathology data.

AI.tldr: SCOUT是一种风险引导的级联框架，先由缩略图生成初始组织掩膜，再用轻量审计网络定位可能的分割错误区域，仅对这些区域调用冻结的病理基础模型进行选择性修正，并以非对称共识规则融合结果。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像分析中，高平均分割精度会掩盖淡色组织、小碎片和染色异质等失败情形；直接全量推理基础模型计算代价高，还可能引入假阳性组织预测。
AI.method: SCOUT包含三部分：（1）轻量审计网络估计分割误差的空间分布，筛选候选区域；（2）由冻结的病理基础模型仅对候选区域推理；（3）非对称共识规则将新预测与初始掩膜融合，以召回漏检组织且抑制假阳性。另有校准的切片级复核分数控制未标记病例组失败的边缘率。
AI.result: 在公开多源多染色基准上，需人工修正掩膜的病例组比例由最佳已发布检测器的38.1%降至18.6%，免疫组化提升尤为明显；源数据留出实验泛化性优于同标注训练的专用分割网络，选择性推理失败率不高于全量处理；下游淋巴结分类性能与三个已发布检测器中的两个非劣。
AI.conclusion: 风险引导的基础模型推理是应对异质病理数据组织检测的有效方案；基于开放许可基础模型的版本已作为可安装Python包及权重公开。

title: One Affinity, Two Axes: Bidirectional Slot Attention for Iterative Aggregation across the Structure--Detail Spectrum in Visual Retrieval
summary: Aggregating dense patch tokens into compact and discriminative global descriptors is central to visual retrieval. Although foundation models provide rich local features, existing aggregation heads still rely on single-pass mappings and lack an explicit mechanism to coordinate structural and fine-grained cues. Therefore, we propose Bidirectional Slot Attention (BiSA), which reformulates aggregation as an iterative coupled system. Cross-Axis Consensus (CAC) progressively refines learnable slots by interpreting a single shared token--slot affinity along two complementary axes. Along the competition axis, slots vie for each token under a temperature shared across all of them, determining token ownership and inducing a non-redundant scene decomposition. Along the selection axis, a slot-specific temperature governs the breadth of each slot's response, spanning a spectrum from broad layouts to sparse fine-grained details. Their consensus couples non-redundant decomposition with multi-granular slot specialization. Furthermore, the two axes expose intrinsic token-reliability cues at no extra cost: a token's claim strength under competition and its salience under selection. Progressive Token Filtering (PTF) converts these cues into a retention probability that down-weights unreliable tokens before the next CAC iteration, without any segmentation branch or external prior, forming a self-reinforcing loop of competitive decomposition, selective focusing, and feedback purification. Across all three retrieval tasks, BiSA leads on five of six place recognition benchmarks (+4.2 R@1 on Baidu Mall), tops all 16 metrics of drone--satellite geo-localization (+8.4 R@1 at 150 m), and improves instance-level retrieval on ROxford-Hard by 4.5 mAP points. Notably, the selection axis adds only 20 learnable scalars, yet improves average R@1 by 2.8 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向槽注意力BiSA，将视觉检索中的token聚合重构为迭代耦合系统，通过跨轴共识与渐进token过滤实现结构+细粒度协同的全局描述子，在多个检索任务上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉检索需要把稠密patch token聚合成紧凑且有判别力的全局描述子。基础模型虽提供丰富局部特征，但现有聚合头依赖单次映射，缺乏显式机制协调结构性与细粒度线索。
AI.method: 提出BiSA，把聚合建模为迭代耦合系统。核心为跨轴共识CAC：沿同一token-slot亲和度的两个互补轴逐步精化可学习槽。竞争轴：所有槽共享温度竞争token归属，形成非冗余场景分解；选择轴：每个槽有独立温度控制响应广度，覆盖从整体布局到稀疏细节。两轴还免费暴露token可靠性线索，渐进token过滤PTF将其转为保留概率，在下轮迭代前降权不可靠token，无需分割分支或外部先验，形成"竞争分解—选择性聚焦—反馈净化"自增强循环。
AI.result: 三个检索任务中：地点识别6个基准中5个领先（Baidu Mall R@1 +4.2）；无人机-卫星地理定位16项指标全第一（150m处R@1 +8.4）；ROxford-Hard实例检索mAP +4.5。选择轴仅增加20个可学习标量，却使平均R@1提升2.8。
AI.conclusion: BiSA以轻量设计显式耦合结构分解与多粒度专化，并通过自增强过滤提升token可靠性，验证了迭代双轴聚合在多种视觉检索任务上的有效性与高效性。

title: CanopyKV: Remember beyond the Crop for Fast Active Visual Reasoning
summary: Active visual reasoning enables multimodal models to answer challenging visual questions by gathering fine-grained evidence through iterative image inspection and tool use. However, accumulating crops and reasoning tokens expands the key-value (KV) cache, making compression important for reducing memory and inference costs. Existing KV compression methods typically select historical tokens based on attention, recency, or redundancy. These criteria do not explicitly distinguish locally replaced evidence from complementary information needed for future exploration: each crop refreshes a local region, while earlier views may still support subsequent decisions. Discarding such evidence can impair accuracy or require additional search, while scoring and cache reorganization can offset the computational savings from compression. We introduce CanopyKV, a training-free KV compression framework that uses parent-child crop relationships to retain complementary evidence, keeps retained history stable, and protects the state needed for ongoing reasoning. Tool metadata provides retention signals without additional attention scoring, while compact KV storage reduces subsequent attention costs. Across VisualProbe, V*, HR-Bench, and MME-Lite, CanopyKV achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and end-to-end efficiency among the evaluated KV compression methods. On MME-Lite, it retains approximately one-quarter of Dense's total KV while improving accuracy by 10.5 percentage points and accelerating complete reasoning by $1.64\times$.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练KV压缩框架CanopyKV，利用父子裁剪关系保留互补证据，在多基准上实现SOTA精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉推理通过迭代图像检查与工具调用积累裁剪和推理token，导致KV缓存膨胀、内存与推理成本高。现有KV压缩方法基于注意力、近因性或冗余性选择历史token，无法区分"被局部替换的证据"与"未来探索所需的互补信息"，丢弃会损害精度或需额外搜索，而打分与缓存重组又抵消压缩收益。
AI.method: CanopyKV为免训练框架：(1) 借助裁剪的父子关系保留互补证据；(2) 保持已保留历史的稳定；(3) 保护持续推理所需状态；(4) 利用工具元数据提供保留信号，无需额外注意力打分；(5) 采用紧凑KV存储降低后续注意力开销。
AI.result: 在VisualProbe、V*、HR-Bench、MME-Lite上，精度与端到端效率均为所评估KV压缩方法中的SOTA。MME-Lite上仅保留约Dense四分之一的KV，精度提升10.5个百分点，完整推理加速1.64倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于裁剪层级结构的免训练KV压缩可在主动视觉推理中兼顾证据保留与效率，避免传统注意力/近因性压缩的证据丢失问题，实现精度与速度双赢。

title: Where Should a Diffusion Transformer Meet Its Teacher?
summary: Representation Alignment (REPA) significantly accelerates Diffusion Transformer training by guiding intermediate student features with a pretrained visual teacher, yet existing methods typically attach supervision to a single fixed layer. As student representations evolve, however, we find that the most effective layer for alignment varies across training stages. To track this evolving layer suitability online without costly search, we measure gradient compatibility between the flow-matching and alignment objectives, and propose AdaREPA, an online routing framework that adaptively selects the supervision layer as training progresses. AdaREPA uses a softmax distribution over smoothed layer compatibility scores to sample a layer for alignment at each training step. This probabilistic routing adapts teacher supervision to the student's changing learning needs, with minimal training overhead and no additional inference cost. On ImageNet-256, AdaREPA accelerates convergence and improves generation quality across model sizes, while revealing how the most suitable layers for supervision shift over training.

AI.tldr: AdaREPA 提出在线路由框架，依据流匹配与对齐目标之间的梯度兼容性自适应选择对齐层，无需搜索即可提升 DiT 训练效率与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 REPA 类方法将教师监督固定挂在单一层，但学生表示随训练演化，最优对齐层会随训练阶段变化。
AI.method: 在线测量流匹配目标与对齐目标之间的梯度兼容性，对平滑后的逐层兼容性分数做 softmax 分布，每步按概率采样一个层进行对齐，避免昂贵搜索且几乎不增加开销。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，不同模型规模下均加速收敛并提升生成质量，同时揭示最优监督层随训练迁移的规律。
AI.conclusion: 动态、概率化的对齐层选择优于固定层策略，且无额外推理成本。

title: Enhancing Active Learning Performance with Initial Data Selection Based on Foundation Models
summary: In active object detection, selecting the initial labeled pool is essential, especially in complex datasets with expensive labeling and low resource budget. This study presents an active learning framework designed to optimize the initial training cycle of active learning for the object detection task. Our approach diverges from traditional methods by utilizing feature-based clustering from the YOLO-World model and refining images based on objectness scores rather than relying on uncertainty sampling in the initial cycle. This approach focuses on finding samples with various features and emphasizes training in areas where the foundation model is most confident. Doing so helps the model better understand different types of objects. For subsequent cycles, we employ a consistency-based sampling technique to maintain the robustness of the training process. To evaluate our method, we use two complex datasets called Aquarium and NWPU VHR-10, which are well known for their diverse object sizes and challenging conditions. In the NWPU dataset, our method increases mAP50 by an average of 6.6% in image-based evaluation. Moreover, the image refinement method shows an improvement of approximately 11% in object-based evaluation. The results show improvements in model performance and labeling time, demonstrating the advantages of using foundation models in early cycles of active learning. An implementation of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/Mhrshd-fllh/ALBoost-FM

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对主动目标检测初始训练轮的主动学习框架：利用YOLO-World的特征聚类并用objectness分数筛选图像，后续轮次采用一致性采样，在Aquarium和NWPU VHR-10上提升mAP50约6.6%，基于物体的评估提升约11%。
AI.motivation: 主动目标检测中初始标注池的选择至关重要，尤其在高标注成本、低资源预算的复杂数据集上。传统初始轮依赖不确定性采样，未充分利用基础模型的先验知识。
AI.method: 基于YOLO-World提取特征进行基于特征的聚类以覆盖多样特征；按objectness分数对图像进行精炼筛选，优先训练基础模型最有信心的区域；后续主动学习轮次改用一致性采样（consistency-based sampling）以维持训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在Aquarium与NWPU VHR-10两个复杂数据集上验证。NWPU上mAP50在图像级评估平均提升6.6%；图像精炼方法在物体级评估提升约11%；同时改善了模型性能与标注时间。
AI.conclusion: 在主动学习早期轮次引入基础模型（YOLO-World）可有效优化初始标注池选择，提升检测性能并降低标注开销，验证了基础模型在主动学习中的价值。

authors: Heitor Eduardo Ferreira Campos Morato Filpi
title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
summary: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.

AI.tldr: 提出一种迭代自训练的多任务DeepLabV3框架，用少量已标注树冠扩张单个树种级树冠（ITC）清单，在亚马逊和塞拉多两个巴西站点显著提升树冠级F1。
AI.motivation: 基于无人机影像的树种级单木树冠清单受标注成本限制，热带森林中许多树种仅有少量经野外验证的树冠样本，亟需低成本扩充标注清单的手段。
AI.method: 在RGB无人机正射影像上迭代自训练一个多任务DeepLabV3网络（语义分割+树冠距离回归头）；每轮候选树冠需同时通过类概率与距离图的置信度过滤，以及树冠面积与实心度的形态学过滤，且每树种每轮最多新增5个树冠，以保持与参考清单的一致性。
AI.result: 在Acre亚马逊雨林（17种、355个标注树冠、4cm GSD）和马拉尼昂塞拉多（4种、51个标注树冠、1.8cm GSD）评估：经20轮迭代，保留树冠数在Acre由约500增至960，在塞拉多由约700增至3100以上；树冠级F1超过单任务与多任务DeepLabV3基线（53.5% vs 50.0%/45.2%；92.2% vs 79.7%/83.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为借助消费级无人机与有限野外工作扩充树种清单提供了一条低成本路径。

title: RAPID: Reconstruction Accelerated by Polarization-Informed Depth for 2D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.

AI.tldr: RAPID：几何优先的偏振多视图高斯泼溅框架，用偏振线索恢复稠密表面先验以加速重建。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅多视图三维重建依赖稀疏几何初始化与迭代致密化，优化开销大，且在反光和弱纹理区域难以兼顾渲染质量与几何精度。
AI.method: 提出RAPID框架：利用多视图偏振线索恢复稠密表面先验；借助稀疏几何锚点将表面法线整合进深度图并跨视图融合；再采用曲率自适应采样与有向高斯初始化支持高效优化。
AI.result: 在PISR数据集上相较SOTA方法PhyGaP约5倍加速，平均优化时间从约21分钟降至4分钟，同时保持有竞争力的新视角合成质量与网格重建精度。
AI.conclusion: RAPID证明了利用偏振多视图输入加速高斯优化的有效性。

title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
summary: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.

AI.tldr: 提出StrideWorld基准，用先于被评运动固定的参考（起始视角真值几何+各动作的stride）来检测交互视频世界模型中的场景形变与动作不一致，评测多个开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准的参考多拟合于待测视频本身（自重建场景或自由缩放的相机轨迹），会吸收逐渐的场景形变与节奏、路线长度变化，导致这些错误无法被发现。
AI.method: 参考在评判前固定：场景刚性用起始视角的真值几何评估；动作一致性用每个动作的stride（单条命令的相机运动）评估，先用模型最初几步测出stride，再检验后续步骤，使每个模型只与自身步幅比较。测量在已知相机运动的渲染视频上验证，并与人工判断比对。
AI.result: 在140个起始视角、多个模型生成的视频上：除一个模型外其余都随相机移动产生形变，偏移可达同一路径刚性渲染的7.3倍；单动作持续时多数模型节奏稳定；组合路线中多个模型常中途停滞，多数完成路线的终点偏离按自身stride预测的位置；仅两个按估计场景深度缩放命令的模型能让多数路线接近预测位置；用少量渲染片段微调可消除两模型大部分中途停滞。
AI.conclusion: 以固定参考和自步幅对齐的基准能揭示此前被掩盖的形变与动作不一致问题，并指出按深度缩放命令与轻量微调是有效改进方向；代码、数据与榜单已公开。

title: Why Multi-Source Audio Fails to Compose: A Geometric Diagnosis and Its Remedy
summary: Multi-source audio-to-image generation exhibits consistent compositional failures when audio tokens occupy geometrically displaced, semantically unanchored positions in the CLIP text-token space, where the diffusion U-Net lacks the prior to reliably attend to them or ground them in distinct spatial regions. We formalize this as the geometric displacement phenomenon and expose it through a two-level clustering analysis comparing BEATs and CLAP embeddings at the raw encoder and projected CLIP token levels. Three geometric properties emerge as important: intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that CLAP, whose contrastive language-audio pretraining aligns embeddings with natural language semantics, substantially outperforms BEATs on all three properties, improving the silhouette score by more than 3x and the Audio-Image Content score as well. Building on this analysis, we introduce a multi-token extension that requires no diffusion-backbone retraining and assigns each audio source to a distinct placeholder token in the CLIP tokenizer, complemented by a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with an A* spatial separation loss to resolve residual cross-token interference. For evaluation, we construct multi-audio compositional benchmarks from VGGSound (VGG2, VGG3, and VGGN) and extend six standard audio-image metrics to the multi-source setting. Across five benchmarks and four strong baselines, our method achieves strong results on the metrics most directly tied to compositional faithfulness, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25x over the strongest baseline and FID reduced by nearly 2x on two-source generation. We propose geometric displacement as a diagnostic framework for cross-modal generation systems that project learned embeddings into a pretrained contrastive space.

AI.tldr: 本文将「多源音频到图像生成」的失败归因为「几何位移」现象：音频 token 在 CLIP 文本 token 空间中位置偏移、语义未锚定，导致 U-Net 难以关注与空间定位；作者用两级聚类分析量化该现象，并提出无需重训扩散主干的多 token 占位符方案与推理期混合目标，在多源基准上显著提升组合忠实度。
AI.motivation: 多源音频到图像生成存在稳定的组合性失败：多个音频源的 token 在 CLIP 文本 token 空间中彼此几何错位且缺乏语义锚定，扩散 U-Net 缺少相应先验去可靠关注这些 token 并将其落到不同空间区域。作者希望形式化并诊断这一问题，而非仅靠经验修补。
AI.method: 1) 提出「几何位移」概念，用两级聚类（原始编码器级 vs 投影后 CLIP token 级）比较 BEATs 与 CLAP 嵌入，归纳三个几何性质：类内紧致度、与 CLIP 文本流形的角度对齐、token 间空间分离度。2) 基于诊断结果，设计无需重训扩散主干的多 token 扩展：为每个音频源分配 CLIP 分词器中独立的占位符 token。3) 推理期混合目标：结合 Attend-and-Excite 与 A* 空间分离损失，缓解残余的跨 token 干扰。4) 构造 VGGSound 派生的多音频组合基准 VGG2/VGG3/VGGN，并将六个标准音频-图像指标扩展到多源设定。
AI.result: CLAP 在三个几何性质上均显著优于 BEATs：轮廓系数提升 3 倍以上，Audio-Image Content（AIC）分数同样提升。在五个基准、四个强基线对比中，方法在直接反映组合忠实度的指标上表现突出：AIC 相对最强基线最高提升 2.25 倍，双源生成 FID 降低近 2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出「几何位移」作为诊断框架，适用于任何将学习到的嵌入投影进预训练对比空间（如 CLIP）的跨模态生成系统；并据此给出免重训的多 token 与推理期优化解决方案，验证了几何对齐对多源组合生成的关键作用。

title: PhysResponse: Probing the Physics of Video Generation with Controlled Interventions
comment: 11 pages. This version contains the main paper and references only. Supplementary material will be added in a later revision
summary: Video generation models are increasingly viewed as world simulators, which requires not only plausible motion but dynamics that respond correctly to specified physical parameters. Existing models, datasets and benchmarks, however, largely target physical plausibility, leaving this physical parameter responsiveness insufficiently explored. We introduce PhysResponse, a benchmark that measures it at two levels: scene-conditioned simulator inversion recovers the effective gravity, friction and initial speed of generated motion, and event evaluation tests outcomes near and across critical transitions. Evaluating ten image-to-video models, we find that even the lowest parameter errors exceed those of physically correct videos by over an order of magnitude, that models rarely reproduce both outcomes of a transition pair, and that the two levels expose complementary failures that visual metrics such as PSNR miss. To supply the missing training signal, we construct 72,000 simulated videos of 20 multi-object interaction types with controlled parameters; fine-tuning on them lowers parameter errors, even on held-out interaction types, and transfers to real videos and an external physics benchmark. Continued training with a numerical encoder further lowers all three errors on held-out types. PhysResponse provides a foundation for world simulators that follow physical conditions, not just appearances.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysResponse 基准，从"场景条件下的模拟器反演"（恢复有效重力、摩擦、初速度）和"临界事件结果评估"两个层面衡量视频生成模型对物理参数的响应性，并构造 7.2 万条受控参数模拟视频用于微调以弥补训练信号缺失。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型被视为世界模拟器，但现有模型、数据集和基准主要关注物理合理性（plausibility），而对其能否正确响应指定物理参数（responsiveness）探索不足。
AI.method: 在两级上评估：1）场景条件模拟器反演，从生成运动中恢复有效重力、摩擦与初速度；2）事件评估，测试临界转变附近及跨越临界的结果。评估 10 个图像到视频模型；并构建 72,000 条覆盖 20 种多物体交互类型、参数受控的模拟视频用于微调，另加数值编码器继续训练。
AI.result: 即便误差最小的模型，其参数误差也比物理正确视频高一个数量级以上；模型很少能同时复现一组临界转变的两种结果；两级评估揭示出 PSNR 等视觉指标遗漏的互补性缺陷。在构造数据上微调可降低参数误差，且在未见过的交互类型上仍有效，并可迁移到真实视频与外部物理基准；配合数值编码器继续训练进一步降低三项误差。
AI.conclusion: PhysResponse 为"遵循物理条件而非仅外观逼真"的世界模拟器提供了评测基础与训练信号。

title: Let a Small Model Read First: Faster Prefill for Long Interleaved Image-Text Inputs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages and collections of hundreds of images, but they are slow to start: on inputs of about 100K tokens, the prefill takes most of the wait for the first output token. A common approach prunes the input by scoring its tokens with the target model itself or with a small model of the same family that first writes an answer. However, this scoring takes much of the time that pruning saves. We find that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units (images or paragraphs), and that a small hybrid model finds them with one attention head of an early layer, even at half image resolution. Based on these findings, we propose SkimPrefill, which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first, up to that early layer, with images at half resolution. Most layers of the small hybrid model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) run in linear time, so this pass is short. SkimPrefill then ranks every unit with that head and gives the target the top units as an ordinary shorter prompt. One untrained selector serves targets of different model families. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench at 128K tokens, with 19 datasets of five task types, show the effectiveness of SkimPrefill. With 10% of the input tokens kept, SkimPrefill speeds up the prefill of Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-VL-32B by 3.7 times, 11.6 time and 8.2 times while maintaining their average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出SkimPrefill：利用小型混合模型的早期注意力头以半分辨率快速筛选长输入中的少数关键单元（图像/段落），为预填充提速。
AI.motivation: VLM在约100K token的长交错输入上预填充耗时占首token等待的大头；现有剪枝需用目标模型或同族小模型先写答案再打分，打分本身耗时抵消了剪枝收益。
AI.method: 发现：问题证据集中于少数完整单元，且小型混合模型某一早期层的单个注意力头即可定位，半分辨率也行。据此让小型混合模型(Qwen3.5-0.8B)先以半分辨率读完全输入至该早期层（多数层线性时间，故很快），用该头对每个单元排序，把top单元作为普通短提示交给目标模型；选择器无需训练，可跨模型族通用。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench 128K、19个数据集5类任务上，保留10%输入token时，Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B、Qwen3-VL-32B的预填充分别加速3.7倍、11.6倍、8.2倍，且平均准确率保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 用轻量线性时间的前置扫描代替昂贵的打分式剪枝，可显著加速长上下文VLM预填充且无损精度，并具备跨模型族通用性。

title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出MLIE-CoT，一种基于多层级图像编辑的视觉思维链框架，让模型自适应选择修复粒度，以减少错误累积并保留正确语义。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图CoT主要依赖文本推理，无法保留图像中的视觉信息；而直接把图像作为上下文又会受不合适的早期图像干扰，整图重生成还会逐步累积幻觉。
AI.method: 构建覆盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集，训练修复层级路由器，使多模态模型能从三个层级中选择合适的图像编辑力度，实现细粒度视觉推理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MLIE-CoT显著优于其基础模型及固定修复策略方法，在多个基准上均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 多层级图像编辑式视觉CoT可有效保留正确语义、抑制错误内容影响，为视觉生成模型的复杂任务推理提供更优范式。

title: Explainable and CPU-Efficient Brain Tumor Classification from MRI Using Two-Phase EfficientNetB3 Fine-Tuning
summary: Brain tumors are among the most lethal neurological disorders, with over 308,000 new diagnoses annually worldwide. Accurate classification of tumor type from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is critical for treatment planning; however, manual radiological interpretation is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. This paper proposes an automated deep learning pipeline for four-class brain MRI classification (glioma, meningioma, no tumor, and pituitary tumor) using EfficientNetB3 transfer learning with a custom classification head. A two-phase training strategy is adopted: Phase 1 trains the head with a frozen backbone (best validation accuracy: 92.77%), and Phase 2 selectively fine-tunes the top 37 layers at a 100x reduced learning rate (best validation accuracy: 94.91%). On an independent balanced test set of 1,600 MRI images, the system achieves 90.62% overall accuracy and a macro-average AUC of 0.9854. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is integrated for class-discriminative visual explainability. The proposed system simultaneously addresses three dimensions absent in prior work: high accuracy, CPU-only computational efficiency, and clinical interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于EfficientNetB3迁移学习的两阶段训练流水线，实现四类脑MRI分类，测试准确率90.62%、宏平均AUC 0.9854，并集成Grad-CAM实现可解释性，兼顾高精度、纯CPU效率与临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤是致命神经系统疾病，全球年新发超30.8万例；MRI分型对治疗规划至关重要，但人工阅片耗时且存在观察者间差异。现有工作往往难以同时满足高精度、低算力（CPU可用）与临床可解释性三个维度。
